## ek3d/addons/curves/NURBSUtils

```typescript
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import { Vector4 } from "../../math/Vector4";

/**
 * Finds knot vector span.
 *
 * @param p - The degree.
 * @param u - The parametric value.
 * @param U - The knot vector.
 * @return The span.
 */
export function findSpan(p: number, u: number, U: number[]): number {
  const n = U.length - p - 1;

  if (u >= U[n]) {
    return n - 1;
  }

  if (u <= U[p]) {
    return p;
  }

  let low = p;
  let high = n;
  let mid = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);

  while (u < U[mid] || u >= U[mid + 1]) {
    if (u < U[mid]) {
      high = mid;
    } else {
      low = mid;
    }

    mid = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
  }

  return mid;
}

/**
 * Calculates basis functions. See The NURBS Book, page 70, algorithm A2.2.
 *
 * @param span - The span in which `u` lies.
 * @param u - The parametric value.
 * @param p - The degree.
 * @param U - The knot vector.
 * @return Array[p+1] with basis functions values.
 */
export function calcBasisFunctions(span: number, u: number, p: number, U: number[]): number[] {
  const N: number[] = [];
  const left: number[] = [];
  const right: number[] = [];
  N[0] = 1.0;

  for (let j = 1; j <= p; ++j) {
    left[j] = u - U[span + 1 - j];
    right[j] = U[span + j] - u;

    let saved = 0.0;

    for (let r = 0; r < j; ++r) {
      const rv = right[r + 1];
      const lv = left[j - r];
      const temp = N[r] / (rv + lv);
      N[r] = saved + rv * temp;
      saved = lv * temp;
    }

    N[j] = saved;
  }

  return N;
}

/**
 * Calculates B-Spline curve points. See The NURBS Book, page 82, algorithm A3.1.
 *
 * @param p - The degree of the B-Spline.
 * @param U - The knot vector.
 * @param P - The control points
 * @param u - The parametric point.
 * @return The point for given `u`.
 */
export function calcBSplinePoint(p: number, U: number[], P: Vector4[], u: number): Vector4 {
  const span = findSpan(p, u, U);
  const N = calcBasisFunctions(span, u, p, U);
  const C = new Vector4(0, 0, 0, 0);

  for (let j = 0; j <= p; ++j) {
    const point = P[span - p + j];
    const Nj = N[j];
    const wNj = point.w * Nj;
    C.x += point.x * wNj;
    C.y += point.y * wNj;
    C.z += point.z * wNj;
    C.w += point.w * Nj;
  }

  return C;
}

/**
 * Calculates basis functions derivatives. See The NURBS Book, page 72, algorithm A2.3.
 *
 * @param span - The span in which `u` lies.
 * @param u - The parametric point.
 * @param p - The degree.
 * @param n - number of derivatives to calculate
 * @param U - The knot vector.
 * @return An array[n+1][p+1] with basis functions derivatives.
 */
export function calcBasisFunctionDerivatives(span: number, u: number, p: number, n: number, U: number[]): number[][] {
  const zeroArr: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= p; ++i) zeroArr[i] = 0.0;

  const ders: number[][] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i <= n; ++i) ders[i] = zeroArr.slice(0);

  const ndu: number[][] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i <= p; ++i) ndu[i] = zeroArr.slice(0);

  ndu[0][0] = 1.0;

  const left = zeroArr.slice(0);
  const right = zeroArr.slice(0);

  for (let j = 1; j <= p; ++j) {
    left[j] = u - U[span + 1 - j];
    right[j] = U[span + j] - u;

    let saved = 0.0;

    for (let r = 0; r < j; ++r) {
      const rv = right[r + 1];
      const lv = left[j - r];
      ndu[j][r] = rv + lv;

      const temp = ndu[r][j - 1] / ndu[j][r];
      ndu[r][j] = saved + rv * temp;
      saved = lv * temp;
    }

    ndu[j][j] = saved;
  }

  for (let j = 0; j <= p; ++j) {
    ders[0][j] = ndu[j][p];
  }

  for (let r = 0; r <= p; ++r) {
    let s1 = 0;
    let s2 = 1;

    const a: number[][] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= p; ++i) {
      a[i] = zeroArr.slice(0);
    }

    a[0][0] = 1.0;

    for (let k = 1; k <= n; ++k) {
      let d = 0.0;
      const rk = r - k;
      const pk = p - k;

      if (r >= k) {
        a[s2][0] = a[s1][0] / ndu[pk + 1][rk];
        d = a[s2][0] * ndu[rk][pk];
      }

      const j1 = rk >= -1 ? 1 : -rk;
      const j2 = r - 1 <= pk ? k - 1 : p - r;

      for (let j = j1; j <= j2; ++j) {
        a[s2][j] = (a[s1][j] - a[s1][j - 1]) / ndu[pk + 1][rk + j];
        d += a[s2][j] * ndu[rk + j][pk];
      }

      if (r <= pk) {
        a[s2][k] = -a[s1][k - 1] / ndu[pk + 1][r];
        d += a[s2][k] * ndu[r][pk];
      }

      ders[k][r] = d;

      const j = s1;
      s1 = s2;
      s2 = j;
    }
  }

  let r = p;

  for (let k = 1; k <= n; ++k) {
    for (let j = 0; j <= p; ++j) {
      ders[k][j] *= r;
    }

    r *= p - k;
  }

  return ders;
}

/**
 * Calculates derivatives of a B-Spline. See The NURBS Book, page 93, algorithm A3.2.
 *
 * @param p - The degree.
 * @param U - The knot vector.
 * @param P - The control points
 * @param u - The parametric point.
 * @param nd - The number of derivatives.
 * @return An array[d+1] with derivatives.
 */
export function calcBSplineDerivatives(p: number, U: number[], P: Vector4[], u: number, nd: number): Vector4[] {
  const du = nd < p ? nd : p;
  const CK: Vector4[] = [];
  const span = findSpan(p, u, U);
  const nders = calcBasisFunctionDerivatives(span, u, p, du, U);
  const Pw: Vector4[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < P.length; ++i) {
    const point = P[i].clone();
    const w = point.w;

    point.x *= w;
    point.y *= w;
    point.z *= w;

    Pw[i] = point;
  }

  for (let k = 0; k <= du; ++k) {
    const point = Pw[span - p].clone().multiplyScalar(nders[k][0]);

    for (let j = 1; j <= p; ++j) {
      point.add(Pw[span - p + j].clone().multiplyScalar(nders[k][j]));
    }

    CK[k] = point;
  }

  for (let k = du + 1; k <= nd + 1; ++k) {
    CK[k] = new Vector4(0, 0, 0);
  }

  return CK;
}

/**
 * Calculates "K over I".
 *
 * @param k - The K value.
 * @param i - The I value.
 * @return k!/(i!(k-i)!)
 */
export function calcKoverI(k: number, i: number): number {
  let nom = 1;

  for (let j = 2; j <= k; ++j) {
    nom *= j;
  }

  let denom = 1;

  for (let j = 2; j <= i; ++j) {
    denom *= j;
  }

  for (let j = 2; j <= k - i; ++j) {
    denom *= j;
  }

  return nom / denom;
}

/**
 * Calculates derivatives (0-nd) of rational curve. See The NURBS Book, page 127, algorithm A4.2.
 *
 * @param Pders - Array with derivatives.
 * @return An array with derivatives for rational curve.
 */
export function calcRationalCurveDerivatives(Pders: Vector4[]): Vector3[] {
  const nd = Pders.length;
  const Aders: Vector3[] = [];
  const wders: number[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < nd; ++i) {
    const point = Pders[i];
    Aders[i] = new Vector3(point.x, point.y, point.z);
    wders[i] = point.w;
  }

  const CK: Vector3[] = [];

  for (let k = 0; k < nd; ++k) {
    const v = Aders[k].clone();

    for (let i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
      v.sub(CK[k - i].clone().multiplyScalar(calcKoverI(k, i) * wders[i]));
    }

    CK[k] = v.divideScalar(wders[0]);
  }

  return CK;
}

/**
 * Calculates NURBS curve derivatives. See The NURBS Book, page 127, algorithm A4.2.
 *
 * @param p - The degree.
 * @param U - The knot vector.
 * @param P - The control points in homogeneous space.
 * @param u - The parametric point.
 * @param nd - The number of derivatives.
 * @return array with derivatives for rational curve.
 */
export function calcNURBSDerivatives(p: number, U: number[], P: Vector4[], u: number, nd: number): Vector3[] {
  const Pders = calcBSplineDerivatives(p, U, P, u, nd);
  return calcRationalCurveDerivatives(Pders);
}

/**
 * Calculates a rational B-Spline surface point. See The NURBS Book, page 134, algorithm A4.3.
 *
 * @param p - The first degree of B-Spline surface.
 * @param q - The second degree of B-Spline surface.
 * @param U - The first knot vector.
 * @param V - The second knot vector.
 * @param P - The control points in homogeneous space.
 * @param u - The first parametric point.
 * @param v - The second parametric point.
 * @param target - The target vector.
 */
export function calcSurfacePoint(
  p: number,
  q: number,
  U: number[],
  V: number[],
  P: Vector4[][],
  u: number,
  v: number,
  target: Vector3,
): void {
  const uspan = findSpan(p, u, U);
  const vspan = findSpan(q, v, V);
  const Nu = calcBasisFunctions(uspan, u, p, U);
  const Nv = calcBasisFunctions(vspan, v, q, V);
  const temp: Vector4[] = [];

  for (let l = 0; l <= q; ++l) {
    temp[l] = new Vector4(0, 0, 0, 0);
    for (let k = 0; k <= p; ++k) {
      const point = P[uspan - p + k][vspan - q + l].clone();
      const w = point.w;
      point.x *= w;
      point.y *= w;
      point.z *= w;
      temp[l].add(point.multiplyScalar(Nu[k]));
    }
  }

  const Sw = new Vector4(0, 0, 0, 0);
  for (let l = 0; l <= q; ++l) {
    Sw.add(temp[l].multiplyScalar(Nv[l]));
  }

  Sw.divideScalar(Sw.w);
  target.set(Sw.x, Sw.y, Sw.z);
}

/**
 * Calculates a rational B-Spline volume point. See The NURBS Book, page 134, algorithm A4.3.
 *
 * @param p - The first degree of B-Spline surface.
 * @param q - The second degree of B-Spline surface.
 * @param r - The third degree of B-Spline surface.
 * @param U - The first knot vector.
 * @param V - The second knot vector.
 * @param W - The third knot vector.
 * @param P - The control points in homogeneous space.
 * @param u - The first parametric point.
 * @param v - The second parametric point.
 * @param w - The third parametric point.
 * @param target - The target vector.
 */
export function calcVolumePoint(
  p: number,
  q: number,
  r: number,
  U: number[],
  V: number[],
  W: number[],
  P: Vector4[][][],
  u: number,
  v: number,
  w: number,
  target: Vector3,
): void {
  const uspan = findSpan(p, u, U);
  const vspan = findSpan(q, v, V);
  const wspan = findSpan(r, w, W);
  const Nu = calcBasisFunctions(uspan, u, p, U);
  const Nv = calcBasisFunctions(vspan, v, q, V);
  const Nw = calcBasisFunctions(wspan, w, r, W);
  const temp: Vector4[][] = [];

  for (let m = 0; m <= r; ++m) {
    temp[m] = [];

    for (let l = 0; l <= q; ++l) {
      temp[m][l] = new Vector4(0, 0, 0, 0);
      for (let k = 0; k <= p; ++k) {
        const point = P[uspan - p + k][vspan - q + l][wspan - r + m].clone();
        const weight = point.w;
        point.x *= weight;
        point.y *= weight;
        point.z *= weight;
        temp[m][l].add(point.multiplyScalar(Nu[k]));
      }
    }
  }

  const Sw = new Vector4(0, 0, 0, 0);
  for (let m = 0; m <= r; ++m) {
    for (let l = 0; l <= q; ++l) {
      Sw.add(temp[m][l].multiplyScalar(Nw[m]).multiplyScalar(Nv[l]));
    }
  }

  Sw.divideScalar(Sw.w);
  target.set(Sw.x, Sw.y, Sw.z);
}
```

## ek3d/addons/curves/NURBSVolume

```typescript
import type { Vector2 } from "../../math/Vector2";
import type { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import { Vector4 } from "../../math/Vector4";
import { calcVolumePoint } from "./NURBSUtils";

/** A NURBS volume using control points with optional z and weight coordinates. */
export class NURBSVolume {
  degree1: number;
  degree2: number;
  degree3: number;
  knots1: number[];
  knots2: number[];
  knots3: number[];
  controlPoints: Vector4[][][];

  constructor(
    degree1: number,
    degree2: number,
    degree3: number,
    knots1: number[],
    knots2: number[],
    knots3: number[],
    controlPoints: (Vector2 | Vector3 | Vector4)[][][],
  ) {
    this.degree1 = degree1;
    this.degree2 = degree2;
    this.degree3 = degree3;
    this.knots1 = knots1;
    this.knots2 = knots2;
    this.knots3 = knots3;
    this.controlPoints = [];
    const len1 = knots1.length - degree1 - 1;
    const len2 = knots2.length - degree2 - 1;
    const len3 = knots3.length - degree3 - 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < len1; ++i) {
      this.controlPoints[i] = [];
      for (let j = 0; j < len2; ++j) {
        this.controlPoints[i][j] = [];
        for (let k = 0; k < len3; ++k) {
          const point = controlPoints[i][j][k];
          this.controlPoints[i][j][k] = new Vector4(
            point.x,
            point.y,
            "z" in point ? point.z : undefined,
            "w" in point ? point.w : undefined,
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /** Writes the point at interpolation factors t1, t2 and t3 to target. */
  getPoint(t1: number, t2: number, t3: number, target: Vector3): void {
    const u = this.knots1[0] + t1 * (this.knots1[this.knots1.length - 1] - this.knots1[0]);
    const v = this.knots2[0] + t2 * (this.knots2[this.knots2.length - 1] - this.knots2[0]);
    const w = this.knots3[0] + t3 * (this.knots3[this.knots3.length - 1] - this.knots3[0]);
    calcVolumePoint(
      this.degree1,
      this.degree2,
      this.degree3,
      this.knots1,
      this.knots2,
      this.knots3,
      this.controlPoints,
      u,
      v,
      w,
      target,
    );
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/effects/OutlineEffect

```typescript
import { Side } from "../../constants";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { ShaderMaterial } from "../../materials/ShaderMaterial";
import { fog, displacementmap } from "../../renderers/shaders/UniformsLib";
import { mergeUniforms } from "../../renderers/shaders/UniformsUtils";
import type { Material } from "../../materials/Material";
import type { Texture } from "../../textures/Texture";
import type { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import type { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import type { Camera } from "../../cameras/Camera";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";
import type { WebGLShadowMapSystem } from "../../renderers/webgl/WebGLShadowMap";
import chunk_common from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/common.glsl";
import chunk_uv_pars_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/uv_pars_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_displacementmap_pars_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/displacementmap_pars_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_fog_pars_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/fog_pars_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_morphtarget_pars_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/morphtarget_pars_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_skinning_pars_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/skinning_pars_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_logdepthbuf_pars_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/logdepthbuf_pars_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_clipping_planes_pars_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/clipping_planes_pars_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_uv_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/uv_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_beginnormal_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/beginnormal_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_morphnormal_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/morphnormal_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_skinbase_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/skinbase_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_skinnormal_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/skinnormal_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_begin_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/begin_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_morphtarget_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/morphtarget_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_skinning_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/skinning_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_displacementmap_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/displacementmap_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_project_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/project_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_logdepthbuf_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/logdepthbuf_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_clipping_planes_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/clipping_planes_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_fog_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/fog_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_fog_pars_fragment from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/fog_pars_fragment.glsl";
import chunk_logdepthbuf_pars_fragment from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/logdepthbuf_pars_fragment.glsl";
import chunk_clipping_planes_pars_fragment from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/clipping_planes_pars_fragment.glsl";
import chunk_clipping_planes_fragment from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/clipping_planes_fragment.glsl";
import chunk_logdepthbuf_fragment from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/logdepthbuf_fragment.glsl";
import chunk_tonemapping_fragment from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/tonemapping_fragment.glsl";
import chunk_colorspace_fragment from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/colorspace_fragment.glsl";
import chunk_fog_fragment from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/fog_fragment.glsl";
import chunk_premultiplied_alpha_fragment from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/premultiplied_alpha_fragment.glsl";

type OutlineMaterial = ShaderMaterial & { displacementMap?: Texture | null };
type SourceMaterial = Material & {
  fog?: boolean;
  displacementMap?: Texture | null;
  displacementScale?: number;
  displacementBias?: number;
  wireframe?: boolean;
};
type OutlineScene = Object3D & { background?: Color | Texture | null };

export class OutlineEffect {
  enabled: boolean;
  autoClear: boolean;
  render: (scene: OutlineScene, camera: Camera) => void;
  renderOutline: (scene: OutlineScene, camera: Camera) => void;
  setSize: (width: number, height: number) => void;

  constructor(
    renderer: WebGLRenderer,
    parameters: {
      defaultThickness?: number;
      defaultColor?: number[];
      defaultAlpha?: number;
      defaultKeepAlive?: boolean;
    } = {},
  ) {
    this.enabled = true;
    this.autoClear = renderer.autoClear;

    const defaultThickness = parameters.defaultThickness !== undefined ? parameters.defaultThickness : 0.003;
    const defaultColor = new Color().fromArray(
      parameters.defaultColor !== undefined ? parameters.defaultColor : [0, 0, 0],
    );
    const defaultAlpha = parameters.defaultAlpha !== undefined ? parameters.defaultAlpha : 1.0;
    const defaultKeepAlive = parameters.defaultKeepAlive !== undefined ? parameters.defaultKeepAlive : false;

    // object.material.uuid -> outlineMaterial or
    // object.material[ n ].uuid -> outlineMaterial
    // save at the outline material creation and release
    // if it's unused removeThresholdCount frames
    // unless keepAlive is true.
    const cache: Record<string, { material: OutlineMaterial; used: boolean; keepAlive: boolean; count: number }> = {};

    const removeThresholdCount = 60;

    // outlineMaterial.uuid -> object.material or
    // outlineMaterial.uuid -> object.material[ n ]
    // save before render and release after render.
    const originalMaterials: Record<string, SourceMaterial> = {};

    // object.uuid -> originalOnBeforeRender
    // save before render and release after render.
    const originalOnBeforeRenders: Record<string, Object3D["onBeforeRender"]> = {};

    const uniformsOutline = {
      outlineThickness: { value: defaultThickness },
      outlineColor: { value: defaultColor },
      outlineAlpha: { value: defaultAlpha },
    };

    const vertexShader = [
      chunk_common,
      chunk_uv_pars_vertex,
      chunk_displacementmap_pars_vertex,
      chunk_fog_pars_vertex,
      chunk_morphtarget_pars_vertex,
      chunk_skinning_pars_vertex,
      chunk_logdepthbuf_pars_vertex,
      chunk_clipping_planes_pars_vertex,

      "uniform float outlineThickness;",

      "vec4 calculateOutline( vec4 pos, vec3 normal, vec4 skinned ) {",
      "	float thickness = outlineThickness;",
      "	const float ratio = 1.0;",
      "	vec4 pos2 = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4( skinned.xyz + normal, 1.0 );",
      // NOTE: subtract pos2 from pos because Side.Back objectNormal is negative
      "	vec4 norm = normalize( pos - pos2 );",
      "	return pos + norm * thickness * pos.w * ratio;",
      "}",

      "void main() {",

      chunk_uv_vertex,

      chunk_beginnormal_vertex,
      chunk_morphnormal_vertex,
      chunk_skinbase_vertex,
      chunk_skinnormal_vertex,

      chunk_begin_vertex,
      chunk_morphtarget_vertex,
      chunk_skinning_vertex,
      chunk_displacementmap_vertex,
      chunk_project_vertex,

      "	vec3 outlineNormal = - objectNormal;", // the outline material is always rendered with Side.Back

      "	gl_Position = calculateOutline( gl_Position, outlineNormal, vec4( transformed, 1.0 ) );",

      chunk_logdepthbuf_vertex,
      chunk_clipping_planes_vertex,
      chunk_fog_vertex,

      "}",
    ].join("\n");

    const fragmentShader = [
      chunk_common,
      chunk_fog_pars_fragment,
      chunk_logdepthbuf_pars_fragment,
      chunk_clipping_planes_pars_fragment,

      "uniform vec3 outlineColor;",
      "uniform float outlineAlpha;",

      "void main() {",

      chunk_clipping_planes_fragment,
      chunk_logdepthbuf_fragment,

      "	gl_FragColor = vec4( outlineColor, outlineAlpha );",

      chunk_tonemapping_fragment,
      chunk_colorspace_fragment,
      chunk_fog_fragment,
      chunk_premultiplied_alpha_fragment,

      "}",
    ].join("\n");

    function createMaterial() {
      return new ShaderMaterial({
        type: "OutlineEffect",
        uniforms: mergeUniforms([fog, displacementmap, uniformsOutline]),
        vertexShader: vertexShader,
        fragmentShader: fragmentShader,
        side: Side.Back,
      });
    }

    function getOutlineMaterialFromCache(originalMaterial: SourceMaterial) {
      let data = cache[originalMaterial.uuid];

      if (data === undefined) {
        data = {
          material: createMaterial(),
          used: true,
          keepAlive: defaultKeepAlive,
          count: 0,
        };

        cache[originalMaterial.uuid] = data;
      }

      data.used = true;

      return data.material;
    }

    function getOutlineMaterial(originalMaterial: SourceMaterial) {
      const outlineMaterial = getOutlineMaterialFromCache(originalMaterial);

      originalMaterials[outlineMaterial.uuid] = originalMaterial;

      updateOutlineMaterial(outlineMaterial, originalMaterial);

      return outlineMaterial;
    }

    function isCompatible(object: Object3D): object is Mesh {
      const mesh = object as Mesh;
      const geometry = mesh.geometry;
      const hasNormals = geometry !== undefined && geometry.attributes.normal !== undefined;

      return mesh.isMesh === true && mesh.material !== undefined && hasNormals === true;
    }

    function setOutlineMaterial(object: Object3D) {
      if (isCompatible(object) === false) return;

      if (Array.isArray(object.material)) {
        for (let i = 0, il = object.material.length; i < il; i++) {
          object.material[i] = getOutlineMaterial(object.material[i]);
        }
      } else {
        object.material = getOutlineMaterial(object.material);
      }

      /* oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/unbound-method -- Restore the original callback with its original receiver. */
      originalOnBeforeRenders[object.uuid] = object.onBeforeRender;
      object.onBeforeRender = onBeforeRender;
    }

    function restoreOriginalMaterial(object: Object3D) {
      if (isCompatible(object) === false) return;

      if (Array.isArray(object.material)) {
        for (let i = 0, il = object.material.length; i < il; i++) {
          object.material[i] = originalMaterials[object.material[i].uuid];
        }
      } else {
        object.material = originalMaterials[object.material.uuid];
      }

      object.onBeforeRender = originalOnBeforeRenders[object.uuid];
    }

    function onBeforeRender(
      renderer: WebGLRenderer,
      scene: Object3D,
      camera: Camera,
      geometry: BufferGeometry,
      material: OutlineMaterial,
    ) {
      const originalMaterial = originalMaterials[material.uuid];

      // just in case
      if (originalMaterial === undefined) return;

      updateUniforms(material, originalMaterial);
    }

    function updateUniforms(material: OutlineMaterial, originalMaterial: SourceMaterial) {
      const outlineParameters = originalMaterial.userData.outlineParameters as
        | { thickness?: number; color?: number[]; alpha?: number }
        | undefined;

      material.uniforms.outlineAlpha.value = originalMaterial.opacity;

      if (outlineParameters !== undefined) {
        if (outlineParameters.thickness !== undefined)
          material.uniforms.outlineThickness.value = outlineParameters.thickness;
        if (outlineParameters.color !== undefined)
          material.uniforms.outlineColor.value.fromArray(outlineParameters.color);
        if (outlineParameters.alpha !== undefined) material.uniforms.outlineAlpha.value = outlineParameters.alpha;
      }

      if (originalMaterial.displacementMap) {
        material.uniforms.displacementMap.value = originalMaterial.displacementMap;
        material.uniforms.displacementScale.value = originalMaterial.displacementScale;
        material.uniforms.displacementBias.value = originalMaterial.displacementBias;
      }
    }

    function updateOutlineMaterial(material: OutlineMaterial, originalMaterial: SourceMaterial) {
      if (material.name === "invisible") return;

      const outlineParameters = originalMaterial.userData.outlineParameters as
        | { visible?: boolean; alpha?: number; keepAlive?: boolean }
        | undefined;

      material.fog = originalMaterial.fog ?? false;
      material.toneMapped = originalMaterial.toneMapped;
      material.premultipliedAlpha = originalMaterial.premultipliedAlpha;
      material.displacementMap = originalMaterial.displacementMap;

      if (outlineParameters !== undefined) {
        if (originalMaterial.visible === false) {
          material.visible = false;
        } else {
          material.visible = outlineParameters.visible !== undefined ? outlineParameters.visible : true;
        }

        material.transparent =
          outlineParameters.alpha !== undefined && outlineParameters.alpha < 1.0 ? true : originalMaterial.transparent;

        if (outlineParameters.keepAlive !== undefined)
          cache[originalMaterial.uuid].keepAlive = outlineParameters.keepAlive;
      } else {
        material.transparent = originalMaterial.transparent;
        material.visible = originalMaterial.visible;
      }

      if (originalMaterial.wireframe === true || originalMaterial.depthTest === false) material.visible = false;

      if (originalMaterial.clippingPlanes) {
        material.clipping = true;

        material.clippingPlanes = originalMaterial.clippingPlanes;
        material.clipIntersection = originalMaterial.clipIntersection;
        material.clipShadows = originalMaterial.clipShadows;
      }

      material.version = originalMaterial.version; // update outline material if necessary
    }

    function cleanupCache() {
      let keys;

      // clear originalMaterials
      keys = Object.keys(originalMaterials);

      for (let i = 0, il = keys.length; i < il; i++) {
        delete originalMaterials[keys[i]];
      }

      // clear originalOnBeforeRenders
      keys = Object.keys(originalOnBeforeRenders);

      for (let i = 0, il = keys.length; i < il; i++) {
        delete originalOnBeforeRenders[keys[i]];
      }

      // remove unused outlineMaterial from cache
      keys = Object.keys(cache);

      for (let i = 0, il = keys.length; i < il; i++) {
        const key = keys[i];

        if (cache[key].used === false) {
          cache[key].count++;

          if (cache[key].keepAlive === false && cache[key].count > removeThresholdCount) {
            delete cache[key];
          }
        } else {
          cache[key].used = false;
          cache[key].count = 0;
        }
      }
    }

    this.render = function (this: OutlineEffect, scene: OutlineScene, camera: Camera) {
      if (this.enabled === false) {
        renderer.render(scene, camera);
        return;
      }

      const currentAutoClear = renderer.autoClear;
      renderer.autoClear = this.autoClear;

      renderer.render(scene, camera);

      renderer.autoClear = currentAutoClear;

      this.renderOutline(scene, camera);
    };

    this.renderOutline = function (scene: OutlineScene, camera: Camera) {
      const currentAutoClear = renderer.autoClear;
      const currentSceneAutoUpdate = scene.matrixWorldAutoUpdate;
      const currentSceneBackground = scene.background;
      const shadowMap = renderer.shadowMap as WebGLShadowMapSystem | null;
      const currentShadowMapEnabled = shadowMap?.enabled;

      scene.matrixWorldAutoUpdate = false;
      scene.background = null;
      renderer.autoClear = false;
      if (shadowMap !== null) shadowMap.enabled = false;

      scene.traverse(setOutlineMaterial);

      renderer.render(scene, camera);

      scene.traverse(restoreOriginalMaterial);

      cleanupCache();

      scene.matrixWorldAutoUpdate = currentSceneAutoUpdate;
      scene.background = currentSceneBackground;
      renderer.autoClear = currentAutoClear;
      if (shadowMap !== null && currentShadowMapEnabled !== undefined) shadowMap.enabled = currentShadowMapEnabled;
    };

    this.setSize = function (width: number, height: number) {
      renderer.setSize(width, height);
    };
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/environments/ColorEnvironment

```typescript
import { Side } from "../../constants";
import { SphereGeometry } from "../../geometries/SphereGeometry";
import { MeshBasicMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshBasicMaterial";
import type { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import { Scene } from "../../scenes/Scene";

/** A uniform color scene for PMREMGenerator.fromScene(). */
export class ColorEnvironment extends Scene {
  constructor(color: number | Color = 0xffffff) {
    super();
    this.name = "ColorEnvironment";
    this.add(new Mesh(new SphereGeometry(1, 16, 16), new MeshBasicMaterial({ color, side: Side.Back })));
  }

  dispose(): void {
    const mesh = this.children[0] as Mesh<MeshBasicMaterial>;
    mesh.geometry.dispose();
    mesh.material.dispose();
  }
}

## ek3d/addons/environments/DebugEnvironment

```typescript
import type { Material } from "../../materials/Material";
import { Side } from "../../constants";
import { BoxGeometry } from "../../geometries/BoxGeometry";
import { PointLight } from "../../lights/PointLight";
import { MeshLambertMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshLambertMaterial";
import { MeshStandardMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshStandardMaterial";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import { Scene } from "../../scenes/Scene";

/** Simple debug room for generating image-based lighting. */
export class DebugEnvironment extends Scene {
  constructor() {
    super();
    const geometry = new BoxGeometry();
    geometry.deleteAttribute("uv");
    const room = new Mesh(geometry, new MeshStandardMaterial({ metalness: 0, side: Side.Back }));
    room.scale.setScalar(10);
    this.add(room, new PointLight(0xffffff, 50, 0, 2));
    const light1 = new Mesh(
      geometry,
      new MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xff0000, emissive: 0xffffff, emissiveIntensity: 10 }),
    );
    light1.position.set(-5, 2, 0);
    light1.scale.set(0.1, 1, 1);
    const light2 = new Mesh(
      geometry,
      new MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x00ff00, emissive: 0xffffff, emissiveIntensity: 10 }),
    );
    light2.position.set(0, 5, 0);
    light2.scale.set(1, 0.1, 1);
    const light3 = new Mesh(
      geometry,
      new MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x0000ff, emissive: 0xffffff, emissiveIntensity: 10 }),
    );
    light3.position.set(2, 1, 5);
    light3.scale.set(1.5, 2, 0.1);
    this.add(light1, light2, light3);
  }

  dispose(): void {
    const resources = new Set<{ dispose(): void }>();
    this.traverse((object) => {
      if (object instanceof Mesh) {
        resources.add(object.geometry);
        const materials: Material[] = Array.isArray(object.material) ? object.material : [object.material];
        for (const material of materials) resources.add(material);
      }
      if (object instanceof PointLight) resources.add(object);
    });
    for (const resource of resources) resource.dispose();
  }
}

## ek3d/addons/environments/RoomEnvironment

````typescript
import { Side } from "../../constants";
import { BoxGeometry } from "../../geometries/BoxGeometry";
import { PointLight } from "../../lights/PointLight";
import { MeshLambertMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshLambertMaterial";
import { MeshStandardMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshStandardMaterial";
import { InstancedMesh } from "../../objects/InstancedMesh";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import { Scene } from "../../scenes/Scene";

/**
 * This class represents a scene with a basic room setup that can be used as
 * input for {@link PMREMGenerator#fromScene}. The resulting PMREM represents the room's
 * lighting and can be used for Image Based Lighting by assigning it to {@link Scene#environment}
 * or directly as an environment map to PBR materials.
 *
 * The implementation is based on the [EnvironmentScene](https://github.com/google/model-viewer/blob/master/packages/model-viewer/src/three-components/EnvironmentScene.ts)
 * component from the `model-viewer` project.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const environment = new RoomEnvironment();
 * const pmremGenerator = new PMREMGenerator( renderer );
 *
 * const envMap = pmremGenerator.fromScene( environment ).texture;
 * scene.environment = envMap;
 * ```
 *
 * @augments Scene
 */
export class RoomEnvironment extends Scene {
  constructor() {
    super();

    this.name = "RoomEnvironment";
    this.position.y = -3.5;

    const geometry = new BoxGeometry();
    geometry.deleteAttribute("uv");

    const roomMaterial = new MeshStandardMaterial({ side: Side.Back });
    const boxMaterial = new MeshStandardMaterial();

    const mainLight = new PointLight(0xffffff, 900, 28, 2);
    mainLight.position.set(0.418, 16.199, 0.3);
    this.add(mainLight);

    const room = new Mesh(geometry, roomMaterial);
    room.position.set(-0.757, 13.219, 0.717);
    room.scale.set(31.713, 28.305, 28.591);
    this.add(room);

    const boxes = new InstancedMesh(geometry, boxMaterial, 6);
    const transform = new Object3D();

    // box1
    transform.position.set(-10.906, 2.009, 1.846);
    transform.rotation.set(0, -0.195, 0);
    transform.scale.set(2.328, 7.905, 4.651);
    transform.updateMatrix();
    boxes.setMatrixAt(0, transform.matrix);

    // box2
    transform.position.set(-5.607, -0.754, -0.758);
    transform.rotation.set(0, 0.994, 0);
    transform.scale.set(1.97, 1.534, 3.955);
    transform.updateMatrix();
    boxes.setMatrixAt(1, transform.matrix);

    // box3
    transform.position.set(6.167, 0.857, 7.803);
    transform.rotation.set(0, 0.561, 0);
    transform.scale.set(3.927, 6.285, 3.687);
    transform.updateMatrix();
    boxes.setMatrixAt(2, transform.matrix);

    // box4
    transform.position.set(-2.017, 0.018, 6.124);
    transform.rotation.set(0, 0.333, 0);
    transform.scale.set(2.002, 4.566, 2.064);
    transform.updateMatrix();
    boxes.setMatrixAt(3, transform.matrix);

    // box5
    transform.position.set(2.291, -0.756, -2.621);
    transform.rotation.set(0, -0.286, 0);
    transform.scale.set(1.546, 1.552, 1.496);
    transform.updateMatrix();
    boxes.setMatrixAt(4, transform.matrix);

    // box6
    transform.position.set(-2.193, -0.369, -5.547);
    transform.rotation.set(0, 0.516, 0);
    transform.scale.set(3.875, 3.487, 2.986);
    transform.updateMatrix();
    boxes.setMatrixAt(5, transform.matrix);

    this.add(boxes);

    // -x right
    const light1 = new Mesh(geometry, createAreaLightMaterial(50));
    light1.position.set(-16.116, 14.37, 8.208);
    light1.scale.set(0.1, 2.428, 2.739);
    this.add(light1);

    // -x left
    const light2 = new Mesh(geometry, createAreaLightMaterial(50));
    light2.position.set(-16.109, 18.021, -8.207);
    light2.scale.set(0.1, 2.425, 2.751);
    this.add(light2);

    // +x
    const light3 = new Mesh(geometry, createAreaLightMaterial(17));
    light3.position.set(14.904, 12.198, -1.832);
    light3.scale.set(0.15, 4.265, 6.331);
    this.add(light3);

    // +z
    const light4 = new Mesh(geometry, createAreaLightMaterial(43));
    light4.position.set(-0.462, 8.89, 14.52);
    light4.scale.set(4.38, 5.441, 0.088);
    this.add(light4);

    // -z
    const light5 = new Mesh(geometry, createAreaLightMaterial(20));
    light5.position.set(3.235, 11.486, -12.541);
    light5.scale.set(2.5, 2.0, 0.1);
    this.add(light5);

    // +y
    const light6 = new Mesh(geometry, createAreaLightMaterial(100));
    light6.position.set(0.0, 20.0, 0.0);
    light6.scale.set(1.0, 0.1, 1.0);
    this.add(light6);
  }

  /**
   * Frees internal resources. This method should be called
   * when the environment is no longer required.
   */
  override dispose(): void {
    const resources = new Set<{ dispose(): void } | { dispose(): void }[]>();

    this.traverse((object) => {
      const mesh = object as Mesh;
      if (mesh.isMesh) {
        resources.add(mesh.geometry);
        resources.add(mesh.material);
      }
    });

    for (const resource of resources) {
      if (Array.isArray(resource)) {
        for (const material of resource) material.dispose();
      } else {
        resource.dispose();
      }
    }
  }
}

function createAreaLightMaterial(intensity: number): MeshLambertMaterial {
  // create an emissive-only material. see #31348
  return new MeshLambertMaterial({
    color: 0x000000,
    emissive: 0xffffff,
    emissiveIntensity: intensity,
  });
}

## ek3d/addons/exporters/DRACOExporter

```typescript
import { ColorSpace } from "../../constants";
import type { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { ColorManagement } from "../../math/ColorManagement";
import type { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import type { Points } from "../../objects/Points";

export interface DracoEncoderOptions {
  decodeSpeed?: number;
  encodeSpeed?: number;
  encoderMethod?: number;
  quantization?: number[];
  exportUvs?: boolean;
  exportNormals?: boolean;
  exportColor?: boolean;
}

interface DracoArray {
  GetValue(index: number): number;
}
interface DracoMeshBuilder {
  AddFloatAttributeToMesh(mesh: object, type: number, count: number, size: number, values: ArrayLike<number>): void;
  AddFacesToMesh(mesh: object, count: number, values: ArrayLike<number>): void;
}
interface DracoPointCloudBuilder {
  AddFloatAttribute(cloud: object, type: number, count: number, size: number, values: ArrayLike<number>): void;
}
interface DracoEncoder {
  SetSpeedOptions(encode: number, decode: number): void;
  SetEncodingMethod(method: number): void;
  SetAttributeQuantization(attribute: number, bits: number): void;
  EncodeMeshToDracoBuffer(mesh: object, data: DracoArray): number;
  EncodePointCloudToDracoBuffer(cloud: object, deduplicate: boolean, data: DracoArray): number;
}
/** An initialized Draco encoder module supplied by the consumer. */
export interface DracoEncoderModule {
  Encoder: new () => DracoEncoder;
  MeshBuilder: new () => DracoMeshBuilder;
  PointCloudBuilder: new () => DracoPointCloudBuilder;
  Mesh: new () => object;
  PointCloud: new () => object;
  DracoInt8Array: new () => DracoArray;
  POSITION: number;
  NORMAL: number;
  TEX_COORD: number;
  COLOR: number;
  destroy(value: object): void;
}

/** Compresses a mesh or point cloud using an initialized Draco encoder module. */
export class DRACOExporter {
  static MESH_EDGEBREAKER_ENCODING: number = 1;
  static MESH_SEQUENTIAL_ENCODING: number = 0;
  static POINT_CLOUD: number = 0;
  static TRIANGULAR_MESH: number = 1;
  static INVALID: number = -1;
  static POSITION: number = 0;
  static NORMAL: number = 1;
  static COLOR: number = 2;
  static TEX_COORD: number = 3;
  static GENERIC: number = 4;
  private readonly module: DracoEncoderModule;

  constructor(module: DracoEncoderModule) {
    this.module = module;
  }

  async parseAsync(object: Mesh | Points, options: DracoEncoderOptions = {}): Promise<Int8Array> {
    const settings = {
      decodeSpeed: 5,
      encodeSpeed: 5,
      encoderMethod: DRACOExporter.MESH_EDGEBREAKER_ENCODING,
      quantization: [16, 8, 8, 8, 8],
      exportUvs: true,
      exportNormals: true,
      exportColor: false,
      ...options,
    };
    const draco = this.module;
    const geometry = object.geometry;
    const vertices = geometry.getAttribute("position") as BufferAttribute;
    let encoder: DracoEncoder | undefined;
    let builder: DracoMeshBuilder | DracoPointCloudBuilder | undefined;
    let dracoObject: object | undefined;
    let encoded: DracoArray | undefined;
    try {
      encoder = new draco.Encoder();
      const isMesh = "isMesh" in object && object.isMesh === true;
      if (isMesh) {
        const meshBuilder = new draco.MeshBuilder();
        builder = meshBuilder;
        dracoObject = new draco.Mesh();
        meshBuilder.AddFloatAttributeToMesh(
          dracoObject,
          draco.POSITION,
          vertices.count,
          vertices.itemSize,
          vertices.array,
        );
        const index = geometry.getIndex();
        if (index !== null) meshBuilder.AddFacesToMesh(dracoObject, index.count / 3, index.array);
        else {
          const faces = new (vertices.count > 65535 ? Uint32Array : Uint16Array)(vertices.count);
          for (let i = 0; i < faces.length; i++) faces[i] = i;
          // The builder expects a triangle count, not the vertex count used upstream.
          meshBuilder.AddFacesToMesh(dracoObject, vertices.count / 3, faces);
        }
        const normals = geometry.getAttribute("normal") as BufferAttribute | undefined;
        if (settings.exportNormals && normals)
          meshBuilder.AddFloatAttributeToMesh(
            dracoObject,
            draco.NORMAL,
            normals.count,
            normals.itemSize,
            normals.array,
          );
        const uvs = geometry.getAttribute("uv") as BufferAttribute | undefined;
        if (settings.exportUvs && uvs)
          meshBuilder.AddFloatAttributeToMesh(dracoObject, draco.TEX_COORD, uvs.count, uvs.itemSize, uvs.array);
        const colors = geometry.getAttribute("color") as BufferAttribute | undefined;
        if (settings.exportColor && colors)
          meshBuilder.AddFloatAttributeToMesh(
            dracoObject,
            draco.COLOR,
            colors.count,
            colors.itemSize,
            vertexColors(colors),
          );
      } else if ("isPoints" in object && object.isPoints === true) {
        const pointBuilder = new draco.PointCloudBuilder();
        builder = pointBuilder;
        dracoObject = new draco.PointCloud();
        pointBuilder.AddFloatAttribute(dracoObject, draco.POSITION, vertices.count, vertices.itemSize, vertices.array);
        const colors = geometry.getAttribute("color") as BufferAttribute | undefined;
        if (settings.exportColor && colors)
          pointBuilder.AddFloatAttribute(dracoObject, draco.COLOR, colors.count, colors.itemSize, vertexColors(colors));
      } else {
        throw new Error("THREE.DRACOExporter: Unsupported object type.");
      }
      encoded = new draco.DracoInt8Array();
      encoder.SetSpeedOptions(settings.encodeSpeed ?? 5, settings.decodeSpeed ?? 5);
      if (settings.encoderMethod !== undefined) encoder.SetEncodingMethod(settings.encoderMethod);
      if (settings.quantization !== undefined)
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
          if (settings.quantization[i] !== undefined) encoder.SetAttributeQuantization(i, settings.quantization[i]);
        }
      const length = isMesh
        ? encoder.EncodeMeshToDracoBuffer(dracoObject, encoded)
        : encoder.EncodePointCloudToDracoBuffer(dracoObject, true, encoded);
      if (length === 0) throw new Error("THREE.DRACOExporter: Draco encoding failed.");
      const output = new Int8Array(length);
      for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) output[i] = encoded.GetValue(i);
      return output;
    } finally {
      if (dracoObject !== undefined) draco.destroy(dracoObject);
      if (encoded !== undefined) draco.destroy(encoded);
      if (encoder !== undefined) draco.destroy(encoder);
      if (builder !== undefined) draco.destroy(builder);
    }
  }

  parse(): never {
    throw new Error("THREE.DRACOExporter: parse() has been replaced by parseAsync().");
  }
}

function vertexColors(attribute: BufferAttribute): Float32Array {
  const color = new Color();
  const array = new Float32Array(attribute.count * attribute.itemSize);
  for (let i = 0; i < attribute.count; i++) {
    color.fromBufferAttribute(attribute, i);
    ColorManagement.workingToColorSpace(color, ColorSpace.SRGB);
    const offset = i * attribute.itemSize;
    array[offset] = color.r;
    array[offset + 1] = color.g;
    array[offset + 2] = color.b;
    if (attribute.itemSize === 4) array[offset + 3] = attribute.getW(i);
  }
  return array;
}
```

## ek3d/addons/exporters/EXRExporter

```typescript
import { TextureType, PixelFormat } from "../../constants";
import { toHalfFloat } from "../../extras/DataUtils";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";
import type { WebGLRenderTarget } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";
import type { DataTexture } from "../../textures/DataTexture";

export interface EXRCompressionRuntime {
  zlibSync(data: Uint8Array): Uint8Array;
}
export interface EXRExporterOptions {
  compression?: number;
  type?: number;
  textureIndex?: number;
}
interface Info {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  type: number;
  format: number;
  compression: number;
  blockLines: number;
  dataType: number;
  dataSize: number;
  numBlocks: number;
  numInputChannels: number;
  numOutputChannels: number;
  textureIndex?: number;
}
interface Chunks {
  data: { dataChunk: Uint8Array; size: number }[];
  totalSize: number;
}
interface Wave {
  l: number;
  h: number;
}
interface HuffmanTable {
  codes: Float64Array;
  lengths: Uint8Array;
  im: number;
  iM: number;
}
interface BitWriter {
  out: Uint8Array;
  offset: number;
  c: number;
  lc: number;
  overflow: boolean;
}
interface Offset {
  value: number;
}
interface ColorValues {
  r: number;
  g: number;
  b: number;
  a: number;
}
type Compare = (a: number, b: number) => boolean;

export class EXRExporter {
  private readonly runtime: EXRCompressionRuntime;
  constructor(runtime: EXRCompressionRuntime) {
    this.runtime = runtime;
  }
  parse(texture: DataTexture, options?: EXRExporterOptions): Promise<Uint8Array>;
  parse(renderer: WebGLRenderer, target: WebGLRenderTarget, options?: EXRExporterOptions): Promise<Uint8Array>;
  async parse(
    input: DataTexture | WebGLRenderer,
    targetOrOptions: WebGLRenderTarget | EXRExporterOptions = {},
    options: EXRExporterOptions = {},
  ): Promise<Uint8Array> {
    if (input && "isWebGLRenderer" in input && input.isWebGLRenderer) {
      const target = targetOrOptions as WebGLRenderTarget;
      supportedRTT(target, options);
      const info = buildInfoRTT(target, options);
      const pixels = await getPixelData(input, target, info);
      return fillData(compressData(reorganizeDataBuffer(pixels, info), info, this.runtime), info);
    }
    if (input && "isDataTexture" in input && input.isDataTexture) {
      supportedDT(input);
      const info = buildInfoDT(input, targetOrOptions as EXRExporterOptions);
      const pixels = input.image.data as Float32Array | Uint16Array;
      return fillData(compressData(reorganizeDataBuffer(pixels, info), info, this.runtime), info);
    }
    throw new Error("EXRExporter.parse: Unsupported first parameter, expected WebGLRenderer or DataTexture.");
  }
}

const textEncoder = new TextEncoder();

export const NO_COMPRESSION = 0;
export const RLE_COMPRESSION = 1;
export const ZIPS_COMPRESSION = 2;
export const ZIP_COMPRESSION = 3;
export const PIZ_COMPRESSION = 4;

const USHORT_RANGE = 1 << 16;
const BITMAP_SIZE = USHORT_RANGE >> 3;
const A_OFFSET = 1 << 15;
const M_OFFSET = 1 << 15;
const MOD_MASK = (1 << 16) - 1;
const HUF_ENCSIZE = (1 << 16) + 1;
const SHORT_ZEROCODE_RUN = 59;
const LONG_ZEROCODE_RUN = 63;
const SHORTEST_LONG_RUN = 2 + LONG_ZEROCODE_RUN - SHORT_ZEROCODE_RUN;
const LONGEST_LONG_RUN = 255 + SHORTEST_LONG_RUN;

function supportedRTT(renderTarget: WebGLRenderTarget, options: EXRExporterOptions = {}) {
  if (!renderTarget || !renderTarget.isRenderTarget) {
    throw Error("EXRExporter.parse: Unsupported second parameter, expected instance of WebGLRenderTarget.");
  }

  const textureIndex = options.textureIndex !== undefined ? options.textureIndex : 0;
  const texture = renderTarget.textures[textureIndex];

  if (texture === undefined) {
    throw Error(
      "EXRExporter.parse: Invalid textureIndex, the render target has " + renderTarget.textures.length + " texture(s).",
    );
  }

  if (
    ("isCubeRenderTarget" in renderTarget && renderTarget.isCubeRenderTarget) ||
    ("isWebGLCubeRenderTarget" in renderTarget && renderTarget.isWebGLCubeRenderTarget) ||
    ("isWebGL3DRenderTarget" in renderTarget && renderTarget.isWebGL3DRenderTarget) ||
    ("isWebGLArrayRenderTarget" in renderTarget && renderTarget.isWebGLArrayRenderTarget)
  ) {
    throw Error("EXRExporter.parse: Unsupported render target type, expected instance of WebGLRenderTarget.");
  }

  if (texture.type !== TextureType.Float && texture.type !== TextureType.HalfFloat) {
    throw Error("EXRExporter.parse: Unsupported WebGLRenderTarget texture type.");
  }

  if (texture.format !== PixelFormat.RGBA) {
    throw Error("EXRExporter.parse: Unsupported WebGLRenderTarget texture format, expected RGBAFormat.");
  }
}

function supportedDT(texture: DataTexture) {
  if (texture.type !== TextureType.Float && texture.type !== TextureType.HalfFloat) {
    throw Error("EXRExporter.parse: Unsupported DataTexture texture type.");
  }

  if (texture.format !== PixelFormat.RGBA) {
    throw Error("EXRExporter.parse: Unsupported DataTexture texture format, expected RGBAFormat.");
  }

  if (!texture.image.data) {
    throw Error("EXRExporter.parse: Invalid DataTexture image data.");
  }

  if (texture.type === TextureType.Float && texture.image.data.constructor.name !== "Float32Array") {
    throw Error("EXRExporter.parse: DataTexture image data doesn't match type, expected 'Float32Array'.");
  }

  if (texture.type === TextureType.HalfFloat && texture.image.data.constructor.name !== "Uint16Array") {
    throw Error("EXRExporter.parse: DataTexture image data doesn't match type, expected 'Uint16Array'.");
  }
}

function buildInfoRTT(renderTarget: WebGLRenderTarget, options: EXRExporterOptions = {}): Info {
  const compressionSizes: Record<number, number> = { 0: 1, 1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 16, 4: 32 };

  const TEXTURE_INDEX = options.textureIndex !== undefined ? options.textureIndex : 0,
    TEXTURE = renderTarget.textures[TEXTURE_INDEX],
    WIDTH = renderTarget.width,
    HEIGHT = renderTarget.height,
    TYPE = TEXTURE.type,
    FORMAT = TEXTURE.format,
    COMPRESSION = options.compression !== undefined ? options.compression : ZIP_COMPRESSION,
    EXPORTER_TYPE = options.type !== undefined ? options.type : TextureType.HalfFloat,
    OUT_TYPE = EXPORTER_TYPE === TextureType.Float ? 2 : 1,
    COMPRESSION_SIZE = compressionSizes[COMPRESSION],
    NUM_CHANNELS = 4;

  if (COMPRESSION_SIZE === undefined) throw new Error("EXRExporter.parse: Unsupported compression.");

  return {
    width: WIDTH,
    height: HEIGHT,
    type: TYPE,
    format: FORMAT,
    compression: COMPRESSION,
    blockLines: COMPRESSION_SIZE,
    dataType: OUT_TYPE,
    dataSize: 2 * OUT_TYPE,
    numBlocks: Math.ceil(HEIGHT / COMPRESSION_SIZE),
    numInputChannels: 4,
    numOutputChannels: NUM_CHANNELS,
    textureIndex: TEXTURE_INDEX,
  };
}

function buildInfoDT(texture: DataTexture, options: EXRExporterOptions = {}): Info {
  const compressionSizes: Record<number, number> = { 0: 1, 1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 16, 4: 32 };

  const WIDTH = texture.image.width,
    HEIGHT = texture.image.height,
    TYPE = texture.type,
    FORMAT = texture.format,
    COMPRESSION = options.compression !== undefined ? options.compression : ZIP_COMPRESSION,
    EXPORTER_TYPE = options.type !== undefined ? options.type : TextureType.HalfFloat,
    OUT_TYPE = EXPORTER_TYPE === TextureType.Float ? 2 : 1,
    COMPRESSION_SIZE = compressionSizes[COMPRESSION],
    NUM_CHANNELS = 4;

  if (COMPRESSION_SIZE === undefined) throw new Error("EXRExporter.parse: Unsupported compression.");

  return {
    width: WIDTH,
    height: HEIGHT,
    type: TYPE,
    format: FORMAT,
    compression: COMPRESSION,
    blockLines: COMPRESSION_SIZE,
    dataType: OUT_TYPE,
    dataSize: 2 * OUT_TYPE,
    numBlocks: Math.ceil(HEIGHT / COMPRESSION_SIZE),
    numInputChannels: 4,
    numOutputChannels: NUM_CHANNELS,
  };
}

async function getPixelData(
  renderer: WebGLRenderer,
  rtt: WebGLRenderTarget,
  info: Info,
): Promise<Float32Array | Uint16Array> {
  const dataBuffer =
    info.type === TextureType.Float
      ? new Float32Array(info.width * info.height * info.numInputChannels)
      : new Uint16Array(info.width * info.height * info.numInputChannels);
  await renderer.readRenderTargetPixelsAsync(
    rtt,
    0,
    0,
    info.width,
    info.height,
    dataBuffer,
    undefined,
    info.textureIndex,
  );
  return dataBuffer;
}

function reorganizeDataBuffer(inBuffer: Float32Array | Uint16Array, info: Info) {
  const w = info.width,
    h = info.height,
    dec = { r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, a: 0 },
    offset = { value: 0 },
    cOffset = info.numOutputChannels == 4 ? 1 : 0,
    getValue = info.type == TextureType.Float ? getFloat32 : getFloat16,
    setValue = info.dataType == 1 ? setFloat16 : setFloat32,
    outBuffer = new Uint8Array(info.width * info.height * info.numOutputChannels * info.dataSize),
    dv = new DataView(outBuffer.buffer);

  for (let y = 0; y < h; ++y) {
    for (let x = 0; x < w; ++x) {
      const i = y * w * 4 + x * 4;

      const r = getValue(inBuffer, i);
      const g = getValue(inBuffer, i + 1);
      const b = getValue(inBuffer, i + 2);
      const a = getValue(inBuffer, i + 3);

      const line = (h - y - 1) * w * (3 + cOffset) * info.dataSize;

      decodeLinear(dec, r, g, b, a);

      offset.value = line + x * info.dataSize;
      setValue(dv, dec.a, offset);

      offset.value = line + cOffset * w * info.dataSize + x * info.dataSize;
      setValue(dv, dec.b, offset);

      offset.value = line + (1 + cOffset) * w * info.dataSize + x * info.dataSize;
      setValue(dv, dec.g, offset);

      offset.value = line + (2 + cOffset) * w * info.dataSize + x * info.dataSize;
      setValue(dv, dec.r, offset);
    }
  }

  return outBuffer;
}

function compressData(inBuffer: Uint8Array, info: Info, runtime: EXRCompressionRuntime): Chunks {
  const chunks: Chunks = { data: [], totalSize: 0 };
  const size = info.width * info.numOutputChannels * info.blockLines * info.dataSize;
  const tmpBuffer =
    info.compression === RLE_COMPRESSION ||
    info.compression === ZIPS_COMPRESSION ||
    info.compression === ZIP_COMPRESSION
      ? new Uint8Array(size)
      : undefined;
  for (let i = 0; i < info.numBlocks; i++) {
    const arr = inBuffer.subarray(size * i, size * (i + 1));
    let block: Uint8Array;
    switch (info.compression) {
      case NO_COMPRESSION:
        block = arr;
        break;
      case RLE_COMPRESSION:
        block = compressRLE(arr, tmpBuffer!);
        break;
      case ZIPS_COMPRESSION:
      case ZIP_COMPRESSION:
        block = compressZIP(arr, tmpBuffer!, runtime);
        break;
      case PIZ_COMPRESSION:
        block = compressPIZ(arr, info);
        break;
      default:
        throw new Error("EXRExporter.parse: Unsupported compression.");
    }
    if (block.length >= arr.length) block = arr;
    chunks.totalSize += block.length;
    chunks.data.push({ dataChunk: block, size: block.length });
  }
  return chunks;
}

function reorderAndPredict(data: Uint8Array, tmpBuffer: Uint8Array) {
  tmpBuffer = tmpBuffer.subarray(0, data.length);

  //
  // Reorder the pixel data.
  //

  let t1 = 0,
    t2 = Math.floor((data.length + 1) / 2),
    s = 0;

  const stop = data.length - 1;

  while (true) {
    if (s > stop) break;
    tmpBuffer[t1++] = data[s++];

    if (s > stop) break;
    tmpBuffer[t2++] = data[s++];
  }

  //
  // Predictor.
  //

  let p = tmpBuffer[0];

  for (let t = 1; t < tmpBuffer.length; t++) {
    const d = tmpBuffer[t] - p + (128 + 256);
    p = tmpBuffer[t];
    tmpBuffer[t] = d;
  }

  return tmpBuffer;
}

function compressRLE(data: Uint8Array, tmpBuffer: Uint8Array) {
  tmpBuffer = reorderAndPredict(data, tmpBuffer);

  const out = new Uint8Array(tmpBuffer.length * 2);
  const end = tmpBuffer.length;

  let runs = 0,
    rune = 1,
    o = 0;

  while (runs < end) {
    let count = 0;

    while (rune < end && tmpBuffer[runs] === tmpBuffer[rune] && count < 127) {
      rune++;
      count++;
    }

    if (count >= 2) {
      out[o++] = count;
      out[o++] = tmpBuffer[runs];

      runs = rune;
    } else {
      count++;

      while (
        rune < end &&
        (rune + 1 >= end ||
          tmpBuffer[rune] !== tmpBuffer[rune + 1] ||
          rune + 2 >= end ||
          tmpBuffer[rune + 1] !== tmpBuffer[rune + 2]) &&
        count < 127
      ) {
        count++;
        rune++;
      }

      out[o++] = -count;

      while (runs < rune) out[o++] = tmpBuffer[runs++];
    }

    rune++;
  }

  return out.slice(0, o);
}

function compressZIP(data: Uint8Array, tmpBuffer: Uint8Array, runtime: EXRCompressionRuntime) {
  tmpBuffer = reorderAndPredict(data, tmpBuffer);

  const deflate = runtime.zlibSync(tmpBuffer);

  return deflate;
}

function compressPIZ(data: Uint8Array, info: Info) {
  const channels = info.numOutputChannels;
  const wcount = info.dataSize / 2;
  const nx = info.width;
  const bpl = nx * info.dataSize;
  const ny = data.length / (bpl * channels);
  const ndata = data.length / 2;

  const buffer = new Uint16Array(ndata);

  for (let y = 0; y < ny; y++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
      const src = (y * channels + c) * bpl;
      const dst = ((c * ny + y) * bpl) / 2;

      for (let i = 0; i < bpl / 2; i++) {
        buffer[dst + i] = data[src + 2 * i] | (data[src + 2 * i + 1] << 8);
      }
    }
  }

  const bitmap = new Uint8Array(BITMAP_SIZE);

  for (let i = 0; i < ndata; i++) {
    bitmap[buffer[i] >> 3] |= 1 << (buffer[i] & 7);
  }

  bitmap[0] &= ~1;

  let minNonZero = BITMAP_SIZE - 1;
  let maxNonZero = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < BITMAP_SIZE; i++) {
    if (bitmap[i]) {
      if (minNonZero > i) minNonZero = i;
      if (maxNonZero < i) maxNonZero = i;
    }
  }

  const lut = new Uint16Array(USHORT_RANGE);
  let k = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < USHORT_RANGE; i++) {
    if (i === 0 || bitmap[i >> 3] & (1 << (i & 7))) lut[i] = k++;
  }

  const maxValue = k - 1;

  for (let i = 0; i < ndata; i++) {
    buffer[i] = lut[buffer[i]];
  }

  for (let c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < wcount; j++) {
      wav2Encode(buffer, c * nx * ny * wcount + j, nx, wcount, ny, wcount * nx, maxValue);
    }
  }

  const bitmapLength = minNonZero <= maxNonZero ? maxNonZero - minNonZero + 1 : 0;

  const huf = hufCompress(buffer, data.length);

  if (huf === null) return data;

  const out = new Uint8Array(8 + bitmapLength + huf.length);
  const dv = new DataView(out.buffer);

  dv.setUint16(0, minNonZero, true);
  dv.setUint16(2, maxNonZero, true);
  out.set(bitmap.subarray(minNonZero, minNonZero + bitmapLength), 4);
  dv.setUint32(4 + bitmapLength, huf.length, true);
  out.set(huf, 8 + bitmapLength);

  return out;
}

const _wenc = { l: 0, h: 0 };

function wenc14(a: number, b: number, out: Wave) {
  const as = (a << 16) >> 16;
  const bs = (b << 16) >> 16;

  out.l = ((as + bs) >> 1) & 0xffff;
  out.h = (as - bs) & 0xffff;
}

function wenc16(a: number, b: number, out: Wave) {
  const ao = (a + A_OFFSET) & MOD_MASK;
  let m = (ao + b) >> 1;
  const d = ao - b;

  if (d < 0) m = (m + M_OFFSET) & MOD_MASK;

  out.l = m;
  out.h = d & MOD_MASK;
}

function wav2Encode(buffer: Uint16Array, j: number, nx: number, ox: number, ny: number, oy: number, mx: number) {
  const wenc = mx < 1 << 14 ? wenc14 : wenc16;
  const n = nx > ny ? ny : nx;

  let p = 1;
  let p2 = 2;

  while (p2 <= n) {
    let py = j;
    const ey = j + oy * (ny - p2);
    const oy1 = oy * p;
    const oy2 = oy * p2;
    const ox1 = ox * p;
    const ox2 = ox * p2;

    for (; py <= ey; py += oy2) {
      let px = py;
      const ex = py + ox * (nx - p2);

      for (; px <= ex; px += ox2) {
        const p01 = px + ox1;
        const p10 = px + oy1;
        const p11 = p10 + ox1;

        wenc(buffer[px], buffer[p01], _wenc);
        const i00 = _wenc.l,
          i01 = _wenc.h;

        wenc(buffer[p10], buffer[p11], _wenc);
        const i10 = _wenc.l,
          i11 = _wenc.h;

        wenc(i00, i10, _wenc);
        buffer[px] = _wenc.l;
        buffer[p10] = _wenc.h;

        wenc(i01, i11, _wenc);
        buffer[p01] = _wenc.l;
        buffer[p11] = _wenc.h;
      }

      if (nx & p) {
        const p10 = px + oy1;

        wenc(buffer[px], buffer[p10], _wenc);
        buffer[px] = _wenc.l;
        buffer[p10] = _wenc.h;
      }
    }

    if (ny & p) {
      let px = py;
      const ex = py + ox * (nx - p2);

      for (; px <= ex; px += ox2) {
        const p01 = px + ox1;

        wenc(buffer[px], buffer[p01], _wenc);
        buffer[px] = _wenc.l;
        buffer[p01] = _wenc.h;
      }
    }

    p = p2;
    p2 <<= 1;
  }
}

function hufCompress(raw: Uint16Array, maxLength: number) {
  const freq = new Float64Array(HUF_ENCSIZE);

  for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) freq[raw[i]]++;

  const table = hufBuildEncTable(freq);

  const out = new Uint8Array(maxLength);
  const writer = { out, offset: 20, c: 0, lc: 0, overflow: false };

  hufPackEncTable(table, writer);

  const tableLength = writer.offset - 20;
  const dataStart = writer.offset;

  writer.c = 0;
  writer.lc = 0;

  hufEncode(table, raw, writer);

  const nBits = (writer.offset - dataStart) * 8 + writer.lc;
  const length = dataStart + Math.ceil(nBits / 8);

  if (writer.overflow || length >= maxLength) return null;

  const dv = new DataView(out.buffer);

  dv.setUint32(0, table.im, true);
  dv.setUint32(4, table.iM, true);
  dv.setUint32(8, tableLength, true);
  dv.setUint32(12, nBits, true);
  dv.setUint32(16, 0, true);

  return out.subarray(0, length);
}

function hufBuildEncTable(frq: Float64Array): HuffmanTable {
  const hlink = new Uint32Array(HUF_ENCSIZE);
  const heap: number[] = [];

  let im = 0;
  let iM = 0;

  while (!frq[im]) im++;

  for (let i = im; i < HUF_ENCSIZE; i++) {
    hlink[i] = i;

    if (frq[i]) {
      heap.push(i);
      iM = i;
    }
  }

  iM++;
  frq[iM] = 1;
  heap.push(iM);

  let nf = heap.length;

  const greater = (a: number, b: number) => frq[a] > frq[b] || (frq[a] === frq[b] && a > b);

  makeHeap(heap, nf, greater);

  const lengths = new Uint8Array(HUF_ENCSIZE);

  while (nf > 1) {
    const mm = heap[0];
    popHeap(heap, nf, greater);
    nf--;

    const m = heap[0];
    popHeap(heap, nf, greater);

    frq[m] += frq[mm];
    pushHeap(heap, nf, greater);

    for (let j = m; ; j = hlink[j]) {
      lengths[j]++;

      if (hlink[j] === j) {
        hlink[j] = mm;
        break;
      }
    }

    for (let j = mm; ; j = hlink[j]) {
      lengths[j]++;

      if (hlink[j] === j) break;
    }
  }

  const n = new Float64Array(59);

  for (let i = 0; i < HUF_ENCSIZE; i++) n[lengths[i]]++;

  let c = 0;

  for (let i = 58; i > 0; i--) {
    const nc = Math.floor((c + n[i]) / 2);
    n[i] = c;
    c = nc;
  }

  const codes = new Float64Array(HUF_ENCSIZE);

  for (let i = 0; i < HUF_ENCSIZE; i++) {
    if (lengths[i] > 0) codes[i] = n[lengths[i]]++;
  }

  return { codes, lengths, im, iM };
}

function pushHeapHole(heap: number[], holeIndex: number, topIndex: number, value: number, greater: Compare) {
  let parent = Math.floor((holeIndex - 1) / 2);

  while (holeIndex > topIndex && greater(heap[parent], value)) {
    heap[holeIndex] = heap[parent];
    holeIndex = parent;
    parent = Math.floor((holeIndex - 1) / 2);
  }

  heap[holeIndex] = value;
}

function adjustHeap(heap: number[], holeIndex: number, len: number, value: number, greater: Compare) {
  const topIndex = holeIndex;
  let secondChild = holeIndex;

  while (secondChild < Math.floor((len - 1) / 2)) {
    secondChild = 2 * (secondChild + 1);

    if (greater(heap[secondChild], heap[secondChild - 1])) secondChild--;

    heap[holeIndex] = heap[secondChild];
    holeIndex = secondChild;
  }

  if ((len & 1) === 0 && secondChild === (len - 2) / 2) {
    secondChild = 2 * (secondChild + 1);
    heap[holeIndex] = heap[secondChild - 1];
    holeIndex = secondChild - 1;
  }

  pushHeapHole(heap, holeIndex, topIndex, value, greater);
}

function makeHeap(heap: number[], len: number, greater: Compare) {
  if (len < 2) return;

  for (let parent = Math.floor((len - 2) / 2); parent >= 0; parent--) {
    adjustHeap(heap, parent, len, heap[parent], greater);
  }
}

function pushHeap(heap: number[], len: number, greater: Compare) {
  pushHeapHole(heap, len - 1, 0, heap[len - 1], greater);
}

function popHeap(heap: number[], len: number, greater: Compare) {
  if (len > 1) {
    const last = len - 1;
    const value = heap[last];

    heap[last] = heap[0];
    adjustHeap(heap, 0, last, value, greater);
  }
}

function outputBits(writer: BitWriter, nBits: number, bits: number) {
  while (nBits > 0) {
    const k = Math.min(nBits, 16);
    nBits -= k;

    writer.c = (writer.c << k) | (Math.floor(bits / 2 ** nBits) % (1 << k));
    writer.lc += k;

    while (writer.lc >= 8) {
      writer.lc -= 8;

      if (writer.offset < writer.out.length) {
        writer.out[writer.offset++] = writer.c >> writer.lc;
      } else {
        writer.overflow = true;
      }
    }

    writer.c &= (1 << writer.lc) - 1;
  }
}

function hufPackEncTable(table: HuffmanTable, writer: BitWriter) {
  const { lengths, iM } = table;

  for (let im = table.im; im <= iM; im++) {
    const l = lengths[im];

    if (l === 0) {
      let zerun = 1;

      while (im < iM && zerun < LONGEST_LONG_RUN) {
        if (lengths[im + 1] > 0) break;

        im++;
        zerun++;
      }

      if (zerun >= 2) {
        if (zerun >= SHORTEST_LONG_RUN) {
          outputBits(writer, 6, LONG_ZEROCODE_RUN);
          outputBits(writer, 8, zerun - SHORTEST_LONG_RUN);
        } else {
          outputBits(writer, 6, SHORT_ZEROCODE_RUN + zerun - 2);
        }

        continue;
      }
    }

    outputBits(writer, 6, l);
  }

  if (writer.lc > 0) outputBits(writer, 8 - writer.lc, 0);
}

function hufEncode(table: HuffmanTable, raw: Uint16Array, writer: BitWriter) {
  const { codes, lengths, iM: rlc } = table;

  const sendCode = (s: number, runCount: number) => {
    if (lengths[s] + lengths[rlc] + 8 < lengths[s] * runCount) {
      outputBits(writer, lengths[s], codes[s]);
      outputBits(writer, lengths[rlc], codes[rlc]);
      outputBits(writer, 8, runCount);
    } else {
      while (runCount-- >= 0) outputBits(writer, lengths[s], codes[s]);
    }
  };

  let s = raw[0];
  let cs = 0;

  for (let i = 1; i < raw.length; i++) {
    const ns = raw[i];

    if (cs === 255 || s !== ns) {
      sendCode(s, cs);
      cs = 0;
      s = ns;
    } else {
      cs++;
    }
  }

  sendCode(s, cs);

  if (writer.lc > 0) {
    if (writer.offset < writer.out.length) {
      writer.out[writer.offset] = (writer.c << (8 - writer.lc)) & 0xff;
    } else {
      writer.overflow = true;
    }
  }
}

function fillHeader(outBuffer: Uint8Array, chunks: Chunks, info: Info) {
  const offset = { value: 0 };
  const dv = new DataView(outBuffer.buffer);

  setUint32(dv, 20000630, offset); // magic
  setUint32(dv, 2, offset); // mask

  // = HEADER =

  setString(dv, "compression", offset);
  setString(dv, "compression", offset);
  setUint32(dv, 1, offset);
  setUint8(dv, info.compression, offset);

  setString(dv, "screenWindowCenter", offset);
  setString(dv, "v2f", offset);
  setUint32(dv, 8, offset);
  setUint32(dv, 0, offset);
  setUint32(dv, 0, offset);

  setString(dv, "screenWindowWidth", offset);
  setString(dv, "float", offset);
  setUint32(dv, 4, offset);
  setFloat32(dv, 1.0, offset);

  setString(dv, "pixelAspectRatio", offset);
  setString(dv, "float", offset);
  setUint32(dv, 4, offset);
  setFloat32(dv, 1.0, offset);

  setString(dv, "lineOrder", offset);
  setString(dv, "lineOrder", offset);
  setUint32(dv, 1, offset);
  setUint8(dv, 0, offset);

  setString(dv, "dataWindow", offset);
  setString(dv, "box2i", offset);
  setUint32(dv, 16, offset);
  setUint32(dv, 0, offset);
  setUint32(dv, 0, offset);
  setUint32(dv, info.width - 1, offset);
  setUint32(dv, info.height - 1, offset);

  setString(dv, "displayWindow", offset);
  setString(dv, "box2i", offset);
  setUint32(dv, 16, offset);
  setUint32(dv, 0, offset);
  setUint32(dv, 0, offset);
  setUint32(dv, info.width - 1, offset);
  setUint32(dv, info.height - 1, offset);

  setString(dv, "channels", offset);
  setString(dv, "chlist", offset);
  setUint32(dv, info.numOutputChannels * 18 + 1, offset);

  setString(dv, "A", offset);
  setUint32(dv, info.dataType, offset);
  offset.value += 4;
  setUint32(dv, 1, offset);
  setUint32(dv, 1, offset);

  setString(dv, "B", offset);
  setUint32(dv, info.dataType, offset);
  offset.value += 4;
  setUint32(dv, 1, offset);
  setUint32(dv, 1, offset);

  setString(dv, "G", offset);
  setUint32(dv, info.dataType, offset);
  offset.value += 4;
  setUint32(dv, 1, offset);
  setUint32(dv, 1, offset);

  setString(dv, "R", offset);
  setUint32(dv, info.dataType, offset);
  offset.value += 4;
  setUint32(dv, 1, offset);
  setUint32(dv, 1, offset);

  setUint8(dv, 0, offset);

  // null-byte
  setUint8(dv, 0, offset);

  // = OFFSET TABLE =

  let sum = offset.value + info.numBlocks * 8;

  for (let i = 0; i < chunks.data.length; ++i) {
    setUint64(dv, sum, offset);

    sum += chunks.data[i].size + 8;
  }
}

function fillData(chunks: Chunks, info: Info) {
  const TableSize = info.numBlocks * 8,
    HeaderSize = 259 + 18 * info.numOutputChannels, // 259 + 18 * chlist
    offset = { value: HeaderSize + TableSize },
    outBuffer = new Uint8Array(HeaderSize + TableSize + chunks.totalSize + info.numBlocks * 8),
    dv = new DataView(outBuffer.buffer);

  fillHeader(outBuffer, chunks, info);

  for (let i = 0; i < chunks.data.length; ++i) {
    const data = chunks.data[i].dataChunk;
    const size = chunks.data[i].size;

    setUint32(dv, i * info.blockLines, offset);
    setUint32(dv, size, offset);

    outBuffer.set(data, offset.value);
    offset.value += size;
  }

  return outBuffer;
}

function decodeLinear(dec: ColorValues, r: number, g: number, b: number, a: number) {
  dec.r = r;
  dec.g = g;
  dec.b = b;
  dec.a = a;
}

function setUint8(dv: DataView, value: number, offset: Offset) {
  dv.setUint8(offset.value, value);

  offset.value += 1;
}

function setUint32(dv: DataView, value: number, offset: Offset) {
  dv.setUint32(offset.value, value, true);

  offset.value += 4;
}

function setFloat16(dv: DataView, value: number, offset: Offset) {
  dv.setUint16(offset.value, toHalfFloat(value), true);

  offset.value += 2;
}

function setFloat32(dv: DataView, value: number, offset: Offset) {
  dv.setFloat32(offset.value, value, true);

  offset.value += 4;
}

function setUint64(dv: DataView, value: number, offset: Offset) {
  dv.setBigUint64(offset.value, BigInt(value), true);

  offset.value += 8;
}

function setString(dv: DataView, string: string, offset: Offset) {
  const tmp = textEncoder.encode(string + "\0");

  for (let i = 0; i < tmp.length; ++i) {
    setUint8(dv, tmp[i], offset);
  }
}

function decodeFloat16(binary: number) {
  const exponent = (binary & 0x7c00) >> 10,
    fraction = binary & 0x03ff;

  return (
    (binary >> 15 ? -1 : 1) *
    (exponent
      ? exponent === 0x1f
        ? fraction
          ? NaN
          : Infinity
        : Math.pow(2, exponent - 15) * (1 + fraction / 0x400)
      : 6.103515625e-5 * (fraction / 0x400))
  );
}

function getFloat16(arr: Float32Array | Uint16Array, i: number) {
  return decodeFloat16(arr[i]);
}

function getFloat32(arr: Float32Array | Uint16Array, i: number) {
  return arr[i];
}

function equalArray(a: readonly number[], b: readonly number[]): boolean {
  return a.length === b.length && a.every((value, index) => value === b[index]);
}

function getMinMax(attribute: GLTFAttribute, start: number, count: number): { min: number[]; max: number[] } {
  const min: number[] = [];
  const max: number[] = [];
  min.length = max.length = attribute.itemSize;
  min.fill(Infinity);
  max.fill(-Infinity);
  for (let i = start; i < start + count; i++) {
    for (let component = 0; component < attribute.itemSize; component++) {
      let value =
        attribute.itemSize > 4
          ? attribute.array[i * attribute.itemSize + component]
          : component === 0
            ? attribute.getX(i)
            : component === 1
              ? attribute.getY(i)
              : component === 2
                ? attribute.getZ(i)
                : attribute.getW(i);
      if (attribute.itemSize <= 4 && attribute.normalized) value = MathUtils.normalize(value, attribute.array);
      min[component] = Math.min(min[component], value);
      max[component] = Math.max(max[component], value);
    }
  }
  return { min, max };
}

function getPaddedBufferSize(size: number): number {
  return Math.ceil(size / 4) * 4;
}

function getPaddedArrayBuffer(buffer: ArrayBuffer, paddingByte = 0): ArrayBuffer {
  const length = getPaddedBufferSize(buffer.byteLength);
  if (length === buffer.byteLength) return buffer;
  const padded = new Uint8Array(length);
  padded.set(new Uint8Array(buffer));
  if (paddingByte !== 0) padded.fill(paddingByte, buffer.byteLength);
  return padded.buffer;
}

function getCanvas(): HTMLCanvasElement | OffscreenCanvas {
  if (typeof document === "undefined" && typeof OffscreenCanvas !== "undefined") return new OffscreenCanvas(1, 1);
  return document.createElement("canvas");
}

function getToBlobPromise(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement | OffscreenCanvas, mimeType: string): Promise<Blob> {
  if (typeof OffscreenCanvas !== "undefined" && canvas instanceof OffscreenCanvas) {
    const quality = mimeType === "image/jpeg" ? 0.92 : mimeType === "image/webp" ? 0.8 : undefined;
    return canvas.convertToBlob({ type: mimeType, quality });
  }
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    (canvas as HTMLCanvasElement).toBlob(
      (blob) => (blob ? resolve(blob) : reject(new Error("THREE.GLTFExporter: Canvas encoding failed."))),
      mimeType,
    );
  });
}
