## ek3d/addons/helpers/PositionalAudioHelper

```typescript
import type { PositionalAudio } from "../../audio/PositionalAudio";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { LineBasicMaterial } from "../../materials/LineBasicMaterial";
import { degToRad } from "../../math/MathUtils";
import { Line } from "../../objects/Line";

/** Visualizes a positional source's directional cone as a child of that source. */
export class PositionalAudioHelper extends Line<LineBasicMaterial[]> {
  audio: PositionalAudio;
  range: number;
  divisionsInnerAngle: number;
  divisionsOuterAngle: number;
  constructor(
    audio: PositionalAudio,
    range: number = 1,
    divisionsInnerAngle: number = 16,
    divisionsOuterAngle: number = 2,
  ) {
    const geometry = new BufferGeometry();
    const divisions = divisionsInnerAngle + divisionsOuterAngle * 2;
    geometry.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array((divisions * 3 + 3) * 3), 3));
    super(geometry, [new LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffff00 }), new LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x00ff00 })]);
    this.audio = audio;
    this.range = range;
    this.divisionsInnerAngle = divisionsInnerAngle;
    this.divisionsOuterAngle = divisionsOuterAngle;
    this.type = "PositionalAudioHelper";
    this.update();
  }
  update(): void {
    const inner = degToRad(this.audio.panner.coneInnerAngle) / 2;
    const outer = degToRad(this.audio.panner.coneOuterAngle) / 2;
    const geometry = this.geometry;
    const positions = geometry.getAttribute("position") as BufferAttribute;
    let start = 0;
    geometry.clearGroups();
    const generateSegment = (from: number, to: number, divisions: number, materialIndex: number): void => {
      const step = (to - from) / divisions;
      positions.setXYZ(start, 0, 0, 0);
      let count = 1;
      for (let angle = from; angle < to; angle += step) {
        const stride = start + count;
        const next = Math.min(angle + step, to);
        positions.setXYZ(stride, Math.sin(angle) * this.range, 0, Math.cos(angle) * this.range);
        positions.setXYZ(stride + 1, Math.sin(next) * this.range, 0, Math.cos(next) * this.range);
        positions.setXYZ(stride + 2, 0, 0, 0);
        count += 3;
      }
      geometry.addGroup(start, count, materialIndex);
      start += count;
    };
    generateSegment(-outer, -inner, this.divisionsOuterAngle, 0);
    generateSegment(-inner, inner, this.divisionsInnerAngle, 1);
    generateSegment(inner, outer, this.divisionsOuterAngle, 0);
    positions.needsUpdate = true;
    this.material[0].visible = inner !== outer;
  }
  dispose(): void {
    this.geometry.dispose();
    this.material[0].dispose();
    this.material[1].dispose();
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/helpers/RapierHelper

```typescript
import { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { LineBasicMaterial } from "../../materials/LineBasicMaterial";
import { LineSegments } from "../../objects/LineSegments";
import type { RapierWorld } from "../physics/RapierPhysics";

/** Displays the colliders in a Rapier world. */
export class RapierHelper extends LineSegments<LineBasicMaterial> {
  world: RapierWorld;

  constructor(world: RapierWorld) {
    super(new BufferGeometry(), new LineBasicMaterial({ vertexColors: true }));
    this.world = world;
    this.frustumCulled = false;
  }

  update(): void {
    const { vertices, colors } = this.world.debugRender();
    const position = this.geometry.getAttribute("position");
    const color = this.geometry.getAttribute("color");
    if (
      position instanceof BufferAttribute &&
      color instanceof BufferAttribute &&
      position.array.length === vertices.length &&
      color.array.length === colors.length
    ) {
      position.array.set(vertices);
      color.array.set(colors);
      position.needsUpdate = true;
      color.needsUpdate = true;
    } else {
      if (position || color) this.geometry.dispose();
      this.geometry.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(vertices, 3));
      this.geometry.setAttribute("color", new BufferAttribute(colors, 4));
    }
  }

  dispose(): void {
    this.geometry.dispose();
    this.material.dispose();
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/helpers/RectAreaLightHelper

```typescript
import { Side } from "../../constants";
import { Float32BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { RectAreaLight } from "../../lights/RectAreaLight";
import { LineBasicMaterial } from "../../materials/LineBasicMaterial";
import { MeshBasicMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshBasicMaterial";
import type { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Line } from "../../objects/Line";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";

/** Visualizes the dimensions, color, and world transform of a rectangular area light. */
export class RectAreaLightHelper extends Line<LineBasicMaterial> {
  light: RectAreaLight;
  color: number | Color | string | undefined;

  constructor(light: RectAreaLight, color?: number | Color | string) {
    const geometry = new BufferGeometry();
    geometry.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute([1, 1, 0, -1, 1, 0, -1, -1, 0, 1, -1, 0, 1, 1, 0], 3));
    geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
    super(geometry, new LineBasicMaterial({ fog: false }));
    this.light = light;
    this.color = color;
    this.type = "RectAreaLightHelper";

    const face = new BufferGeometry();
    face.setAttribute(
      "position",
      new Float32BufferAttribute([1, 1, 0, -1, 1, 0, -1, -1, 0, 1, 1, 0, -1, -1, 0, 1, -1, 0], 3),
    );
    face.computeBoundingSphere();
    this.add(new Mesh(face, new MeshBasicMaterial({ side: Side.Back, fog: false })));
  }

  updateMatrixWorld(): void {
    this.scale.set(0.5 * this.light.width, 0.5 * this.light.height, 1);
    const face = this.children[0] as Mesh<MeshBasicMaterial>;
    if (this.color !== undefined) {
      this.material.color.set(this.color);
      face.material.color.set(this.color);
    } else {
      const color = this.material.color.copy(this.light.color).multiplyScalar(this.light.intensity);
      const max = Math.max(color.r, color.g, color.b);
      if (max > 1) color.multiplyScalar(1 / max);
      face.material.color.copy(color);
    }
    this.matrixWorld.extractRotation(this.light.matrixWorld).scale(this.scale).copyPosition(this.light.matrixWorld);
    face.matrixWorld.copy(this.matrixWorld);
  }

  /** Frees the GPU resources allocated by this helper. */
  dispose(): void {
    const face = this.children[0] as Mesh<MeshBasicMaterial>;
    this.geometry.dispose();
    this.material.dispose();
    face.geometry.dispose();
    face.material.dispose();
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/helpers/TextureHelper

```typescript
import { BoxGeometry } from "../../geometries/BoxGeometry";
import { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { Side } from "../../constants";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import { PlaneGeometry } from "../../geometries/PlaneGeometry";
import { ShaderMaterial } from "../../materials/ShaderMaterial";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import type { Texture } from "../../textures/Texture";
import type { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { mergeGeometries } from "../utils/BufferGeometryUtils";

type TextureKinds = Texture & {
  isCubeTexture?: boolean;
  isDataArrayTexture?: boolean;
  isCompressedArrayTexture?: boolean;
  isData3DTexture?: boolean;
  isCompressed3DTexture?: boolean;
};

export class TextureHelper extends Mesh<ShaderMaterial> {
  texture: Texture;

  constructor(texture: TextureKinds, width = 1, height = 1, depth = 1) {
    const material = new ShaderMaterial({
      type: "TextureHelperMaterial",

      side: Side.Double,
      transparent: true,

      uniforms: {
        map: { value: texture },
        alpha: { value: getAlpha(texture) },
      },

      vertexShader: [
        "attribute vec3 uvw;",

        "varying vec3 vUvw;",

        "void main() {",

        "	vUvw = uvw;",

        "	gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4( position, 1.0 );",

        "}",
      ].join("\n"),

      fragmentShader: [
        "precision highp float;",

        "precision highp sampler2DArray;",

        "precision highp sampler3D;",

        "uniform {samplerType} map;",

        "uniform float alpha;",

        "varying vec3 vUvw;",

        "vec4 textureHelper( in sampler2D map ) { return texture( map, vUvw.xy ); }",

        "vec4 textureHelper( in sampler2DArray map ) { return texture( map, vUvw ); }",

        "vec4 textureHelper( in sampler3D map ) { return texture( map, vUvw ); }",

        "vec4 textureHelper( in samplerCube map ) { return texture( map, vUvw ); }",

        "void main() {",

        "	gl_FragColor = linearToOutputTexel( vec4( textureHelper( map ).xyz, alpha ) );",

        "}",
      ]
        .join("\n")
        .replace("{samplerType}", getSamplerType(texture)),
    });

    const geometry = texture.isCubeTexture
      ? createCubeGeometry(width, height, depth)
      : createSliceGeometry(texture, width, height, depth);

    super(geometry, material);

    this.texture = texture;
    this.type = "TextureHelper";
  }

  dispose() {
    this.geometry.dispose();
    this.material.dispose();
  }
}

function getSamplerType(texture: TextureKinds) {
  if (texture.isCubeTexture) {
    return "samplerCube";
  } else if (texture.isDataArrayTexture || texture.isCompressedArrayTexture) {
    return "sampler2DArray";
  } else if (texture.isData3DTexture || texture.isCompressed3DTexture) {
    return "sampler3D";
  } else {
    return "sampler2D";
  }
}

function getImageCount(texture: TextureKinds) {
  if (texture.isCubeTexture) {
    return 6;
  } else if (
    texture.isDataArrayTexture ||
    texture.isCompressedArrayTexture ||
    texture.isData3DTexture ||
    texture.isCompressed3DTexture
  ) {
    // Array and 3D texture images carry their slice count as depth.
    const image = texture.image as { depth: number };
    return image.depth;
  } else {
    return 1;
  }
}

function getAlpha(texture: TextureKinds) {
  if (texture.isCubeTexture) {
    return 1;
  } else if (
    texture.isDataArrayTexture ||
    texture.isCompressedArrayTexture ||
    texture.isData3DTexture ||
    texture.isCompressed3DTexture
  ) {
    return Math.max(1 / getImageCount(texture), 0.25);
  } else {
    return 1;
  }
}

function createCubeGeometry(width: number, height: number, depth: number) {
  const geometry = new BoxGeometry(width, height, depth);

  const position = geometry.attributes.position as BufferAttribute;
  const uv = geometry.attributes.uv as BufferAttribute;
  const uvw = new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(uv.count * 3), 3);

  const _direction = new Vector3();

  for (let j = 0, jl = uv.count; j < jl; ++j) {
    _direction.fromBufferAttribute(position, j).normalize();

    const u = _direction.x;
    const v = _direction.y;
    const w = _direction.z;

    uvw.setXYZ(j, u, v, w);
  }

  geometry.deleteAttribute("uv");
  geometry.setAttribute("uvw", uvw);

  return geometry;
}

function createSliceGeometry(texture: TextureKinds, width: number, height: number, depth: number) {
  const sliceCount = getImageCount(texture);

  const geometries: BufferGeometry[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < sliceCount; ++i) {
    const geometry = new PlaneGeometry(width, height);

    if (sliceCount > 1) {
      geometry.translate(0, 0, depth * (i / (sliceCount - 1) - 0.5));
    }

    const uv = geometry.attributes.uv as BufferAttribute;
    const uvw = new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(uv.count * 3), 3);

    for (let j = 0, jl = uv.count; j < jl; ++j) {
      const u = uv.getX(j);
      const v = texture.flipY ? uv.getY(j) : 1 - uv.getY(j);
      const w =
        sliceCount === 1
          ? 1
          : texture.isDataArrayTexture || texture.isCompressedArrayTexture
            ? i
            : i / (sliceCount - 1);

      uvw.setXYZ(j, u, v, w);
    }

    geometry.deleteAttribute("uv");
    geometry.setAttribute("uvw", uvw);

    geometries.push(geometry);
  }

  return mergeGeometries(geometries)!;
}
```

## ek3d/addons/helpers/VertexNormalsHelper

````typescript
import { Float32BufferAttribute, type BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { InterleavedBufferAttribute } from "../../core/InterleavedBufferAttribute";
import type { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import { LineBasicMaterial } from "../../materials/LineBasicMaterial";
import type { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Matrix3 } from "../../math/Matrix3";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import { LineSegments } from "../../objects/LineSegments";

const _v1 = new Vector3();
const _v2 = new Vector3();
const _normalMatrix = new Matrix3();

/**
 * Visualizes an object's vertex normals. The geometry must have a normal attribute.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { VertexNormalsHelper } from 'ek3d/addons/helpers/VertexNormalsHelper';
 * import { BoxGeometry } from 'ek3d/geometries/BoxGeometry';
 * import { MeshStandardMaterial } from 'ek3d/materials/MeshStandardMaterial';
 * import { Mesh } from 'ek3d/objects/Mesh';
 * import { Scene } from 'ek3d/scenes/Scene';
 *
 * const scene = new Scene();
 * const mesh = new Mesh(new BoxGeometry(10, 10, 10, 2, 2, 2), new MeshStandardMaterial());
 * scene.add(mesh, new VertexNormalsHelper(mesh, 1, 0xff0000));
 * ```
 */
export class VertexNormalsHelper extends LineSegments<LineBasicMaterial> {
  object: Object3D & { geometry: BufferGeometry };
  size: number;
  readonly isVertexNormalsHelper: boolean;

  /**
   * @param object - The object for which to visualize vertex normals.
   * @param [size=1] - The helper's size.
   * @param [color=0xff0000] - The helper's color.
   */
  constructor(object: Object3D & { geometry: BufferGeometry }, size = 1, color: Color | string | number = 0xff0000) {
    const geometry = new BufferGeometry();
    const nNormals = object.geometry.attributes.normal.count;
    geometry.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(nNormals * 2 * 3, 3));
    super(geometry, new LineBasicMaterial({ color, toneMapped: false }));
    this.object = object;
    this.size = size;
    this.type = "VertexNormalsHelper";
    this.matrixAutoUpdate = false;
    this.isVertexNormalsHelper = true;
    this.update();
  }

  /** Updates the preview based on the object's world transform. */
  update(): void {
    this.object.updateMatrixWorld(true);
    _normalMatrix.getNormalMatrix(this.object.matrixWorld);
    const matrixWorld = this.object.matrixWorld;
    const position = this.geometry.attributes.position as BufferAttribute;
    const objGeometry = this.object.geometry;
    if (objGeometry) {
      const objPos = objGeometry.attributes.position as BufferAttribute | InterleavedBufferAttribute;
      const objNorm = objGeometry.attributes.normal as BufferAttribute | InterleavedBufferAttribute;
      let idx = 0;
      // Ignore indices and draw ranges, and render every normal.
      for (let j = 0, jl = objPos.count; j < jl; j++) {
        _v1.fromBufferAttribute(objPos, j).applyMatrix4(matrixWorld);
        _v2.fromBufferAttribute(objNorm, j).applyMatrix3(_normalMatrix).normalize().multiplyScalar(this.size).add(_v1);
        position.setXYZ(idx++, _v1.x, _v1.y, _v1.z);
        position.setXYZ(idx++, _v2.x, _v2.y, _v2.z);
      }
    }
    position.needsUpdate = true;
  }

  /** Frees the GPU resources allocated by this helper. */
  dispose(): void {
    this.geometry.dispose();
    this.material.dispose();
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/helpers/VertexTangentsHelper

````typescript
import { Float32BufferAttribute, type BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { InterleavedBufferAttribute } from "../../core/InterleavedBufferAttribute";
import type { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import { LineBasicMaterial } from "../../materials/LineBasicMaterial";
import type { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import { LineSegments } from "../../objects/LineSegments";

const _v1 = new Vector3();
const _v2 = new Vector3();

/**
 * Visualizes an object's vertex tangents. The geometry must have a tangent attribute.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { VertexTangentsHelper } from 'ek3d/addons/helpers/VertexTangentsHelper';
 * import { BoxGeometry } from 'ek3d/geometries/BoxGeometry';
 * import { MeshStandardMaterial } from 'ek3d/materials/MeshStandardMaterial';
 * import { Mesh } from 'ek3d/objects/Mesh';
 * import { Scene } from 'ek3d/scenes/Scene';
 *
 * const scene = new Scene();
 * const geometry = new BoxGeometry();
 * geometry.computeTangents();
 * const mesh = new Mesh(geometry, new MeshStandardMaterial());
 * scene.add(mesh, new VertexTangentsHelper(mesh, 1, 0xff0000));
 * ```
 */
export class VertexTangentsHelper extends LineSegments<LineBasicMaterial> {
  object: Object3D & { geometry: BufferGeometry };
  size: number;

  /**
   * @param object - The object for which to visualize vertex tangents.
   * @param [size=1] - The helper's size.
   * @param [color=0x00ffff] - The helper's color.
   */
  constructor(object: Object3D & { geometry: BufferGeometry }, size = 1, color: Color | string | number = 0x00ffff) {
    const geometry = new BufferGeometry();
    const nTangents = object.geometry.attributes.tangent.count;
    geometry.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(nTangents * 2 * 3, 3));
    super(geometry, new LineBasicMaterial({ color, toneMapped: false }));
    this.object = object;
    this.size = size;
    this.type = "VertexTangentsHelper";
    this.matrixAutoUpdate = false;
    this.update();
  }

  /** Updates the preview based on the object's world transform. */
  update(): void {
    this.object.updateMatrixWorld(true);
    const matrixWorld = this.object.matrixWorld;
    const position = this.geometry.attributes.position as BufferAttribute;
    const objGeometry = this.object.geometry;
    const objPos = objGeometry.attributes.position as BufferAttribute | InterleavedBufferAttribute;
    const objTan = objGeometry.attributes.tangent as BufferAttribute | InterleavedBufferAttribute;
    let idx = 0;
    // Ignore indices and draw ranges, and render every tangent.
    for (let j = 0, jl = objPos.count; j < jl; j++) {
      _v1.fromBufferAttribute(objPos, j).applyMatrix4(matrixWorld);
      _v2.fromBufferAttribute(objTan, j).transformDirection(matrixWorld).multiplyScalar(this.size).add(_v1);
      position.setXYZ(idx++, _v1.x, _v1.y, _v1.z);
      position.setXYZ(idx++, _v2.x, _v2.y, _v2.z);
    }
    position.needsUpdate = true;
  }

  /** Frees the GPU resources allocated by this helper. */
  dispose(): void {
    this.geometry.dispose();
    this.material.dispose();
  }
}

## ek3d/addons/helpers/ViewHelper

```typescript
import { CylinderGeometry } from "../../geometries/CylinderGeometry";
import { CanvasTexture } from "../../textures/CanvasTexture";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Euler } from "../../math/Euler";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import { MeshBasicMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshBasicMaterial";
import { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import { OrthographicCamera } from "../../cameras/OrthographicCamera";
import { Quaternion } from "../../math/Quaternion";
import { Raycaster } from "../../core/Raycaster";
import { Sprite } from "../../objects/Sprite";
import { SpriteMaterial } from "../../materials/SpriteMaterial";
import { ColorSpace } from "../../constants";
import { Vector2 } from "../../math/Vector2";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import { Vector4 } from "../../math/Vector4";
import type { Camera } from "../../cameras/Camera";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";

export class ViewHelper extends Object3D {
  isViewHelper: boolean;
  camera: Camera;
  animating: boolean;
  center: Vector3;
  location: { top: number | null; right: number; bottom: number; left: number | null };
  render: (renderer: WebGLRenderer) => void;
  handleClick: (event: PointerEvent) => boolean;
  setLabels: (x?: string, y?: string, z?: string) => void;
  setLabelStyle: (font?: string, color?: string, radius?: number) => void;
  update: (delta: number) => void;
  dispose: () => void;

  constructor(camera: Camera, domElement: HTMLElement) {
    super();

    this.isViewHelper = true;

    this.camera = camera;

    this.animating = false;

    this.center = new Vector3();

    this.location = {
      top: null,
      right: 0,
      bottom: 0,
      left: null,
    };

    const color1 = new Color("#ff4466");
    const color2 = new Color("#88ff44");
    const color3 = new Color("#4488ff");
    const color4 = new Color("#000000");

    const options: {
      labelX?: string;
      labelY?: string;
      labelZ?: string;
      font?: string;
      color?: string;
      radius?: number;
    } = {};

    const interactiveObjects: Sprite[] = [];
    const raycaster = new Raycaster();
    const mouse = new Vector2();
    const dummy = new Object3D();

    const orthoCamera = new OrthographicCamera(-2, 2, 2, -2, 0, 4);
    orthoCamera.position.set(0, 0, 2);

    const geometry = new CylinderGeometry(0.04, 0.04, 0.8, 5).rotateZ(-Math.PI / 2).translate(0.4, 0, 0);

    const xAxis = new Mesh<MeshBasicMaterial>(geometry, getAxisMaterial(color1));
    const yAxis = new Mesh<MeshBasicMaterial>(geometry, getAxisMaterial(color2));
    const zAxis = new Mesh<MeshBasicMaterial>(geometry, getAxisMaterial(color3));

    yAxis.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
    zAxis.rotation.y = -Math.PI / 2;

    this.add(xAxis);
    this.add(zAxis);
    this.add(yAxis);

    const spriteMaterial1 = getSpriteMaterial(color1);
    const spriteMaterial2 = getSpriteMaterial(color2);
    const spriteMaterial3 = getSpriteMaterial(color3);
    const spriteMaterial4 = getSpriteMaterial(color4);

    const posXAxisHelper = new Sprite(spriteMaterial1);
    const posYAxisHelper = new Sprite(spriteMaterial2);
    const posZAxisHelper = new Sprite(spriteMaterial3);
    const negXAxisHelper = new Sprite(spriteMaterial4);
    const negYAxisHelper = new Sprite(spriteMaterial4);
    const negZAxisHelper = new Sprite(spriteMaterial4);

    posYAxisHelper.position.y = 1;
    posZAxisHelper.position.z = 1;
    negXAxisHelper.position.x = -1;
    negYAxisHelper.position.y = -1;
    negZAxisHelper.position.z = -1;

    negYAxisHelper.material.opacity = 0.2;
    negZAxisHelper.material.opacity = 0.2;

    posYAxisHelper.userData.type = "posY";
    posZAxisHelper.userData.type = "posZ";

    negYAxisHelper.userData.type = "negY";

    this.add(posZAxisHelper);
    this.add(negXAxisHelper);
    this.add(negYAxisHelper);
    this.add(negZAxisHelper);

    interactiveObjects.push(posXAxisHelper);
    interactiveObjects.push(posYAxisHelper);
    interactiveObjects.push(posZAxisHelper);
    interactiveObjects.push(negXAxisHelper);
    interactiveObjects.push(negYAxisHelper);
    interactiveObjects.push(negZAxisHelper);

    const point = new Vector3();
    const dim = 128;
    const turnRate = 2 * Math.PI; // turn rate in angles per second

    this.render = function (this: ViewHelper, renderer: WebGLRenderer) {
      this.quaternion.copy(this.camera.quaternion).invert();
      this.updateMatrixWorld();

      point.set(0, 0, 1);
      point.applyQuaternion(this.camera.quaternion);

      //

      const location = this.location;

      let x, y;

      if (location.left !== null) {
        x = location.left;
      } else {
        x = domElement.offsetWidth - dim - location.right;
      }

      if (location.top !== null) {
        // Position from top
        y = domElement.offsetHeight - dim - location.top;
      } else {
        // Position from bottom
        y = location.bottom;
      }

      renderer.clearDepth();

      renderer.getViewport(viewport);
      renderer.setViewport(x, y, dim, dim);

      renderer.render(this, orthoCamera);

      renderer.setViewport(viewport.x, viewport.y, viewport.z, viewport.w);
    };

    const targetPosition = new Vector3();
    const targetQuaternion = new Quaternion();

    const q1 = new Quaternion();
    const q2 = new Quaternion();
    const viewport = new Vector4();
    let radius = 0;

    this.handleClick = function (this: ViewHelper, event: PointerEvent) {
      if (this.animating === true) return false;

      const rect = domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      const location = this.location;

      let offsetX, offsetY;

      if (location.left !== null) {
        offsetX = rect.left + location.left;
      } else {
        offsetX = rect.left + domElement.offsetWidth - dim - location.right;
      }

      if (location.top !== null) {
        offsetY = rect.top + location.top;
      } else {
        offsetY = rect.top + domElement.offsetHeight - dim - location.bottom;
      }

      mouse.x = ((event.clientX - offsetX) / dim) * 2 - 1;
      mouse.y = -((event.clientY - offsetY) / dim) * 2 + 1;

      raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, orthoCamera);

      const intersects = raycaster.intersectObjects(interactiveObjects);

      if (intersects.length > 0) {
        const intersection = intersects[0];
        const object = intersection.object;

        prepareAnimationData(object, this.center);

        this.animating = true;

        return true;
      } else {
        return false;
      }
    };

    this.setLabels = function (labelX?: string, labelY?: string, labelZ?: string) {
      options.labelX = labelX;
      options.labelY = labelY;
      options.labelZ = labelZ;

      updateLabels();
    };

    this.setLabelStyle = function (font?: string, color?: string, radius?: number) {
      options.font = font;
      options.color = color;
      options.radius = radius;

      updateLabels();
    };

    this.update = function (this: ViewHelper, delta: number) {
      const step = delta * turnRate;

      // animate position by doing a slerp and then scaling the position on the unit sphere

      q1.rotateTowards(q2, step);
      this.camera.position.set(0, 0, 1).applyQuaternion(q1).multiplyScalar(radius).add(this.center);

      // animate orientation

      this.camera.quaternion.rotateTowards(targetQuaternion, step);

      if (q1.angleTo(q2) === 0) {
        this.animating = false;
      }
    };

    this.dispose = function () {
      geometry.dispose();

      xAxis.material.dispose();
      yAxis.material.dispose();
      zAxis.material.dispose();

      posXAxisHelper.material.map!.dispose();
      posYAxisHelper.material.map!.dispose();
      posZAxisHelper.material.map!.dispose();
      negXAxisHelper.material.map!.dispose();
      negYAxisHelper.material.map!.dispose();
      negZAxisHelper.material.map!.dispose();

      posXAxisHelper.material.dispose();
      posYAxisHelper.material.dispose();
      posZAxisHelper.material.dispose();
      negXAxisHelper.material.dispose();
      negYAxisHelper.material.dispose();
      negZAxisHelper.material.dispose();
    };

    const prepareAnimationData = (object: Object3D, focusPoint: Vector3) => {
      switch (object.userData.type) {
        case "posX":
          targetPosition.set(1, 0, 0);
          targetQuaternion.setFromEuler(new Euler(0, Math.PI * 0.5, 0));
          break;

        case "posY":
          targetPosition.set(0, 1, 0);
          targetQuaternion.setFromEuler(new Euler(-Math.PI * 0.5, 0, 0));
          break;

        case "posZ":
          targetPosition.set(0, 0, 1);
          targetQuaternion.setFromEuler(new Euler());
          break;

        case "negX":
          targetPosition.set(-1, 0, 0);
          targetQuaternion.setFromEuler(new Euler(0, -Math.PI * 0.5, 0));
          break;

        case "negY":
          targetPosition.set(0, -1, 0);
          targetQuaternion.setFromEuler(new Euler(Math.PI * 0.5, 0, 0));
          break;

        case "negZ":
          targetPosition.set(0, 0, -1);
          targetQuaternion.setFromEuler(new Euler(0, Math.PI, 0));
          break;

        default:
          console.error("ViewHelper: Invalid axis.");
      }

      //

      radius = this.camera.position.distanceTo(focusPoint);
      targetPosition.multiplyScalar(radius).add(focusPoint);

      dummy.position.copy(focusPoint);

      dummy.lookAt(this.camera.position);
      q1.copy(dummy.quaternion);

      dummy.lookAt(targetPosition);
      q2.copy(dummy.quaternion);
    };

    function getAxisMaterial(color: Color) {
      return new MeshBasicMaterial({ color: color, toneMapped: false });
    }

    function useOffscreenCanvas() {
      let result = false;

      try {
        // this check has been adapted from WebGLTextures

        result = typeof OffscreenCanvas !== "undefined" && new OffscreenCanvas(1, 1).getContext("2d") !== null;
      } catch {
        // Ignore any errors
      }

      return result;
    }

    function createCanvas(width: number, height: number) {
      let canvas;

      if (useOffscreenCanvas()) {
        canvas = new OffscreenCanvas(width, height);
      } else {
        canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
        canvas.width = width;
        canvas.height = height;
      }

      return canvas;
    }

    function getSpriteMaterial(color: Color, text?: string) {
      const { font = "24px Arial", color: labelColor = "#000000", radius = 14 } = options;

      const canvas = createCanvas(64, 64);

      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      if (context === null) throw new Error("ViewHelper requires a 2D canvas context.");
      context.beginPath();
      context.arc(32, 32, radius, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      context.closePath();
      context.fillStyle = color.getStyle();
      context.fill();

      if (text) {
        context.font = font;
        context.textAlign = "center";
        context.fillStyle = labelColor;
        context.fillText(text, 32, 41);
      }

      const texture = new CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB;

      return new SpriteMaterial({ map: texture, toneMapped: false });
    }

    function updateLabels() {
      posXAxisHelper.material.map!.dispose();
      posYAxisHelper.material.map!.dispose();
      posZAxisHelper.material.map!.dispose();

      posXAxisHelper.material.dispose();
      posYAxisHelper.material.dispose();
      posZAxisHelper.material.dispose();

      posXAxisHelper.material = getSpriteMaterial(color1, options.labelX);
      posYAxisHelper.material = getSpriteMaterial(color2, options.labelY);
      posZAxisHelper.material = getSpriteMaterial(color3, options.labelZ);
    }
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/interaction/InteractionManager

````typescript
import { Matrix4 } from "../../math/Matrix4";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import type { Camera } from "../../cameras/Camera";
import type { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import type { HTMLTexture } from "../../textures/HTMLTexture";

const _pixelToLocal = new Matrix4();
const _mvp = new Matrix4();
const _viewport = new Matrix4();
const _size = new Vector3();

/** Any renderer exposing the canvas element used to host HTML textures. */
interface RendererLike {
  domElement: HTMLCanvasElement | OffscreenCanvas;
}

/**
 * Manages interaction for 3D objects independently of the scene graph.
 *
 * For objects with an {@link HTMLTexture}, the manager computes CSS `matrix3d`
 * transforms each frame so the underlying HTML elements stay aligned with
 * their meshes. Because the elements are children of the canvas, the browser
 * dispatches pointer events to them natively.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const interactions = new InteractionManager();
 * interactions.connect( renderer, camera );
 *
 * // Objects live anywhere in the scene graph
 * scene.add( mesh );
 *
 * // Register for interaction separately
 * interactions.add( mesh );
 *
 * // In the animation loop
 * interactions.update();
 * ```
 *
 */
export class InteractionManager {
  /**
   * The registered interactive objects.
   */
  objects: Object3D[];

  /**
   * The canvas element.
   *
   * @default null
   */
  element: HTMLCanvasElement | OffscreenCanvas | null;

  /**
   * The camera used for computing the element transforms.
   *
   * @default null
   */
  camera: Camera | null;

  private _cachedCssW: number;
  private _cachedCssH: number;

  constructor() {
    this.objects = [];

    this.element = null;

    this.camera = null;

    this._cachedCssW = -1;
    this._cachedCssH = -1;
  }

  /**
   * Adds one or more objects to the manager.
   *
   * @param objects - The objects to add.
   * @return A reference to this manager.
   */
  add(...objects: Object3D[]): this {
    for (const object of objects) {
      if (this.objects.indexOf(object) === -1) {
        this.objects.push(object);
      }
    }

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Removes one or more objects from the manager.
   *
   * @param objects - The objects to remove.
   * @return A reference to this manager.
   */
  remove(...objects: Object3D[]): this {
    for (const object of objects) {
      const index = this.objects.indexOf(object);

      if (index !== -1) {
        this.objects.splice(index, 1);
      }
    }

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Stores the renderer and camera needed for computing element transforms.
   *
   * @param renderer - The WebGL renderer.
   * @param camera - The camera.
   */
  connect(renderer: RendererLike, camera: Camera): void {
    this.camera = camera;
    this.element = renderer.domElement;
  }

  /**
   * Updates the element transforms for all registered objects.
   * Call this once per frame in the animation loop.
   */
  update(): void {
    const canvas = this.element;
    const camera = this.camera;

    if (canvas === null || camera === null) return;

    // Viewport: NDC (-1,1) to canvas CSS pixels, Y flipped.
    // Using CSS pixels (clientWidth/clientHeight) so the resulting matrix
    // can be applied directly as a CSS transform without DPR conversion.

    const cssW = canvas instanceof HTMLCanvasElement ? canvas.clientWidth : 0;
    const cssH = canvas instanceof HTMLCanvasElement ? canvas.clientHeight : 0;

    if (cssW !== this._cachedCssW || cssH !== this._cachedCssH) {
      _viewport.set(cssW / 2, 0, 0, cssW / 2, 0, -cssH / 2, 0, cssH / 2, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1);

      this._cachedCssW = cssW;
      this._cachedCssH = cssH;
    }

    for (const object of this.objects) {
      const holder = object as unknown as { material?: { map?: HTMLTexture } | undefined };
      const texture = holder.material?.map;

      if (!texture || !texture.isHTMLTexture) continue;

      const element = texture.image as HTMLElement | undefined;

      if (!element) continue;

      // Position at canvas origin so the CSS matrix3d maps correctly.
      element.style.position = "absolute";
      element.style.left = "0";
      element.style.top = "0";
      element.style.transformOrigin = "0 0";

      const elemW = element.offsetWidth;
      const elemH = element.offsetHeight;

      // Get mesh dimensions from geometry bounding box

      const holder2 = object as unknown as { geometry: import("../../geometries/BoxGeometry").BoxGeometry };
      const geometry = holder2.geometry;

      if (!geometry.boundingBox) geometry.computeBoundingBox();

      geometry.boundingBox!.getSize(_size);

      // Map element pixel coords (0,0)-(elemW,elemH) to mesh local coords.
      // Front face: top-left at (-sizeX/2, sizeY/2, maxZ), bottom-right at (sizeX/2, -sizeY/2, maxZ).

      _pixelToLocal.set(
        _size.x / elemW,
        0,
        0,
        -_size.x / 2,
        0,
        -_size.y / elemH,
        0,
        _size.y / 2,
        0,
        0,
        1,
        geometry.boundingBox!.max.z,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        1,
      );

      // Model-View-Projection

      _mvp.multiplyMatrices(camera.projectionMatrix, camera.matrixWorldInverse);
      _mvp.multiply(object.matrixWorld);
      _mvp.multiply(_pixelToLocal);

      // Apply viewport

      _mvp.premultiply(_viewport);

      // The browser performs the perspective divide (by w) when applying the matrix3d.

      element.style.transform = "matrix3d(" + _mvp.elements.join(",") + ")";
    }
  }

  /**
   * Disconnects this manager, clearing the renderer and camera references.
   */
  disconnect(): void {
    this.camera = null;
    this.element = null;
    this._cachedCssW = -1;
    this._cachedCssH = -1;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/interactive/HTMLMesh

````typescript
import { CanvasTexture } from "../../textures/CanvasTexture";
import { PlaneGeometry } from "../../geometries/PlaneGeometry";
import { MeshBasicMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshBasicMaterial";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import { Vector2 } from "../../math/Vector2";
import { TextureFilter, ColorSpace } from "../../constants";

interface Clip {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

/**
 * Pointer event forwarded to an {@link HTMLMesh} by an interactive group: `data` holds the
 * intersection UV with the y axis pointing up (texture rows run top-down).
 */
export interface HTMLCanvasPointerEvent {
  type: string;
  data?: Vector2;
}

/** One strokeable border edge of a box: the style triple plus the line segment, as upstream draws it. */
interface BorderEdge {
  width: string;
  style: string;
  color: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  dx: number;
  dy: number;
}

/** The computed-style subset `drawText` needs; a `CSSStyleDeclaration` satisfies it structurally. */
interface TextStyle {
  color: string;
  fontFamily: string;
  fontSize: string;
  fontWeight: string;
  textTransform?: string;
}

/** Canvases are reused between renders because a resized canvas allocation is expensive. */
const canvases = new WeakMap<HTMLElement, HTMLCanvasElement>();

function createClipper(context: CanvasRenderingContext2D): { add(clip: Clip): void; remove(): void } {
  const clips: Clip[] = [];
  let isClipping = false;

  function doClip(): void {
    if (isClipping) {
      isClipping = false;
      context.restore();
    }

    if (clips.length === 0) return;

    let minX = -Infinity,
      minY = -Infinity;
    let maxX = Infinity,
      maxY = Infinity;

    for (const clip of clips) {
      minX = Math.max(minX, clip.x);
      minY = Math.max(minY, clip.y);
      maxX = Math.min(maxX, clip.x + clip.width);
      maxY = Math.min(maxY, clip.y + clip.height);
    }

    context.save();
    context.beginPath();
    context.rect(minX, minY, maxX - minX, maxY - minY);
    context.clip();

    isClipping = true;
  }

  return {
    add(clip: Clip): void {
      clips.push(clip);
      doClip();
    },
    remove(): void {
      clips.pop();
      doClip();
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Rasterizes a DOM subtree into a reusable canvas with the 2D API: boxes, borders, text, images,
 * canvases, scrolling clips and native form controls. Only what the DOM actually paints is drawn.
 */
function html2canvas(element: HTMLElement): HTMLCanvasElement {
  const range = document.createRange();
  const color = new Color();

  function drawText(style: TextStyle, x: number, y: number, string: string): void {
    if (string !== "") {
      if (style.textTransform === "uppercase") string = string.toUpperCase();

      context.font = style.fontWeight + " " + style.fontSize + " " + style.fontFamily;
      context.textBaseline = "top";
      context.fillStyle = style.color;
      context.fillText(string, x, y + parseFloat(style.fontSize) * 0.1);
    }
  }

  function buildRectPath(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, r: number): void {
    if (w < 2 * r) r = w / 2;
    if (h < 2 * r) r = h / 2;

    context.beginPath();
    context.moveTo(x + r, y);
    context.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    context.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    context.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    context.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    context.closePath();
  }

  function drawBorder(edge: BorderEdge): void {
    if (
      edge.width !== "0px" &&
      edge.style !== "none" &&
      edge.color !== "transparent" &&
      edge.color !== "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"
    ) {
      context.strokeStyle = edge.color;
      context.lineWidth = parseFloat(edge.width);
      context.beginPath();
      context.moveTo(edge.x, edge.y);
      context.lineTo(edge.x + edge.dx, edge.y + edge.dy);
      context.stroke();
    }
  }

  function borderEdges(style: CSSStyleDeclaration, x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number): BorderEdge[] {
    return [
      {
        width: style.borderTopWidth,
        style: style.borderTopStyle,
        color: style.borderTopColor,
        x,
        y,
        dx: width,
        dy: 0,
      },
      {
        width: style.borderLeftWidth,
        style: style.borderLeftStyle,
        color: style.borderLeftColor,
        x,
        y,
        dx: 0,
        dy: height,
      },
      {
        width: style.borderBottomWidth,
        style: style.borderBottomStyle,
        color: style.borderBottomColor,
        x,
        y: y + height,
        dx: width,
        dy: 0,
      },
      {
        width: style.borderRightWidth,
        style: style.borderRightStyle,
        color: style.borderRightColor,
        x: x + width,
        y,
        dx: 0,
        dy: height,
      },
    ];
  }

  function drawElement(element: Node, inheritedStyle: CSSStyleDeclaration): void {
    // Do not render invisible elements, comments and scripts.
    if (
      element.nodeType === Node.COMMENT_NODE ||
      element.nodeName === "SCRIPT" ||
      ((element instanceof HTMLElement || element instanceof SVGElement) && element.style.display === "none")
    ) {
      return;
    }

    let style = inheritedStyle;

    let x = 0,
      y = 0,
      width = 0,
      height = 0;

    if (element.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
      // text
      range.selectNode(element);

      const rect = range.getBoundingClientRect();

      x = rect.left - offset.left - 0.5;
      y = rect.top - offset.top - 0.5;
      width = rect.width;
      height = rect.height;

      drawText(style, x, y, element.nodeValue?.trim() ?? "");
    } else if (element instanceof HTMLCanvasElement) {
      // Canvas element
      const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
      x = rect.left - offset.left - 0.5;
      y = rect.top - offset.top - 0.5;
      const canvasWidth = rect.width;
      const canvasHeight = rect.height;
      context.drawImage(element, x, y, canvasWidth, canvasHeight);
    } else if (element instanceof HTMLImageElement) {
      const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();

      x = rect.left - offset.left - 0.5;
      y = rect.top - offset.top - 0.5;
      width = rect.width;
      height = rect.height;

      context.drawImage(element, x, y, width, height);
    } else {
      if (!(element instanceof Element)) return;

      const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();

      x = rect.left - offset.left - 0.5;
      y = rect.top - offset.top - 0.5;
      width = rect.width;
      height = rect.height;

      style = window.getComputedStyle(element);

      // Get the border of the element used for fill and border

      buildRectPath(x, y, width, height, parseFloat(style.borderRadius));

      const backgroundColor = style.backgroundColor;

      if (backgroundColor !== "transparent" && backgroundColor !== "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)") {
        context.fillStyle = backgroundColor;
        context.fill();
      }

      // If all the borders match then stroke the round rectangle

      const edges = borderEdges(style, x, y, width, height);
      const [first] = edges;
      const match = edges.every(
        (edge) => edge.width === first.width && edge.color === first.color && edge.style === first.style,
      );

      if (match === true) {
        // They all match so stroke the rectangle from before allows for border-radius

        const borderWidth = parseFloat(style.borderTopWidth);

        if (
          style.borderTopWidth !== "0px" &&
          style.borderTopStyle !== "none" &&
          style.borderTopColor !== "transparent" &&
          style.borderTopColor !== "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"
        ) {
          context.strokeStyle = style.borderTopColor;
          context.lineWidth = borderWidth;
          context.stroke();
        }
      } else {
        // Otherwise draw individual borders

        for (const edge of edges) drawBorder(edge);
      }

      if (element instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
        let accentColor = style.accentColor;

        if (accentColor === "" || accentColor === "auto") accentColor = style.color;

        color.set(accentColor);

        const luminance = Math.sqrt(0.299 * color.r ** 2 + 0.587 * color.g ** 2 + 0.114 * color.b ** 2);
        const accentTextColor = luminance < 0.5 ? "white" : "#111111";

        if (element.type === "radio") {
          buildRectPath(x, y, width, height, height);

          context.fillStyle = "white";
          context.strokeStyle = accentColor;
          context.lineWidth = 1;
          context.fill();
          context.stroke();

          if (element.checked) {
            buildRectPath(x + 2, y + 2, width - 4, height - 4, height);

            context.fillStyle = accentColor;
            context.strokeStyle = accentTextColor;
            context.lineWidth = 2;
            context.fill();
            context.stroke();
          }
        }

        if (element.type === "checkbox") {
          buildRectPath(x, y, width, height, 2);

          context.fillStyle = element.checked ? accentColor : "white";
          context.strokeStyle = element.checked ? accentTextColor : accentColor;
          context.lineWidth = 1;
          context.stroke();
          context.fill();

          if (element.checked) {
            const currentTextAlign = context.textAlign;

            context.textAlign = "center";

            const properties = {
              color: accentTextColor,
              fontFamily: style.fontFamily,
              fontSize: height + "px",
              fontWeight: "bold",
            };

            drawText(properties, x + width / 2, y, "✔");

            context.textAlign = currentTextAlign;
          }
        }

        if (element.type === "range") {
          const min = parseFloat(element.min);
          const max = parseFloat(element.max);
          const value = parseFloat(element.value);
          const position = ((value - min) / (max - min)) * (width - height);

          buildRectPath(x, y + height / 4, width, height / 2, height / 4);
          context.fillStyle = accentTextColor;
          context.strokeStyle = accentColor;
          context.lineWidth = 1;
          context.fill();
          context.stroke();

          buildRectPath(x, y + height / 4, position + height / 2, height / 2, height / 4);
          context.fillStyle = accentColor;
          context.fill();

          buildRectPath(x + position, y, height, height, height / 2);
          context.fillStyle = accentColor;
          context.fill();
        }

        if (
          element.type === "color" ||
          element.type === "text" ||
          element.type === "number" ||
          element.type === "email" ||
          element.type === "password"
        ) {
          clipper.add({ x: x, y: y, width: width, height: height });

          const displayValue = element.type === "password" ? "*".repeat(element.value.length) : element.value;

          drawText(style, x + parseInt(style.paddingLeft), y + parseInt(style.paddingTop), displayValue);

          clipper.remove();
        }
      }
    }

    const isClipping = style.overflow === "auto" || style.overflow === "hidden";

    if (isClipping) clipper.add({ x: x, y: y, width: width, height: height });

    for (let i = 0; i < element.childNodes.length; i++) {
      drawElement(element.childNodes[i], style);
    }

    if (isClipping) clipper.remove();
  }

  const offset = element.getBoundingClientRect();

  let canvas = canvases.get(element);

  if (canvas === undefined) {
    canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvases.set(element, canvas);
  }

  canvas.width = offset.width;
  canvas.height = offset.height;

  const contextOrNull = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (contextOrNull === null) throw new Error("HTMLMesh requires a 2D canvas context to rasterize the DOM element.");
  const context: CanvasRenderingContext2D = contextOrNull;

  const clipper = createClipper(context);

  context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  drawElement(element, window.getComputedStyle(element));

  return canvas;
}

/**
 * Replays one bubbling pointer event on the deepest DOM target at normalized coordinates.
 * Dispatching on every ancestor separately would activate label-backed controls twice.
 */
function htmlevent(element: HTMLElement, event: string, x: number, y: number): void {
  const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
  x = x * rect.width + rect.left;
  y = y * rect.height + rect.top;

  let target: Element | undefined;
  function traverse(current: Node): void {
    if (!(current instanceof Element)) return;
    const currentRect = current.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (x > currentRect.left && x < currentRect.right && y > currentRect.top && y < currentRect.bottom) {
      target = current;
    }
    for (const child of current.childNodes) traverse(child);
  }
  traverse(element);
  if (target === undefined) return;

  target.dispatchEvent(
    new MouseEvent(event, {
      clientX: x,
      clientY: y,
      view: element.ownerDocument.defaultView,
      bubbles: true,
      cancelable: true,
    }),
  );

  if (!(target instanceof HTMLInputElement) || (event !== "mousedown" && event !== "click")) return;
  if (target.type === "range") {
    const inputRect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
    const min = parseFloat(target.min);
    const max = parseFloat(target.max);
    target.value = String(min + ((max - min) * (x - inputRect.x)) / inputRect.width);
    target.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent("input", { bubbles: true }));
  }
  if (target.type === "text" || target.type === "number" || target.type === "email" || target.type === "password")
    target.focus();
}

/**
 * A canvas texture that rasterizes a DOM element with the internal 2D renderer.
 *
 * DOM mutations are observed and coalesced into a single rerender in the next task, because a
 * renderer is not available here. Form control state (`checked`, `value`) is not reported by
 * `MutationObserver`, so `input` and `change` events are observed too.
 *
 * Unrelated to the experimental HTML-in-canvas texture in `src/textures/HTMLTexture`.
 */
class HTMLCanvasTexture extends CanvasTexture {
  /** The DOM element this texture rasterizes. */
  dom: HTMLElement;

  /** Observes attribute, child list and character data mutations. */
  observer: MutationObserver;

  /** Pending rerender timer handle, or `undefined` when no rerender is scheduled. */
  scheduleUpdate: number | undefined;

  /** Bound rerender scheduler shared with the DOM event listeners. */
  _scheduleUpdate: () => void;

  /** Set by `dispose()` so a late timer callback cannot update a disposed texture. */
  _disposed: boolean;

  /**
   * Constructs a new texture for the given element and its initial canvas.
   *
   * @param dom - The DOM element to rasterize.
   * @param canvas - The canvas returned by the initial `html2canvas` render.
   */
  constructor(dom: HTMLElement, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement) {
    super(canvas);

    this.dom = dom;

    this.anisotropy = 16;
    this.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB;
    this.minFilter = TextureFilter.Linear;
    this.magFilter = TextureFilter.Linear;
    this.generateMipmaps = false;

    this.scheduleUpdate = undefined;
    this._disposed = false;

    const scheduleUpdate = (): void => {
      if (this._disposed || this.scheduleUpdate !== undefined) return;

      // Ideally should use xr.requestAnimationFrame, here setTimeout to avoid passing the renderer.
      this.scheduleUpdate = window.setTimeout(() => {
        this.scheduleUpdate = undefined;
        this.update();
      }, 16);
    };

    this.observer = new MutationObserver(scheduleUpdate);
    this._scheduleUpdate = scheduleUpdate;

    dom.addEventListener("input", scheduleUpdate);
    dom.addEventListener("change", scheduleUpdate);

    this.observer.observe(dom, { attributes: true, childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true });
  }

  /**
   * Forwards a mesh intersection event to the DOM at the intersection UV.
   *
   * @param event - The pointer event with intersection UV data.
   */
  dispatchDOMEvent(event: HTMLCanvasPointerEvent): void {
    if (event.data) {
      htmlevent(this.dom, event.type, event.data.x, event.data.y);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Rasterizes the DOM element again and marks the texture for upload.
   */
  update(): void {
    if (this._disposed) return;

    this.image = html2canvas(this.dom);
    this.needsUpdate = true;
  }

  /**
   * Disconnects the mutation observer, removes the form listeners and cancels a pending rerender.
   */
  override dispose(): void {
    this._disposed = true;

    this.observer.disconnect();
    this.dom.removeEventListener("input", this._scheduleUpdate);
    this.dom.removeEventListener("change", this._scheduleUpdate);

    window.clearTimeout(this.scheduleUpdate);
    this.scheduleUpdate = undefined;

    super.dispose();
  }
}

/**
 * This class can be used to render a DOM element onto a canvas and use it as a texture
 * for a plane mesh.
 *
 * A typical use case for this class is to render the GUI of `lil-gui` as a texture so it
 * is compatible for VR. Pointer events dispatched on the mesh by an interactive group are
 * replayed on the DOM element, so the rendered GUI stays editable in 3D.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { GUI } from 'ek3d/addons/libs/lil-gui/GUI';
 * import { HTMLMesh } from 'ek3d/addons/interactive/HTMLMesh';
 * import { Scene } from 'ek3d/scenes/Scene';
 *
 * const scene = new Scene();
 *
 * const gui = new GUI({ width: 300 });
 * // Keep the DOM laid out and focusable, but invisible and click-through on the page.
 * gui.domElement.style.opacity = '0';
 * gui.domElement.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
 *
 * const mesh = new HTMLMesh(gui.domElement);
 * scene.add(mesh);
 * ```
 *
 * @augments Mesh
 * @demo examples/webgl_interactive_htmlmesh.html
 */
export class HTMLMesh extends Mesh<MeshBasicMaterial> {
  /** The texture rasterizing the DOM element; call `texture.update()` for canvas children that paint imperatively. */
  texture: HTMLCanvasTexture;

  /** Bound listener replaying mesh pointer events on the DOM element. */
  _onEvent: (event: HTMLCanvasPointerEvent) => void;

  /**
   * Constructs a new HTML mesh.
   *
   * @param dom - The DOM element to display as a plane mesh. It must be laid out: `display: none`
   * or a missing parent produces an empty, zero-sized raster.
   */
  constructor(dom: HTMLElement) {
    const canvas = html2canvas(dom);
    const texture = new HTMLCanvasTexture(dom, canvas);
    const geometry = new PlaneGeometry(canvas.width * 0.001, canvas.height * 0.001);
    const material = new MeshBasicMaterial({ map: texture, toneMapped: false, transparent: true });

    super(geometry, material);

    this.texture = texture;

    this._onEvent = (event: HTMLCanvasPointerEvent): void => {
      texture.dispatchDOMEvent(event);
    };

    this.addEventListener("mousedown", this._onEvent);
    this.addEventListener("mousemove", this._onEvent);
    this.addEventListener("mouseup", this._onEvent);
    this.addEventListener("click", this._onEvent);
  }

  /**
   * Frees the GPU-related resources allocated by this instance and removes all event listeners.
   * Call this method whenever this instance is no longer used in your app.
   */
  override dispose(): void {
    this.geometry.dispose();
    this.material.dispose();
    this.texture.dispose();

    canvases.delete(this.texture.dom);

    this.removeEventListener("mousedown", this._onEvent);
    this.removeEventListener("mousemove", this._onEvent);
    this.removeEventListener("mouseup", this._onEvent);
    this.removeEventListener("click", this._onEvent);

    super.dispose();
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/interactive/InteractiveGroup

```typescript
import type { Camera } from "../../cameras/Camera";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";
import { Group } from "../../objects/Group";
import { Raycaster } from "../../core/Raycaster";
import { Vector2 } from "../../math/Vector2";

const pointer = new Vector2();
const dispatchedEvent = { type: "", data: pointer };
const pointerEvents = [
  "pointerdown",
  "pointerup",
  "pointermove",
  "mousedown",
  "mouseup",
  "mousemove",
  "click",
] as const;

/** Groups objects receiving pointer and mouse events through WebGL raycasting. */
export class InteractiveGroup extends Group {
  raycaster: Raycaster = new Raycaster();
  element: HTMLElement | null = null;
  camera: Camera | null = null;
  private _onPointerEvent: (event: MouseEvent) => void = this.onPointerEvent.bind(this);

  onPointerEvent(event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (this.element === null || this.camera === null) return;
    const rect = this.element.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.y = -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
    this.raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, this.camera);
    const intersection = this.raycaster.intersectObjects(this.children, false)[0];
    if (intersection) {
      dispatchedEvent.type = event.type;
      dispatchedEvent.data.set(intersection.uv!.x, 1 - intersection.uv!.y);
      intersection.object.dispatchEvent(dispatchedEvent);
    }
  }

  listenToPointerEvents(renderer: WebGLRenderer, camera: Camera): void {
    this.camera = camera;
    this.element = renderer.domElement as HTMLCanvasElement;
    for (const type of pointerEvents) {
      this.element.addEventListener(type, this._onPointerEvent);
    }
  }

  disconnectionPointerEvents(): void {
    if (this.element !== null) {
      for (const type of pointerEvents) {
        this.element.removeEventListener(type, this._onPointerEvent);
      }
    }
  }

  /** XR controller support is omitted because this package excludes the XR backend. */
  disconnect(): void {
    this.disconnectionPointerEvents();
    this.camera = null;
    this.element = null;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/interactive/SelectionBox

````typescript
import { OrthographicCamera } from "../../cameras/OrthographicCamera";
import { Frustum } from "../../math/Frustum";
import { Matrix4 } from "../../math/Matrix4";
import { Quaternion } from "../../math/Quaternion";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import type { PerspectiveCamera } from "../../cameras/PerspectiveCamera";
import type { Sphere } from "../../math/Sphere";
import type { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import type { BatchedMesh } from "../../objects/BatchedMesh";
import type { InstancedMesh } from "../../objects/InstancedMesh";
import type { Scene } from "../../scenes/Scene";

const _frustum = new Frustum();
const _center = new Vector3();

const _tmpPoint = new Vector3();

const _vecNear = new Vector3();
const _vecTopLeft = new Vector3();
const _vecTopRight = new Vector3();
const _vecDownRight = new Vector3();
const _vecDownLeft = new Vector3();

const _vecFarTopLeft = new Vector3();
const _vecFarTopRight = new Vector3();
const _vecFarDownRight = new Vector3();
const _vecFarDownLeft = new Vector3();

const _vectemp1 = new Vector3();
const _vectemp2 = new Vector3();
const _vectemp3 = new Vector3();

const _matrix = new Matrix4();
const _quaternion = new Quaternion();
const _scale = new Vector3();

/** The camera types whose selection frustum can be built. */
type SelectionCamera = PerspectiveCamera | OrthographicCamera;

/**
 * This class can be used to select 3D objects in a scene with a selection box.
 * It is recommended to visualize the selected area with the help of {@link SelectionHelper}.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const selectionBox = new SelectionBox( camera, scene );
 * const selectedObjects = selectionBox.select( startPoint, endPoint );
 * ```
 */
export class SelectionBox {
  /**
   * The camera the scene is rendered with.
   */
  camera: SelectionCamera;

  /**
   * The scene.
   */
  scene: Scene;

  /**
   * The start point of the selection.
   */
  startPoint: Vector3;

  /**
   * The end point of the selection.
   */
  endPoint: Vector3;

  /**
   * The selected 3D objects.
   */
  collection: Object3D[];

  /**
   * The selected instance IDs of instanced meshes.
   */
  instances: Record<string, number[]>;

  /**
   * The selected batches of batched meshes.
   */
  batches: Record<string, number[]>;

  /**
   * How deep the selection frustum of perspective cameras should extend.
   */
  deep: number;

  /**
   * Constructs a new selection box.
   *
   * @param camera - The camera the scene is rendered with.
   * @param scene - The scene.
   * @param deep - How deep the selection frustum of perspective cameras should extend.
   */
  constructor(camera: SelectionCamera, scene: Scene, deep: number = Number.MAX_VALUE) {
    this.camera = camera;
    this.scene = scene;
    this.startPoint = new Vector3();
    this.endPoint = new Vector3();
    this.collection = [];
    this.instances = {};
    this.batches = {};
    this.deep = deep;
  }

  /**
   * This method selects 3D objects in the scene based on the given start
   * and end point. If no parameters are provided, the method uses the start
   * and end values of the respective members.
   *
   * @param startPoint - The start point.
   * @param endPoint - The end point.
   * @return The selected 3D objects.
   */
  select(startPoint?: Vector3, endPoint?: Vector3): Object3D[] {
    this.startPoint = startPoint ?? this.startPoint;
    this.endPoint = endPoint ?? this.endPoint;
    this.collection = [];

    this._updateFrustum(this.startPoint, this.endPoint);
    this._searchChildInFrustum(_frustum, this.scene);

    return this.collection;
  }

  // private

  _updateFrustum(startPoint?: Vector3, endPoint?: Vector3): void {
    const start = startPoint ?? this.startPoint;
    const end = endPoint ?? this.endPoint;

    // Avoid invalid frustum

    if (start.x === end.x) {
      end.x += Number.EPSILON;
    }

    if (start.y === end.y) {
      end.y += Number.EPSILON;
    }

    this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    this.camera.updateMatrixWorld();

    if (this.camera.isPerspectiveCamera) {
      _tmpPoint.copy(start);
      _tmpPoint.x = Math.min(start.x, end.x);
      _tmpPoint.y = Math.max(start.y, end.y);
      end.x = Math.max(start.x, end.x);
      end.y = Math.min(start.y, end.y);

      _vecNear.setFromMatrixPosition(this.camera.matrixWorld);
      _vecTopLeft.copy(_tmpPoint);
      _vecTopRight.set(end.x, _tmpPoint.y, 0);
      _vecDownRight.copy(end);
      _vecDownLeft.set(_tmpPoint.x, end.y, 0);

      _vecTopLeft.unproject(this.camera);
      _vecTopRight.unproject(this.camera);
      _vecDownRight.unproject(this.camera);
      _vecDownLeft.unproject(this.camera);

      _vectemp1.copy(_vecTopLeft).sub(_vecNear);
      _vectemp2.copy(_vecTopRight).sub(_vecNear);
      _vectemp3.copy(_vecDownRight).sub(_vecNear);
      _vectemp1.normalize();
      _vectemp2.normalize();
      _vectemp3.normalize();

      _vectemp1.multiplyScalar(this.deep);
      _vectemp2.multiplyScalar(this.deep);
      _vectemp3.multiplyScalar(this.deep);
      _vectemp1.add(_vecNear);
      _vectemp2.add(_vecNear);
      _vectemp3.add(_vecNear);

      const planes = _frustum.planes;

      planes[0].setFromCoplanarPoints(_vecNear, _vecTopLeft, _vecTopRight);
      planes[1].setFromCoplanarPoints(_vecNear, _vecTopRight, _vecDownRight);
      planes[2].setFromCoplanarPoints(_vecDownRight, _vecDownLeft, _vecNear);
      planes[3].setFromCoplanarPoints(_vecDownLeft, _vecTopLeft, _vecNear);
      planes[4].setFromCoplanarPoints(_vecTopRight, _vecDownRight, _vecDownLeft);
      planes[5].setFromCoplanarPoints(_vectemp3, _vectemp2, _vectemp1);
      planes[5].normal.multiplyScalar(-1);
    } else if (this.camera.type === "OrthographicCamera") {
      const left = Math.min(start.x, end.x);
      const top = Math.max(start.y, end.y);
      const right = Math.max(start.x, end.x);
      const down = Math.min(start.y, end.y);

      _vecTopLeft.set(left, top, -1);
      _vecTopRight.set(right, top, -1);
      _vecDownRight.set(right, down, -1);
      _vecDownLeft.set(left, down, -1);

      _vecFarTopLeft.set(left, top, 1);
      _vecFarTopRight.set(right, top, 1);
      _vecFarDownRight.set(right, down, 1);
      _vecFarDownLeft.set(left, down, 1);

      _vecTopLeft.unproject(this.camera);
      _vecTopRight.unproject(this.camera);
      _vecDownRight.unproject(this.camera);
      _vecDownLeft.unproject(this.camera);

      _vecFarTopLeft.unproject(this.camera);
      _vecFarTopRight.unproject(this.camera);
      _vecFarDownRight.unproject(this.camera);
      _vecFarDownLeft.unproject(this.camera);

      const planes = _frustum.planes;

      planes[0].setFromCoplanarPoints(_vecTopLeft, _vecFarTopLeft, _vecFarTopRight);
      planes[1].setFromCoplanarPoints(_vecTopRight, _vecFarTopRight, _vecFarDownRight);
      planes[2].setFromCoplanarPoints(_vecFarDownRight, _vecFarDownLeft, _vecDownLeft);
      planes[3].setFromCoplanarPoints(_vecFarDownLeft, _vecFarTopLeft, _vecTopLeft);
      planes[4].setFromCoplanarPoints(_vecTopRight, _vecDownRight, _vecDownLeft);
      planes[5].setFromCoplanarPoints(_vecFarDownRight, _vecFarTopRight, _vecFarTopLeft);
      planes[5].normal.multiplyScalar(-1);
    } else {
      console.error("THREE.SelectionBox: Unsupported camera type.");
    }
  }

  _searchChildInFrustum(frustum: Frustum, object: Object3D): void {
    const meshLike = object as Object3D & {
      isMesh?: boolean | undefined;
      isLine?: boolean | undefined;
      isPoints?: boolean | undefined;
      isInstancedMesh?: boolean | undefined;
      isBatchedMesh?: boolean | undefined;
      geometry?: { boundingSphere: Sphere | null; computeBoundingSphere(): void };
      getMatrixAt(instanceId: number, matrix: Matrix4): void;
      count?: number | undefined;
    };

    if (meshLike.isMesh || meshLike.isLine || meshLike.isPoints) {
      if ((meshLike as { isInstancedMesh?: boolean }).isInstancedMesh) {
        const instanced = object as InstancedMesh;

        this.instances[instanced.uuid] = [];

        for (let instanceId = 0; instanceId < instanced.count; instanceId++) {
          instanced.getMatrixAt(instanceId, _matrix);
          _matrix.decompose(_center, _quaternion, _scale);
          _center.applyMatrix4(instanced.matrixWorld);

          if (frustum.containsPoint(_center)) {
            this.instances[instanced.uuid].push(instanceId);
          }
        }
      } else if ((meshLike as { isBatchedMesh?: boolean }).isBatchedMesh) {
        const batched = object as BatchedMesh;

        this.batches[batched.uuid] = [];

        for (let instanceId = 0, count = 0; count < batched.instanceCount; instanceId++) {
          // skip invalid instances in the batchedMesh

          if ((batched.validateInstanceId(instanceId) as unknown as boolean) === false) continue;

          count++;

          batched.getMatrixAt(instanceId, _matrix);
          _matrix.decompose(_center, _quaternion, _scale);
          _center.applyMatrix4(batched.matrixWorld);

          if (frustum.containsPoint(_center)) {
            this.batches[batched.uuid].push(instanceId);
          }
        }
      } else {
        const geometry = meshLike.geometry!;
        if (geometry.boundingSphere === null) geometry.computeBoundingSphere();

        _center.copy(geometry.boundingSphere!.center);

        _center.applyMatrix4(object.matrixWorld);

        if (frustum.containsPoint(_center)) {
          this.collection.push(object);
        }
      }
    }

    if (object.children.length > 0) {
      for (let x = 0; x < object.children.length; x++) {
        this._searchChildInFrustum(frustum, object.children[x]);
      }
    }
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/interactive/SelectionHelper

```typescript
import { Vector2 } from "../../math/Vector2";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";

/**
 * A helper for {@link SelectionBox}.
 *
 * It visualizes the current selection box with a `div` container element.
 */
export class SelectionHelper {
  /**
   * The visualization of the selection box.
   */
  element: HTMLDivElement;

  /**
   * A reference to the renderer.
   */
  renderer: WebGLRenderer;

  /**
   * Whether the mouse or pointer is pressed down.
   */
  isDown: boolean;

  /**
   * Whether helper is enabled or not.
   */
  enabled: boolean;

  _startPoint: Vector2;
  _pointTopLeft: Vector2;
  _pointBottomRight: Vector2;

  _onPointerDown: (event: PointerEvent) => void;
  _onPointerMove: (event: PointerEvent) => void;
  _onPointerUp: () => void;

  /**
   * Constructs a new selection helper.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param cssClassName - The CSS class name of the `div`.
   */
  constructor(renderer: WebGLRenderer, cssClassName: string) {
    this.element = document.createElement("div");
    this.element.classList.add(cssClassName);
    this.element.style.pointerEvents = "none";

    this.renderer = renderer;

    this.isDown = false;
    this.enabled = true;

    this._startPoint = new Vector2();
    this._pointTopLeft = new Vector2();
    this._pointBottomRight = new Vector2();

    this._onPointerDown = (event: PointerEvent) => {
      if (this.enabled === false) return;

      this.isDown = true;
      this._onSelectStart(event);
    };

    this._onPointerMove = (event: PointerEvent) => {
      if (this.enabled === false) return;

      if (this.isDown) {
        this._onSelectMove(event);
      }
    };

    this._onPointerUp = () => {
      if (this.enabled === false) return;

      this.isDown = false;
      this._onSelectOver();
    };

    const listen = this.renderer.domElement as HTMLCanvasElement;
    listen.addEventListener("pointerdown", this._onPointerDown);
    listen.addEventListener("pointermove", this._onPointerMove);
    listen.addEventListener("pointerup", this._onPointerUp);
  }

  /**
   * Call this method if you no longer want use to the controls. It frees all internal
   * resources and removes all event listeners.
   */
  dispose(): void {
    const listen = this.renderer.domElement as HTMLCanvasElement;
    listen.removeEventListener("pointerdown", this._onPointerDown);
    listen.removeEventListener("pointermove", this._onPointerMove);
    listen.removeEventListener("pointerup", this._onPointerUp);

    this.element.remove(); // in case disposal happens while dragging
  }

  // private

  _onSelectStart(event: PointerEvent): void {
    this.element.style.display = "none";

    (this.renderer.domElement as HTMLCanvasElement).parentElement!.appendChild(this.element);

    this.element.style.left = event.clientX + "px";
    this.element.style.top = event.clientY + "px";
    this.element.style.width = "0px";
    this.element.style.height = "0px";

    this._startPoint.x = event.clientX;
    this._startPoint.y = event.clientY;
  }

  _onSelectMove(event: PointerEvent): void {
    this.element.style.display = "block";

    this._pointBottomRight.x = Math.max(this._startPoint.x, event.clientX);
    this._pointBottomRight.y = Math.max(this._startPoint.y, event.clientY);
    this._pointTopLeft.x = Math.min(this._startPoint.x, event.clientX);
    this._pointTopLeft.y = Math.min(this._startPoint.y, event.clientY);

    this.element.style.left = this._pointTopLeft.x + "px";
    this.element.style.top = this._pointTopLeft.y + "px";
    this.element.style.width = this._pointBottomRight.x - this._pointTopLeft.x + "px";
    this.element.style.height = this._pointBottomRight.y - this._pointTopLeft.y + "px";
  }

  _onSelectOver(): void {
    this.element.remove();
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/libs/Stats

```typescript
/**
 * A simple performance monitor: FPS, millisecond and memory panels drawn on stacked
 * canvases. Click or call `showPanel()` to cycle panels. Port of the stats.js r16 module
 * used by upstream examples; the class form replaces the closure-based original.
 */
export class Stats {
  REVISION: string = "16";

  /** The outermost container element. */
  domElement: HTMLDivElement;

  /**
   * The container element; identical to `domElement`.
   */
  dom: HTMLDivElement;

  _panels: StatsPanel[];

  /** Index of the visible panel. */
  mode: number;

  _beginTime: number;
  _prevTime: number;
  _frames: number;

  _fpsPanel: StatsPanel;
  _msPanel: StatsPanel;
  _memPanel: StatsPanel | undefined;

  /** `begin()` stored for the `update()` shorthand. */
  _updateBound: () => void;

  _onClick: (event: MouseEvent) => void;

  /**
   * Constructs the statistics panel and appends nothing; callers add `stats.dom` themselves.
   */
  constructor() {
    this.mode = 0;

    const container = document.createElement("div");
    container.style.cssText = "position:fixed;top:0;left:0;cursor:pointer;opacity:0.9;z-index:10000";

    this._panels = [];
    this._onClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.showPanel(++this.mode % container.children.length);
    };
    container.addEventListener("click", this._onClick, false);

    this.domElement = container;
    this.dom = container;

    this._beginTime = (performance || Date).now();
    this._prevTime = this._beginTime;
    this._frames = 0;

    this._fpsPanel = this.addPanel(new StatsPanel("FPS", "#0ff", "#002"));
    this._msPanel = this.addPanel(new StatsPanel("MS", "#0f0", "#020"));

    const perfWithMemory = self.performance as Performance & {
      memory?: { usedJSHeapSize: number; jsHeapSizeLimit: number };
    };
    if (perfWithMemory && perfWithMemory.memory) {
      this._memPanel = this.addPanel(new StatsPanel("MB", "#f08", "#201"));
    }

    this.showPanel(0);

    this._updateBound = () => {
      this._beginTime = this.end();
    };
  }

  /** Adds a panel to the container and returns it. */
  addPanel(panel: StatsPanel): StatsPanel {
    this.domElement.appendChild(panel.dom);
    return panel;
  }

  /** Shows the panel with the given index, hiding the others. */
  showPanel(id: number): void {
    const children = this.domElement.children;
    for (let i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
      (children[i] as HTMLElement).style.display = i === id ? "block" : "none";
    }

    this.mode = id;
  }

  /** Starts a timing span. */
  begin(): void {
    this._beginTime = (performance || Date).now();
  }

  /** Ends the timing span, updates panels and returns the current timestamp. */
  end(): number {
    this._frames++;

    const time = (performance || Date).now();

    this._msPanel.update(time - this._beginTime, 200);

    if (time >= this._prevTime + 1000) {
      this._fpsPanel.update((this._frames * 1000) / (time - this._prevTime), 100);

      this._prevTime = time;
      this._frames = 0;

      if (this._memPanel) {
        const memory = (
          self.performance as Performance & { memory: { usedJSHeapSize: number; jsHeapSizeLimit: number } }
        ).memory;
        this._memPanel.update(memory.usedJSHeapSize / 1048576, memory.jsHeapSizeLimit / 1048576);
      }
    }

    return time;
  }

  /** Shorthand for a per-frame `end()` followed by `begin()`. */
  update(): void {
    this._updateBound();
  }
}

/** Canvas-drawn graph panel showing a value with min/max history. */
export class StatsPanel {
  /** The canvas element showing this panel. */
  dom: HTMLCanvasElement;

  _name: string;
  _fg: string;
  _bg: string;

  _min: number;
  _max: number;

  _PR: number;
  _WIDTH: number;
  _HEIGHT: number;
  _TEXT_X: number;
  _TEXT_Y: number;
  _GRAPH_X: number;
  _GRAPH_Y: number;
  _GRAPH_WIDTH: number;
  _GRAPH_HEIGHT: number;

  _context: CanvasRenderingContext2D;

  /**
   * Constructs a panel.
   *
   * @param name - Panel label.
   * @param fg - Foreground color.
   * @param bg - Background color.
   */
  constructor(name: string, fg: string, bg: string) {
    this._name = name;
    this._fg = fg;
    this._bg = bg;
    this._min = Infinity;
    this._max = 0;

    const round = Math.round;
    const PR = round(window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    this._PR = PR;

    const WIDTH = 80 * PR,
      HEIGHT = 48 * PR;
    const TEXT_X = 3 * PR,
      TEXT_Y = 2 * PR;
    const GRAPH_X = 3 * PR,
      GRAPH_Y = 15 * PR;
    const GRAPH_WIDTH = 74 * PR,
      GRAPH_HEIGHT = 30 * PR;
    this._WIDTH = WIDTH;
    this._HEIGHT = HEIGHT;
    this._TEXT_X = TEXT_X;
    this._TEXT_Y = TEXT_Y;
    this._GRAPH_X = GRAPH_X;
    this._GRAPH_Y = GRAPH_Y;
    this._GRAPH_WIDTH = GRAPH_WIDTH;
    this._GRAPH_HEIGHT = GRAPH_HEIGHT;

    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = WIDTH;
    canvas.height = HEIGHT;
    canvas.style.cssText = "width:80px;height:48px";
    this.dom = canvas;

    const context = canvas.getContext("2d")!;
    this._context = context;
    context.font = `bold ${9 * PR}px Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif`;
    context.textBaseline = "top";

    context.fillStyle = bg;
    context.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);

    context.fillStyle = fg;
    context.fillText(name, TEXT_X, TEXT_Y);
    context.fillRect(GRAPH_X, GRAPH_Y, GRAPH_WIDTH, GRAPH_HEIGHT);

    context.fillStyle = bg;
    context.globalAlpha = 0.9;
    context.fillRect(GRAPH_X, GRAPH_Y, GRAPH_WIDTH, GRAPH_HEIGHT);
  }

  /**
   * Pushes a value onto the graph.
   *
   * @param value - The measured value.
   * @param maxValue - The scale maximum.
   */
  update(this: StatsPanel, value: number, maxValue: number): void {
    this._min = Math.min(this._min, value);
    this._max = Math.max(this._max, value);

    const context = this._context;
    const round = Math.round;

    context.fillStyle = this._bg;
    context.globalAlpha = 1;
    context.fillRect(0, 0, this._WIDTH, this._GRAPH_Y);
    context.fillStyle = this._fg;
    context.fillText(
      `${round(value)} ${this._name} (${round(this._min)}-${round(this._max)})`,
      this._TEXT_X,
      this._TEXT_Y,
    );

    context.drawImage(
      this.dom,
      this._GRAPH_X + this._PR,
      this._GRAPH_Y,
      this._GRAPH_WIDTH - this._PR,
      this._GRAPH_HEIGHT,
      this._GRAPH_X,
      this._GRAPH_Y,
      this._GRAPH_WIDTH - this._PR,
      this._GRAPH_HEIGHT,
    );

    context.fillRect(this._GRAPH_X + this._GRAPH_WIDTH - this._PR, this._GRAPH_Y, this._PR, this._GRAPH_HEIGHT);

    context.fillStyle = this._bg;
    context.globalAlpha = 0.9;
    context.fillRect(
      this._GRAPH_X + this._GRAPH_WIDTH - this._PR,
      this._GRAPH_Y,
      this._PR,
      round((1 - value / maxValue) * this._GRAPH_HEIGHT),
    );
  }
}
