## ek3d/addons/libs/lil-gui/ColorController

```typescript
import { Controller } from "./Controller";
import type { GUI } from "./GUI";
import { getColorFormat, normalizeColorString } from "./colorUtils";

/** A color format description able to read and write hex strings. */
interface ColorFormat {
  isPrimitive: boolean;
  fromHexString(hex: string, target?: unknown, rgbScale?: number): unknown;
  toHexString(value: unknown, rgbScale?: number): string;
}

/**
 * Controls a color property. Accepts CSS hex strings, `number` packed RGB, `[r, g, b]`
 * arrays (and typed arrays thereof) and `{ r, g, b }` objects, applying an `rgbScale`.
 */
export class ColorController extends Controller {
  /** The swatch input of the widget. */
  $input: HTMLInputElement;

  /** The text input of the widget. */
  $text: HTMLInputElement;

  /** The highlighted swatch display. */
  $display: HTMLDivElement;

  _format: ColorFormat;
  _rgbScale: number;
  _initialValueHexString: string;
  _textFocused: boolean;

  /**
   * Constructs a color controller.
   *
   * @param parent - The GUI that owns this controller.
   * @param object - The object whose property is controlled.
   * @param property - The property name.
   * @param rgbScale - Scale applied to normalized RGB channels for object/array targets.
   */
  constructor(parent: GUI, object: Record<string, unknown>, property: string, rgbScale = 1) {
    super(parent, object, property, "color");

    this.$input = document.createElement("input");
    this.$input.setAttribute("type", "color");
    this.$input.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
    this.$input.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", this.$name.id);

    this.$text = document.createElement("input");
    this.$text.setAttribute("type", "text");
    this.$text.setAttribute("spellcheck", "false");
    this.$text.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", this.$name.id);

    this.$display = document.createElement("div");
    this.$display.classList.add("display");

    this.$display.appendChild(this.$input);
    this.$widget.appendChild(this.$display);
    this.$widget.appendChild(this.$text);

    this._format = getColorFormat(this.initialValue as never) as ColorFormat;
    this._rgbScale = rgbScale;

    this._initialValueHexString = this.save();
    this._textFocused = false;

    this.$input.addEventListener("input", () => {
      this._setValueFromHexString(this.$input.value);
    });

    this.$input.addEventListener("blur", () => {
      this._callOnFinishChange();
    });

    this.$text.addEventListener("input", () => {
      const tryParse = normalizeColorString(this.$text.value);
      if (tryParse) {
        this._setValueFromHexString(tryParse);
      }
    });

    this.$text.addEventListener("focus", () => {
      this._textFocused = true;
      this.$text.select();
    });

    this.$text.addEventListener("blur", () => {
      this._textFocused = false;
      this.updateDisplay();
      this._callOnFinishChange();
    });

    this.$disable = this.$text;

    this.updateDisplay();
  }

  override reset(): this {
    this._setValueFromHexString(this._initialValueHexString);
    return this;
  }

  /** Writes the color from a `#rrggbb` string, mutating non-primitive targets in place. */
  _setValueFromHexString(hex: string): void {
    if (this._format.isPrimitive) {
      const newValue = this._format.fromHexString(hex);
      this.setValue(newValue);
    } else {
      this._format.fromHexString(hex, this.getValue(), this._rgbScale);
      this._callOnChange();
      this.updateDisplay();
    }
  }

  override save(): string {
    return this._format.toHexString(this.getValue(), this._rgbScale);
  }

  override load(hex: string): this {
    this._setValueFromHexString(hex);
    this._callOnFinishChange();
    return this;
  }

  override updateDisplay(): this {
    this.$input.value = this._format.toHexString(this.getValue(), this._rgbScale);
    if (!this._textFocused) {
      this.$text.value = this.$input.value.substring(1);
    }
    this.$display.style.backgroundColor = this.$input.value;
    return this;
  }
}

## ek3d/addons/libs/lil-gui/Controller

```typescript
import type { GUI } from "./GUI";

/**
 * Base class for all GUI controllers. A controller wraps one property of an object
 * and renders it as a labeled widget inside a {@link GUI} panel.
 */
export class Controller {
  /**
   * The GUI that contains this controller.
   */
  parent: GUI;

  /**
   * The object this controller will modify.
   */
  object: Record<string, unknown>;

  /**
   * The name of the property to control.
   */
  property: string;

  /**
   * Used to determine if the controller is disabled.
   * Use `controller.disable(true | false)` to modify this value.
   *
   * @default false
   */
  _disabled: boolean;

  /**
   * Used to determine if the Controller is hidden.
   * Use `controller.show()` or `controller.hide()` to change this.
   *
   * @default false
   */
  _hidden: boolean;

  /**
   * The value of `object[property]` when the controller was created.
   */
  initialValue: unknown;

  /**
   * The outermost container DOM element for this controller.
   */
  domElement: HTMLElement;

  /**
   * The DOM element that contains the controller's name.
   */
  $name: HTMLElement;

  /**
   * The DOM element that contains the controller's "widget" (which differs by controller type).
   */
  $widget: HTMLElement;

  /**
   * The DOM element that receives the disabled attribute when using `disable()`.
   */
  $disable: HTMLElement;

  /** Whether the controller value changed since the last finish-change event. */
  _changed: boolean;

  /** Callback bound through `onChange()`. */
  _onChange: ((value: unknown) => void) | undefined;

  /** Callback bound through `onFinishChange()`. */
  _onFinishChange: ((value: unknown) => void) | undefined;

  /** Whether the controller polls its value every frame. */
  _listening: boolean;

  _pendingInsertion: boolean;

  /** `requestAnimationFrame` id of the active listener loop. */
  _listenCallbackID: number | undefined;

  /** Last value seen by the listener loop. */
  _listenPrevValue: unknown;

  static nextNameID: number;

  /**
   * Constructs a controller and attaches it to the parent GUI.
   *
   * @param parent - The GUI that owns this controller.
   * @param object - The object whose property is controlled.
   * @param property - The property name.
   * @param className - Additional CSS class for the row.
   * @param elementType - The tag name of the row element.
   */
  constructor(parent: GUI, object: Record<string, unknown>, property: string, className: string, elementType = "div") {
    this.parent = parent;
    this.object = object;
    this.property = property;

    this._disabled = false;
    this._hidden = false;

    this.initialValue = this.getValue();

    this.domElement = document.createElement(elementType);
    this.domElement.classList.add("controller", className);

    this.$name = document.createElement("div");
    this.$name.classList.add("name");
    this.$name.textContent = property;

    Controller.nextNameID = Controller.nextNameID || 0;
    this.$name.id = `lil-gui-name-${++Controller.nextNameID}`;

    this.$widget = document.createElement("div");
    this.$widget.classList.add("widget");

    this.$disable = this.$widget;

    this.domElement.appendChild(this.$name);
    this.domElement.appendChild(this.$widget);

    // Don't fire global key events while typing in a controller
    this.domElement.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => e.stopPropagation());
    this.domElement.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => e.stopPropagation());

    this.parent.children.push(this);
    this.parent.controllers.push(this);

    this.parent.$children.appendChild(this.domElement);

    this._listenCallback = this._listenCallback.bind(this);

    this._onChange = undefined;
    this._onFinishChange = undefined;
    this._changed = false;
    this._listening = false;
    this._listenCallbackID = undefined;
    this._listenPrevValue = null;
    this._pendingInsertion = false;
  }

  /**
   * Sets the name of the controller and its label in the GUI.
   *
   * @param name - The new name.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  name(name: string): this {
    this.$name.textContent = name;
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Pass a function to be called whenever the value is modified by this controller.
   * The function receives the new value as its first parameter. The value of `this` will be the
   * controller.
   *
   * For function controllers, the `onChange` callback will be fired on click, after the function
   * executes.
   *
   * @param callback - Receives the new value.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  onChange(callback: (value: unknown) => void): this {
    this._onChange = callback;
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Calls the `onChange` methods of this controller and its parent GUI.
   */
  _callOnChange(): void {
    this.parent._callOnChange(this as Controller);

    if (this._onChange !== undefined) {
      this._onChange.call(this, this.getValue());
    }

    this._changed = true;
  }

  /**
   * Pass a function to be called after this controller has been modified and loses focus.
   *
   * @param callback - Receives the final value.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  onFinishChange(callback: (value: unknown) => void): this {
    this._onFinishChange = callback;
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Should be called by the controller when its widget loses focus.
   */
  _callOnFinishChange(): void {
    if (this._changed) {
      this.parent._callOnFinishChange(this);

      if (this._onFinishChange !== undefined) {
        this._onFinishChange.call(this, this.getValue());
      }
    }

    this._changed = false;
  }

  /**
   * Sets this controller back to its initial value.
   *
   * @returns `this`
   */
  reset(): this {
    this.setValue(this.initialValue);
    this._callOnFinishChange();
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Enables this controller.
   *
   * @param enabled - Pass `false` to disable.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  enable(enabled = true): this {
    return this.disable(!enabled);
  }

  /**
   * Disables this controller.
   *
   * @param disabled - Pass `false` to enable.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  disable(disabled = true): this {
    if (disabled === this._disabled) return this;

    this._disabled = disabled;

    this.domElement.classList.toggle("disabled", disabled);
    this.$disable.toggleAttribute("disabled", disabled);

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Shows the controller after it's been hidden.
   *
   * @param show - Pass `false` to hide.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  show(show = true): this {
    this._hidden = !show;

    this.domElement.style.display = this._hidden ? "none" : "";

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Hides the controller.
   *
   * @returns `this`
   */
  hide(): this {
    return this.show(false);
  }

  /**
   * Changes this controller into a dropdown of options.
   *
   * Calling this method on an option controller will simply update the options. However, if this
   * controller was not already an option controller, old references to this controller are
   * destroyed, and a new controller is added to the end of the GUI.
   *
   * @param options - Option values keyed by labels, or as an array.
   * @returns The replacement controller. Not `this` when re-created.
   */
  options(options: Record<string, unknown> | unknown[]): Controller {
    const controller = this.parent.add(this.object, this.property, options);
    controller.name(this.$name.textContent ?? "");
    this.destroy();
    return controller;
  }

  /**
   * Sets the minimum value. Only works on number controllers.
   *
   * @param _min - Ignored unless overridden.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  min(_min: number): this {
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Sets the maximum value. Only works on number controllers.
   *
   * @param _max - Ignored unless overridden.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  max(_max: number): this {
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Rounds values set by this controller to multiples of `step`. Only works on number controllers.
   *
   * @param _step - Ignored unless overridden.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  step(_step: number): this {
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Rounds the displayed value to a fixed number of decimals, without affecting the actual value
   * like `step()`. Only works on number controllers.
   *
   * @param _decimals - Ignored unless overridden.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  decimals(_decimals: number): this {
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Calls `updateDisplay()` every animation frame. Pass `false` to stop listening.
   *
   * @param listen - Whether to listen for external updates.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  listen(listen = true): this {
    this._listening = listen;

    if (this._listenCallbackID !== undefined) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this._listenCallbackID);
      this._listenCallbackID = undefined;
    }

    if (this._listening) {
      this._listenCallback();
    }

    return this;
  }

  /** Listener loop body; polls the value and refreshes the display when it changed. */
  _listenCallback(): void {
    this._listenCallbackID = requestAnimationFrame(this._listenCallback);

    // To prevent framerate loss, make sure the value has changed before updating the display.
    // Note: save() is used here instead of `getValue()` only because of `ColorController`. The
    // `!==` operator won't work for color objects or arrays, but its `save()` returns a string.

    const curValue = this.save();

    if (curValue !== this._listenPrevValue) {
      this.updateDisplay();
    }

    this._listenPrevValue = curValue;
  }

  /**
   * Returns `object[property]`.
   */
  getValue(): unknown {
    return (this.object as Record<string, unknown>)[this.property];
  }

  /**
   * Sets the value of `object[property]`, invokes any `onChange` handlers and updates the display.
   *
   * @param value - The new value.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  setValue(value: unknown): this {
    if (this.getValue() !== value) {
      (this.object as Record<string, unknown>)[this.property] = value;
      this._callOnChange();
      this.updateDisplay();
    }

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Updates the display to keep it in sync with the current value. Useful for updating
   * controllers when their values have been modified outside of the GUI.
   *
   * @returns `this`
   */
  updateDisplay(): this {
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Recalls a value from a state object created by `save()`.
   *
   * @param value - The restored value.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  load(value: unknown): this {
    this.setValue(value);
    this._callOnFinishChange();
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Returns the persisted representation of the current value.
   */
  save(): unknown {
    return this.getValue();
  }

  /**
   * Destroys this controller and removes it from the parent GUI.
   */
  destroy(): void {
    this.listen(false);
    this.parent.children.splice(this.parent.children.indexOf(this), 1);
    this.parent.controllers.splice(this.parent.controllers.indexOf(this), 1);
    this.parent.$children.removeChild(this.domElement);
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/libs/lil-gui/GUI

````typescript
import { BooleanController, FunctionController, OptionController, StringController } from "./controllers";
import { ColorController } from "./ColorController";
import { NumberController } from "./NumberController";
import { Controller } from "./Controller";
import stylesheet from "./stylesheet";
import { injectStyles as injectStylesheet } from "./injectStyles";

let stylesInjected = false;

/** Options accepted by the `GUI` constructor. */
export interface GUIOptions {
  /**
   * Adds the GUI as a child in another GUI. Usually this is done for you by `addFolder()`.
   */
  parent?: GUI | undefined;

  /**
   * Adds the GUI to `document.body` and fixes it to the top right of the page.
   *
   * @default true
   */
  autoPlace?: boolean | undefined;

  /**
   * Adds the GUI to this DOM element. Overrides `autoPlace`.
   */
  container?: HTMLElement | undefined;

  /**
   * Width of the GUI in pixels, usually set when name labels become too long.
   *
   * @default undefined
   */
  width?: number | undefined;

  /**
   * Name to display in the title bar.
   *
   * @default 'Controls'
   */
  title?: string | undefined;

  /**
   * Pass `true` to close all folders in this GUI by default.
   *
   * @default false
   */
  closeFolders?: boolean | undefined;

  /**
   * Injects the default stylesheet into the page if this is the first GUI.
   * Pass `false` to use your own stylesheet.
   *
   * @default true
   */
  injectStyles?: boolean | undefined;

  /**
   * Makes controllers larger on touch devices. Pass `false` to disable touch styles.
   *
   * @default true
   */
  touchStyles?: boolean | undefined;
}

/** Argument payload of `onChange`/`onFinishChange` handlers bound through `GUI`. */
export interface GUIChangeEvent {
  /** The object that was modified. */
  object: Record<string, unknown>;
  /** The name of the modified property. */
  property: string;
  /** The new value of the controller. */
  value: unknown;
  /** The controller that was modified. */
  controller: Controller;
}

/**
 * A lightweight graphical user interface. Changes made with GUI are automatically applied to
 * the controlled object.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { GUI } from 'ek3d/addons/libs/lil-gui';
 *
 * const gui = new GUI();
 *
 * const params = { size: 1, color: '#ff0000', animate: true };
 *
 * gui.add( params, 'size', 0, 2 );
 * gui.addColor( params, 'color' );
 * gui.add( params, 'animate' );
 * ```
 */
export class GUI {
  /**
   * The GUI containing this folder, or `undefined` if this is a root GUI.
   */
  parent: GUI | undefined;

  /**
   * The top level GUI containing this folder, or `this` if this is a root GUI.
   */
  root: GUI;

  /**
   * The list of controllers and folders contained by this GUI.
   */
  children: Array<GUI | Controller>;

  /**
   * The list of controllers contained by this GUI.
   */
  controllers: Controller[];

  /**
   * The list of folders contained by this GUI.
   */
  folders: GUI[];

  /**
   * Used to determine if the GUI is closed. Use `gui.open()` or `gui.close()` to change this.
   *
   * @default false
   */
  _closed: boolean;

  /**
   * Used to determine if the GUI is hidden. Use `gui.show()` or `gui.hide()` to change this.
   *
   * @default false
   */
  _hidden: boolean;

  /**
   * Current title of the GUI. Use `gui.title('Title')` to modify this value.
   */
  _title: string = "Controls";

  /**
   * The outermost container element.
   */
  domElement: HTMLDivElement;

  /**
   * The DOM element that contains the title.
   */
  $title: HTMLButtonElement;

  /**
   * The DOM element that contains children.
   */
  $children: HTMLDivElement;

  _closeFolders: boolean = false;

  _onChange: ((event: GUIChangeEvent) => void) | undefined;
  _onFinishChange: ((event: GUIChangeEvent) => void) | undefined;
  _onOpenClose: ((gui: GUI) => void) | undefined;

  /**
   * Creates a panel that holds controllers.
   *
   * @param options - Panel options; `parent`-less GUIs auto-place into `document.body`.
   */
  constructor({
    parent,
    autoPlace = parent === undefined,
    container,
    width,
    title = "Controls",
    closeFolders = false,
    injectStyles = true,
    touchStyles = true,
  }: GUIOptions = {}) {
    this.parent = parent;
    this.root = parent ? parent.root : this;

    this.children = [];
    this.controllers = [];
    this.folders = [];

    this._closed = false;
    this._hidden = false;
    this._onChange = undefined;
    this._onFinishChange = undefined;
    this._onOpenClose = undefined;

    this.domElement = document.createElement("div");
    this.domElement.classList.add("lil-gui");

    this.$title = document.createElement("button");
    this.$title.classList.add("title");
    this.$title.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");

    this.$title.addEventListener("click", () => this.openAnimated(this._closed));

    // enables :active pseudo class on mobile
    this.$title.addEventListener("touchstart", () => {}, { passive: true });

    this.$children = document.createElement("div");
    this.$children.classList.add("children");

    this.domElement.appendChild(this.$title);
    this.domElement.appendChild(this.$children);

    this.title(title);

    if (this.parent) {
      this.parent.children.push(this);
      this.parent.folders.push(this);

      this.parent.$children.appendChild(this.domElement);

      // Stop the constructor early, everything onward only applies to root GUI's
      return;
    }

    this.domElement.classList.add("root");

    if (touchStyles) {
      this.domElement.classList.add("allow-touch-styles");
    }

    // Inject stylesheet if we haven't done that yet
    if (!stylesInjected && injectStyles) {
      injectStylesheet(stylesheet);
      stylesInjected = true;
    }

    if (container) {
      container.appendChild(this.domElement);
    } else if (autoPlace) {
      this.domElement.classList.add("autoPlace");
      document.body.appendChild(this.domElement);
    }

    if (width) {
      this.domElement.style.setProperty("--width", String(width) + "px");
    }

    this._closeFolders = closeFolders;
  }

  /**
   * Adds a controller to the GUI, inferring controller type using the `typeof` operator.
   *
   * ```ts
   * gui.add( object, 'property' );
   * gui.add( object, 'number', 0, 100, 1 );
   * gui.add( object, 'options', [ 1, 2, 3 ] );
   * ```
   *
   * @param object The object the controller will modify.
   * @param property Name of the property to control.
   * @param $1 Minimum value for number controllers, or the set of selectable values for a dropdown.
   * @param max Maximum value for number controllers.
   * @param step Step value for number controllers.
   * @returns The created controller.
   */
  add(
    object: object,
    property: string,
    $1?: number | Record<string, unknown> | unknown[],
    max?: number,
    step?: number,
  ): Controller {
    if (Object($1) === $1) {
      return new OptionController(
        this,
        object as Record<string, unknown>,
        property,
        $1 as Record<string, unknown> | unknown[],
      );
    }

    const initialValue = (object as Record<string, unknown>)[property];

    switch (typeof initialValue) {
      case "number":
        return new NumberController(
          this,
          object as Record<string, unknown>,
          property,
          $1 as number | undefined,
          max,
          step,
        );
      case "boolean":
        return new BooleanController(this, object as Record<string, unknown>, property);
      case "string":
        return new StringController(this, object as Record<string, unknown>, property);
      case "function":
        return new FunctionController(this, object as Record<string, unknown>, property);
    }

    console.error(`gui.add failed\n[property:`, property, `\nobject:`, object, `\nvalue:`, initialValue);

    return undefined as unknown as Controller;
  }

  /**
   * Adds a color controller to the GUI.
   *
   * ```ts
   * const params = {
   * 	cssColor: '#ff00ff',
   * 	rgbColor: { r: 0, g: 0.2, b: 0.4 },
   * 	customRange: [ 0, 127, 255 ],
   * };
   *
   * gui.addColor( params, 'cssColor' );
   * gui.addColor( params, 'rgbColor' );
   * gui.addColor( params, 'customRange', 255 );
   * ```
   *
   * @param object The object the controller will modify.
   * @param property Name of the property to control.
   * @param rgbScale Maximum value for a color channel when using an RGB color. You may
   * need to set this to 255 if your colors are too bright.
   * @returns The created controller.
   */
  addColor(object: Record<string, unknown>, property: string, rgbScale = 1): ColorController {
    return new ColorController(this, object as Record<string, unknown>, property, rgbScale);
  }

  /**
   * Adds a folder to the GUI, which is just another GUI. This method returns
   * the nested GUI so you can add controllers to it.
   *
   * @param title Name to display in the folder's title bar.
   * @returns The created folder.
   */
  addFolder(title: string): GUI {
    const folder = new GUI({ parent: this, title });
    if (this.root._closeFolders) folder.close();
    return folder;
  }

  /**
   * Recalls values that were saved with `gui.save()`.
   *
   * @param obj The saved state.
   * @param recursive Pass false to exclude folders descending from this GUI.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  load(obj: { controllers?: Record<string, unknown>; folders?: Record<string, unknown> }, recursive = true): this {
    const savedControllers = obj.controllers;
    const savedFolders = obj.folders;

    if (savedControllers !== undefined) {
      this.controllers.forEach((c) => {
        if (c instanceof FunctionController) return;

        if (c.property in savedControllers) {
          c.load(savedControllers[c.property]);
        }
      });
    }

    if (recursive && savedFolders !== undefined) {
      this.folders.forEach((f) => {
        if (f.title() in savedFolders) {
          f.load(
            savedFolders[f.title()] as { controllers?: Record<string, unknown>; folders?: Record<string, unknown> },
          );
        }
      });
    }

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Returns an object mapping property names to values. The object can be passed to `gui.load()`
   * to recall these values.
   *
   * @param recursive Pass false to exclude folders descending from this GUI.
   * @returns The saved state.
   */
  save(recursive = true): { controllers: Record<string, unknown>; folders: Record<string, unknown> } {
    const obj = {
      controllers: {} as Record<string, unknown>,
      folders: {} as Record<string, unknown>,
    };

    this.controllers.forEach((c) => {
      if (c instanceof FunctionController) return;

      if (c.property in obj.controllers) {
        throw new Error(`Cannot save GUI with duplicate property "${c.property}"`);
      }

      obj.controllers[c.property] = c.save();
    });

    if (recursive) {
      this.folders.forEach((f) => {
        if (f.title() in obj.folders) {
          throw new Error(`Cannot save GUI with duplicate folder "${f.title()}"`);
        }

        obj.folders[f.title()] = f.save();
      });
    }

    return obj;
  }

  /**
   * Opens a GUI or folder. GUI and folders are open by default.
   *
   * @param open Pass false to close.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  open(open = true): this {
    this._setClosed(!open);

    this.$title.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(!this._closed));
    this.domElement.classList.toggle("closed", this._closed);

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Closes the GUI.
   *
   * @returns `this`
   */
  close(): this {
    return this.open(false);
  }

  _setClosed(closed: boolean): void {
    if (this._closed === closed) return;
    this._closed = closed;
    this._callOnOpenClose(this);
  }

  /**
   * Shows the GUI after it's been hidden.
   *
   * @param show Pass `false` to hide.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  show(show = true): this {
    this._hidden = !show;

    this.domElement.style.display = this._hidden ? "none" : "";

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Hides the GUI.
   *
   * @returns `this`
   */
  hide(): this {
    return this.show(false);
  }

  /**
   * Opens or closes the GUI with an animated height transition.
   *
   * @param open Pass `false` to close.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  openAnimated(open = true): this {
    // set state immediately
    this._setClosed(!open);

    this.$title.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(!this._closed));

    // wait for next frame to measure $children
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      // explicitly set initial height for transition
      const initialHeight = this.$children.clientHeight;
      this.$children.style.height = initialHeight + "px";

      this.domElement.classList.add("transition");

      const onTransitionEnd = (e: TransitionEvent) => {
        if (e.target !== this.$children) return;
        this.$children.style.height = "";
        this.domElement.classList.remove("transition");
        this.$children.removeEventListener("transitionend", onTransitionEnd);
      };

      this.$children.addEventListener("transitionend", onTransitionEnd);

      const targetHeight = !open ? 0 : this.$children.scrollHeight;

      this.domElement.classList.toggle("closed", !open);

      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        this.$children.style.height = targetHeight + "px";
      });
    });

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Change the title of this GUI.
   *
   * @param title The new title.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  title(title?: string): string {
    if (title !== undefined) {
      this._title = title;
      this.$title.textContent = title;
    }

    return this._title;
  }

  /**
   * Resets all controllers to their initial values.
   *
   * @param recursive Pass false to exclude folders descending from this GUI.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  reset(recursive = true): this {
    const controllers = recursive ? this.controllersRecursive() : this.controllers;
    controllers.forEach((c) => c.reset());
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Pass a function to be called whenever a controller in this GUI changes.
   *
   * @param callback Receives the change event.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  onChange(callback: (event: GUIChangeEvent) => void): this {
    this._onChange = callback;
    return this;
  }

  _callOnChange(controller: Controller): void {
    if (this.parent) {
      this.parent._callOnChange(controller);
    }

    if (this._onChange !== undefined) {
      this._onChange.call(this, {
        object: controller.object,
        property: controller.property,
        value: controller.getValue(),
        controller,
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Pass a function to be called whenever a controller in this GUI has finished changing.
   *
   * @param callback Receives the change event.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  onFinishChange(callback: (event: GUIChangeEvent) => void): this {
    this._onFinishChange = callback;
    return this;
  }

  _callOnFinishChange(controller: Controller): void {
    if (this.parent) {
      this.parent._callOnFinishChange(controller);
    }

    if (this._onFinishChange !== undefined) {
      this._onFinishChange.call(this, {
        object: controller.object,
        property: controller.property,
        value: controller.getValue(),
        controller,
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Pass a function to be called when this GUI or its descendants are opened or closed.
   *
   * @param callback Receives the toggled GUI.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  onOpenClose(callback: (gui: GUI) => void): this {
    this._onOpenClose = callback;
    return this;
  }

  _callOnOpenClose(changedGUI: GUI): void {
    if (this.parent) {
      this.parent._callOnOpenClose(changedGUI);
    }

    if (this._onOpenClose !== undefined) {
      this._onOpenClose.call(this, changedGUI);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Destroys all DOM elements and event listeners associated with this GUI.
   */
  destroy(): void {
    if (this.parent) {
      this.parent.children.splice(this.parent.children.indexOf(this), 1);
      this.parent.folders.splice(this.parent.folders.indexOf(this), 1);
    }

    if (this.domElement.parentElement) {
      this.domElement.parentElement.removeChild(this.domElement);
    }

    Array.from(this.children as GUI[]).forEach((c) => c.destroy());
  }

  /**
   * Returns an array of controllers contained by this GUI and its descendants.
   *
   * @returns The recursive controller list.
   */
  controllersRecursive(): Controller[] {
    let controllers = Array.from(this.controllers);
    this.folders.forEach((f) => {
      controllers = controllers.concat(f.controllersRecursive());
    });
    return controllers;
  }

  /**
   * Returns an array of folders contained by this GUI and its descendants.
   *
   * @returns The recursive folder list.
   */
  foldersRecursive(): GUI[] {
    let folders = Array.from(this.folders);
    this.folders.forEach((f) => {
      folders = folders.concat(f.foldersRecursive());
    });
    return folders;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/libs/lil-gui/NumberController

```typescript
import { Controller } from "./Controller";
import type { GUI } from "./GUI";

/**
 * Controls a number property with a text input. When both `min()` and `max()` are set,
 * displays a draggable slider filled proportionally to the value.
 */
export class NumberController extends Controller {
  $input!: HTMLInputElement;
  $slider: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  $fill: HTMLDivElement | undefined;

  _hasSlider: boolean;

  _inputFocused: boolean;

  _min: number | undefined;
  _max: number | undefined;
  _step: number;
  _stepExplicit: boolean;
  _decimals: number | undefined;

  /**
   * Constructs a number controller.
   *
   * @param parent - The GUI that owns this controller.
   * @param object - The object whose property is controlled.
   * @param property - The property name.
   * @param min - Minimum value, enables the slider when `max` is given too.
   * @param max - Maximum value.
   * @param step - Snap step; defaults to an implicit step derived from min/max.
   */
  constructor(
    parent: GUI,
    object: Record<string, unknown>,
    property: string,
    min?: number,
    max?: number,
    step?: number,
  ) {
    super(parent, object, property, "number");

    this._hasSlider = false;
    this._inputFocused = false;
    this._min = undefined;
    this._max = undefined;
    this._step = 0.1;
    this._stepExplicit = false;
    this._decimals = undefined;

    this._initInput();

    this.min(min);
    this.max(max);

    const stepExplicit = step !== undefined;
    this.step(stepExplicit ? step : this._getImplicitStep(), stepExplicit);

    this.updateDisplay();
  }

  /**
   * Rounds the displayed value to a fixed number of decimals without affecting the actual value.
   *
   * @param decimals - Digits after the decimal point.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  override decimals(decimals: number): this {
    this._decimals = decimals;
    this.updateDisplay();
    return this;
  }

  override min(min?: number): this {
    this._min = min;
    this._onUpdateMinMax();
    return this;
  }

  override max(max?: number): this {
    this._max = max;
    this._onUpdateMinMax();
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Sets the snap step.
   *
   * @param step - The new step.
   * @param explicit - Whether the step was explicitly requested (drives arrow-key multiplier).
   * @returns `this`
   */
  override step(step: number, explicit = true): this {
    this._step = step;
    this._stepExplicit = explicit;
    return this;
  }

  override updateDisplay(): this {
    const value = this.getValue() as number;

    if (this._hasSlider) {
      let percent = (value - this._min!) / (this._max! - this._min!);
      percent = Math.max(0, Math.min(percent, 1));

      this.$fill!.style.width = percent * 100 + "%";
    }

    if (!this._inputFocused) {
      this.$input.value = this._decimals === undefined ? String(value) : value.toFixed(this._decimals);
    }

    return this;
  }

  _initInput(): void {
    this.$input = document.createElement("input");
    this.$input.setAttribute("type", "text");
    this.$input.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", this.$name.id);

    // On touch devices only, use input[type=number] to force a numeric keyboard.
    // Ideally we could use one input type everywhere, but [type=number] has quirks
    // on desktop, and [inputmode=decimal] has quirks on iOS.
    // See https://github.com/georgealways/lil-gui/pull/16

    const isTouch = window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches;

    if (isTouch) {
      this.$input.setAttribute("type", "number");
      this.$input.setAttribute("step", "any");
    }

    this.$widget.appendChild(this.$input);

    this.$disable = this.$input;

    const onInput = () => {
      let value = parseFloat(this.$input.value);

      if (isNaN(value)) return;

      if (this._stepExplicit) {
        value = this._snap(value);
      }

      this.setValue(this._clamp(value));
    };

    // Keys & mouse wheel

    const increment = (delta: number) => {
      const value = parseFloat(this.$input.value);

      if (isNaN(value)) return;

      this._snapClampSetValue(value + delta);

      // Force the input to updateDisplay when it's focused
      this.$input.value = String(this.getValue());
    };

    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      // Using `e.key` instead of `e.code` also catches NumpadEnter
      if (e.key === "Enter") {
        this.$input.blur();
      }
      if (e.code === "ArrowUp") {
        e.preventDefault();
        increment(this._step * this._arrowKeyMultiplier(e));
      }
      if (e.code === "ArrowDown") {
        e.preventDefault();
        increment(this._step * this._arrowKeyMultiplier(e) * -1);
      }
    };

    const onWheel = (e: WheelEvent) => {
      if (this._inputFocused) {
        e.preventDefault();
        increment(this._step * this._normalizeMouseWheel(e));
      }
    };

    // Vertical drag

    let testingForVerticalDrag = false,
      initClientX: number,
      prevClientY: number,
      initValue: number,
      dragDelta: number;

    // Once the mouse is dragged more than DRAG_THRESH px on any axis, we decide
    // on the user's intent: horizontal means highlight, vertical means drag.
    const DRAG_THRESH = 5;

    const onMouseDown = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      initClientX = e.clientX;
      prevClientY = e.clientY;
      testingForVerticalDrag = true;

      initValue = this.getValue() as number;
      dragDelta = 0;

      window.addEventListener("mousemove", onMouseMove);
      window.addEventListener("mouseup", onMouseUp);
    };

    const onMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (testingForVerticalDrag) {
        const dx = e.clientX - initClientX;
        const dy = e.clientY - prevClientY;

        if (Math.abs(dy) > DRAG_THRESH) {
          e.preventDefault();
          this.$input.blur();
          testingForVerticalDrag = false;
          this._setDraggingStyle(true, "vertical");
        } else if (Math.abs(dx) > DRAG_THRESH) {
          onMouseUp();
        }
      }

      // This isn't an else so that the first move counts towards dragDelta
      if (!testingForVerticalDrag) {
        const dy = e.clientY - prevClientY;

        dragDelta -= dy * this._step * this._arrowKeyMultiplier(e);

        // Clamp dragDelta so we don't have 'dead space' after dragging past bounds.
        // We're okay with the fact that bounds can be undefined here.
        if (this._max !== undefined && initValue + dragDelta > this._max) {
          dragDelta = this._max - initValue;
        } else if (this._min !== undefined && initValue + dragDelta < this._min) {
          dragDelta = this._min - initValue;
        }

        this._snapClampSetValue(initValue + dragDelta);
      }

      prevClientY = e.clientY;
    };

    const onMouseUp = () => {
      this._setDraggingStyle(false, "vertical");
      this._callOnFinishChange();
      window.removeEventListener("mousemove", onMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener("mouseup", onMouseUp);
    };

    // Focus state & onFinishChange

    const onFocus = () => {
      this._inputFocused = true;
    };

    const onBlur = () => {
      this._inputFocused = false;
      this.updateDisplay();
      this._callOnFinishChange();
    };

    this.$input.addEventListener("input", onInput);
    this.$input.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    this.$input.addEventListener("wheel", onWheel, { passive: false });
    this.$input.addEventListener("mousedown", onMouseDown);
    this.$input.addEventListener("focus", onFocus);
    this.$input.addEventListener("blur", onBlur);
  }

  _initSlider(): void {
    this._hasSlider = true;

    // Build DOM

    this.$slider = document.createElement("div");
    this.$slider.classList.add("slider");

    this.$fill = document.createElement("div");
    this.$fill.classList.add("fill");

    this.$slider.appendChild(this.$fill);
    this.$widget.insertBefore(this.$slider, this.$input);

    this.domElement.classList.add("has-slider");

    // Map clientX to value

    const map = (v: number, a: number, b: number, c: number, d: number) => {
      return ((v - a) / (b - a)) * (d - c) + c;
    };

    const setValueFromX = (clientX: number) => {
      const rect = this.$slider!.getBoundingClientRect();
      const value = map(clientX, rect.left, rect.right, this._min!, this._max!);
      this._snapClampSetValue(value);
    };

    // Mouse drag

    const mouseDown = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      this._setDraggingStyle(true);
      setValueFromX(e.clientX);
      window.addEventListener("mousemove", mouseMove);
      window.addEventListener("mouseup", mouseUp);
    };

    const mouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      setValueFromX(e.clientX);
    };

    const mouseUp = () => {
      this._callOnFinishChange();
      this._setDraggingStyle(false);
      window.removeEventListener("mousemove", mouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener("mouseup", mouseUp);
    };

    // Touch drag

    let testingForScroll = false,
      prevClientX: number,
      prevClientY: number;

    const beginTouchDrag = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      this._setDraggingStyle(true);
      setValueFromX(e.touches[0].clientX);
      testingForScroll = false;
    };

    const onTouchStart = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (e.touches.length > 1) return;

      // If we're in a scrollable container, we should wait for the first
      // touchmove to see if the user is trying to slide or scroll.
      if (this._hasScrollBar) {
        prevClientX = e.touches[0].clientX;
        prevClientY = e.touches[0].clientY;
        testingForScroll = true;
      } else {
        // Otherwise, we can set the value straight away on touchstart.
        beginTouchDrag(e);
      }

      window.addEventListener("touchmove", onTouchMove, { passive: false });
      window.addEventListener("touchend", onTouchEnd);
    };

    const onTouchMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (testingForScroll) {
        const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - prevClientX;
        const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - prevClientY;

        if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) {
          // We moved horizontally, set the value and stop checking.
          beginTouchDrag(e);
        } else {
          // This was, in fact, an attempt to scroll. Abort.
          window.removeEventListener("touchmove", onTouchMove);
          window.removeEventListener("touchend", onTouchEnd);
        }
      } else {
        e.preventDefault();
        setValueFromX(e.touches[0].clientX);
      }
    };

    const onTouchEnd = () => {
      this._callOnFinishChange();
      this._setDraggingStyle(false);
      window.removeEventListener("touchmove", onTouchMove);
      window.removeEventListener("touchend", onTouchEnd);
    };

    // Mouse wheel

    // We have to use a debounced function to call onFinishChange because
    // there's no way to tell when the user is "done" mouse-wheeling.
    const callOnFinishChange = this._callOnFinishChange.bind(this);
    const WHEEL_DEBOUNCE_TIME = 400;
    let wheelFinishChangeTimeout: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;

    const onWheel = (e: WheelEvent) => {
      // ignore vertical wheels if there's a scrollbar
      const isVertical = Math.abs(e.deltaX) < Math.abs(e.deltaY);
      if (isVertical && this._hasScrollBar) return;

      e.preventDefault();

      // set value
      const delta = this._normalizeMouseWheel(e) * this._step;
      this._snapClampSetValue((this.getValue() as number) + delta);

      // force the input to updateDisplay when it's focused
      this.$input.value = String(this.getValue());

      // debounce onFinishChange
      clearTimeout(wheelFinishChangeTimeout);
      wheelFinishChangeTimeout = setTimeout(callOnFinishChange, WHEEL_DEBOUNCE_TIME);
    };

    this.$slider.addEventListener("mousedown", mouseDown);
    this.$slider.addEventListener("touchstart", onTouchStart, { passive: false });
    this.$slider.addEventListener("wheel", onWheel, { passive: false });
  }

  _setDraggingStyle(active: boolean, axis = "horizontal"): void {
    if (this.$slider) {
      this.$slider.classList.toggle("active", active);
    }
    document.body.classList.toggle(axis === "vertical" ? "lil-gui-vertical" : "lil-gui-dragging", active);
  }

  _getImplicitStep(): number {
    if (this._hasMin && this._hasMax) {
      return (this._max! - this._min!) / 1000;
    }

    return 0.1;
  }

  _onUpdateMinMax(): void {
    if (!this._hasSlider && this._hasMin && this._hasMax) {
      // If this is the first time we're hearing about min and max
      // and we haven't explicitly stated what our step is, let's
      // update that too.
      if (!this._stepExplicit) {
        this.step(this._getImplicitStep(), false);
      }

      this._initSlider();
      this.updateDisplay();
    }
  }

  _normalizeMouseWheel(e: WheelEvent): number {
    let { deltaX, deltaY } = e;

    // Safari and Chrome report weird non-integral values for a notched wheel,
    // but still expose actual lines scrolled via wheelDelta. Notched wheels
    // should behave the same way as arrow keys.
    const wheelDelta = (e as WheelEvent & { wheelDelta?: number }).wheelDelta;
    if (Math.floor(e.deltaY) !== e.deltaY && wheelDelta) {
      deltaX = 0;
      deltaY = -wheelDelta / 120;
      deltaY *= this._stepExplicit ? 1 : 10;
    }

    const wheel = deltaX + -deltaY;

    return wheel;
  }

  _arrowKeyMultiplier(e: KeyboardEvent | MouseEvent | WheelEvent): number {
    let mult = this._stepExplicit ? 1 : 10;

    if (e.shiftKey) {
      mult *= 10;
    } else if (e.altKey) {
      mult /= 10;
    }

    return mult;
  }

  _snap(value: number): number {
    // Make the steps "start" at min or max.
    let offset = 0;
    if (this._hasMin) {
      offset = this._min as number;
    } else if (this._hasMax) {
      offset = this._max as number;
    }

    value -= offset;

    value = Math.round(value / this._step) * this._step;

    value += offset;

    // Used to prevent "flyaway" decimals like 1.00000000000001
    value = parseFloat(value.toPrecision(15));

    return value;
  }

  _clamp(value: number): number {
    // either condition is false if min or max is undefined
    if (this._min !== undefined && value < this._min) value = this._min;
    if (this._max !== undefined && value > this._max) value = this._max;
    return value;
  }

  _snapClampSetValue(value: number): void {
    this.setValue(this._clamp(this._snap(value)));
  }

  get _hasScrollBar(): boolean {
    const root = this.parent.root.$children;
    return root.scrollHeight > root.clientHeight;
  }

  get _hasMin(): boolean {
    return this._min !== undefined;
  }

  get _hasMax(): boolean {
    return this._max !== undefined;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/libs/lil-gui/colorUtils

```typescript
/** Normalizes any supported CSS color string to an `#rrggbb` hex string, or `false`. */
export function normalizeColorString(string: string): string | false {
  let match: RegExpExecArray | RegExpMatchArray | null;

  if ((match = string.match(/(#|0x)?([a-f0-9]{6})/i))) {
    return `#${match[2]}`;
  } else if ((match = string.match(/rgb\(\s*(\d*)\s*,\s*(\d*)\s*,\s*(\d*)\s*\)/))) {
    return (
      `#${parseInt(match[1]).toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}` +
      `${parseInt(match[2]).toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}` +
      `${parseInt(match[3]).toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
    );
  } else if ((match = string.match(/^(?:#)?([a-f0-9])([a-f0-9])([a-f0-9])$/i)) !== null) {
    const a = match[1];
    const b = match[2];
    const c = match[3];
    return `#${a}${a}${b}${b}${c}${c}`;
  }

  return false;
}

type ColorChannelTuple = number[];

/** A color format description able to read and write hex strings. */
export interface ColorFormat {
  isPrimitive: boolean;
  match(v: unknown): boolean;
  fromHexString(
    hex: string,
    target?: ColorChannelTuple | { r: number; g: number; b: number },
    rgbScale?: number,
  ): unknown;
  toHexString(value: unknown, rgbScale?: number): string;
}

/** Color formats matched against the property's initial value. */
const STRING: ColorFormat = {
  isPrimitive: true,
  match: (v: unknown): boolean => typeof v === "string",
  fromHexString: (hex: string): string => normalizeColorString(hex) || hex,
  toHexString: (value: string): string => normalizeColorString(value) || value,
};

const INT: ColorFormat = {
  isPrimitive: true,
  match: (v: unknown): boolean => typeof v === "number",
  fromHexString: (hex: string): number => parseInt(hex.substring(1), 16),
  toHexString: (value: number): string => `#${value.toString(16).padStart(6, "0")}`,
};

const ARRAY: ColorFormat = {
  isPrimitive: false,
  match: (v: unknown): boolean => Array.isArray(v) || ArrayBuffer.isView(v),
  fromHexString(hex: string, target: ColorChannelTuple, rgbScale = 1): void {
    const int = INT.fromHexString(hex) as number;

    target[0] = (((int >> 16) & 255) / 255) * rgbScale;
    target[1] = (((int >> 8) & 255) / 255) * rgbScale;
    target[2] = ((int & 255) / 255) * rgbScale;
  },
  toHexString([r, g, b]: ColorChannelTuple, rgbScale = 1): string {
    rgbScale = 255 / rgbScale;

    const int = ((r * rgbScale) << 16) ^ ((g * rgbScale) << 8) ^ ((b * rgbScale) << 0);

    return INT.toHexString(int);
  },
};

const OBJECT: ColorFormat = {
  isPrimitive: false,
  match: (v: unknown): boolean => Object(v) === v && !Array.isArray(v) && !ArrayBuffer.isView(v),
  fromHexString(hex: string, target: { r: number; g: number; b: number }, rgbScale = 1): void {
    const int = INT.fromHexString(hex) as number;

    target.r = (((int >> 16) & 255) / 255) * rgbScale;
    target.g = (((int >> 8) & 255) / 255) * rgbScale;
    target.b = ((int & 255) / 255) * rgbScale;
  },
  toHexString({ r, g, b }: { r: number; g: number; b: number }, rgbScale = 1): string {
    rgbScale = 255 / rgbScale;

    const int = ((r * rgbScale) << 16) ^ ((g * rgbScale) << 8) ^ ((b * rgbScale) << 0);

    return INT.toHexString(int);
  },
};

const FORMATS = [STRING, INT, ARRAY, OBJECT];

/**
 * Returns the color format that matches the given initial `value`.
 *
 * @param value - The initial property value.
 * @returns The matching format description, or `undefined` if unsupported.
 */
export function getColorFormat(
  value: string | number | unknown[] | { r: number; g: number; b: number },
): ColorFormat | undefined {
  return FORMATS.find((format) => format.match(value));
}
```

```typescript
import { Controller } from "./Controller";
import type { GUI } from "./GUI";

/**
 * Controls a boolean property with a checkbox.
 */
export class BooleanController extends Controller {
  /** The checkbox input of the widget. */
  $input: HTMLInputElement;

  /**
   * Constructs a boolean checkbox controller.
   *
   * @param parent - The GUI that owns this controller.
   * @param object - The object whose property is controlled.
   * @param property - The property name.
   */
  constructor(parent: GUI, object: Record<string, unknown>, property: string) {
    super(parent, object, property, "boolean", "label");

    this.$input = document.createElement("input");
    this.$input.setAttribute("type", "checkbox");
    this.$input.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", this.$name.id);

    this.$widget.appendChild(this.$input);

    this.$input.addEventListener("change", () => {
      this.setValue(this.$input.checked);
      this._callOnFinishChange();
    });

    this.$disable = this.$input;

    this.updateDisplay();
  }

  override updateDisplay(): this {
    this.$input.checked = this.getValue() as boolean;
    return this;
  }
}

/**
 * Controls a function property and runs it on click.
 */
export class FunctionController extends Controller {
  /** The button element that renders the function name. */
  $button: HTMLButtonElement;

  /**
   * Constructs a function button controller.
   *
   * @param parent - The GUI that owns this controller.
   * @param object - The object whose property is controlled.
   * @param property - The property name.
   */
  constructor(parent: GUI, object: Record<string, unknown>, property: string) {
    super(parent, object, property, "function");

    // Buttons are the only case where widget contains name
    this.$button = document.createElement("button");
    this.$button.appendChild(this.$name);
    this.$widget.appendChild(this.$button);

    this.$button.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      (this.getValue() as () => void).call(this.object);
      this._callOnChange();
    });

    // enables :active pseudo class on mobile
    this.$button.addEventListener("touchstart", () => {}, { passive: true });

    this.$disable = this.$button;
  }
}

/**
 * Controls a string property with a text input.
 */
export class StringController extends Controller {
  /** The text input of the widget. */
  $input: HTMLInputElement;

  /**
   * Constructs a string controller.
   *
   * @param parent - The GUI that owns this controller.
   * @param object - The object whose property is controlled.
   * @param property - The property name.
   */
  constructor(parent: GUI, object: Record<string, unknown>, property: string) {
    super(parent, object, property, "string");

    this.$input = document.createElement("input");
    this.$input.setAttribute("type", "text");
    this.$input.setAttribute("spellcheck", "false");
    this.$input.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", this.$name.id);

    this.$input.addEventListener("input", () => {
      this.setValue(this.$input.value);
    });

    this.$input.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Enter") {
        this.$input.blur();
      }
    });

    this.$input.addEventListener("blur", () => {
      this._callOnFinishChange();
    });

    this.$widget.appendChild(this.$input);

    this.$disable = this.$input;

    this.updateDisplay();
  }

  override updateDisplay(): this {
    this.$input.value = this.getValue() as string;
    return this;
  }
}

/**
 * Controls a property with a dropdown of predefined options.
 */
export class OptionController extends Controller {
  /** The select element of the widget. */
  $select: HTMLSelectElement;

  /** The label shown over the collapsed select. */
  $display: HTMLDivElement;

  /** Option values aligned with `$select`'s children. */
  _values: unknown[] = [];

  /** Option labels aligned with `_values`. */
  _names: string[] = [];

  /**
   * Constructs an option dropdown controller.
   *
   * @param parent - The GUI that owns this controller.
   * @param object - The object whose property is controlled.
   * @param property - The property name.
   * @param options - Option values keyed by labels, or as an array.
   */
  constructor(
    parent: GUI,
    object: Record<string, unknown>,
    property: string,
    options: Record<string, unknown> | unknown[],
  ) {
    super(parent, object, property, "option");

    this.$select = document.createElement("select");
    this.$select.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", this.$name.id);

    this.$display = document.createElement("div");
    this.$display.classList.add("display");

    this.$select.addEventListener("change", () => {
      this.setValue(this._values[this.$select.selectedIndex]);
      this._callOnFinishChange();
    });

    this.$select.addEventListener("focus", () => {
      this.$display.classList.add("focus");
    });

    this.$select.addEventListener("blur", () => {
      this.$display.classList.remove("focus");
    });

    this.$widget.appendChild(this.$select);
    this.$widget.appendChild(this.$display);

    this.$disable = this.$select;

    this.options(options);
  }

  /**
   * Replaces the dropdown options.
   *
   * @param options - Option values keyed by labels, or as an array.
   * @returns `this`
   */
  override options(options: Record<string, unknown> | unknown[]): this {
    this._values = Array.isArray(options) ? options : Object.values(options);
    this._names = Array.isArray(options) ? options.map(String) : Object.keys(options);

    this.$select.replaceChildren();

    this._names.forEach((name) => {
      const $option = document.createElement("option");
      $option.textContent = name;
      this.$select.appendChild($option);
    });

    this.updateDisplay();

    return this;
  }

  override updateDisplay(): this {
    const value = this.getValue();
    const index = this._values.indexOf(value);
    this.$select.selectedIndex = index;
    this.$display.textContent = index === -1 ? String(value) : this._names[index];
    return this;
  }
}

## ek3d/addons/libs/lil-gui/injectStyles

```typescript
/** Injects a stylesheet `<style>` before any existing `link[rel=stylesheet]` or `style` in `head`. */
export function injectStyles(cssContent: string): void {
  const injected = document.createElement("style");
  injected.innerHTML = cssContent;
  const before = document.querySelector("head link[rel=stylesheet], head style");
  if (before) {
    document.head.insertBefore(injected, before);
  } else {
    document.head.appendChild(injected);
  }
}
