const BEAM = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/3dmanufacturing/beamlattice/2017/02";
const BALL = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/3dmanufacturing/beamlattice/balls/2020/07";

function number(node: Element, name: string, fallback = NaN): number {
  const value = node.getAttribute(name);
  return value === null ? fallback : parseFloat(value);
}
function required(node: Element, name: string): string {
  const value = node.getAttribute(name);
  if (value === null) throw new Error(`ThreeMFLoader: Missing ${name} attribute.`);
  return value;
}
type ImplicitPorts = Record<string, Record<string, string>>;
interface ImplicitFunction {
  id: string | null;
  displayname: string | null;
  operations: Record<string, ImplicitPorts | Record<string, string | null | ImplicitPorts>>;
}
function implicitPorts(node: Element): ImplicitPorts {
  const result: ImplicitPorts = {};
  for (const port of Array.from(node.children)) {
    const args: Record<string, string> = { type: port.nodeName.substring(2) };
    for (const attribute of Array.from(port.attributes))
      if (attribute.specified) args[attribute.name] = attribute.value;
    result[port.getAttribute("identifier") ?? "null"] = args;
  }
  return result;
}
function implicitFunctions(resources: Element): Record<string, ImplicitFunction> {
  const result: Record<string, ImplicitFunction> = {};
  for (const node of Array.from(resources.querySelectorAll("implicitfunction"))) {
    const entry: ImplicitFunction = {
      id: node.getAttribute("id"),
      displayname: node.getAttribute("displayname"),
      operations: {},
    };
    for (const operation of Array.from(node.children)) {
      if (operation.nodeName === "i:in" || operation.nodeName === "i:out") {
        entry.operations[operation.nodeName === "i:in" ? "inputs" : "outputs"] = implicitPorts(operation);
      } else {
        const args: Record<string, string | null | ImplicitPorts> = {
          op: operation.nodeName.substring(2),
          identifier: operation.getAttribute("identifier"),
        };
        for (const child of Array.from(operation.children)) args[child.nodeName.substring(2)] = implicitPorts(child);
        entry.operations[operation.getAttribute("identifier") ?? "null"] = args;
      }
    }
    result[entry.id ?? "null"] = entry;
  }
  return result;
}
function transform(value: string | null): Matrix4 | undefined {
  if (value === null) return undefined;
  const t = value.trim().split(/\s+/).map(Number);
  if (t.length !== 12 || t.some((v) => !Number.isFinite(v))) throw new Error("ThreeMFLoader: Invalid transform.");
  return new Matrix4().set(t[0], t[3], t[6], t[9], t[1], t[4], t[7], t[10], t[2], t[5], t[8], t[11], 0, 0, 0, 1);
}
function parseMesh(node: Element): ThreeMFMeshData {
  const vertices: number[] = [];
  for (const vertex of Array.from(node.querySelectorAll("vertices vertex")))
    vertices.push(number(vertex, "x"), number(vertex, "y"), number(vertex, "z"));
  const indices: number[] = [];
  const triangleProperties: ThreeMFTriangle[] = [];
  for (const triangle of Array.from(node.querySelectorAll("triangles triangle"))) {
    const item: ThreeMFTriangle = {
      v1: number(triangle, "v1"),
      v2: number(triangle, "v2"),
      v3: number(triangle, "v3"),
    };
    indices.push(item.v1, item.v2, item.v3);
    const pid = triangle.getAttribute("pid");
    if (pid !== null) item.pid = pid;
    for (const key of ["p1", "p2", "p3"] as const) if (triangle.hasAttribute(key)) item[key] = number(triangle, key);
    triangleProperties.push(item);
  }
  const mesh: ThreeMFMeshData = {
    vertices: new Float32Array(vertices),
    triangles: new Uint32Array(indices),
    triangleProperties,
  };
  const lattice = node.getElementsByTagNameNS(BEAM, "beamlattice")[0];
  if (lattice !== undefined) {
    const clip = lattice.getAttribute("clippingmode") ?? lattice.getAttribute("clipping");
    if (clip !== null && clip !== "none") console.warn("ThreeMFLoader: Beam lattice clipping is not supported.");
    const beams: ThreeMFBeamLattice["beams"] = [];
    const balls: ThreeMFBeamLattice["balls"] = [];
    for (const beam of Array.from(lattice.getElementsByTagNameNS(BEAM, "beam"))) {
      const item: ThreeMFBeamLattice["beams"][number] = { v1: number(beam, "v1"), v2: number(beam, "v2") };
      if (beam.hasAttribute("r1")) item.r1 = number(beam, "r1");
      if (beam.hasAttribute("r2")) item.r2 = number(beam, "r2");
      beams.push(item);
    }
    for (const ball of Array.from(lattice.getElementsByTagNameNS(BALL, "ball"))) {
      const item: ThreeMFBeamLattice["balls"][number] = { vindex: number(ball, "vindex") };
      if (ball.hasAttribute("r")) item.r = number(ball, "r");
      balls.push(item);
    }
    mesh.beamlattice = {
      radius: number(lattice, "radius"),
      minLength: number(lattice, "minlength"),
      cap: lattice.getAttribute("cap") || "sphere",
      ballMode: lattice.getAttributeNS(BALL, "ballmode") || "none",
      ballRadius: parseFloat(lattice.getAttributeNS(BALL, "ballradius") ?? "NaN"),
      beams,
      balls,
    };
  }
  return mesh;
}
function latticeMesh(data: ThreeMFMeshData): Mesh | undefined {
  const lattice = data.beamlattice;
  if (lattice === undefined) return undefined;
  const geometries: BufferGeometry[] = [];
  const radii = new Map<number, number>();
  const a = new Vector3(),
    b = new Vector3(),
    direction = new Vector3();
  const up = new Vector3(0, 1, 0),
    rotation = new Quaternion(),
    matrix = new Matrix4();
  const addRadius = (index: number, radius: number) => radii.set(index, Math.max(radius, radii.get(index) ?? 0));
  for (const beam of lattice.beams) {
    a.fromArray(data.vertices, beam.v1 * 3);
    b.fromArray(data.vertices, beam.v2 * 3);
    const length = a.distanceTo(b);
    if (length < lattice.minLength || length === 0) continue;
    const r1 = beam.r1 ?? lattice.radius,
      r2 = beam.r2 ?? r1;
    const open = lattice.cap !== "butt";
    const geometry = new CylinderGeometry(r2, r1, length, 8, 1, open);
    rotation.setFromUnitVectors(up, direction.subVectors(b, a).divideScalar(length));
    matrix.makeRotationFromQuaternion(rotation).setPosition(a.add(b).multiplyScalar(0.5));
    geometry.applyMatrix4(matrix);
    geometries.push(geometry);
    if (open) {
      addRadius(beam.v1, r1);
      addRadius(beam.v2, r2);
    }
    if (lattice.ballMode === "all") {
      addRadius(beam.v1, lattice.ballRadius);
      addRadius(beam.v2, lattice.ballRadius);
    }
  }
  for (const ball of lattice.balls) addRadius(ball.vindex, ball.r ?? lattice.ballRadius);
  for (const [index, radius] of radii) {
    const geometry = new SphereGeometry(radius, 8, 6);
    a.fromArray(data.vertices, index * 3);
    geometry.translate(a.x, a.y, a.z);
    geometries.push(geometry);
  }
  if (geometries.length === 0) return undefined;
  const geometry = mergeGeometries(geometries);
  for (const item of geometries) item.dispose();
  if (geometry === null) throw new Error("ThreeMFLoader: Cannot merge lattice geometry.");
  return new Mesh(geometry, new MeshPhongMaterial({ name: Loader.DEFAULT_MATERIAL_NAME, color: 0xffffff }));
}

/** 3MF loader. ZIP decompression is supplied by the consumer. */
export class ThreeMFLoader extends Loader<Group, string> {
  zipRuntime: ThreeMFZipRuntime | null = null;
  availableExtensions: ThreeMFExtension[] = [];

  setZipRuntime(runtime: ThreeMFZipRuntime): this {
    this.zipRuntime = runtime;
    return this;
  }
  addExtension(extension: ThreeMFExtension): void {
    this.availableExtensions.push(extension);
  }
  override load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (group: Group) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (data) => {
        try {
          onLoad?.(this.parse(data as ArrayBuffer));
        } catch (error) {
          if (onError !== undefined) onError(error);
          else console.error(error);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  parse(data: ArrayBuffer): Group {
    if (this.zipRuntime === null) throw new Error("ThreeMFLoader: ZIP runtime is required.");
    const zip = this.zipRuntime.unzipSync(new Uint8Array(data));
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    const xml = (path: string): Document => {
      const bytes = zip[path];
      if (bytes === undefined) throw new Error(`ThreeMFLoader: Missing archive part ${path}.`);
      const document = new DOMParser().parseFromString(decoder.decode(bytes), "application/xml");
      if (document.documentElement.localName === "parsererror")
        throw new Error(`ThreeMFLoader: Invalid XML in ${path}.`);
      return document;
    };
    const relName = Object.keys(zip).find((name) => /_rels\/.rels$/.test(name));
    if (relName === undefined) throw new Error("ThreeMFLoader: Cannot find relationship file `rels` in 3MF archive.");
    const rels = Array.from(xml(relName).querySelectorAll("Relationship"));
    const modelRel = rels.find((rel) => (rel.getAttribute("Target") ?? "").toLowerCase().endsWith(".model"));
    if (modelRel === undefined) throw new Error("ThreeMFLoader: Cannot find model relationship.");
    const rootPath = required(modelRel, "Target").replace(/^\//, "");
    const modelPaths = Object.keys(zip).filter((name) => /^3D\/.*\.model$/i.test(name) && name !== rootPath);
    modelPaths.push(rootPath);
    const models = new Map<string, Element>();
    for (const path of modelPaths) {
      const root = xml(path).documentElement;
      if (root.localName.toLowerCase() !== "model") throw new Error(`ThreeMFLoader: Invalid model ${path}.`);
      models.set(path, root);
    }
    const textureLoader = new TextureLoader(this.manager);
    textureLoader.setPriority(this.priority);
    textureLoader.setCache(this.cache);
    const objects = new Map<string, Group>();
    const textures = new Map<Element, Texture>();
    const materials = new Map<Element, MeshPhongMaterial | MeshStandardMaterial>();

    const buildTexture = (node: Element, resources: Element): Texture | null => {
      const texid = required(node, "texid");
      const textureNode = Array.from(resources.querySelectorAll("texture2d")).find(
        (item) => item.getAttribute("id") === texid,
      );
      if (textureNode === undefined) return null;
      const cached = textures.get(textureNode);
      if (cached !== undefined) return cached;
      const path = required(textureNode, "path").replace(/^\//, "");
      const bytes = zip[path];
      if (bytes === undefined) throw new Error(`ThreeMFLoader: Missing texture ${path}.`);
      const uri = URL.createObjectURL(
        new Blob([bytes as Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>], { type: required(textureNode, "contenttype") }),
      );
      const texture = textureLoader.load(
        uri,
        () => URL.revokeObjectURL(uri),
        undefined,
        () => URL.revokeObjectURL(uri),
      );
      texture.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB;
      const wrap = (value: string | null) =>
        value === "mirror"
          ? Wrapping.MirroredRepeat
          : value === "none" || value === "clamp"
            ? Wrapping.ClampToEdge
            : Wrapping.Repeat;
      texture.wrapS = wrap(textureNode.getAttribute("tilestyleu"));
      texture.wrapT = wrap(textureNode.getAttribute("tilestylev"));
      const filter = textureNode.getAttribute("filter");
      texture.magFilter = filter === "nearest" ? TextureFilter.Nearest : TextureFilter.Linear;
      texture.minFilter =
        filter === "nearest"
          ? TextureFilter.Nearest
          : filter === "linear"
            ? TextureFilter.Linear
            : TextureFilter.LinearMipmapLinear;
      if (filter === "nearest" || filter === "linear") texture.generateMipmaps = false;
      textures.set(textureNode, texture);
      return texture;
    };
    const baseMaterial = (
      base: Element,
      index: number,
      resources: Element,
    ): MeshPhongMaterial | MeshStandardMaterial => {
      const cached = materials.get(base);
      if (cached !== undefined) return cached;
      const displayId = base.getAttribute("displaypropertiesid");
      const display = Array.from(resources.querySelectorAll("pbmetallicdisplayproperties")).find(
        (item) => item.getAttribute("id") === displayId,
      );
      const metallic = display?.querySelectorAll("pbmetallic")[index];
      const material =
        metallic === undefined
          ? new MeshPhongMaterial({ flatShading: true })
          : new MeshStandardMaterial({
              flatShading: true,
              metalness: number(metallic, "metallicness"),
              roughness: number(metallic, "roughness"),
            });
      material.name = base.getAttribute("name") ?? "";
      const value = required(base, "displaycolor");
      material.color.setStyle(value.substring(0, 7), ColorSpace.SRGB);
      if (value.length === 9) material.opacity = parseInt(value.substring(7, 9), 16) / 255;
      materials.set(base, material);
      return material;
    };
    const buildMesh = (mesh: ThreeMFMeshData, object: Element, resources: Element): Group => {
      const group = new Group();
      const resourceMap = new Map<string, ThreeMFTriangle[]>();
      for (const triangle of mesh.triangleProperties) {
        const pid = triangle.pid ?? object.getAttribute("pid") ?? "default";
        const list = resourceMap.get(pid) ?? [];
        list.push(triangle);
        resourceMap.set(pid, list);
      }
      const resourcesById = Array.from(resources.children);
      for (const [pid, triangles] of resourceMap) {
        const resource = resourcesById.find((item) => item.getAttribute("id") === pid);
        if (pid === "default") {
          const geometry = new BufferGeometry();
          geometry.setIndex(new BufferAttribute(mesh.triangles, 1));
          geometry.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(mesh.vertices, 3));
          const item = new Mesh(
            geometry,
            new MeshPhongMaterial({ name: Loader.DEFAULT_MATERIAL_NAME, color: 0xffffff, flatShading: true }),
          );
          item.name = object.getAttribute("name") ?? "";
          group.add(item);
          continue;
        }
        if (resource === undefined) {
          console.error("ThreeMFLoader: Unsupported resource type.");
          continue;
        }
        const kind = resource.localName;
        const partitions = new Map<number, ThreeMFTriangle[]>();
        for (const triangle of triangles) {
          const key = kind === "basematerials" ? (triangle.p1 ?? number(object, "pindex", 0)) : 0;
          const list = partitions.get(key) ?? [];
          list.push(triangle);
          partitions.set(key, list);
        }
        const props = Array.from(resource.children);
        const colorValues: number[] = [];
        const uvValues: number[] = [];
        if (kind === "colorgroup") {
          const color = new Color();
          for (const prop of props) {
            color.setStyle(required(prop, "color").substring(0, 7), ColorSpace.SRGB);
            colorValues.push(color.r, color.g, color.b);
          }
        } else if (kind === "texture2dgroup") {
          for (const prop of props) uvValues.push(number(prop, "u"), number(prop, "v"));
        }
        for (const [index, part] of partitions) {
          const positions: number[] = [],
            values: number[] = [];
          for (const triangle of part) {
            const indices = [triangle.v1, triangle.v2, triangle.v3];
            const p1 = triangle.p1 ?? number(object, "pindex", 0);
            const properties = [p1, triangle.p2 ?? p1, triangle.p3 ?? p1];
            for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
              const offset = indices[i] * 3;
              positions.push(mesh.vertices[offset], mesh.vertices[offset + 1], mesh.vertices[offset + 2]);
              if (kind === "colorgroup") {
                const property = properties[i] * 3;
                values.push(colorValues[property], colorValues[property + 1], colorValues[property + 2]);
              } else if (kind === "texture2dgroup") {
                const property = properties[i] * 2;
                values.push(uvValues[property], uvValues[property + 1]);
              }
            }
          }
          const geometry = new BufferGeometry();
          geometry.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
          let material: MeshPhongMaterial | MeshStandardMaterial;
          if (kind === "basematerials") material = baseMaterial(props[index], index, resources);
          else if (kind === "colorgroup") {
            geometry.setAttribute("color", new Float32BufferAttribute(values, 3));
            material = new MeshPhongMaterial({ vertexColors: true, flatShading: true });
          } else if (kind === "texture2dgroup") {
            geometry.setAttribute("uv", new Float32BufferAttribute(values, 2));
            material = new MeshPhongMaterial({ map: buildTexture(resource, resources), flatShading: true });
          } else {
            geometry.dispose();
            console.error("ThreeMFLoader: Unsupported resource type.");
            continue;
          }
          const item = new Mesh(geometry, material);
          item.name = object.getAttribute("name") ?? "";
          group.add(item);
        }
      }
      const lattice = latticeMesh(mesh);
      if (lattice !== undefined) {
        lattice.name = object.getAttribute("name") ?? "";
        group.add(lattice);
      }
      return group;
    };
    for (const [, model] of models) {
      const resources = model.querySelector("resources");
      if (resources === null) throw new Error("ThreeMFLoader: Model has no resources.");
      const objectNodes = Array.from(resources.querySelectorAll("object"));
      const building = new Set<string>();
      const built = new Set<string>();
      const buildObject = (id: string): Group => {
        const object = objectNodes.find((node) => node.getAttribute("id") === id);
        const existing = objects.get(id);
        if (existing !== undefined && (built.has(id) || object === undefined)) return existing;
        if (building.has(id)) throw new Error("ThreeMFLoader: Circular component reference.");
        if (object === undefined) throw new Error(`ThreeMFLoader: Missing object ${id}.`);
        building.add(id);
        const meshNode = object.querySelector("mesh");
        let group: Group;
        if (meshNode !== null) {
          const mesh = parseMesh(meshNode);
          for (const attr of Array.from(model.attributes)) {
            if (!attr.name.startsWith("xmlns:")) continue;
            for (const extension of this.availableExtensions) {
              if (attr.value === extension.ns) extension.apply(model, attr.name.substring(6), mesh);
            }
          }
          group = buildMesh(mesh, object, resources);
        } else {
          group = new Group();
          for (const component of Array.from(object.querySelectorAll("components component"))) {
            const child = buildObject(required(component, "objectid")).clone();
            const matrix = transform(component.getAttribute("transform"));
            if (matrix !== undefined) child.applyMatrix4(matrix);
            group.add(child);
          }
        }
        group.name = object.getAttribute("name") ?? "";
        building.delete(id);
        built.add(id);
        objects.set(id, group);
        return group;
      };
      for (const object of objectNodes) buildObject(required(object, "id"));
      const implicit = implicitFunctions(resources);
      if (Object.keys(implicit).length > 0) console.warn("ThreeMFLoader: Implicit functions are data-only.", implicit);
    }
    const root = models.get(rootPath);
    if (root === undefined) throw new Error("ThreeMFLoader: Missing root model.");
    const group = new Group();
    for (const item of Array.from(root.querySelectorAll("build item"))) {
      const id = required(item, "objectid");
      const object = objects.get(id);
      if (object === undefined) throw new Error(`ThreeMFLoader: Missing build object ${id}.`);
      const child = object.clone();
      const matrix = transform(item.getAttribute("transform"));
      if (matrix !== undefined) child.applyMatrix4(matrix);
      group.add(child);
    }
    return group;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/AMFLoader

```typescript
import { Float32BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import { MeshPhongMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshPhongMaterial";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Group } from "../../objects/Group";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";

/** ZIP decoder supplied by the application for compressed AMF files. */
export interface AMFZipRuntime {
  unzipSync(data: Uint8Array): Record<string, Uint8Array>;
}

interface AMFColor {
  r: number;
  g: number;
  b: number;
  a: number;
}

function color(node: Element): AMFColor {
  const component = (name: string): number => {
    const value = node.getElementsByTagName(name)[0];
    return value === undefined ? 1 : Number(value.textContent);
  };
  return { r: component("r"), g: component("g"), b: component("b"), a: component("a") };
}

function materialColor(material: MeshPhongMaterial, value: AMFColor): void {
  material.color = new Color(value.r, value.g, value.b);
  if (value.a !== 1) {
    material.transparent = true;
    material.opacity = value.a;
  }
}

function metadata(node: Element, type: string): string {
  for (const child of Array.from(node.children)) {
    if (child.localName === "metadata" && child.getAttribute("type") === type) return child.textContent ?? "";
  }
  return "";
}

/** Loads AMF meshes, colors, materials and units; constellations are not supported. */
export class AMFLoader extends Loader<Group, string> {
  zipRuntime: AMFZipRuntime | null = null;

  setZipRuntime(runtime: AMFZipRuntime): this {
    this.zipRuntime = runtime;
    return this;
  }

  override load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (group: Group) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (data) => {
        try {
          onLoad?.(this.parse(data as ArrayBuffer));
        } catch (error) {
          if (onError !== undefined) onError(error);
          else console.error(error);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  parse(data: ArrayBuffer): Group {
    let bytes: Uint8Array = new Uint8Array(data);
    if (bytes[0] === 0x50 && bytes[1] === 0x4b) {
      if (this.zipRuntime === null) throw new Error("AMFLoader: ZIP runtime is required for compressed AMF files.");
      const entries = this.zipRuntime.unzipSync(bytes);
      const name = Object.keys(entries).find((entry) => entry.toLowerCase().endsWith(".amf"));
      if (name === undefined) throw new Error("AMFLoader: ZIP archive contains no AMF file.");
      bytes = entries[name];
    }
    const xml = new DOMParser().parseFromString(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes), "application/xml");
    const root = xml.documentElement;
    if (root.localName.toLowerCase() !== "amf") throw new Error("AMFLoader: Invalid AMF document.");
    const scales: Record<string, number> = { millimeter: 1, inch: 25.4, feet: 304.8, meter: 1000, micron: 0.001 };
    const scale = scales[(root.getAttribute("unit") ?? "millimeter").toLowerCase()] ?? 1;
    const materials = new Map<string, MeshPhongMaterial>();
    for (const node of Array.from(root.children)) {
      if (node.localName !== "material") continue;
      const material = new MeshPhongMaterial({ name: metadata(node, "name") || "AMF Material", flatShading: true });
      const colorNode = Array.from(node.children).find((child) => child.localName === "color");
      if (colorNode !== undefined) materialColor(material, color(colorNode));
      materials.set(node.getAttribute("id") ?? "", material);
    }
    const result = new Group();
    result.name = metadata(root, "name");
    result.userData.author = metadata(root, "author");
    result.userData.loader = "AMF";
    const fallback = new MeshPhongMaterial({ name: Loader.DEFAULT_MATERIAL_NAME, color: 0xaaaaff, flatShading: true });
    for (const object of Array.from(root.children)) {
      if (object.localName !== "object") continue;
      const group = new Group();
      group.name = metadata(object, "name") || "amfobject";
      let objectColor: AMFColor | undefined;
      for (const child of Array.from(object.children)) {
        if (child.localName === "color") {
          objectColor = color(child);
          continue;
        }
        if (child.localName !== "mesh") continue;
        const vertexValues: number[] = [];
        const normalValues: number[] = [];
        const verticesNode = Array.from(child.children).find((entry) => entry.localName === "vertices");
        if (verticesNode !== undefined) {
          for (const vertex of Array.from(verticesNode.children)) {
            if (vertex.localName !== "vertex") continue;
            for (const entry of Array.from(vertex.children)) {
              const names =
                entry.localName === "coordinates"
                  ? ["x", "y", "z"]
                  : entry.localName === "normal"
                    ? ["nx", "ny", "nz"]
                    : [];
              const target = entry.localName === "normal" ? normalValues : vertexValues;
              for (const name of names) target.push(Number(entry.getElementsByTagName(name)[0]?.textContent));
            }
          }
        }
        const positions = new Float32BufferAttribute(vertexValues, 3);
        const normals = normalValues.length ? new Float32BufferAttribute(normalValues, 3) : null;
        const defaultMaterial = fallback.clone();
        if (objectColor !== undefined) materialColor(defaultMaterial, objectColor);
        for (const volume of Array.from(child.children)) {
          if (volume.localName !== "volume") continue;
          const indices: number[] = [];
          for (const triangle of Array.from(volume.children)) {
            if (triangle.localName !== "triangle") continue;
            for (const name of ["v1", "v2", "v3"])
              indices.push(Number(triangle.getElementsByTagName(name)[0]?.textContent));
          }
          const geometry = new BufferGeometry();
          geometry.setIndex(indices);
          geometry.setAttribute("position", positions.clone());
          if (normals !== null) geometry.setAttribute("normal", normals.clone());
          geometry.scale(scale, scale, scale);
          group.add(
            new Mesh(geometry, (materials.get(volume.getAttribute("materialid") ?? "") ?? defaultMaterial).clone()),
          );
        }
      }
      result.add(group);
    }
    return result;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/BVHLoader

````typescript
import { AnimationClip } from "../../animation/AnimationClip";
import { QuaternionKeyframeTrack } from "../../animation/tracks/QuaternionKeyframeTrack";
import { VectorKeyframeTrack } from "../../animation/tracks/VectorKeyframeTrack";
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import type { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";
import { Quaternion } from "../../math/Quaternion";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import { Bone } from "../../objects/Bone";
import { Skeleton } from "../../objects/Skeleton";

/** The skeleton and animation clip produced by {@link BVHLoader#parse}. */
export interface BVHLoaderResult {
  skeleton: Skeleton;
  clip: AnimationClip;
}

interface BVHKeyframe {
  time: number;
  position: Vector3;
  rotation: Quaternion;
}

interface BVHNode {
  name: string;
  type: string;
  offset: Vector3;
  channels: string[];
  frames: BVHKeyframe[];
  children: BVHNode[];
}

const _vx = /*@__PURE__*/ new Vector3(1, 0, 0);
const _vy = /*@__PURE__*/ new Vector3(0, 1, 0);
const _vz = /*@__PURE__*/ new Vector3(0, 0, 1);

/**
 * A loader for the Biovision Hierarchy (BVH) motion capture format.
 *
 * Imports BVH files and outputs a single {@link Skeleton} and {@link AnimationClip}.
 * Only files with a single root joint are supported.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { BVHLoader } from "ek3d/addons/loaders/BVHLoader";
 * import { AnimationMixer } from "ek3d/animation/AnimationMixer";
 *
 * const loader = new BVHLoader();
 * const result = await loader.loadAsync( "models/bvh/pirouette.bvh" );
 *
 * const mixer = new AnimationMixer( result.skeleton.bones[ 0 ] );
 * mixer.clipAction( result.clip ).play();
 * ```
 */
export class BVHLoader extends Loader<BVHLoaderResult> {
  /** Whether to animate bone positions. */
  animateBonePositions: boolean = true;
  /** Whether to animate bone rotations. */
  animateBoneRotations: boolean = true;

  /**
   * Constructs a new BVH loader.
   *
   * @param [manager] - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
  }

  /**
   * Starts loading from the given URL and passes the parsed result to the `onLoad()` callback.
   *
   * @param url - The path/URL of the file to be loaded. This can also be a data URI.
   * @param onLoad - Executed when the loading process has been finished.
   * @param onProgress - Executed while the loading is in progress.
   * @param onError - Executed when errors occur.
   */
  override load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (result: BVHLoaderResult) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (text) => {
        try {
          if (typeof text !== "string") throw new TypeError("BVHLoader requires text data");
          onLoad?.(this.parse(text));
        } catch (error) {
          if (onError) onError(error);
          else console.error(error);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  /**
   * Parses the given BVH data and returns the resulting skeleton and animation clip.
   *
   * @param text - The raw BVH data as a string.
   * @return An object holding the parsed skeleton and clip.
   */
  parse(text: string): BVHLoaderResult {
    const animateBonePositions = this.animateBonePositions;
    const animateBoneRotations = this.animateBoneRotations;
    const lines = text.split(/[\r\n]+/g);
    const bones = readBvh(lines);
    const threeBones: Bone[] = [];
    toTHREEBone(bones[0], threeBones);
    const threeClip = toTHREEAnimation(bones);
    return {
      skeleton: new Skeleton(threeBones),
      clip: threeClip,
    };

    // Reads the HIERARCHY and MOTION sections and returns a flat list of BVH nodes.
    function readBvh(lines: string[]): BVHNode[] {
      if (nextLine(lines) !== "HIERARCHY") {
        console.error("THREE.BVHLoader: HIERARCHY expected.");
      }

      const list: BVHNode[] = [];
      const root = readNode(lines, nextLine(lines), list);

      if (nextLine(lines) !== "MOTION") {
        console.error("THREE.BVHLoader: MOTION expected.");
      }

      let tokens = nextLine(lines).split(/[\s]+/);
      const numFrames = parseInt(tokens[1]);
      if (isNaN(numFrames)) {
        console.error("THREE.BVHLoader: Failed to read number of frames.");
      }

      tokens = nextLine(lines).split(/[\s]+/);
      const frameTime = parseFloat(tokens[2]);
      if (isNaN(frameTime)) {
        console.error("THREE.BVHLoader: Failed to read frame time.");
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < numFrames; i++) {
        tokens = nextLine(lines).split(/[\s]+/);
        readFrameData(tokens, i * frameTime, root);
      }

      return list;
    }

    // Reads one number from the remaining frame tokens, failing clearly on truncated data.
    function nextValue(data: string[]): number {
      const token = data.shift();
      if (token === undefined) throw new Error("THREE.BVHLoader: Missing motion channel value.");
      return parseFloat(token.trim());
    }

    // Reads one frame of channel data into the node hierarchy, consuming `data` as it goes.
    function readFrameData(data: string[], frameTime: number, bone: BVHNode): void {
      // end sites have no motion data
      if (bone.type === "ENDSITE") return;

      const keyframe: BVHKeyframe = {
        time: frameTime,
        position: new Vector3(),
        rotation: new Quaternion(),
      };
      bone.frames.push(keyframe);

      const quat = new Quaternion();

      for (let i = 0; i < bone.channels.length; i++) {
        switch (bone.channels[i]) {
          case "Xposition":
            keyframe.position.x = nextValue(data);
            break;
          case "Yposition":
            keyframe.position.y = nextValue(data);
            break;
          case "Zposition":
            keyframe.position.z = nextValue(data);
            break;
          case "Xrotation":
            quat.setFromAxisAngle(_vx, (nextValue(data) * Math.PI) / 180);
            keyframe.rotation.multiply(quat);
            break;
          case "Yrotation":
            quat.setFromAxisAngle(_vy, (nextValue(data) * Math.PI) / 180);
            keyframe.rotation.multiply(quat);
            break;
          case "Zrotation":
            quat.setFromAxisAngle(_vz, (nextValue(data) * Math.PI) / 180);
            keyframe.rotation.multiply(quat);
            break;
          default:
            console.warn("THREE.BVHLoader: Invalid channel type.");
        }
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < bone.children.length; i++) {
        readFrameData(data, frameTime, bone.children[i]);
      }
    }

    // Recursively parses the HIERARCHY section and collects a flat list of nodes.
    function readNode(lines: string[], firstline: string, list: BVHNode[]): BVHNode {
      const node: BVHNode = {
        name: "",
        type: "",
        offset: new Vector3(),
        channels: [],
        frames: [],
        children: [],
      };
      list.push(node);

      let tokens = firstline.split(/[\s]+/);

      if (tokens[0].toUpperCase() === "END" && tokens[1].toUpperCase() === "SITE") {
        node.type = "ENDSITE";
        node.name = "ENDSITE"; // bvh end sites have no name
      } else {
        node.name = tokens[1];
        node.type = tokens[0].toUpperCase();
      }

      if (nextLine(lines) !== "{") {
        console.error("THREE.BVHLoader: Expected opening { after type & name");
      }

      tokens = nextLine(lines).split(/[\s]+/);
      if (tokens[0] !== "OFFSET") {
        console.error("THREE.BVHLoader: Expected OFFSET but got: " + tokens[0]);
      }
      if (tokens.length !== 4) {
        console.error("THREE.BVHLoader: Invalid number of values for OFFSET.");
      }
      node.offset.set(parseFloat(tokens[1]), parseFloat(tokens[2]), parseFloat(tokens[3]));
      if (isNaN(node.offset.x) || isNaN(node.offset.y) || isNaN(node.offset.z)) {
        console.error("THREE.BVHLoader: Invalid values of OFFSET.");
      }

      if (node.type !== "ENDSITE") {
        tokens = nextLine(lines).split(/[\s]+/);
        if (tokens[0] !== "CHANNELS") {
          console.error("THREE.BVHLoader: Expected CHANNELS definition.");
        }
        const numChannels = parseInt(tokens[1]);
        node.channels = tokens.splice(2, numChannels);
      }

      while (true) {
        const line = nextLine(lines);
        if (line === "}") return node;
        node.children.push(readNode(lines, line, list));
      }
    }

    // Recursively converts the internal node structure to a Bone hierarchy.
    function toTHREEBone(source: BVHNode, list: Bone[]): Bone {
      const bone = new Bone();
      list.push(bone);
      bone.position.add(source.offset);
      bone.name = source.name;
      if (source.type !== "ENDSITE") {
        for (let i = 0; i < source.children.length; i++) {
          bone.add(toTHREEBone(source.children[i], list));
        }
      }
      return bone;
    }

    // Builds position and quaternion tracks from the keyframe data stored in each node.
    function toTHREEAnimation(bones: BVHNode[]): AnimationClip {
      const tracks: (VectorKeyframeTrack | QuaternionKeyframeTrack)[] = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < bones.length; i++) {
        const bone = bones[i];
        if (bone.type === "ENDSITE") continue;

        const times: number[] = [];
        const positions: number[] = [];
        const rotations: number[] = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < bone.frames.length; j++) {
          const frame = bone.frames[j];
          times.push(frame.time);
          // The animation system animates the position property, so add the joint offset.
          positions.push(frame.position.x + bone.offset.x);
          positions.push(frame.position.y + bone.offset.y);
          positions.push(frame.position.z + bone.offset.z);
          rotations.push(frame.rotation.x);
          rotations.push(frame.rotation.y);
          rotations.push(frame.rotation.z);
          rotations.push(frame.rotation.w);
        }

        if (animateBonePositions) {
          tracks.push(new VectorKeyframeTrack(bone.name + ".position", times, positions));
        }
        if (animateBoneRotations) {
          tracks.push(new QuaternionKeyframeTrack(bone.name + ".quaternion", times, rotations));
        }
      }

      return new AnimationClip("animation", -1, tracks);
    }

    // Returns the next non-empty line, consuming it from `lines`.
    function nextLine(lines: string[]): string {
      let line = lines.shift();
      while (line !== undefined && line.trim().length === 0) line = lines.shift();
      if (line === undefined) throw new Error("THREE.BVHLoader: Unexpected end of file.");
      return line.trim();
    }
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/loaders/ColladaLoader

```typescript
import type { AnimationClip } from "../../animation/AnimationClip";
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import { LoaderUtils } from "../../loaders/LoaderUtils";
import { TextureLoader } from "../../loaders/TextureLoader";
import type { Group } from "../../objects/Group";
import { Scene } from "../../scenes/Scene";
import { TGALoader } from "./TGALoader";
import { ColladaParser, type ColladaLibrary } from "./collada/ColladaParser";
import { ColladaComposer, type ColladaKinematics } from "./collada/ColladaComposer";

export interface ColladaResult {
  scene: Scene | Group;
  readonly animations?: AnimationClip[];
  kinematics?: ColladaKinematics;
  library?: ColladaLibrary;
}

/** Loads Collada scenes, animations and kinematics. */
export class ColladaLoader extends Loader<ColladaResult | null> {
  override load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (result: ColladaResult | null) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const path = this.path === "" ? LoaderUtils.extractUrlBase(url) : this.path;
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (text) => {
        try {
          onLoad?.(this.parse(text as string, path));
        } catch (error) {
          if (onError !== undefined) onError(error);
          else console.error(error);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  parse(text: string, path = ""): ColladaResult | null {
    if (text.length === 0) return { scene: new Scene() };
    const result = new ColladaParser().parse(text);
    if (result === null) return null;
    const { library, asset, collada } = result;
    const textureLoader = new TextureLoader(this.manager);
    textureLoader.setPriority(this.priority);
    textureLoader.setCache(this.cache);
    textureLoader.setPath(this.resourcePath || path).setCrossOrigin(this.crossOrigin);
    const tgaLoader = new TGALoader(this.manager);
    tgaLoader.setPriority(this.priority);
    tgaLoader.setCache(this.cache);
    tgaLoader.setPath(this.resourcePath || path);
    tgaLoader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    tgaLoader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    const { scene, animations, kinematics } = new ColladaComposer(library, collada, textureLoader, tgaLoader).compose();
    scene.animations = animations;
    if (asset.upAxis === "Z_UP") {
      console.warn(
        "THREE.ColladaLoader: You are loading an asset with a Z-UP coordinate system. The loader just rotates the asset to transform it into Y-UP. The vertex data are not converted, see #24289.",
      );
      scene.rotation.set(-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0);
    }
    scene.scale.multiplyScalar(asset.unit);
    return {
      get animations() {
        console.warn("THREE.ColladaLoader: Please access animations over scene.animations now.");
        return animations;
      },
      kinematics,
      library,
      scene,
    };
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/DDSLoader

````typescript
import { CompressedTextureLoader } from "../../loaders/CompressedTextureLoader";
import type { CompressedTextureData } from "../../loaders/CompressedTextureLoader";
import type { CompressedTextureMipmap } from "../../textures/CompressedTexture";
import type { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";
import { PixelFormat } from "../../constants";

// All values and structures referenced from:
// http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/bb943991.aspx
const DDS_MAGIC = 0x20534444;
const DDSD_MIPMAPCOUNT = 0x20000;

const DDSCAPS2_CUBEMAP = 0x200;
const DDSCAPS2_CUBEMAP_POSITIVEX = 0x400;
const DDSCAPS2_CUBEMAP_NEGATIVEX = 0x800;
const DDSCAPS2_CUBEMAP_POSITIVEY = 0x1000;
const DDSCAPS2_CUBEMAP_NEGATIVEY = 0x2000;
const DDSCAPS2_CUBEMAP_POSITIVEZ = 0x4000;
const DDSCAPS2_CUBEMAP_NEGATIVEZ = 0x8000;

const DXGI_FORMAT_BC6H_UF16 = 95;
const DXGI_FORMAT_BC6H_SF16 = 96;

const FOURCC_DXT1 = fourCCToInt32("DXT1");
const FOURCC_DXT3 = fourCCToInt32("DXT3");
const FOURCC_DXT5 = fourCCToInt32("DXT5");
const FOURCC_ETC1 = fourCCToInt32("ETC1");
const FOURCC_DX10 = fourCCToInt32("DX10");

// The header length in 32 bit ints, and the DX10 extended header length.
const HEADER_LENGTH_INT = 31;
const EXTENDED_HEADER_LENGTH_INT = 5;

// Offsets into the header array.
const OFF_MAGIC = 0;
const OFF_SIZE = 1;
const OFF_FLAGS = 2;
const OFF_HEIGHT = 3;
const OFF_WIDTH = 4;
const OFF_MIPMAP_COUNT = 7;
const OFF_PF_FOUR_CC = 21;
const OFF_RGB_BIT_COUNT = 22;
const OFF_R_BIT_MASK = 23;
const OFF_G_BIT_MASK = 24;
const OFF_B_BIT_MASK = 25;
const OFF_A_BIT_MASK = 26;
const OFF_CAPS2 = 28;
const OFF_DXGI_FORMAT = 0;

function fourCCToInt32(value: string): number {
  return value.charCodeAt(0) + (value.charCodeAt(1) << 8) + (value.charCodeAt(2) << 16) + (value.charCodeAt(3) << 24);
}

function int32ToFourCC(value: number): string {
  return String.fromCharCode(value & 0xff, (value >> 8) & 0xff, (value >> 16) & 0xff, (value >> 24) & 0xff);
}

/** Expands BGRA rows into the RGBA upload layout. */
function loadARGBMip(buffer: ArrayBuffer, dataOffset: number, width: number, height: number): Uint8Array {
  const dataLength = width * height * 4;
  const srcBuffer = new Uint8Array(buffer, dataOffset, dataLength);
  const byteArray = new Uint8Array(dataLength);
  let dst = 0;
  let src = 0;
  for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const b = srcBuffer[src];
      src++;
      const g = srcBuffer[src];
      src++;
      const r = srcBuffer[src];
      src++;
      const a = srcBuffer[src];
      src++;
      byteArray[dst] = r;
      dst++;
      byteArray[dst] = g;
      dst++;
      byteArray[dst] = b;
      dst++;
      byteArray[dst] = a;
      dst++;
    }
  }
  return byteArray;
}

/** Expands 24 bit BGR rows into RGBA with opaque alpha. */
function loadRGBMip(buffer: ArrayBuffer, dataOffset: number, width: number, height: number): Uint8Array {
  const dataLength = width * height * 3;
  const srcBuffer = new Uint8Array(buffer, dataOffset, dataLength);
  const byteArray = new Uint8Array(width * height * 4);
  let dst = 0;
  let src = 0;
  for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const b = srcBuffer[src];
      src++;
      const g = srcBuffer[src];
      src++;
      const r = srcBuffer[src];
      src++;
      byteArray[dst] = r;
      dst++;
      byteArray[dst] = g;
      dst++;
      byteArray[dst] = b;
      dst++;
      byteArray[dst] = 255;
      dst++;
    }
  }
  return byteArray;
}

/**
 * A loader for the S3TC, ETC1 and BPTC texture compression formats stored in DDS containers.
 *
 * Unsupported headers are reported by throwing instead of returning an empty texture, so a
 * caller cannot mistake a format the GPU cannot decode for a valid black texture.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { DDSLoader } from "ek3d/addons/loaders/DDSLoader";
 * import { ColorSpace } from "ek3d/constants";
 *
 * const map = await new DDSLoader().loadAsync("textures/compressed/disturb_dxt1_nomip.dds");
 * map.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB; // only for color textures
 * ```
 */
export class DDSLoader extends CompressedTextureLoader {
  /**
   * Constructs a new DDS loader.
   *
   * @param [manager] - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
  }

  /**
   * Parses the given DDS texture data.
   *
   * @param buffer - The raw texture data.
   * @param loadMipmaps - Whether to load mipmaps or not.
   * @return An object representing the parsed texture data.
   */
  parse(buffer: ArrayBuffer, loadMipmaps?: boolean): CompressedTextureData {
    if (buffer.byteLength < (HEADER_LENGTH_INT + 1) * 4) {
      throw new Error("THREE.DDSLoader: Not enough data to contain a DDS header.");
    }
    // Adapted from @toji's DDS utils
    // https://github.com/toji/webgl-texture-utils/blob/master/texture-util/dds.js
    const header = new Int32Array(buffer, 0, HEADER_LENGTH_INT);

    if (header[OFF_MAGIC] !== DDS_MAGIC) {
      throw new Error("THREE.DDSLoader: Invalid magic number in DDS header.");
    }

    let blockBytes: number;
    const fourCC = header[OFF_PF_FOUR_CC];
    let isRGBAUncompressed = false;
    let isRGBUncompressed = false;
    let dataOffset = header[OFF_SIZE] + 4;
    let format: PixelFormat;

    switch (fourCC) {
      case FOURCC_DXT1:
        blockBytes = 8;
        format = PixelFormat.RGB_S3TC_DXT1;
        break;
      case FOURCC_DXT3:
        blockBytes = 16;
        format = PixelFormat.RGBA_S3TC_DXT3;
        break;
      case FOURCC_DXT5:
        blockBytes = 16;
        format = PixelFormat.RGBA_S3TC_DXT5;
        break;
      case FOURCC_ETC1:
        blockBytes = 8;
        format = PixelFormat.RGB_ETC1;
        break;
      case FOURCC_DX10: {
        dataOffset += EXTENDED_HEADER_LENGTH_INT * 4;
        if (buffer.byteLength < dataOffset) {
          throw new Error("THREE.DDSLoader: Not enough data to contain the DDS DX10 header.");
        }
        const extendedHeader = new Int32Array(buffer, (HEADER_LENGTH_INT + 1) * 4, EXTENDED_HEADER_LENGTH_INT);
        const dxgiFormat = extendedHeader[OFF_DXGI_FORMAT];
        if (dxgiFormat === DXGI_FORMAT_BC6H_SF16) {
          blockBytes = 16;
          format = PixelFormat.RGB_BPTC_SIGNED;
        } else if (dxgiFormat === DXGI_FORMAT_BC6H_UF16) {
          blockBytes = 16;
          format = PixelFormat.RGB_BPTC_UNSIGNED;
        } else {
          throw new Error("THREE.DDSLoader: Unsupported DXGI_FORMAT code " + dxgiFormat);
        }
        break;
      }
      default:
        if (
          header[OFF_RGB_BIT_COUNT] === 32 &&
          header[OFF_R_BIT_MASK] & 0xff0000 &&
          header[OFF_G_BIT_MASK] & 0xff00 &&
          header[OFF_B_BIT_MASK] & 0xff &&
          header[OFF_A_BIT_MASK] & 0xff000000
        ) {
          isRGBAUncompressed = true;
          blockBytes = 64;
          format = PixelFormat.RGBA;
        } else if (
          header[OFF_RGB_BIT_COUNT] === 24 &&
          header[OFF_R_BIT_MASK] & 0xff0000 &&
          header[OFF_G_BIT_MASK] & 0xff00 &&
          header[OFF_B_BIT_MASK] & 0xff
        ) {
          isRGBUncompressed = true;
          blockBytes = 64;
          format = PixelFormat.RGBA;
        } else {
          throw new Error("THREE.DDSLoader: Unsupported FourCC code " + int32ToFourCC(fourCC));
        }
    }

    let mipmapCount = 1;
    if ((header[OFF_FLAGS] & DDSD_MIPMAPCOUNT) !== 0 && loadMipmaps !== false) {
      mipmapCount = Math.max(1, header[OFF_MIPMAP_COUNT]);
    }

    const caps2 = header[OFF_CAPS2];
    const isCubemap = (caps2 & DDSCAPS2_CUBEMAP) !== 0;
    if (
      isCubemap &&
      (!(caps2 & DDSCAPS2_CUBEMAP_POSITIVEX) ||
        !(caps2 & DDSCAPS2_CUBEMAP_NEGATIVEX) ||
        !(caps2 & DDSCAPS2_CUBEMAP_POSITIVEY) ||
        !(caps2 & DDSCAPS2_CUBEMAP_NEGATIVEY) ||
        !(caps2 & DDSCAPS2_CUBEMAP_POSITIVEZ) ||
        !(caps2 & DDSCAPS2_CUBEMAP_NEGATIVEZ))
    ) {
      throw new Error("THREE.DDSLoader: Incomplete cubemap faces.");
    }

    const width = header[OFF_WIDTH];
    const height = header[OFF_HEIGHT];
    const mipmaps: CompressedTextureMipmap[] = [];
    const faces = isCubemap ? 6 : 1;

    for (let face = 0; face < faces; face++) {
      let mipWidth = width;
      let mipHeight = height;
      for (let i = 0; i < mipmapCount; i++) {
        let byteArray: Uint8Array;
        let dataLength: number;
        if (isRGBAUncompressed) {
          byteArray = loadARGBMip(buffer, dataOffset, mipWidth, mipHeight);
          dataLength = byteArray.length;
        } else if (isRGBUncompressed) {
          byteArray = loadRGBMip(buffer, dataOffset, mipWidth, mipHeight);
          dataLength = mipWidth * mipHeight * 3;
        } else {
          dataLength = Math.ceil(mipWidth / 4) * Math.ceil(mipHeight / 4) * blockBytes;
          byteArray = new Uint8Array(buffer, dataOffset, dataLength);
        }
        mipmaps.push({ data: byteArray, width: mipWidth, height: mipHeight });
        dataOffset += dataLength;
        mipWidth = Math.max(mipWidth >> 1, 1);
        mipHeight = Math.max(mipHeight >> 1, 1);
      }
    }

    return { mipmaps, width, height, format, mipmapCount, isCubemap };
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/loaders/DRACOLoader

````typescript
import { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { ColorManagement } from "../../math/ColorManagement";
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import type { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";
import { ColorSpace } from "../../constants";
import { InterleavedBuffer } from "../../core/InterleavedBuffer";
import { InterleavedBufferAttribute } from "../../core/InterleavedBufferAttribute";
import { LoaderUtils } from "../../loaders/LoaderUtils";

const _taskCache = new WeakMap<ArrayBuffer, { key: string; promise: Promise<BufferGeometry> }>();

const WASM_BIN_URL = "/libs/draco/draco_decoder.wasm";
const WASM_JS_URL = "/libs/draco/draco_wasm_wrapper.js";
const JS_URL = "/libs/draco/draco_decoder.js";

/** glTF-embedded Draco uses a dedicated wasm runtime optimized for the glTF attribute layout. */
export const DRACO_GLTF_CONFIG = {
  js: "/libs/draco/gltf/draco_wasm_wrapper.js",
  wasm: "/libs/draco/gltf/draco_decoder.wasm",
};

/** Geometry payload produced inside the decoding worker. */
export interface DRACOGeometryData {
  index: { array: Uint32Array; itemSize: number } | null;
  attributes: DRACOAttributeData[];
}

/** One decoded attribute as transferred arrays plus layout metadata. */
export interface DRACOAttributeData {
  name: string;
  count: number;
  itemSize: number;
  array: Float32Array | Int8Array | Int16Array | Int32Array | Uint8Array | Uint16Array | Uint32Array;
  stride: number;
  vertexColorSpace?: string | null;
}

/** Numeric typed arrays accepted as decode targets. */
type TypedArrayCtor =
  | Float32ArrayConstructor
  | Int8ArrayConstructor
  | Int16ArrayConstructor
  | Int32ArrayConstructor
  | Uint8ArrayConstructor
  | Uint16ArrayConstructor
  | Uint32ArrayConstructor;

/** Instance shape of the typed arrays produced by the decoder. */
type TypedArrayInstance = Float32Array | Int8Array | Int16Array | Int32Array | Uint8Array | Uint16Array | Uint32Array;

/** Draco module surface used inside the worker. */
interface DracoDecoderHost {
  HEAPU32: Uint32Array;
  DT_FLOAT32: number;
  DT_INT8: number;
  DT_INT16: number;
  DT_INT32: number;
  DT_UINT8: number;
  DT_UINT16: number;
  DT_UINT32: number;
  TRIANGULAR_MESH: number;
  POINT_CLOUD: number;
  Decoder: new () => DracoDecoderInstance;
  Mesh: new () => DracoGeometryHost;
  PointCloud: new () => DracoGeometryHost;
  destroy(target: unknown): void;
  _malloc(byteLength: number): number;
  _free(ptr: number): void;
  /** Draco exposes semantic constants (POSITION, NORMAL, COLOR, TEX_COORD) as numbers. */
  [name: string]: unknown;
}

/** Draco decoder instance surface used inside the worker. */
interface DracoDecoderInstance {
  GetEncodedGeometryType(array: Int8Array): number;
  DecodeArrayToMesh(array: Int8Array, byteLength: number, geometry: unknown): { ok(): boolean; error_msg(): string };
  DecodeArrayToPointCloud(
    array: Int8Array,
    byteLength: number,
    geometry: unknown,
  ): { ok(): boolean; error_msg(): string };
  GetAttributeId(geometry: unknown, semantic: number): number;
  GetAttribute(geometry: unknown, id: number): unknown;
  GetAttributeByUniqueId(geometry: unknown, id: number): unknown;
  GetTrianglesUInt32Array(geometry: unknown, byteLength: number, ptr: number): void;
  GetAttributeDataArrayForAllPoints(
    geometry: unknown,
    attribute: unknown,
    dataFormat: number,
    byteLength: number,
    ptr: number,
  ): void;
}

/** Attribute handle inside the worker. */
interface DracoAttribute {
  num_components(): number;
}

/** Geometry handle inside the worker. */
interface DracoGeometryHost {
  ptr: number;
  num_points(): number;
  num_faces(): number;
}

/** A dedicated decoder worker enriched by DRACOLoader with task bookkeeping. */
interface DRACOWorkerHost extends Worker {
  _callbacks: Record<number, { resolve: (message: unknown) => void; reject: (message: unknown) => void }>;
  _taskCosts: Record<number, number>;
  _taskLoad: number;
}

export type DRACOOnLoad = (bufferGeometry: BufferGeometry) => void;
export type DRACOOnProgress = (event: ProgressEvent) => void;

/**
 * A loader for the Draco format.
 *
 * [Draco](https://google.github.io/draco/) is an open source library for compressing
 * and decompressing 3D meshes and point clouds. Compressed geometry can be significantly smaller,
 * at the cost of additional decoding time on the client device.
 *
 * Standalone Draco files have a `.drc` extension, and contain vertex positions, normals, colors,
 * and other attributes. Draco files do not contain materials, textures, animation, or node hierarchies –
 * to use these features, embed Draco geometry inside of a glTF file. A normal glTF file can be converted
 * to a Draco-compressed glTF file using [glTF-Pipeline](https://github.com/CesiumGS/gltf-pipeline).
 * When using Draco with glTF, an instance of `DRACOLoader`
 * will need to be attached to {@link GLTFLoader} so that the loader decoder can be reused, using
 * the {@link GLTFLoader#setDRACOLoader} method.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const loader = new DRACOLoader();
 * const geometry = await loader.loadAsync( 'models/draco/bunny.drc' );
 * geometry.computeVertexNormals(); // optional
 *
 * loader.dispose();
 * ```
 *
 * @augments Loader
 */
export class DRACOLoader extends Loader<BufferGeometry, string> {
  decoderPaths: { js: string | null; wasm: string | null; dep_js: string | null };
  decoderConfig: { type?: "js" | "wasm"; wasmBinary?: ArrayBuffer };
  decoderBinary: string | null;
  decoderPending: Promise<void> | null;

  workerLimit: number;
  workerPool: DRACOWorkerHost[];
  workerNextTaskID: number;
  workerSourceURL: string;

  defaultAttributeIDs: { position: string; normal: string; color: string; uv: string };
  defaultAttributeTypes: { position: string; normal: string; color: string; uv: string };

  /**
   * Constructs a new Draco loader.
   *
   * @param manager - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);

    this.decoderPaths = {
      js: WASM_JS_URL,
      wasm: WASM_BIN_URL,
      dep_js: JS_URL,
    };
    this.decoderConfig = {};
    this.decoderBinary = null;
    this.decoderPending = null;

    this.workerLimit = 4;
    this.workerPool = [];
    this.workerNextTaskID = 1;
    this.workerSourceURL = "";

    this.defaultAttributeIDs = {
      position: "POSITION",
      normal: "NORMAL",
      color: "COLOR",
      uv: "TEX_COORD",
    };
    this.defaultAttributeTypes = {
      position: "Float32Array",
      normal: "Float32Array",
      color: "Float32Array",
      uv: "Float32Array",
    };
  }

  /**
   * Provides configuration for the decoder libraries. Configuration cannot be changed after decoding begins.
   *
   * @param path - The decoder path, or a config object with explicit URLs for each decoder file.
   * @return A reference to this loader.
   */
  setDecoderPath(path: string | { js: string; wasm: string }): this {
    const { decoderPaths } = this;
    if (typeof path === "object") {
      decoderPaths.js = path.js;
      decoderPaths.wasm = path.wasm;
      decoderPaths.dep_js = null;
    } else {
      decoderPaths.js = LoaderUtils.resolveURL(WASM_JS_URL, path);
      decoderPaths.wasm = LoaderUtils.resolveURL(WASM_BIN_URL, path);
      decoderPaths.dep_js = LoaderUtils.resolveURL(JS_URL, path);
    }

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Provides configuration for the decoder libraries. Configuration cannot be changed after decoding begins.
   * Kept for API parity with the upstream lifecycle; the module paths are fixed at construction.
   *
   * @param config - The decoder config.
   * @return A reference to this loader.
   */
  setDecoderConfig(config: { type?: "js" | "wasm" }): this {
    this.decoderConfig = config;

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Sets the maximum number of Web Workers to be used during decoding.
   * A lower limit may be preferable if workers are also for other tasks in the application.
   *
   * @param workerLimit - The worker limit.
   * @return A reference to this loader.
   */
  setWorkerLimit(workerLimit: number): this {
    this.workerLimit = workerLimit;

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Starts loading from the given URL and passes the loaded Draco asset
   * to the `onLoad()` callback.
   *
   * @param url - The path/URL of the file to be loaded. This can also be a data URI.
   * @param onLoad - Executed when the loading process has been finished.
   * @param onProgress - Executed while the loading is in progress.
   * @param onError - Executed when errors occur.
   */
  override load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: DRACOOnLoad,
    onProgress?: DRACOOnProgress,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);

    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);

    loader.load(
      url,
      (buffer: unknown) => {
        this.parse(buffer as ArrayBuffer, onLoad, onError);
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  /**
   * Parses the given Draco data.
   *
   * @param buffer - The raw Draco data as an array buffer.
   * @param onLoad - Executed when the loading/parsing process has been finished.
   * @param onError - Executed when errors occur.
   */
  parse(buffer: ArrayBuffer, onLoad?: DRACOOnLoad, onError: (error: unknown) => void = () => {}): void {
    this.decodeDracoFile(buffer, onLoad ?? (() => {}), null, null, ColorSpace.SRGB, onError).catch(onError);
  }

  //

  decodeDracoFile(
    buffer: ArrayBuffer,
    callback: DRACOOnLoad,
    attributeIDs: Record<string, string | number> | null = null,
    attributeTypes: Record<string, string> | null = null,
    vertexColorSpace: string = ColorSpace.LinearSRGB,
    onError: (error: unknown) => void = () => {},
  ): Promise<void> {
    const taskConfig = {
      attributeIDs: attributeIDs ?? this.defaultAttributeIDs,
      attributeTypes: attributeTypes ?? this.defaultAttributeTypes,
      useUniqueIDs: !!attributeIDs,
      vertexColorSpace: vertexColorSpace,
    };

    return this.decodeGeometry(buffer, taskConfig)
      .then((geometry) => callback(geometry))
      .catch(onError);
  }

  decodeGeometry(buffer: ArrayBuffer, taskConfig: DecodeTaskConfig): Promise<BufferGeometry> {
    const taskKey = JSON.stringify(taskConfig);

    // Check for an existing task using this buffer. A transferred buffer cannot be transferred
    // again from this thread.
    if (_taskCache.has(buffer)) {
      const cachedTask = _taskCache.get(buffer)!;

      if (cachedTask.key === taskKey) {
        return cachedTask.promise;
      } else if (buffer.byteLength === 0) {
        // Technically, it would be possible to wait for the previous task to complete,
        // transfer the buffer back, and decode again with the second configuration. That
        // is complex, and I don't know of any reason to decode a Draco buffer twice in
        // different ways, so this is left unimplemented.
        throw new Error(
          "THREE.DRACOLoader: Unable to re-decode a buffer with different settings. Buffer has already been transferred.",
        );
      }
    }

    //

    let worker: DRACOWorkerHost;

    const taskID = this.workerNextTaskID++;
    const taskCost = buffer.byteLength;

    // Obtain a worker and assign a task, and construct a geometry instance
    // when the task completes.
    const geometryPending = this._getWorker(taskID, taskCost)
      .then((_worker) => {
        worker = _worker;

        return new Promise<unknown>((resolve, reject) => {
          worker._callbacks[taskID] = { resolve, reject };

          worker.postMessage({ type: "decode", id: taskID, taskConfig, buffer }, [buffer]);
        });
      })
      .then((raw) => {
        const message = raw as DRACODecodeMessage;
        return this._createGeometry(message.geometry);
      });

    // Remove task from the task list.
    // Note: replaced '.finally()' with '.catch().then()' block - iOS 11 support (#19416)
    void geometryPending
      .catch(() => true)
      .then(() => {
        if (worker && taskID) {
          this._releaseTask(worker, taskID);
        }
      });

    // Cache the task result.
    _taskCache.set(buffer, {
      key: taskKey,
      promise: geometryPending,
    });

    return geometryPending;
  }

  _createGeometry(geometryData: DRACOGeometryData): BufferGeometry {
    const geometry = new BufferGeometry();

    if (geometryData.index) {
      geometry.setIndex(new BufferAttribute(geometryData.index.array, 1));
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < geometryData.attributes.length; i++) {
      const { name, array, itemSize, stride, vertexColorSpace } = geometryData.attributes[i];

      let attribute;

      if (itemSize === stride) {
        attribute = new BufferAttribute(array, itemSize);
      } else {
        const buffer = new InterleavedBuffer(array as Float32Array, stride);

        attribute = new InterleavedBufferAttribute(buffer, itemSize, 0);
      }

      if (name === "color") {
        this._assignVertexColorSpace(attribute, vertexColorSpace ?? ColorSpace.LinearSRGB);

        attribute.normalized = array instanceof Float32Array === false;
      }

      geometry.setAttribute(name, attribute);
    }

    return geometry;
  }

  _assignVertexColorSpace(attribute: BufferAttribute | InterleavedBufferAttribute, inputColorSpace: string): void {
    // While .drc files do not specify colorspace, the only 'official' tooling
    // is PLY and OBJ converters, which use sRGB. We'll assume sRGB when a .drc
    // file is passed into .load() or .parse(). GLTFLoader uses internal APIs
    // to decode geometry, and vertex colors are already Linear-sRGB in there.

    if (inputColorSpace !== ColorSpace.SRGB) return;

    const _color = new Color();

    for (let i = 0, il = attribute.count; i < il; i++) {
      _color.fromBufferAttribute(attribute, i);
      ColorManagement.colorSpaceToWorking(_color, ColorSpace.SRGB);
      attribute.setXYZ(i, _color.r, _color.g, _color.b);
    }
  }

  _loadLibrary(url: string, responseType: string): Promise<unknown> {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setResponseType(responseType);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      loader.load(url, resolve as never, undefined, reject);
    });
  }

  /**
   * Preloads the decoder (prefetching library and Web Worker used for decoding).
   *
   * @return A reference to this loader.
   */
  preload(): this {
    // Preloading resolves asynchronously up to each worker's onmessage; nothing to await here.
    void this._initDecoder();

    return this;
  }

  _initDecoder(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.decoderPending !== null) return this.decoderPending;

    const useJS = typeof WebAssembly !== "object" || this.decoderConfig.type === "js";
    const librariesPending: Promise<unknown>[] = [];

    const { decoderPaths } = this;
    if (useJS) {
      if (decoderPaths.dep_js === null) {
        throw new Error("THREE.DRACOLoader: WebAssembly is required when using a custom decoder paths.");
      }

      librariesPending.push(this._loadLibrary(decoderPaths.dep_js as string, "text"));
    } else {
      librariesPending.push(this._loadLibrary(decoderPaths.js as string, "text"));
      librariesPending.push(this._loadLibrary(decoderPaths.wasm as string, "arraybuffer"));
    }

    this.decoderPending = Promise.all(librariesPending).then((libraries) => {
      const jsContent = libraries[0] as string;

      if (!useJS) {
        this.decoderConfig.wasmBinary = libraries[1] as ArrayBuffer;
      }

      const fn = DRACOWorker.toString();

      const body = [
        "/* draco decoder */",
        jsContent,
        "",
        "/* worker */",
        fn.substring(fn.indexOf("{") + 1, fn.lastIndexOf("}")),
      ].join("\n");

      this.workerSourceURL = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([body]));
    });

    return this.decoderPending as Promise<void>;
  }

  _getWorker(taskID: number, taskCost: number): Promise<DRACOWorkerHost> {
    return this._initDecoder().then(() => {
      if (this.workerPool.length < this.workerLimit) {
        const worker = new Worker(this.workerSourceURL) as DRACOWorkerHost;

        worker._callbacks = {};
        worker._taskCosts = {};
        worker._taskLoad = 0;

        worker.onmessage = function (e: MessageEvent) {
          const message = e.data as { type: string; id: number };

          switch (message.type) {
            case "decode":
              worker._callbacks[message.id].resolve(message);
              break;

            case "error":
              worker._callbacks[message.id].reject(message);
              break;

            default:
              console.error('THREE.DRACOLoader: Unexpected message, "' + message.type + '"');
          }
        };

        worker.postMessage({ type: "init", decoderConfig: this.decoderConfig });

        this.workerPool.push(worker);
      } else {
        this.workerPool.sort(function (a, b) {
          return a._taskLoad > b._taskLoad ? -1 : 1;
        });
      }

      const target = this.workerPool[this.workerPool.length - 1]!;
      target._taskCosts[taskID] = taskCost;
      target._taskLoad += taskCost;
      return target;
    });
  }

  _releaseTask(worker: DRACOWorkerHost, taskID: number): void {
    worker._taskLoad -= worker._taskCosts[taskID];
    delete worker._callbacks[taskID];
    delete worker._taskCosts[taskID];
  }

  debug(): void {
    console.log(
      "Task load: ",
      this.workerPool.map((worker) => worker._taskLoad),
    );
  }

  /**
   * Disposes this loader instance: terminates workers and releases the decoder blob URL.
   *
   * @return A reference to this loader.
   */
  dispose(): this {
    for (let i = 0; i < this.workerPool.length; ++i) {
      this.workerPool[i].terminate();
    }

    this.workerPool.length = 0;

    if (this.workerSourceURL !== "") {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(this.workerSourceURL);
    }

    return this;
  }
}

/** Messages exchanged with the decoder worker. */
type WorkerMessage =
  | { type: "init"; decoderConfig: Record<string, unknown> }
  | { type: "decode"; id: number; buffer: ArrayBuffer; taskConfig: DecodeTaskConfig }
  | { type: "error"; id: number; error: string };

/** Worker-side decode task payload. */
interface DecodeTaskConfig {
  attributeIDs: Record<string, string | number>;
  attributeTypes: Record<string, string>;
  useUniqueIDs: boolean;
  vertexColorSpace: string;
}

/** Worker decode result envelope. */
interface DRACODecodeMessage {
  id: number;
  geometry: DRACOGeometryData;
}

/* WEB WORKER */

declare global {
  /** Provided by the draco decoder script loaded ahead of this worker body. */
  function DracoDecoderModule(config: Record<string, unknown>): void;
}

function DRACOWorker(): void {
  let decoderConfig: Record<string, unknown>;
  let decoderPending: Promise<{ draco: DracoDecoderHost }>;

  onmessage = function (e: MessageEvent) {
    const message = e.data as WorkerMessage;

    switch (message.type) {
      case "init":
        decoderConfig = message.decoderConfig;
        decoderPending = new Promise(function (resolve /*, reject*/) {
          decoderConfig.onModuleLoaded = function (draco: DracoDecoderHost) {
            // Module is Promise-like. Wrap before resolving to avoid loop.
            resolve({ draco: draco });
          };

          // The draco decoder script exposes this global inside the worker.
          (self as unknown as { DracoDecoderModule: (config: Record<string, unknown>) => void }).DracoDecoderModule(
            decoderConfig,
          );
        });
        break;

      case "decode": {
        const buffer = message.buffer;
        const taskConfig = message.taskConfig;
        // Errors inside the decode pipeline are posted back through worker message instead of
        // thrown rejection — nothing to await in the worker event handler.
        void decoderPending.then((module) => {
          const draco = module.draco;
          const decoder = new draco.Decoder();

          try {
            const geometry = decodeGeometry(draco, decoder, new Int8Array(buffer), taskConfig);

            const buffers: Transferable[] = geometry.attributes.map((attr) => attr.array.buffer as ArrayBuffer);

            if (geometry.index) buffers.push(geometry.index.array.buffer as ArrayBuffer);

            (self as unknown as { postMessage(m: unknown, t: Transferable[]): void }).postMessage(
              { type: "decode", id: message.id, geometry },
              buffers,
            );
          } catch (error) {
            console.error(error);

            (self as unknown as { postMessage(m: unknown): void }).postMessage({
              type: "error",
              id: message.id,
              error: (error as Error).message,
            });
          } finally {
            draco.destroy(decoder);
          }
        });
        break;
      }
    }
  };

  function decodeGeometry(
    draco: DracoDecoderHost,
    decoder: DracoDecoderInstance,
    array: Int8Array,
    taskConfig: DecodeTaskConfig,
  ): DRACOGeometryData {
    const attributeIDs = taskConfig.attributeIDs;
    const attributeTypes = taskConfig.attributeTypes;

    let dracoGeometry: DracoGeometryHost;
    let decodingStatus: { ok(): boolean; error_msg(): string };

    const geometryType = decoder.GetEncodedGeometryType(array);

    if (geometryType === draco.TRIANGULAR_MESH) {
      dracoGeometry = new draco.Mesh();
      decodingStatus = decoder.DecodeArrayToMesh(array, array.byteLength, dracoGeometry);
    } else if (geometryType === draco.POINT_CLOUD) {
      dracoGeometry = new draco.PointCloud();
      decodingStatus = decoder.DecodeArrayToPointCloud(array, array.byteLength, dracoGeometry);
    } else {
      throw new Error("THREE.DRACOLoader: Unexpected geometry type.");
    }

    if (!decodingStatus.ok() || dracoGeometry.ptr === 0) {
      throw new Error("THREE.DRACOLoader: Decoding failed: " + decodingStatus.error_msg());
    }

    const geometry = { index: null, attributes: [] } as DRACOGeometryData;

    // Gather all vertex attributes.
    for (const attributeName in attributeIDs) {
      // Upstream resolves e.g. "Float32Array" against the worker global scope.
      const attributeType = (self as unknown as Record<string, TypedArrayCtor | undefined>)[
        attributeTypes[attributeName]
      ] as TypedArrayCtor;

      let attribute;
      let attributeID;

      // A Draco file may be created with default vertex attributes, whose attribute IDs
      // are mapped 1:1 from their semantic name (POSITION, NORMAL, ...). Alternatively,
      // a Draco file may contain a custom set of attributes, identified by known unique
      // IDs. glTF files always do the latter, and `.drc` files typically do the former.
      if (taskConfig.useUniqueIDs) {
        attributeID = Number(attributeIDs[attributeName]);
        attribute = decoder.GetAttributeByUniqueId(dracoGeometry, attributeID);
      } else {
        const semantic = draco[attributeIDs[attributeName].toString()] as number;
        attributeID = decoder.GetAttributeId(dracoGeometry, semantic);

        if (attributeID === -1) continue;

        attribute = decoder.GetAttribute(dracoGeometry, attributeID);
      }

      const attributeResult = decodeAttribute(
        draco,
        decoder,
        dracoGeometry,
        attributeName,
        attributeType,
        attribute as DracoAttribute,
      );

      if (attributeName === "color") {
        attributeResult.vertexColorSpace = taskConfig.vertexColorSpace;
      }

      geometry.attributes.push(attributeResult);
    }

    // Add index.
    if (geometryType === draco.TRIANGULAR_MESH) {
      geometry.index = decodeIndex(draco, decoder, dracoGeometry);
    }

    draco.destroy(dracoGeometry);

    return geometry;
  }

  function decodeIndex(
    draco: DracoDecoderHost,
    decoder: DracoDecoderInstance,
    dracoGeometry: DracoGeometryHost,
  ): { array: Uint32Array; itemSize: number } {
    const numFaces = dracoGeometry.num_faces();
    const numIndices = numFaces * 3;
    const byteLength = numIndices * 4;

    const ptr = draco._malloc(byteLength);
    decoder.GetTrianglesUInt32Array(dracoGeometry, byteLength, ptr);
    const index = new Uint32Array(draco.HEAPU32.buffer, ptr, numIndices).slice();
    draco._free(ptr);

    return { array: index, itemSize: 1 };
  }

  function decodeAttribute(
    draco: DracoDecoderHost,
    decoder: DracoDecoderInstance,
    dracoGeometry: DracoGeometryHost,
    attributeName: string,
    TypedArray: TypedArrayCtor,
    attribute: DracoAttribute,
  ): DRACOAttributeData {
    const count = dracoGeometry.num_points();
    const itemSize = attribute.num_components();
    const dracoDataType = getDracoDataType(draco, TypedArray);

    // Reference: https://registry.khronos.org/glTF/specs/2.0/glTF-2.0.html#data-alignment
    const srcByteStride = itemSize * TypedArray.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT;
    const dstByteStride = Math.ceil(srcByteStride / 4) * 4;

    const dstStride = dstByteStride / TypedArray.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT;

    const srcByteLength = count * srcByteStride;
    const dstByteLength = count * dstByteStride;

    const ptr = draco._malloc(srcByteLength);
    decoder.GetAttributeDataArrayForAllPoints(dracoGeometry, attribute, dracoDataType, srcByteLength, ptr);

    const heap = draco.HEAPU32.buffer as ArrayBuffer;
    const srcArray = new TypedArray(heap, ptr, srcByteLength / TypedArray.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT);
    let dstArray: TypedArrayInstance;

    if (srcByteStride === dstByteStride) {
      // THREE.BufferAttribute

      dstArray = srcArray.slice();
    } else {
      // THREE.InterleavedBufferAttribute

      dstArray = new TypedArray(dstByteLength / TypedArray.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT);

      let dstOffset = 0;

      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        for (let j = 0; j < itemSize; j++) {
          dstArray[dstOffset + j] = srcArray[i * itemSize + j];
        }

        dstOffset += dstStride;
      }
    }

    draco._free(ptr);

    return {
      name: attributeName,
      count: count,
      itemSize: itemSize,
      array: dstArray,
      stride: dstStride,
    };
  }

  function getDracoDataType(draco: DracoDecoderHost, TypedArray: TypedArrayCtor): number {
    switch (TypedArray) {
      case Float32Array:
        return draco.DT_FLOAT32;
      case Int8Array:
        return draco.DT_INT8;
      case Int16Array:
        return draco.DT_INT16;
      case Int32Array:
        return draco.DT_INT32;
      case Uint8Array:
        return draco.DT_UINT8;
      case Uint16Array:
        return draco.DT_UINT16;
      case Uint32Array:
        return draco.DT_UINT32;
    }

    return draco.DT_FLOAT32;
  }
}
````

/** An injected zlib runtime; the package never bundles a decompressor. */
export interface EXRZlibDecoder {
  unzlibSync(data: Uint8Array): Uint8Array;
}

/** A channel entry from the file's `channels` (chlist) attribute. */
export interface EXRChannel {
  name: string;
  pixelType: number;
  pLinear: number;
  xSampling: number;
  ySampling: number;
}

/** A `box2i` attribute such as the data window. */
export interface EXRBox2i {
  xMin: number;
  yMin: number;
  xMax: number;
  yMax: number;
}

/** A `chromaticities` attribute. */
export interface EXRChromaticities {
  redX: number;
  redY: number;
  greenX: number;
  greenY: number;
  blueX: number;
  blueY: number;
  whiteX: number;
  whiteY: number;
}

/** A `tiledesc` attribute. */
export interface EXRTiledesc {
  xSize: number;
  ySize: number;
  levelMode: string;
  roundingMode: string;
}

/** The version-flags byte of the file header. */
export interface EXRSpec {
  singleTile: boolean;
  longName: boolean;
  deepFormat: boolean;
  multiPart: boolean;
}

/**
 * One parsed part header. Unknown attributes are retained by their file names;
 * the parsed header is exposed as `header` on the returned texture data.
 */
export interface EXRPartHeader {
  [attributeName: string]: unknown;
  channels: EXRChannel[];
  compression: string;
  dataWindow: EXRBox2i;
  lineOrder?: string;
  tiles?: EXRTiledesc;
  version: number;
  spec: EXRSpec;
