## ek3d/addons/loaders/GaussianSplatPLYLoader

````typescript
import type { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import type { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import type { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";
import { PLYLoader } from "./PLYLoader";
import {
  SH_BAND_COMPONENTS,
  SH_BAND_WORDS,
  createGaussianSplatGeometry,
  createPackedSphericalHarmonicsBand,
  sigmoid,
  writeColorBytesFromSH0,
  writeCovariance,
} from "../utils/GaussianSplatUtils";

const SH_DEGREE_TO_COMPONENTS = [0, 9, 24, 45];
const PROPERTY_MAPPING: Record<string, string[]> = {
  scale: ["scale_0", "scale_1", "scale_2"],
  rotation: ["rot_0", "rot_1", "rot_2", "rot_3"],
  f_dc: ["f_dc_0", "f_dc_1", "f_dc_2"],
  opacity: ["opacity"],
};
const REQUIRED_PROPERTIES = ["x", "y", "z", ...Object.values(PROPERTY_MAPPING).flat()];
const HEADER_PATTERN = /^ply([\s\S]*?)end_header/;
const PROPERTY_PATTERN = /^property\s+\S+\s+(\S+)\s*$/;
const REST_PROPERTY_PATTERN = /^f_rest_\d+$/;

/**
 * Loads GraphDECO/INRIA Gaussian splat PLY files, detecting spherical harmonics
 * degree from the header and converting the properties to splat geometry.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { GaussianSplatPLYLoader } from "ek3d/addons/loaders/GaussianSplatPLYLoader";
 * const geometry = await new GaussianSplatPLYLoader().loadAsync("./point_cloud.ply");
 * console.log(geometry.getAttribute("position"));
 * ```
 */
export class GaussianSplatPLYLoader extends Loader<BufferGeometry, string> {
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
  }

  override load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (value: BufferGeometry) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (data: unknown) => {
        try {
          const geometry = this.parse(data as ArrayBuffer);
          if (onLoad !== undefined) onLoad(geometry);
        } catch (error) {
          if (onError !== undefined) onError(error);
          else console.error(error);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  /** Parses ASCII text or binary PLY data into Gaussian splat geometry. */
  parse(data: ArrayBuffer | string): BufferGeometry {
    const degree = detectSphericalHarmonicsDegree(data);
    const mapping = { ...PROPERTY_MAPPING };
    const count = SH_DEGREE_TO_COMPONENTS[degree];
    if (count > 0) mapping.f_rest = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => `f_rest_${i}`);
    const loader = new PLYLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setCustomPropertyNameMapping(mapping);
    return convertPLYGeometry(loader.parse(data));
  }
}

function detectSphericalHarmonicsDegree(data: ArrayBuffer | string): number {
  const text = typeof data === "string" ? data : decodeHeaderText(new Uint8Array(data));
  const header = HEADER_PATTERN.exec(text);
  if (header === null) throw new Error("THREE.GaussianSplatPLYLoader: Missing PLY header.");
  const names = new Set<string>();
  let count = 0;
  for (const line of header[1].split(/\r\n|\r|\n/)) {
    const property = PROPERTY_PATTERN.exec(line.trim());
    if (property === null) continue;
    names.add(property[1]);
    if (REST_PROPERTY_PATTERN.test(property[1])) count++;
  }
  if (REQUIRED_PROPERTIES.some((name) => !names.has(name))) {
    throw new Error(
      "THREE.GaussianSplatPLYLoader: PLY file requires position, scale, rotation, f_dc and opacity properties.",
    );
  }
  const degree = SH_DEGREE_TO_COMPONENTS.indexOf(count);
  if (degree === -1) {
    throw new Error(
      `THREE.GaussianSplatPLYLoader: Unsupported number of f_rest spherical harmonics coefficients (${count}).`,
    );
  }
  return degree;
}

function decodeHeaderText(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  const marker = "end_header";
  const scanLength = Math.min(bytes.length, 1024 * 1024);
  let headerEnd = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i <= scanLength - marker.length; i++) {
    let matches = true;
    for (let j = 0; j < marker.length; j++) {
      if (bytes[i + j] !== marker.charCodeAt(j)) {
        matches = false;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (matches) {
      headerEnd = i + marker.length;
      break;
    }
  }
  return new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.subarray(0, headerEnd === -1 ? bytes.length : headerEnd));
}

function convertPLYGeometry(geometry: BufferGeometry): BufferGeometry {
  // PLYLoader constructs ordinary BufferAttributes, never GPU or interleaved attributes.
  const position = geometry.getAttribute("position") as BufferAttribute | undefined;
  const scale = geometry.getAttribute("scale") as BufferAttribute | undefined;
  const rotation = geometry.getAttribute("rotation") as BufferAttribute | undefined;
  const sh0 = geometry.getAttribute("f_dc") as BufferAttribute | undefined;
  const shRest = geometry.getAttribute("f_rest") as BufferAttribute | undefined;
  const opacity = geometry.getAttribute("opacity") as BufferAttribute | undefined;
  if (
    position === undefined ||
    scale === undefined ||
    rotation === undefined ||
    sh0 === undefined ||
    opacity === undefined
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "THREE.GaussianSplatPLYLoader: PLY file requires position, scale, rotation, f_dc and opacity properties.",
    );
  }
  const count = position.count;
  if (
    position.itemSize !== 3 ||
    scale.itemSize !== 3 ||
    rotation.itemSize !== 4 ||
    sh0.itemSize !== 3 ||
    opacity.itemSize !== 1
  ) {
    throw new Error("THREE.GaussianSplatPLYLoader: Invalid Gaussian splat PLY property itemSize.");
  }
  if (scale.count !== count || rotation.count !== count || sh0.count !== count || opacity.count !== count) {
    throw new Error("THREE.GaussianSplatPLYLoader: Gaussian splat PLY property counts must match position.");
  }
  const centers = new Float32Array(count * 3);
  const covariances = new Float32Array(count * 6);
  const colors = new Uint8ClampedArray(count * 4);
  const degree = shRest === undefined ? 0 : SH_DEGREE_TO_COMPONENTS.indexOf(shRest.itemSize);
  if (degree === -1)
    throw new Error("THREE.GaussianSplatPLYLoader: Unsupported number of f_rest spherical harmonics coefficients.");
  const sphericalHarmonics: Record<string, Uint32Array> = {};
  const bytes: Record<string, Uint8ClampedArray> = {};
  for (let bandDegree = 1; bandDegree <= degree; bandDegree++) {
    const band = createPackedSphericalHarmonicsBand(count, bandDegree);
    sphericalHarmonics[`sh${bandDegree}`] = band.packed;
    bytes[`sh${bandDegree}`] = band.bytes;
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const i3 = i * 3;
    centers[i3] = position.getX(i);
    centers[i3 + 1] = position.getY(i);
    centers[i3 + 2] = position.getZ(i);
    writeCovariance(
      covariances,
      i * 6,
      Math.exp(scale.getX(i)),
      Math.exp(scale.getY(i)),
      Math.exp(scale.getZ(i)),
      rotation.getY(i),
      rotation.getZ(i),
      rotation.getW(i),
      rotation.getX(i),
    );
    writeColorBytesFromSH0(colors, i * 4, sh0.getX(i), sh0.getY(i), sh0.getZ(i), sigmoid(opacity.getX(i)));
    if (shRest !== undefined && degree > 0) writeSphericalHarmonicsFromRest(bytes, i, shRest);
  }
  return createGaussianSplatGeometry(centers, covariances, colors, sphericalHarmonics);
}

function writeSphericalHarmonicsFromRest(
  bytes: Record<string, Uint8ClampedArray>,
  index: number,
  shRest: BufferAttribute,
): void {
  const stride = shRest.itemSize / 3;
  const source = shRest.array;
  const sourceOffset = index * shRest.itemSize;
  for (let degree = 1; degree <= 3; degree++) {
    const target = bytes[`sh${degree}`];
    if (target === undefined) break;
    const bandOffset = degree === 1 ? 0 : degree === 2 ? 3 : 8;
    const targetOffset = index * SH_BAND_WORDS[degree] * 4;
    for (let j = 0; j < SH_BAND_COMPONENTS[degree]; j++) {
      const coefficient = Math.floor(j / 3);
      const channel = j % 3;
      target[targetOffset + j] = source[sourceOffset + bandOffset + coefficient + channel * stride] * 128 + 128;
    }
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/loaders/HDRCubeTextureLoader

```typescript
import { TextureType, TextureFilter, ColorSpace } from "../../constants";
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import type { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";
import { CubeTexture } from "../../textures/CubeTexture";
import { DataTexture } from "../../textures/DataTexture";
import { error } from "../../utils";
import { HDRLoader } from "./HDRLoader";

/** Loads six RGBE images into an HDR cube texture. */
export class HDRCubeTextureLoader extends Loader<CubeTexture, string[]> {
  hdrLoader: HDRLoader;
  type: TextureType;

  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
    this.hdrLoader = new HDRLoader(this.manager);
    this.type = TextureType.HalfFloat;
  }

  load(
    urls: string[],
    onLoad?: (texture: CubeTexture) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (cause: unknown) => void,
  ): CubeTexture {
    const texture = new CubeTexture();
    texture.type = this.type;
    if (texture.type === TextureType.Float || texture.type === TextureType.HalfFloat) {
      texture.colorSpace = ColorSpace.LinearSRGB;
      texture.minFilter = TextureFilter.Linear;
      texture.magFilter = TextureFilter.Linear;
      texture.generateMipmaps = false;
    }
    let loaded = 0;
    let failed = false;
    urls.forEach((url, i) => {
      const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
      loader
        .setPriority(this.priority)
        .setCache(this.cache)
        .setPath(this.path)
        .setResponseType("arraybuffer")
        .setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader)
        .setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
      loader.load(
        url,
        (buffer) => {
          if (failed) return;
          try {
            if (!(buffer instanceof ArrayBuffer))
              throw new Error("HDRCubeTextureLoader: Expected an ArrayBuffer response.");
            const texData = this.hdrLoader.parse(buffer);
            if (texData.data === undefined || texData.width === undefined || texData.height === undefined)
              throw new Error("HDRCubeTextureLoader: Missing face data.");
            const face = new DataTexture(texData.data, texData.width, texData.height);
            face.type = texture.type;
            face.colorSpace = texture.colorSpace;
            face.format = texture.format;
            face.minFilter = texture.minFilter;
            face.magFilter = texture.magFilter;
            face.generateMipmaps = texture.generateMipmaps;
            texture.images[i] = face;
          } catch (cause) {
            failed = true;
            if (onError) onError(cause);
            else error(cause);
            this.manager.itemError(this.manager.resolveURL(this.path + url));
            return;
          }
          if (++loaded === 6) {
            texture.needsUpdate = true;
            onLoad?.(texture);
          }
        },
        onProgress,
        (cause) => {
          failed = true;
          onError?.(cause);
        },
      );
    });
    return texture;
  }

  setDataType(value: TextureType): this {
    this.type = value;
    this.hdrLoader.setDataType(value);
    return this;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/HDRLoader

````typescript
import { TextureType, TextureFilter, ColorSpace } from "../../constants";
import { DataTextureLoader } from "../../loaders/DataTextureLoader";
import type { DataTextureData } from "../../loaders/DataTextureLoader";
import type { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";
import { toHalfFloat } from "../../extras/DataUtils";

const rgbeReadError = 1;
const rgbeWriteError = 2;
const rgbeFormatError = 3;
const rgbeMemoryError = 4;

function rgbeError(rgbeErrorCode: number, msg?: string): never {
  switch (rgbeErrorCode) {
    case rgbeReadError:
      throw new Error("THREE.HDRLoader: Read Error: " + (msg || ""));
    case rgbeWriteError:
      throw new Error("THREE.HDRLoader: Write Error: " + (msg || ""));
    case rgbeFormatError:
      throw new Error("THREE.HDRLoader: Bad File Format: " + (msg || ""));
    default:
    case rgbeMemoryError:
      throw new Error("THREE.HDRLoader: Memory Error: " + (msg || ""));
  }
}

/* flags indicating which fields in an rgbe_header_info are valid */
const RGBE_VALID_PROGRAMTYPE = 1;
const RGBE_VALID_FORMAT = 2;
const RGBE_VALID_DIMENSIONS = 4;

const NEWLINE = "\n";

/** View over the raw bytes with a moving read cursor, as upstream's buffer.pos attachment. */
interface RgbeBuffer extends Uint8Array {
  pos: number;
}

/** A parsed RGBE header. */
interface RGBEHeaderInfo {
  valid: number;
  string: string;
  comments: string;
  programtype: string;
  format: string;
  gamma: number;
  exposure: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

function fgets(buffer: RgbeBuffer, lineLimit?: number, consume?: boolean): string | false {
  const chunkSize = 128;

  lineLimit = !lineLimit ? 1024 : lineLimit;
  let p = buffer.pos;
  let i = -1;
  let len = 0;
  let s = "";
  let chunk = String.fromCharCode.apply(
    null,
    new Uint16Array(buffer.subarray(p, p + chunkSize)) as unknown as number[],
  );

  while ((i = chunk.indexOf(NEWLINE)) < 0 && len < lineLimit && p < buffer.byteLength) {
    s += chunk;
    len += chunk.length;
    p += chunkSize;
    chunk = String.fromCharCode.apply(null, new Uint16Array(buffer.subarray(p, p + chunkSize)) as unknown as number[]);
  }

  if (i > -1) {
    if (consume !== false) buffer.pos += len + i + 1;
    return s + chunk.slice(0, i);
  }

  return false;
}

/* minimal header reading. modify if you want to parse more information */
function RGBE_ReadHeader(buffer: RgbeBuffer): RGBEHeaderInfo {
  // regexes to parse header info fields
  const magic_token_re = /^#\?(\S+)/;
  const gamma_re = /^\s*GAMMA\s*=\s*(\d+(\.\d+)?)\s*$/;
  const exposure_re = /^\s*EXPOSURE\s*=\s*(\d+(\.\d+)?)\s*$/;
  const format_re = /^\s*FORMAT=(\S+)\s*$/;
  const dimensions_re = /^\s*-Y\s+(\d+)\s+\+X\s+(\d+)\s*$/;

  // RGBE format header struct
  const header: RGBEHeaderInfo = {
    valid: 0 /* indicate which fields are valid */,
    string: "" /* the actual header string */,
    comments: "" /* comments found in header */,
    programtype: "RGBE" /* listed at beginning of file to identify it after "#?" defaults to "RGBE" */,
    format: "" /* RGBE format, default 32-bit_rle_rgbe */,
    gamma: 1.0 /* image has already been gamma corrected with given gamma defaults is 1.0 (no correction) */,
    exposure: 1.0 /* a value of 1.0 in an image corresponds to <exposure> watts/steradian/m^2 defaults is 1.0 */,
    width: 0,
    height: 0 /* image dimensions, width/height */,
  };

  let line: string | false;
  let match: RegExpExecArray | RegExpMatchArray | null;

  if (buffer.pos >= buffer.byteLength || !(line = fgets(buffer))) {
    rgbeError(rgbeReadError, "no header found");
  }

  /* if you want to require the magic token then uncomment the next line */
  if (!(match = (line as string).match(magic_token_re))) {
    rgbeError(rgbeFormatError, "bad initial token");
  }

  header.valid |= RGBE_VALID_PROGRAMTYPE;
  header.programtype = match![1]!;
  header.string += line + "\n";

  for (;;) {
    line = fgets(buffer);
    if (line === false) break;
    header.string += line + "\n";

    if ("#" === line.charAt(0)) {
      header.comments += line + "\n";
      continue; // comment line
    }

    if ((match = line.match(gamma_re))) {
      header.gamma = parseFloat(match[1]!);
    }

    if ((match = line.match(exposure_re))) {
      header.exposure = parseFloat(match[1]!);
    }

    if ((match = line.match(format_re))) {
      header.valid |= RGBE_VALID_FORMAT;
      header.format = match[1]!; //'32-bit_rle_rgbe';
    }

    if ((match = line.match(dimensions_re))) {
      header.valid |= RGBE_VALID_DIMENSIONS;
      header.height = parseInt(match[1]!, 10);
      header.width = parseInt(match[2]!, 10);
    }

    if ((header.valid & RGBE_VALID_FORMAT) !== 0 && (header.valid & RGBE_VALID_DIMENSIONS) !== 0) break;
  }

  if (!(header.valid & RGBE_VALID_FORMAT)) {
    rgbeError(rgbeFormatError, "missing format specifier");
  }

  if (!(header.valid & RGBE_VALID_DIMENSIONS)) {
    rgbeError(rgbeFormatError, "missing image size specifier");
  }

  return header;
}

function RGBE_ReadPixels_RLE(buffer: RgbeBuffer, w: number, h: number): Uint8Array {
  const scanline_width = w;

  if (
    // run length encoding is not allowed so read flat
    scanline_width < 8 ||
    scanline_width > 0x7fff ||
    // this file is not run length encoded
    buffer[0] !== 2 ||
    buffer[1] !== 2 ||
    (buffer[2]! & 0x80) !== 0
  ) {
    // return the flat buffer
    return new Uint8Array(buffer);
  }

  if (scanline_width !== ((buffer[2]! << 8) | buffer[3]!)) {
    rgbeError(rgbeFormatError, "wrong scanline width");
  }

  const data_rgba = new Uint8Array(4 * w * h);

  if (!data_rgba.length) {
    rgbeError(rgbeMemoryError, "unable to allocate buffer space");
  }

  let offset = 0;
  let pos = 0;

  const ptr_end = 4 * scanline_width;
  const rgbeStart = new Uint8Array(4);
  const scanline_buffer = new Uint8Array(ptr_end);
  let num_scanlines = h;

  // read in each successive scanline
  while (num_scanlines > 0 && pos < buffer.byteLength) {
    if (pos + 4 > buffer.byteLength) {
      rgbeError(rgbeReadError);
    }

    rgbeStart[0] = buffer[pos++]!;
    rgbeStart[1] = buffer[pos++]!;
    rgbeStart[2] = buffer[pos++]!;
    rgbeStart[3] = buffer[pos++]!;

    if (rgbeStart[0] !== 2 || rgbeStart[1] !== 2 || ((rgbeStart[2]! << 8) | rgbeStart[3]!) !== scanline_width) {
      rgbeError(rgbeFormatError, "bad rgbe scanline format");
    }

    // read each of the four channels for the scanline into the buffer
    // first red, then green, then blue, then exponent
    let ptr = 0;
    let count: number;

    while (ptr < ptr_end && pos < buffer.byteLength) {
      count = buffer[pos++]!;
      const isEncodedRun = count > 128;
      if (isEncodedRun) count -= 128;

      if (count === 0 || ptr + count > ptr_end) {
        rgbeError(rgbeFormatError, "bad scanline data");
      }

      if (isEncodedRun) {
        // a (encoded) run of the same value
        const byteValue = buffer[pos++]!;
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          scanline_buffer[ptr++] = byteValue;
        }
        //ptr += count;
      } else {
        // a literal-run
        scanline_buffer.set(buffer.subarray(pos, pos + count), ptr);
        ptr += count;
        pos += count;
      }
    }

    // now convert data from buffer into rgba
    // first red, then green, then blue, then exponent (alpha)
    const l = scanline_width; //scanline_buffer.byteLength;
    for (let i = 0; i < l; i++) {
      let off = 0;
      data_rgba[offset] = scanline_buffer[i + off]!;
      off += scanline_width; //1;
      data_rgba[offset + 1] = scanline_buffer[i + off]!;
      off += scanline_width; //1;
      data_rgba[offset + 2] = scanline_buffer[i + off]!;
      off += scanline_width; //1;
      data_rgba[offset + 3] = scanline_buffer[i + off]!;
      offset += 4;
    }

    num_scanlines--;
  }

  return data_rgba;
}

function RGBEByteToRGBFloat(
  sourceArray: Uint8Array,
  sourceOffset: number,
  destArray: Float32Array,
  destOffset: number,
): void {
  const e = sourceArray[sourceOffset + 3]!;
  const scale = Math.pow(2.0, e - 128.0) / 255.0;

  destArray[destOffset] = sourceArray[sourceOffset]! * scale;
  destArray[destOffset + 1] = sourceArray[sourceOffset + 1]! * scale;
  destArray[destOffset + 2] = sourceArray[sourceOffset + 2]! * scale;
  destArray[destOffset + 3] = 1;
}

function RGBEByteToRGBHalf(
  sourceArray: Uint8Array,
  sourceOffset: number,
  destArray: Uint16Array,
  destOffset: number,
): void {
  const e = sourceArray[sourceOffset + 3]!;
  const scale = Math.pow(2.0, e - 128.0) / 255.0;

  // clamping to 65504, the maximum representable value in float16
  destArray[destOffset] = toHalfFloat(Math.min(sourceArray[sourceOffset]! * scale, 65504));
  destArray[destOffset + 1] = toHalfFloat(Math.min(sourceArray[sourceOffset + 1]! * scale, 65504));
  destArray[destOffset + 2] = toHalfFloat(Math.min(sourceArray[sourceOffset + 2]! * scale, 65504));
  destArray[destOffset + 3] = toHalfFloat(1);
}

/**
 * A loader for the RGBE HDR texture format.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { HDRLoader } from 'ek3d/addons/loaders/HDRLoader';
 * import { Mapping } from 'ek3d/constants';
 * import { Scene } from 'ek3d/scenes/Scene';
 *
 * const loader = new HDRLoader();
 * const envMap = await loader.loadAsync( 'textures/equirectangular/blouberg_sunrise_2_1k.hdr' );
 * envMap.mapping = Mapping.EquirectangularReflection;
 *
 * const scene = new Scene();
 * scene.environment = envMap;
 * ```
 *
 * @augments DataTextureLoader
 */
export class HDRLoader extends DataTextureLoader {
  /**
   * The texture type.
   *
   * @default TextureType.HalfFloat
   */
  type: TextureType;

  /**
   * Constructs a new RGBE/HDR loader.
   *
   * @param manager - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);

    this.type = TextureType.HalfFloat;
  }

  /**
   * Parses the given RGBE texture data.
   *
   * @param buffer - The raw texture data.
   * @return An object representing the parsed texture data.
   */
  override parse(buffer: ArrayBuffer): DataTextureData & { header: string } {
    // adapted from http://www.graphics.cornell.edu/~bjw/rgbe.html

    const byteArray = new Uint8Array(buffer) as RgbeBuffer;
    byteArray.pos = 0;
    const rgbe_header_info = RGBE_ReadHeader(byteArray);

    const w = rgbe_header_info.width;
    const h = rgbe_header_info.height;
    const pixelBuffer = new Uint8Array(byteArray.subarray(byteArray.pos)) as RgbeBuffer;
    pixelBuffer.pos = 0;
    const image_rgba_data = RGBE_ReadPixels_RLE(pixelBuffer, w, h);

    let data: Float32Array | Uint16Array;
    let type: number;
    let numElements: number;

    switch (this.type) {
      case TextureType.Float: {
        numElements = image_rgba_data.length / 4;
        const floatArray = new Float32Array(numElements * 4);

        for (let j = 0; j < numElements; j++) {
          RGBEByteToRGBFloat(image_rgba_data, j * 4, floatArray, j * 4);
        }

        data = floatArray;
        type = TextureType.Float;
        break;
      }
      case TextureType.HalfFloat: {
        numElements = image_rgba_data.length / 4;
        const halfArray = new Uint16Array(numElements * 4);

        for (let j = 0; j < numElements; j++) {
          RGBEByteToRGBHalf(image_rgba_data, j * 4, halfArray, j * 4);
        }

        data = halfArray;
        type = TextureType.HalfFloat;
        break;
      }
      default:
        throw new Error("THREE.HDRLoader: Unsupported type: " + this.type);
    }

    return {
      width: w,
      height: h,
      data: data,
      header: rgbe_header_info.string,
      gamma: rgbe_header_info.gamma,
      exposure: rgbe_header_info.exposure,
      type: type,
      colorSpace: ColorSpace.LinearSRGB,
      minFilter: TextureFilter.Linear,
      magFilter: TextureFilter.Linear,
      generateMipmaps: false,
      flipY: true,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Sets the texture type.
   *
   * @param value - The texture type to set.
   * @return A reference to this loader.
   */
  setDataType(value: TextureType): this {
    this.type = value;
    return this;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/loaders/IESLoader

```typescript
import { TextureType, TextureFilter, PixelFormat, Wrapping } from "../../constants";
import { toHalfFloat } from "../../extras/DataUtils";
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import { lerp } from "../../math/MathUtils";
import { DataTexture } from "../../textures/DataTexture";

interface IESProfile {
  vertical: number[];
  horizontal: number[];
  candela: number[][];
}

/** Loads normalized IES photometric profiles as red-channel textures. */
export class IESLoader extends Loader<DataTexture> {
  type: TextureType = TextureType.HalfFloat;

  override load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (texture: DataTexture) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setResponseType("text");
    loader.setCrossOrigin(this.crossOrigin);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (text) => {
        try {
          if (typeof text !== "string") throw new TypeError("IESLoader requires text data");
          const texture = this.parse(text);
          onLoad?.(texture);
        } catch (error) {
          if (onError) onError(error);
          else console.error(error);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  parse(text: string): DataTexture {
    const profile = parseProfile(text);
    const width = profile.horizontal.length === 1 ? 1 : 360;
    const height = 180;
    let data: Uint8Array | Uint16Array | Float32Array;
    switch (this.type) {
      case TextureType.UnsignedByte:
        data = new Uint8Array(width * height);
        break;
      case TextureType.HalfFloat:
        data = new Uint16Array(width * height);
        break;
      case TextureType.Float:
        data = new Float32Array(width * height);
        break;
      default:
        throw new Error(`IESLoader: Unsupported type: ${this.type}`);
    }
    const endTheta = profile.horizontal[profile.horizontal.length - 1];
    for (let theta = 0; theta < width; theta++) {
      let sampleTheta = theta;
      if (endTheta !== 0 && sampleTheta > endTheta) {
        sampleTheta %= endTheta * 2;
        if (sampleTheta > endTheta) sampleTheta = endTheta * 2 - sampleTheta;
      }
      for (let phi = 0; phi < height; phi++) {
        const value = interpolate(profile, (phi * 180) / (height - 1), sampleTheta);
        data[phi + theta * height] =
          this.type === TextureType.HalfFloat
            ? toHalfFloat(value)
            : this.type === TextureType.UnsignedByte
              ? Math.min(value * 255, 255)
              : value;
      }
    }
    const texture = new DataTexture(data, height, width, PixelFormat.Red, this.type);
    texture.minFilter = TextureFilter.Linear;
    texture.magFilter = TextureFilter.Linear;
    texture.wrapT = Wrapping.Repeat;
    texture.needsUpdate = true;
    return texture;
  }
}

function interpolate(profile: IESProfile, phi: number, theta: number): number {
  let thetaIndex = 0,
    phiIndex = 0;
  let startTheta = 0,
    endTheta = 0,
    startPhi = 0,
    endPhi = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < profile.horizontal.length - 1; i++) {
    if (theta < profile.horizontal[i + 1] || i === profile.horizontal.length - 2) {
      thetaIndex = i;
      startTheta = profile.horizontal[i];
      endTheta = profile.horizontal[i + 1];
      break;
    }
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < profile.vertical.length - 1; i++) {
    if (phi < profile.vertical[i + 1] || i === profile.vertical.length - 2) {
      phiIndex = i;
      startPhi = profile.vertical[i];
      endPhi = profile.vertical[i + 1];
      break;
    }
  }
  const deltaTheta = endTheta - startTheta,
    deltaPhi = endPhi - startPhi;
  if (deltaPhi === 0) return 0;
  const t1 = deltaTheta === 0 ? 0 : (theta - startTheta) / deltaTheta;
  const t2 = (phi - startPhi) / deltaPhi;
  const nextTheta = deltaTheta === 0 ? thetaIndex : thetaIndex + 1;
  return lerp(
    lerp(profile.candela[thetaIndex][phiIndex], profile.candela[nextTheta][phiIndex], t1),
    lerp(profile.candela[thetaIndex][phiIndex + 1], profile.candela[nextTheta][phiIndex + 1], t1),
    t2,
  );
}

function parseProfile(text: string): IESProfile {
  const lines = text.split("\n");
  const tilt = lines.findIndex((line) => line.includes("TILT"));
  if (tilt === -1) throw new Error("IESLoader: Missing TILT record");
  const mode = lines[tilt];
  if (!mode.includes("NONE") && !mode.includes("INCLUDE")) {
    throw new Error("IESLoader: External tilt files are not supported");
  }
  const tokens = lines
    .slice(tilt + 1)
    .join(" ")
    .trim()
    .split(/[\s,]+/);
  let offset = 0;
  function read(count: number): number[] {
    if (!Number.isInteger(count) || count < 0 || count > tokens.length - offset) {
      throw new Error("IESLoader: Invalid or truncated numeric record");
    }
    const values: number[] = [];
    values.length = count;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const value = Number(tokens[offset++]);
      if (!Number.isFinite(value)) throw new Error("IESLoader: Invalid numeric value");
      values[i] = value;
    }
    return values;
  }
  if (!mode.includes("NONE")) {
    read(1);
    const count = read(1)[0];
    read(count);
    read(count);
  }
  const values = read(10);
  const factors = read(3);
  const vertical = read(values[3]);
  const horizontal = read(values[4]);
  if (vertical.length === 0 || horizontal.length === 0) throw new Error("IESLoader: Missing angles");
  const candela: number[][] = [];
  let maximum = -1;
  const multiplier = values[2] * factors[0] * factors[1];
  const base = horizontal[0];
  for (let i = 0; i < horizontal.length; i++) {
    horizontal[i] -= base;
    const row = read(vertical.length);
    for (let j = 0; j < row.length; j++) {
      row[j] *= multiplier;
      maximum = Math.max(maximum, row[j]);
    }
    candela.push(row);
  }
  const endAngle = horizontal[horizontal.length - 1];
  if (endAngle > 180 && endAngle < 360) {
    horizontal.push(360);
    candela.push(candela[0].slice());
  }
  if (maximum > 0) {
    for (const row of candela) {
      for (let j = 0; j < row.length; j++) row[j] /= maximum;
    }
  }
  return { vertical, horizontal, candela };
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/JXLLoader

```typescript
import { TextureType, TextureFilter, ColorSpace, PixelFormat } from "../../constants";
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import { DataTexture } from "../../textures/DataTexture";

interface HDRPixels {
  data: Float16Array;
  pixelFormat: string;
}

// The native HDR Canvas2D extension is not yet included in the TypeScript DOM library.
interface HDRContext {
  globalHDRHeadroom: number;
  getContextAttributes(): { colorType?: string };
  drawImage(image: HTMLImageElement, x: number, y: number): void;
  getImageData(
    x: number,
    y: number,
    width: number,
    height: number,
    options: { colorSpace: "srgb-linear"; pixelFormat: "rgba-float16" },
  ): HDRPixels;
}

interface DecodedImage {
  data: Uint16Array;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

/** Loads native HDR JPEG XL images as linear-sRGB half-float textures. */
export class JXLLoader extends Loader<DataTexture> {
  override load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (texture: DataTexture) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): DataTexture {
    const texture = new DataTexture(null, 0, 0, PixelFormat.RGBA, TextureType.HalfFloat);
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    this.manager.itemStart(url);
    const failure = (error: unknown): void => {
      try {
        if (onError) onError(error);
        else console.error(error);
      } finally {
        this.manager.itemError(url);
        this.manager.itemEnd(url);
      }
    };
    loader.load(
      url,
      (buffer) => {
        if (!(buffer instanceof ArrayBuffer)) {
          failure(new TypeError("JXLLoader requires an ArrayBuffer"));
          return;
        }
        void this._decode(buffer).then((data) => {
          this._applyData(texture, data);
          try {
            onLoad?.(texture);
          } finally {
            this.manager.itemEnd(url);
          }
        }, failure);
      },
      onProgress,
      failure,
    );
    return texture;
  }

  parse(buffer: ArrayBuffer, onLoad: (texture: DataTexture) => void, onError?: (error: unknown) => void): void {
    void this.parseAsync(buffer).then(onLoad, onError);
  }

  async parseAsync(buffer: ArrayBuffer): Promise<DataTexture> {
    const data = await this._decode(buffer);
    const texture = new DataTexture();
    this._applyData(texture, data);
    return texture;
  }

  _applyData(texture: DataTexture, data: DecodedImage): void {
    texture.image = data;
    texture.format = PixelFormat.RGBA;
    texture.type = TextureType.HalfFloat;
    texture.colorSpace = ColorSpace.LinearSRGB;
    texture.minFilter = TextureFilter.Linear;
    texture.magFilter = TextureFilter.Linear;
    texture.flipY = true;
    texture.needsUpdate = true;
  }

  async _decode(buffer: ArrayBuffer): Promise<DecodedImage> {
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    const options = { colorSpace: "srgb-linear", colorType: "float16" };
    const context = canvas.getContext(
      "2d",
      options as CanvasRenderingContext2DSettings,
    ) as unknown as HDRContext | null;
    if (
      context === null ||
      context.getContextAttributes().colorType !== "float16" ||
      !("globalHDRHeadroom" in context)
    ) {
      throw new Error("JXLLoader: Canvas2D float16 storage and globalHDRHeadroom are required.");
    }
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([buffer]));
    try {
      const image = new Image();
      image.src = url;
      await image.decode();
      canvas.width = image.naturalWidth;
      canvas.height = image.naturalHeight;
      context.globalHDRHeadroom = Infinity;
      context.drawImage(image, 0, 0);
      const pixels = context.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height, {
        colorSpace: "srgb-linear",
        pixelFormat: "rgba-float16",
      });
      if (pixels.pixelFormat !== "rgba-float16") {
        throw new Error("JXLLoader: Canvas2D rgba-float16 readback is required.");
      }
      return {
        data: new Uint16Array(pixels.data.buffer, pixels.data.byteOffset, pixels.data.length),
        width: canvas.width,
        height: canvas.height,
      };
    } finally {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      canvas.width = canvas.height = 0;
    }
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/KMZLoader

```typescript
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";
import { Group } from "../../objects/Group";
import { ColladaLoader, type ColladaResult } from "./ColladaLoader";

/** ZIP decoder supplied by the application. */
export interface KMZZipRuntime {
  unzipSync(data: Uint8Array): Record<string, Uint8Array>;
}

/** Loads KMZ archives containing a Collada model and its textures. */
export class KMZLoader extends Loader<ColladaResult | null> {
  zipRuntime: KMZZipRuntime | null = null;

  setZipRuntime(runtime: KMZZipRuntime): this {
    this.zipRuntime = runtime;
    return this;
  }

  override load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (result: ColladaResult | null) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (data) => {
        try {
          onLoad?.(this.parse(data as ArrayBuffer));
        } catch (error) {
          if (onError !== undefined) onError(error);
          else console.error(error);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  parse(data: ArrayBuffer): ColladaResult | null {
    if (this.zipRuntime === null) throw new Error("KMZLoader: ZIP runtime is required.");
    const zip = this.zipRuntime.unzipSync(new Uint8Array(data));
    const urls: string[] = [];
    const manager = new LoadingManager(
      () => {
        for (const url of urls) URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        urls.length = 0;
      },
      undefined,
      (url) => this.manager.itemError(url),
    );
    manager.setURLModifier((url) => {
      const path = Object.keys(zip).find((entry) => entry.endsWith(url));
      if (path === undefined) return url;
      const blob = new Blob([Uint8Array.from(zip[path])], { type: "application/octet-stream" });
      const objectURL = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      urls.push(objectURL);
      return objectURL;
    });
    let model: Uint8Array | undefined;
    if (zip["doc.kml"] !== undefined) {
      const xml = new DOMParser().parseFromString(new TextDecoder().decode(zip["doc.kml"]), "application/xml");
      const href = xml.querySelector("Placemark Model Link href")?.textContent;
      if (href !== null && href !== undefined) model = zip[href];
    } else {
      console.warn("KMZLoader: Missing doc.kml file.");
      const path = Object.keys(zip).find((entry) => entry.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() === "dae");
      if (path !== undefined) model = zip[path];
    }
    if (model === undefined) {
      console.error("KMZLoader: Couldn't find .dae file.");
      return { scene: new Group() };
    }
    const loader = new ColladaLoader(manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    return loader.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(model));
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/KSPLATLoader

````typescript
import { fromHalfFloat } from "../../extras/DataUtils";
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import type { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";

import {
  SH_BAND_COMPONENTS,
  SH_BAND_WORDS,
  createGaussianSplatGeometry,
  createPackedSphericalHarmonicsBand,
  writeColorBytes,
  writeCovariance,
} from "../utils/GaussianSplatUtils";

const HEADER_SIZE_BYTES = 4096;
const SECTION_HEADER_SIZE_BYTES = 1024;
const CURRENT_VERSION_MAJOR = 0;
const CURRENT_VERSION_MINOR = 1;
const MAX_SPLATS = 10000000;
const SH_DEGREE_TO_COMPONENTS = [0, 9, 24, 45];
const SH_BAND_INDEX = [
  null,
  [0, 3, 6, 1, 4, 7, 2, 5, 8],
  [9, 14, 19, 10, 15, 20, 11, 16, 21, 12, 17, 22, 13, 18, 23],
  [24, 31, 38, 25, 32, 39, 26, 33, 40, 27, 34, 41, 28, 35, 42, 29, 36, 43, 30, 37, 44],
];
const COMPRESSION_LEVELS: Record<number, Compression> = {
  0: {
    bytesPerCenter: 12,
    bytesPerScale: 12,
    bytesPerRotation: 16,
    bytesPerColor: 4,
    bytesPerSphericalHarmonicsComponent: 4,
    scaleOffsetBytes: 12,
    rotationOffsetBytes: 24,
    colorOffsetBytes: 40,
    scaleRange: 1,
  },
  1: {
    bytesPerCenter: 6,
    bytesPerScale: 6,
    bytesPerRotation: 8,
    bytesPerColor: 4,
    bytesPerSphericalHarmonicsComponent: 2,
    scaleOffsetBytes: 6,
    rotationOffsetBytes: 12,
    colorOffsetBytes: 20,
    scaleRange: 32767,
  },
  2: {
    bytesPerCenter: 6,
    bytesPerScale: 6,
    bytesPerRotation: 8,
    bytesPerColor: 4,
    bytesPerSphericalHarmonicsComponent: 1,
    scaleOffsetBytes: 6,
    rotationOffsetBytes: 12,
    colorOffsetBytes: 20,
    scaleRange: 32767,
  },
};

type Compression = {
  bytesPerCenter: number;
  bytesPerScale: number;
  bytesPerRotation: number;
  bytesPerColor: number;
  bytesPerSphericalHarmonicsComponent: number;
  scaleOffsetBytes: number;
  rotationOffsetBytes: number;
  colorOffsetBytes: number;
  scaleRange: number;
};
type Header = {
  versionMajor: number;
  versionMinor: number;
  maxSectionCount: number;
  sectionCount: number;
  maxSplatCount: number;
  splatCount: number;
  compressionLevel: number;
  minSphericalHarmonicsCoeff: number;
  maxSphericalHarmonicsCoeff: number;
};
type Section = {
  splatCount: number;
  maxSplatCount: number;
  bucketSize: number;
  bucketCount: number;
  bucketBlockSize: number;
  bucketStorageSizeBytes: number;
  compressionScaleRange: number;
  fullBucketCount: number;
  partiallyFilledBucketCount: number;
  sphericalHarmonicsDegree: number;
};

/**
 * A loader for GaussianSplats3D `.ksplat` files.
 *
 * Decodes splat geometry with optional packed spherical harmonics attributes.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { KSPLATLoader } from "ek3d/addons/loaders/KSPLATLoader";
 * const geometry = await new KSPLATLoader().loadAsync("model.ksplat");
 * ```
 */
export class KSPLATLoader extends Loader<BufferGeometry, string> {
  /**
   * Constructs a new Gaussian splat KSPLAT loader.
   *
   * @param manager - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
  }

  /**
   * Starts loading from the given URL and passes the loaded splat data to
   * the `onLoad()` callback.
   *
   * @param url - The path/URL of the file to be loaded. This can also be a data URI.
   * @param onLoad - Executed when the loading process has been finished.
   * @param onProgress - Executed while the loading is in progress.
   * @param onError - Executed when errors occur.
   */
  override load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (geometry: BufferGeometry) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (buffer) => {
        try {
          if (!(buffer instanceof ArrayBuffer)) throw new TypeError("KSPLATLoader requires array buffer data");
          onLoad?.(this.parse(buffer));
        } catch (e) {
          if (onError) {
            onError(e);
          } else {
            console.error(e);
          }

          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  /**
   * Parses the given `.ksplat` data.
   *
   * @param buffer - The raw KSPLAT file as an array buffer.
   * @return The parsed splat geometry.
   */
  parse(buffer: ArrayBuffer): BufferGeometry {
    if (buffer.byteLength < HEADER_SIZE_BYTES) {
      throw new Error("THREE.KSPLATLoader: Invalid KSPLAT header.");
    }

    const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
    const view = new DataView(buffer);
    const header = parseHeader(view);

    if (header.versionMajor !== CURRENT_VERSION_MAJOR || header.versionMinor < CURRENT_VERSION_MINOR) {
      throw new Error(`THREE.KSPLATLoader: Unsupported KSPLAT version ${header.versionMajor}.${header.versionMinor}.`);
    }

    if (header.compressionLevel < 0 || header.compressionLevel > 2) {
      throw new Error(`THREE.KSPLATLoader: Unsupported KSPLAT compression level ${header.compressionLevel}.`);
    }

    if (header.splatCount > MAX_SPLATS) {
      throw new Error(`THREE.KSPLATLoader: KSPLAT file contains too many splats (${header.splatCount}).`);
    }

    const sectionHeadersOffset = HEADER_SIZE_BYTES;
    const sectionDataOffset = HEADER_SIZE_BYTES + header.maxSectionCount * SECTION_HEADER_SIZE_BYTES;

    if (bytes.byteLength < sectionDataOffset) {
      throw new Error("THREE.KSPLATLoader: Invalid KSPLAT section headers.");
    }

    const compression = COMPRESSION_LEVELS[header.compressionLevel];
    const centers = new Float32Array(header.splatCount * 3);
    const covariances = new Float32Array(header.splatCount * 6);
    const colors = new Uint8ClampedArray(header.splatCount * 4);
    const sphericalHarmonics: Record<string, Uint32Array> = {};
    const sphericalHarmonicsBytes: Record<string, Uint8ClampedArray> = {};
    let splatOffset = 0;
    let sectionBase = sectionDataOffset;

    for (let sectionIndex = 0; sectionIndex < header.maxSectionCount; sectionIndex++) {
      const sectionHeaderOffset = sectionHeadersOffset + sectionIndex * SECTION_HEADER_SIZE_BYTES;
      const section = parseSectionHeader(view, sectionHeaderOffset, compression);
      const shComponents = SH_DEGREE_TO_COMPONENTS[section.sphericalHarmonicsDegree];

      if (shComponents === undefined) {
        throw new Error(
          `THREE.KSPLATLoader: Unsupported KSPLAT spherical harmonics degree ${section.sphericalHarmonicsDegree}.`,
        );
      }

      const bytesPerSplat =
        compression.bytesPerCenter +
        compression.bytesPerScale +
        compression.bytesPerRotation +
        compression.bytesPerColor +
        shComponents * compression.bytesPerSphericalHarmonicsComponent;
      const bucketsMetaDataSizeBytes = section.partiallyFilledBucketCount * 4;
      const bucketsStorageSizeBytes = section.bucketStorageSizeBytes * section.bucketCount + bucketsMetaDataSizeBytes;
      const splatDataStorageSizeBytes = bytesPerSplat * section.maxSplatCount;
      const storageSizeBytes = bucketsStorageSizeBytes + splatDataStorageSizeBytes;

      if (sectionBase + storageSizeBytes > bytes.byteLength) {
        throw new Error("THREE.KSPLATLoader: Invalid KSPLAT byte length.");
      }

      if (section.splatCount > 0) {
        readSection(
          view,
          bytes,
          section,
          compression,
          sectionBase,
          bucketsMetaDataSizeBytes,
          bucketsStorageSizeBytes,
          bytesPerSplat,
          splatOffset,
          centers,
          covariances,
          colors,
          sphericalHarmonics,
          sphericalHarmonicsBytes,
          header,
        );

        splatOffset += section.splatCount;
      }

      sectionBase += storageSizeBytes;
    }

    if (splatOffset !== header.splatCount) {
      throw new Error("THREE.KSPLATLoader: KSPLAT splat count mismatch.");
    }

    return createGaussianSplatGeometry(centers, covariances, colors, sphericalHarmonics);
  }
}

function parseHeader(view: DataView) {
  return {
    versionMajor: view.getUint8(0),
    versionMinor: view.getUint8(1),
    maxSectionCount: view.getUint32(4, true),
    sectionCount: view.getUint32(8, true),
    maxSplatCount: view.getUint32(12, true),
    splatCount: view.getUint32(16, true),
    compressionLevel: view.getUint16(20, true),
    minSphericalHarmonicsCoeff: view.getFloat32(36, true) || -1.5,
    maxSphericalHarmonicsCoeff: view.getFloat32(40, true) || 1.5,
  };
}

function parseSectionHeader(view: DataView, offset: number, compression: Compression) {
  return {
    splatCount: view.getUint32(offset, true),
    maxSplatCount: view.getUint32(offset + 4, true),
    bucketSize: view.getUint32(offset + 8, true),
    bucketCount: view.getUint32(offset + 12, true),
    bucketBlockSize: view.getFloat32(offset + 16, true),
    bucketStorageSizeBytes: view.getUint16(offset + 20, true),
    compressionScaleRange: view.getUint32(offset + 24, true) || compression.scaleRange,
    fullBucketCount: view.getUint32(offset + 32, true),
    partiallyFilledBucketCount: view.getUint32(offset + 36, true),
    sphericalHarmonicsDegree: view.getUint16(offset + 40, true),
  };
}

function readSection(
  view: DataView,
  bytes: Uint8Array,
  section: Section,
  compression: Compression,
  sectionBase: number,
  bucketsMetaDataSizeBytes: number,
  bucketsStorageSizeBytes: number,
  bytesPerSplat: number,
  splatOffset: number,
  centers: Float32Array,
  covariances: Float32Array,
  colors: Uint8ClampedArray,
  sphericalHarmonics: Record<string, Uint32Array>,
  sphericalHarmonicsBytes: Record<string, Uint8ClampedArray>,
  header: Header,
) {
  const bucketsBase = sectionBase + bucketsMetaDataSizeBytes;
  const dataBase = sectionBase + bucketsStorageSizeBytes;
  const fullBucketSplats = section.fullBucketCount * section.bucketSize;
  const compressionScaleFactor = section.bucketBlockSize / 2 / section.compressionScaleRange;
  const sphericalHarmonicsOffset = compression.colorOffsetBytes + compression.bytesPerColor;
  let partialBucketIndex = section.fullBucketCount;
  let partialBucketBase = fullBucketSplats;

  ensureSphericalHarmonics(
    sphericalHarmonics,
    sphericalHarmonicsBytes,
    header.splatCount,
    section.sphericalHarmonicsDegree,
  );

  for (let i = 0; i < section.splatCount; i++) {
    const bucketIndex = getBucketIndex(
      view,
      section,
      sectionBase,
      i,
      fullBucketSplats,
      partialBucketIndex,
      partialBucketBase,
    );

    if (bucketIndex.partialBucketIndex !== undefined) {
      partialBucketIndex = bucketIndex.partialBucketIndex;
      partialBucketBase = bucketIndex.partialBucketBase!;
    }

    const rowOffset = dataBase + i * bytesPerSplat;
    const outIndex = splatOffset + i;
    const i3 = outIndex * 3;

    if (compression.bytesPerCenter === 12) {
      centers[i3] = view.getFloat32(rowOffset, true);
      centers[i3 + 1] = view.getFloat32(rowOffset + 4, true);
      centers[i3 + 2] = view.getFloat32(rowOffset + 8, true);
    } else {
      const bucketBase = bucketsBase + bucketIndex.value * section.bucketStorageSizeBytes;
      centers[i3] =
        (view.getUint16(rowOffset, true) - section.compressionScaleRange) * compressionScaleFactor +
        view.getFloat32(bucketBase, true);
      centers[i3 + 1] =
        (view.getUint16(rowOffset + 2, true) - section.compressionScaleRange) * compressionScaleFactor +
        view.getFloat32(bucketBase + 4, true);
      centers[i3 + 2] =
        (view.getUint16(rowOffset + 4, true) - section.compressionScaleRange) * compressionScaleFactor +
        view.getFloat32(bucketBase + 8, true);
    }

    const sx = readCompressedFloat(view, rowOffset + compression.scaleOffsetBytes, compression.bytesPerScale);
    const sy = readCompressedFloat(
      view,
      rowOffset + compression.scaleOffsetBytes + compression.bytesPerScale / 3,
      compression.bytesPerScale,
    );
    const sz = readCompressedFloat(
      view,
      rowOffset + compression.scaleOffsetBytes + (compression.bytesPerScale / 3) * 2,
      compression.bytesPerScale,
    );
    const qw = readCompressedFloat(view, rowOffset + compression.rotationOffsetBytes, compression.bytesPerRotation);
    const qx = readCompressedFloat(
      view,
      rowOffset + compression.rotationOffsetBytes + compression.bytesPerRotation / 4,
      compression.bytesPerRotation,
    );
    const qy = readCompressedFloat(
      view,
      rowOffset + compression.rotationOffsetBytes + (compression.bytesPerRotation / 4) * 2,
      compression.bytesPerRotation,
    );
    const qz = readCompressedFloat(
      view,
      rowOffset + compression.rotationOffsetBytes + (compression.bytesPerRotation / 4) * 3,
      compression.bytesPerRotation,
    );

    writeCovariance(covariances, outIndex * 6, sx, sy, sz, qx, qy, qz, qw);
    writeColorBytes(
      colors,
      outIndex * 4,
      bytes[rowOffset + compression.colorOffsetBytes],
      bytes[rowOffset + compression.colorOffsetBytes + 1],
      bytes[rowOffset + compression.colorOffsetBytes + 2],
      bytes[rowOffset + compression.colorOffsetBytes + 3],
    );

    for (let degree = 1; degree <= section.sphericalHarmonicsDegree; degree++) {
      writeKSPLATSphericalHarmonicsBand(
        sphericalHarmonicsBytes[`sh${degree}`],
        outIndex,
        SH_BAND_COMPONENTS[degree],
        SH_BAND_WORDS[degree] * 4,
        SH_BAND_INDEX[degree]!,
        view,
        rowOffset + sphericalHarmonicsOffset,
        compression.bytesPerSphericalHarmonicsComponent,
        header,
      );
    }
  }
}

function ensureSphericalHarmonics(
  sphericalHarmonics: Record<string, Uint32Array>,
  sphericalHarmonicsBytes: Record<string, Uint8ClampedArray>,
  count: number,
  degree: number,
) {
  for (let i = 1; i <= degree; i++) {
    if (sphericalHarmonics[`sh${i}`] === undefined) {
      const band = createPackedSphericalHarmonicsBand(count, i);
      sphericalHarmonics[`sh${i}`] = band.packed;
      sphericalHarmonicsBytes[`sh${i}`] = band.bytes;
    }
  }
}

function writeKSPLATSphericalHarmonicsBand(
  target: Uint8ClampedArray,
  index: number,
  bandComponents: number,
  byteStride: number,
  componentIndexes: number[],
  view: DataView,
  rowOffset: number,
  bytesPerComponent: number,
  header: Header,
) {
  const targetOffset = index * byteStride;

  for (let i = 0; i < bandComponents; i++) {
    target[targetOffset + i] =
      readCompressedSphericalHarmonic(
        view,
        rowOffset + componentIndexes[i] * bytesPerComponent,
        bytesPerComponent,
        header,
      ) *
        128 +
      128;
  }
}

function getBucketIndex(
  view: DataView,
  section: Section,
  sectionBase: number,
  splatIndex: number,
  fullBucketSplats: number,
  partialBucketIndex: number,
  partialBucketBase: number,
) {
  if (section.bucketCount === 0) {
    return { value: 0 };
  }

  if (splatIndex < fullBucketSplats) {
    return { value: Math.floor(splatIndex / section.bucketSize) };
  }

  while (partialBucketIndex < section.bucketCount) {
    const partialIndex = partialBucketIndex - section.fullBucketCount;
    const bucketLength = view.getUint32(sectionBase + partialIndex * 4, true);

    if (splatIndex < partialBucketBase + bucketLength) {
      return { value: partialBucketIndex, partialBucketIndex, partialBucketBase };
    }

    partialBucketIndex++;
    partialBucketBase += bucketLength;
  }

  throw new Error("THREE.KSPLATLoader: Invalid KSPLAT bucket data.");
}

function readCompressedFloat(view: DataView, offset: number, bytesPerVector: number) {
  if (bytesPerVector === 12 || bytesPerVector === 16) {
    return view.getFloat32(offset, true);
  }

  return fromHalfFloat(view.getUint16(offset, true));
}

function readCompressedSphericalHarmonic(view: DataView, offset: number, bytesPerComponent: number, header: Header) {
  if (bytesPerComponent === 4) {
    return view.getFloat32(offset, true);
  }

  if (bytesPerComponent === 2) {
    return fromHalfFloat(view.getUint16(offset, true));
  }

  const t = view.getUint8(offset) / 255;

  return (
    header.minSphericalHarmonicsCoeff + t * (header.maxSphericalHarmonicsCoeff - header.minSphericalHarmonicsCoeff)
  );
}
````

/**
 * Minimal KTX 2.0 container reader and the subset of Khronos constants the
 * ({@link https://registry.khronos.org/KTX/specs/2.0/ktx-2.0.html|KTX 2.0})

/** One parsed mip level: `levelData` aliases the source buffer. */
export interface KTX2Level {
  levelData: Uint8Array;
  uncompressedByteLength: number;
}

/** Basis Universal supercompression global data block (`KTX2Loader` only carries it). */
export interface KTX2GlobalData {

  selectorCount: number;
  imageDescs: {
    imageFlags: number;
    rgbSliceByteOffset: number;
    rgbSliceByteLength: number;
    alphaSliceByteOffset: number;
    alphaSliceByteLength: number;
  }[];

/** One DFD sample. */
export interface KTX2DFDSample {

  bitLength: number;
  channelType: number;
  samplePosition: number[];
  sampleLower: number;
  sampleUpper: number;
}

/** Basic data format descriptor block (`KHR_df2` texture metadata). */
export interface KTX2DFD {
  vendorId: number;
  descriptorType: number;
  versionNumber: number;
  colorModel: number;
  colorPrimaries: number;
  transferFunction: number;
  flags: number;
  texelBlockDimension: number[];
  bytesPlane: number[];
  samples: KTX2DFDSample[];
}

/** Parsed KTX 2.0 container; the shape `KTX2Loader` consumes. */
export interface KTX2Container {
  vkFormat: number;
  typeSize: number;
  pixelWidth: number;
  pixelHeight: number;
  pixelDepth: number;
  layerCount: number;
  faceCount: number;
  levelCount: number;
  supercompressionScheme: number;
  levels: KTX2Level[];
  dataFormatDescriptor: KTX2DFD[];
  keyValue: Record<string, string>;
  globalData: KTX2GlobalData | null;
}

const MAGIC = [0xab, 0x4b, 0x54, 0x58, 0x20, 0x32, 0x30, 0xbb, 0xd, 0xa, 0x1a, 0xa];

class ByteCursor {
  dataView: DataView;
  littleEndian: boolean;
  offset: number;

  constructor(data: Uint8Array, offset: number, length: number, littleEndian: boolean) {
    this.dataView = new DataView(data.buffer, data.byteOffset + offset, length);
    this.littleEndian = littleEndian;
    this.offset = 0;
  }

  _nextUint8(): number {
    const value = this.dataView.getUint8(this.offset);
    this.offset += 1;
    return value;
  }

  _nextUint16(): number {
    const value = this.dataView.getUint16(this.offset, this.littleEndian);
    this.offset += 2;
    return value;
  }

  _nextUint32(): number {
    const value = this.dataView.getUint32(this.offset, this.littleEndian);
    this.offset += 4;
    return value;
  }

  _nextInt32(): number {
    const value = this.dataView.getInt32(this.offset, this.littleEndian);
    this.offset += 4;
    return value;
  }

  _nextUint64(): number {
    const value =
      this.dataView.getUint32(this.offset, this.littleEndian) +
      2 ** 32 * this.dataView.getUint32(this.offset + 4, this.littleEndian);
    this.offset += 8;
    return value;
  }

  _skip(length: number): this {
    this.offset += length;
    return this;
  }

  _scan(length: number, terminator: number = 0): Uint8Array {
    const start = this.offset;
    let result = 0;
    while (this.dataView.getUint8(this.offset) !== terminator && result < length) {
      result++;
      this.offset++;
    }
    if (result < length) this.offset++;
    return new Uint8Array(this.dataView.buffer, this.dataView.byteOffset + start, result);
  }
}
/** Parses a KTX 2.0 container from the given bytes (the `read()` contract). */
export function read(data: Uint8Array): KTX2Container {
  for (let i = 0; i < MAGIC.length; i++) {
    if (data[i] !== MAGIC[i]) throw new Error("Missing KTX 2.0 identifier.");
  }

  const container: KTX2Container = {
    vkFormat: 0,
    typeSize: 1,
    pixelWidth: 0,
    pixelHeight: 0,
    pixelDepth: 0,
    layerCount: 0,
    faceCount: 1,
    levelCount: 0,
    supercompressionScheme: 0,
    levels: [],
    dataFormatDescriptor: [
      {
        vendorId: 0,
        descriptorType: 0,
        versionNumber: 2,
        colorModel: 0,
        colorPrimaries: 1,
        transferFunction: 2,
        flags: 0,
        texelBlockDimension: [0, 0, 0, 0],
        bytesPlane: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
        samples: [],
      },
    ],
    keyValue: {},
    globalData: null,
  };

  const header = new ByteCursor(data, MAGIC.length, 68, true); // 9 u32 + 4 u32 + 2 u64
  container.vkFormat = header._nextUint32();
  container.typeSize = header._nextUint32();
  container.pixelWidth = header._nextUint32();
  container.pixelHeight = header._nextUint32();
  container.pixelDepth = header._nextUint32();
  container.layerCount = header._nextUint32();
  container.faceCount = header._nextUint32();
  container.levelCount = header._nextUint32();
  container.supercompressionScheme = header._nextUint32();
  const dfdByteOffset = header._nextUint32();
  const dfdByteLength = header._nextUint32();
  const kvpByteOffset = header._nextUint32();
  const kvpByteLength = header._nextUint32();

  const sgdByteOffset = header._nextUint64();
  const sgdByteLength = header._nextUint64();

  // Level index: 3 * max(levelCount, 1) u64 values.
  const levelIndex = new ByteCursor(data, MAGIC.length + 68, 3 * Math.max(container.levelCount, 1) * 8, true);
  for (let i = 0, levelCount = Math.max(container.levelCount, 1); i < levelCount; i++) {
    container.levels.push({
      levelData: new Uint8Array(data.buffer, data.byteOffset + levelIndex._nextUint64(), levelIndex._nextUint64()),
      uncompressedByteLength: levelIndex._nextUint64(),
    });
  }

  // Data format descriptor.
  if (dfdByteLength > 0) {
    const dfd = new ByteCursor(data, dfdByteOffset, dfdByteLength, true);
    dfd._skip(4); // total size of the descriptor section
    const vendorId = dfd._nextUint16();
    const descriptorType = dfd._nextUint16();
    const versionNumber = dfd._nextUint16();
    const descriptorBlockSize = dfd._nextUint16();
    const dfdBlock: KTX2DFD = {
      vendorId,
      descriptorType,
      versionNumber,
      colorModel: dfd._nextUint8(),
      colorPrimaries: dfd._nextUint8(),
      transferFunction: dfd._nextUint8(),
      flags: dfd._nextUint8(),
      texelBlockDimension: [dfd._nextUint8(), dfd._nextUint8(), dfd._nextUint8(), dfd._nextUint8()],
      bytesPlane: [
        dfd._nextUint8(),
        dfd._nextUint8(),
        dfd._nextUint8(),
        dfd._nextUint8(),
        dfd._nextUint8(),
        dfd._nextUint8(),
        dfd._nextUint8(),
        dfd._nextUint8(),
      ],
      samples: [],
    };
    const sampleCount = (descriptorBlockSize / 4 - 6) / 4;
    for (let i = 0; i < sampleCount; i++) {
      const sample: KTX2DFDSample = {
        bitOffset: dfd._nextUint16(),
        bitLength: dfd._nextUint8(),
        channelType: dfd._nextUint8(),
        samplePosition: [dfd._nextUint8(), dfd._nextUint8(), dfd._nextUint8(), dfd._nextUint8()],
        sampleLower: Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY,
        sampleUpper: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
      };
      if (sample.channelType & KHR_DF_SAMPLE_DATATYPE_SIGNED) {
        sample.sampleLower = dfd._nextInt32();
        sample.sampleUpper = dfd._nextInt32();
      } else {
        sample.sampleLower = dfd._nextUint32();
        sample.sampleUpper = dfd._nextUint32();
      }
      dfdBlock.samples.push(sample);
    }
    container.dataFormatDescriptor.length = 0;
    container.dataFormatDescriptor.push(dfdBlock);
    dfd._skip(descriptorBlockSize - 28 - sampleCount * 16);
  }

  // Key/value metadata.
  if (kvpByteLength > 0) {
    const kvp = new ByteCursor(data, kvpByteOffset, kvpByteLength, true);
    while (kvp.offset < kvpByteLength) {
      const keyAndValueByteLength = kvp._nextUint32();
      if (keyAndValueByteLength === 0) break;
      const key = kvp._scan(keyAndValueByteLength);
      const value = new Uint8Array(
        data.buffer,
        data.byteOffset + kvpByteOffset + kvp.offset,
        keyAndValueByteLength - key.byteLength - 1,
      );
      kvp.offset += keyAndValueByteLength - key.byteLength - 1;
      const keyText = new TextDecoder().decode(key);
      const valueText = new TextDecoder().decode(value);
      container.keyValue[keyText] = /^ktx/i.test(keyText)
        ? valueText.substring(0, valueText.lastIndexOf("\x00"))
        : valueText;
      kvp._skip(keyAndValueByteLength % 4 ? 4 - (keyAndValueByteLength % 4) : 0);
    }
  }

  // Basis Universal supercompression global data.
  if (sgdByteLength > 0) {
    const sgd = new ByteCursor(data, sgdByteOffset, sgdByteLength, true);
    const endpointCount = sgd._nextUint16();
    const selectorCount = sgd._nextUint16();
    const endpointsByteLength = sgd._nextUint32();
    const selectorsByteLength = sgd._nextUint32();
    const tablesByteLength = sgd._nextUint32();
    const extendedByteLength = sgd._nextUint32();
    const imageDescs = [];
    for (let i = 0, levelCount = Math.max(container.levelCount, 1); i < levelCount; i++) {
      imageDescs.push({
        imageFlags: sgd._nextUint32(),
        rgbSliceByteOffset: sgd._nextUint32(),
        rgbSliceByteLength: sgd._nextUint32(),
        alphaSliceByteOffset: sgd._nextUint32(),
        alphaSliceByteLength: sgd._nextUint32(),
      });
    }
    const globalDataStart = sgdByteOffset + sgd.offset;
    const endpointsStart = globalDataStart;
    const selectorsStart = endpointsStart + endpointsByteLength;
    const tablesStart = selectorsStart + selectorsByteLength;
    const extendedStart = tablesStart + tablesByteLength;
    container.globalData = {
      endpointCount,
      selectorCount,
      imageDescs,
      endpointsData: new Uint8Array(data.buffer, data.byteOffset + endpointsStart, endpointsByteLength),
      selectorsData: new Uint8Array(data.buffer, data.byteOffset + selectorsStart, selectorsByteLength),
      tablesData: new Uint8Array(data.buffer, data.byteOffset + tablesStart, tablesByteLength),
      extendedData: new Uint8Array(data.buffer, data.byteOffset + extendedStart, extendedByteLength),
    };
  }

  return container;
}
```

let _activeLoaders = 0;
