    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (text: unknown) => {
        try {
          const geometry = this.parse(text as ArrayBuffer);

          if (onLoad !== undefined) onLoad(geometry);
        } catch (e) {
          if (onError !== undefined) {
            onError(e);
          } else {
            console.error(e);
          }

          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  /**
   * Sets a property name mapping that maps default property names
   * to custom ones. For example, the following maps the properties
   * "diffuse_(red|green|blue)" in the file to standard color names.
   *
   * ```ts
   * loader.setPropertyNameMapping( {
   *   diffuse_red: "red",
   *   diffuse_green: "green",
   *   diffuse_blue: "blue"
   * } );
   * ```
   *
   * @param mapping - The mapping dictionary.
   */
  setPropertyNameMapping(mapping: Record<string, string>): void {
    this.propertyNameMapping = mapping;
  }

  /**
   * Custom properties outside of the defaults for position, uv, normal
   * and color attributes can be added using the setCustomPropertyNameMapping method.
   * For example, the following maps the element properties "custom_property_a"
   * and "custom_property_b" to an attribute "customAttribute" with an item size of 2.
   * Attribute item sizes are set from the number of element properties in the property array.
   *
   * ```ts
   * loader.setCustomPropertyNameMapping( {
   *   customAttribute: ["custom_property_a", "custom_property_b"],
   * } );
   * ```
   *
   * @param mapping - The mapping dictionary.
   */
  setCustomPropertyNameMapping(mapping: Record<string, string[]>): void {
    this.customPropertyMapping = mapping;
  }

  /**
   * Parses the given PLY data and returns the resulting geometry.
   *
   * @param data - The raw PLY data as an array buffer or, for ASCII files, as text.
   * @return The parsed geometry.
   */
  parse(data: ArrayBuffer | string): BufferGeometry {
    const propertyNameMapping = this.propertyNameMapping;
    const customPropertyMapping = this.customPropertyMapping;

    function parseHeader(text: string, headerLength: number = 0): PlyHeader {
      const patternHeader = /^ply([\s\S]*)end_header(\r\n|\r|\n)/;
      let headerText = "";
      const result = patternHeader.exec(text);

      if (result !== null) {
        headerText = result[1];
      }

      const header: PlyHeader = {
        comments: [],
        elements: [],
        headerLength: headerLength,
        objInfo: "",
      };

      const lines = headerText.split(/\r\n|\r|\n/);
      let currentElement: PlyElement | undefined;

      function makeElementProperty(propertyValues: string[], propertyNameMapping: Record<string, string>): PlyProperty {
        const type = propertyValues[0] as PlyProperty["type"];

        if (type === "list") {
          const property: PlyProperty = {
            type,
            name: propertyValues[3],
            countType: propertyValues[1] as PlyScalarType,
            itemType: propertyValues[2] as PlyScalarType,
          };

          if (property.name in propertyNameMapping) {
            property.name = propertyNameMapping[property.name];
          }

          return property;
        }

        const property: PlyProperty = { type, name: propertyValues[1] };

        if (property.name in propertyNameMapping) {
          property.name = propertyNameMapping[property.name];
        }

        return property;
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
        let line = lines[i];
        line = line.trim();

        if (line === "") continue;

        const lineValues = line.split(/\s+/);
        const lineType = lineValues.shift() as string;
        line = lineValues.join(" ");

        switch (lineType) {
          case "format":
            header.format = lineValues[0];
            header.version = lineValues[1];

            break;

          case "comment":
            header.comments.push(line);

            break;

          case "element":
            if (currentElement !== undefined) {
              header.elements.push(currentElement);
            }

            currentElement = {
              name: lineValues[0],
              count: parseInt(lineValues[1]),
              properties: [],
            };

            break;

          case "property":
            currentElement!.properties.push(makeElementProperty(lineValues, propertyNameMapping));

            break;

          case "obj_info":
            header.objInfo = line;

            break;

          default:
            console.log("unhandled", lineType, lineValues);
        }
      }

      if (currentElement !== undefined) {
        header.elements.push(currentElement);
      }

      return header;
    }

    function parseASCIINumber(n: string, type: PlyScalarType): number {
      switch (type) {
        case "char":
        case "uchar":
        case "short":
        case "ushort":
        case "int":
        case "uint":
        case "int8":
        case "uint8":
        case "int16":
        case "uint16":
        case "int32":
        case "uint32":
          return parseInt(n);

        case "float":
        case "double":
        case "float32":
        case "float64":
          return parseFloat(n);

        // The header may name an unknown type; upstream leaves such values undefined, which
        // typed arrays and list loops treat exactly like NaN.
        default:
          return Number.NaN;
      }
    }

    function parseASCIIElement(properties: PlyProperty[], tokens: ArrayStream): PlyElementValues | null {
      const element: PlyElementValues = {};

      for (let i = 0; i < properties.length; i++) {
        if (tokens.empty()) return null;

        const property = properties[i];

        if (property.type === "list") {
          const list: number[] = [];
          const n = parseASCIINumber(tokens.next(), property.countType);

          for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (tokens.empty()) return null;

            list.push(parseASCIINumber(tokens.next(), property.itemType));
          }

          element[property.name] = list;
        } else {
          element[property.name] = parseASCIINumber(tokens.next(), property.type);
        }
      }

      return element;
    }

    function createBuffer(): PlyBuffer {
      const buffer: PlyBuffer = {
        indices: [],
        vertices: [],
        normals: [],
        uvs: [],
        faceVertexUvs: [],
        colors: [],
        faceVertexColors: [],
        descriptors: {},
        custom: {},
      };

      for (const customProperty of Object.keys(customPropertyMapping)) {
        buffer.custom[customProperty] = [];
      }

      return buffer;
    }

    function getBufferAttributeClass(type: PlyScalarType): BufferAttributeConstructor {
      switch (type) {
        case "int8":
        case "char":
          return Int8BufferAttribute;
        case "uint8":
        case "uchar":
          return Uint8BufferAttribute;
        case "int16":
        case "short":
          return Int16BufferAttribute;
        case "uint16":
        case "ushort":
          return Uint16BufferAttribute;
        case "int32":
        case "int":
          return Int32BufferAttribute;
        case "uint32":
        case "uint":
          return Uint32BufferAttribute;
        case "float32":
        case "float":
          return Float32BufferAttribute;
        case "float64":
        case "double":
          return Float64BufferAttribute;
        default:
          throw new TypeError(`PLYLoader: Unsupported attribute type "${String(type)}".`);
      }
    }

    function getColorScale(type: PlyScalarType): number {
      switch (type) {
        case "uchar":
        case "uint8":
          return 1 / 255;
        case "ushort":
        case "uint16":
          return 1 / 65535;
        case "float":
        case "float32":
        case "double":
        case "float64":
          return 1;
        default:
          return 1 / 255;
      }
    }

    function isFloatType(type: PlyScalarType): boolean {
      return type === "float" || type === "float32" || type === "double" || type === "float64";
    }

    function getAttributeDescriptor(properties: PlyProperty[]): PlyElementDescriptor {
      function findProperty(names: string[]): PlyProperty | null {
        for (const name of names) {
          const property = properties.find((p) => p.name === name);
          if (property) return property;
        }

        return null;
      }

      // property lookup

      const x = findProperty(["x", "px", "posx"]);
      const y = findProperty(["y", "py", "posy"]);
      const z = findProperty(["z", "pz", "posz"]);
      const nx = findProperty(["nx", "normalx"]);
      const ny = findProperty(["ny", "normaly"]);
      const nz = findProperty(["nz", "normalz"]);
      const s = findProperty(["s", "u", "texture_u", "tx"]);
      const t = findProperty(["t", "v", "texture_v", "ty"]);
      const r = findProperty(["red", "diffuse_red", "r", "diffuse_r"]);
      const g = findProperty(["green", "diffuse_green", "g", "diffuse_g"]);
      const b = findProperty(["blue", "diffuse_blue", "b", "diffuse_b"]);
      const texcoord = findProperty(["texcoord"]);

      // custom property lookup

      const custom: Record<string, { type: PlyScalarType; usage: boolean }> = {};

      for (const customAttr of Object.keys(customPropertyMapping)) {
        const propNames = customPropertyMapping[customAttr];
        const matched = propNames.map((name) => properties.find((p) => p.name === name));
        const types = matched.filter((p) => p !== undefined).map((p) => p.type);
        const uniform = types.length > 0 && types.every((type) => type === types[0]);

        custom[customAttr] = {
          type: uniform ? (types[0] as PlyScalarType) : "float32",
          usage: matched.every((p) => p !== undefined),
        };
      }

      // build descriptor

      return {
        position: {
          names: [x ? x.name : "x", y ? y.name : "y", z ? z.name : "z"],
          type: x ? (x.type as PlyScalarType) : "float32",
          usage: !!(x && y && z),
        },
        normal: {
          names: [nx ? nx.name : "nx", ny ? ny.name : "ny", nz ? nz.name : "nz"],
          type: nx ? (nx.type as PlyScalarType) : "float32",
          usage: !!(nx && ny && nz),
        },
        uv: {
          names: [s ? s.name : "s", t ? t.name : "t"],
          type: s ? (s.type as PlyScalarType) : "float32",
          usage: !!(s && t),
        },
        texcoord: {
          // Upstream reads `itemType` even when a property named texcoord is not a list; keep that
          // runtime undefined so the later UV class lookup fails the same way.
          type: texcoord ? (texcoord as { itemType: PlyScalarType }).itemType : "float32",
          usage: !!texcoord,
        },
        color: {
          names: [r ? r.name : "red", g ? g.name : "green", b ? b.name : "blue"],
          type: r ? (r.type as PlyScalarType) : "uchar",
          usage: !!(r && g && b),
        },
        custom: custom,
      };
    }

    function parseASCII(text: string, header: PlyHeader): BufferGeometry {
      // PLY ascii format specification, as per http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PLY_(file_format)

      const buffer = createBuffer();

      const patternBody = /end_header\s+(\S[\s\S]*\S|\S)\s*$/;
      let body: string[];

      const matches = patternBody.exec(text);

      if (matches !== null) {
        body = matches[1].split(/\s+/);
      } else {
        body = [];
      }

      const tokens = new ArrayStream(body);

      loop: for (let i = 0; i < header.elements.length; i++) {
        const elementDesc = header.elements[i];
        const attributeDescriptor = getAttributeDescriptor(elementDesc.properties);
        buffer.descriptors[elementDesc.name] = attributeDescriptor;

        for (let j = 0; j < elementDesc.count; j++) {
          const element = parseASCIIElement(elementDesc.properties, tokens);

          if (!element) break loop;

          handleElement(buffer, elementDesc.name, element, attributeDescriptor);
        }
      }

      return postProcess(buffer);
    }

    function postProcess(buffer: PlyBuffer): BufferGeometry {
      let geometry = new BufferGeometry();

      const vertexDescriptor = buffer.descriptors.vertex;

      // mandatory buffer data

      if (buffer.indices.length > 0) {
        geometry.setIndex(buffer.indices);
      }

      const PositionClass = getBufferAttributeClass(vertexDescriptor ? vertexDescriptor.position.type : "float32");
      geometry.setAttribute("position", new PositionClass(buffer.vertices, 3));

      // optional buffer data

      if (buffer.normals.length > 0) {
        const NormalClass = getBufferAttributeClass(vertexDescriptor!.normal.type);
        geometry.setAttribute("normal", new NormalClass(buffer.normals, 3));
      }

      if (buffer.uvs.length > 0) {
        const UvClass = getBufferAttributeClass(vertexDescriptor!.uv.type);
        geometry.setAttribute("uv", new UvClass(buffer.uvs, 2));
      }

      if (buffer.colors.length > 0) {
        const colorType = vertexDescriptor!.color.type;
        const normalized = !isFloatType(colorType);

        const ColorClass = getBufferAttributeClass(colorType);
        geometry.setAttribute("color", new ColorClass(buffer.colors, 3, normalized));
      }

      // custom buffer data

      for (const customProperty of Object.keys(customPropertyMapping)) {
        if (buffer.custom[customProperty].length > 0) {
          const CustomClass = getBufferAttributeClass(vertexDescriptor!.custom[customProperty].type);
          geometry.setAttribute(
            customProperty,
            new CustomClass(buffer.custom[customProperty], customPropertyMapping[customProperty].length),
          );
        }
      }

      if (buffer.faceVertexUvs.length > 0 || buffer.faceVertexColors.length > 0) {
        const faceDescriptor = buffer.descriptors.face!;

        geometry = geometry.toNonIndexed();

        if (buffer.faceVertexUvs.length > 0) {
          const UvClass = getBufferAttributeClass(faceDescriptor.texcoord.type);
          geometry.setAttribute("uv", new UvClass(buffer.faceVertexUvs, 2));
        }

        if (buffer.faceVertexColors.length > 0) {
          const colorType = faceDescriptor.color.type;
          const normalized = !isFloatType(colorType);

          const ColorClass = getBufferAttributeClass(colorType);
          geometry.setAttribute("color", new ColorClass(buffer.faceVertexColors, 3, normalized));
        }
      }

      geometry.computeBoundingSphere();

      return geometry;
    }

    function handleElement(
      buffer: PlyBuffer,
      elementName: string,
      element: PlyElementValues,
      attributeDescriptor: PlyElementDescriptor,
    ): void {
      if (elementName === "vertex") {
        const { position, normal, uv, color } = attributeDescriptor;

        if (position.usage) {
          buffer.vertices.push(
            element[position.names[0]] as number,
            element[position.names[1]] as number,
            element[position.names[2]] as number,
          );
        }

        if (normal.usage) {
          buffer.normals.push(
            element[normal.names[0]] as number,
            element[normal.names[1]] as number,
            element[normal.names[2]] as number,
          );
        }

        if (uv.usage) {
          buffer.uvs.push(element[uv.names[0]] as number, element[uv.names[1]] as number);
        }

        if (color.usage) {
          const scale = getColorScale(color.type);
          const isFloat = isFloatType(color.type);

          // convert to float for color space conversion

          _color.setRGB(
            (element[color.names[0]] as number) * scale,
            (element[color.names[1]] as number) * scale,
            (element[color.names[2]] as number) * scale,
            ColorSpace.SRGB,
          );

          // convert back to original type

          const invScale = 1 / scale;

          buffer.colors.push(
            isFloat ? _color.r : Math.round(_color.r * invScale),
            isFloat ? _color.g : Math.round(_color.g * invScale),
            isFloat ? _color.b : Math.round(_color.b * invScale),
          );
        }

        for (const customProperty of Object.keys(customPropertyMapping)) {
          for (const elementProperty of customPropertyMapping[customProperty]) {
            buffer.custom[customProperty].push(element[elementProperty] as number);
          }
        }
      } else if (elementName === "face") {
        const vertexIndices = (element["vertex_indices"] || element["vertex_index"]) as number[]; // issue #9338
        const texcoord = element["texcoord"] as number[] | undefined;

        if (vertexIndices.length === 3) {
          buffer.indices.push(vertexIndices[0], vertexIndices[1], vertexIndices[2]);

          if (texcoord && texcoord.length === 6) {
            buffer.faceVertexUvs.push(texcoord[0], texcoord[1]);
            buffer.faceVertexUvs.push(texcoord[2], texcoord[3]);
            buffer.faceVertexUvs.push(texcoord[4], texcoord[5]);
          }
        } else if (vertexIndices.length === 4) {
          // according to the spec, quads need to be split along a specific rule
          // 4 0 1 2 3 results in 0,1,2 and 0,2,3

          buffer.indices.push(vertexIndices[0], vertexIndices[1], vertexIndices[2]);
          buffer.indices.push(vertexIndices[0], vertexIndices[2], vertexIndices[3]);

          if (texcoord && texcoord.length === 8) {
            buffer.faceVertexUvs.push(texcoord[0], texcoord[1]);
            buffer.faceVertexUvs.push(texcoord[2], texcoord[3]);
            buffer.faceVertexUvs.push(texcoord[4], texcoord[5]);
            buffer.faceVertexUvs.push(texcoord[0], texcoord[1]);
            buffer.faceVertexUvs.push(texcoord[4], texcoord[5]);
            buffer.faceVertexUvs.push(texcoord[6], texcoord[7]);
          }
        }

        // face colors

        const { color } = attributeDescriptor;

        if (color.usage) {
          // convert to float for color space conversion

          const scale = getColorScale(color.type);

          _color.setRGB(
            (element[color.names[0]] as number) * scale,
            (element[color.names[1]] as number) * scale,
            (element[color.names[2]] as number) * scale,
            ColorSpace.SRGB,
          );

          // convert back to original type

          const invScale = 1 / scale;

          const r = _color.r * invScale;
          const g = _color.g * invScale;
          const b = _color.b * invScale;

          buffer.faceVertexColors.push(r, g, b);
          buffer.faceVertexColors.push(r, g, b);
          buffer.faceVertexColors.push(r, g, b);

          if (vertexIndices.length === 4) {
            buffer.faceVertexColors.push(r, g, b);
            buffer.faceVertexColors.push(r, g, b);
            buffer.faceVertexColors.push(r, g, b);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    function binaryReadElement(
      at: number,
      properties: PlyProperty[],
      readers: BinaryPropertyReaders[],
    ): [PlyElementValues, number] {
      const element: PlyElementValues = {};
      let read = 0;

      for (let i = 0; i < properties.length; i++) {
        const property = properties[i];
        const propertyReaders = readers[i];
        const valueReader = propertyReaders.value;

        if (property.type === "list") {
          const list: number[] = [];

          const countReader = propertyReaders.count!;

          const n = countReader.read(at + read);
          read += countReader.size;

          for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            list.push(valueReader.read(at + read));
            read += valueReader.size;
          }

          element[property.name] = list;
        } else {
          element[property.name] = valueReader.read(at + read);
          read += valueReader.size;
        }
      }

      return [element, read];
    }

    function setPropertyBinaryReaders(
      properties: PlyProperty[],
      body: DataView,
      littleEndian: boolean,
    ): BinaryPropertyReaders[] {
      function getBinaryReader(type: PlyScalarType): BinaryReader {
        switch (type) {
          // correspondences for non-specific length types here match rply:
          case "int8":
          case "char":
            return { read: (at: number) => body.getInt8(at), size: 1 };
          case "uint8":
          case "uchar":
            return { read: (at: number) => body.getUint8(at), size: 1 };
          case "int16":
          case "short":
            return { read: (at: number) => body.getInt16(at, littleEndian), size: 2 };
          case "uint16":
          case "ushort":
            return { read: (at: number) => body.getUint16(at, littleEndian), size: 2 };
          case "int32":
          case "int":
            return { read: (at: number) => body.getInt32(at, littleEndian), size: 4 };
          case "uint32":
          case "uint":
            return { read: (at: number) => body.getUint32(at, littleEndian), size: 4 };
          case "float32":
          case "float":
            return { read: (at: number) => body.getFloat32(at, littleEndian), size: 4 };
          case "float64":
          case "double":
            return { read: (at: number) => body.getFloat64(at, littleEndian), size: 8 };
          default:
            throw new TypeError(`PLYLoader: Unsupported binary type "${String(type)}".`);
        }
      }

      return properties.map((property) =>
        property.type === "list"
          ? { count: getBinaryReader(property.countType), value: getBinaryReader(property.itemType) }
          : { value: getBinaryReader(property.type) },
      );
    }

    function parseBinary(bytes: ArrayBuffer, header: PlyHeader): BufferGeometry {
      const buffer = createBuffer();

      const littleEndian = header.format === "binary_little_endian";
      const body = new DataView(bytes, header.headerLength);
      let loc = 0;

      for (let currentElement = 0; currentElement < header.elements.length; currentElement++) {
        const elementDesc = header.elements[currentElement];
        const properties = elementDesc.properties;
        const attributeDescriptor = getAttributeDescriptor(properties);
        buffer.descriptors[elementDesc.name] = attributeDescriptor;

        const readers = setPropertyBinaryReaders(properties, body, littleEndian);

        for (let currentElementCount = 0; currentElementCount < elementDesc.count; currentElementCount++) {
          const result = binaryReadElement(loc, properties, readers);
          loc += result[1];
          const element = result[0];

          handleElement(buffer, elementDesc.name, element, attributeDescriptor);
        }
      }

      return postProcess(buffer);
    }

    function extractHeaderText(bytes: Uint8Array): { headerText: string; headerLength: number } {
      let i = 0;
      let cont = true;

      let line = "";
      const lines: string[] = [];

      const startLine = new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.subarray(0, 5));
      const hasCRNL = startLine.startsWith("ply\r\n");

      do {
        const c = String.fromCharCode(bytes[i++]);

        if (c !== "\n" && c !== "\r") {
          line += c;
        } else {
          if (line === "end_header") cont = false;
          if (line !== "") {
            lines.push(line);
            line = "";
          }
        }
      } while (cont && i < bytes.length);

      // ascii section using \r\n as line endings
      if (hasCRNL === true) i++;

      return { headerText: lines.join("\r") + "\r", headerLength: i };
    }

    let geometry: BufferGeometry;

    if (data instanceof ArrayBuffer) {
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(data);
      const { headerText, headerLength } = extractHeaderText(bytes);
      const header = parseHeader(headerText, headerLength);

      if (header.format === "ascii") {
        const text = new TextDecoder().decode(bytes);

        geometry = parseASCII(text, header);
      } else {
        geometry = parseBinary(data, header);
      }
    } else {
      geometry = parseASCII(data, parseHeader(data));
    }

    return geometry;
  }
}

/** PLY `double`/`float64` data stays 64-bit, matching upstream. */
class Float64BufferAttribute extends BufferAttribute {
  constructor(array: number[], itemSize: number, normalized?: boolean) {
    super(new Float64Array(array), itemSize, normalized);
  }
}

class ArrayStream {
  arr: string[];
  i: number;

  constructor(arr: string[]) {
    this.arr = arr;
    this.i = 0;
  }

  empty(): boolean {
    return this.i >= this.arr.length;
  }

  next(): string {
    return this.arr[this.i++];
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/loaders/PVRLoader

````typescript
import { CompressedTextureLoader } from "../../loaders/CompressedTextureLoader";
import type { CompressedTextureData } from "../../loaders/CompressedTextureLoader";
import type { CompressedTextureMipmap } from "../../textures/CompressedTexture";
import type { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";
import { PixelFormat } from "../../constants";

const HEADER_LENGTH_INT = 13;

interface PvrDatas {
  buffer: ArrayBuffer;
  header: Uint32Array;
  dataPtr?: number;
  bpp?: number;
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  numSurfaces?: number;
  numMipmaps?: number;
  isCubemap?: boolean;
}

/**
 * A loader for the PVRTC texture compression format in PVR v2 and v3 containers.
 *
 * Unsupported containers and format codes throw during parsing, so a driver without PVRTC
 * support reports a failure through the loading manager instead of rendering blank geometry.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { PVRLoader } from "ek3d/addons/loaders/PVRLoader";
 * import { ColorSpace } from "ek3d/constants";
 *
 * const map = await new PVRLoader().loadAsync("textures/compressed/disturb_4bpp_rgb.pvr");
 * map.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB; // only for color textures
 * ```
 */
export class PVRLoader extends CompressedTextureLoader {
  /**
   * Constructs a new PVR loader.
   *
   * @param [manager] - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
  }

  /**
   * Parses the given PVRTC texture data.
   *
   * @param buffer - The raw texture data.
   * @return An object representing the parsed texture data.
   */
  parse(buffer: ArrayBuffer): CompressedTextureData {
    if (buffer.byteLength < HEADER_LENGTH_INT * 4) {
      throw new Error("THREE.PVRLoader: Not enough data to contain a PVR header.");
    }
    const header = new Uint32Array(buffer, 0, HEADER_LENGTH_INT);
    const pvrDatas: PvrDatas = { buffer, header };

    if (header[0] === 0x03525650) {
      // PVR v3
      return parseV3(pvrDatas);
    } else if (header[11] === 0x21525650) {
      // PVR v2
      return parseV2(pvrDatas);
    }
    throw new Error("THREE.PVRLoader: Unknown PVR format.");
  }
}

function parseV3(pvrDatas: PvrDatas): CompressedTextureData {
  const header = pvrDatas.header;
  const metaLen = header[12];
  const pixelFormat = header[2];
  const height = header[6];
  const width = header[7];
  const numFaces = header[10];
  const numMipmaps = header[11];

  let bpp: number;
  let format: PixelFormat;
  switch (pixelFormat) {
    case 0: // PVRTC 2bpp RGB
      bpp = 2;
      format = PixelFormat.RGB_PVRTC_2BPPV1;
      break;
    case 1: // PVRTC 2bpp RGBA
      bpp = 2;
      format = PixelFormat.RGBA_PVRTC_2BPPV1;
      break;
    case 2: // PVRTC 4bpp RGB
      bpp = 4;
      format = PixelFormat.RGB_PVRTC_4BPPV1;
      break;
    case 3: // PVRTC 4bpp RGBA
      bpp = 4;
      format = PixelFormat.RGBA_PVRTC_4BPPV1;
      break;
    default:
      throw new Error("THREE.PVRLoader: Unsupported PVR format: " + pixelFormat);
  }

  pvrDatas.dataPtr = 52 + metaLen;
  pvrDatas.bpp = bpp;
  pvrDatas.width = width;
  pvrDatas.height = height;
  pvrDatas.numSurfaces = numFaces;
  pvrDatas.numMipmaps = numMipmaps;
  pvrDatas.isCubemap = numFaces === 6;
  return extract(pvrDatas, format);
}

function parseV2(pvrDatas: PvrDatas): CompressedTextureData {
  const header = pvrDatas.header;
  const headerLength = header[0];
  const height = header[1];
  const width = header[2];
  const numMipmaps = header[3];
  const flags = header[4];
  const bitmaskAlpha = header[10];
  const numSurfs = header[12];

  const TYPE_MASK = 0xff;
  const PVRTC_2 = 24;
  const PVRTC_4 = 25;

  const formatFlags = flags & TYPE_MASK;
  const hasAlpha = bitmaskAlpha > 0;
  let bpp: number;
  let format: PixelFormat;

  if (formatFlags === PVRTC_4) {
    format = hasAlpha ? PixelFormat.RGBA_PVRTC_4BPPV1 : PixelFormat.RGB_PVRTC_4BPPV1;
    bpp = 4;
  } else if (formatFlags === PVRTC_2) {
    format = hasAlpha ? PixelFormat.RGBA_PVRTC_2BPPV1 : PixelFormat.RGB_PVRTC_2BPPV1;
    bpp = 2;
  } else {
    throw new Error("THREE.PVRLoader: Unknown PVR format: " + formatFlags);
  }

  pvrDatas.dataPtr = headerLength;
  pvrDatas.bpp = bpp;
  pvrDatas.width = width;
  pvrDatas.height = height;
  pvrDatas.numSurfaces = numSurfs;
  pvrDatas.numMipmaps = numMipmaps + 1;
  // v2 has no explicit cubemap flag: six surfaces are treated as a cube.
  pvrDatas.isCubemap = numSurfs === 6;
  return extract(pvrDatas, format);
}

function extract(pvrDatas: PvrDatas, format: PixelFormat): CompressedTextureData {
  const width = pvrDatas.width ?? 0;
  const height = pvrDatas.height ?? 0;
  const numMipmaps = pvrDatas.numMipmaps ?? 1;
  const numSurfs = pvrDatas.numSurfaces ?? 1;
  const isCubemap = pvrDatas.isCubemap === true;
  const pvr: CompressedTextureData = { mipmaps: [], width, height, format, mipmapCount: numMipmaps, isCubemap };

  const buffer = pvrDatas.buffer;
  let dataOffset = pvrDatas.dataPtr ?? 0;
  const bpp = pvrDatas.bpp ?? 0;

  // PVRTC packs one 8x4 texel block at 2bpp, or one 4x4 block at 4bpp.
  const blockWidth = bpp === 2 ? 8 : 4;
  const blockSize = (blockWidth * 4 * bpp) / 8;
  const mipmaps: CompressedTextureMipmap[] = Array.from({ length: numMipmaps * numSurfs });

  for (let mipLevel = 0; mipLevel < numMipmaps; mipLevel++) {
    const sWidth = Math.max(width >> mipLevel, 1);
    const sHeight = Math.max(height >> mipLevel, 1);
    // PVRTC clamps each dimension to at least two blocks.
    const widthBlocks = Math.max(sWidth / blockWidth, 2);
    const heightBlocks = Math.max(sHeight / 4, 2);
    const dataSize = widthBlocks * heightBlocks * blockSize;

    for (let surfIndex = 0; surfIndex < numSurfs; surfIndex++) {
      if (dataOffset + dataSize > buffer.byteLength) {
        throw new Error("THREE.PVRLoader: Truncated PVR image data for level " + mipLevel + ".");
      }
      const byteArray = new Uint8Array(buffer, dataOffset, dataSize);
      mipmaps[surfIndex * numMipmaps + mipLevel] = { data: byteArray, width: sWidth, height: sHeight };
      dataOffset += dataSize;
    }
  }

  pvr.mipmaps = mipmaps;
  return pvr;
}
````

## ek3d/addons/loaders/Rhino3dmWorker

```typescript
export function Rhino3dmWorker(): void {
  type EnumValue = { constructor: { name: string }; value: number };
  type Vector = [number, number, number];
  type Buffers = {
    format: "buffers";
    position: ArrayBufferView;
    normal?: ArrayBufferView;
    index?: ArrayBufferView;
    uv?: ArrayBufferView;
    color?: ArrayBufferView;
  };
  type Node = {
    delete(): void;
    count: number;
    get(index: number): Node;
    geometry(): Node;
    attributes(): Node;
    objectType: EnumValue;
    id: string;
    groupCount: number;
    userStringCount: number;
    getGroupList(): unknown;
    getUserStrings(): unknown;
    decals(): Node;
    drawColor(doc: Document): { r: number; g: number; b: number };
    location: Vector;
    faces(): Node;
    getMesh(type: EnumValue): Node | null;
    append(mesh: Node): void;
    compact(): void;
    subdivide(level: number): void;
    toThreejsBuffers?: (indexed: boolean) => Omit<Buffers, "format">;
    toThreejsJSON(): unknown;
    xform: Node;
    toFloatArray(rowMajor: boolean): number[];
    physicallyBased(): Node & { supported: boolean };
    getTexture(type: EnumValue): Node | null;
    fileName: string;
    wrapU: unknown;
    wrapV: unknown;
    wrapW: unknown;
    uvwTransform: Node;
    kind: string;
    findChild(name: string): Node | null;
    getObjectIds(): unknown;
    domain: [number, number];
    tangentAt(t: number): Vector;
    pointAt(t: number): Vector;
    renderSettings(): Node;
    renderEnvironments: Node & { reflectionId: string };
    groundPlane: Node;
    safeFrame: Node;
    dithering: Node;
    skylight: Node;
    linearWorkflow: Node;
    renderChannels: Node;
    sun: Node;
    postEffects: Node;
  };
  type LineCurve = Node & { pointAtStart: Vector; pointAtEnd: Vector };
  type PolylineCurve = Node & { pointCount: number; point(index: number): Vector };
  type PolyCurve = Node & { segmentCount: number; segmentCurve(index: number): Node };
  type ArcCurve = Node & { angleDegrees: number };
  type NurbsCurve = Node & { degree: number; tryGetPolyline(): Node };
  type Document = Node & {
    objects(): Node;
    instanceDefinitions(): Node;
    materials(): Node;
    layers(): Node;
    views(): Node;
    namedViews(): Node;
    groups(): Node;
    strings(): Node;
    settings(): Node;
    renderContent(): Node;
    embeddedFiles(): Node;
    getEmbeddedFileAsBase64(name: string): string;
  };
  type Rhino = {
    File3dm: { fromByteArray(bytes: Uint8Array): Document | null };
    ObjectType: Record<string, EnumValue>;
    TextureType: Record<string, EnumValue>;
    MeshType: { Any: EnumValue };
    Mesh: { new (): Node; createFromSubDControlNet(node: Node, flag: boolean): Node | null };
    LineCurve: { new (): LineCurve };
    PolylineCurve: { new (): PolylineCurve };
    PolyCurve: { new (): PolyCurve };
    ArcCurve: { new (): ArcCurve };
    NurbsCurve: { new (): NurbsCurve };
  };
  type Message =
    | { type: "init"; libraryConfig: { wasmBinary: ArrayBuffer } }
    | { type: "decode"; id: number; buffer: ArrayBuffer; subdivisionLevel: number };
  type ObjectData = { geometry: unknown; attributes: Record<string, unknown>; objectType: string };
  type Decoded = {
    objects: ObjectData[];
    materials: Record<string, unknown>[];
    layers: Record<string, unknown>[];
    views: Record<string, unknown>[];
    namedViews: Record<string, unknown>[];
    groups: Record<string, unknown>[];
    strings: unknown[];
    settings: Record<string, unknown>;
    renderSettings: Record<string, unknown>;
    renderEnvironment: { type: string; image: string; name: string } | null;
  };
  const worker = self as unknown as {
    postMessage(message: unknown, transfer?: Transferable[]): void;
    rhino3dm(config: { wasmBinary: ArrayBuffer; onAbort(reason: unknown): void }): Promise<Rhino>;
  };
  let pending: Promise<Rhino> | undefined;

  onmessage = (event: MessageEvent<unknown>): void => {
    const message = event.data as Message;
    if (!message || typeof message !== "object") return;
    if (message.type === "init") {
      pending = new Promise<Rhino>((resolve, reject) => {
        try {
          if (!(message.libraryConfig?.wasmBinary instanceof ArrayBuffer)) throw new Error("Invalid Rhino WASM binary");
          Promise.resolve(worker.rhino3dm({ wasmBinary: message.libraryConfig.wasmBinary, onAbort: reject })).then(
            resolve,
            reject,
          );
        } catch (error) {
          reject(error);
        }
      });
      // A decode may arrive later; keep an initialization failure from becoming unhandled.
      void pending.catch(() => {});
    } else if (message.type === "decode") {
      void (async () => {
        try {
          if (!pending) throw new Error("Rhino worker is not initialized");
          if (
            !(message.buffer instanceof ArrayBuffer) ||
            message.buffer.byteLength === 0 ||
            !Number.isInteger(message.subdivisionLevel) ||
            message.subdivisionLevel < 0
          )
            throw new Error("Invalid Rhino decode input");
          const rhino = await pending;
          const data = decodeObjects(rhino, message.buffer, message.subdivisionLevel, message.id);
          worker.postMessage({ type: "decode", id: message.id, data }, collectTransferables(data));
        } catch (error) {
          const e = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
          worker.postMessage({ type: "error", id: message.id, error: { message: e.message, stack: e.stack } });
        }
      })();
    }
  };

  function warning(id: number, message: string, type: string, guid?: string): void {
    worker.postMessage({ type: "warning", id, data: guid === undefined ? { message, type } : { message, type, guid } });
  }

  function properties(object: object): Record<string, unknown> {
    const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    const source = object as Record<string, unknown>;
    for (const key in source) {
      const value = source[key];
      if (typeof value === "function") continue;
      if (value !== null && typeof value === "object") {
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(value, "constructor")) {
          const enumeration = value as { constructor: { name: string }; value: unknown };
          result[key] = { name: enumeration.constructor.name, value: enumeration.value };
        } else result[key] = properties(value);
      } else result[key] = value;
    }
    return result;
  }

  function meshToThreejs(mesh: Node): unknown {
    if (typeof mesh.toThreejsBuffers !== "function") return mesh.toThreejsJSON();
    const b = mesh.toThreejsBuffers(false);
    const result: Buffers = { format: "buffers", position: b.position };
    if (b.normal) result.normal = b.normal;
    if (b.index) result.index = b.index;
    if (b.uv) result.uv = b.uv;
    if (b.color) result.color = b.color;
    return result;
  }

  function collectTransferables(data: Decoded): Transferable[] {
    const buffers = new Set<ArrayBuffer>();
    for (const object of data.objects) {
      const geometry = object.geometry as Buffers | null;
      if (geometry?.format !== "buffers") continue;
      for (const attribute of [geometry.position, geometry.normal, geometry.uv, geometry.color, geometry.index]) {
        if (attribute?.buffer instanceof ArrayBuffer) buffers.add(attribute.buffer);
      }
    }
    return Array.from(buffers);
  }

  function curveToPoints(rhino: Rhino, curve: Node, limit: number): Vector[] {
    let count = limit;
    let points: Vector[] = [];
    if (curve instanceof rhino.LineCurve) return [curve.pointAtStart, curve.pointAtEnd];
    if (curve instanceof rhino.PolylineCurve) {
      for (let i = 0; i < curve.pointCount; i++) points.push(curve.point(i));
      return points;
    }
    if (curve instanceof rhino.PolyCurve) {
      for (let i = 0; i < curve.segmentCount; i++) {
        const segment = curve.segmentCurve(i);
        try {
          points = points.concat(curveToPoints(rhino, segment, count));
        } finally {
          segment.delete();
        }
      }
      return points;
    }
    if (curve instanceof rhino.ArcCurve) count = Math.max(2, Math.floor(curve.angleDegrees / 5));
    if (curve instanceof rhino.NurbsCurve && curve.degree === 1) {
      const polyline = curve.tryGetPolyline();
      try {
        for (let i = 0; i < polyline.count; i++) points.push(polyline.get(i) as unknown as Vector);
      } finally {
        polyline.delete();
      }
      return points;
    }
    const domain = curve.domain;
    const times: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const t = domain[0] + (i / (count - 1)) * (domain[1] - domain[0]);
      if (t === domain[0] || t === domain[1]) {
        times.push(t);
        continue;
      }
      const tangent = curve.tangentAt(t);
      const previous = curve.tangentAt(times[times.length - 1]);
      const denominator = Math.sqrt(
        (tangent[0] ** 2 + tangent[1] ** 2 + tangent[2] ** 2) *
          (previous[0] ** 2 + previous[1] ** 2 + previous[2] ** 2),
      );
      const angle =
        denominator === 0
          ? Math.PI / 2
          : Math.acos(
              Math.max(
                -1,
                Math.min(
                  1,
                  (tangent[0] * previous[0] + tangent[1] * previous[1] + tangent[2] * previous[2]) / denominator,
                ),
              ),
            );
      if (angle >= 0.1) times.push(t);
    }
    return times.map((t) => curve.pointAt(t));
  }

  function extractObject(rhino: Rhino, object: Node, doc: Document, level: number, id: number): ObjectData | undefined {
    const geom = object.geometry();
    const attrs = object.attributes();
    const type = geom.objectType;
    let geometry: unknown;
    try {
      switch (type) {
        case rhino.ObjectType.Curve: {
          const array = curveToPoints(rhino, geom, 100).flat();
          geometry = { data: { attributes: { position: { itemSize: 3, type: "Float32Array", array } } } };
          break;
        }
        case rhino.ObjectType.Point: {
          const color = attrs.drawColor(doc);
          geometry = {
            data: {
              attributes: {
                position: { itemSize: 3, type: "Float32Array", array: geom.location },
                color: { itemSize: 3, type: "Float32Array", array: [color.r / 255, color.g / 255, color.b / 255] },
              },
            },
          };
          break;
        }
        case rhino.ObjectType.PointSet:
        case rhino.ObjectType.Mesh:
          geometry = meshToThreejs(geom);
          break;
        case rhino.ObjectType.Brep: {
          const faces = geom.faces();
          const mesh = new rhino.Mesh();
          try {
            for (let i = 0; i < faces.count; i++) {
              const face = faces.get(i);
              try {
                const part = face.getMesh(rhino.MeshType.Any);
                if (part)
                  try {
                    mesh.append(part);
                  } finally {
                    part.delete();
                  }
              } finally {
                face.delete();
              }
            }
            const meshFaces = mesh.faces();
            try {
              if (meshFaces.count > 0) {
                mesh.compact();
                geometry = meshToThreejs(mesh);
              }
            } finally {
              meshFaces.delete();
            }
          } finally {
            mesh.delete();
            faces.delete();
          }
          break;
        }
        case rhino.ObjectType.Extrusion:
        case rhino.ObjectType.SubD: {
          if (type === rhino.ObjectType.SubD) geom.subdivide(level);
          const mesh =
            type === rhino.ObjectType.SubD
              ? rhino.Mesh.createFromSubDControlNet(geom, false)
              : geom.getMesh(rhino.MeshType.Any);
          if (mesh)
            try {
              geometry = meshToThreejs(mesh);
            } finally {
              mesh.delete();
            }
          break;
        }
        case rhino.ObjectType.TextDot:
          geometry = properties(geom);
          break;
        case rhino.ObjectType.Light: {
          const light = properties(geom);
          geometry = light;
          if ((light.lightStyle as { name?: string } | undefined)?.name === "LightStyle_WorldLinear")
            warning(
              id,
              `THREE.3DMLoader: No conversion exists for ${type.constructor.name} LightStyle_WorldLinear`,
              "no conversion",
              attrs.id,
            );
          break;
        }
        case rhino.ObjectType.InstanceReference: {
          const instance = properties(geom);
          instance.xform = { ...properties(geom.xform), array: geom.xform.toFloatArray(true) };
          geometry = instance;
          break;
        }
        default:
          warning(
            id,
            `THREE.3DMLoader: Conversion not implemented for ${type.constructor.name}`,
            "not implemented",
            attrs.id,
          );
      }
      if (!geometry) {
        warning(
          id,
          `THREE.3DMLoader: ${type.constructor.name} has no associated mesh geometry.`,
          "missing mesh",
          attrs.id,
        );
        return undefined;
      }
      const attributes = properties(attrs);
      const geometryProperties = properties(geom);
      attributes.geometry = geometryProperties;
      if (attrs.groupCount > 0) attributes.groupIds = attrs.getGroupList();
      if (attrs.userStringCount > 0) attributes.userStrings = attrs.getUserStrings();
      if (geom.userStringCount > 0) geometryProperties.userStrings = geom.getUserStrings();
      if (attrs.decals().count > 0)
        warning(
          id,
          "THREE.3DMLoader: No conversion exists for the decals associated with this object.",
          "no conversion",
          attrs.id,
        );
      attributes.drawColor = attrs.drawColor(doc);
      return { geometry, attributes, objectType: type.constructor.name.substring(11) };
    } finally {
      geom.delete();
      attrs.delete();
    }
  }

  function textures(material: Node, types: EnumValue[], doc: Document, id: number): Record<string, unknown>[] {
    const result: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
    for (const type of types) {
      const texture = material.getTexture(type);
      if (!texture) continue;
      try {
        const name = type.constructor.name.substring(12);
        const image = doc.getEmbeddedFileAsBase64(texture.fileName);
        const uvw = texture.uvwTransform.toFloatArray(true);
        if (!image) warning(id, `THREE.3DMLoader: Image for ${name} texture not embedded in file.`, "missing resource");
        result.push({
          type: name,
          wrapU: texture.wrapU,
          wrapV: texture.wrapV,
          wrapW: texture.wrapW,
          repeat: [uvw[0], uvw[5]],
          image: image ? "data:image/png;base64," + image : null,
        });
      } finally {
        texture.delete();
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  function decodeObjects(rhino: Rhino, buffer: ArrayBuffer, level: number, id: number): Decoded {
    const doc = rhino.File3dm.fromByteArray(new Uint8Array(buffer));
    if (!doc) throw new Error("Invalid 3DM file");
    try {
      const objects: ObjectData[] = [];
      const objectTable = doc.objects();
      for (let i = 0; i < objectTable.count; i++) {
        const object = objectTable.get(i);
        try {
          const data = extractObject(rhino, object, doc, level, id);
          if (data) objects.push(data);
        } finally {
          object.delete();
        }
      }
      const definitions = doc.instanceDefinitions();
      for (let i = 0; i < definitions.count; i++) {
        const definition = definitions.get(i);
        try {
          const attributes = properties(definition);
          attributes.objectIds = definition.getObjectIds();
          objects.push({ geometry: null, attributes, objectType: "InstanceDefinition" });
        } finally {
          definition.delete();
        }
      }
      const textureTypes = ["Diffuse", "Bump", "Transparency", "Opacity", "Emap"].map(
        (name) => rhino.TextureType[name],
      );
      const pbrTypes = [
        "PBR_BaseColor",
        "PBR_Subsurface",
        "PBR_SubsurfaceScattering",
        "PBR_SubsurfaceScatteringRadius",
        "PBR_Metallic",
        "PBR_Specular",
        "PBR_SpecularTint",
        "PBR_Roughness",
        "PBR_Anisotropic",
        "PBR_Anisotropic_Rotation",
        "PBR_Sheen",
        "PBR_SheenTint",
        "PBR_Clearcoat",
        "PBR_ClearcoatBump",
        "PBR_ClearcoatRoughness",
        "PBR_OpacityIor",
        "PBR_OpacityRoughness",
        "PBR_Emission",
        "PBR_AmbientOcclusion",
        "PBR_Displacement",
      ].map((name) => rhino.TextureType[name]);
      const materials: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
      const materialTable = doc.materials();
      for (let i = 0; i < materialTable.count; i++) {
        const material = materialTable.get(i);
        try {
          const data = properties(material);
          const maps = textures(material, textureTypes, doc, id);
          const pbr = material.physicallyBased();
          data.pbrSupported = pbr.supported;
          if (pbr.supported) {
            maps.push(...textures(material, pbrTypes, doc, id));
            data.pbr = properties(pbr);
          }
          data.textures = maps;
          materials.push(data);
        } finally {
          material.delete();
        }
      }
      function tableData(table: Node): Record<string, unknown>[] {
        const result: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < table.count; i++) {
          const item = table.get(i);
          try {
            result.push(properties(item));
          } finally {
            item.delete();
          }
        }
        return result;
      }
      const layers = tableData(doc.layers());
      const views = tableData(doc.views());
      const namedViews = tableData(doc.namedViews());
      const groups = tableData(doc.groups());
      const settingsNode = doc.settings();
      const settings = properties(settingsNode);
      const strings: unknown[] = [];
      const stringTable = doc.strings();
      for (let i = 0; i < stringTable.count; i++) strings.push(stringTable.get(i));
      const render = settingsNode.renderSettings();
      const reflectionId = render.renderEnvironments.reflectionId;
      const contentTable = doc.renderContent();
      let renderEnvironment: Decoded["renderEnvironment"] = null;
      for (let i = 0; i < contentTable.count; i++) {
        const content = contentTable.get(i);
        if (content.kind !== "environment" || content.id !== reflectionId) continue;
        const texture = content.findChild("texture");
        if (!texture) continue;
        const files = doc.embeddedFiles();
        for (let j = 0; j < files.count; j++) {
          if (texture.fileName === files.get(j).fileName)
            renderEnvironment = {
              type: "renderEnvironment",
              image: "data:image/png;base64," + doc.getEmbeddedFileAsBase64(texture.fileName),
              name: texture.fileName,
            };
        }
      }
      const renderSource = render as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
      const renderSettings: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      for (const key of [
        "ambientLight",
        "backgroundColorTop",
        "backgroundColorBottom",
        "useHiddenLights",
        "depthCue",
        "flatShade",
        "renderBackFaces",
        "renderPoints",
        "renderCurves",
        "renderIsoParams",
        "renderMeshEdges",
        "renderAnnotations",
        "useViewportSize",
        "scaleBackgroundToFit",
        "transparentBackground",
        "imageDpi",
        "shadowMapLevel",
        "namedView",
        "snapShot",
        "specificViewport",
      ])
        renderSettings[key] = renderSource[key];
      for (const key of [
        "groundPlane",
        "safeFrame",
        "dithering",
        "skylight",
        "linearWorkflow",
        "renderChannels",
        "sun",
        "renderEnvironments",
        "postEffects",
      ])
        renderSettings[key] = properties(renderSource[key] as object);
      return {
        objects,
        materials,
        layers,
        views,
        namedViews,
        groups,
        strings,
        settings,
        renderSettings,
        renderEnvironment,
      };
    } finally {
      doc.delete();
    }
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/SPLATLoader

````typescript
import type { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import type { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";
import { error } from "../../utils";
import { createGaussianSplatGeometry, writeCovariance } from "../utils/GaussianSplatUtils";

const ROW_SIZE_BYTES = 32;

/**
 * Loads fixed-width Gaussian splat data as a BufferGeometry.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { SPLATLoader } from "ek3d/addons/loaders/SPLATLoader";
 * const geometry = await new SPLATLoader().loadAsync("model.splat");
 * ```
 */
export class SPLATLoader extends Loader<BufferGeometry> {
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
  }

  load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (geometry: BufferGeometry) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (cause: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (buffer) => {
        try {
          if (!(buffer instanceof ArrayBuffer)) throw new Error("THREE.SPLATLoader: Expected an ArrayBuffer response.");
          onLoad?.(this.parse(buffer));
        } catch (cause) {
          if (onError) onError(cause);
          else error(cause);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  parse(buffer: ArrayBuffer): BufferGeometry {
    if (buffer.byteLength % ROW_SIZE_BYTES !== 0) throw new Error("THREE.SPLATLoader: Invalid .splat byte length.");
    const count = buffer.byteLength / ROW_SIZE_BYTES;
    const centers = new Float32Array(count * 3);
    const covariances = new Float32Array(count * 6);
    const colors = new Uint8Array(count * 4);
    const view = new DataView(buffer);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const offset = i * ROW_SIZE_BYTES;
      const i3 = i * 3;
      const i4 = i * 4;
      centers[i3] = view.getFloat32(offset, true);
      centers[i3 + 1] = view.getFloat32(offset + 4, true);
      centers[i3 + 2] = view.getFloat32(offset + 8, true);
      const sx = view.getFloat32(offset + 12, true);
      const sy = view.getFloat32(offset + 16, true);
      const sz = view.getFloat32(offset + 20, true);
      colors[i4] = bytes[offset + 24];
      colors[i4 + 1] = bytes[offset + 25];
      colors[i4 + 2] = bytes[offset + 26];
      colors[i4 + 3] = bytes[offset + 27];
      const qw = (bytes[offset + 28] - 128) / 128;
      const qx = (bytes[offset + 29] - 128) / 128;
      const qy = (bytes[offset + 30] - 128) / 128;
      const qz = (bytes[offset + 31] - 128) / 128;
      writeCovariance(covariances, i * 6, sx, sy, sz, qx, qy, qz, qw);
    }
    return createGaussianSplatGeometry(centers, covariances, colors);
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/loaders/SPZLoader

````typescript
import { fromHalfFloat } from "../../extras/DataUtils";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import {
  SH_BAND_COMPONENTS,
  SH_BAND_WORDS,
  SH_C0,
  createGaussianSplatGeometry,
  createPackedSphericalHarmonicsBand,
  writeCovariance,
} from "../utils/GaussianSplatUtils";

export interface SPZGzipRuntime {
  gunzipSync(data: Uint8Array): Uint8Array;
}

export interface SPZZSTDRuntime {
  init?(): Promise<void>;
  decode(data: Uint8Array, uncompressedByteLength: number): Uint8Array;
}

const MAGIC = 0x5053474e;
const SH_VECTORS = [0, 3, 8, 15, 24];
const SCALE = new Float32Array(256);
const COLOR = new Uint8ClampedArray(256);
const QUAT = new Float64Array(1024);
for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
  SCALE[i] = Math.exp(i / 16 - 10);
  COLOR[i] = ((i / 255 - 0.5) * (SH_C0 / 0.15) + 0.5) * 255;
}
for (let i = 0; i < 1024; i++) {
  const value = Math.SQRT1_2 * ((i & 511) / 511);
  QUAT[i] = (i & 512) !== 0 ? -value : value;
}

interface Attributes {
  positions: Uint8Array;
  alphas: Uint8Array;
  colors: Uint8Array;
  scales: Uint8Array;
  rotations: Uint8Array;
  sphericalHarmonics: Uint8Array;
  count: number;
  version: number;
  fractionalBits: number;
  storedShDegree: number;
}

/** Loads compressed SPZ Gaussian splat data into geometry.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { SPZLoader, type SPZGzipRuntime, type SPZZSTDRuntime } from "ek3d/addons/loaders/SPZLoader";
 * async function loadSplat(gzip: SPZGzipRuntime, zstd: SPZZSTDRuntime) {
 *   const loader = new SPZLoader().setGzipRuntime(gzip).setZSTDRuntime(zstd);
 *   return await loader.loadAsync("model.spz");
 * }
 * ```
 * Gzip is required for versions 1–3; ZSTD is required for version 4.
 */
export class SPZLoader extends Loader<BufferGeometry> {
  gzipRuntime: SPZGzipRuntime | null = null;
  zstdRuntime: SPZZSTDRuntime | null = null;
  private zstdReady: Promise<void> | null = null;

  setGzipRuntime(runtime: SPZGzipRuntime): this {
    this.gzipRuntime = runtime;
    return this;
  }

  setZSTDRuntime(runtime: SPZZSTDRuntime): this {
    this.zstdRuntime = runtime;
    this.zstdReady = null;
    return this;
  }

  override load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (geometry: BufferGeometry) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (buffer) => {
        const reportError = (error: unknown): void => {
          if (onError) onError(error);
          else console.error(error);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        };
        try {
          if (!(buffer instanceof ArrayBuffer)) throw new TypeError("SPZLoader requires array buffer data");
          const result = this.parse(buffer);
          if (result instanceof Promise) result.then(onLoad).catch(reportError);
          else if (result !== undefined) onLoad?.(result);
        } catch (error) {
          reportError(error);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  parse(
    buffer: ArrayBuffer,
    onLoad?: (geometry: BufferGeometry) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): BufferGeometry | Promise<BufferGeometry> | undefined {
    try {
      if (buffer.byteLength >= 8 && new DataView(buffer).getUint32(0, true) === MAGIC) {
        const version = new DataView(buffer).getUint32(4, true);
        if (version !== 4) throw new Error(`THREE.SPZLoader: SPZ version ${version} is not supported.`);
        const runtime = this.zstdRuntime;
        if (runtime === null) throw new Error("THREE.SPZLoader: ZSTD runtime is required.");
        if (this.zstdReady === null) {
          const ready = Promise.resolve()
            .then(() => runtime.init?.())
            .catch((error: unknown) => {
              if (this.zstdReady === ready) this.zstdReady = null;
              throw error;
            });
          this.zstdReady = ready;
        }
        const promise = this.zstdReady.then(() => this.parseRawSPZV4(new Uint8Array(buffer), runtime));
        if (onLoad !== undefined || onError !== undefined) {
          const callback = promise.then(onLoad);
          if (onError !== undefined) callback.catch(onError);
        }
        return promise;
      }
      if (this.gzipRuntime === null) throw new Error("THREE.SPZLoader: Gzip runtime is required.");
      const geometry = this.parseRawSPZ(this.gzipRuntime.gunzipSync(new Uint8Array(buffer)));
      onLoad?.(geometry);
      return geometry;
    } catch (error) {
      if (onError !== undefined) {
        onError(error);
        return undefined;
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  parseRawSPZ(bytes: Uint8Array): BufferGeometry {
    if (bytes.byteLength < 16) throw new Error("THREE.SPZLoader: Invalid SPZ header.");
    const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);
    if (view.getUint32(0, true) !== MAGIC) throw new Error("THREE.SPZLoader: Invalid SPZ magic.");
    const version = view.getUint32(4, true);
    if (version < 1 || version > 3) throw new Error(`THREE.SPZLoader: SPZ version ${version} is not supported.`);
    const count = view.getUint32(8, true);
    const storedShDegree = view.getUint8(12);
    if (storedShDegree >= SH_VECTORS.length)
      throw new Error(`THREE.SPZLoader: Unsupported SPZ spherical harmonics degree ${storedShDegree}.`);
    const fractionalBits = view.getUint8(13);
    const sizes = [
      count * 3 * (version === 1 ? 2 : 3),
      count,
      count * 3,
      count * 3,
      count * (version === 3 ? 4 : 3),
      count * SH_VECTORS[storedShDegree] * 3,
    ];
    const expected = 16 + sizes.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) + ((view.getUint8(14) & 0x80) !== 0 ? count * 6 : 0);
    if (bytes.byteLength !== expected) throw new Error("THREE.SPZLoader: Invalid SPZ byte length.");
    let offset = 16;
    const streams = sizes.map((size) => {
      const stream = bytes.subarray(offset, offset + size);
      offset += size;
      return stream;
    });
    return parseAttributes({
      positions: streams[0],
      alphas: streams[1],
      colors: streams[2],
      scales: streams[3],
      rotations: streams[4],
      sphericalHarmonics: streams[5],
      count,
      version,
      fractionalBits,
      storedShDegree,
    });
  }

  parseRawSPZV4(bytes: Uint8Array, zstd: SPZZSTDRuntime): BufferGeometry {
    if (bytes.byteLength < 20) throw new Error("THREE.SPZLoader: Invalid SPZ header.");
    const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);
    if (view.getUint32(0, true) !== MAGIC || view.getUint32(4, true) !== 4)
      throw new Error("THREE.SPZLoader: Invalid SPZ v4 header.");
    const count = view.getUint32(8, true);
    const storedShDegree = view.getUint8(12);
    if (storedShDegree >= SH_VECTORS.length)
      throw new Error(`THREE.SPZLoader: Unsupported SPZ spherical harmonics degree ${storedShDegree}.`);
    const fractionalBits = view.getUint8(13);
    if ((view.getUint8(14) & 2) !== 0)
      console.warn("THREE.SPZLoader: SPZ vendor extensions are not supported and will be skipped.");
    const numStreams = view.getUint8(15);
    const tocOffset = view.getUint32(16, true);
    if (tocOffset < 20 || tocOffset + numStreams * 16 > bytes.length)
      throw new Error("THREE.SPZLoader: Invalid SPZ table of contents.");
    const sizes = [count * 9, count, count * 3, count * 3, count * 4, count * SH_VECTORS[storedShDegree] * 3];
    let compressedOffset = tocOffset + numStreams * 16;
    let index = 0;
    const streams = sizes.map((size) => {
      if (size === 0) return new Uint8Array();
      if (index >= numStreams) throw new Error("THREE.SPZLoader: Missing SPZ stream.");
      const length = view.getBigUint64(tocOffset + index++ * 16, true);
      if (length > BigInt(bytes.length - compressedOffset))
        throw new Error("THREE.SPZLoader: Invalid SPZ stream length.");
      const end = compressedOffset + Number(length);
      const decoded = zstd.decode(bytes.subarray(compressedOffset, end), size);
      compressedOffset = end;
      if (decoded.byteLength !== size) throw new Error("THREE.SPZLoader: Invalid decoded SPZ stream length.");
      return decoded;
    });
    return parseAttributes({
      positions: streams[0],
      alphas: streams[1],
      colors: streams[2],
      scales: streams[3],
      rotations: streams[4],
      sphericalHarmonics: streams[5],
      count,
      version: 4,
      fractionalBits,
      storedShDegree,
    });
  }
}

function parseAttributes(data: Attributes): BufferGeometry {
  const {
    positions,
    alphas,
    colors,
    scales,
    rotations,
    sphericalHarmonics,
    count,
    version,
    fractionalBits,
    storedShDegree,
  } = data;
  const centers = new Float32Array(count * 3);
  const covariances = new Float32Array(count * 6);
  const colorBytes = new Uint8ClampedArray(count * 4);
  const bands: Record<string, Uint32Array> = {};
  const bandBytes: { bytes: Uint8ClampedArray; components: number; stride: number }[] = [];
  for (let band = 1; band <= Math.min(storedShDegree, 3); band++) {
    const packed = createPackedSphericalHarmonicsBand(count, band);
    bands[`sh${band}`] = packed.packed;
    bandBytes.push({ bytes: packed.bytes, components: SH_BAND_COMPONENTS[band], stride: SH_BAND_WORDS[band] * 4 });
  }
  readCenters(positions, centers, count, version, fractionalBits);
  const packedRotations =
    version >= 3
      ? rotations.byteOffset % 4 === 0
        ? new Uint32Array(rotations.buffer, rotations.byteOffset, count)
        : new Uint32Array(rotations.slice().buffer)
      : null;
  const q = [0, 0, 0, 0];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    if (packedRotations !== null) {
      readSmallestThreeQuaternion(packedRotations[i], q);
    } else {
      const offset = i * 3;
      q[0] = rotations[offset] / 127.5 - 1;
      q[1] = rotations[offset + 1] / 127.5 - 1;
      q[2] = rotations[offset + 2] / 127.5 - 1;
      q[3] = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - q[0] * q[0] - q[1] * q[1] - q[2] * q[2]));
    }
    const i3 = i * 3,
      i4 = i * 4;
    writeCovariance(
      covariances,
      i * 6,
      SCALE[scales[i3]],
      SCALE[scales[i3 + 1]],
      SCALE[scales[i3 + 2]],
      q[0],
      q[1],
      q[2],
      q[3],
    );
    for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) colorBytes[i4 + c] = COLOR[colors[i3 + c]];
    colorBytes[i4 + 3] = alphas[i];
    let source = i * SH_VECTORS[storedShDegree] * 3;
    for (const band of bandBytes) {
      for (let j = 0; j < band.components; j++) band.bytes[i * band.stride + j] = sphericalHarmonics[source++];
    }
  }
  return createGaussianSplatGeometry(centers, covariances, colorBytes, bands);
}

function readCenters(
  bytes: Uint8Array,
  centers: Float32Array,
  count: number,
  version: number,
  fractionalBits: number,
): void {
  if (version === 1) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const i3 = i * 3;
      const offset = i3 * 2;
      centers[i3] = fromHalfFloat(bytes[offset] | (bytes[offset + 1] << 8));
      centers[i3 + 1] = fromHalfFloat(bytes[offset + 2] | (bytes[offset + 3] << 8));
      centers[i3 + 2] = fromHalfFloat(bytes[offset + 4] | (bytes[offset + 5] << 8));
    }
    return;
  }
  const fixedScale = 1 / (1 << fractionalBits);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const i3 = i * 3;
    const offset = i * 9;
    centers[i3] = readInt24(bytes, offset) * fixedScale;
    centers[i3 + 1] = readInt24(bytes, offset + 3) * fixedScale;
    centers[i3 + 2] = readInt24(bytes, offset + 6) * fixedScale;
  }
}

function readInt24(bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number): number {
  return ((bytes[offset] << 8) | (bytes[offset + 1] << 16) | (bytes[offset + 2] << 24)) >> 8;
}

function readSmallestThreeQuaternion(packed: number, target: number[]): void {
  const largest = packed >>> 30;
  const a = QUAT[packed & 1023];
  const b = QUAT[(packed >>> 10) & 1023];
  const c = QUAT[(packed >>> 20) & 1023];
  switch (largest) {
    case 0:
      target[1] = c;
      target[2] = b;
      target[3] = a;
      break;
    case 1:
      target[0] = c;
      target[2] = b;
      target[3] = a;
      break;
    case 2:
      target[0] = c;
      target[1] = b;
      target[3] = a;
      break;
    default:
      target[0] = c;
      target[1] = b;
      target[2] = a;
  }
  target[largest] = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - (a * a + b * b + c * c)));
}
````

## ek3d/addons/loaders/STLLoader

````typescript
import { ColorSpace } from "../../constants";
import { BufferAttribute, Float32BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import type { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";

/**
 * Non-indexed STL geometry with optional binary "Magics" color metadata.
 */
export class STLGeometry extends BufferGeometry {
  /**
   * Whether the binary file declared per-facet colors via a `COLOR=` header.
   */
  hasColors: boolean | undefined = undefined;

  /**
   * Opacity declared by the binary header's `COLOR=rgba` default, when present.
   */
  alpha: number | undefined = undefined;
}

/** US-ASCII ordinal values for 's', 'o', 'l', 'i', 'd' */
const SOLID_BYTES = [115, 111, 108, 105, 100];

interface BinaryColorState {
  /** Allocated only when the header declared a `COLOR=` default. */
  colors: Float32Array | null;
  defaultR: number;
  defaultG: number;
  defaultB: number;
  alpha: number;
}

function isBinary(data: ArrayBufferLike): boolean {
  const reader = new DataView(data);
  const face_size = (32 / 8) * 3 + (32 / 8) * 3 * 3 + 16 / 8;
  const n_faces = reader.getUint32(80, true);
  const expect = 80 + 32 / 8 + n_faces * face_size;

  if (expect === reader.byteLength) {
    return true;
  }

  // An ASCII STL data must begin with 'solid ' as the first six bytes.
  // However, ASCII STLs lacking the SPACE after the 'd' are known to be
  // plentiful. So, check the first 5 bytes for 'solid'.

  // Several encodings, such as UTF-8, precede the text with up to 5 bytes:
  // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Byte_order_mark#Byte_order_marks_by_encoding
  // Search for "solid" to start anywhere after those prefixes.

  for (let off = 0; off < 5; off++) {
    // If "solid" text is matched to the current offset, declare it to be an ASCII STL.

    if (matchDataViewAt(SOLID_BYTES, reader, off)) return false;
  }

  // Couldn't find "solid" text at the beginning; it is binary STL.

  return true;
}

function matchDataViewAt(query: number[], reader: DataView, offset: number): boolean {
  // Check if each byte in query matches the corresponding byte from the current offset

  for (let i = 0, il = query.length; i < il; i++) {
    if (query[i] !== reader.getUint8(offset + i)) return false;
  }

  return true;
}

function readHeaderColors(reader: DataView, faces: number): BinaryColorState {
  const state: BinaryColorState = {
    colors: null,
    defaultR: 1,
    defaultG: 1,
    defaultB: 1,
    alpha: 1,
  };

  // process STL header
  // check for default color in header ("COLOR=rgba" sequence).

  for (let index = 0; index <= 80 - 10; index++) {
    if (
      reader.getUint32(index, false) === 0x434f4c4f /*COLO*/ &&
      reader.getUint8(index + 4) === 0x52 /*'R'*/ &&
      reader.getUint8(index + 5) === 0x3d /*'='*/
    ) {
      state.colors = new Float32Array(faces * 3 * 3);

      state.defaultR = reader.getUint8(index + 6) / 255;
      state.defaultG = reader.getUint8(index + 7) / 255;
      state.defaultB = reader.getUint8(index + 8) / 255;
      state.alpha = reader.getUint8(index + 9) / 255;
    }
  }

  return state;
}

function parseBinary(data: ArrayBufferLike): STLGeometry {
  const reader = new DataView(data);
  const faces = reader.getUint32(80, true);

  let r = 0;
  let g = 0;
  let b = 0;

  const { colors, defaultR, defaultG, defaultB, alpha } = readHeaderColors(reader, faces);
  const dataOffset = 84;
  const faceLength = 12 * 4 + 2;

  const geometry = new STLGeometry();

  const vertices = new Float32Array(faces * 3 * 3);
  const normals = new Float32Array(faces * 3 * 3);

  const color = new Color();

  for (let face = 0; face < faces; face++) {
    const start = dataOffset + face * faceLength;
    const normalX = reader.getFloat32(start, true);
    const normalY = reader.getFloat32(start + 4, true);
    const normalZ = reader.getFloat32(start + 8, true);

    if (colors !== null) {
      const packedColor = reader.getUint16(start + 48, true);

      if ((packedColor & 0x8000) === 0) {
        // facet has its own unique color

        r = (packedColor & 0x1f) / 31;
        g = ((packedColor >> 5) & 0x1f) / 31;
        b = ((packedColor >> 10) & 0x1f) / 31;
      } else {
        r = defaultR;
        g = defaultG;
        b = defaultB;
      }
    }

    for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
      const vertexstart = start + i * 12;
      const componentIdx = face * 3 * 3 + (i - 1) * 3;

      vertices[componentIdx] = reader.getFloat32(vertexstart, true);
      vertices[componentIdx + 1] = reader.getFloat32(vertexstart + 4, true);
      vertices[componentIdx + 2] = reader.getFloat32(vertexstart + 8, true);

      normals[componentIdx] = normalX;
      normals[componentIdx + 1] = normalY;
      normals[componentIdx + 2] = normalZ;

      if (colors !== null) {
        color.setRGB(r, g, b, ColorSpace.SRGB);

        colors[componentIdx] = color.r;
        colors[componentIdx + 1] = color.g;
        colors[componentIdx + 2] = color.b;
      }
    }
  }

  geometry.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(vertices, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute("normal", new BufferAttribute(normals, 3));

  if (colors !== null) {
    geometry.setAttribute("color", new BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
    geometry.hasColors = true;
    geometry.alpha = alpha;
  }

  return geometry;
}

function parseASCII(data: string): STLGeometry {
  const geometry = new STLGeometry();
  const patternSolid = /solid([\s\S]*?)endsolid/g;
  const patternFace = /facet([\s\S]*?)endfacet/g;
  const patternName = /solid\s(.+)/;
  let faceCounter = 0;

  const patternFloat = /[\s]+([+-]?(?:\d*)(?:\.\d*)?(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?)/.source;
  const patternVertex = new RegExp("vertex" + patternFloat + patternFloat + patternFloat, "g");
  const patternNormal = new RegExp("normal" + patternFloat + patternFloat + patternFloat, "g");

  const vertices: number[] = [];
  const normals: number[] = [];
  const groupNames: string[] = [];

  const normal = new Vector3();

  let result: RegExpExecArray | null;

  let groupCount = 0;
  let startVertex = 0;
  let endVertex = 0;

  while ((result = patternSolid.exec(data)) !== null) {
    startVertex = endVertex;

    const solid = result[0];

    const nameResult = patternName.exec(solid);
    const name = nameResult !== null ? nameResult[1] : "";
    groupNames.push(name);

    while ((result = patternFace.exec(solid)) !== null) {
      let vertexCountPerFace = 0;
      let normalCountPerFace = 0;

      const text = result[0];

      while ((result = patternNormal.exec(text)) !== null) {
        normal.x = parseFloat(result[1]);
        normal.y = parseFloat(result[2]);
        normal.z = parseFloat(result[3]);
        normalCountPerFace++;
      }

      while ((result = patternVertex.exec(text)) !== null) {
        vertices.push(parseFloat(result[1]), parseFloat(result[2]), parseFloat(result[3]));
        normals.push(normal.x, normal.y, normal.z);
        vertexCountPerFace++;
        endVertex++;
      }

      // every face have to own ONE valid normal

      if (normalCountPerFace !== 1) {
        console.error("THREE.STLLoader: Something isn't right with the normal of face number " + faceCounter);
      }

      // each face have to own THREE valid vertices

      if (vertexCountPerFace !== 3) {
        console.error("THREE.STLLoader: Something isn't right with the vertices of face number " + faceCounter);
      }

      faceCounter++;
    }

    const start = startVertex;
    const count = endVertex - startVertex;

    geometry.userData.groupNames = groupNames;

    geometry.addGroup(start, count, groupCount);
    groupCount++;
  }

  geometry.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(vertices, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute("normal", new Float32BufferAttribute(normals, 3));

  return geometry;
}

function ensureString(buffer: ArrayBufferLike | string): string {
  if (typeof buffer !== "string") {
    return new TextDecoder().decode(buffer);
  }

  return buffer;
}

function ensureBinary(buffer: ArrayBufferLike | string): ArrayBufferLike {
  if (typeof buffer === "string") {
    const arrayBuffer = new Uint8Array(buffer.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < buffer.length; i++) {
      arrayBuffer[i] = buffer.charCodeAt(i) & 0xff; // implicitly assumes little-endian
    }

    return arrayBuffer.buffer;
  } else {
    return buffer;
  }
}

/**
 * A loader for the STL format, as created by Solidworks and other CAD programs.
 *
 * Supports both binary and ASCII encoded files. The loader returns a non-indexed buffer geometry.
 *
 * Limitations:
 * - Binary decoding supports "Magics" color format (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/STL_(file_format)#Color_in_binary_STL).
 * - There is perhaps some question as to how valid it is to always assume little-endian-ness.
 * - ASCII decoding assumes file is UTF-8.
 *
 * For binary STLs geometry might contain colors for vertices. To use it:
 * ```ts
 * import { STLLoader } from "ek3d/addons/loaders/STLLoader";
 * import { MeshPhongMaterial } from "ek3d/materials/MeshPhongMaterial";
 * import { Mesh } from "ek3d/objects/Mesh";
 * import { Scene } from "ek3d/scenes/Scene";
 *
 * const scene = new Scene();
 * const geometry = await new STLLoader().loadAsync("./models/stl/binary/colored.stl");
 * const material = geometry.hasColors
 *   ? new MeshPhongMaterial({ opacity: geometry.alpha, vertexColors: true })
 *   : new MeshPhongMaterial();
 * scene.add(new Mesh(geometry, material));
 * ```
 * For ASCII STLs containing multiple solids, each solid is assigned to a different group.
 * Groups can be used to assign a different color by defining an array of materials with the same length of
 * geometry.groups and passing it to the Mesh constructor:
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { STLLoader } from "ek3d/addons/loaders/STLLoader";
 * import { MeshPhongMaterial } from "ek3d/materials/MeshPhongMaterial";
 * import { Mesh } from "ek3d/objects/Mesh";
 * import { Scene } from "ek3d/scenes/Scene";
 *
 * const scene = new Scene();
 * const geometry = await new STLLoader().loadAsync("./models/stl/ascii/multiple-solids.stl");
 * const colorMap = [0xff0000, 0x00ff00];
 * const materials = geometry.groups.map((_, i) => new MeshPhongMaterial({ color: colorMap[i] }));
 * scene.add(new Mesh(geometry, materials));
 * ```
 */
export class STLLoader extends Loader<STLGeometry, string> {
  /**
   * Constructs a new STL loader.
   *
   * @param manager - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
  }

  /**
   * Starts loading from the given URL and passes the loaded STL asset
   * to the `onLoad()` callback.
   *
   * @param url - The path/URL of the file to be loaded. This can also be a data URI.
   * @param onLoad - Executed when the loading process has been finished.
   * @param onProgress - Executed while the loading is in progress.
   * @param onError - Executed when errors occur.
   */
  override load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (value: STLGeometry) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);

    loader.load(
      url,
      (text: unknown) => {
        try {
          const geometry = this.parse(text as ArrayBufferLike);
          if (onLoad !== undefined) onLoad(geometry);
        } catch (e) {
          if (onError !== undefined) {
            onError(e);
          } else {
            console.error(e);
          }

          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  /**
   * Parses the given STL data and returns the resulting geometry.
   *
   * @param data - The raw STL data as an array buffer or, for ASCII files, a string.
   * @return The parsed geometry.
   */
  parse(data: ArrayBufferLike | string): STLGeometry {
    // start

    const binData = ensureBinary(data);
