    return isBinary(binData) ? parseBinary(binData) : parseASCII(ensureString(data));
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/loaders/SVGGradients

```typescript
import { Wrapping, Side, ColorSpace } from "../../constants";
import { ShapePath } from "../../extras/core/ShapePath";
import { MeshBasicMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshBasicMaterial";
import { Box2 } from "../../math/Box2";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Matrix3 } from "../../math/Matrix3";
import { Vector2 } from "../../math/Vector2";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import { CanvasTexture } from "../../textures/CanvasTexture";

export interface SVGPathStyle {
  fill?: string;
  fillOpacity: number;
  fillRule?: string;
  opacity?: number;
  stroke?: string;
  strokeOpacity: number;
  strokeColor: string;
  strokeWidth: number;
  strokeLineJoin: string;
  strokeLineCap: string;
  strokeMiterLimit: number;
  visibility?: string;
}

interface SVGGradientStop {
  offset: number;
  color: string;
  opacity: number;
}
interface SVGGradientBase {
  gradientUnits: "userSpaceOnUse" | "objectBoundingBox";
  spreadMethod: "reflect" | "repeat" | "pad";
  gradientTransform: Matrix3 | null;
  stops: SVGGradientStop[];
}
export type SVGGradient = SVGGradientBase &
  (
    | { type: "linearGradient"; x1: number; y1: number; x2: number; y2: number }
    | { type: "radialGradient"; cx: number; cy: number; r: number; fx: number; fy: number }
  );
export type SVGGradients = Record<string, SVGGradient>;
export type SVGLoadedPath = ShapePath & {
  userData: { node: Element; style: SVGPathStyle; transform: Matrix3; gradients: SVGGradients };
};

const gradientURL = /^\s*url\(\s*(?:["']\s*)?#([^)'"\s]+)(?:\s*["'])?\s*\)\s*$/;

export function parseSVGGradients(
  xml: Document,
  parseTransform: (text: string) => Matrix3,
  parseLength: (value: string) => number,
): SVGGradients {
  const attrs = [
    "x1",
    "y1",
    "x2",
    "y2",
    "cx",
    "cy",
    "r",
    "fx",
    "fy",
    "gradientUnits",
    "gradientTransform",
    "spreadMethod",
  ];
  interface Entry {
    type: "linearGradient" | "radialGradient";
    attrs: Record<string, string>;
    stops: SVGGradientStop[] | null;
    href: string | null;
  }
  const parsed: Record<string, Entry> = {};
  for (const node of xml.querySelectorAll("linearGradient, radialGradient")) {
    const id = node.getAttribute("id");
    if (!id) continue;
    const entry: Entry = {
      type: node.nodeName === "radialGradient" ? "radialGradient" : "linearGradient",
      attrs: {},
      stops: null,
      href: null,
    };
    const href = node.getAttributeNS("http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink", "href") || node.getAttribute("href") || "";
    if (href.startsWith("#")) entry.href = href.substring(1);
    for (const name of attrs) {
      const value = node.getAttribute(name);
      if (value !== null) entry.attrs[name] = value;
    }
    const stops = node.querySelectorAll("stop");
    if (stops.length > 0) {
      entry.stops = [];
      for (const stop of stops) {
        const style = (stop as SVGElement).style;
        const color = stop.getAttribute("stop-color") || style?.getPropertyValue("stop-color") || "#000";
        const opacityText = stop.getAttribute("stop-opacity") || style?.getPropertyValue("stop-opacity");
        const opacity = opacityText ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, parseFloat(opacityText))) : 1;
        const offset = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, parseFloat(stop.getAttribute("offset") || "0")));
        entry.stops.push({ offset, color, opacity });
      }
    }
    parsed[id] = entry;
  }
  function inherit(id: string, visited: Set<string>): Entry | undefined {
    const entry = parsed[id];
    if (!entry || visited.has(id)) return entry;
    visited.add(id);
    if (entry.href && parsed[entry.href]) {
      const parent = inherit(entry.href, visited);
      if (parent) {
        if (!entry.stops) entry.stops = parent.stops;
        for (const key in parent.attrs) if (!(key in entry.attrs)) entry.attrs[key] = parent.attrs[key];
      }
    }
    return entry;
  }
  for (const id in parsed) inherit(id, new Set());
  const gradients: SVGGradients = {};
  function coord(value: string): number {
    if (value.endsWith("%")) return parseFloat(value) / 100;
    return parseLength(value);
  }
  for (const id in parsed) {
    const entry = parsed[id],
      a = entry.attrs;
    const gradientUnits = a.gradientUnits === "userSpaceOnUse" ? "userSpaceOnUse" : "objectBoundingBox";
    const base: SVGGradientBase = {
      gradientUnits,
      spreadMethod: a.spreadMethod === "reflect" || a.spreadMethod === "repeat" ? a.spreadMethod : "pad",
      gradientTransform: a.gradientTransform ? parseTransform(a.gradientTransform) : null,
      stops: (entry.stops || []).slice().sort((x, y) => x.offset - y.offset),
    };
    if (entry.type === "linearGradient") {
      gradients[id] = {
        ...base,
        type: entry.type,
        x1: a.x1 !== undefined ? coord(a.x1) : 0,
        y1: a.y1 !== undefined ? coord(a.y1) : 0,
        x2: a.x2 !== undefined ? coord(a.x2) : gradientUnits === "objectBoundingBox" ? 1 : 0,
        y2: a.y2 !== undefined ? coord(a.y2) : 0,
      };
    } else {
      const center = gradientUnits === "objectBoundingBox" ? 0.5 : 0;
      const cx = a.cx !== undefined ? coord(a.cx) : center,
        cy = a.cy !== undefined ? coord(a.cy) : center;
      gradients[id] = {
        ...base,
        type: entry.type,
        cx,
        cy,
        r: a.r !== undefined ? coord(a.r) : center,
        fx: a.fx !== undefined ? coord(a.fx) : cx,
        fy: a.fy !== undefined ? coord(a.fy) : cy,
      };
    }
  }
  return gradients;
}

export function createSVGFillMaterial(path: SVGLoadedPath): MeshBasicMaterial | null {
  const style = path.userData.style;
  if (style.fill === undefined || style.fill === "none") return null;
  const match = gradientURL.exec(style.fill);
  const texture = match ? buildGradientTexture(path.userData.gradients[match[1]], path) : null;
  const material = new MeshBasicMaterial({
    opacity: style.fillOpacity * (style.opacity || 1),
    transparent: true,
    side: Side.Double,
    depthWrite: false,
  });
  if (texture !== null) material.map = texture;
  else material.color = path.color;
  return material;
}

export function createSVGStrokeMaterial(path: SVGLoadedPath): MeshBasicMaterial | null {
  const style = path.userData.style;
  if (style.stroke === undefined || style.stroke === "none") return null;
  if (gradientURL.test(style.stroke)) console.warn("THREE.SVGLoader: Gradient strokes are not supported.");
  return new MeshBasicMaterial({
    color: new Color().setStyle(style.stroke, ColorSpace.SRGB),
    opacity: style.strokeOpacity * (style.opacity || 1),
    transparent: true,
    side: Side.Double,
    depthWrite: false,
  });
}

function buildGradientTexture(gradient: SVGGradient | undefined, path: SVGLoadedPath): CanvasTexture | null {
  if (!gradient || !Array.isArray(gradient.stops) || gradient.stops.length === 0) return null;
  const world = path.userData.transform;
  const isBBox = gradient.gradientUnits === "objectBoundingBox";
  const bbox = isBBox ? computeLocalBBox(path, world) : null;
  if (isBBox && bbox === null) return null;
  function resolvePoint(x: number, y: number, out: Vector3): void {
    out.set(x, y, 1);
    if (gradient!.gradientTransform) out.applyMatrix3(gradient!.gradientTransform);
    if (bbox) out.set(bbox.minX + out.x * bbox.width, bbox.minY + out.y * bbox.height, 1);
    if (world) out.applyMatrix3(world);
  }
  const resolution = 256;
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  let matrix: Matrix3;
  if (gradient.type === "linearGradient") {
    canvas.width = resolution;
    canvas.height = 1;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d")!;
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, resolution, 0);
    addStops(grad, gradient.stops);
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, resolution, 1);
    const p1 = new Vector3(),
      p2 = new Vector3();
    resolvePoint(gradient.x1, gradient.y1, p1);
    resolvePoint(gradient.x2, gradient.y2, p2);
    const dx = p2.x - p1.x,
      dy = p2.y - p1.y,
      len2 = dx * dx + dy * dy || 1e-20;
    const a = dx / len2,
      b = dy / len2,
      c = -(a * p1.x + b * p1.y);
    matrix = new Matrix3().set(a, b, c, 0, 0, 0.5, 0, 0, 1);
  } else {
    let { cx, cy, fx, fy, r } = gradient;
    if (gradient.gradientTransform) {
      const tmp = new Vector3().set(cx, cy, 1).applyMatrix3(gradient.gradientTransform);
      cx = tmp.x;
      cy = tmp.y;
      tmp.set(fx, fy, 1).applyMatrix3(gradient.gradientTransform);
      fx = tmp.x;
      fy = tmp.y;
    }
    if (bbox) {
      cx = bbox.minX + cx * bbox.width;
      cy = bbox.minY + cy * bbox.height;
      fx = bbox.minX + fx * bbox.width;
      fy = bbox.minY + fy * bbox.height;
      r *= Math.sqrt((bbox.width * bbox.width + bbox.height * bbox.height) / 2);
    }
    if (r <= 0) return null;
    canvas.width = resolution;
    canvas.height = resolution;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d")!;
    const minX = cx - r,
      minY = cy - r,
      span = 2 * r,
      scale = resolution / span;
    ctx.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, -minX * scale, -minY * scale);
    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(fx, fy, 0, cx, cy, r);
    addStops(grad, gradient.stops);
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(minX, minY, span, span);
    const inv = world ? world.clone().invert() : new Matrix3();
    matrix = new Matrix3().set(1 / span, 0, -minX / span, 0, 1 / span, -minY / span, 0, 0, 1).multiply(inv);
  }
  const texture = new CanvasTexture(canvas);
  texture.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB;
  texture.flipY = false;
  texture.matrixAutoUpdate = false;
  texture.matrix = matrix;
  const wrap =
    gradient.spreadMethod === "reflect"
      ? Wrapping.MirroredRepeat
      : gradient.spreadMethod === "repeat"
        ? Wrapping.Repeat
        : Wrapping.ClampToEdge;
  texture.wrapS = wrap;
  texture.wrapT = wrap;
  return texture;
}

function computeLocalBBox(
  path: SVGLoadedPath,
  world: Matrix3,
): { minX: number; minY: number; width: number; height: number } | null {
  const inv = world ? world.clone().invert() : null;
  const tmp = new Vector2(),
    box = new Box2();
  for (const subPath of path.subPaths)
    for (const point of subPath.getPoints()) {
      tmp.copy(point);
      if (inv) tmp.applyMatrix3(inv);
      box.expandByPoint(tmp);
    }
  if (box.isEmpty()) return null;
  return { minX: box.min.x, minY: box.min.y, width: box.max.x - box.min.x, height: box.max.y - box.min.y };
}

function addStops(gradient: CanvasGradient, stops: SVGGradientStop[]): void {
  const color = new Color();
  for (const stop of stops) {
    let css = stop.color;
    if (stop.opacity < 1) {
      color.setStyle(stop.color, ColorSpace.SRGB);
      const match = /rgb\(([^)]+)\)/.exec(color.getStyle(ColorSpace.SRGB));
      if (match) css = `rgba(${match[1]},${stop.opacity})`;
    }
    gradient.addColorStop(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, stop.offset)), css);
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/SVGLoader

```typescript
import { ColorSpace } from "../../constants";
import { Path } from "../../extras/core/Path";
import { ShapePath } from "../../extras/core/ShapePath";
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import type { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";
import { Matrix3 } from "../../math/Matrix3";
import { SVGStroke } from "../utils/SVGStroke";
import { parseSVGPath } from "./SVGPath";
import { createSVGFillMaterial, createSVGStrokeMaterial, parseSVGGradients } from "./SVGGradients";
import type { SVGGradients, SVGLoadedPath, SVGPathStyle } from "./SVGGradients";
import { getSVGTransformScale, parseSVGTransform, transformSVGPath } from "./SVGTransforms";

export interface SVGResult {
  paths: SVGLoadedPath[];
  gradients: SVGGradients;
  xml: Element;
}
type SVGUnit = "mm" | "cm" | "in" | "pt" | "pc" | "px";

export class SVGLoader extends Loader<SVGResult> {
  defaultDPI: number = 90;
  defaultUnit: SVGUnit = "px";

  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
  }

  load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (data: SVGResult) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (data) => {
        try {
          if (typeof data !== "string") throw new Error("SVGLoader: Expected text");
          onLoad?.(this.parse(data));
        } catch (error) {
          if (onError) onError(error);
          else console.error(error);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  parse(text: string): SVGResult {
    const xml = new DOMParser().parseFromString(text, "image/svg+xml");
    if (xml.querySelector("parsererror")) throw new Error("SVGLoader: Invalid SVG XML");
    const paths: SVGLoadedPath[] = [];
    const stylesheets: Record<string, Record<string, string>> = {};
    const inches: Record<SVGUnit, number> = {
      mm: 1 / 25.4,
      cm: 1 / 2.54,
      in: 1,
      pt: 1 / 72,
      pc: 1 / 6,
      px: 1 / this.defaultDPI,
    };
    const number = (value: string | null): number => {
      if (value === null) return NaN;
      const match = value.trim().match(/(mm|cm|in|pt|pc|px)$/);
      const unit = (match?.[1] ?? "px") as SVGUnit;
      return (parseFloat(value) * inches[unit]) / inches[this.defaultUnit];
    };
    const gradients = parseSVGGradients(xml, parseSVGTransform, number);
    const attr = (node: Element, name: string, fallback = "0"): number => number(node.getAttribute(name) || fallback);
    const parseCSS = (node: Element): void => {
      const sheet = (node as SVGStyleElement).sheet;
      if (sheet?.cssRules) {
        for (const rule of Array.from(sheet.cssRules)) {
          if (!(rule instanceof CSSStyleRule)) continue;
          const definitions: Record<string, string> = {};
          for (const property of Array.from(rule.style)) definitions[property] = rule.style.getPropertyValue(property);
          for (const selector of rule.selectorText.split(","))
            Object.assign((stylesheets[selector.trim()] ??= {}), definitions);
        }
      } else {
        const css = (node.textContent ?? "").replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, "");
        for (const match of css.matchAll(/([^{}]+)\{([^{}]*)\}/g)) {
          const definitions: Record<string, string> = {};
          for (const declaration of match[2].split(";")) {
            const colon = declaration.indexOf(":");
            if (colon !== -1) definitions[declaration.slice(0, colon).trim()] = declaration.slice(colon + 1).trim();
          }
          for (const selector of match[1].split(",")) Object.assign((stylesheets[selector.trim()] ??= {}), definitions);
        }
      }
    };
    const parseStyle = (node: Element, inherited: SVGPathStyle): SVGPathStyle => {
      const result = { ...inherited };
      const css: Record<string, string> = {};
      for (const name of (node.getAttribute("class") ?? "").split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean))
        Object.assign(css, stylesheets[`.${name}`]);
      if (node.hasAttribute("id")) Object.assign(css, stylesheets[`#${node.getAttribute("id")}`]);
      const inline = (node as SVGElement).style;
      const value = (name: string): string | undefined =>
        inline?.getPropertyValue(name) || css[name] || node.getAttribute(name) || undefined;
      const fill = value("fill");
      if (fill !== undefined) result.fill = fill;
      const stroke = value("stroke");
      if (stroke !== undefined) result.stroke = stroke;
      const fillRule = value("fill-rule");
      if (fillRule !== undefined) result.fillRule = fillRule;
      const visibility = value("visibility");
      if (visibility !== undefined) result.visibility = visibility;
      const lineJoin = value("stroke-linejoin");
      if (lineJoin !== undefined) result.strokeLineJoin = lineJoin;
      const lineCap = value("stroke-linecap");
      if (lineCap !== undefined) result.strokeLineCap = lineCap;
      const clamp = (name: string): number | undefined => {
        const v = value(name);
        return v === undefined ? undefined : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, number(v)));
      };
      const opacity = clamp("opacity");
      if (opacity !== undefined) result.opacity = opacity;
      const fillOpacity = clamp("fill-opacity");
      if (fillOpacity !== undefined) result.fillOpacity = fillOpacity;
      const strokeOpacity = clamp("stroke-opacity");
      if (strokeOpacity !== undefined) result.strokeOpacity = strokeOpacity;
      const width = value("stroke-width");
      if (width !== undefined) result.strokeWidth = Math.max(0, number(width));
      const miter = value("stroke-miterlimit");
      if (miter !== undefined) result.strokeMiterLimit = Math.max(0, number(miter));
      result.strokeColor = result.stroke ?? "#000";
      return result;
    };
    const primitive = (node: Element): ShapePath | null => {
      const path = new ShapePath();
      switch (node.nodeName) {
        case "path":
          return node.hasAttribute("d") ? parseSVGPath(node.getAttribute("d") ?? "") : null;
        case "rect": {
          const x = attr(node, "x"),
            y = attr(node, "y"),
            w = number(node.getAttribute("width")),
            h = number(node.getAttribute("height"));
          const rx = number(node.getAttribute("rx") || node.getAttribute("ry") || "0"),
            ry = number(node.getAttribute("ry") || node.getAttribute("rx") || "0"),
            b = 1 - 0.551915024494;
          path.moveTo(x + rx, y);
          path.lineTo(x + w - rx, y);
          if (rx || ry) path.bezierCurveTo(x + w - rx * b, y, x + w, y + ry * b, x + w, y + ry);
          path.lineTo(x + w, y + h - ry);
          if (rx || ry) path.bezierCurveTo(x + w, y + h - ry * b, x + w - rx * b, y + h, x + w - rx, y + h);
          path.lineTo(x + rx, y + h);
          if (rx || ry) path.bezierCurveTo(x + rx * b, y + h, x, y + h - ry * b, x, y + h - ry);
          path.lineTo(x, y + ry);
          if (rx || ry) path.bezierCurveTo(x, y + ry * b, x + rx * b, y, x + rx, y);
          return path;
        }
        case "polygon":
        case "polyline": {
          const points = node.getAttribute("points") ?? "";
          const regex =
            /([+-]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d+)?|\.\d+)(?:e[+-]?\d+)?)(?:,|\s)([+-]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d+)?|\.\d+)(?:e[+-]?\d+)?)/g;
          for (const match of points.matchAll(regex)) {
            const x = number(match[1]),
              y = number(match[2]);
            if (path.currentPath === null) path.moveTo(x, y);
            else path.lineTo(x, y);
          }
          if (path.currentPath) path.currentPath.autoClose = node.nodeName === "polygon";
          return path;
        }
        case "circle":
        case "ellipse": {
          const subpath = new Path();
          const x = attr(node, "cx"),
            y = attr(node, "cy");
          if (node.nodeName === "circle") subpath.absarc(x, y, attr(node, "r"), 0, Math.PI * 2);
          else subpath.absellipse(x, y, attr(node, "rx"), attr(node, "ry"), 0, Math.PI * 2);
          path.subPaths.push(subpath);
          return path;
        }
        case "line":
          path.moveTo(attr(node, "x1"), attr(node, "y1"));
          path.lineTo(attr(node, "x2"), attr(node, "y2"));
          return path;
        default:
          return null;
      }
    };
    const visit = (node: Element, inherited: SVGPathStyle, parent: Matrix3): void => {
      if (node.hasAttribute("filter")) console.warn("SVGLoader: Filters are not supported.");
      let transform = parent;
      if (
        node.hasAttribute("transform") ||
        (node.nodeName === "use" && (node.hasAttribute("x") || node.hasAttribute("y")))
      ) {
        const local = parseSVGTransform(node.getAttribute("transform") ?? "");
        if (node.nodeName === "use")
          local.multiply(new Matrix3().set(1, 0, attr(node, "x"), 0, 1, attr(node, "y"), 0, 0, 1));
        transform = parent.clone().multiply(local);
      }
      if (node.nodeName === "style") parseCSS(node);
      let style = inherited;
      if (
        ["svg", "g", "path", "rect", "polygon", "polyline", "circle", "ellipse", "line", "use"].includes(node.nodeName)
      )
        style = parseStyle(node, inherited);
      if (node.nodeName === "use") {
        const href = node.getAttributeNS("http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink", "href") || node.getAttribute("href") || "";
        const used = xml.getElementById(href.substring(1));
        if (used) visit(used, style, transform);
        else console.warn(`SVGLoader: 'use node' references non-existent node id: ${href.substring(1)}`);
      }
      const path = primitive(node);
      if (path) {
        if (style.fill !== undefined && style.fill !== "none" && !style.fill.startsWith("url"))
          path.color.setStyle(style.fill, ColorSpace.SRGB);
        transformSVGPath(path, transform);
        const loaded = path as SVGLoadedPath;
        loaded.userData = {
          node,
          style: { ...style, strokeWidth: style.strokeWidth * getSVGTransformScale(transform) },
          transform: transform.clone(),
          gradients,
        };
        paths.push(loaded);
      }
      for (const child of Array.from(node.children)) {
        if (node.nodeName === "defs" && child.nodeName !== "style" && child.nodeName !== "defs") continue;
        visit(child, style, transform);
      }
    };
    visit(
      xml.documentElement,
      {
        fill: "#000",
        fillOpacity: 1,
        strokeOpacity: 1,
        strokeWidth: 1,
        strokeLineJoin: "miter",
        strokeLineCap: "butt",
        strokeMiterLimit: 4,
        strokeColor: "#000",
      },
      new Matrix3(),
    );
    return { paths, gradients, xml: xml.documentElement };
  }

  static createFillMaterial(path: SVGLoadedPath) {
    return createSVGFillMaterial(path);
  }
  static createStrokeMaterial(path: SVGLoadedPath) {
    return createSVGStrokeMaterial(path);
  }
  static createShapes(path: ShapePath) {
    return path.toShapes();
  }
  static getStrokeStyle(...args: Parameters<typeof SVGStroke.getStrokeStyle>) {
    return SVGStroke.getStrokeStyle(...args);
  }
  static pointsToStroke(...args: Parameters<typeof SVGStroke.pointsToStroke>) {
    return SVGStroke.pointsToStroke(...args);
  }
  static pointsToStrokeWithBuffers(...args: Parameters<typeof SVGStroke.pointsToStrokeWithBuffers>) {
    return SVGStroke.pointsToStrokeWithBuffers(...args);
  }
}
