## ek3d/addons/loaders/SVGPath

```typescript
import { ShapePath } from "../../extras/core/ShapePath";
import { Vector2 } from "../../math/Vector2";

function angle(ux: number, uy: number, vx: number, vy: number): number {
  const dot = ux * vx + uy * vy;
  const length = Math.sqrt(ux * ux + uy * uy) * Math.sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy);
  const value = Math.acos(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, dot / length)));
  return ux * vy - uy * vx < 0 ? -value : value;
}

function arc(
  path: ShapePath,
  rx: number,
  ry: number,
  rotation: number,
  large: number,
  sweep: number,
  start: Vector2,
  end: Vector2,
): void {
  if (rx === 0 || ry === 0) {
    path.lineTo(end.x, end.y);
    return;
  }
  rotation = (rotation * Math.PI) / 180;
  rx = Math.abs(rx);
  ry = Math.abs(ry);
  const cos = Math.cos(rotation),
    sin = Math.sin(rotation);
  const dx = (start.x - end.x) / 2,
    dy = (start.y - end.y) / 2;
  const xp = cos * dx + sin * dy,
    yp = -sin * dx + cos * dy;
  let rxs = rx * rx,
    rys = ry * ry;
  const xps = xp * xp,
    yps = yp * yp;
  const ratio = xps / rxs + yps / rys;
  if (ratio > 1) {
    const scale = Math.sqrt(ratio);
    rx *= scale;
    ry *= scale;
    rxs = rx * rx;
    rys = ry * ry;
  }
  const denominator = rxs * yps + rys * xps;
  let q = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, (rxs * rys - denominator) / denominator));
  if (large === sweep) q = -q;
  const cxp = (q * rx * yp) / ry,
    cyp = (-q * ry * xp) / rx;
  const cx = cos * cxp - sin * cyp + (start.x + end.x) / 2;
  const cy = sin * cxp + cos * cyp + (start.y + end.y) / 2;
  const theta = angle(1, 0, (xp - cxp) / rx, (yp - cyp) / ry);
  const delta = angle((xp - cxp) / rx, (yp - cyp) / ry, (-xp - cxp) / rx, (-yp - cyp) / ry) % (Math.PI * 2);
  path.currentPath!.absellipse(cx, cy, rx, ry, theta, theta + delta, sweep === 0, rotation);
}

/** Parses SVG path data into a ShapePath. */
export function parseSVGPath(data: string): ShapePath | null {
  if (data === "" || data === "none") return null;
  const path = new ShapePath(),
    point = new Vector2(),
    control = new Vector2(),
    first = new Vector2();
  let closed = false;
  for (const command of data.match(/[a-df-z][^a-df-z]*/gi) || []) {
    const type = command[0],
      upper = type.toUpperCase(),
      relative = type !== upper;
    if (closed) {
      if (upper !== "M" && upper !== "Z") path.moveTo(first.x, first.y);
      closed = false;
    }
    if (upper === "Z") {
      if (path.currentPath) {
        path.currentPath.autoClose = true;
        if (path.currentPath.curves.length) {
          point.copy(first);
          path.currentPath.currentPoint.copy(point);
          closed = true;
        }
      }
      continue;
    }
    const stride =
      upper === "H" || upper === "V"
        ? 1
        : upper === "C"
          ? 6
          : upper === "S" || upper === "Q"
            ? 4
            : upper === "A"
              ? 7
              : 2;
    const text = command.slice(1),
      values: number[] = [];
    let index = 0,
      comma = false;
    while (index < text.length) {
      while (index < text.length && /\s/.test(text[index])) index++;
      if (text[index] === ",") {
        if (values.length === 0 || comma) throw new SyntaxError(`Invalid SVG path comma at ${index}`);
        comma = true;
        index++;
        continue;
      }
      if (index >= text.length) break;
      const flag = upper === "A" && (values.length % stride === 3 || values.length % stride === 4);
      const match = flag
        ? /^[01]/.exec(text.slice(index))
        : /^[+-]?(?:\d*\.\d+|\d+\.?\d*)(?:e[+-]?\d+)?/i.exec(text.slice(index));
      if (!match) throw new SyntaxError(`Invalid SVG path number at ${index}`);
      if (match[0].endsWith(".") && text[index + match[0].length] === ".")
        throw new SyntaxError(`Invalid SVG path decimal at ${index}`);
      values.push(Number(match[0]));
      index += match[0].length;
      comma = false;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i + stride <= values.length; i += stride) {
      const x = point.x,
        y = point.y;
      const px = (offset: number): number => values[i + offset] + (relative ? x : 0);
      const py = (offset: number): number => values[i + offset] + (relative ? y : 0);
      switch (upper) {
        case "M":
          point.set(px(0), py(1));
          if (i === 0) {
            path.moveTo(point.x, point.y);
            first.copy(point);
          } else path.lineTo(point.x, point.y);
          control.copy(point);
          break;
        case "L":
          point.set(px(0), py(1));
          path.lineTo(point.x, point.y);
          control.copy(point);
          break;
        case "H":
          point.x = px(0);
          path.lineTo(point.x, point.y);
          control.copy(point);
          break;
        case "V":
          point.y = py(0);
          path.lineTo(point.x, point.y);
          control.copy(point);
          break;
        case "C":
          path.bezierCurveTo(px(0), py(1), px(2), py(3), px(4), py(5));
          control.set(px(2), py(3));
          point.set(px(4), py(5));
          break;
        case "S":
          path.bezierCurveTo(2 * x - control.x, 2 * y - control.y, px(0), py(1), px(2), py(3));
          control.set(px(0), py(1));
          point.set(px(2), py(3));
          break;
        case "Q":
          path.quadraticCurveTo(px(0), py(1), px(2), py(3));
          control.set(px(0), py(1));
          point.set(px(2), py(3));
          break;
        case "T": {
          const cx = 2 * x - control.x,
            cy = 2 * y - control.y;
          path.quadraticCurveTo(cx, cy, px(0), py(1));
          control.set(cx, cy);
          point.set(px(0), py(1));
          break;
        }
        case "A": {
          const end = new Vector2(px(5), py(6));
          if (!point.equals(end)) {
            arc(path, values[i], values[i + 1], values[i + 2], values[i + 3], values[i + 4], point, end);
            point.copy(end);
            control.copy(point);
          }
          break;
        }
        default:
          console.warn(command);
          break;
      }
    }
  }
  return path;
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/SVGTransforms

```typescript
import type { ShapePath } from "../../extras/core/ShapePath";
import { LineCurve } from "../../extras/curves/LineCurve";
import { CubicBezierCurve } from "../../extras/curves/CubicBezierCurve";
import { QuadraticBezierCurve } from "../../extras/curves/QuadraticBezierCurve";
import { EllipseCurve } from "../../extras/curves/EllipseCurve";
import { Matrix3 } from "../../math/Matrix3";
import { Vector2 } from "../../math/Vector2";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";

export function parseSVGTransform(text: string): Matrix3 {
  const transform = new Matrix3();
  const current = new Matrix3();
  const temp1 = new Matrix3();
  const temp2 = new Matrix3();
  const parts = text.split(")");
  for (let i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const part = parts[i].trim();
    const open = part.indexOf("(");
    if (open <= 0 || open >= part.length) continue;
    const values = (part.slice(open + 1).match(/[+-]?(?:\d*\.\d+|\d+\.?\d*)(?:e[+-]?\d+)?/gi) || []).map(Number);
    current.identity();
    switch (part.slice(0, open)) {
      case "translate":
        if (values.length >= 1) current.makeTranslation(values[0], values.length >= 2 ? values[1] : 0);
        break;
      case "rotate":
        if (values.length >= 1) {
          const cx = values.length >= 3 ? values[1] : 0;
          const cy = values.length >= 3 ? values[2] : 0;
          temp1.makeTranslation(-cx, -cy);
          temp2.makeRotation((values[0] * Math.PI) / 180).multiply(temp1);
          current.makeTranslation(cx, cy).multiply(temp2);
        }
        break;
      case "scale":
        if (values.length >= 1) current.makeScale(values[0], values.length >= 2 ? values[1] : values[0]);
        break;
      case "skewX":
        if (values.length === 1) current.set(1, Math.tan((values[0] * Math.PI) / 180), 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1);
        break;
      case "skewY":
        if (values.length === 1) current.set(1, 0, 0, Math.tan((values[0] * Math.PI) / 180), 1, 0, 0, 0, 1);
        break;
      case "matrix":
        if (values.length === 6) current.set(values[0], values[2], values[4], values[1], values[3], values[5], 0, 0, 1);
        break;
    }
    transform.premultiply(current);
  }
  return transform;
}

function isFlipped(matrix: Matrix3): boolean {
  const e = matrix.elements;
  return e[0] * e[4] - e[1] * e[3] < 0;
}

function scaleX(matrix: Matrix3): number {
  const e = matrix.elements;
  return Math.sqrt(e[0] * e[0] + e[1] * e[1]);
}

function scaleY(matrix: Matrix3): number {
  const e = matrix.elements;
  return Math.sqrt(e[3] * e[3] + e[4] * e[4]);
}

function isSkewed(matrix: Matrix3): boolean {
  const e = matrix.elements;
  const dot = e[0] * e[3] + e[1] * e[4];
  return dot !== 0 && Math.abs(dot / (scaleX(matrix) * scaleY(matrix))) > Number.EPSILON;
}

export function getSVGTransformScale(matrix: Matrix3): number {
  const e = matrix.elements;
  return Math.sqrt(Math.abs(e[0] * e[4] - e[1] * e[3]));
}

function eigenDecomposition(a: number, b: number, c: number): { rt1: number; rt2: number; cs: number; sn: number } {
  let rt1 = NaN,
    rt2: number,
    cs: number,
    sn: number,
    t: number;
  const sm = a + c,
    df = a - c;
  const rt = Math.sqrt(df * df + 4 * b * b);
  if (sm > 0) {
    rt1 = 0.5 * (sm + rt);
    t = 1 / rt1;
    rt2 = a * t * c - b * t * b;
  } else if (sm < 0) {
    rt2 = 0.5 * (sm - rt);
  } else {
    rt1 = 0.5 * rt;
    rt2 = -0.5 * rt;
  }
  cs = df > 0 ? df + rt : df - rt;
  if (Math.abs(cs) > 2 * Math.abs(b)) {
    t = (-2 * b) / cs;
    sn = 1 / Math.sqrt(1 + t * t);
    cs = t * sn;
  } else if (Math.abs(b) === 0) {
    cs = 1;
    sn = 0;
  } else {
    t = (-0.5 * cs) / b;
    cs = 1 / Math.sqrt(1 + t * t);
    sn = t * cs;
  }
  if (df > 0) {
    t = cs;
    cs = -sn;
    sn = t;
  }
  return { rt1, rt2, cs, sn };
}

function transformEllipseGeneric(curve: EllipseCurve, matrix: Matrix3): void {
  const cos = Math.cos(curve.aRotation),
    sin = Math.sin(curve.aRotation);
  const f1 = new Vector3(curve.xRadius * cos, curve.xRadius * sin, 0).applyMatrix3(matrix);
  const f2 = new Vector3(-curve.yRadius * sin, curve.yRadius * cos, 0).applyMatrix3(matrix);
  const f = new Matrix3().set(f1.x, f2.x, 0, f1.y, f2.y, 0, 0, 0, 1);
  const inv = new Matrix3().copy(f).invert();
  const q = new Matrix3().copy(inv).transpose().multiply(inv).elements;
  const ed = eigenDecomposition(q[0], q[1], q[4]);
  const r1 = Math.sqrt(ed.rt1),
    r2 = Math.sqrt(ed.rt2);
  curve.xRadius = 1 / r1;
  curve.yRadius = 1 / r2;
  curve.aRotation = Math.atan2(ed.sn, ed.cs);
  const isFullEllipse = (curve.aEndAngle - curve.aStartAngle) % (2 * Math.PI) < Number.EPSILON;
  if (!isFullEllipse) {
    const drf = new Matrix3()
      .set(r1, 0, 0, 0, r2, 0, 0, 0, 1)
      .multiply(new Matrix3().set(ed.cs, ed.sn, 0, -ed.sn, ed.cs, 0, 0, 0, 1))
      .multiply(f);
    const transformAngle = (phi: number): number => {
      const v = new Vector3(Math.cos(phi), Math.sin(phi), 0).applyMatrix3(drf);
      return Math.atan2(v.y, v.x);
    };
    curve.aStartAngle = transformAngle(curve.aStartAngle);
    curve.aEndAngle = transformAngle(curve.aEndAngle);
    if (isFlipped(matrix)) curve.aClockwise = !curve.aClockwise;
  }
}

function transformEllipseNoSkew(curve: EllipseCurve, matrix: Matrix3): void {
  const sx = scaleX(matrix),
    sy = scaleY(matrix);
  curve.xRadius *= sx;
  curve.yRadius *= sy;
  const e = matrix.elements;
  curve.aRotation += sx > Number.EPSILON ? Math.atan2(e[1], e[0]) : Math.atan2(-e[3], e[4]);
  if (isFlipped(matrix)) {
    curve.aStartAngle *= -1;
    curve.aEndAngle *= -1;
    curve.aClockwise = !curve.aClockwise;
  }
}

export function transformSVGPath(path: ShapePath, matrix: Matrix3): void {
  const center = new Vector2();
  for (const subPath of path.subPaths) {
    for (const curve of subPath.curves) {
      if (curve instanceof LineCurve) {
        curve.v1.applyMatrix3(matrix);
        curve.v2.applyMatrix3(matrix);
      } else if (curve instanceof CubicBezierCurve) {
        curve.v0.applyMatrix3(matrix);
        curve.v1.applyMatrix3(matrix);
        curve.v2.applyMatrix3(matrix);
        curve.v3.applyMatrix3(matrix);
      } else if (curve instanceof QuadraticBezierCurve) {
        curve.v0.applyMatrix3(matrix);
        curve.v1.applyMatrix3(matrix);
        curve.v2.applyMatrix3(matrix);
      } else if (curve instanceof EllipseCurve) {
        center.set(curve.aX, curve.aY).applyMatrix3(matrix);
        curve.aX = center.x;
        curve.aY = center.y;
        if (isSkewed(matrix)) transformEllipseGeneric(curve, matrix);
        else transformEllipseNoSkew(curve, matrix);
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/TDSLoader

````typescript
import { Blending, Side } from "../../constants";
import { Float32BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import { LoaderUtils } from "../../loaders/LoaderUtils";
import type { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";
import { TextureLoader } from "../../loaders/TextureLoader";
import { MeshPhongMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshPhongMaterial";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Matrix4 } from "../../math/Matrix4";
import { Group } from "../../objects/Group";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import type { Texture } from "../../textures/Texture";

type TDSMesh = Mesh<MeshPhongMaterial | MeshPhongMaterial[]>;

/**
 * A loader for the 3DS format, based on lib3ds.
 *
 * Loads geometry with uv and materials basic properties with texture support.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { TDSLoader } from "ek3d/addons/loaders/TDSLoader";
 *
 * const loader = new TDSLoader();
 * loader.setResourcePath("models/3ds/portalgun/textures/");
 * const object = await loader.loadAsync("models/3ds/portalgun/portalgun.3ds");
 * scene.add(object);
 * ```
 */
export class TDSLoader extends Loader<Group, string> {
  /** Whether loader-level diagnostics are logged. Chunk-level diagnostics stay silent, matching upstream. */
  debug: boolean = false;

  private group: Group = new Group();
  private materials: Record<string, MeshPhongMaterial> = {};
  private meshes: TDSMesh[] = [];

  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
  }

  override load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (group: Group) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const path = this.path === "" ? LoaderUtils.extractUrlBase(url) : this.path;

    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);

    loader.load(
      url,
      (data: unknown) => {
        try {
          onLoad?.(this.parse(data as ArrayBuffer, path));
        } catch (error) {
          if (onError !== undefined) onError(error);
          else console.error(error);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  /**
   * Parses the given 3DS data and returns the resulting object graph.
   *
   * @param arraybuffer - The raw 3DS data as an array buffer.
   * @param path - The asset path.
   * @return The parsed asset represented as a group.
   */
  parse(arraybuffer: ArrayBuffer, path: string): Group {
    this.group = new Group();
    this.materials = {};
    this.meshes = [];

    this.readFile(arraybuffer, path);

    const group = this.group;
    for (const mesh of this.meshes) group.add(mesh);

    return group;
  }

  /** Reads the top-level 3DS chunks. */
  private readFile(arraybuffer: ArrayBuffer, path: string): void {
    const data = new DataView(arraybuffer);
    const chunk = new Chunk(data, 0);

    if (chunk.id === MLIBMAGIC || chunk.id === CMAGIC || chunk.id === M3DMAGIC) {
      let next = chunk.readChunk();

      while (next !== null) {
        if (next.id === M3D_VERSION) {
          const version = next.readDWord();
          this.debugMessage("3DS file version: " + version);
        } else if (next.id === MDATA) {
          this.readMeshData(next, path);
        } else {
          this.debugMessage("Unknown main chunk: " + next.hexId);
        }

        next = chunk.readChunk();
      }
    }

    this.debugMessage("Parsed " + this.meshes.length + " meshes");
  }

  private readMeshData(chunk: Chunk, path: string): void {
    let next = chunk.readChunk();

    while (next !== null) {
      if (next.id === MESH_VERSION) {
        const version = +next.readDWord();
        this.debugMessage("Mesh Version: " + version);
      } else if (next.id === MASTER_SCALE) {
        const scale = next.readFloat();
        this.debugMessage("Master scale: " + scale);
        this.group.scale.set(scale, scale, scale);
      } else if (next.id === NAMED_OBJECT) {
        this.debugMessage("Named Object");
        this.readNamedObject(next);
      } else if (next.id === MAT_ENTRY) {
        this.debugMessage("Material");
        this.readMaterialEntry(next, path);
      } else {
        this.debugMessage("Unknown MDATA chunk: " + next.hexId);
      }

      next = chunk.readChunk();
    }
  }

  private readNamedObject(chunk: Chunk): void {
    const name = chunk.readString();

    let next = chunk.readChunk();
    while (next !== null) {
      if (next.id === N_TRI_OBJECT) {
        const mesh = this.readMesh(next);
        mesh.name = name;
        this.meshes.push(mesh);
      } else {
        this.debugMessage("Unknown named objet chunk: " + next.hexId);
      }

      next = chunk.readChunk();
    }
  }

  private readMaterialEntry(chunk: Chunk, path: string): void {
    let next = chunk.readChunk();
    const material = new MeshPhongMaterial();

    while (next !== null) {
      if (next.id === MAT_NAME) {
        material.name = next.readString();
        this.debugMessage("   Name: " + material.name);
      } else if (next.id === MAT_WIRE) {
        this.debugMessage("   Wireframe");
        material.wireframe = true;
      } else if (next.id === MAT_WIRE_SIZE) {
        const value = next.readByte();
        material.wireframeLinewidth = value;
        this.debugMessage("   Wireframe Thickness: " + value);
      } else if (next.id === MAT_TWO_SIDE) {
        material.side = Side.Double;
        this.debugMessage("   DoubleSided");
      } else if (next.id === MAT_ADDITIVE) {
        this.debugMessage("   Additive Blending");
        material.blending = Blending.Additive;
      } else if (next.id === MAT_DIFFUSE) {
        this.debugMessage("   Diffuse Color");
        material.color = this.readColor(next);
      } else if (next.id === MAT_SPECULAR) {
        this.debugMessage("   Specular Color");
        material.specular = this.readColor(next);
      } else if (next.id === MAT_AMBIENT) {
        this.debugMessage("   Ambient color");
        material.color = this.readColor(next);
      } else if (next.id === MAT_SHININESS) {
        const shininess = this.readPercentage(next);
        material.shininess = shininess * 100;
        this.debugMessage("   Shininess : " + shininess);
      } else if (next.id === MAT_TRANSPARENCY) {
        const transparency = this.readPercentage(next);
        material.opacity = 1 - transparency;
        this.debugMessage("  Transparency : " + transparency);
        material.transparent = material.opacity < 1;
      } else if (next.id === MAT_TEXMAP) {
        this.debugMessage("   ColorMap");
        material.map = this.readMap(next, path);
      } else if (next.id === MAT_BUMPMAP) {
        this.debugMessage("   BumpMap");
        material.bumpMap = this.readMap(next, path);
      } else if (next.id === MAT_OPACMAP) {
        this.debugMessage("   OpacityMap");
        material.alphaMap = this.readMap(next, path);
      } else if (next.id === MAT_SPECMAP) {
        this.debugMessage("   SpecularMap");
        material.specularMap = this.readMap(next, path);
      } else {
        this.debugMessage("   Unknown material chunk: " + next.hexId);
      }

      next = chunk.readChunk();
    }

    this.materials[material.name] = material;
  }

  private readMesh(chunk: Chunk): TDSMesh {
    let next = chunk.readChunk();

    const geometry = new BufferGeometry();

    const material = new MeshPhongMaterial();
    const mesh = new Mesh<MeshPhongMaterial | MeshPhongMaterial[]>(geometry, material);
    mesh.name = "mesh";

    while (next !== null) {
      if (next.id === POINT_ARRAY) {
        const points = next.readWord();
        this.debugMessage("   Vertex: " + points);

        const vertices: number[] = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < points; i++) {
          vertices.push(next.readFloat(), next.readFloat(), next.readFloat());
        }

        geometry.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(vertices, 3));
      } else if (next.id === FACE_ARRAY) {
        this.readFaceArray(next, mesh);
      } else if (next.id === TEX_VERTS) {
        const texels = next.readWord();
        this.debugMessage("   UV: " + texels);

        const uvs: number[] = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < texels; i++) {
          uvs.push(next.readFloat(), next.readFloat());
        }

        geometry.setAttribute("uv", new Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2));
      } else if (next.id === MESH_MATRIX) {
        this.debugMessage("   Transformation Matrix (TODO)");
        const values: number[] = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) values[i] = next.readFloat();

        const matrix = new Matrix4();

        // X Line
        matrix.elements[0] = values[0];
        matrix.elements[1] = values[6];
        matrix.elements[2] = values[3];
        matrix.elements[3] = values[9];

        // Y Line
        matrix.elements[4] = values[2];
        matrix.elements[5] = values[8];
        matrix.elements[6] = values[5];
        matrix.elements[7] = values[11];

        // Z Line
        matrix.elements[8] = values[1];
        matrix.elements[9] = values[7];
        matrix.elements[10] = values[4];
        matrix.elements[11] = values[10];

        // W Line
        matrix.elements[12] = 0;
        matrix.elements[13] = 0;
        matrix.elements[14] = 0;
        matrix.elements[15] = 1;

        matrix.transpose();

        const inverse = new Matrix4();
        inverse.copy(matrix).invert();
        geometry.applyMatrix4(inverse);

        matrix.decompose(mesh.position, mesh.quaternion, mesh.scale);
      } else {
        this.debugMessage("   Unknown mesh chunk: " + next.hexId);
      }

      next = chunk.readChunk();
    }

    geometry.computeVertexNormals();

    return mesh;
  }

  private readFaceArray(chunk: Chunk, mesh: TDSMesh): void {
    const faces = chunk.readWord();
    this.debugMessage("   Faces: " + faces);

    const index: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < faces; ++i) {
      index.push(chunk.readWord(), chunk.readWord(), chunk.readWord());
      chunk.readWord(); // visibility
    }

    mesh.geometry.setIndex(index);

    // The rest of the FACE_ARRAY chunk is subchunks.

    let materialIndex = 0;
    let start = 0;

    while (!chunk.endOfChunk) {
      // A FACE_ARRAY sub-chunk header that cannot be read means the index table is corrupt.
      const subchunk = chunk.readChunk();
      if (subchunk === null) throw new Error("THREE.TDSLoader: unable to read a FACE_ARRAY sub-chunk.");

      if (subchunk.id === MSH_MAT_GROUP) {
        this.debugMessage("      Material Group");

        const group = this.readMaterialGroup(subchunk);
        const count = group.index.length * 3; // assuming successive indices

        mesh.geometry.addGroup(start, count, materialIndex);

        start += count;
        materialIndex++;

        const material = this.materials[group.name];
        const materials = Array.isArray(mesh.material) ? mesh.material : (mesh.material = []);
        if (material !== undefined) materials.push(material);
      } else {
        this.debugMessage("      Unknown face array chunk: " + subchunk.hexId);
      }
    }

    // For backwards compatibility a single material group yields a plain material.
    if (Array.isArray(mesh.material) && mesh.material.length === 1) mesh.material = mesh.material[0];
  }

  private readMap(chunk: Chunk, path: string): Texture | null {
    let next = chunk.readChunk();
    let texture: Texture | null = null;

    const loader = new TextureLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.resourcePath || path).setCrossOrigin(this.crossOrigin);

    // A transform before MAT_MAPNAME is malformed; upstream threw when it mutated its placeholder.
    const mapped = (): Texture => {
      if (texture === null) throw new Error("THREE.TDSLoader: map transform before MAT_MAPNAME.");
      return texture;
    };

    while (next !== null) {
      if (next.id === MAT_MAPNAME) {
        const name = next.readString();
        texture = loader.load(name);
        this.debugMessage("      File: " + path + name);
      } else if (next.id === MAT_MAP_UOFFSET) {
        const offset = next.readFloat();
        mapped().offset.x = offset;
        this.debugMessage("      OffsetX: " + offset);
      } else if (next.id === MAT_MAP_VOFFSET) {
        const offset = next.readFloat();
        mapped().offset.y = offset;
        this.debugMessage("      OffsetY: " + offset);
      } else if (next.id === MAT_MAP_USCALE) {
        const scale = next.readFloat();
        mapped().repeat.x = scale;
        this.debugMessage("      RepeatX: " + scale);
      } else if (next.id === MAT_MAP_VSCALE) {
        const scale = next.readFloat();
        mapped().repeat.y = scale;
        this.debugMessage("      RepeatY: " + scale);
      } else {
        this.debugMessage("      Unknown map chunk: " + next.hexId);
      }

      next = chunk.readChunk();
    }

    return texture;
  }

  private readMaterialGroup(chunk: Chunk): { name: string; index: number[] } {
    const name = chunk.readString();
    const numFaces = chunk.readWord();

    this.debugMessage("         Name: " + name);
    this.debugMessage("         Faces: " + numFaces);

    const index: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < numFaces; ++i) index.push(chunk.readWord());

    return { name, index };
  }

  private readColor(chunk: Chunk): Color {
    const subChunk = chunk.readChunk();
    const color = new Color();
    if (subChunk === null) return color;

    if (subChunk.id === COLOR_24 || subChunk.id === LIN_COLOR_24) {
      const r = subChunk.readByte();
      const g = subChunk.readByte();
      const b = subChunk.readByte();

      color.setRGB(r / 255, g / 255, b / 255);
      this.debugMessage("      Color: " + color.r + ", " + color.g + ", " + color.b);
    } else if (subChunk.id === COLOR_F || subChunk.id === LIN_COLOR_F) {
      const r = subChunk.readFloat();
      const g = subChunk.readFloat();
      const b = subChunk.readFloat();

      color.setRGB(r, g, b);
      this.debugMessage("      Color: " + color.r + ", " + color.g + ", " + color.b);
    } else {
      this.debugMessage("      Unknown color chunk: " + subChunk.hexId);
    }

    return color;
  }

  private readPercentage(chunk: Chunk): number {
    const subChunk = chunk.readChunk();
    if (subChunk === null) return 0;

    switch (subChunk.id) {
      case INT_PERCENTAGE:
        return subChunk.readShort() / 100;
      case FLOAT_PERCENTAGE:
        return subChunk.readFloat();
      default:
        this.debugMessage("      Unknown percentage chunk: " + subChunk.hexId);
        return 0;
    }
  }

  private debugMessage(message: string): void {
    if (this.debug) console.log(message);
  }
}

/**
 * Reads data and sub-chunks from a 3DS chunk.
 *
 * Upstream replaced its own diagnostics callback with a no-op, so chunk-level
 * messages never reach the console; this port drops them instead of keeping dead plumbing.
 */
class Chunk {
  data: DataView;
  /** The offset of the beginning of this chunk. */
  offset: number;
  /** The current reading position. */
  position: number;
  id: number;
  size: number;
  end: number;

  constructor(data: DataView, position: number) {
    this.data = data;
    this.offset = position;
    this.position = position;

    this.id = this.readWord();
    this.size = this.readDWord();
    this.end = this.offset + this.size;
  }

  /** Reads and advances over the next sub-chunk, or returns `null` when none can be read. */
  readChunk(): Chunk | null {
    if (this.endOfChunk) return null;

    try {
      const next = new Chunk(this.data, this.position);
      this.position += next.size;
      return next;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  get hexId(): string {
    return this.id.toString(16);
  }

  get endOfChunk(): boolean {
    return this.position >= this.end;
  }

  readByte(): number {
    const v = this.data.getUint8(this.position);
    this.position += 1;
    return v;
  }

  readFloat(): number {
    try {
      const v = this.data.getFloat32(this.position, true);
      this.position += 4;
      return v;
    } catch {
      return 0;
    }
  }

  readShort(): number {
    const v = this.data.getInt16(this.position, true);
    this.position += 2;
    return v;
  }

  readDWord(): number {
    const v = this.data.getUint32(this.position, true);
    this.position += 4;
    return v;
  }

  readWord(): number {
    const v = this.data.getUint16(this.position, true);
    this.position += 2;
    return v;
  }

  /** Reads a NULL terminated ASCII string from the current position. */
  readString(): string {
    let s = "";
    let c = this.readByte();
    while (c) {
      s += String.fromCharCode(c);
      c = this.readByte();
    }
    return s;
  }
}

const M3DMAGIC = 0x4d4d;
const MLIBMAGIC = 0x3daa;
const CMAGIC = 0xc23d;
const M3D_VERSION = 0x0002;
const COLOR_F = 0x0010;
const COLOR_24 = 0x0011;
const LIN_COLOR_24 = 0x0012;
const LIN_COLOR_F = 0x0013;
const INT_PERCENTAGE = 0x0030;
const FLOAT_PERCENTAGE = 0x0031;
const MDATA = 0x3d3d;
const MESH_VERSION = 0x3d3e;
const MASTER_SCALE = 0x0100;
const MAT_ENTRY = 0xafff;
const MAT_NAME = 0xa000;
const MAT_AMBIENT = 0xa010;
const MAT_DIFFUSE = 0xa020;
const MAT_SPECULAR = 0xa030;
const MAT_SHININESS = 0xa040;
const MAT_TRANSPARENCY = 0xa050;
const MAT_TWO_SIDE = 0xa081;
const MAT_ADDITIVE = 0xa083;
const MAT_WIRE = 0xa085;
const MAT_WIRE_SIZE = 0xa087;
const MAT_TEXMAP = 0xa200;
const MAT_OPACMAP = 0xa210;
const MAT_BUMPMAP = 0xa230;
const MAT_SPECMAP = 0xa204;
const MAT_MAPNAME = 0xa300;
const MAT_MAP_USCALE = 0xa354;
const MAT_MAP_VSCALE = 0xa356;
const MAT_MAP_UOFFSET = 0xa358;
const MAT_MAP_VOFFSET = 0xa35a;
const NAMED_OBJECT = 0x4000;
const N_TRI_OBJECT = 0x4100;
const POINT_ARRAY = 0x4110;
const FACE_ARRAY = 0x4120;
const MSH_MAT_GROUP = 0x4130;
const TEX_VERTS = 0x4140;
const MESH_MATRIX = 0x4160;
````

## ek3d/addons/loaders/TGALoader

````typescript
import { DataTextureLoader } from "../../loaders/DataTextureLoader";
import type { DataTextureData } from "../../loaders/DataTextureLoader";
import type { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";
import { TextureFilter } from "../../constants";

const TGA_TYPE_NO_DATA = 0;
const TGA_TYPE_INDEXED = 1;
const TGA_TYPE_RGB = 2;
const TGA_TYPE_GREY = 3;
const TGA_TYPE_RLE_INDEXED = 9;
const TGA_TYPE_RLE_RGB = 10;
const TGA_TYPE_RLE_GREY = 11;

const TGA_ORIGIN_MASK = 0x30;
const TGA_ORIGIN_SHIFT = 0x04;
const TGA_ORIGIN_BL = 0x00;
const TGA_ORIGIN_BR = 0x01;
const TGA_ORIGIN_UL = 0x02;
const TGA_ORIGIN_UR = 0x03;

interface TgaHeader {
  id_length: number;
  colormap_type: number;
  image_type: number;
  colormap_index: number;
  colormap_length: number;
  colormap_size: number;
  origin: number[];
  width: number;
  height: number;
  pixel_size: number;
  flags: number;
}

/** Copies one source image into the RGBA destination honouring the header's origin flags. */
type RowWriter = (
  imageData: Uint8Array,
  yStart: number,
  yStep: number,
  yEnd: number,
  xStart: number,
  xStep: number,
  xEnd: number,
  image: Uint8Array,
  palettes: Uint8Array | undefined,
) => void;

/**
 * A loader for the TGA texture format.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { TGALoader } from "ek3d/addons/loaders/TGALoader";
 * import { ColorSpace } from "ek3d/constants";
 *
 * const texture = await new TGALoader().loadAsync("textures/crate_color8.tga");
 * texture.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB; // only for color textures
 * ```
 */
export class TGALoader extends DataTextureLoader {
  /**
   * Constructs a new TGA loader.
   *
   * @param [manager] - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
  }

  /**
   * Parses the given TGA texture data.
   *
   * @param buffer - The raw texture data.
   * @return An object representing the parsed texture data.
   */
  parse(buffer: ArrayBuffer): DataTextureData {
    // reference from vthibault, https://github.com/vthibault/roBrowser/blob/master/src/Loaders/Targa.js
    if (buffer.byteLength < 19) throw new Error("THREE.TGALoader: Not enough data to contain header.");

    let offset = 0;
    const content = new Uint8Array(buffer);
    const header: TgaHeader = {
      id_length: content[offset++],
      colormap_type: content[offset++],
      image_type: content[offset++],
      colormap_index: content[offset++] | (content[offset++] << 8),
      colormap_length: content[offset++] | (content[offset++] << 8),
      colormap_size: content[offset++],
      origin: [content[offset++] | (content[offset++] << 8), content[offset++] | (content[offset++] << 8)],
      width: content[offset++] | (content[offset++] << 8),
      height: content[offset++] | (content[offset++] << 8),
      pixel_size: content[offset++],
      flags: content[offset++],
    };
    const width = header.width;

    function checkHeader(): void {
      switch (header.image_type) {
        // check indexed type
        case TGA_TYPE_INDEXED:
        case TGA_TYPE_RLE_INDEXED:
          if (header.colormap_length > 256 || header.colormap_size !== 24 || header.colormap_type !== 1) {
            throw new Error("THREE.TGALoader: Invalid type colormap data for indexed type.");
          }
          break;
        // check colormap type
        case TGA_TYPE_RGB:
        case TGA_TYPE_GREY:
        case TGA_TYPE_RLE_RGB:
        case TGA_TYPE_RLE_GREY:
          if (header.colormap_type) {
            throw new Error("THREE.TGALoader: Invalid type colormap data for colormap type.");
          }
          break;
        // a file without data cannot produce a texture
        case TGA_TYPE_NO_DATA:
          throw new Error("THREE.TGALoader: No data.");
        default:
          throw new Error("THREE.TGALoader: Invalid type " + header.image_type);
      }

      if (header.width <= 0 || header.height <= 0) throw new Error("THREE.TGALoader: Invalid image size.");

      if (header.pixel_size !== 8 && header.pixel_size !== 16 && header.pixel_size !== 24 && header.pixel_size !== 32) {
        throw new Error("THREE.TGALoader: Invalid pixel size " + header.pixel_size);
      }
    }

    function parsePixels(
      useRle: boolean,
      usePal: boolean,
      dataOffset: number,
      data: Uint8Array,
    ): { pixelData: Uint8Array; palettes: Uint8Array | undefined } {
      let pixelData: Uint8Array;
      let palettes: Uint8Array | undefined;

      const pixelSize = header.pixel_size >> 3;
      const pixelTotal = header.width * header.height * pixelSize;

      if (usePal) {
        palettes = data.subarray(dataOffset, (dataOffset += header.colormap_length * (header.colormap_size >> 3)));
      }

      if (useRle) {
        pixelData = new Uint8Array(pixelTotal);
        let shift = 0;
        const pixels = new Uint8Array(pixelSize);
        while (shift < pixelTotal) {
          // Truncated packet data would otherwise decode as zeroed pixels.
          if (dataOffset >= data.length) throw new Error("THREE.TGALoader: Truncated RLE image data.");
          const c = data[dataOffset++];
          let count = (c & 0x7f) + 1;
          if (c & 0x80) {
            // RLE packet: repeat one pixel
            if (dataOffset + pixelSize > data.length) throw new Error("THREE.TGALoader: Truncated RLE image data.");
            for (let i = 0; i < pixelSize; ++i) pixels[i] = data[dataOffset++];
            // A packet may not write past the destination buffer.
            if (shift + pixelSize * count > pixelTotal) {
              throw new Error("THREE.TGALoader: RLE packet exceeds the image size.");
            }
            for (let i = 0; i < count; ++i) pixelData.set(pixels, shift + i * pixelSize);
            shift += pixelSize * count;
          } else {
            // raw packet
            count *= pixelSize;
            if (dataOffset + count > data.length) throw new Error("THREE.TGALoader: Truncated RLE image data.");
            if (shift + count > pixelTotal) throw new Error("THREE.TGALoader: RLE packet exceeds the image size.");
            pixelData.set(data.subarray(dataOffset, dataOffset + count), shift);
            dataOffset += count;
            shift += count;
          }
        }
      } else {
        pixelData = data.subarray(dataOffset, (dataOffset += usePal ? header.width * header.height : pixelTotal));
      }

      return { pixelData, palettes };
    }

    const rgb8: RowWriter = (imageData, yStart, yStep, yEnd, xStart, xStep, xEnd, image, palettes) => {
      if (palettes === undefined) throw new Error("THREE.TGALoader: Missing color map for an indexed image.");
      const colormap = palettes;
      const colormapIndex = header.colormap_index;
      let i = 0;
      for (let y = yStart; y !== yEnd; y += yStep) {
        for (let x = xStart; x !== xEnd; x += xStep, i++) {
          // map from the full color map index to the stored palette index
          const index = image[i] - colormapIndex;
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 3] = 255;
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 2] = colormap[index * 3 + 0];
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 1] = colormap[index * 3 + 1];
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 0] = colormap[index * 3 + 2];
        }
      }
    };

    const rgb16: RowWriter = (imageData, yStart, yStep, yEnd, xStart, xStep, xEnd, image) => {
      let i = 0;
      for (let y = yStart; y !== yEnd; y += yStep) {
        for (let x = xStart; x !== xEnd; x += xStep, i += 2) {
          const color = image[i + 0] + (image[i + 1] << 8);
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 0] = (color & 0x7c00) >> 7;
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 1] = (color & 0x03e0) >> 2;
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 2] = (color & 0x001f) << 3;
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 3] = color & 0x8000 ? 0 : 255;
        }
      }
    };

    const rgb24: RowWriter = (imageData, yStart, yStep, yEnd, xStart, xStep, xEnd, image) => {
      let i = 0;
      for (let y = yStart; y !== yEnd; y += yStep) {
        for (let x = xStart; x !== xEnd; x += xStep, i += 3) {
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 3] = 255;
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 2] = image[i + 0];
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 1] = image[i + 1];
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 0] = image[i + 2];
        }
      }
    };

    const rgb32: RowWriter = (imageData, yStart, yStep, yEnd, xStart, xStep, xEnd, image) => {
      let i = 0;
      for (let y = yStart; y !== yEnd; y += yStep) {
        for (let x = xStart; x !== xEnd; x += xStep, i += 4) {
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 2] = image[i + 0];
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 1] = image[i + 1];
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 0] = image[i + 2];
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 3] = image[i + 3];
        }
      }
    };

    const grey8: RowWriter = (imageData, yStart, yStep, yEnd, xStart, xStep, xEnd, image) => {
      let i = 0;
      for (let y = yStart; y !== yEnd; y += yStep) {
        for (let x = xStart; x !== xEnd; x += xStep, i++) {
          const color = image[i];
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 0] = color;
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 1] = color;
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 2] = color;
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 3] = 255;
        }
      }
    };

    const grey16: RowWriter = (imageData, yStart, yStep, yEnd, xStart, xStep, xEnd, image) => {
      let i = 0;
      for (let y = yStart; y !== yEnd; y += yStep) {
        for (let x = xStart; x !== xEnd; x += xStep, i += 2) {
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 0] = image[i + 0];
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 1] = image[i + 0];
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 2] = image[i + 0];
          imageData[(x + width * y) * 4 + 3] = image[i + 1];
        }
      }
    };

    function getTgaRGBA(
      imageData: Uint8Array,
      imageWidth: number,
      imageHeight: number,
      image: Uint8Array,
      palette: Uint8Array | undefined,
      useGrey: boolean,
    ): Uint8Array {
      let xStart: number;
      let yStart: number;
      let xStep: number;
      let yStep: number;
      let xEnd: number;
      let yEnd: number;

      switch ((header.flags & TGA_ORIGIN_MASK) >> TGA_ORIGIN_SHIFT) {
        default:
        case TGA_ORIGIN_UL:
          xStart = 0;
          xStep = 1;
          xEnd = imageWidth;
          yStart = 0;
          yStep = 1;
          yEnd = imageHeight;
          break;
        case TGA_ORIGIN_BL:
          xStart = 0;
          xStep = 1;
          xEnd = imageWidth;
          yStart = imageHeight - 1;
          yStep = -1;
          yEnd = -1;
          break;
        case TGA_ORIGIN_UR:
          xStart = imageWidth - 1;
          xStep = -1;
          xEnd = -1;
          yStart = 0;
          yStep = 1;
          yEnd = imageHeight;
          break;
        case TGA_ORIGIN_BR:
          xStart = imageWidth - 1;
          xStep = -1;
          xEnd = -1;
          yStart = imageHeight - 1;
          yStep = -1;
          yEnd = -1;
          break;
      }

      let writer: RowWriter;
      if (useGrey) {
        if (header.pixel_size === 8) writer = grey8;
        else if (header.pixel_size === 16) writer = grey16;
        else throw new Error("THREE.TGALoader: Format not supported.");
      } else {
        if (header.pixel_size === 8) writer = rgb8;
        else if (header.pixel_size === 16) writer = rgb16;
        else if (header.pixel_size === 24) writer = rgb24;
        else if (header.pixel_size === 32) writer = rgb32;
        else throw new Error("THREE.TGALoader: Format not supported.");
      }
      writer(imageData, yStart, yStep, yEnd, xStart, xStep, xEnd, image, palette);
      return imageData;
    }

    checkHeader();

    if (header.id_length + offset > buffer.byteLength) throw new Error("THREE.TGALoader: No data.");

    // skip the image ID field
    offset += header.id_length;

    let useRle = false;
    let usePal = false;
    let useGrey = false;

    switch (header.image_type) {
      case TGA_TYPE_RLE_INDEXED:
        useRle = true;
        usePal = true;
        break;
      case TGA_TYPE_INDEXED:
        usePal = true;
        break;
      case TGA_TYPE_RLE_RGB:
        useRle = true;
        break;
      case TGA_TYPE_RLE_GREY:
        useRle = true;
        useGrey = true;
        break;
      case TGA_TYPE_GREY:
        useGrey = true;
        break;
    }

    const imageData = new Uint8Array(header.width * header.height * 4);
    const result = parsePixels(useRle, usePal, offset, content);
    getTgaRGBA(imageData, header.width, header.height, result.pixelData, result.palettes, useGrey);

    return {
      data: imageData,
      width: header.width,
      height: header.height,
      flipY: true,
      generateMipmaps: true,
      minFilter: TextureFilter.LinearMipmapLinear,
    };
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/loaders/TIFFLoader

```typescript
import { TextureFilter } from "../../constants";
import { DataTextureLoader } from "../../loaders/DataTextureLoader";
import type { DataTextureData } from "../../loaders/DataTextureLoader";
import type { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";

/** A TIFF image file directory decoded by UTIF. */
export interface TIFFImageDirectory {
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

/** The UTIF functions required by TIFFLoader. */
export interface TIFFRuntime {
  decode(buffer: ArrayBuffer): TIFFImageDirectory[];
  decodeImage(buffer: ArrayBuffer, directory: TIFFImageDirectory): void;
  toRGBA8(directory: TIFFImageDirectory): Uint8Array;
}

/** Loads TIFF textures using a consumer-supplied UTIF runtime. */
export class TIFFLoader extends DataTextureLoader {
  runtime: TIFFRuntime;

  constructor(runtime: TIFFRuntime, manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
    this.runtime = runtime;
  }

  override parse(buffer: ArrayBuffer): DataTextureData {
    const ifds = this.runtime.decode(buffer);
    const image = ifds[0];
    if (image === undefined) throw new Error("TIFFLoader: No image directory found.");
    this.runtime.decodeImage(buffer, image);
    const data = this.runtime.toRGBA8(image);
    return {
      width: image.width,
      height: image.height,
      data,
      flipY: true,
      magFilter: TextureFilter.Linear,
      minFilter: TextureFilter.LinearMipmapLinear,
    };
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/TTFLoader

```typescript
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import type { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";
import { error } from "../../utils";
import type { FontData, FontOriginalInformation, Glyph } from "./FontLoader";

export interface TTFCommand {
  type: string;
  x?: number;
  y?: number;
  x1?: number;
  y1?: number;
  x2?: number;
  y2?: number;
}

export interface TTFFont {
  unitsPerEm: number;
  ascender: number;
  descender: number;
  encoding: { cmap: { glyphIndexMap: Record<string, number> } };
  glyphs: {
    get(index: number): { advanceWidth: number; xMin: number; xMax: number; path: { commands: TTFCommand[] } };
  };
  tables: {
    post: { underlinePosition: number; underlineThickness: number };
    head: { xMin: number; xMax: number; yMin: number; yMax: number };
    name: unknown;
  };
  getEnglishName(name: string): string;
}

export interface TTFParser {
  parse(buffer: ArrayBuffer): TTFFont;
}

/** Converts a TrueType font to the typeface data consumed by Font. The parser is supplied by the consumer. */
export class TTFLoader extends Loader<FontData> {
  parser: TTFParser;
  reversed: boolean;

  constructor(parser: TTFParser, manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
    this.parser = parser;
    this.reversed = false;
  }

  load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (data: FontData) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (cause: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (buffer) => {
        try {
          if (!(buffer instanceof ArrayBuffer)) throw new Error("TTFLoader: Expected an ArrayBuffer response.");
          onLoad?.(this.parse(buffer));
        } catch (cause) {
          if (onError) onError(cause);
          else error(cause);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  parse(buffer: ArrayBuffer): FontData {
    const font = this.parser.parse(buffer);
    const scale = 100000 / ((font.unitsPerEm || 2048) * 72);
    const glyphs: Record<string, Glyph> = {};
    for (const [unicode, index] of Object.entries(font.encoding.cmap.glyphIndexMap)) {
      const glyph = font.glyphs.get(index);
      const commands = this.reversed ? reverseCommands(glyph.path.commands) : glyph.path.commands;
      let outline = "";
      for (const command of commands) {
        const type = command.type.toLowerCase();
        outline += (type === "c" ? "b" : type) + " ";
        if (command.x !== undefined && command.y !== undefined)
          outline += `${Math.round(command.x * scale)} ${Math.round(command.y * scale)} `;
        if (command.x1 !== undefined && command.y1 !== undefined)
          outline += `${Math.round(command.x1 * scale)} ${Math.round(command.y1 * scale)} `;
        if (command.x2 !== undefined && command.y2 !== undefined)
          outline += `${Math.round(command.x2 * scale)} ${Math.round(command.y2 * scale)} `;
      }
      glyphs[String.fromCodePoint(Number(unicode))] = {
        ha: Math.round(glyph.advanceWidth * scale),
        x_min: Math.round(glyph.xMin * scale),
        x_max: Math.round(glyph.xMax * scale),
        o: outline,
      };
    }
    return {
      glyphs,
      familyName: font.getEnglishName("fullName"),
      ascender: Math.round(font.ascender * scale),
      descender: Math.round(font.descender * scale),
      underlinePosition: font.tables.post.underlinePosition,
      underlineThickness: font.tables.post.underlineThickness,
      boundingBox: {
        xMin: font.tables.head.xMin,
        xMax: font.tables.head.xMax,
        yMin: font.tables.head.yMin,
        yMax: font.tables.head.yMax,
      },
      resolution: 1000,
      original_font_information: font.tables.name as FontOriginalInformation,
    };
  }
}

function reverseCommands(commands: TTFCommand[]): TTFCommand[] {
  const paths: TTFCommand[][] = [];
  for (const command of commands) {
    if (command.type.toLowerCase() === "m") paths.push([command]);
    else if (command.type.toLowerCase() !== "z") {
      const path = paths[paths.length - 1];
      if (path === undefined) throw new Error("TTFLoader: Outline must start with a move command.");
      path.push(command);
    }
  }
  const result: TTFCommand[] = [];
  for (const path of paths) {
    const last = path[path.length - 1];
    result.push({ type: "m", x: last.x, y: last.y });
    for (let i = path.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const command = path[i];
      const previous = path[i - 1];
      const reversed: TTFCommand = { type: command.type, x: previous.x, y: previous.y };
      if (command.x2 !== undefined && command.y2 !== undefined) {
        reversed.x1 = command.x2;
        reversed.y1 = command.y2;
        reversed.x2 = command.x1;
        reversed.y2 = command.y1;
      } else if (command.x1 !== undefined && command.y1 !== undefined) {
        reversed.x1 = command.x1;
        reversed.y1 = command.y1;
      }
      result.push(reversed);
    }
  }
  return result;
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/USDLoader

```typescript
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import { LoaderUtils } from "../../loaders/LoaderUtils";
import type { Group } from "../../objects/Group";
import { USDAParser, type USDAData } from "./usd/USDAParser";
import { USDCParser, type USDCData } from "./usd/USDCParser";
import { USDComposer } from "./usd/USDComposer";

/** ZIP decoder supplied by the application. */
export interface USDZipRuntime {
  unzipSync(data: Uint8Array): Record<string, Uint8Array>;
}

/** Loads USD, USDA, USDC and USDZ assets. */
export class USDLoader extends Loader<Group> {
  zipRuntime: USDZipRuntime | null = null;

  setZipRuntime(runtime: USDZipRuntime): this {
    this.zipRuntime = runtime;
    return this;
  }

  override load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (group: Group) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const path = this.path === "" ? LoaderUtils.extractUrlBase(url) : this.path;
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (data) => {
        try {
          this.parse(data as ArrayBuffer, path, onLoad, onError);
        } catch (error) {
          if (onError !== undefined) onError(error);
          else console.error(error);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  parse(
    buffer: ArrayBuffer | string,
    path = "",
    onLoad?: (group: Group) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): Group {
    const usda = new USDAParser();
    const usdc = new USDCParser();
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    const isCrate = (bytes: Uint8Array): boolean =>
      bytes.length >= 8 &&
      bytes[0] === 0x50 &&
      bytes[1] === 0x58 &&
      bytes[2] === 0x52 &&
      bytes[3] === 0x2d &&
      bytes[4] === 0x55 &&
      bytes[5] === 0x53 &&
      bytes[6] === 0x44 &&
      bytes[7] === 0x43;
    const composer = new USDComposer(this.manager);
    composer.imageLoader.setCrossOrigin(this.crossOrigin);
    composer.imageLoader.setPriority(this.priority);
    composer.imageLoader.setCache(this.cache);
    const finalize = (group: Group): Group => {
      if (onLoad !== undefined)
        Promise.all(composer.texturePromises)
          .then(() => onLoad(group))
          .catch((error: unknown) => {
            if (onError !== undefined) onError(error);
            else console.error(error);
          });
      return group;
    };
    if (typeof buffer === "string") return finalize(composer.compose(usda.parseData(buffer), {}, {}, path));
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
    if (isCrate(bytes)) return finalize(composer.compose(usdc.parseData(buffer), {}, {}, path));
    if (bytes[0] !== 0x50 || bytes[1] !== 0x4b)
      return finalize(composer.compose(usda.parseData(decoder.decode(bytes)), {}, {}, path));
    if (this.zipRuntime === null) throw new Error("USDLoader: ZIP runtime is required.");
    const zip = this.zipRuntime.unzipSync(bytes);
    const assets: Record<string, USDAData | USDCData | Uint8Array> = {};
    const extension = (filename: string): string => {
      const dot = filename.lastIndexOf(".");
      return dot < 0 || filename.lastIndexOf("/") > dot ? "" : filename.slice(dot + 1).toLowerCase();
    };
    for (const filename in zip) {
      const file = zip[filename];
      const ext = extension(filename);
      if (ext === "png" || ext === "jpg" || ext === "jpeg" || ext === "avif") assets[filename] = file;
      else if (ext === "usd" || ext === "usda" || ext === "usdc") {
        assets[filename] = isCrate(file)
          ? usdc.parseData(Uint8Array.from(file).buffer)
          : usda.parseData(decoder.decode(file));
      }
    }
    const filename = Object.keys(zip)[0];
    if (filename === undefined || !["usd", "usda", "usdc"].includes(extension(filename))) {
      throw new Error(
        "THREE.USDLoader: Invalid USDZ package. The first ZIP entry must be a USD layer (.usd/.usda/.usdc).",
      );
    }
    const data = assets[filename];
    if (data === undefined || data instanceof Uint8Array)
      throw new Error(`THREE.USDLoader: Failed to parse root layer "${filename}".`);
    const slash = filename.lastIndexOf("/");
    return finalize(composer.compose(data, assets, {}, slash >= 0 ? filename.slice(0, slash) : ""));
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/UltraHDRLoader

````typescript
import { Wrapping, TextureType, TextureFilter, ColorSpace, PixelFormat, Mapping } from "../../constants";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import type { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";
import { DataTexture } from "../../textures/DataTexture";
import { toHalfFloat } from "../../extras/DataUtils";
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";

/** Precalculated sRGB→linear lookup for byte-ish values 0..1023. */
export const SRGB_TO_LINEAR: Float64Array = new Float64Array(1024);
for (let i = 0; i < 1024; i++) {
  // (1/255) * 0.9478672986 = 0.003717127
  SRGB_TO_LINEAR[i] = Math.pow(i * 0.003717127 + 0.0521327014, 2.4);
}

/** Metadata shared between XMP and ISO 21496-1 sources. */
export interface UltraHDRMetadata {
  version: string | null;
  baseRenditionIsHDR: boolean | null;
  gainMapMin: number | null;
  gainMapMax: number | null;
  gamma: number | null;
  offsetSDR: number | null;
  offsetHDR: number | null;
  hdrCapacityMin: number | null;
  hdrCapacityMax: number | null;
}

/** Texture pixel payload assembled by the parser. */
export interface UltraHDRTextureData {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  data: Uint16Array | Float32Array;
  format: number;
  type: number;
}

/** JPEG segment list layout. */
interface JPEGSection {
  sectionType: number;
  section: Uint8Array;
  sectionOffset: number;
}

/**
 * A loader for the Ultra HDR Image Format.
 *
 * Existing HDR or EXR textures can be converted to Ultra HDR with this [tool](https://gainmap-creator.monogrid.com/).
 *
 * Current feature set:
 * - JPEG headers (required)
 * - XMP metadata (legacy format, supported)
 * - ISO 21496-1 metadata (current standard, supported)
 * - XMP validation (not implemented)
 * - EXIF profile (not implemented)
 * - ICC profile (not implemented)
 * - Binary storage for SDR & HDR images (required)
 * - Gainmap metadata (required)
 * - Non-JPEG image formats (not implemented)
 * - Primary image as an HDR image (not implemented)
 *
 * ```ts
 * const loader = new UltraHDRLoader();
 * const texture = await loader.loadAsync( 'textures/equirectangular/ice_planet_close.jpg' );
 * texture.mapping = Mapping.EquirectangularReflection;
 *
 * scene.background = texture;
 * scene.environment = texture;
 * ```
 *
 * @augments Loader
 */
export class UltraHDRLoader extends Loader<DataTexture, string> {
  /**
   * The texture type.
   *
   * @default TextureType.HalfFloat
   */
  type: TextureType;

  /**
   * Constructs a new Ultra HDR loader.
   *
   * @param manager - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);

    this.type = TextureType.HalfFloat;
  }

  /**
   * Sets the texture type.
   *
   * @param value - The texture type to set.
   * @return A reference to this loader.
   */
  setDataType(value: TextureType): this {
    this.type = value;

    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Parses the given Ultra HDR texture data.
   *
   * @param buffer - The raw texture data.
   * @param onLoad - The `onLoad` callback.
   */
  parse(buffer: ArrayBuffer, onLoad?: (texData: UltraHDRTextureData) => void): void {
    const metadata: UltraHDRMetadata = {
      version: null,
      baseRenditionIsHDR: null,
      gainMapMin: null,
      gainMapMax: null,
      gamma: null,
      offsetSDR: null,
      offsetHDR: null,
      hdrCapacityMin: null,
      hdrCapacityMax: null,
    };
    const textDecoder = new TextDecoder();

    const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);

    const sections: JPEGSection[] = [];

    // JPEG segment-aware scanner using length headers
    let offset = 0;

    while (offset < bytes.length - 1) {
      // Find marker prefix
      if (bytes[offset] !== 0xff) {
        offset++;
        continue;
      }

      const markerType = bytes[offset + 1];

      // SOI (0xD8) - Start of Image, no length field
      if (markerType === 0xd8) {
        sections.push({
          sectionType: markerType,
          section: bytes.subarray(offset, offset + 2),
          sectionOffset: offset + 2,
        });

        offset += 2;
        continue;
      }

      // APP0-APP2 segments have length headers
      if (markerType === 0xe0 || markerType === 0xe1 || markerType === 0xe2) {
        // Length is stored as big-endian 16-bit value (includes length bytes, excludes marker)
        const segmentLength = (bytes[offset + 2] << 8) | bytes[offset + 3];
        const segmentEnd = offset + 2 + segmentLength;

        sections.push({
          sectionType: markerType,
          section: bytes.subarray(offset, segmentEnd),
          sectionOffset: offset + 2,
        });

        offset = segmentEnd;
        continue;
      }

      // Skip other markers with length fields (0xC0-0xFE range, except RST and EOI)
      if (markerType >= 0xc0 && markerType <= 0xfe && markerType !== 0xd9 && (markerType < 0xd0 || markerType > 0xd7)) {
        const segmentLength = (bytes[offset + 2] << 8) | bytes[offset + 3];
        offset += 2 + segmentLength;
        continue;
      }

      // EOI (0xD9) or RST markers (0xD0-0xD7) - no length field
      offset += 2;
    }

    let primaryImage: Uint8Array | undefined;
    let gainmapImage: Uint8Array | undefined;

    for (let i = 0; i < sections.length; i++) {
      const { sectionType, section, sectionOffset } = sections[i];

      if (sectionType === 0xe0) {
        /* JPEG Header - no useful information */
      } else if (sectionType === 0xe1) {
        /* APP1: XMP Metadata */

        this._parseXMPMetadata(textDecoder.decode(new Uint8Array(section)), metadata);
      } else if (sectionType === 0xe2) {
        /* APP2: Data Sections - MPF / ICC Profile / ISO 21496-1 Metadata */

        const sectionData = new DataView(section.buffer!, section.byteOffset + 2, section.byteLength - 2);

        // Check for ISO 21496-1 namespace: "urn:iso:std:iso:ts:21496:-1\0"
        const isoNameSpace = "urn:iso:std:iso:ts:21496:-1\0";
        if (section.byteLength >= isoNameSpace.length + 2) {
          let isISO = true;
          for (let j = 0; j < isoNameSpace.length; j++) {
            if (section[2 + j] !== isoNameSpace.charCodeAt(j)) {
              isISO = false;
              break;
            }
          }

          if (isISO) {
            // Parse ISO 21496-1 metadata
            const isoData = section.subarray(2 + isoNameSpace.length);
            this._parseISOMetadata(isoData, metadata);
            continue;
          }
        }

        // Check for MPF
        const sectionHeader = sectionData.getUint32(2, false);

        if (sectionHeader === 0x4d504600) {
          /* MPF Section */

          const mpfLittleEndian = sectionData.getUint32(6) === 0x49492a00;
          const mpfBytesOffset = 60;

          /* SDR size includes the metadata length, SDR offset is always 0 */

          const primaryImageSize = sectionData.getUint32(mpfBytesOffset, mpfLittleEndian);
          const primaryImageOffset = sectionData.getUint32(mpfBytesOffset + 4, mpfLittleEndian);

          /* Gainmap size is an absolute value starting from its offset, gainmap offset needs 6 bytes padding to take into account 0x00 bytes at the end of XMP */
          const gainmapImageSize = sectionData.getUint32(mpfBytesOffset + 16, mpfLittleEndian);
          const gainmapImageOffset = sectionData.getUint32(mpfBytesOffset + 20, mpfLittleEndian) + sectionOffset + 6;

          primaryImage = new Uint8Array(buffer, primaryImageOffset, primaryImageSize);

          gainmapImage = new Uint8Array(buffer, gainmapImageOffset, gainmapImageSize);
        }
      }
    }

    /* Minimal sufficient validation - https://developer.android.com/media/platform/hdr-image-format#signal_of_the_format */
    // Version can come from either XMP or ISO metadata
    if (!metadata.version) {
      throw new Error("THREE.UltraHDRLoader: Not a valid UltraHDR image");
    }

    if (primaryImage && gainmapImage && onLoad) {
      this._applyGainmapToSDR(
        metadata,
        primaryImage,
        gainmapImage,
        (hdrBuffer, width, height) => {
          onLoad({
            width,
            height,
            data: hdrBuffer,
            format: PixelFormat.RGBA,
            type: this.type,
          });
        },
        (error) => {
          throw new Error(error);
        },
      );
    } else {
      throw new Error("THREE.UltraHDRLoader: Could not parse UltraHDR images");
    }
  }

  /**
   * Starts loading from the given URL and passes the loaded Ultra HDR texture
   * to the `onLoad()` callback.
   *
   * @param url - The path/URL of the files to be loaded. This can also be a data URI.
   * @param onLoad - Executed when the loading process has been finished.
   * @param onProgress - Executed while the loading is in progress.
   * @param onError - Executed when errors occur.
   * @return The Ultra HDR texture.
   */
  override load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (texture: DataTexture, texData: UltraHDRTextureData) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): DataTexture {
    const texture = new DataTexture(
      this.type === TextureType.HalfFloat ? new Uint16Array() : new Float32Array(),
      0,
      0,
      PixelFormat.RGBA,
      this.type,
      Mapping.UV,
      Wrapping.ClampToEdge,
      Wrapping.ClampToEdge,
      TextureFilter.Linear,
      TextureFilter.LinearMipMapLinear,
      1,
      ColorSpace.LinearSRGB,
    );
    texture.generateMipmaps = true;
    texture.flipY = true;

    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (buffer) => {
        try {
          this.parse(buffer as ArrayBuffer, (texData) => {
            texture.image = {
              data: texData.data,
              width: texData.width,
              height: texData.height,
            } as never;
            texture.needsUpdate = true;

            if (onLoad) onLoad(texture, texData);
          });
        } catch (error) {
          if (onError) onError(error);

          console.error(error);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );

    return texture;
  }

  _parseXMPMetadata(xmpDataString: string, metadata: UltraHDRMetadata): void {
    const domParser = new DOMParser();

    const xmpXml = domParser.parseFromString(
      xmpDataString.substring(xmpDataString.indexOf("<"), xmpDataString.lastIndexOf(">") + 1),
      "text/xml",
    );

    /* Determine if given XMP metadata is the primary GContainer descriptor or a gainmap descriptor */
    const [hasHDRContainerDescriptor] = xmpXml.getElementsByTagName("Container:Directory") as unknown as Element[];

    if (hasHDRContainerDescriptor) {
      /* There's not much useful information in the container descriptor besides memory-validation */
    } else {
      /* Gainmap descriptor - defaults from https://developer.android.com/media/platform/hdr-image-format#HDR_gain_map_metadata */

      const [gainmapNode] = xmpXml.getElementsByTagName("rdf:Description") as unknown as Element[];

      metadata.version = gainmapNode.getAttribute("hdrgm:Version");
      metadata.baseRenditionIsHDR = gainmapNode.getAttribute("hdrgm:BaseRenditionIsHDR") === "True";
      metadata.gainMapMin = parseFloat(gainmapNode.getAttribute("hdrgm:GainMapMin") || "0.0");
      metadata.gainMapMax = parseFloat(gainmapNode.getAttribute("hdrgm:GainMapMax") || "1.0");
      metadata.gamma = parseFloat(gainmapNode.getAttribute("hdrgm:Gamma") || "1.0");
      metadata.offsetSDR = parseFloat(gainmapNode.getAttribute("hdrgm:OffsetSDR") || "0") / (1 / 64);
      metadata.offsetHDR = parseFloat(gainmapNode.getAttribute("hdrgm:OffsetHDR") || "0") / (1 / 64);
      metadata.hdrCapacityMin = parseFloat(gainmapNode.getAttribute("hdrgm:HDRCapacityMin") || "0.0");
      metadata.hdrCapacityMax = parseFloat(gainmapNode.getAttribute("hdrgm:HDRCapacityMax") || "1.0");
    }
  }

  _srgbToLinear(value: number): number {
    // 0.04045 * 255 = 10.31475
    if (value < 10.31475) {
      // (1/255) * 0.0773993808
      return value * 0.000303527;
    }

    if (value < 1024) {
      return SRGB_TO_LINEAR[value | 0];
    }

    // (1/255) * 0.9478672986 = 0.003717127
    return Math.pow(value * 0.003717127 + 0.0521327014, 2.4);
  }

  /**
   * Parses ISO 21496-1 gainmap metadata from binary data.
   *
   * @param data - The binary ISO metadata.
   * @param metadata - The metadata object to populate.
   */
  _parseISOMetadata(data: Uint8Array, metadata: UltraHDRMetadata): void {
    const view = new DataView(data.buffer as unknown as ArrayBuffer, data.byteOffset, data.byteLength);

    // Skip minimum version (2 bytes) and writer version (2 bytes)
    let offset = 4;

    // Read flags (1 byte)
    const flags = view.getUint8(offset);
    offset += 1;

    const backwardDirection = (flags & 0x4) !== 0;
    const useCommonDenominator = (flags & 0x8) !== 0;

    let gainMapMin: number;
    let gainMapMax: number;
    let gamma: number;
    let offsetSDR: number;
    let offsetHDR: number;
    let hdrCapacityMin: number;
    let hdrCapacityMax: number;

    if (useCommonDenominator) {
      // Read common denominator (4 bytes, unsigned)
      const commonDenominator = view.getUint32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;

      // Read baseHdrHeadroom (4 bytes, unsigned)
      const baseHdrHeadroomN = view.getUint32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      hdrCapacityMin = Math.log2(baseHdrHeadroomN / commonDenominator);

      // Read alternateHdrHeadroom (4 bytes, unsigned)
      const alternateHdrHeadroomN = view.getUint32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      hdrCapacityMax = Math.log2(alternateHdrHeadroomN / commonDenominator);

      // Read first channel (or only channel) parameters
      const gainMapMinN = view.getInt32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      gainMapMin = gainMapMinN / commonDenominator;

      const gainMapMaxN = view.getInt32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      gainMapMax = gainMapMaxN / commonDenominator;

      const gammaN = view.getUint32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      gamma = gammaN / commonDenominator;

      const offsetSDRN = view.getInt32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      offsetSDR = (offsetSDRN / commonDenominator) * 255.0;

      const offsetHDRN = view.getInt32(offset, false);
      offsetHDR = (offsetHDRN / commonDenominator) * 255.0;
    } else {
      const baseHdrHeadroomN = view.getUint32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      const baseHdrHeadroomD = view.getUint32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      hdrCapacityMin = Math.log2(baseHdrHeadroomN / baseHdrHeadroomD);

      const alternateHdrHeadroomN = view.getUint32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      const alternateHdrHeadroomD = view.getUint32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      hdrCapacityMax = Math.log2(alternateHdrHeadroomN / alternateHdrHeadroomD);

      const gainMapMinN = view.getInt32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      const gainMapMinD = view.getUint32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      gainMapMin = gainMapMinN / gainMapMinD;

      const gainMapMaxN = view.getInt32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      const gainMapMaxD = view.getUint32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      gainMapMax = gainMapMaxN / gainMapMaxD;

      const gammaN = view.getUint32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      const gammaD = view.getUint32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      gamma = gammaN / gammaD;

      const offsetSDRN = view.getInt32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      const offsetSDRD = view.getUint32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      offsetSDR = (offsetSDRN / offsetSDRD) * 255.0;

      const offsetHDRN = view.getInt32(offset, false);
      offset += 4;
      const offsetHDRD = view.getUint32(offset, false);
      offsetHDR = (offsetHDRN / offsetHDRD) * 255.0;
    }

    // The ISO variant does not encode a version string; use the current standard default.
    metadata.version = "1.0";
    metadata.baseRenditionIsHDR = backwardDirection;
    metadata.gainMapMin = gainMapMin;
    metadata.gainMapMax = gainMapMax;
    metadata.gamma = gamma;
    metadata.offsetSDR = offsetSDR;
    metadata.offsetHDR = offsetHDR;
    metadata.hdrCapacityMin = hdrCapacityMin;
    metadata.hdrCapacityMax = hdrCapacityMax;
  }

  _applyGainmapToSDR(
    metadata: UltraHDRMetadata,
    sdrBuffer: Uint8Array,
    gainmapBuffer: Uint8Array,
    onSuccess: (hdrBuffer: Uint16Array | Float32Array, width: number, height: number) => void,
    onError: (error: string) => void,
  ): void {
    const decodeImage = (data: Uint8Array) =>
      createImageBitmap(new Blob([data as unknown as BlobPart], { type: "image/jpeg" }));

    Promise.all([decodeImage(sdrBuffer), decodeImage(gainmapBuffer)])
      .then(([sdrImage, gainmapImage]) => {
        const sdrWidth = sdrImage.width;
        const sdrHeight = sdrImage.height;
        const sdrImageAspect = sdrWidth / sdrHeight;
        const gainmapImageAspect = gainmapImage.width / gainmapImage.height;

        if (sdrImageAspect !== gainmapImageAspect) {
          onError("THREE.UltraHDRLoader Error: Aspect ratio mismatch between SDR and Gainmap images");

          return;
        }

        const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d", {
          willReadFrequently: true,
          colorSpace: "srgb",
        }) as CanvasRenderingContext2D;

        canvas.width = sdrWidth;
        canvas.height = sdrHeight;

        /* Use out-of-the-box interpolation of Canvas API to scale gainmap to fit the SDR resolution */
        ctx.drawImage(gainmapImage, 0, 0, gainmapImage.width, gainmapImage.height, 0, 0, sdrWidth, sdrHeight);
        const gainmapImageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, sdrWidth, sdrHeight, { colorSpace: "srgb" } as never);

        ctx.drawImage(sdrImage, 0, 0);
        const sdrImageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, sdrWidth, sdrHeight, { colorSpace: "srgb" } as never);

        /* HDR Recovery formula - https://developer.android.com/media/platform/hdr-image-format#use_the_gain_map_to_create_adapted_HDR_rendition */

        /* 1.8 instead of 2 near-perfectly rectifies approximations introduced by precalculated SRGB_TO_LINEAR values */
        const hdrCapacityMax = metadata.hdrCapacityMax ?? 1;
        const hdrCapacityMin = metadata.hdrCapacityMin ?? 0;
        const maxDisplayBoost = 1.8 ** (hdrCapacityMax * 0.5);
        const unclampedWeightFactor = (Math.log2(maxDisplayBoost) - hdrCapacityMin) / (hdrCapacityMax - hdrCapacityMin);
        const weightFactor = Math.min(Math.max(unclampedWeightFactor, 0.0), 1.0);

        const sdrData = sdrImageData.data;
        const gainmapData = gainmapImageData.data;
        const dataLength = sdrData.length;
        const gainMapMin = metadata.gainMapMin as number;
        const gainMapMax = metadata.gainMapMax as number;
        const offsetSDR = metadata.offsetSDR as number;
        const offsetHDR = metadata.offsetHDR as number;
        const invGamma = 1.0 / (metadata.gamma as number);
        const useGammaOne = metadata.gamma === 1.0;
        const isHalfFloat = this.type === TextureType.HalfFloat;
        const toHalfFloatLocal = toHalfFloat;
        const srgbToLinear = this._srgbToLinear.bind(this);

        const hdrBuffer = isHalfFloat
          ? new Uint16Array(dataLength).fill(15360)
          : new Float32Array(dataLength).fill(1.0);

        for (let i = 0; i < dataLength; i += 4) {
          for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
            const idx = i + c;
            const sdrValue = sdrData[idx];
            const gainmapValue = gainmapData[idx] * 0.00392156862745098; // 1/255

            const logRecovery = useGammaOne ? gainmapValue : Math.pow(gainmapValue, invGamma);

            const logBoost = gainMapMin + (gainMapMax - gainMapMin) * logRecovery;

            const hdrValue =
              (sdrValue + offsetSDR) * (logBoost * weightFactor === 0.0 ? 1.0 : Math.pow(2, logBoost * weightFactor)) -
              offsetHDR;

            const linearHDRValue = Math.min(Math.max(srgbToLinear(hdrValue), 0), 65504);

            hdrBuffer[idx] = isHalfFloat ? toHalfFloatLocal(linearHDRValue) : linearHDRValue;
          }
        }

        onSuccess(hdrBuffer, sdrWidth, sdrHeight);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        onError(e);
      });
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/loaders/VDBLoader

```typescript
/*
 * three-vdb-loader 0.3.0
