import { TextureType, TextureFilter, PixelFormat } from "../../constants";
import { fromHalfFloat } from "../../extras/DataUtils";
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import type { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";
import { Box3 } from "../../math/Box3";
import { Matrix4 } from "../../math/Matrix4";
import { Data3DTexture } from "../../textures/Data3DTexture";

export interface VDBRuntime {
  unzlibSync(data: Uint8Array): Uint8Array;
}
export type VDBValueType = "half" | "float" | "double" | "vec3s" | "vec3d";
export type VDBMetadata = Record<string, string | boolean | number | number[]>;
export interface VDBGrid {
  name: string;
  type: VDBValueType;
  metadata: VDBMetadata;
  transform: Matrix4;
  background: number | number[];
  bbox: Box3;
  texture: Data3DTexture | null;
}
type BaseType = "half" | "float" | "double";
interface GridContext {
  name: string;
  compression: number;
  metadata: VDBMetadata;
  transform: Matrix4;
  base: BaseType;
  components: number;
  saveFloatAsHalf: boolean;
  background: number[];
}
interface LeafNode {
  origin: number[];
  valueMask: Uint8Array;
  values: Float32Array | null;
}
interface InternalNode {
  origin: number[];
  log2Dim: number;
  childTotal: number;
  childMask: Uint8Array;
  valueMask: Uint8Array;
  values: Float32Array;
  children: Map<number, TreeNode>;
}
type TreeNode = InternalNode | LeafNode;
interface Dense {
  data: Float32Array;
  bounds: number[];
  width: number;
  height: number;
  stride: number;
}

function decompressZip(reader: Reader, length: number): Uint8Array {
  if (!reader.runtime) throw new Error("VDBLoader: ZIP compression requires a zlib decoder runtime.");
  return reader.runtime.unzlibSync(reader.bytes(length));
}

const MAGIC = 0x56444220;

const FILE_VERSION_NODE_MASK_COMPRESSION = 222;

const COMPRESS_ZIP = 0x1;
const COMPRESS_ACTIVE_MASK = 0x2;
const COMPRESS_BLOSC = 0x4;

const BLOSC_DOSHUFFLE = 0x1;
const BLOSC_MEMCPYED = 0x2;
const BLOSC_DOBITSHUFFLE = 0x4;
const BLOSC_DONT_SPLIT = 0x10;
const BLOSC_LZ4_FORMAT = 1;

const NO_MASK_OR_INACTIVE_VALS = 0;
const NO_MASK_AND_ONE_INACTIVE_VAL = 2;
const MASK_AND_NO_INACTIVE_VALS = 3;
const MASK_AND_ONE_INACTIVE_VAL = 4;
const MASK_AND_TWO_INACTIVE_VALS = 5;
const NO_MASK_AND_ALL_VALS = 6;

const HALF_FLOAT_SUFFIX = "_HalfFloat";
const VALUE_SIZES = { half: 2, float: 4, double: 8 };

const VALUE_TYPES = {
  half: { base: "half", components: 1 },
  float: { base: "float", components: 1 },
  double: { base: "double", components: 1 },
  vec3s: { base: "float", components: 3 },
  vec3d: { base: "double", components: 3 },
} as const;

const MAX_DENSE_VALUES = 1 << 28;

export class VDBLoader extends Loader<VDBGrid[]> {
  gridNames: string[] | null = null;
  runtime?: VDBRuntime;

  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager, runtime?: VDBRuntime) {
    super(manager);
    this.runtime = runtime;
  }

  setGridNames(names: string[] | null): this {
    this.gridNames = names;
    return this;
  }
  override load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (grids: VDBGrid[]) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setCrossOrigin(this.crossOrigin);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (buffer) => {
        try {
          if (!(buffer instanceof ArrayBuffer)) throw new TypeError("VDBLoader requires an ArrayBuffer");
          const grids = this.parse(buffer);
          onLoad?.(grids);
        } catch (e) {
          if (onError) {
            onError(e);
          } else {
            console.error(e);
          }

          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }
  parse(buffer: ArrayBuffer): VDBGrid[] {
    const reader = new Reader(buffer, this.runtime);

    if (reader.int64() !== MAGIC) {
      throw new Error("THREE.VDBLoader: Not a VDB file.");
    }

    const fileVersion = reader.uint32();

    if (fileVersion < FILE_VERSION_NODE_MASK_COMPRESSION) {
      throw new Error("THREE.VDBLoader: Unsupported file version " + fileVersion + ".");
    }

    reader.skip(8); // library version

    if (reader.uint8() === 0) {
      throw new Error("THREE.VDBLoader: Files without grid offsets are not supported.");
    }

    reader.skip(36); // uuid

    readMetadata(reader);

    const descriptors = [];
    const gridCount = reader.int32();

    for (let i = 0; i < gridCount; i++) {
      const descriptor = {
        name: reader.string().split("\x1e")[0],
        type: reader.string(),
        instanceParent: reader.string(),
        gridPos: reader.int64(),
        blockPos: reader.int64(),
        endPos: reader.int64(),
      };

      descriptors.push(descriptor);

      reader.offset = descriptor.endPos;
    }

    const grids = [];

    for (const descriptor of descriptors) {
      if (this.gridNames !== null && this.gridNames.includes(descriptor.name) === false) continue;

      let type = descriptor.type;
      let saveFloatAsHalf = false;

      if (type.endsWith(HALF_FLOAT_SUFFIX)) {
        type = type.slice(0, -HALF_FLOAT_SUFFIX.length);
        saveFloatAsHalf = true;
      }

      const match = /^Tree_(float|double|half|vec3s|vec3d)_5_4_3$/.exec(type);

      if (match === null || descriptor.instanceParent !== "") {
        console.warn(
          'THREE.VDBLoader: Skipping unsupported grid "' + descriptor.name + '" of type ' + descriptor.type + ".",
        );
        continue;
      }

      reader.offset = descriptor.gridPos;

      grids.push(readGrid(reader, descriptor.name, match[1] as VDBValueType, saveFloatAsHalf));
    }

    return grids;
  }
}

class Reader {
  buffer: ArrayBuffer;
  view: DataView;
  offset: number;
  runtime?: VDBRuntime;

  constructor(buffer: ArrayBuffer, runtime?: VDBRuntime) {
    this.runtime = runtime;

    this.buffer = buffer;
    this.view = new DataView(buffer);
    this.offset = 0;
  }

  skip(n: number) {
    this.offset += n;
  }

  uint8() {
    return this.view.getUint8(this.offset++);
  }

  int32() {
    const value = this.view.getInt32(this.offset, true);
    this.offset += 4;
    return value;
  }

  uint32() {
    const value = this.view.getUint32(this.offset, true);
    this.offset += 4;
    return value;
  }

  int64() {
    const value = Number(this.view.getBigInt64(this.offset, true));
    this.offset += 8;
    return value;
  }

  float64() {
    const value = this.view.getFloat64(this.offset, true);
    this.offset += 8;
    return value;
  }

  bytes(n: number) {
    const value = new Uint8Array(this.buffer, this.offset, n);
    this.offset += n;
    return value;
  }

  string() {
    const length = this.uint32();
    return new TextDecoder().decode(this.bytes(length));
  }

  mask(size: number) {
    return this.bytes(size >> 3).slice();
  }
}

function readMetadata(reader: Reader): VDBMetadata {
  const metadata: VDBMetadata = {};
  const count = reader.uint32();

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const name = reader.string();
    const type = reader.string();
    const size = reader.uint32();
    const view = new DataView(reader.buffer, reader.offset, size);

    switch (type) {
      case "string":
        metadata[name] = new TextDecoder().decode(reader.bytes(size));
        break;
      case "bool":
        metadata[name] = view.getUint8(0) !== 0;
        break;
      case "int32":
        metadata[name] = view.getInt32(0, true);
        break;
      case "int64":
        metadata[name] = Number(view.getBigInt64(0, true));
        break;
      case "float":
        metadata[name] = view.getFloat32(0, true);
        break;
      case "double":
        metadata[name] = view.getFloat64(0, true);
        break;
      case "vec3i":
        metadata[name] = [view.getInt32(0, true), view.getInt32(4, true), view.getInt32(8, true)];
        break;
      case "vec3s":
        metadata[name] = [view.getFloat32(0, true), view.getFloat32(4, true), view.getFloat32(8, true)];
        break;
      case "vec3d":
        metadata[name] = [view.getFloat64(0, true), view.getFloat64(8, true), view.getFloat64(16, true)];
        break;
    }

    reader.offset = view.byteOffset + size;
  }

  return metadata;
}

function readTransform(reader: Reader): Matrix4 {
  const type = reader.string();
  const vec3 = () => [reader.float64(), reader.float64(), reader.float64()];
  const matrix = new Matrix4();

  switch (type) {
    case "TranslationMap": {
      const t = vec3();
      matrix.makeTranslation(t[0], t[1], t[2]);
      break;
    }

    case "ScaleMap":
    case "UniformScaleMap": {
      const s = vec3();
      reader.skip(4 * 24);
      matrix.makeScale(s[0], s[1], s[2]);
      break;
    }

    case "ScaleTranslateMap":
    case "UniformScaleTranslateMap": {
      const t = vec3();
      const s = vec3();
      reader.skip(4 * 24);
      matrix.makeScale(s[0], s[1], s[2]).setPosition(t[0], t[1], t[2]);
      break;
    }

    case "AffineMap":
    case "UnitaryMap": {
      const elements = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) elements.push(reader.float64());
      matrix.fromArray(elements);
      break;
    }

    default:
      throw new Error("THREE.VDBLoader: Unsupported transform " + type + ".");
  }

  return matrix;
}

function readGrid(reader: Reader, name: string, valueType: VDBValueType, saveFloatAsHalf: boolean): VDBGrid {
  const grid: GridContext = {
    background: [],
    name,
    compression: reader.uint32(),
    metadata: readMetadata(reader),
    transform: readTransform(reader),
    base: VALUE_TYPES[valueType].base,
    components: VALUE_TYPES[valueType].components,
    saveFloatAsHalf,
  };

  reader.skip(4); // buffer count

  grid.background = readValue(reader, grid);

  const tileCount = reader.uint32();
  const childCount = reader.uint32();

  const tiles = [];
  const children = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < tileCount; i++) {
    const origin = [reader.int32(), reader.int32(), reader.int32()];
    const value = readValue(reader, grid);
    const active = reader.uint8() !== 0;
    tiles.push({ origin, value, active });
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < childCount; i++) {
    const origin = [reader.int32(), reader.int32(), reader.int32()];
    children.push(readInternalTopology(reader, grid, origin, 5, 7));
  }

  for (const child of children) readInternalBuffers(reader, grid, child);

  const bounds = [Infinity, Infinity, Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity];

  for (const tile of tiles) {
    if (tile.active) expandByCube(bounds, tile.origin, 1 << 12);
  }

  for (const child of children) expandByNode(bounds, child);

  const bbox = new Box3();

  const result: VDBGrid = {
    name,
    type: valueType,
    metadata: grid.metadata,
    transform: grid.transform,
    background: grid.components === 1 ? grid.background[0] : grid.background,
    bbox,
    texture: null,
  };

  if (bounds[0] > bounds[3]) return result;

  bbox.min.fromArray(bounds, 0);
  bbox.max.fromArray(bounds, 3);

  const width = bounds[3] - bounds[0] + 1;
  const height = bounds[4] - bounds[1] + 1;
  const depth = bounds[5] - bounds[2] + 1;

  const stride = grid.components === 1 ? 1 : 4;

  if (width * height * depth * stride > MAX_DENSE_VALUES) {
    throw new Error(
      'THREE.VDBLoader: Grid "' +
        name +
        '" is too large for a dense texture (' +
        width +
        "x" +
        height +
        "x" +
        depth +
        ").",
    );
  }

  const data = new Float32Array(width * height * depth * stride);
  const dense = { data, bounds, width, height, stride };

  fillCube(dense, bounds, Infinity, grid.background);

  for (const tile of tiles) fillCube(dense, tile.origin, 1 << 12, tile.value);
  for (const child of children) fillNode(dense, child);

  const texture = new Data3DTexture(data, width, height, depth);
  texture.format = stride === 1 ? PixelFormat.Red : PixelFormat.RGBA;
  texture.type = TextureType.Float;
  texture.minFilter = TextureFilter.Linear;
  texture.magFilter = TextureFilter.Linear;
  texture.unpackAlignment = 1;
  texture.needsUpdate = true;

  result.texture = texture;

  return result;
}

function readValue(reader: Reader, grid: GridContext): number[] {
  const value = [];

  for (let c = 0; c < grid.components; c++) {
    const offset = reader.offset;

    reader.offset += VALUE_SIZES[grid.base];

    switch (grid.base) {
      case "half":
        value.push(fromHalfFloat(reader.view.getUint16(offset, true)));
        break;
      case "float":
        value.push(reader.view.getFloat32(offset, true));
        break;
      case "double":
        value.push(reader.view.getFloat64(offset, true));
        break;
    }
  }

  return value;
}

function readInternalTopology(
  reader: Reader,
  grid: GridContext,
  origin: number[],
  log2Dim: number,
  childTotal: number,
): InternalNode {
  const size = 1 << (3 * log2Dim);

  const node: InternalNode = {
    origin,
    log2Dim,
    childTotal,
    childMask: reader.mask(size),
    valueMask: new Uint8Array(0),
    values: new Float32Array(0),
    children: new Map<number, TreeNode>(),
  };

  node.valueMask = reader.mask(size);
  node.values = readCompressedValues(reader, grid, size, node.valueMask);

  for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
    if (isOn(node.childMask, i) === false) continue;

    const childOrigin = offsetToCoord(i, log2Dim, childTotal, origin);

    node.children.set(
      i,
      log2Dim === 5
        ? readInternalTopology(reader, grid, childOrigin, 4, 3)
        : { origin: childOrigin, valueMask: reader.mask(512), values: null },
    );
  }

  return node;
}

function readInternalBuffers(reader: Reader, grid: GridContext, node: InternalNode): void {
  for (const child of node.children.values()) {
    if ("children" in child) {
      readInternalBuffers(reader, grid, child);
    } else {
      child.valueMask = reader.mask(512);
      child.values = readCompressedValues(reader, grid, 512, child.valueMask);
    }
  }
}

function readCompressedValues(reader: Reader, grid: GridContext, count: number, valueMask: Uint8Array): Float32Array {
  const metadata = reader.uint8();

  let inactiveVal1 = grid.background;
  let inactiveVal0 = metadata === NO_MASK_OR_INACTIVE_VALS ? grid.background : grid.background.map((v) => -v);

  if (
    metadata === NO_MASK_AND_ONE_INACTIVE_VAL ||
    metadata === MASK_AND_ONE_INACTIVE_VAL ||
    metadata === MASK_AND_TWO_INACTIVE_VALS
  ) {
    inactiveVal0 = readValue(reader, grid);

    if (metadata === MASK_AND_TWO_INACTIVE_VALS) inactiveVal1 = readValue(reader, grid);
  }

  let selectionMask = null;

  if (
    metadata === MASK_AND_NO_INACTIVE_VALS ||
    metadata === MASK_AND_ONE_INACTIVE_VAL ||
    metadata === MASK_AND_TWO_INACTIVE_VALS
  ) {
    selectionMask = reader.mask(count);
  }

  const maskCompressed = (grid.compression & COMPRESS_ACTIVE_MASK) !== 0 && metadata !== NO_MASK_AND_ALL_VALS;
  const storedCount = maskCompressed ? countOn(valueMask) : count;
  const stored = readData(reader, grid, storedCount);

  if (storedCount === count) return stored;

  const components = grid.components;
  const values = new Float32Array(count * components);

  for (let i = 0, j = 0; i < count; i++) {
    if (isOn(valueMask, i)) {
      for (let c = 0; c < components; c++) values[i * components + c] = stored[j * components + c];
      j++;
    } else {
      values.set(selectionMask !== null && isOn(selectionMask, i) ? inactiveVal1 : inactiveVal0, i * components);
    }
  }

  return values;
}

function readData(reader: Reader, grid: GridContext, count: number): Float32Array {
  if (grid.saveFloatAsHalf && count === 0) return new Float32Array(0);

  const valueType = grid.saveFloatAsHalf ? "half" : grid.base;
  const length = count * grid.components;
  const byteLength = length * VALUE_SIZES[valueType];

  let bytes: Uint8Array;

  if (grid.compression & COMPRESS_BLOSC) {
    const compressedLength = reader.int64();

    bytes = compressedLength <= 0 ? reader.bytes(-compressedLength) : bloscDecompress(reader.bytes(compressedLength));
  } else if (grid.compression & COMPRESS_ZIP) {
    const zippedLength = reader.int64();

    bytes = zippedLength <= 0 ? reader.bytes(-zippedLength) : decompressZip(reader, zippedLength);
  } else {
    bytes = reader.bytes(byteLength);
  }

  if (bytes.byteLength !== byteLength) {
    throw new Error("THREE.VDBLoader: Unexpected data size.");
  }

  const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);
  const values = new Float32Array(length);

  for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
    switch (valueType) {
      case "half":
        values[i] = fromHalfFloat(view.getUint16(i * 2, true));
        break;
      case "float":
        values[i] = view.getFloat32(i * 4, true);
        break;
      case "double":
        values[i] = view.getFloat64(i * 8, true);
        break;
    }
  }

  return values;
}

function bloscDecompress(src: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  const view = new DataView(src.buffer, src.byteOffset, src.byteLength);

  const flags = src[2];
  const typeSize = src[3];
  const size = view.getUint32(4, true);
  const blockSize = view.getUint32(8, true);

  const out = new Uint8Array(size);

  if (flags & BLOSC_MEMCPYED) {
    out.set(src.subarray(16, 16 + size));
    return out;
  }

  if (flags >> 5 !== BLOSC_LZ4_FORMAT || flags & BLOSC_DOBITSHUFFLE) {
    throw new Error("THREE.VDBLoader: Unsupported Blosc codec.");
  }

  const shuffle = (flags & BLOSC_DOSHUFFLE) !== 0 && typeSize > 1;
  const split = (flags & BLOSC_DONT_SPLIT) === 0;
  const blockCount = Math.ceil(size / blockSize);
  const tmp = new Uint8Array(blockSize);

  for (let i = 0; i < blockCount; i++) {
    const start = i * blockSize;
    const length = Math.min(blockSize, size - start);
    const leftover = length < blockSize;
    const splits = split && typeSize <= 16 && Math.floor(length / typeSize) >= 128 && !leftover ? typeSize : 1;
    const splitLength = Math.floor(length / splits);
    const target = shuffle ? tmp : out.subarray(start, start + length);

    let offset = view.getInt32(16 + i * 4, true);

    for (let j = 0; j < splits; j++) {
      const compressedLength = view.getInt32(offset, true);
      const chunk = src.subarray(offset + 4, offset + 4 + compressedLength);
      const dst = target.subarray(j * splitLength, (j + 1) * splitLength);

      if (compressedLength === splitLength) {
        dst.set(chunk);
      } else if (lz4Decompress(chunk, dst) !== splitLength) {
        throw new Error("THREE.VDBLoader: Invalid Blosc data.");
      }

      offset += 4 + compressedLength;
    }

    if (shuffle) {
      const count = Math.floor(length / typeSize);

      for (let e = 0; e < count; e++) {
        for (let b = 0; b < typeSize; b++) {
          out[start + e * typeSize + b] = tmp[b * count + e];
        }
      }

      const rest = length - count * typeSize;
      out.set(tmp.subarray(length - rest, length), start + length - rest);
    }
  }

  return out;
}

function lz4Decompress(src: Uint8Array, dst: Uint8Array): number {
  let s = 0;
  let d = 0;

  while (s < src.length) {
    const token = src[s++];

    let literals = token >> 4;

    if (literals === 15) {
      let b;
      do {
        b = src[s++];
        literals += b;
      } while (b === 255);
    }

    dst.set(src.subarray(s, s + literals), d);
    s += literals;
    d += literals;

    if (s >= src.length) break;

    const distance = src[s] | (src[s + 1] << 8);
    s += 2;

    let match = token & 15;

    if (match === 15) {
      let b;
      do {
        b = src[s++];
        match += b;
      } while (b === 255);
    }

    match += 4;

    for (let m = d - distance, end = d + match; d < end;) dst[d++] = dst[m++];
  }

  return d;
}

function isOn(mask: Uint8Array, i: number): boolean {
  return (mask[i >> 3] & (1 << (i & 7))) !== 0;
}

function countOn(mask: Uint8Array): number {
  let count = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < mask.length; i++) {
    let byte = mask[i];

    while (byte !== 0) {
      byte &= byte - 1;
      count++;
    }
  }

  return count;
}

function offsetToCoord(i: number, log2Dim: number, childTotal: number, origin: number[]): number[] {
  const mask = (1 << log2Dim) - 1;

  return [
    origin[0] + ((i >> (2 * log2Dim)) << childTotal),
    origin[1] + (((i >> log2Dim) & mask) << childTotal),
    origin[2] + ((i & mask) << childTotal),
  ];
}

function expandByCube(bounds: number[], origin: number[], size: number): void {
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    bounds[i] = Math.min(bounds[i], origin[i]);
    bounds[i + 3] = Math.max(bounds[i + 3], origin[i] + size - 1);
  }
}

function expandByNode(bounds: number[], node: TreeNode): void {
  if (!("children" in node)) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 512; i++) {
      if (isOn(node.valueMask, i) === false) continue;

      const x = node.origin[0] + (i >> 6);
      const y = node.origin[1] + ((i >> 3) & 7);
      const z = node.origin[2] + (i & 7);

      if (x < bounds[0]) bounds[0] = x;
      if (y < bounds[1]) bounds[1] = y;
      if (z < bounds[2]) bounds[2] = z;
      if (x > bounds[3]) bounds[3] = x;
      if (y > bounds[4]) bounds[4] = y;
      if (z > bounds[5]) bounds[5] = z;
    }

    return;
  }

  const size = 1 << (3 * node.log2Dim);

  for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
    const child = node.children.get(i);

    if (child !== undefined) {
      expandByNode(bounds, child);
    } else if (isOn(node.valueMask, i)) {
      expandByCube(bounds, offsetToCoord(i, node.log2Dim, node.childTotal, node.origin), 1 << node.childTotal);
    }
  }
}

function fillCube(dense: Dense, origin: number[], size: number, value: ArrayLike<number>): void {
  const { data, bounds, width, height, stride } = dense;

  const x0 = Math.max(origin[0], bounds[0]),
    x1 = Math.min(origin[0] + size - 1, bounds[3]);
  const y0 = Math.max(origin[1], bounds[1]),
    y1 = Math.min(origin[1] + size - 1, bounds[4]);
  const z0 = Math.max(origin[2], bounds[2]),
    z1 = Math.min(origin[2] + size - 1, bounds[5]);

  if (x0 > x1 || y0 > y1 || z0 > z1) return;

  for (let z = z0; z <= z1; z++) {
    for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) {
      const row = ((z - bounds[2]) * height + (y - bounds[1])) * width - bounds[0];

      if (stride === 1) {
        data.fill(value[0], row + x0, row + x1 + 1);
      } else {
        for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) data.set(value, (row + x) * stride);
      }
    }
  }
}

function fillNode(dense: Dense, node: TreeNode): void {
  if (!("children" in node)) {
    const { data, bounds, width, height, stride } = dense;
    const components = stride === 1 ? 1 : 3;

    for (let i = 0; i < 512; i++) {
      const x = node.origin[0] + (i >> 6) - bounds[0];
      const y = node.origin[1] + ((i >> 3) & 7) - bounds[1];
      const z = node.origin[2] + (i & 7) - bounds[2];

      if (x < 0 || y < 0 || z < 0 || x >= width || y >= height || z > bounds[5] - bounds[2]) continue;

      const index = ((z * height + y) * width + x) * stride;

      for (let c = 0; c < components; c++) data[index + c] = node.values![i * components + c];
    }

    return;
  }

  const size = 1 << (3 * node.log2Dim);

  for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
    const child = node.children.get(i);

    if (child !== undefined) {
      fillNode(dense, child);
    } else {
      const components = dense.stride === 1 ? 1 : 3;

      fillCube(
        dense,
        offsetToCoord(i, node.log2Dim, node.childTotal, node.origin),
        1 << node.childTotal,
        node.values.subarray(i * components, (i + 1) * components),
      );
    }
  }
}
```

````typescript
import { TextureFilter, PixelFormat, ColorSpace } from "../../constants";
import { Float32BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";

import type { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";

/** A `SIZE`/`XYZI` pair: voxel grid dimensions plus the packed voxel list. */
export interface VOXChunk {
  /** 256 palette entries; index 0 is unused, matching the VOX specification. */
  palette: number[];
  size: { x: number; y: number; z: number };
  /** Packed `x, y, z, colorIndex` records, or `undefined` when the file has no `XYZI` chunk. */
  data?: Uint8Array;
}

/** A VOX scene node transform frame. */
export interface VOXFrame {
  rotation: Matrix4 | null;
  translation: { x: number; y: number; z: number } | null;
}

/** Base fields shared by `nTRN`, `nGRP` and `nSHP` nodes. */
interface VOXNodeBase {
  id: number;
  attributes: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface VOXTransformNode extends VOXNodeBase {
  type: "transform";
  childNodeId: number;
  layerId: number;
  frames: VOXFrame[];
}

export interface VOXGroupNode extends VOXNodeBase {
  type: "group";
  childIds: number[];
}

export interface VOXShapeNode extends VOXNodeBase {
  type: "shape";
  models: Array<{ modelId: number; attributes: Record<string, string> }>;
}

export type VOXNode = VOXTransformNode | VOXGroupNode | VOXShapeNode;

/** The parsed VOX document. */
export interface VOXResult {
  chunks: VOXChunk[];
  /** The scene graph built from `nTRN`/`nGRP`/`nSHP` nodes, or `null` when the file has none. */
  scene: Object3D | null;
}

// Helper function to read a STRING from the data view.
function readString(data: DataView, offset: number): { value: string; size: number } {
  const size = data.getUint32(offset, true);
  offset += 4;

  let str = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) str += String.fromCharCode(data.getUint8(offset++));

  return { value: str, size: 4 + size };
}

// Helper function to read a DICT from the data view.
function readDict(data: DataView, offset: number): { value: Record<string, string>; size: number } {
  const dict: Record<string, string> = {};
  const count = data.getUint32(offset, true);
  offset += 4;

  let totalSize = 4;

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const key = readString(data, offset);
    offset += key.size;
    totalSize += key.size;

    const value = readString(data, offset);
    offset += value.size;
    totalSize += value.size;

    dict[key.value] = value.value;
  }

  return { value: dict, size: totalSize };
}

// Helper function to decode a ROTATION byte into a rotation matrix.
function decodeRotation(byte: number): Matrix4 {
  // The rotation is stored as a row-major 3x3 matrix encoded in a single byte.
  // Bits 0-1: index of the non-zero entry in the first row
  // Bits 2-3: index of the non-zero entry in the second row
  // Bit 4: sign of the first row entry (0 = positive, 1 = negative)
  // Bit 5: sign of the second row entry
  // Bit 6: sign of the third row entry
  // The third row index is determined by the remaining column.
  const index1 = byte & 0x3;
  const index2 = (byte >> 2) & 0x3;
  const sign1 = (byte >> 4) & 0x1 ? -1 : 1;
  const sign2 = (byte >> 5) & 0x1 ? -1 : 1;
  const sign3 = (byte >> 6) & 0x1 ? -1 : 1;

  const index3 = 3 - index1 - index2;

  const r = [
    [0, 0, 0],
    [0, 0, 0],
    [0, 0, 0],
  ];

  r[0][index1] = sign1;
  r[1][index2] = sign2;
  r[2][index3] = sign3;

  // Convert from the VOX coordinate system (Z-up) to Three.js (Y-up).
  const m = new Matrix4();
  m.set(r[0][0], r[0][2], -r[0][1], 0, r[2][0], r[2][2], -r[2][1], 0, -r[1][0], -r[1][2], r[1][1], 0, 0, 0, 0, 1);

  return m;
}

// Apply a VOX node transform to a Three.js object.
function applyTransform(object: Object3D, node: VOXTransformNode): void {
  if (node.attributes._name) object.name = node.attributes._name;

  if (node.frames.length > 0) {
    const frame = node.frames[0];

    if (frame.rotation) object.applyMatrix4(frame.rotation);

    // VOX uses Z-up, Three.js uses Y-up.
    if (frame.translation) {
      object.position.set(frame.translation.x, frame.translation.z, -frame.translation.y);
    }
  }
}

// Recursively build a Three.js object graph from VOX nodes.
function buildObject(nodeId: number, nodes: Record<number, VOXNode | undefined>, chunks: VOXChunk[]): Object3D | null {
  // Missing nodes are skipped rather than thrown on, matching upstream for partially valid files.
  const node = nodes[nodeId];
  if (node === undefined) return null;

  if (node.type === "transform") {
    const childNode = nodes[node.childNodeId];
    if (childNode === undefined) return null;

    const frame = node.frames[0];
    const hasTransform = frame !== undefined && (frame.rotation !== null || frame.translation !== null);

    // Flatten: if the child is a single-model shape, apply the transform directly to the mesh.
    if (childNode.type === "shape" && childNode.models.length === 1) {
      const mesh = buildMesh(chunkAt(chunks, childNode.models[0].modelId));
      applyTransform(mesh, node);
      return mesh;
    }

    // With no transform, return the child directly and avoid an unnecessary group.
    if (!hasTransform) {
      const child = buildObject(node.childNodeId, nodes, chunks);
      if (child !== null && node.attributes._name) child.name = node.attributes._name;
      return child;
    }

    const group = new Group();
    applyTransform(group, node);
    const child = buildObject(node.childNodeId, nodes, chunks);
    if (child !== null) group.add(child);
    return group;
  }

  if (node.type === "group") {
    const group = new Group();
    for (const childId of node.childIds) {
      const child = buildObject(childId, nodes, chunks);
      if (child !== null) group.add(child);
    }
    return group;
  }

  // A shape reached directly, which well-formed files do not do.
  if (node.models.length === 1) return buildMesh(chunkAt(chunks, node.models[0].modelId));

  const group = new Group();
  for (const model of node.models) group.add(buildMesh(chunkAt(chunks, model.modelId)));
  return group;
}

/** Resolves a model id to its shape chunk; ids refer to the `SIZE` chunk index. */
function chunkAt(chunks: VOXChunk[], modelId: number): VOXChunk {
  const chunk: VOXChunk | undefined = chunks[modelId];
  if (chunk === undefined) throw new Error(`THREE.VOXLoader: model ${modelId} has no SIZE chunk.`);
  return chunk;
}

/**
 * Builds a mesh from a VOX chunk using greedy meshing over the voxel volume.
 *
 * @param chunk - A VOX chunk loaded via {@link VOXLoader}.
 * @return The generated mesh.
 */
export function buildMesh(chunk: VOXChunk): Mesh<MeshStandardMaterial> {
  const data = chunk.data;
  if (data === undefined) throw new Error("THREE.VOXLoader: chunk has no voxel data.");

  const size = chunk.size;
  const palette = chunk.palette;

  const sx = size.x;
  const sy = size.y;
  const sz = size.z;

  // Build the volume with color indices.
  const volume = new Uint8Array(sx * sy * sz);

  for (let j = 0; j < data.length; j += 4) {
    const x = data[j + 0];
    const y = data[j + 1];
    const z = data[j + 2];
    const c = data[j + 3];

    volume[x + y * sx + z * sx * sy] = c;
  }

  // Greedy meshing.
  const vertices: number[] = [];
  const indices: number[] = [];
  const colors: number[] = [];

  const color = new Color();
  let hasColors = false;

  // Process each of the 6 face directions; `d` is the axis normal to the face.
  const dims = [sx, sy, sz];

  for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++) {
    const u = (d + 1) % 3;
    const v = (d + 2) % 3;

    const dimsD = dims[d];
    const dimsU = dims[u];
    const dimsV = dims[v];

    const q = [0, 0, 0];
    const mask = new Int16Array(dimsU * dimsV);

    q[d] = 1;

    // Sweep through slices.
    for (let slice = 0; slice <= dimsD; slice++) {
      // Build the mask for this slice.
      let n = 0;

      for (let vv = 0; vv < dimsV; vv++) {
        for (let uu = 0; uu < dimsU; uu++) {
          const pos = [0, 0, 0];
          pos[d] = slice;
          pos[u] = uu;
          pos[v] = vv;

          const x0 = pos[0],
            y0 = pos[1],
            z0 = pos[2];

          // Voxel behind and in front of this face.
          const behind = slice > 0 ? volume[x0 - q[0] + (y0 - q[1]) * sx + (z0 - q[2]) * sx * sy] : 0;
          const infront = slice < dimsD ? volume[x0 + y0 * sx + z0 * sx * sy] : 0;

          // A face exists if exactly one side is solid.
          if (behind > 0 && infront === 0) mask[n] = behind;
          else if (infront > 0 && behind === 0) mask[n] = -infront;

          n++;
        }
      }

      // Greedily merge the mask into quads.
      n = 0;

      for (let vv = 0; vv < dimsV; vv++) {
        for (let uu = 0; uu < dimsU;) {
          const c = mask[n];

          if (c === 0) {
            uu++;
            n++;
            continue;
          }

          let w = 1;
          while (uu + w < dimsU && mask[n + w] === c) w++;

          let h = 1;
          let done = false;
          while (vv + h < dimsV && !done) {
            for (let k = 0; k < w; k++) {
              if (mask[n + k + h * dimsU] !== c) {
                done = true;
                break;
              }
            }
            if (!done) h++;
          }

          const pos = [0, 0, 0];
          pos[d] = slice;
          pos[u] = uu;
          pos[v] = vv;

          const du = [0, 0, 0];
          const dv = [0, 0, 0];
          du[u] = w;
          dv[v] = h;

          const hex = palette[Math.abs(c)];
          const r = ((hex >> 0) & 0xff) / 0xff;
          const g = ((hex >> 8) & 0xff) / 0xff;
          const b = ((hex >> 16) & 0xff) / 0xff;

          if (r > 0 || g > 0 || b > 0) hasColors = true;

          color.setRGB(r, g, b, ColorSpace.SRGB);

          // Convert VOX coordinates (X right, Y forward, Z up) to Three.js (Y up).
          const toThree = (p: number[]): number[] => [p[0] - sx / 2, p[2] - sz / 2, -p[1] + sy / 2];

          const v0 = toThree(pos);
          const v1 = toThree([pos[0] + du[0], pos[1] + du[1], pos[2] + du[2]]);
          const v2 = toThree([pos[0] + du[0] + dv[0], pos[1] + du[1] + dv[1], pos[2] + du[2] + dv[2]]);
          const v3 = toThree([pos[0] + dv[0], pos[1] + dv[1], pos[2] + dv[2]]);

          const idx = vertices.length / 3;

          // The winding order depends on the face direction.
          if (c > 0) {
            vertices.push(...v0, ...v1, ...v2, ...v3);
          } else {
            vertices.push(...v0, ...v3, ...v2, ...v1);
          }
          indices.push(idx, idx + 1, idx + 2, idx, idx + 2, idx + 3);

          colors.push(
            color.r,
            color.g,
            color.b,
            color.r,
            color.g,
            color.b,
            color.r,
            color.g,
            color.b,
            color.r,
            color.g,
            color.b,
          );

          // Clear the mask.
          for (let hh = 0; hh < h; hh++) {
            for (let ww = 0; ww < w; ww++) mask[n + ww + hh * dimsU] = 0;
          }

          uu += w;
          n += w;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const geometry = new BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(vertices, 3));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  geometry.computeVertexNormals();

  const material = new MeshStandardMaterial();
  if (hasColors) {
    geometry.setAttribute("color", new Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
    material.vertexColors = true;
  }

  return new Mesh(geometry, material);
}

/**
 * Builds a 3D texture from a VOX chunk.
 *
 * @param chunk - A VOX chunk loaded via {@link VOXLoader}.
 * @return The generated 3D texture.
 */
export function buildData3DTexture(chunk: VOXChunk): Data3DTexture {
  const data = chunk.data;
  if (data === undefined) throw new Error("THREE.VOXLoader: chunk has no voxel data.");

  const size = chunk.size;

  const offsety = size.x;
  const offsetz = size.x * size.y;

  const array = new Uint8Array(size.x * size.y * size.z);

  for (let j = 0; j < data.length; j += 4) {
    const x = data[j + 0];
    const y = data[j + 1];
    const z = data[j + 2];

    array[x + y * offsety + z * offsetz] = 255;
  }

  const texture = new Data3DTexture(array, size.x, size.y, size.z);
  texture.format = PixelFormat.Red;
  texture.minFilter = TextureFilter.Nearest;
  texture.magFilter = TextureFilter.Linear;
  texture.unpackAlignment = 1;
  texture.needsUpdate = true;

  return texture;
}

/**
 * A loader for the VOX format.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { VOXLoader } from "ek3d/addons/loaders/VOXLoader";
 *
 * const loader = new VOXLoader();
 * const result = await loader.loadAsync("models/vox/monu10.vox");
 * if (result) scene.add(result.scene!.children[0]);
 * ```
 */
export class VOXLoader extends Loader<VOXResult | undefined, string> {
  override load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (result: VOXResult | undefined) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (buffer: unknown) => {
        try {
          onLoad?.(this.parse(buffer as ArrayBuffer));
        } catch (error) {
          if (onError !== undefined) onError(error);
          else console.error(error);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  /**
   * Parses the given VOX data and returns the result object.
   *
   * Returns `undefined` and logs an error for an invalid magic number or an
   * unsupported version, matching upstream.
   *
   * @param buffer - The raw VOX data as an array buffer.
   * @return The parsed chunk list and scene graph.
   */
  parse(buffer: ArrayBuffer): VOXResult | undefined {
    const data = new DataView(buffer);

    const id = data.getUint32(0, true);
    const version = data.getUint32(4, true);

    if (id !== 542658390) {
      console.error("THREE.VOXLoader: Invalid VOX file.");
      return undefined;
    }

    if (version !== 150 && version !== 200) {
      console.error("THREE.VOXLoader: Invalid VOX file. Unsupported version:", version);
      return undefined;
    }

    const DEFAULT_PALETTE = [
      0x00000000, 0xffffffff, 0xffccffff, 0xff99ffff, 0xff66ffff, 0xff33ffff, 0xff00ffff, 0xffffccff, 0xffccccff,
      0xff99ccff, 0xff66ccff, 0xff33ccff, 0xff00ccff, 0xffff99ff, 0xffcc99ff, 0xff9999ff, 0xff6699ff, 0xff3399ff,
      0xff0099ff, 0xffff66ff, 0xffcc66ff, 0xff9966ff, 0xff6666ff, 0xff3366ff, 0xff0066ff, 0xffff33ff, 0xffcc33ff,
      0xff9933ff, 0xff6633ff, 0xff3333ff, 0xff0033ff, 0xffff00ff, 0xffcc00ff, 0xff9900ff, 0xff6600ff, 0xff3300ff,
      0xff0000ff, 0xffffffcc, 0xffccffcc, 0xff99ffcc, 0xff66ffcc, 0xff33ffcc, 0xff00ffcc, 0xffffcccc, 0xffcccccc,
      0xff99cccc, 0xff66cccc, 0xff33cccc, 0xff00cccc, 0xffff99cc, 0xffcc99cc, 0xff9999cc, 0xff6699cc, 0xff3399cc,
      0xff0099cc, 0xffff66cc, 0xffcc66cc, 0xff9966cc, 0xff6666cc, 0xff3366cc, 0xff0066cc, 0xffff33cc, 0xffcc33cc,
      0xff9933cc, 0xff6633cc, 0xff3333cc, 0xff0033cc, 0xffff00cc, 0xffcc00cc, 0xff9900cc, 0xff6600cc, 0xff3300cc,
      0xff0000cc, 0xffffff99, 0xffccff99, 0xff99ff99, 0xff66ff99, 0xff33ff99, 0xff00ff99, 0xffffcc99, 0xffcccc99,
      0xff99cc99, 0xff66cc99, 0xff33cc99, 0xff00cc99, 0xffff9999, 0xffcc9999, 0xff999999, 0xff669999, 0xff339999,
      0xff009999, 0xffff6699, 0xffcc6699, 0xff996699, 0xff666699, 0xff336699, 0xff006699, 0xffff3399, 0xffcc3399,
      0xff993399, 0xff663399, 0xff333399, 0xff003399, 0xffff0099, 0xffcc0099, 0xff990099, 0xff660099, 0xff330099,
      0xff000099, 0xffffff66, 0xffccff66, 0xff99ff66, 0xff66ff66, 0xff33ff66, 0xff00ff66, 0xffffcc66, 0xffcccc66,
      0xff99cc66, 0xff66cc66, 0xff33cc66, 0xff00cc66, 0xffff9966, 0xffcc9966, 0xff999966, 0xff669966, 0xff339966,
      0xff009966, 0xffff6666, 0xffcc6666, 0xff996666, 0xff666666, 0xff336666, 0xff006666, 0xffff3366, 0xffcc3366,
      0xff993366, 0xff663366, 0xff333366, 0xff003366, 0xffff0066, 0xffcc0066, 0xff990066, 0xff660066, 0xff330066,
      0xff000066, 0xffffff33, 0xffccff33, 0xff99ff33, 0xff66ff33, 0xff33ff33, 0xff00ff33, 0xffffcc33, 0xffcccc33,
      0xff99cc33, 0xff66cc33, 0xff33cc33, 0xff00cc33, 0xffff9933, 0xffcc9933, 0xff999933, 0xff669933, 0xff339933,
      0xff009933, 0xffff6633, 0xffcc6633, 0xff996633, 0xff666633, 0xff336633, 0xff006633, 0xffff3333, 0xffcc3333,
      0xff993333, 0xff663333, 0xff333333, 0xff003333, 0xffff0033, 0xffcc0033, 0xff990033, 0xff660033, 0xff330033,
      0xff000033, 0xffffff00, 0xffccff00, 0xff99ff00, 0xff66ff00, 0xff33ff00, 0xff00ff00, 0xffffcc00, 0xffcccc00,
      0xff99cc00, 0xff66cc00, 0xff33cc00, 0xff00cc00, 0xffff9900, 0xffcc9900, 0xff999900, 0xff669900, 0xff339900,
      0xff009900, 0xffff6600, 0xffcc6600, 0xff996600, 0xff666600, 0xff336600, 0xff006600, 0xffff3300, 0xffcc3300,
      0xff993300, 0xff663300, 0xff333300, 0xff003300, 0xffff0000, 0xffcc0000, 0xff990000, 0xff660000, 0xff330000,
      0xff0000ee, 0xff0000dd, 0xff0000bb, 0xff0000aa, 0xff000088, 0xff000077, 0xff000055, 0xff000044, 0xff000022,
      0xff000011, 0xff00ee00, 0xff00dd00, 0xff00bb00, 0xff00aa00, 0xff008800, 0xff007700, 0xff005500, 0xff004400,
      0xff002200, 0xff001100, 0xffee0000, 0xffdd0000, 0xffbb0000, 0xffaa0000, 0xff880000, 0xff770000, 0xff550000,
      0xff440000, 0xff220000, 0xff110000, 0xffeeeeee, 0xffdddddd, 0xffbbbbbb, 0xffaaaaaa, 0xff888888, 0xff777777,
      0xff555555, 0xff444444, 0xff222222, 0xff111111,
    ];

    let i = 8;

    // The SIZE chunk currently receiving voxel data.
    let chunk: VOXChunk | undefined;
    const chunks: VOXChunk[] = [];

    const nodes: Record<number, VOXNode | undefined> = {};
    let palette = DEFAULT_PALETTE;

    while (i < data.byteLength) {
      let id = "";

      for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) id += String.fromCharCode(data.getUint8(i++));

      const chunkSize = data.getUint32(i, true);
      i += 4;
      i += 4; // child chunks

      if (id === "SIZE") {
        const x = data.getUint32(i, true);
        i += 4;
        const y = data.getUint32(i, true);
        i += 4;
        const z = data.getUint32(i, true);
        i += 4;

        chunk = { palette: DEFAULT_PALETTE, size: { x, y, z } };
        chunks.push(chunk);

        i += chunkSize - 3 * 4;
      } else if (id === "XYZI") {
        if (chunk === undefined) throw new Error("THREE.VOXLoader: XYZI chunk without a preceding SIZE chunk.");

        const numVoxels = data.getUint32(i, true);
        i += 4;
        chunk.data = new Uint8Array(buffer, i, numVoxels * 4);

        i += numVoxels * 4;
      } else if (id === "RGBA") {
        palette = [0];

        for (let j = 0; j < 256; j++) {
          palette[j + 1] = data.getUint32(i, true);
          i += 4;
        }

        if (chunk === undefined) throw new Error("THREE.VOXLoader: RGBA chunk without a preceding SIZE chunk.");
        chunk.palette = palette;
      } else if (id === "nTRN") {
        // Transform node.
        const nodeId = data.getUint32(i, true);
        i += 4;
        const attributes = readDict(data, i);
        i += attributes.size;

        const childNodeId = data.getUint32(i, true);
        i += 4;
        i += 4; // reserved (-1)
        const layerId = data.getInt32(i, true);
        i += 4;
        const numFrames = data.getUint32(i, true);
        i += 4;

        const frames: VOXFrame[] = [];

        for (let f = 0; f < numFrames; f++) {
          const frameDict = readDict(data, i);
          i += frameDict.size;

          const frame: VOXFrame = { rotation: null, translation: null };

          if (frameDict.value._r !== undefined) frame.rotation = decodeRotation(parseInt(frameDict.value._r));

          if (frameDict.value._t !== undefined) {
            const parts = frameDict.value._t.split(" ").map(Number);
            frame.translation = { x: parts[0], y: parts[1], z: parts[2] };
          }

          frames.push(frame);
        }

        nodes[nodeId] = {
          type: "transform",
          id: nodeId,
          attributes: attributes.value,
          childNodeId,
          layerId,
          frames,
        };
      } else if (id === "nGRP") {
        // Group node.
        const nodeId = data.getUint32(i, true);
        i += 4;
        const attributes = readDict(data, i);
        i += attributes.size;

        const numChildren = data.getUint32(i, true);
        i += 4;
        const childIds: number[] = [];

        for (let c = 0; c < numChildren; c++) {
          childIds.push(data.getUint32(i, true));
          i += 4;
        }

        nodes[nodeId] = { type: "group", id: nodeId, attributes: attributes.value, childIds };
      } else if (id === "nSHP") {
        // Shape node.
        const nodeId = data.getUint32(i, true);
        i += 4;
        const attributes = readDict(data, i);
        i += attributes.size;

        const numModels = data.getUint32(i, true);
        i += 4;
        const models: VOXShapeNode["models"] = [];

        for (let m = 0; m < numModels; m++) {
          const modelId = data.getUint32(i, true);
          i += 4;
          const modelAttributes = readDict(data, i);
          i += modelAttributes.size;

          models.push({ modelId, attributes: modelAttributes.value });
        }

        nodes[nodeId] = { type: "shape", id: nodeId, attributes: attributes.value, models };
      } else {
        // Skip unknown chunks.
        i += chunkSize;
      }
    }

    // Apply the palette to all chunks.
    for (const entry of chunks) entry.palette = palette;

    const scene = Object.keys(nodes).length > 0 ? buildObject(0, nodes, chunks) : null;

    return { chunks, scene };
  }
}

/**
 * Mesh built from a VOX chunk.
 *
 * @deprecated Use {@link buildMesh} instead.
 */
export class VOXMesh extends Mesh<MeshStandardMaterial> {
  constructor(chunk: VOXChunk) {
    console.warn("VOXMesh has been deprecated. Use buildMesh() instead.");
    const mesh = buildMesh(chunk);
    super(mesh.geometry, mesh.material);
  }
}

/**
 * 3D texture built from a VOX chunk.
 *
 * @deprecated Use {@link buildData3DTexture} instead.
 */
export class VOXData3DTexture extends Data3DTexture {
  constructor(chunk: VOXChunk) {
    console.warn("VOXData3DTexture has been deprecated. Use buildData3DTexture() instead.");
    const texture = buildData3DTexture(chunk);
    const image = texture.image;
    if (image.data === null) throw new Error("THREE.VOXLoader: chunk has no voxel data.");
    super(image.data, image.width, image.height, image.depth);
    this.format = texture.format;
    this.minFilter = texture.minFilter;
    this.magFilter = texture.magFilter;
    this.unpackAlignment = texture.unpackAlignment;
    this.needsUpdate = true;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/loaders/VRMLLoader

```typescript

type MaterialData = {
  diffuseColor?: Color;
  emissiveColor?: Color;
  shininess?: number;
  specularColor?: Color;
  transparency?: number;
};
type TransformData = { center: Vector2; rotation: number | Vector2; scale: Vector2; translation: Vector2 };
