export class VRMLLoader extends Loader<Scene> {
  constructor(
    private readonly runtime: ChevrotainRuntime,
    manager?: LoadingManager,
  ) {
    super(manager);
  }

  load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (scene: Scene) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const path = this.path === "" ? LoaderUtils.extractUrlBase(url) : this.path;
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader
      .setPriority(this.priority)
      .setCache(this.cache)
      .setPath(this.path)
      .setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader)
      .setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (text) => {
        try {
          const scene = this.parse(text as string, path);
          onLoad?.(scene);
        } catch (error) {
          if (onError) onError(error);
          else console.error(error);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  parse(data: string, path = ""): Scene {
    if (!data.includes("#VRML V2.0")) throw Error("THREE.VRMLLexer: Version of VRML asset not supported.");
    const tree = parseVRML(data, this.runtime);
    const textureLoader = new TextureLoader(this.manager);
    textureLoader
      .setPriority(this.priority)
      .setCache(this.cache)
      .setPath(this.resourcePath || path)
      .setCrossOrigin(this.crossOrigin);
    const definitions: Record<string, VRMLNode> = {};
    const builds = new WeakMap<VRMLNode, unknown>();
    const collect = (node: VRMLNode): void => {
      if (node.DEF) definitions[node.DEF] = node;
      for (const field of node.fields)
        if (field.type === "node") for (const value of field.values) collect(value as VRMLNode);
    };
    for (const node of tree.nodes) collect(node);

    const getNode = (node: VRMLNode | VRMLUse): unknown => {
      if ("USE" in node) {
        const value = getNode(definitions[node.USE]);
        return value instanceof Object3D || value instanceof Material ? value.clone() : value;
      }
      const cached = builds.get(node);
      if (cached !== undefined) return cached;
      const value = buildNode(node);
      if (node.DEF && value !== undefined && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(value, "name"))
        (value as { name: string }).name = node.DEF;
      builds.set(node, value);
      return value;
    };
    const child = (value: unknown): unknown => getNode(value as VRMLNode | VRMLUse);
    const buildNode = (node: VRMLNode): unknown => {
      switch (node.name) {
        case "Anchor":
        case "Group":
        case "Transform":
        case "Collision":
          return grouping(node);
        case "Background":
          return background(node);
        case "Shape":
          return shape(node);
        case "Appearance":
          return appearance(node);
        case "Material":
          return material(node);
        case "ImageTexture":
          return imageTexture(node);
        case "PixelTexture":
          return pixelTexture(node);
        case "TextureTransform":
          return textureTransform(node);
        case "IndexedFaceSet":
        case "IndexedLineSet":
        case "PointSet":
        case "Box":
        case "Cone":
        case "Cylinder":
        case "Sphere":
        case "ElevationGrid":
        case "Extrusion":
          return buildVRMLGeometry(node, getNode);
        case "Color":
        case "Coordinate":
        case "Normal":
        case "TextureCoordinate":
          return node.fields[0].values;
        case "WorldInfo": {
          const result: { title?: unknown; info?: unknown } = {};
          for (const field of node.fields) {
            if (field.name === "title") result.title = field.values[0];
            else if (field.name === "info") result.info = field.values;
            else unknownField(field.name);
          }
          return result;
        }
        case "PerspectiveCamera":
        case "OrthographicCamera":
          return camera(node);
        case "Billboard":
        case "Inline":
        case "LOD":
        case "Switch":
        case "AudioClip":
        case "DirectionalLight":
        case "PointLight":
        case "Script":
        case "Sound":
        case "SpotLight":
        case "CylinderSensor":
        case "PlaneSensor":
        case "ProximitySensor":
        case "SphereSensor":
        case "TimeSensor":
        case "TouchSensor":
        case "VisibilitySensor":
        case "Text":
        case "FontStyle":
        case "MovieTexture":
        case "ColorInterpolator":
        case "CoordinateInterpolator":
        case "NormalInterpolator":
        case "OrientationInterpolator":
        case "PositionInterpolator":
        case "ScalarInterpolator":
        case "Fog":
        case "NavigationInfo":
        case "Viewpoint":
          return undefined;
        default:
          console.warn("THREE.VRMLLoader: Unknown node:", node.name);
          return undefined;
      }
    };
    const grouping = (node: VRMLNode): Group => {
      const result = new Group();
      for (const field of node.fields) {
        const v = field.values as number[];
        switch (field.name) {
          case "children":
            for (const value of field.values) {
              const object = child(value);
              if (object instanceof Object3D) result.add(object);
            }
            break;
          case "translation":
            result.position.set(v[0], v[1], v[2]);
            break;
          case "scale":
            result.scale.set(v[0], v[1], v[2]);
            break;
          case "rotation":
            result.quaternion.setFromAxisAngle(new Vector3(v[0], v[1], v[2]).normalize(), v[3]);
            break;
          case "bboxCenter":
          case "bboxSize":
          case "center":
          case "description":
          case "collide":
          case "parameter":
          case "scaleOrientation":
          case "proxy":
          case "url":
            break;
          default:
            unknownField(field.name);
        }
      }
      return result;
    };
    const background = (node: VRMLNode): Group => {
      const group = new Group();
      let groundAngle: number[] | undefined,
        groundColor: number[] | undefined,
        skyAngle: number[] | undefined,
        skyColor: number[] | undefined;
      for (const field of node.fields) {
        const v = field.values as number[];
        switch (field.name) {
          case "groundAngle":
            groundAngle = v;
            break;
          case "groundColor":
            groundColor = v;
            break;
          case "skyAngle":
            skyAngle = v;
            break;
          case "skyColor":
            skyColor = v;
            break;
          case "backUrl":
          case "bottomUrl":
          case "frontUrl":
          case "leftUrl":
          case "rightUrl":
          case "topUrl":
            break;
          default:
            unknownField(field.name);
        }
      }
      const radius = 10000;
      if (skyColor) {
        const geometry = new SphereGeometry(radius, 32, 16);
        const mat = new MeshBasicMaterial({ fog: false, side: Side.Back, depthWrite: false, depthTest: false });
        if (skyColor.length > 3) {
          paintFaces(geometry, radius, skyAngle as number[], toColorArray(skyColor), true);
          mat.vertexColors = true;
        } else mat.color.setRGB(skyColor[0], skyColor[1], skyColor[2], ColorSpace.SRGB);
        group.add(new Mesh(geometry, mat));
      }
      if (groundColor && groundColor.length > 0) {
        const geometry = new SphereGeometry(radius, 32, 16, 0, 2 * Math.PI, 0.5 * Math.PI, 1.5 * Math.PI);
        const mat = new MeshBasicMaterial({
          fog: false,
          side: Side.Back,
          vertexColors: true,
          depthWrite: false,
          depthTest: false,
        });
        paintFaces(geometry, radius, groundAngle as number[], toColorArray(groundColor), false);
        group.add(new Mesh(geometry, mat));
      }
      group.renderOrder = -Infinity;
      return group;
    };
    const shape = (node: VRMLNode): Object3D => {
      let mat: SceneMaterial = new MeshBasicMaterial({ name: Loader.DEFAULT_MATERIAL_NAME, color: 0 });
      let geometry: VRMLGeometry | undefined;
      for (const field of node.fields) {
        if (field.name === "appearance") {
          if (field.values[0] !== null) mat = child(field.values[0]) as SceneMaterial;
        } else if (field.name === "geometry") {
          if (field.values[0] !== null) geometry = child(field.values[0]) as VRMLGeometry;
        } else unknownField(field.name);
      }
      if (!geometry || !geometry.attributes.position) {
        const object = new Object3D();
        object.visible = false;
        return object;
      }
      if (geometry._type === "points" || geometry._type === "line") {
        const params = {
          name: Loader.DEFAULT_MATERIAL_NAME,
          color: 0xffffff,
          opacity: mat.opacity,
          transparent: mat.transparent,
        };
        const lineMat = geometry._type === "points" ? new PointsMaterial(params) : new LineBasicMaterial(params);
        if (geometry.attributes.color !== undefined) lineMat.vertexColors = true;
        else if (mat instanceof MeshPhongMaterial) lineMat.color.copy(mat.emissive);
        return geometry._type === "points"
          ? new Points(geometry, lineMat as PointsMaterial)
          : new LineSegments(geometry, lineMat as LineBasicMaterial);
      }
      if (geometry._solid !== undefined) mat.side = geometry._solid ? Side.Front : Side.Double;
      if (geometry.attributes.color !== undefined) mat.vertexColors = true;
      return new Mesh(geometry, mat);
    };
    const appearance = (node: VRMLNode): SceneMaterial => {
      let mat: SceneMaterial = new MeshPhongMaterial();
      let transform: TransformData | undefined;
      for (const field of node.fields) {
        const value = field.values[0];
        switch (field.name) {
          case "material":
            if (value !== null) {
              const m = child(value) as MaterialData;
              if (m.diffuseColor) mat.color.copy(m.diffuseColor);
              if (m.emissiveColor) (mat as MeshPhongMaterial).emissive.copy(m.emissiveColor);
              if (m.shininess) (mat as MeshPhongMaterial).shininess = m.shininess;
              if (m.specularColor) (mat as MeshPhongMaterial).specular.copy(m.specularColor);
              if (m.transparency) mat.opacity = 1 - m.transparency;
              if (m.transparency && m.transparency > 0) mat.transparent = true;
            } else mat = new MeshBasicMaterial({ name: Loader.DEFAULT_MATERIAL_NAME, color: 0 });
            break;
          case "texture":
            if (
              (value !== null && (value as VRMLNode).name === "ImageTexture") ||
              (value !== null && (value as VRMLNode).name === "PixelTexture")
            )
              mat.map = child(value) as Texture;
            break;
          case "textureTransform":
            if (value !== null) transform = child(value) as TransformData;
            break;
          default:
            unknownField(field.name);
        }
      }
      if (mat.map) {
        const map = mat.map as PixelTexture;
        if (map.__type) {
          if (map.__type === 2 || map.__type === 4) mat.opacity = 1;
          if (map.__type === 3 || map.__type === 4) mat.color.set(0xffffff);
          delete map.__type;
        }
        if (transform) {
          mat.map.center.copy(transform.center);
          Reflect.set(mat.map, "rotation", transform.rotation);
          mat.map.repeat.copy(transform.scale);
          mat.map.offset.copy(transform.translation);
        }
      }
      return mat;
    };
    const material = (node: VRMLNode): MaterialData => {
      const result: MaterialData = {};
      for (const field of node.fields) {
        const v = field.values as number[];
        switch (field.name) {
          case "ambientIntensity":
            break;
          case "diffuseColor":
            result.diffuseColor = new Color().setRGB(v[0], v[1], v[2], ColorSpace.SRGB);
            break;
          case "emissiveColor":
            result.emissiveColor = new Color().setRGB(v[0], v[1], v[2], ColorSpace.SRGB);
            break;
          case "specularColor":
            result.specularColor = new Color().setRGB(v[0], v[1], v[2], ColorSpace.SRGB);
            break;
          case "shininess":
            result.shininess = v[0];
            break;
          case "transparency":
            result.transparency = v[0];
            break;
          default:
            unknownField(field.name);
        }
      }
      return result;
    };
    const imageTexture = (node: VRMLNode): Texture | undefined => {
      let texture: Texture | undefined,
        wrapS: Wrapping = Wrapping.Repeat,
        wrapT: Wrapping = Wrapping.Repeat;
      for (const field of node.fields) {
        switch (field.name) {
          case "url":
            if (field.values[0]) texture = textureLoader.load(field.values[0] as string);
            break;
          case "repeatS":
            if (field.values[0] === false) wrapS = Wrapping.ClampToEdge;
            break;
          case "repeatT":
            if (field.values[0] === false) wrapT = Wrapping.ClampToEdge;
            break;
          default:
            unknownField(field.name);
        }
      }
      if (texture) {
        texture.wrapS = wrapS;
        texture.wrapT = wrapT;
        texture.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB;
      }
      return texture;
    };
    const pixelTexture = (node: VRMLNode): PixelTexture | undefined => {
      let texture: PixelTexture | undefined,
        wrapS: Wrapping = Wrapping.Repeat,
        wrapT: Wrapping = Wrapping.Repeat;
      for (const field of node.fields) {
        switch (field.name) {
          case "image": {
            const values = field.values;
            const width = values[0] as number,
              height = values[1] as number,
              type = values[2] as number;
            const bytes = new Uint8Array(4 * width * height);
            const color = { r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, a: 0 };
            for (let i = 3; i < values.length; i++) {
              const hex = values[i] as string;
              if (type === 1) {
                color.r = parseInt(hex);
                color.g = color.r;
                color.b = color.r;
                color.a = 1;
              } else if (type === 2) {
                color.r = parseInt("0x" + hex.substring(2, 4));
                color.g = color.r;
                color.b = color.r;
                color.a = parseInt("0x" + hex.substring(4, 6));
              } else if (type === 3 || type === 4) {
                color.r = parseInt("0x" + hex.substring(2, 4));
                color.g = parseInt("0x" + hex.substring(4, 6));
                color.b = parseInt("0x" + hex.substring(6, 8));
                color.a = type === 3 ? 1 : parseInt("0x" + hex.substring(8, 10));
              }
              const offset = (i - 3) * 4;
              bytes[offset] = color.r;
              bytes[offset + 1] = color.g;
              bytes[offset + 2] = color.b;
              bytes[offset + 3] = color.a;
            }
            texture = new DataTexture(bytes, width, height) as PixelTexture;
            texture.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB;
            texture.needsUpdate = true;
            texture.__type = type >= 1 && type <= 4 ? type : undefined;
            break;
          }
          case "repeatS":
            if (field.values[0] === false) wrapS = Wrapping.ClampToEdge;
            break;
          case "repeatT":
            if (field.values[0] === false) wrapT = Wrapping.ClampToEdge;
            break;
          default:
            unknownField(field.name);
        }
      }
      if (texture) {
        texture.wrapS = wrapS;
        texture.wrapT = wrapT;
      }
      return texture;
    };
    const textureTransform = (node: VRMLNode): TransformData => {
      const result: TransformData = {
        center: new Vector2(),
        rotation: new Vector2(),
        scale: new Vector2(),
        translation: new Vector2(),
      };
      for (const field of node.fields) {
        const v = field.values as number[];
        switch (field.name) {
          case "center":
            result.center.set(v[0], v[1]);
            break;
          case "rotation":
            result.rotation = v[0];
            break;
          case "scale":
            result.scale.set(v[0], v[1]);
            break;
          case "translation":
            result.translation.set(v[0], v[1]);
            break;
          default:
            unknownField(field.name);
        }
      }
      return result;
    };
    const camera = (node: VRMLNode): PerspectiveCamera | OrthographicCamera => {
      const result = node.name === "PerspectiveCamera" ? new PerspectiveCamera() : new OrthographicCamera();
      const aspect =
        (typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.innerWidth : 1) /
        (typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.innerHeight : 1);
      for (const field of node.fields) {
        const v = field.values as number[];
        switch (field.name) {
          case "position":
            result.position.set(v[0], v[1], v[0]);
            break;
          case "orientation":
            result.quaternion.setFromAxisAngle(new Vector3(v[0], v[1], v[2]).normalize(), v[3]);
            break;
          case "focalDistance":
            result.userData.focalDistance = v[0];
            break;
          case "heightAngle":
            (result as PerspectiveCamera).fov = radToDeg(v[0]);
            (result as PerspectiveCamera).aspect = aspect;
            result.updateProjectionMatrix();
            break;
          case "height": {
            const h = v[0] / 2,
              w = h * aspect;
            const ortho = result as OrthographicCamera;
            ortho.left = -w;
            ortho.right = w;
            ortho.top = h;
            ortho.bottom = -h;
            result.updateProjectionMatrix();
            break;
          }
          default:
            unknownField(field.name);
        }
      }
      return result;
    };
    const scene = new Scene();
    for (const node of tree.nodes) {
      const object = getNode(node);
      if (object instanceof Object3D) scene.add(object);
      if (node.name === "WorldInfo") scene.userData.worldInfo = object;
    }
    return scene;
  }
}

function unknownField(name: string): void {
  console.warn("THREE.VRMLLoader: Unknown field:", name);
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/VTKLoader

```typescript
import { ColorSpace } from "../../constants";
import { BufferAttribute, Float32BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import type { LoadingManager } from "../../loaders/LoadingManager";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";

export interface VTKZlibDecoder {
  unzlibSync(data: Uint8Array): Uint8Array;
}

/** Loads legacy VTK and XML VTP polygonal data. Compressed VTP requires a zlib decoder. */
export class VTKLoader extends Loader<BufferGeometry> {
  zlibDecoder: VTKZlibDecoder | undefined;

  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager, zlibDecoder?: VTKZlibDecoder) {
    super(manager);
    this.zlibDecoder = zlibDecoder;
    console.warn(
      "THREE.VTKLoader: The loader has been deprecated and will be removed with r194. Export your VTK files to glTF before using them on the web.",
    );
  }

  load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (geometry: BufferGeometry) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (data) => {
        try {
          if (!(data instanceof ArrayBuffer)) throw new Error("VTKLoader: Expected an ArrayBuffer");
          onLoad?.(this.parse(data));
        } catch (error) {
          if (onError) onError(error);
          else console.error(error);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  parse(data: ArrayBuffer): BufferGeometry {
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    const prefix = decoder.decode(new Uint8Array(data, 0, Math.min(data.byteLength, 250)));
    if (prefix.split("\n")[0].includes("xml")) return this.parseXML(decoder.decode(data));
    if (prefix.split("\n")[2]?.includes("ASCII")) return this.parseASCII(decoder.decode(data));
    return this.parseBinary(data);
  }

  private parseASCII(text: string): BufferGeometry {
    const positions: number[] = [],
      indices: number[] = [],
      normals: number[] = [],
      colors: number[] = [];
    let section = "",
      dataSection = "";
    const color = new Color();
    for (const raw of text.split("\n")) {
      const line = raw.trim();
      if (line.startsWith("DATASET ") && line.split(/\s+/)[1] !== "POLYDATA")
        throw new Error("Unsupported DATASET type: " + line.split(/\s+/)[1]);
      const keyword = line.split(/\s+/)[0];
      if (["POINTS", "POLYGONS", "TRIANGLE_STRIPS"].includes(keyword)) {
        section = keyword;
        continue;
      }
      if (keyword === "POINT_DATA" || keyword === "CELL_DATA") {
        section = "";
        dataSection = keyword;
        continue;
      }
      if (dataSection && (keyword === "COLOR_SCALARS" || keyword === "NORMALS")) {
        section = keyword;
        continue;
      }
      if (!line || /^[^\d.\s-]+/.test(line)) continue;
      const values = line.split(/\s+/).map(Number);
      if (section === "POINTS") positions.push(...values.slice(0, values.length - (values.length % 3)));
      else if (section === "NORMALS") normals.push(...values.slice(0, values.length - (values.length % 3)));
      else if (section === "COLOR_SCALARS") {
        for (let i = 0; i + 2 < values.length; i += 3) {
          color.setRGB(values[i], values[i + 1], values[i + 2], ColorSpace.SRGB);
          colors.push(color.r, color.g, color.b);
        }
      } else if (section === "POLYGONS" || section === "TRIANGLE_STRIPS") {
        const count = values[0],
          nodes = values.slice(1, count + 1);
        for (let i = 0; i < count - 2; i++) {
          if (section === "POLYGONS") indices.push(nodes[0], nodes[i + 1], nodes[i + 2]);
          else if (i % 2) indices.push(nodes[i], nodes[i + 2], nodes[i + 1]);
          else indices.push(nodes[i], nodes[i + 1], nodes[i + 2]);
        }
      }
    }
    let geometry = new BufferGeometry();
    geometry.setIndex(indices);
    geometry.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
    if (normals.length === positions.length) geometry.setAttribute("normal", new Float32BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
    if (colors.length !== indices.length) {
      if (colors.length === positions.length) geometry.setAttribute("color", new Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
    } else {
      geometry = geometry.toNonIndexed();
      if (colors.length === geometry.attributes.position.count) {
        const expanded: number[] = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < colors.length; i += 3) {
          color.setRGB(colors[i], colors[i + 1], colors[i + 2], ColorSpace.SRGB);
          for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) expanded.push(color.r, color.g, color.b);
        }
        geometry.setAttribute("color", new Float32BufferAttribute(expanded, 3));
      }
    }
    return geometry;
  }

  private parseBinary(data: ArrayBuffer): BufferGeometry {
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(data),
      view = new DataView(data);
    let index = 0;
    let points = new Float32Array(0),
      normals = new Float32Array(0),
      indices = new Uint32Array(0);
    const line = (): string => {
      const start = index;
      while (index < bytes.length && bytes[index] !== 10) index++;
      return new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.subarray(start, index++));
    };
    while (index < bytes.length) {
      const parts = line().trim().split(/\s+/);
      if (parts[0] === "DATASET" && parts[1] !== "POLYDATA") throw new Error("Unsupported DATASET type: " + parts[1]);
      if (parts[0] === "POINTS" || parts[0] === "POINT_DATA") {
        const count = Number(parts[1]) * 3;
        if (parts[0] === "POINT_DATA") line();
        const values = new Float32Array(count);
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++, index += 4) values[i] = view.getFloat32(index, false);
        if (parts[0] === "POINTS") points = values;
        else normals = values;
        index++;
      } else if (parts[0] === "POLYGONS" || parts[0] === "TRIANGLE_STRIPS") {
        const result: number[] = [];
        for (let n = 0; n < Number(parts[1]); n++) {
          const count = view.getInt32(index, false);
          index += 4;
          const nodes: number[] = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < count; i++, index += 4) nodes.push(view.getInt32(index, false));
          for (let i = 0; i < count - 2; i++) {
            if (parts[0] === "POLYGONS") result.push(nodes[0], nodes[i + 1], nodes[i + 2]);
            else if (i % 2) result.push(nodes[i], nodes[i + 2], nodes[i + 1]);
            else result.push(nodes[i], nodes[i + 1], nodes[i + 2]);
          }
        }
        indices = new Uint32Array(result);
        index++;
      }
    }
    const geometry = new BufferGeometry();
    geometry.setIndex(new BufferAttribute(indices, 1));
    geometry.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(points, 3));
    if (normals.length === points.length) geometry.setAttribute("normal", new BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
    return geometry;
  }

  private parseXML(text: string): BufferGeometry {
    const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(text, "application/xml");
    const root = doc.documentElement,
      piece = root.querySelector("PolyData > Piece");
    if (!piece) throw new Error("Unsupported DATASET type");
    const headerBytes = root.getAttribute("header_type") === "UInt64" ? 8 : 4;
    const littleEndian = root.getAttribute("byte_order") !== "BigEndian";
    const compressed = root.hasAttribute("compressor");
    const appended = root.querySelector("AppendedData")?.textContent?.trim().slice(1) ?? "";
    const arrays = Array.from(piece.querySelectorAll("DataArray"));
    const offsets = arrays
      .filter((array) => array.hasAttribute("offset"))
      .map((array) => Number(array.getAttribute("offset")));
    const readArray = (element: Element): number[] => {
      const format = element.getAttribute("format") ?? "ascii";
      const type = element.getAttribute("type");
      if (!["Float32", "Int32", "Int64"].includes(type ?? ""))
        throw new Error("VTKLoader: Unsupported array type " + type);
      if (format === "ascii") return (element.textContent ?? "").trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).map(Number);
      let encoded = (element.textContent ?? "").trim();
      if (format === "appended") {
        const offset = Number(element.getAttribute("offset"));
        const next = offsets.find((value) => value > offset);
        encoded = appended.slice(offset, next);
      }
      const decodeBase64 = (value: string): Uint8Array =>
        Uint8Array.from(atob(value.replace(/\s/g, "")), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
      let payload: Uint8Array;
      if (compressed) {
        if (!this.zlibDecoder) throw new Error("VTKLoader: Compressed data requires a zlib decoder");
        const first = decodeBase64(encoded.slice(0, Math.ceil((headerBytes * 3) / 3) * 4));
        const headView = new DataView(first.buffer, first.byteOffset, first.byteLength);
        const blocks =
          headerBytes === 8 ? Number(headView.getBigUint64(0, littleEndian)) : headView.getUint32(0, littleEndian);
        const headerLength = headerBytes * (blocks + 3);
        const encodedHeaderLength = Math.ceil(headerLength / 3) * 4;
        const header = decodeBase64(encoded.slice(0, encodedHeaderLength));
        const view = new DataView(header.buffer, header.byteOffset, header.byteLength);
        const compressedData = decodeBase64(encoded.slice(encodedHeaderLength));
        const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
        let offset = 0,
          total = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < blocks; i++) {
          const at = headerBytes * (i + 3);
          const size =
            headerBytes === 8 ? Number(view.getBigUint64(at, littleEndian)) : view.getUint32(at, littleEndian);
          const chunk = this.zlibDecoder.unzlibSync(compressedData.subarray(offset, offset + size));
          chunks.push(chunk);
          total += chunk.length;
          offset += size;
        }
        payload = new Uint8Array(total);
        let cursor = 0;
        for (const chunk of chunks) {
          payload.set(chunk, cursor);
          cursor += chunk.length;
        }
      } else {
        payload = decodeBase64(encoded).subarray(headerBytes);
      }
      const view = new DataView(payload.buffer, payload.byteOffset, payload.byteLength);
      const stride = type === "Int64" ? 8 : 4,
        result: number[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i + stride <= payload.length; i += stride) {
        result.push(
          type === "Float32"
            ? view.getFloat32(i, littleEndian)
            : type === "Int64"
              ? Number(view.getBigInt64(i, littleEndian))
              : view.getInt32(i, littleEndian),
        );
      }
      return result;
    };
    const pointArray = piece.querySelector(":scope > Points > DataArray");
    const numberOfPoints = Number(piece.getAttribute("NumberOfPoints"));
    const points = new Float32Array(
      pointArray && numberOfPoints > 0 ? numberOfPoints * Number(pointArray.getAttribute("NumberOfComponents")) : 0,
    );
    if (pointArray && numberOfPoints > 0) points.set(readArray(pointArray));
    const pointData = piece.querySelector(":scope > PointData");
    const normalName = pointData?.getAttribute("Normals");
    const normalArray = Array.from(pointData?.querySelectorAll("DataArray") ?? []).find(
      (array) => array.getAttribute("Name") === normalName,
    );
    const normals = new Float32Array(
      normalArray && numberOfPoints > 0 ? numberOfPoints * Number(normalArray.getAttribute("NumberOfComponents")) : 0,
    );
    if (normalArray && numberOfPoints > 0) normals.set(readArray(normalArray));
    let indices: number[] = [];
    for (const name of ["Strips", "Polys"]) {
      const section = piece.querySelector(`:scope > ${name}`);
      const elements = Array.from(section?.querySelectorAll("DataArray") ?? []);
      if (elements.length < 2 || Number(piece.getAttribute(`NumberOf${name}`)) <= 0) continue;
      indices = [];
      const connectivity = readArray(elements[0]),
        ends = readArray(elements[1]);
      let start = 0;
      for (const end of ends) {
        const nodes = name === "Strips" ? connectivity.slice(0, end - start) : connectivity.slice(start, end);
        for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length - 2; i++) {
          if (name === "Polys") indices.push(nodes[0], nodes[i + 1], nodes[i + 2]);
          else if (i % 2) indices.push(nodes[i], nodes[i + 2], nodes[i + 1]);
          else indices.push(nodes[i], nodes[i + 1], nodes[i + 2]);
        }
        start = end;
      }
    }
    const geometry = new BufferGeometry();
    geometry.setIndex(new BufferAttribute(new Uint32Array(indices), 1));
    geometry.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(points), 3));
    if (normals.length === points.length)
      geometry.setAttribute("normal", new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(normals), 3));
    return geometry;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/XYZLoader

````typescript
import { ColorSpace } from "../../constants";
import { Float32BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { FileLoader } from "../../loaders/FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "../../loaders/Loader";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";

/**
 * Loads XYZ point clouds, with optional RGB colors in the sRGB 0–255 range.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { XYZLoader } from "ek3d/addons/loaders/XYZLoader";
 * import { PointsMaterial } from "ek3d/materials/PointsMaterial";
 * import { Points } from "ek3d/objects/Points";
 *
 * const geometry = await new XYZLoader().loadAsync("models/xyz/helix_201.xyz");
 * geometry.center();
 * const material = new PointsMaterial({ size: 0.1, vertexColors: geometry.hasAttribute("color") });
 * const points = new Points(geometry, material);
 * ```
 */
export class XYZLoader extends Loader<BufferGeometry, string> {
  override load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (geometry: BufferGeometry) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (text) => {
        try {
          if (typeof text !== "string") throw new TypeError("XYZLoader requires text data");
          const geometry = this.parse(text);
          onLoad?.(geometry);
        } catch (error) {
          if (onError) onError(error);
          else console.error(error);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }

  /** Parses XYZ or XYZRGB rows; comments and other row widths are ignored. */
  parse(text: string): BufferGeometry {
    const vertices: number[] = [];
    const colors: number[] = [];
    const color = new Color();
    for (let line of text.split("\n")) {
      line = line.trim();
      if (line.charAt(0) === "#") continue;
      const values = line.split(/\s+/);
      if (values.length === 3 || values.length === 6) {
        vertices.push(parseFloat(values[0]), parseFloat(values[1]), parseFloat(values[2]));
      }
      if (values.length === 6) {
        color.setRGB(
          parseFloat(values[3]) / 255,
          parseFloat(values[4]) / 255,
          parseFloat(values[5]) / 255,
          ColorSpace.SRGB,
        );
        colors.push(color.r, color.g, color.b);
      }
    }
    const geometry = new BufferGeometry();
    geometry.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(vertices, 3));
    if (colors.length > 0) geometry.setAttribute("color", new Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
    return geometry;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/loaders/collada/ColladaComposer

```typescript
import { AmbientLight } from "../../../lights/AmbientLight";
import { AnimationClip } from "../../../animation/AnimationClip";
import { Bone } from "../../../objects/Bone";

import { Mesh } from "../../../objects/Mesh";

import { Quaternion } from "../../../math/Quaternion";
