```typescript
        this.IFF.currentSurface.attributes.side = this.IFF.reader.getUint16();
        break;

      case "RIMG":
        this.IFF.currentSurface.attributes.reflectionMap = this.IFF.reader.getVariableLengthIndex();
        break;

      case "RIND":
        this.IFF.currentSurface.attributes.refractiveIndex = this.IFF.reader.getFloat32();
        this.IFF.reader.skip(2);
        break;

      case "TIMG":
        this.IFF.currentSurface.attributes.refractionMap = this.IFF.reader.getVariableLengthIndex();
        break;

      case "IMAP":
        this.IFF.reader.skip(2);
        break;

      case "TMAP":
        this.IFF.debugger.skipped = true;
        this.IFF.reader.skip(length); // needs implementing
        break;

      case "IUVI": // uv channel name
        this.IFF.currentNode.UVChannel = this.IFF.reader.getString(length);
        break;

      case "IUTL": // widthWrappingMode: 0 = Reset, 1 = Repeat, 2 = Mirror, 3 = Edge
        this.IFF.currentNode.widthWrappingMode = this.IFF.reader.getUint32();
        break;
      case "IVTL": // heightWrappingMode
        this.IFF.currentNode.heightWrappingMode = this.IFF.reader.getUint32();
        break;

      // LWO2 USE
      case "BLOK":
        // skip
        break;

      default:
        this.IFF.parseUnknownCHUNK(blockID, length);
    }

    if (blockID != "FORM") {
      this.IFF.debugger.node = 1;
      this.IFF.debugger.nodeID = blockID;
      this.IFF.debugger.log();
    }

    if (this.IFF.reader.offset >= this.IFF.currentFormEnd) {
      this.IFF.currentForm = this.IFF.parentForm;
    }
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/lwo/LWO3Parser

```typescript
import type { IFFParser } from "./IFFParser";

export class LWO3Parser {
  IFF: IFFParser;

  constructor(IFFParser: IFFParser) {
    this.IFF = IFFParser;
  }

  parseBlock() {
    this.IFF.debugger.offset = this.IFF.reader.offset;
    this.IFF.debugger.closeForms();

    const blockID = this.IFF.reader.getIDTag();
    const length = this.IFF.reader.getUint32(); // size of data in bytes

    this.IFF.debugger.dataOffset = this.IFF.reader.offset;
    this.IFF.debugger.length = length;

    // Data types may be found in either LWO2 OR LWO3 spec
    switch (blockID) {
      case "FORM": // form blocks may consist of sub -chunks or sub-forms
        this.IFF.parseForm(length);
        break;

      // SKIPPED CHUNKS
      // MISC skipped
      case "ICON": // Thumbnail Icon Image
      case "VMPA": // Vertex Map Parameter
      case "BBOX": // bounding box
      // case 'VMMD':
      // case 'VTYP':

      // normal maps can be specified, normally on models imported from other applications. Currently ignored
      case "NORM":

      // ENVL FORM skipped
      case "PRE ": // Pre-loop behavior for the keyframe
      case "POST": // Post-loop behavior for the keyframe
      case "KEY ":
      case "SPAN":

      // CLIP FORM skipped
      case "TIME":
      case "CLRS":
      case "CLRA":
      case "FILT":
      case "DITH":
      case "CONT":
      case "BRIT":
      case "SATR":
      case "HUE ":
      case "GAMM":
      case "NEGA":
      case "IFLT":
      case "PFLT":

      // Image Map Layer skipped
      case "PROJ":
      case "AXIS":
      case "AAST":
      case "PIXB":
      case "STCK":

      // Procedural Textures skipped
      case "VALU":

      // Gradient Textures skipped
      case "PNAM":
      case "INAM":
      case "GRST":
      case "GREN":
      case "GRPT":
      case "FKEY":
      case "IKEY":

      // Texture Mapping Form skipped
      case "CSYS":

      // Surface CHUNKs skipped
      case "OPAQ": // top level 'opacity' checkbox
      case "CMAP": // clip map

      // Surface node CHUNKS skipped
      // These mainly specify the node editor setup in LW
      case "NLOC":
      case "NZOM":
      case "NVER":
      case "NSRV":
      case "NCRD":
      case "NMOD":
      case "NSEL":
      case "NPRW":
      case "NPLA":
      case "VERS":
      case "ENUM":
      case "TAG ":

      // Car Material CHUNKS
      case "CGMD":
      case "CGTY":
      case "CGST":
      case "CGEN":
      case "CGTS":
      case "CGTE":
      case "OSMP":
      case "OMDE":
      case "OUTR":
      case "FLAG":

      case "TRNL":
      case "SHRP":
      case "RFOP":
      case "RSAN":
      case "TROP":
      case "RBLR":
      case "TBLR":
      case "CLRH":
      case "CLRF":
      case "ADTR":
      case "GLOW":
      case "LINE":
      case "ALPH":
      case "VCOL":
      case "ENAB":
        this.IFF.debugger.skipped = true;
        this.IFF.reader.skip(length);
        break;

      // Texture node chunks (not in spec)
      case "IPIX": // usePixelBlending
      case "IMIP": // useMipMaps
      case "IMOD": // imageBlendingMode
      case "AMOD": // unknown
      case "IINV": // imageInvertAlpha
      case "INCR": // imageInvertColor
      case "IAXS": // imageAxis ( for non-UV maps)
      case "IFOT": // imageFallofType
      case "ITIM": // timing for animated textures
      case "IWRL":
      case "IUTI":
      case "IINX":
      case "IINY":
      case "IINZ":
      case "IREF": // possibly a VX for reused texture nodes
        if (length === 4) this.IFF.currentNode[blockID] = this.IFF.reader.getInt32();
        else this.IFF.reader.skip(length);
        break;

      case "OTAG":
        this.IFF.parseObjectTag();
        break;

      case "LAYR":
        this.IFF.parseLayer(length);
        break;

      case "PNTS":
        this.IFF.parsePoints(length);
        break;

      case "VMAP":
        this.IFF.parseVertexMapping(length);
        break;

      case "POLS":
        this.IFF.parsePolygonList(length);
        break;

      case "TAGS":
        this.IFF.parseTagStrings(length);
        break;

      case "PTAG":
        this.IFF.parsePolygonTagMapping(length);
        break;

      case "VMAD":
        this.IFF.parseVertexMapping(length, true);
        break;

      // Misc CHUNKS
      case "DESC": // Description Line
        this.IFF.currentForm.description = this.IFF.reader.getString();
        break;

      case "TEXT":
      case "CMNT":
      case "NCOM":
        this.IFF.currentForm.comment = this.IFF.reader.getString();
        break;

      // Envelope Form
      case "NAME":
        this.IFF.currentForm.channelName = this.IFF.reader.getString();
        break;

      // Image Map Layer
      case "WRAP":
        this.IFF.currentForm.wrap = { w: this.IFF.reader.getUint16(), h: this.IFF.reader.getUint16() };
        break;

      case "IMAG":
        const index = this.IFF.reader.getVariableLengthIndex();
        this.IFF.currentForm.imageIndex = index;
        break;

      // Texture Mapping Form
      case "OREF":
        this.IFF.currentForm.referenceObject = this.IFF.reader.getString();
        break;

      case "ROID":
        this.IFF.currentForm.referenceObjectID = this.IFF.reader.getUint32();
        break;

      // Surface Blocks
      case "SSHN":
        this.IFF.currentSurface.surfaceShaderName = this.IFF.reader.getString();
        break;

      case "AOVN":
        this.IFF.currentSurface.surfaceCustomAOVName = this.IFF.reader.getString();
        break;

      // Nodal Blocks
      case "NSTA":
        this.IFF.currentForm.disabled = this.IFF.reader.getUint16();
        break;

      case "NRNM":
        this.IFF.currentForm.realName = this.IFF.reader.getString();
        break;

      case "NNME":
        this.IFF.currentForm.refName = this.IFF.reader.getString();
        this.IFF.currentSurface.nodes[this.IFF.currentForm.refName] = this.IFF.currentForm;
        break;

      // Nodal Blocks : connections
      case "INME":
        if (!this.IFF.currentForm.nodeName) this.IFF.currentForm.nodeName = [];
        this.IFF.currentForm.nodeName.push(this.IFF.reader.getString());
        break;

      case "IINN":
        if (!this.IFF.currentForm.inputNodeName) this.IFF.currentForm.inputNodeName = [];
        this.IFF.currentForm.inputNodeName.push(this.IFF.reader.getString());
        break;

      case "IINM":
        if (!this.IFF.currentForm.inputName) this.IFF.currentForm.inputName = [];
        (this.IFF.currentForm.inputName as string[]).push(this.IFF.reader.getString());
        break;

      case "IONM":
        if (!this.IFF.currentForm.inputOutputName) this.IFF.currentForm.inputOutputName = [];
        this.IFF.currentForm.inputOutputName.push(this.IFF.reader.getString());
        break;

      case "FNAM":
        this.IFF.currentForm.fileName = this.IFF.reader.getString();
        break;

      case "CHAN": // NOTE: ENVL Forms may also have CHAN chunk, however ENVL is currently ignored
        if (length === 4) this.IFF.currentForm.textureChannel = this.IFF.reader.getIDTag();
        else this.IFF.reader.skip(length);
        break;

      // LWO2 Spec chunks: these are needed since the SURF FORMs are often in LWO2 format
      case "SMAN":
        const maxSmoothingAngle = this.IFF.reader.getFloat32();
        this.IFF.currentSurface.attributes.smooth = maxSmoothingAngle < 0 ? false : true;
        break;

      // LWO2: Basic Surface Parameters
      case "COLR":
        this.IFF.currentSurface.attributes.Color = { value: this.IFF.reader.getFloat32Array(3) };
        this.IFF.reader.skip(2); // VX: envelope
        break;

      case "LUMI":
        this.IFF.currentSurface.attributes.Luminosity = { value: this.IFF.reader.getFloat32() };
        this.IFF.reader.skip(2);
        break;

      case "SPEC":
        this.IFF.currentSurface.attributes.Specular = { value: this.IFF.reader.getFloat32() };
        this.IFF.reader.skip(2);
        break;

      case "DIFF":
        this.IFF.currentSurface.attributes.Diffuse = { value: this.IFF.reader.getFloat32() };
        this.IFF.reader.skip(2);
        break;

      case "REFL":
        this.IFF.currentSurface.attributes.Reflection = { value: this.IFF.reader.getFloat32() };
        this.IFF.reader.skip(2);
        break;

      case "GLOS":
        this.IFF.currentSurface.attributes.Glossiness = { value: this.IFF.reader.getFloat32() };
        this.IFF.reader.skip(2);
        break;

      case "TRAN":
        this.IFF.currentSurface.attributes.opacity = this.IFF.reader.getFloat32();
        this.IFF.reader.skip(2);
        break;

      case "BUMP":
        this.IFF.currentSurface.attributes.bumpStrength = this.IFF.reader.getFloat32();
        this.IFF.reader.skip(2);
        break;

      case "SIDE":
        this.IFF.currentSurface.attributes.side = this.IFF.reader.getUint16();
        break;

      case "RIMG":
        this.IFF.currentSurface.attributes.reflectionMap = this.IFF.reader.getVariableLengthIndex();
        break;

      case "RIND":
        this.IFF.currentSurface.attributes.refractiveIndex = this.IFF.reader.getFloat32();
        this.IFF.reader.skip(2);
        break;

      case "TIMG":
        this.IFF.currentSurface.attributes.refractionMap = this.IFF.reader.getVariableLengthIndex();
        break;

      case "IMAP":
        this.IFF.currentSurface.attributes.imageMapIndex = this.IFF.reader.getUint32();
        break;

      case "IUVI": // uv channel name
        this.IFF.currentNode.UVChannel = this.IFF.reader.getString(length);
        break;

      case "IUTL": // widthWrappingMode: 0 = Reset, 1 = Repeat, 2 = Mirror, 3 = Edge
        this.IFF.currentNode.widthWrappingMode = this.IFF.reader.getUint32();
        break;
      case "IVTL": // heightWrappingMode
        this.IFF.currentNode.heightWrappingMode = this.IFF.reader.getUint32();
        break;

      default:
        this.IFF.parseUnknownCHUNK(blockID, length);
    }

    if (blockID != "FORM") {
      this.IFF.debugger.node = 1;
      this.IFF.debugger.nodeID = blockID;
      this.IFF.debugger.log();
    }

    if (this.IFF.reader.offset >= this.IFF.currentFormEnd) {
      this.IFF.currentForm = this.IFF.parentForm;
    }
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/lwo/LWOGeometryParser

```typescript
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { BufferAttribute, Float32BufferAttribute } from "../../../core/BufferAttribute";
import type { LWOGeometry, LWOLayer, LWOTree } from "./IFFParser";

export class LWOGeometryParser {
  constructor(private readonly tree: LWOTree) {}

  parse(geoData: LWOGeometry, layer: LWOLayer): BufferGeometry {
    const geometry = new BufferGeometry();
    geometry.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(geoData.points, 3));
    geometry.setIndex(this.splitIndices(geoData.vertexIndices, geoData.polygonDimensions));
    this.parseGroups(geometry, geoData);
    geometry.computeVertexNormals();
    this.parseUVs(geometry, layer);
    this.parseMorphTargets(geometry, layer);
    return geometry;
  }

  // Split quads into triangles.
  splitIndices(indices: number[], polygonDimensions: number[]): number[] {
    const remappedIndices: number[] = [];
    let i = 0;
    polygonDimensions.forEach(function (dim) {
      if (dim < 4) {
        for (let k = 0; k < dim; k++) remappedIndices.push(indices[i + k]);
      } else if (dim === 4) {
        remappedIndices.push(indices[i], indices[i + 1], indices[i + 2], indices[i], indices[i + 2], indices[i + 3]);
      } else if (dim > 4) {
        for (let k = 1; k < dim - 1; k++) {
          remappedIndices.push(indices[i], indices[i + k], indices[i + k + 1]);
        }
        console.warn("LWOLoader: polygons with greater than 4 sides are not supported");
      }
      i += dim;
    });
    return remappedIndices;
  }

  // Polygon indices are ignored; they are assumed to be ordered.
  parseGroups(geometry: BufferGeometry, geoData: LWOGeometry): void {
    const tags = this.tree.tags;
    const matNames: string[] = [];
    let elemSize = 3;
    if (geoData.type === "lines") elemSize = 2;
    if (geoData.type === "points") elemSize = 1;
    const remappedIndices = this.splitMaterialIndices(geoData.polygonDimensions, geoData.materialIndices!);
    let indexNum = 0;
    const indexPairs: Record<string, number> = {};
    let prevMaterialIndex: number | undefined;
    let materialIndex: number | undefined;
    let prevStart = 0;
    let currentCount = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < remappedIndices.length; i += 2) {
      materialIndex = remappedIndices[i + 1];
      if (i === 0) matNames[indexNum] = tags[materialIndex];
      if (prevMaterialIndex === undefined) prevMaterialIndex = materialIndex;
      if (materialIndex !== prevMaterialIndex) {
        let currentIndex: number;
        if (indexPairs[tags[prevMaterialIndex]]) {
          currentIndex = indexPairs[tags[prevMaterialIndex]];
        } else {
          currentIndex = indexNum;
          indexPairs[tags[prevMaterialIndex]] = indexNum;
          matNames[indexNum] = tags[prevMaterialIndex];
          indexNum++;
        }
        geometry.addGroup(prevStart, currentCount, currentIndex);
        prevStart += currentCount;
        prevMaterialIndex = materialIndex;
        currentCount = 0;
      }
      currentCount += elemSize;
    }

    if (geometry.groups.length > 0) {
      let currentIndex: number;
      if (indexPairs[tags[materialIndex!]]) {
        currentIndex = indexPairs[tags[materialIndex!]];
      } else {
        currentIndex = indexNum;
        indexPairs[tags[materialIndex!]] = indexNum;
        matNames[indexNum] = tags[materialIndex!];
      }
      geometry.addGroup(prevStart, currentCount, currentIndex);
    }
    geometry.userData.matNames = matNames;
  }

  splitMaterialIndices(polygonDimensions: number[], indices: number[]): number[] {
    const remappedIndices: number[] = [];
    polygonDimensions.forEach(function (dim, i) {
      if (dim <= 3) {
        remappedIndices.push(indices[i * 2], indices[i * 2 + 1]);
      } else if (dim === 4) {
        remappedIndices.push(indices[i * 2], indices[i * 2 + 1], indices[i * 2], indices[i * 2 + 1]);
      } else {
        for (let k = 0; k < dim - 2; k++) {
          remappedIndices.push(indices[i * 2], indices[i * 2 + 1]);
        }
      }
    });
    return remappedIndices;
  }

  // Multiple partial VMAPs are merged; discontinuous VMADs are not supported.
  parseUVs(geometry: BufferGeometry, layer: LWOLayer): void {
    const remappedUVs = Array.from(Array<number>(geometry.attributes.position.count * 2), function () {
      return 0;
    });
    for (const name in layer.uvs) {
      const uvs = layer.uvs![name].uvs;
      const uvIndices = layer.uvs![name].uvIndices;
      uvIndices.forEach(function (i, j) {
        remappedUVs[i * 2] = uvs[j * 2];
        remappedUVs[i * 2 + 1] = uvs[j * 2 + 1];
      });
    }
    geometry.setAttribute("uv", new Float32BufferAttribute(remappedUVs, 2));
  }

  parseMorphTargets(geometry: BufferGeometry, layer: LWOLayer): void {
    let num = 0;
    for (const name in layer.morphTargets) {
      const remappedPoints = (geometry.attributes.position as BufferAttribute).array.slice();
      if (!geometry.morphAttributes.position) geometry.morphAttributes.position = [];
      const morphPoints = layer.morphTargets![name].points;
      const morphIndices = layer.morphTargets![name].indices;
      const type = layer.morphTargets![name].type;
      morphIndices.forEach(function (i, j) {
        if (type === "relative") {
          remappedPoints[i * 3] += morphPoints[j * 3];
          remappedPoints[i * 3 + 1] += morphPoints[j * 3 + 1];
          remappedPoints[i * 3 + 2] += morphPoints[j * 3 + 2];
        } else {
          remappedPoints[i * 3] = morphPoints[j * 3];
          remappedPoints[i * 3 + 1] = morphPoints[j * 3 + 1];
          remappedPoints[i * 3 + 2] = morphPoints[j * 3 + 2];
        }
      });
      geometry.morphAttributes.position[num] = new Float32BufferAttribute(remappedPoints, 3);
      geometry.morphAttributes.position[num].name = name;
      num++;
    }
    geometry.morphTargetsRelative = false;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/lwo/LWOMaterialParser

```typescript
import type { TextureLoader } from "../../../loaders/TextureLoader";
import type { Texture } from "../../../textures/Texture";
import type { LWOAttributes, LWOForm, LWOSurface, LWOTree } from "./IFFParser";
import { Combine, Side, Wrapping, Mapping, ColorSpace } from "../../../constants";
import { Color } from "../../../math/Color";
import { Vector2 } from "../../../math/Vector2";
import { MeshPhongMaterial } from "../../../materials/MeshPhongMaterial";
import { MeshPhysicalMaterial } from "../../../materials/MeshPhysicalMaterial";
import { MeshStandardMaterial } from "../../../materials/MeshStandardMaterial";

type ScalarAttribute = LWOForm & { value: number };
type ColorAttribute = LWOForm & { value: number[] };
type MaterialAttributes = LWOAttributes & {
  Color?: ColorAttribute;
  "Luminous Color"?: ColorAttribute;
  Transparency?: ScalarAttribute;
  "Bump Height"?: ScalarAttribute;
  Clearcoat?: ScalarAttribute;
  "Clearcoat Gloss"?: ScalarAttribute;
  Luminous?: ScalarAttribute;
  Roughness?: ScalarAttribute;
  Metallic?: ScalarAttribute;
  "Refraction Index"?: ScalarAttribute;
  Diffuse?: ScalarAttribute;
  Reflection?: ScalarAttribute;
  Luminosity?: ScalarAttribute;
  Specular?: ScalarAttribute;
  "Color Highlight"?: ScalarAttribute;
  Glossiness?: ScalarAttribute;
};
type MaterialNode = LWOForm & {
  fileName?: string;
  widthWrappingMode?: number;
  heightWrappingMode?: number;
  amplitude?: number;
};
type ImageMap = LWOForm & { imageIndex: number; wrap?: { w: number; h: number } };
type MaterialParams = {
  name?: string;
  side?: Side;
  flatShading?: boolean;
  color?: Color;
  map?: Texture;
  aoMap?: Texture;
  roughnessMap?: Texture;
  roughness?: number;
  specularMap?: Texture;
  specular?: Color | number;
  emissiveMap?: Texture;
  emissive?: Color | number;
  emissiveIntensity?: number;
  metalnessMap?: Texture;
  metalness?: number;
  alphaMap?: Texture;
  transparent?: boolean;
  normalMap?: Texture;
  normalScale?: Vector2;
  bumpMap?: Texture;
  bumpScale?: number;
  envMap?: Texture;
  opacity?: number;
  clearcoat?: number;
  clearcoatRoughness?: number;
  refractionRatio?: number;
  reflectivity?: number;
  combine?: Combine;
  shininess?: number;
};
type AttributeParams = MaterialParams & { color: Color };
type MaterialConnections = {
  maps: Record<string, MaterialNode>;
  attributes: MaterialAttributes;
  envMap?: string;
  name?: string;
};

export class LWOMaterialParser {
  constructor(
    private readonly tree: LWOTree,
    private readonly textureLoader: TextureLoader,
  ) {}

  parse(): (MeshPhongMaterial | MeshStandardMaterial | MeshPhysicalMaterial)[] {
    const materials: (MeshPhongMaterial | MeshStandardMaterial | MeshPhysicalMaterial)[] = [];
    for (const name in this.tree.materials) {
      if (this.tree.format === "LWO3") materials.push(this.parseMaterial(this.tree.materials[name], name));
      else if (this.tree.format === "LWO2") materials.push(this.parseMaterialLwo2(this.tree.materials[name], name));
    }
    return materials;
  }

  private parseMaterial(materialData: LWOSurface, name: string) {
    let params: MaterialParams = {
      name,
      side: this.getSide(materialData.attributes),
      flatShading: this.getSmooth(materialData.attributes),
    };
    const connections = this.parseConnections(materialData.connections, materialData.nodes);
    const maps = this.parseTextureNodes(connections.maps)!;
    this.parseAttributeImageMaps(connections.attributes, maps);
    const attributes = this.parseAttributes(connections.attributes, maps);
    this.parseEnvMap(connections, maps, attributes);
    params = Object.assign(maps, params);
    params = Object.assign(params, attributes);
    const materialType = this.getMaterialType(connections.attributes);
    if (materialType !== MeshPhongMaterial) delete params.refractionRatio;
    return new materialType(params);
  }

  private parseMaterialLwo2(materialData: LWOSurface, name: string) {
    let params: MaterialParams = {
      name,
      side: this.getSide(materialData.attributes),
      flatShading: this.getSmooth(materialData.attributes),
    };
    const attributes = this.parseAttributes(materialData.attributes as MaterialAttributes, {});
    params = Object.assign(params, attributes);
    return new MeshPhongMaterial(params);
  }

  // The handedness conversion switches front and back faces.
  private getSide(attributes: LWOAttributes): Side | undefined {
    if (!attributes.side) return Side.Back;
    switch (attributes.side) {
      case 0:
      case 1:
        return Side.Back;
      case 2:
        return Side.Front;
      case 3:
        return Side.Double;
    }
  }

  private getSmooth(attributes: LWOAttributes): boolean {
    if (!attributes.smooth) return true;
    return !attributes.smooth;
  }

  private parseConnections(connections: LWOForm, nodes: Record<string, LWOForm>): MaterialConnections {
    const result = { maps: {} } as MaterialConnections;
    const inputName = connections.inputName as string[];
    const inputNodeName = connections.inputNodeName!;
    const nodeName = connections.nodeName!;
    inputName.forEach((name, index) => {
      if (name === "Material") {
        const node = this.getNodeByRefName(inputNodeName[index], nodes)!;
        result.attributes = node.attributes as MaterialAttributes;
        result.envMap = node.fileName;
        result.name = inputNodeName[index];
      }
    });
    nodeName.forEach((name, index) => {
      if (name === result.name) result.maps[inputName[index]] = this.getNodeByRefName(inputNodeName[index], nodes)!;
    });
    return result;
  }

  private getNodeByRefName(refName: string, nodes: Record<string, LWOForm>): MaterialNode | undefined {
    for (const name in nodes) {
      if (nodes[name].refName === refName) return nodes[name] as MaterialNode;
    }
  }

  private parseTextureNodes(textureNodes: Record<string, MaterialNode>): MaterialParams | undefined {
    const maps: MaterialParams = {};
    for (const name in textureNodes) {
      const node = textureNodes[name];
      const path = node.fileName;
      if (!path) return;
      const texture = this.loadTexture(path);
      if (node.widthWrappingMode !== undefined) texture.wrapS = this.getWrappingType(node.widthWrappingMode)!;
      if (node.heightWrappingMode !== undefined) texture.wrapT = this.getWrappingType(node.heightWrappingMode)!;
      switch (name) {
        case "Color":
          maps.map = texture;
          texture.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB;
          break;
        case "Roughness":
          maps.roughnessMap = texture;
          maps.roughness = 1;
          break;
        case "Specular":
          maps.specularMap = texture;
          texture.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB;
          maps.specular = 0xffffff;
          break;
        case "Luminous":
          maps.emissiveMap = texture;
          texture.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB;
          maps.emissive = 0x808080;
          break;
        case "Luminous Color":
          maps.emissive = 0x808080;
          break;
        case "Metallic":
          maps.metalnessMap = texture;
          maps.metalness = 1;
          break;
        case "Transparency":
        case "Alpha":
          maps.alphaMap = texture;
          maps.transparent = true;
          break;
        case "Normal":
          maps.normalMap = texture;
          if (node.amplitude !== undefined) maps.normalScale = new Vector2(node.amplitude, node.amplitude);
          break;
        case "Bump":
          maps.bumpMap = texture;
          break;
      }
    }
    if (maps.roughnessMap && maps.specularMap) delete maps.specularMap;
    return maps;
  }

  private parseAttributeImageMaps(attributes: MaterialAttributes, maps: MaterialParams): void {
    for (const name in attributes) {
      const attribute = attributes[name] as LWOForm;
      if (attribute.maps) {
        const mapData = attribute.maps[0] as ImageMap;
        const path = this.getTexturePathByIndex(mapData.imageIndex);
        if (!path) return;
        const texture = this.loadTexture(path);
        if (mapData.wrap !== undefined) texture.wrapS = this.getWrappingType(mapData.wrap.w)!;
        if (mapData.wrap !== undefined) texture.wrapT = this.getWrappingType(mapData.wrap.h)!;
        switch (name) {
          case "Color":
            maps.map = texture;
            texture.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB;
            break;
          case "Diffuse":
            maps.aoMap = texture;
            break;
          case "Roughness":
            maps.roughnessMap = texture;
            maps.roughness = 1;
            break;
          case "Specular":
            maps.specularMap = texture;
            texture.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB;
            maps.specular = 0xffffff;
            break;
          case "Luminosity":
            maps.emissiveMap = texture;
            texture.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB;
            maps.emissive = 0x808080;
            break;
          case "Metallic":
            maps.metalnessMap = texture;
            maps.metalness = 1;
            break;
          case "Transparency":
          case "Alpha":
            maps.alphaMap = texture;
            maps.transparent = true;
            break;
          case "Normal":
            maps.normalMap = texture;
            break;
          case "Bump":
            maps.bumpMap = texture;
            break;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  private parseAttributes(attributes: MaterialAttributes, maps: MaterialParams): AttributeParams {
    const params: AttributeParams = {
      color: attributes.Color && !maps.map ? new Color().fromArray(attributes.Color.value) : new Color(),
    };
    if (attributes.Transparency && attributes.Transparency.value !== 0) {
      params.opacity = 1 - attributes.Transparency.value;
      params.transparent = true;
    }
    if (attributes["Bump Height"]) params.bumpScale = attributes["Bump Height"].value * 0.1;
    this.parsePhysicalAttributes(params, attributes);
    this.parseStandardAttributes(params, attributes, maps);
    this.parsePhongAttributes(params, attributes, maps);
    return params;
  }

  private parsePhysicalAttributes(params: AttributeParams, attributes: MaterialAttributes): void {
    if (attributes.Clearcoat && attributes.Clearcoat.value > 0) {
      params.clearcoat = attributes.Clearcoat.value;
      if (attributes["Clearcoat Gloss"]) params.clearcoatRoughness = 0.5 * (1 - attributes["Clearcoat Gloss"].value);
    }
  }

  private parseStandardAttributes(params: AttributeParams, attributes: MaterialAttributes, maps: MaterialParams): void {
    if (attributes.Luminous) {
      params.emissiveIntensity = attributes.Luminous.value;
      if (attributes["Luminous Color"] && !maps.emissive)
        params.emissive = new Color().fromArray(attributes["Luminous Color"].value);
      else params.emissive = new Color(0x808080);
    }
    if (attributes.Roughness && !maps.roughnessMap) params.roughness = attributes.Roughness.value;
    if (attributes.Metallic && !maps.metalnessMap) params.metalness = attributes.Metallic.value;
  }

  private parsePhongAttributes(params: AttributeParams, attributes: MaterialAttributes, maps: MaterialParams): void {
    if (attributes["Refraction Index"]) params.refractionRatio = 0.98 / attributes["Refraction Index"].value;
    if (attributes.Diffuse) params.color.multiplyScalar(attributes.Diffuse.value);
    if (attributes.Reflection) {
      params.reflectivity = attributes.Reflection.value;
      params.combine = Combine.Add;
    }
    if (attributes.Luminosity) {
      params.emissiveIntensity = attributes.Luminosity.value;
      if (!maps.emissiveMap && !maps.map) params.emissive = params.color;
      else params.emissive = new Color(0x808080);
    }
    if (!attributes.Roughness && attributes.Specular && !maps.specularMap) {
      if (attributes["Color Highlight"]) {
        params.specular = new Color()
          .setScalar(attributes.Specular.value)
          .lerp(params.color.clone().multiplyScalar(attributes.Specular.value), attributes["Color Highlight"].value);
      } else params.specular = new Color().setScalar(attributes.Specular.value);
    }
    if (params.specular && attributes.Glossiness)
      params.shininess = 7 + Math.pow(2, attributes.Glossiness.value * 12 + 2);
  }

  private parseEnvMap(connections: MaterialConnections, maps: MaterialParams, attributes: AttributeParams): void {
    if (connections.envMap) {
      const envMap = this.loadTexture(connections.envMap);
      if (attributes.transparent && attributes.opacity! < 0.999) {
        envMap.mapping = Mapping.EquirectangularRefraction;
        if (attributes.reflectivity !== undefined) {
          delete attributes.reflectivity;
          delete attributes.combine;
        }
        if (attributes.metalness !== undefined) attributes.metalness = 1;
        attributes.opacity = 1;
      } else envMap.mapping = Mapping.EquirectangularReflection;
      maps.envMap = envMap;
    }
  }

  private getTexturePathByIndex(index: number): string {
    let fileName = "";
    if (!this.tree.textures) return fileName;
    this.tree.textures.forEach((texture) => {
      if (texture.index === index) fileName = texture.fileName!;
    });
    return fileName;
  }

  private loadTexture(path: string): Texture {
    return this.textureLoader.load(path, undefined, undefined, () => {
      console.warn(
        "LWOLoader: non-standard resource hierarchy. Use `resourcePath` parameter to specify root content directory.",
      );
    });
  }

  private getWrappingType(num: number): Wrapping | undefined {
    switch (num) {
      case 0:
        console.warn('LWOLoader: "Reset" texture wrapping type is not supported in three.js');
        return Wrapping.ClampToEdge;
      case 1:
        return Wrapping.Repeat;
      case 2:
        return Wrapping.MirroredRepeat;
      case 3:
        return Wrapping.ClampToEdge;
    }
  }

  private getMaterialType(
    nodeData: MaterialAttributes,
  ): typeof MeshPhysicalMaterial | typeof MeshStandardMaterial | typeof MeshPhongMaterial {
    if (nodeData.Clearcoat && nodeData.Clearcoat.value > 0) return MeshPhysicalMaterial;
    if (nodeData.Roughness) return MeshStandardMaterial;
    return MeshPhongMaterial;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/materialx/MaterialXArchive

```typescript
export interface MaterialXZipRuntime {
  unzipSync(data: Uint8Array): Record<string, Uint8Array>;
}

const decoder = new TextDecoder();

function normalizePath(path: string): string {
  return path
    .split("\\")
    .join("/")
    .replace(/^\.?\//, "")
    .replace(/^\/+/, "");
}

export function isZipBuffer(buffer: ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array): boolean {
  const bytes = buffer instanceof Uint8Array ? buffer : new Uint8Array(buffer);
  return bytes.length >= 4 && bytes[0] === 0x50 && bytes[1] === 0x4b;
}

export function readMtlxArchive(
  buffer: ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array,
  zipRuntime: MaterialXZipRuntime,
): {
  text: string;
  mtlxPath: string;
  files: Map<string, Uint8Array>;
} {
  const bytes = buffer instanceof Uint8Array ? buffer : new Uint8Array(buffer);
  const archive = zipRuntime.unzipSync(bytes);
  const files = new Map<string, Uint8Array>();
  let mtlxPath: string | null = null;
  for (const path in archive) {
    const normalized = normalizePath(path);
    files.set(normalized, archive[path]);
    if (normalized.toLowerCase().endsWith(".mtlx")) {
      if (mtlxPath !== null)
        throw new Error("THREE.MaterialXLoader: Invalid .mtlx.zip package. Exactly one .mtlx file is required.");
      mtlxPath = normalized;
    }
  }
  if (mtlxPath === null) throw new Error("THREE.MaterialXLoader: Invalid .mtlx.zip package. Missing .mtlx file.");
  return { text: decoder.decode(files.get(mtlxPath)), mtlxPath, files };
}

export function createArchiveResolver(files: Map<string, Uint8Array>): {
  resolve(uri: string): string | null;
  dispose(): void;
} {
  const cache = new Map<string, string>();
  function resolve(uri: string): string | null {
    const cached = cache.get(uri);
    if (cached !== undefined) return cached;
    const normalized = normalizePath(decodeURI(uri));
    let bytes = files.get(normalized);
    if (!bytes) {
      for (const [path, data] of files) {
        if (path.endsWith(normalized)) {
          bytes = data;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if (!bytes) return null;
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([Uint8Array.from(bytes)], { type: "application/octet-stream" }));
    cache.set(uri, url);
    return url;
  }
  return {
    resolve,
    dispose() {
      for (const url of cache.values()) URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      cache.clear();
    },
  };
}
```

```typescript
import { MaterialXLogCodes, type MaterialXLog } from "./MaterialXLog";
import type { MaterialXResolvedNodeDef } from "./MaterialXNodeDefs";

export interface MaterialXValidationNode {
  element: string;
  name: string | null;
  type: string | null;
  output: string | null;
  referencePath: string | null;
  hasReference: boolean;
  nodeDef: MaterialXResolvedNodeDef | null;
  children: MaterialXValidationNode[];
  materialX: { getMaterialXNode(path: string): MaterialXValidationNode | null | undefined };
  getAttribute(name: string): string | null;
}

// Upstream compiler categories affect whether unresolved interfaces are checked.
const compilerCategories = new Set<string>([

function formatElement(node: MaterialXValidationNode, names: string[], tag = node.element): string {
  const attrs: string[] = [];
  for (const name of names) {
    const value = node.getAttribute(name);
    if (value !== null && value !== "") attrs.push(`${name}="${value}"`);
  }
  return `<${tag} ${attrs.join(" ")}>`;
}

function compatible(expected: string | null, actual: string | null): boolean {
  return (
    !expected ||
    !actual ||
    expected === actual ||
    (expected === "float" && actual === "integer") ||
    (expected === "integer" && actual === "float")
  );
}

function validateConnection(input: MaterialXValidationNode, parent: MaterialXValidationNode, log: MaterialXLog): void {
  if (!input.referencePath) return;
  const source = input.materialX.getMaterialXNode(input.referencePath);
  if (!source) return;
  let outputType: string | null = null;
  if (source.element === "output") outputType = source.type;
  else if (source.nodeDef) {
    const outputs = source.nodeDef.outputs;
    if (input.output) outputType = outputs[input.output] ?? null;
    else if (source.type && source.type !== "multioutput") outputType = source.type;
    else if (outputs.out) outputType = outputs.out;
    else {
      const values = Object.values(outputs);
      outputType = values.length === 1 ? values[0] : source.type;
    }
  }
  const snippet = formatElement(
    input,
    ["name", "type", "nodename", "nodegraph", "interfacename", "output", "value"],
    "input",
  );
  if (input.output && outputType === null) {
    log.add(
      MaterialXLogCodes.INVALID_OUTPUT_CONNECTION,
      `No output found for port connection: ${snippet}`,
      parent.name,
    );
  } else if (input.type && outputType && !compatible(input.type, outputType)) {
    log.add(MaterialXLogCodes.TYPE_MISMATCH, `Mismatched types in port connection: ${snippet}`, parent.name);
  }
}

function validateNode(node: MaterialXValidationNode, log: MaterialXLog): void {
  if (node.element === "materialx" || node.element === "nodegraph") {
    for (const child of node.children) validateNode(child, log);
    return;
  }
  if (node.element === "input" || node.element === "output") return;
  if (node.nodeDef) {
    const inputs = node.nodeDef.inputs;
    for (const child of node.children) {
      if (child.element !== "input" || !child.name) continue;
      const expected = inputs[child.name]?.type;
      const snippet = formatElement(node, ["name", "type", "nodedef"]);
      if (expected === undefined) {
        log.add(
          MaterialXLogCodes.UNKNOWN_INPUT,
          `Node interface error: Input '${child.name}' doesn't match declaration: ${snippet}`,
          node.name,
        );
      } else if (child.type && expected && child.hasReference === false && !compatible(expected, child.type)) {
        log.add(
          MaterialXLogCodes.TYPE_MISMATCH,
          `Input '${child.name}' type '${child.type}' doesn't match nodedef type '${expected}' on ${snippet}`,
          node.name,
        );
      }
      if (child.hasReference) validateConnection(child, node, log);
    }
  } else if (!compilerCategories.has(node.element) && node.element !== "surfacematerial") {
    for (const child of node.children)
      if (child.element === "input" && child.hasReference) validateConnection(child, node, log);
  }
  for (const child of node.children)
    if (child.element !== "input" && child.element !== "output") validateNode(child, log);
}

export function createStrictInterfaceValidator(): (root: MaterialXValidationNode, log: MaterialXLog) => void {
  return validateNode;
}
```

```typescript
export const MaterialXLogCodes = {
  UNSUPPORTED_NODE: { label: "unsupported-node", severity: "error" },
  IGNORED_SURFACE_INPUT: { label: "ignored-surface-input", severity: "warning" },
  MISSING_REFERENCE: { label: "missing-reference", severity: "error" },
  MISSING_MATERIAL: { label: "missing-material", severity: "error" },
  INVALID_VALUE: { label: "invalid-value", severity: "error" },
  TEXTURE_LOAD_FAILED: { label: "texture-load-failed", severity: "warning" },
  UNKNOWN_INPUT: { label: "unknown-input", severity: "error" },
  INVALID_OUTPUT_CONNECTION: { label: "invalid-output-connection", severity: "error" },
  TYPE_MISMATCH: { label: "type-mismatch", severity: "error" },
} as const;

export interface MaterialXLogEntry {
  code: string;
  severity: "error" | "warning";
  message: string;
  nodeName?: string;
}

export class MaterialXLog {
  entries: MaterialXLogEntry[] = [];
  get errors(): MaterialXLogEntry[] {
    return this.entries.filter((entry) => entry.severity === "error");
  }
  get warnings(): MaterialXLogEntry[] {
    return this.entries.filter((entry) => entry.severity === "warning");
  }
  add(code: { label: string; severity: "error" | "warning" }, message: string, nodeName?: string | null): void {
    const entry: MaterialXLogEntry = { code: code.label, severity: code.severity, message };
    if (nodeName !== undefined && nodeName !== null) entry.nodeName = nodeName;
    this.entries.push(entry);
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/materialx/MaterialXNodeDefs

```typescript
import { registryData } from "./MaterialXNodeInterfaceRegistry";

export interface MaterialXNodeDef {
  node: string;
  version?: string;
  isdefaultversion?: boolean;
  inputs: Record<string, { type: string; value?: string; defaultgeomprop?: string }>;
  outputs: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface MaterialXResolvedNodeDef extends MaterialXNodeDef {
  name: string;
}

export interface MaterialXNodeDefInstance {
  element: string;
  type: string | null;
  children: { element: string; name: string | null; type: string | null }[];
  materialX: { getDocumentNodeDefs(): Record<string, MaterialXNodeDef> };
  getAttribute(name: string): string | null;
}

const namesByCategory = new Map<string, string[]>();
for (const [name, def] of Object.entries(registryData.nodedefs)) {
  const names = namesByCategory.get(def.node) ?? [];
  names.push(name);
  namesByCategory.set(def.node, names);
}

export function getNodeDefNames(category: string): string[] {
  return namesByCategory.get(category) || [];
}

export function resolveNodeDef(node: MaterialXNodeDefInstance): MaterialXResolvedNodeDef | null {
  const documentDefs = node.materialX.getDocumentNodeDefs();
  const explicitName = node.getAttribute("nodedef");
  if (explicitName) {
    const def = registryData.nodedefs[explicitName] || documentDefs[explicitName];
    if (def) return { name: explicitName, ...def };
  }
  const version = node.getAttribute("version") || "";
  const candidates: [string, MaterialXNodeDef][] = [
    ...getNodeDefNames(node.element).map((name): [string, MaterialXNodeDef] => [name, registryData.nodedefs[name]]),
    ...Object.entries(documentDefs).filter(([, def]) => def.node === node.element),
  ];
  let roughMatch: MaterialXResolvedNodeDef | null = null;
  for (const [name, def] of candidates) {
    if ((def.version || "") !== version && !(def.isdefaultversion === true && version === "")) continue;
    const outputs = Object.keys(def.outputs);
    const outputType = outputs.length > 1 ? "multioutput" : (def.outputs.out ?? def.outputs[outputs[0]] ?? null);
    if (node.type && outputType !== "multioutput" && outputType !== node.type) continue;
    const match = node.children.every((child) => {
      if (child.element !== "input") return true;
      const declared = def.inputs[child.name ?? "null"];
      return !!declared && (!child.type || declared.type === child.type);
    });
    if (match) return { name, ...def };
    roughMatch ??= { name, ...def };
  }
  return roughMatch;
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/materialx/parse/MaterialXParser

```typescript
export interface MaterialXTreeNode<T> {
  nodePath: string | null;
  add(child: T): void;
}

export function parseMaterialXNodeTree<T extends MaterialXTreeNode<T>>(
  nodeXML: Element,
  createNode: (node: Element, path: string | null) => T,
  addNode: (node: T) => void,
  nodePath: string | null = "",
): T {
  const node = createNode(nodeXML, nodePath);
  if (node.nodePath) addNode(node);
  for (const child of nodeXML.children) node.add(parseMaterialXNodeTree(child, createNode, addNode, node.nodePath));
  return node;
}

export function parseMaterialXText<T extends MaterialXTreeNode<T>>(
  text: string,
  createNode: (node: Element, path: string | null) => T,
  addNode: (node: T) => void,
): T {
  const root = new DOMParser().parseFromString(text, "application/xml").documentElement;
  return parseMaterialXNodeTree(root, createNode, addNode);
}
```

## ek3d/addons/loaders/usd/USDAParser

```typescript
// Pre-compiled regex patterns for performance
const DEF_MATCH_REGEX = /^def\s+(?:(\w+)\s+)?"?([^"]+)"?$/;
const VARIANT_STRING_REGEX = /^string\s+(\w+)$/;
const ATTR_MATCH_REGEX = /^(?:uniform\s+)?(\w+(?:\[\])?)\s+(.+)$/;
// Preserve metadata blocks without changing the legacy parseText value shape.
const VALUE_METADATA = Symbol("valueMetadata");

export type USDAValue = string | number | boolean | null | USDAValue[] | { [key: string]: USDAValue } | undefined;

export interface USDASpecFields {
  typeName?: string;
  default?: USDAValue;
  primChildren?: string[];
  upAxis?: string;
  defaultPrim?: string;
  metersPerUnit?: number;
  framesPerSecond?: number;
  timeCodesPerSecond?: number;
  references?: USDATextValue[];
  payload?: USDATextValue;
  variantSelection?: Record<string, string>;
  targetPaths?: string[];
  bindMaterialAs?: string;
  xformOpOrder?: string[];
  connectionPaths?: string[];
  timeSamples?: { times: number[]; values: USDAValue[] };
  elementSize?: number;
}

export interface USDASpec {
  specType: number;
  fields: USDASpecFields;
}

export interface USDAData {
  specsByPath: Record<string, USDASpec>;
}

export type USDATextValue = string | USDATextNode;
export interface USDATextNode {
  [key: string]: USDATextValue;
  [VALUE_METADATA]?: Record<string, USDATextNode>;
}

// Spec types (must match USDCParser/USDComposer)
const SpecType = {
  Attribute: 1,
  Prim: 6,
  Relationship: 8,
};

export class USDAParser {
  parseText(text: string): USDATextNode {
    // Preprocess: strip comments and normalize multiline values
    text = this._preprocess(text);

    const root: USDATextNode = {};

    const lines = text.split("\n");

    let string: string | null = null;
    let target = root;

    const stack = [root];

    for (const line of lines) {
      if (line.includes("=")) {
        // Find the first '=' that's not inside quotes
        const eqIdx = this._findAssignmentOperator(line);

        if (eqIdx === -1) {
          string = line.trim();
          continue;
        }

        const lhs = line.slice(0, eqIdx).trim();
        const rhs = line.slice(eqIdx + 1).trim();

        if (rhs.endsWith("{")) {
          const group: USDATextNode = {};
          stack.push(group);

          target[lhs] = group;
          target = group;
        } else if (rhs.endsWith("(")) {
          // see #28631

          const values = rhs.slice(0, -1).trim();
          target[lhs] = values;

          const meta: USDATextNode = {};
          if (target[VALUE_METADATA] === undefined) target[VALUE_METADATA] = {};
          target[VALUE_METADATA][lhs] = meta;
          stack.push(meta);

          target = meta;
        } else {
          target[lhs] = rhs;
        }
      } else if (line.includes(":") && !line.includes("=")) {
        // Handle dictionary entries like "0: [(...)...]" for timeSamples
        const colonIdx = line.indexOf(":");
        const key = line.slice(0, colonIdx).trim();
        const value = line.slice(colonIdx + 1).trim();

        // Only process if key looks like a number (timeSamples frame)
        if (/^-?[\d.]+$/.test(key)) {
          target[key] = value;
        }
      } else if (line.endsWith("{")) {
        string = line.slice(0, -1).trim() || string;

        const group = (target[string as string] || {}) as USDATextNode;
        stack.push(group);

        target[string as string] = group;
        target = group;
      } else if (line.endsWith("}")) {
        stack.pop();

        if (stack.length === 0) continue;

        target = stack[stack.length - 1];
      } else if (line.endsWith("(")) {
        const meta: USDATextNode = {};
        stack.push(meta);

        string = line.split("(")[0].trim() || string;

        target[string as string] = meta;
        target = meta;
      } else if (line.endsWith(")")) {
        stack.pop();

        target = stack[stack.length - 1];
      } else if (line.trim()) {
        string = line.trim();
      }
    }

    return root;
  }

  _preprocess(text: string): string {
    // Remove block comments /* ... */
    text = this._stripBlockComments(text);

    // Collapse triple-quoted strings into single lines
    text = this._collapseTripleQuotedStrings(text);

    // Remove line comments # ... (but preserve #usda header)
    // Only remove # comments that aren't at the start of a line or after whitespace
    const lines = text.split("\n");
    const processed = [];

    let inMultilineValue = false;
    let bracketDepth = 0;
    let parenDepth = 0;
    let accumulated = "";

    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
      let line = lines[i];

      // Strip inline comments (but not inside strings)
      line = this._stripInlineComment(line);

      // Track bracket/paren depth for multiline values
      const trimmed = line.trim();

      if (inMultilineValue) {
        // Continue accumulating multiline value
        accumulated += " " + trimmed;

        // Update depths
        for (const ch of trimmed) {
          if (ch === "[") bracketDepth++;
          else if (ch === "]") bracketDepth--;
          else if (ch === "(" && bracketDepth > 0) parenDepth++;
          else if (ch === ")" && bracketDepth > 0) parenDepth--;
        }

        // Check if multiline value is complete
        if (bracketDepth === 0 && parenDepth === 0) {
          processed.push(accumulated);
          accumulated = "";
          inMultilineValue = false;
        }
      } else {
        // Check if this line starts a multiline array value
        // Look for patterns like "attr = [" or "attr = @path@[" without closing ]
        if (trimmed.includes("=")) {
          const eqIdx = this._findAssignmentOperator(trimmed);

          if (eqIdx !== -1) {
            const rhs = trimmed.slice(eqIdx + 1).trim();

            // Count brackets in the value part
            let openBrackets = 0;
            let closeBrackets = 0;

            for (const ch of rhs) {
              if (ch === "[") openBrackets++;
              else if (ch === "]") closeBrackets++;
            }

            if (openBrackets > closeBrackets) {
              // Multiline array detected
              inMultilineValue = true;
              bracketDepth = openBrackets - closeBrackets;
              parenDepth = 0;
              accumulated = trimmed;
              continue;
            }
          }
        }

        processed.push(trimmed);
      }
    }

    return processed.join("\n");
  }

  _stripBlockComments(text: string): string {
    // Iteratively remove /* ... */ comments without regex backtracking.
    // Strings are copied as is since they may contain /* (e.g. path expressions)
    const tokens = /\/\*|"""|'''|["']/g;

    let result = "";
    let i = 0;

    while (i < text.length) {
      tokens.lastIndex = i;
      const match = tokens.exec(text);

      if (match === null) {
        result += text.slice(i);
        break;
      }

      const start = match.index;
      const token = match[0];

      if (token === "/*") {
        result += text.slice(i, start);

        // Move past the comment (or to end if unclosed)
        const end = text.indexOf("*/", start + 2);
        i = end === -1 ? text.length : end + 2;
      } else {
        const end = this._findStringEnd(text, start, token);

        result += text.slice(i, end);
        i = end;
      }
    }

    return result;
  }

  _findStringEnd(text: string, start: number, quote: string): number {
    if (quote.length === 3) {
      const end = text.indexOf(quote, start + 3);
      return end === -1 ? text.length : end + 3;
    }

    // Single-line string with escapes, ends at the line end if unclosed
    for (let i = start + 1; i < text.length; i++) {
      const ch = text[i];

      if (ch === "\\") i++;
      else if (ch === quote) return i + 1;
      else if (ch === "\n") return i;
    }

    return text.length;
  }

  _collapseTripleQuotedStrings(text: string): string {
    const tripleQuote = /'''|"""/g;

    let result = "";
    let i = 0;

    while (i < text.length) {
      tripleQuote.lastIndex = i;
      const match = tripleQuote.exec(text);

      if (match === null) {
        result += text.slice(i);
        break;
      }

      const start = match.index;
      const quoteChar = match[0];

      result += text.slice(i, start);

      const end = text.indexOf(quoteChar, start + 3);
      const content = text.slice(start + 3, end === -1 ? text.length : end);

      result += quoteChar + content.replace(/\r/g, "").replace(/\n/g, "\\n");

      if (end === -1) break;

      result += quoteChar;
      i = end + 3;
    }

    return result;
  }

  _stripInlineComment(line: string): string {
    // Don't strip if line starts with #usda
    if (line.trim().startsWith("#usda")) return line;

    // Find # that's not inside a string
    let inString = false;
    let stringChar = null;
    let escaped = false;

    for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
      const ch = line[i];

      if (escaped) {
        escaped = false;
        continue;
      }

      if (ch === "\\") {
        escaped = true;
        continue;
      }

      if (!inString && (ch === '"' || ch === "'")) {
        inString = true;
        stringChar = ch;
      } else if (inString && ch === stringChar) {
        inString = false;
        stringChar = null;
      } else if (!inString && ch === "#") {
        // Found comment start outside of string
        return line.slice(0, i).trimEnd();
      }
    }

    return line;
  }

  _findAssignmentOperator(line: string): number {
    // Find the first '=' that's not inside quotes
    let inString = false;
    let stringChar = null;
    let escaped = false;

    for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
      const ch = line[i];

      if (escaped) {
        escaped = false;
        continue;
      }

      if (ch === "\\") {
        escaped = true;
        continue;
      }

      if (!inString && (ch === '"' || ch === "'")) {
        inString = true;
        stringChar = ch;
      } else if (inString && ch === stringChar) {
        inString = false;
        stringChar = null;
      } else if (!inString && ch === "=") {
        return i;
      }
    }

    return -1;
  }

  /**
   * Parse USDA text and return raw spec data in specsByPath format.
   * Used by USDComposer for unified scene composition.
   */
  parseData(text: string): USDAData {
    const root = this.parseText(text);
    const specsByPath: Record<string, USDASpec> = {};

    // Parse root metadata
    const rootFields: USDASpecFields = {};
    if ("#usda 1.0" in root) {
      const header = root["#usda 1.0"] as Record<string, string>;

      if (header.upAxis) {
        rootFields.upAxis = header.upAxis.replace(/"/g, "");
      }

      if (header.defaultPrim) {
        rootFields.defaultPrim = header.defaultPrim.replace(/"/g, "");
      }

      if (header.metersPerUnit !== undefined) {
        rootFields.metersPerUnit = parseFloat(header.metersPerUnit);
      }

      if (header.framesPerSecond !== undefined) {
        rootFields.framesPerSecond = parseFloat(header.framesPerSecond);
      }

      if (header.timeCodesPerSecond !== undefined) {
        rootFields.timeCodesPerSecond = parseFloat(header.timeCodesPerSecond);
      }
    }

    specsByPath["/"] = { specType: SpecType.Prim, fields: rootFields };

    // Walk the tree and build specsByPath
    const walkTree = (data: USDATextNode, parentPath: string): void => {
      const primChildren = [];

      for (const key in data) {
        // Skip metadata
        if (key === "#usda 1.0") continue;
        if (key === "variants") continue;

        // Check for primitive definitions
        // Matches both 'def TypeName "name"' and 'def "name"' (no type)
        const defMatch = key.match(DEF_MATCH_REGEX);
        if (defMatch) {
          const typeName = defMatch[1] || "";
          const name = defMatch[2];
          const path = parentPath === "/" ? "/" + name : parentPath + "/" + name;

          primChildren.push(name);

          const primFields: USDASpecFields = { typeName };
          const primData = data[key] as USDATextNode;

          // Extract attributes and relationships from this prim
          this._extractPrimData(primData, path, primFields, specsByPath, SpecType);

          specsByPath[path] = { specType: SpecType.Prim, fields: primFields };

          // Recurse into children
          walkTree(primData, path);
        }
      }

      // Add primChildren to parent spec
      if (primChildren.length > 0 && specsByPath[parentPath]) {
        specsByPath[parentPath].fields.primChildren = primChildren;
      }
    };

    walkTree(root, "/");

    // Fallback: infer elementSize for primvars:skel:jointIndices/jointWeights
    // when not explicitly declared in the USDA text
    this._inferSkelElementSize(specsByPath);

    return { specsByPath };
  }

  _inferSkelElementSize(specsByPath: Record<string, USDASpec>): void {
    // For each mesh prim with primvars:skel:jointIndices/jointWeights but no
    // elementSize, infer it from the data: elementSize = array.length / numVertices.
    for (const path in specsByPath) {
      const spec = specsByPath[path];
      if (spec.specType !== SpecType.Prim || spec.fields.typeName !== "Mesh") continue;

      const pointsSpec = specsByPath[path + ".points"];
      if (!pointsSpec || !pointsSpec.fields.default) continue;

      const numVertices = (pointsSpec.fields.default as string | USDAValue[]).length / 3;
      if (numVertices === 0) continue;

      this._inferElementSize(specsByPath[path + ".primvars:skel:jointIndices"], numVertices);
      this._inferElementSize(specsByPath[path + ".primvars:skel:jointWeights"], numVertices);
    }
  }

  _inferElementSize(attrSpec: USDASpec | undefined, numVertices: number): void {
    if (!attrSpec || attrSpec.fields.elementSize !== undefined || !attrSpec.fields.default) return;

    const len = (attrSpec.fields.default as string | USDAValue[]).length;
    if (len > 0 && len % numVertices === 0) attrSpec.fields.elementSize = len / numVertices;
  }

  _extractPrimData(
    data: USDATextNode,
    path: string,
    primFields: USDASpecFields,
    specsByPath: Record<string, USDASpec>,
    SpecType: { Attribute: number; Prim: number; Relationship: number },
  ): void {
    if (!data || typeof data !== "object") return;

    for (const key in data) {
      // Skip nested defs (handled by walkTree)
      if (key.startsWith("def ")) continue;

      if (key === "prepend references") {
        primFields.references = [data[key]];
        continue;
      }

      if (key === "payload") {
        primFields.payload = data[key];
        continue;
      }

      if (key === "variants") {
        const variantSelection: Record<string, string> = {};
        const variants = data[key] as Record<string, string>;

        for (const vKey in variants) {
          const match = vKey.match(VARIANT_STRING_REGEX);
          if (match) {
            const variantSetName = match[1];
            const variantValue = variants[vKey].replace(/"/g, "");
            variantSelection[variantSetName] = variantValue;
          }
        }

        if (Object.keys(variantSelection).length > 0) {
          primFields.variantSelection = variantSelection;
        }

        continue;
      }

      if (key.startsWith("rel ")) {
        const relName = key.slice(4);
        const relPath = path + "." + relName;
        const target = (data[key] as string).replace(/[<>]/g, "");
        const metadata = data[VALUE_METADATA]?.[key];
        const fields: USDASpecFields = { targetPaths: [target] };

        if (typeof metadata?.bindMaterialAs === "string") {
          fields.bindMaterialAs = this._parseString(metadata.bindMaterialAs.trim());
        }

        specsByPath[relPath] = {
          specType: SpecType.Relationship,
          fields,
        };
        continue;
      }

      // Handle xformOpOrder
      if (key.includes("xformOpOrder")) {
        const ops = (data[key] as string)
          .replace(/[[\]]/g, "")
          .split(",")
          .map((s) => s.trim().replace(/"/g, ""));
        primFields.xformOpOrder = ops;
        continue;
      }

      // Handle typed attributes
      // Format: [qualifier] type attrName (e.g., "uniform token[] joints", "float3 position")
      const attrMatch = key.match(ATTR_MATCH_REGEX);
      if (attrMatch) {
        const valueType = attrMatch[1];
        const attrName = attrMatch[2];
        const rawValue = data[key];

        // Handle connection attributes (e.g., "inputs:normal.connect = </path>")
        if (attrName.endsWith(".connect")) {
          const baseAttrName = attrName.slice(0, -8); // Remove '.connect'
          const attrPath = path + "." + baseAttrName;

          // Parse connection path - extract from <path> format
          if (typeof rawValue !== "string") continue;
          let connPath = rawValue.trim();
          if (connPath.startsWith("<")) connPath = connPath.slice(1);
          if (connPath.endsWith(">")) connPath = connPath.slice(0, -1);

          // Get or create the attribute spec
          if (!specsByPath[attrPath]) {
            specsByPath[attrPath] = {
              specType: SpecType.Attribute,
              fields: { typeName: valueType },
            };
          }

          specsByPath[attrPath].fields.connectionPaths = [connPath];
          continue;
        }

        // Handle timeSamples attributes specially
        if (attrName.endsWith(".timeSamples") && typeof rawValue === "object") {
          const baseAttrName = attrName.slice(0, -12); // Remove '.timeSamples'
          const attrPath = path + "." + baseAttrName;

          // Parse timeSamples dictionary into times and values arrays
          const times: number[] = [];
          const values: USDAValue[] = [];

          for (const frameKey in rawValue) {
            const frame = parseFloat(frameKey);
            if (isNaN(frame)) continue;

            times.push(frame);
            values.push(this._parseAttributeValue(valueType, rawValue[frameKey]));
          }

          // Sort by time
          const sorted = times.map((t, i) => ({ t, v: values[i] })).sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t);

          specsByPath[attrPath] = {
            specType: SpecType.Attribute,
            fields: {
              timeSamples: { times: sorted.map((s) => s.t), values: sorted.map((s) => s.v) },
              typeName: valueType,
            },
          };
        } else {
          // Parse value based on type
          const parsedValue = this._parseAttributeValue(valueType, rawValue);

          // Store as attribute spec, preserving any existing fields
          // (e.g. connectionPaths set by an earlier `.connect` form)
          const attrPath = path + "." + attrName;

          if (specsByPath[attrPath]) {
            specsByPath[attrPath].fields.default = parsedValue;
            specsByPath[attrPath].fields.typeName = valueType;
          } else {
            specsByPath[attrPath] = {
              specType: SpecType.Attribute,
              fields: { default: parsedValue, typeName: valueType },
            };
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  _parseAttributeValue(valueType: string, rawValue: USDATextValue | undefined): USDAValue {
    if (typeof rawValue !== "string") return undefined;

    const str = rawValue.trim();

    // Array types
    if (valueType.endsWith("[]")) {
      let result: USDAValue[];

      // Parse JSON-like arrays
      try {
        // Handle arrays with parentheses like [(1,2,3), (4,5,6)]
        // Remove trailing comma (valid in USDA but not JSON)
        let cleaned = str.replace(/\(/g, "[").replace(/\)/g, "]");
        if (cleaned.endsWith(",")) cleaned = cleaned.slice(0, -1);
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cleaned) as USDAValue[];

        // Flatten nested arrays for types like point3f[]
        result = Array.isArray(parsed) && Array.isArray(parsed[0]) ? parsed.flat() : parsed;
      } catch {
        // Try simple array parsing
        const cleaned = str.replace(/[[\]]/g, "");
        result = cleaned.split(",").map((s) => {
          const trimmed = s.trim();
          const num = parseFloat(trimmed);
          return isNaN(num) ? trimmed.replace(/"/g, "") : num;
        });
      }

      //reorder (w, x, y, z) to (x, y, z, w)
      if (valueType.startsWith("quat")) {
        for (let i = 0; i < result.length; i += 4) {
          const w = result[i];
          result[i] = result[i + 1];
          result[i + 1] = result[i + 2];
          result[i + 2] = result[i + 3];
          result[i + 3] = w;
        }
      }

      return result;
    }

    // Vector types (double3, float3, point3f, etc.)
    if (valueType.includes("3") || valueType.includes("2") || valueType.includes("4")) {
      // Parse (x, y, z) format
      const cleaned = str.replace(/[()]/g, "");
      const values = cleaned.split(",").map((s) => parseFloat(s.trim()));
      return values;
    }

    // Quaternion types (quatf, quatd, quath)
    // Text format is (w, x, y, z), convert to (x, y, z, w)
    if (valueType.startsWith("quat")) {
      const cleaned = str.replace(/[()]/g, "");
      const values = cleaned.split(",").map((s) => parseFloat(s.trim()));
      return [values[1], values[2], values[3], values[0]];
    }

    // Matrix types
    if (valueType.includes("matrix")) {
      const cleaned = str.replace(/[()]/g, "");
      const values = cleaned.split(",").map((s) => parseFloat(s.trim()));
      return values;
    }

    // Scalar numeric types
    if (valueType === "float" || valueType === "double" || valueType === "int") {
      return parseFloat(str);
    }

    // String/token types
    if (valueType === "string" || valueType === "token") {
      return this._parseString(str);
    }

    // Asset path
    if (valueType === "asset") {
      return str.replace(/@/g, "").replace(/"/g, "");
    }

    // Default: return as string with quotes removed
    return this._parseString(str);
  }

  _parseString(str: string): string {
    // Remove surrounding quotes
    if ((str.startsWith('"') && str.endsWith('"')) || (str.startsWith("'") && str.endsWith("'"))) {
      str = str.slice(1, -1);
    }

    // Handle escape sequences
    let result = "";
    let i = 0;

    while (i < str.length) {
      if (str[i] === "\\" && i + 1 < str.length) {
        const next = str[i + 1];

        switch (next) {
          case "n":
            result += "\n";
            break;
          case "t":
            result += "\t";
            break;
          case "r":
            result += "\r";
            break;
          case "\\":
            result += "\\";
            break;
          case '"':
            result += '"';
            break;
          case "'":
            result += "'";
            break;
          default:
            result += next;
            break;
        }

        i += 2;
      } else {
        result += str[i];
        i++;
      }
    }

    return result;
  }
}
```
