```typescript
import { IS_LEAF, OFFSET, COUNT, LEFT_NODE, RIGHT_NODE } from "../utils/nodeBufferUtils";

/****************************************************/
/* This file is generated from "refit.template.js". */
/****************************************************/

export function refit_indirect(bvh: MeshBVH, nodeIndices: number[] | Set<number> | null = null) {
  if (nodeIndices && Array.isArray(nodeIndices)) {
    nodeIndices = new Set(nodeIndices);
  }

  const geometry = bvh.geometry;
  const indexArr = geometry.index ? geometry.index.array : null;
  const posAttr = geometry.attributes.position as BufferAttribute | InterleavedBufferAttribute;

  let buffer: ArrayBufferLike, uint32Array: Uint32Array, uint16Array: Uint16Array, float32Array: Float32Array;
  let byteOffset = 0;
  const roots = bvh._roots;
  for (let i = 0, l = roots.length; i < l; i++) {
    buffer = roots[i];
    uint32Array = new Uint32Array(buffer);
    uint16Array = new Uint16Array(buffer);
    float32Array = new Float32Array(buffer);

    _traverse(0, byteOffset);
    byteOffset += buffer.byteLength;
  }

  function _traverse(nodeIndex32: number, byteOffset: number, force = false): boolean {
    const nodeIndex16 = nodeIndex32 * 2;
    if (IS_LEAF(nodeIndex16, uint16Array)) {
      const offset = OFFSET(nodeIndex32, uint32Array);
      const count = COUNT(nodeIndex16, uint16Array);

      let minx = Infinity;
      let miny = Infinity;
      let minz = Infinity;
      let maxx = -Infinity;
      let maxy = -Infinity;
      let maxz = -Infinity;

      for (let i = offset, l = offset + count; i < l; i++) {
        const t = 3 * bvh.resolveTriangleIndex(i);
        for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
          let index = t + j;
          index = indexArr ? indexArr[index] : index;

          const x = posAttr.getX(index);
          const y = posAttr.getY(index);
          const z = posAttr.getZ(index);

          if (x < minx) minx = x;
          if (x > maxx) maxx = x;

          if (y < miny) miny = y;
          if (y > maxy) maxy = y;

          if (z < minz) minz = z;
          if (z > maxz) maxz = z;
        }
      }

      if (
        float32Array[nodeIndex32 + 0] !== minx ||
        float32Array[nodeIndex32 + 1] !== miny ||
        float32Array[nodeIndex32 + 2] !== minz ||
        float32Array[nodeIndex32 + 3] !== maxx ||
        float32Array[nodeIndex32 + 4] !== maxy ||
        float32Array[nodeIndex32 + 5] !== maxz
      ) {
        float32Array[nodeIndex32 + 0] = minx;
        float32Array[nodeIndex32 + 1] = miny;
        float32Array[nodeIndex32 + 2] = minz;

        float32Array[nodeIndex32 + 3] = maxx;
        float32Array[nodeIndex32 + 4] = maxy;
        float32Array[nodeIndex32 + 5] = maxz;

        return true;
      } else {
        return false;
      }
    } else {
      const left = LEFT_NODE(nodeIndex32);
      const right = RIGHT_NODE(nodeIndex32, uint32Array);

      // the identifying node indices provided by the shapecast function include offsets of all
      // root buffers to guarantee they're unique between roots so offset left and right indices here.
      let forceChildren = force;
      let includesLeft = false;
      let includesRight = false;

      if (nodeIndices) {
        // if we see that neither the left or right child are included in the set that need to be updated
        // then we assume that all children need to be updated.
        if (!forceChildren) {
          const leftNodeId = left / UINT32_PER_NODE + byteOffset / BYTES_PER_NODE;
          const rightNodeId = right / UINT32_PER_NODE + byteOffset / BYTES_PER_NODE;
          includesLeft = (nodeIndices as Set<number>).has(leftNodeId);
          includesRight = (nodeIndices as Set<number>).has(rightNodeId);
          forceChildren = !includesLeft && !includesRight;
        }
      } else {
        includesLeft = true;
        includesRight = true;
      }

      const traverseLeft = forceChildren || includesLeft;
      const traverseRight = forceChildren || includesRight;

      let leftChange = false;
      if (traverseLeft) {
        leftChange = _traverse(left, byteOffset, forceChildren);
      }

      let rightChange = false;
      if (traverseRight) {
        rightChange = _traverse(right, byteOffset, forceChildren);
      }

      const didChange = leftChange || rightChange;
      if (didChange) {
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
          const left_i = left + i;
          const right_i = right + i;
          const minLeftValue = float32Array[left_i];
          const maxLeftValue = float32Array[left_i + 3];
          const minRightValue = float32Array[right_i];
          const maxRightValue = float32Array[right_i + 3];

          float32Array[nodeIndex32 + i] = minLeftValue < minRightValue ? minLeftValue : minRightValue;
          float32Array[nodeIndex32 + i + 3] = maxLeftValue > maxRightValue ? maxLeftValue : maxRightValue;
```

## ek3d/addons/math/bvh/core/cast/shapecast

```typescript
import { Box3 } from "../../../../../math/Box3";
import type { BVH } from "../BVH";
import { CONTAINED, UINT32_PER_NODE } from "../Constants";
import { arrayToBox } from "../../utils/ArrayBoxUtilities";
import { PrimitivePool } from "../../utils/PrimitivePool";
import { COUNT, OFFSET, LEFT_NODE, RIGHT_NODE, IS_LEAF, BOUNDING_DATA_INDEX } from "../utils/nodeBufferUtils";
import { BufferStack } from "../utils/BufferStack";

let _box1: Box3, _box2: Box3;
const boxStack: Box3[] = [];
const boxPool = /* @__PURE__ */ new PrimitivePool(() => new Box3());

export type BoundsCallback = (
  box: Box3,
  isLeaf: boolean,
  score: number | undefined,
  depth: number,
  nodeIndex: number,
) => boolean | number;
export type RangeCallback = (
  offset: number,
  count: number,
  contained: boolean,
  depth: number,
  nodeIndex: number,
  box: Box3,
) => boolean | void;
export type BoundsTraverseOrder = (box: Box3) => number;

export function shapecast(
  bvh: BVH,
  root: number,
  intersectsBounds: BoundsCallback,
  intersectsRange: RangeCallback,
  boundsTraverseOrder: BoundsTraverseOrder | null | undefined,
  nodeOffset: number,
) {
  // setup
  _box1 = boxPool.getPrimitive();
  _box2 = boxPool.getPrimitive();
  boxStack.push(_box1, _box2);
  BufferStack.setBuffer(bvh._roots[root]);

  const result = shapecastTraverse(0, intersectsBounds, intersectsRange, boundsTraverseOrder, nodeOffset);

  // cleanup
  BufferStack.clearBuffer();
  boxPool.releasePrimitive(_box1);
  boxPool.releasePrimitive(_box2);
  boxStack.pop();
  boxStack.pop();

  const length = boxStack.length;
  if (length > 0) {
    _box2 = boxStack[length - 1];
    _box1 = boxStack[length - 2];
  }

  return result;
}

function shapecastTraverse(
  nodeIndex32: number,
  intersectsBoundsFunc: BoundsCallback,
  intersectsRangeFunc: RangeCallback,
  nodeScoreFunc: BoundsTraverseOrder | null | undefined = null,
  nodeIndexOffset = 0, // offset for unique node identifier
  depth = 0,
): boolean | void {
  const { float32Array, uint16Array, uint32Array } = BufferStack;
  let nodeIndex16 = nodeIndex32 * 2;

  const isLeaf = IS_LEAF(nodeIndex16, uint16Array);
  if (isLeaf) {
    const offset = OFFSET(nodeIndex32, uint32Array);
    const count = COUNT(nodeIndex16, uint16Array);
    arrayToBox(BOUNDING_DATA_INDEX(nodeIndex32), float32Array, _box1);
    return intersectsRangeFunc(offset, count, false, depth, nodeIndexOffset + nodeIndex32 / UINT32_PER_NODE, _box1);
  } else {
    const left = LEFT_NODE(nodeIndex32);
    const right = RIGHT_NODE(nodeIndex32, uint32Array);
    let c1 = left;
    let c2 = right;

    let score1, score2;
    let box1, box2;
    if (nodeScoreFunc) {
      box1 = _box1;
      box2 = _box2;

      // bounding data is not offset
      arrayToBox(BOUNDING_DATA_INDEX(c1), float32Array, box1);
      arrayToBox(BOUNDING_DATA_INDEX(c2), float32Array, box2);

      score1 = nodeScoreFunc(box1);
      score2 = nodeScoreFunc(box2);

      if (score2 < score1) {
        c1 = right;
        c2 = left;

        const temp = score1;
        score1 = score2;
        score2 = temp;

        box1 = box2;
        // box2 is always set before use below
      }
    }

    // Check box 1 intersection
    if (!box1) {
      box1 = _box1;
      arrayToBox(BOUNDING_DATA_INDEX(c1), float32Array, box1);
    }

    const isC1Leaf = IS_LEAF(c1 * 2, uint16Array);
    const c1Intersection = intersectsBoundsFunc(
      box1,
      isC1Leaf,
      score1,
      depth + 1,
      nodeIndexOffset + c1 / UINT32_PER_NODE,
    );

    let c1StopTraversal;
    if (c1Intersection === CONTAINED) {
      const offset = getLeftOffset(c1);
      const end = getRightEndOffset(c1);
      const count = end - offset;

      c1StopTraversal = intersectsRangeFunc(
        offset,
        count,
        true,
        depth + 1,
        nodeIndexOffset + c1 / UINT32_PER_NODE,
        box1,
      );
    } else {
      c1StopTraversal =
        c1Intersection &&
        shapecastTraverse(c1, intersectsBoundsFunc, intersectsRangeFunc, nodeScoreFunc, nodeIndexOffset, depth + 1);
    }

    if (c1StopTraversal) return true;

    // Check box 2 intersection
    // cached box2 will have been overwritten by previous traversal
    box2 = _box2;
    arrayToBox(BOUNDING_DATA_INDEX(c2), float32Array, box2);

    const isC2Leaf = IS_LEAF(c2 * 2, uint16Array);
    const c2Intersection = intersectsBoundsFunc(
      box2,
      isC2Leaf,
      score2,
      depth + 1,
      nodeIndexOffset + c2 / UINT32_PER_NODE,
    );

    let c2StopTraversal;
    if (c2Intersection === CONTAINED) {
      const offset = getLeftOffset(c2);
      const end = getRightEndOffset(c2);
      const count = end - offset;

      c2StopTraversal = intersectsRangeFunc(
        offset,
        count,
        true,
        depth + 1,
        nodeIndexOffset + c2 / UINT32_PER_NODE,
        box2,
      );
    } else {
      c2StopTraversal =
        c2Intersection &&
        shapecastTraverse(c2, intersectsBoundsFunc, intersectsRangeFunc, nodeScoreFunc, nodeIndexOffset, depth + 1);
    }

    if (c2StopTraversal) return true;

    return false;

    // Define these inside the function so it has access to the local variables needed
    // when converting to the buffer equivalents
    function getLeftOffset(nodeIndex32: number) {
      const { uint16Array, uint32Array } = BufferStack;
      let nodeIndex16 = nodeIndex32 * 2;

      // traverse until we find a leaf
      while (!IS_LEAF(nodeIndex16, uint16Array)) {
        nodeIndex32 = LEFT_NODE(nodeIndex32);
        nodeIndex16 = nodeIndex32 * 2;
      }

      return OFFSET(nodeIndex32, uint32Array);
    }

    function getRightEndOffset(nodeIndex32: number) {
      const { uint16Array, uint32Array } = BufferStack;
      let nodeIndex16 = nodeIndex32 * 2;

      // traverse until we find a leaf
      while (!IS_LEAF(nodeIndex16, uint16Array)) {
        // adjust offset to point to the right node
        nodeIndex32 = RIGHT_NODE(nodeIndex32, uint32Array);
        nodeIndex16 = nodeIndex32 * 2;
      }

      // return the end offset of the triangle range
      return OFFSET(nodeIndex32, uint32Array) + COUNT(nodeIndex16, uint16Array);
    }
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/bvh/core/utils/BufferStack

```typescript
export class BufferStackClass {
  float32Array: Float32Array = null!;
  uint16Array: Uint16Array = null!;
  uint32Array: Uint32Array = null!;
  private stack: ArrayBufferLike[] = [];
  private prevBuffer: ArrayBufferLike | null = null;

  setBuffer(buffer: ArrayBufferLike): void {
    if (this.prevBuffer) this.stack.push(this.prevBuffer);
    this.prevBuffer = buffer;
    this.float32Array = new Float32Array(buffer);
    this.uint16Array = new Uint16Array(buffer);
    this.uint32Array = new Uint32Array(buffer);
  }

  clearBuffer(): void {
    this.prevBuffer = null;
    this.float32Array = null!;
    this.uint16Array = null!;
    this.uint32Array = null!;
    if (this.stack.length !== 0) this.setBuffer(this.stack.pop()!);
  }
}

export const BufferStack = new BufferStackClass();
```

## ek3d/addons/math/bvh/core/utils/intersectUtils

```typescript
import { Ray } from "../../../../../math/Ray";

export function intersectsNodeBounds(nodeIndex32: number, array: Float32Array, ray: Ray, near: number, far: number) {
  // This function performs intersection tests similar to Ray.intersectBox in three.js,
  // with the difference that the box values are read from an array to improve performance.

  let tmin, tmax, tymin, tymax, tzmin, tzmax;

  const invdirx = 1 / ray.direction.x,
    invdiry = 1 / ray.direction.y,
    invdirz = 1 / ray.direction.z;

  const ox = ray.origin.x;
  const oy = ray.origin.y;
  const oz = ray.origin.z;

  let minx = array[nodeIndex32];
  let maxx = array[nodeIndex32 + 3];

  let miny = array[nodeIndex32 + 1];
  let maxy = array[nodeIndex32 + 3 + 1];

  let minz = array[nodeIndex32 + 2];
  let maxz = array[nodeIndex32 + 3 + 2];

  if (invdirx >= 0) {
    tmin = (minx - ox) * invdirx;
    tmax = (maxx - ox) * invdirx;
  } else {
    tmin = (maxx - ox) * invdirx;
    tmax = (minx - ox) * invdirx;
  }

  if (invdiry >= 0) {
    tymin = (miny - oy) * invdiry;
    tymax = (maxy - oy) * invdiry;
  } else {
    tymin = (maxy - oy) * invdiry;
    tymax = (miny - oy) * invdiry;
  }

  if (tmin > tymax || tymin > tmax) return false;

  if (tymin > tmin || isNaN(tmin)) tmin = tymin;

  if (tymax < tmax || isNaN(tmax)) tmax = tymax;

  if (invdirz >= 0) {
    tzmin = (minz - oz) * invdirz;
    tzmax = (maxz - oz) * invdirz;
  } else {
    tzmin = (maxz - oz) * invdirz;
    tzmax = (minz - oz) * invdirz;
  }

  if (tmin > tzmax || tzmin > tmax) return false;

  if (tzmin > tmin || tmin !== tmin) tmin = tzmin;

  if (tzmax < tmax || tmax !== tmax) tmax = tzmax;

  //return point closest to the ray (positive side)

  return tmin <= far && tmax >= near;
}
```

```typescript
import { Side } from "../../../../../constants";
import type { MeshBVH } from "../MeshBVH";
import type { Ray } from "../../../../../math/Ray";
import type { Material } from "../../../../../materials/Material";
import type { RayIntersection as Intersection } from "../../utils/ThreeRayIntersectUtilities";
import type { ExtendedTriangle } from "../../math/ExtendedTriangle";
import { intersectTri } from "../../utils/ThreeRayIntersectUtilities";
import { setTriangle } from "../../utils/TriangleUtilities";

/*************************************************************/
/* This file is generated from "iterationUtils.template.js". */
/*************************************************************/

export function intersectTris(
  bvh: MeshBVH,
  materialOrSide: Material | Material[] | Side,
  ray: Ray,
  offset: number,
  count: number,
  intersections: Intersection[],
  near: number,
  far: number,
) {
  const { geometry, _indirectBuffer } = bvh;
  for (let i = offset, end = offset + count; i < end; i++) {
    intersectTri(geometry, materialOrSide, ray, i, intersections, near, far);
  }
}

export function intersectClosestTri(
  bvh: MeshBVH,
  materialOrSide: Material | Material[] | Side,
  ray: Ray,
  offset: number,
  count: number,
  near: number,
  far: number,
): Intersection | null {
  const { geometry, _indirectBuffer } = bvh;
  let dist = Infinity;
  let res = null;
  for (let i = offset, end = offset + count; i < end; i++) {
    let intersection;

    intersection = intersectTri(geometry, materialOrSide, ray, i, null, near, far);

    if (intersection && intersection.distance < dist) {
      res = intersection;
      dist = intersection.distance;
    }
  }

  return res;
}

export function iterateOverTriangles(
  offset: number,
  count: number,
  bvh: MeshBVH,
  intersectsTriangleFunc: (
    triangle: ExtendedTriangle,
    index: number,
    contained: boolean,
    depth: number,
  ) => boolean | void,
  contained: boolean,
  depth: number,
  triangle: ExtendedTriangle,
) {
  const { geometry } = bvh;
  const { index } = geometry;
  const pos = geometry.attributes.position as Parameters<typeof setTriangle>[3];
  for (let i = offset, l = count + offset; i < l; i++) {
    let tri;

    tri = i;

    setTriangle(triangle, tri * 3, index, pos);
    triangle.needsUpdate = true;

    if (intersectsTriangleFunc(triangle, tri, contained, depth)) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/bvh/core/utils/nodeBufferUtils

```typescript
import { IS_LEAFNODE_FLAG, UINT32_PER_NODE } from "../Constants";

export function IS_LEAF(n16: number, uint16Array: Uint16Array) {
  return uint16Array[n16 + 15] === IS_LEAFNODE_FLAG;
}

export function OFFSET(n32: number, uint32Array: Uint32Array) {
  return uint32Array[n32 + 6];
}

export function COUNT(n16: number, uint16Array: Uint16Array) {
  return uint16Array[n16 + 14];
}

// Returns the uint32-aligned offset of the left child node for performance
export function LEFT_NODE(n32: number) {
  return n32 + UINT32_PER_NODE;
}

// Returns the uint32-aligned offset of the right child node for performance
export function RIGHT_NODE(n32: number, uint32Array: Uint32Array) {
  // stored value is relative offset from parent, convert to absolute uint32 index
  const relativeOffset = uint32Array[n32 + 6];
  return n32 + relativeOffset * UINT32_PER_NODE;
}

export function SPLIT_AXIS(n32: number, uint32Array: Uint32Array) {
  return uint32Array[n32 + 7];
}

export function BOUNDING_DATA_INDEX(n32: number) {
  return n32;
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/bvh/math/ExtendedTriangle

```typescript
import { Triangle } from "../../../../math/Triangle";
import { Vector3 } from "../../../../math/Vector3";
import { Vector2 } from "../../../../math/Vector2";
import { Line3 } from "../../../../math/Line3";
import { Plane } from "../../../../math/Plane";
import type { Sphere } from "../../../../math/Sphere";
import { SeparatingAxisBounds } from "./SeparatingAxisBounds";
import { closestPointsSegmentToSegment, sphereIntersectTriangle } from "./MathUtilities";

const componentKeys = ["x", "y", "z"] as const;
const ZERO_EPSILON = 1e-15;
const ZERO_EPSILON_SQR = ZERO_EPSILON * ZERO_EPSILON;
function isNearZero(value: number) {
  return Math.abs(value) < ZERO_EPSILON;
}

/**
 * An extended version of three' Triangle class. A variety of derivative values are cached on
 * the object to accelerate the intersection functions. `.needsUpdate` must be set to true when
 * modifying the triangle parameters.
 */
export class ExtendedTriangle extends Triangle {
  isExtendedTriangle: boolean;
  satAxes: Vector3[];
  satBounds: SeparatingAxisBounds[];
  points: Vector3[];
  plane: Plane;
  isDegenerateIntoSegment: boolean;
  isDegenerateIntoPoint: boolean;
  degenerateSegment: Line3;
  needsUpdate: boolean;

  constructor(...args: ConstructorParameters<typeof Triangle>) {
    super(...args);

    this.isExtendedTriangle = true;
    this.satAxes = Array.from({ length: 4 }, () => new Vector3());
    this.satBounds = Array.from({ length: 4 }, () => new SeparatingAxisBounds());
    this.points = [this.a, this.b, this.c];
    this.plane = new Plane();
    this.isDegenerateIntoSegment = false;
    this.isDegenerateIntoPoint = false;
    this.degenerateSegment = new Line3();

    /**
     * Indicates that the triangle fields have changed so cached variables to accelerate other
     * function execution can be updated. Must be set to true after modifying the triangle
     * `a`, `b`, `c` fields.
     */
    this.needsUpdate = true;
  }

  /**
   * Returns whether the triangle intersects the given sphere.
   */
  intersectsSphere(sphere: Sphere) {
    return sphereIntersectTriangle(sphere, this);
  }

  update() {
    const a = this.a;
    const b = this.b;
    const c = this.c;
    const points = this.points;

    const satAxes = this.satAxes;
    const satBounds = this.satBounds;

    const axis0 = satAxes[0];
    const sab0 = satBounds[0];
    this.getNormal(axis0);
    sab0.setFromPoints(axis0, points);

    const axis1 = satAxes[1];
    const sab1 = satBounds[1];
    axis1.subVectors(a, b);
    sab1.setFromPoints(axis1, points);

    const axis2 = satAxes[2];
    const sab2 = satBounds[2];
    axis2.subVectors(b, c);
    sab2.setFromPoints(axis2, points);

    const axis3 = satAxes[3];
    const sab3 = satBounds[3];
    axis3.subVectors(c, a);
    sab3.setFromPoints(axis3, points);

    const lengthAB = axis1.length();
    const lengthBC = axis2.length();
    const lengthCA = axis3.length();

    this.isDegenerateIntoPoint = false;
    this.isDegenerateIntoSegment = false;

    if (lengthAB < ZERO_EPSILON) {
      if (lengthBC < ZERO_EPSILON || lengthCA < ZERO_EPSILON) {
        this.isDegenerateIntoPoint = true;
      } else {
        this.isDegenerateIntoSegment = true;
        this.degenerateSegment.start.copy(a);
        this.degenerateSegment.end.copy(c);
      }
    } else if (lengthBC < ZERO_EPSILON) {
      if (lengthCA < ZERO_EPSILON) {
        this.isDegenerateIntoPoint = true;
      } else {
        this.isDegenerateIntoSegment = true;
        this.degenerateSegment.start.copy(b);
        this.degenerateSegment.end.copy(a);
      }
    } else if (lengthCA < ZERO_EPSILON) {
      this.isDegenerateIntoSegment = true;
      this.degenerateSegment.start.copy(c);
      this.degenerateSegment.end.copy(b);
    }

    this.plane.setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(axis0, a);

    this.needsUpdate = false;
  }

  closestPointToSegment(segment: Line3, target1: Vector3 | null = null, target2: Vector3 | null = null) {
    const { start, end } = segment;
    const points = this.points;
    let distSq;
    let closestDistanceSq = Infinity;

    // check the triangle edges
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const nexti = (i + 1) % 3;
      _closestPointToSegment_edge.start.copy(points[i]);
      _closestPointToSegment_edge.end.copy(points[nexti]);

      closestPointsSegmentToSegment(
        _closestPointToSegment_edge,
        segment,
        _closestPointToSegment_point1,
        _closestPointToSegment_point2,
      );

      distSq = _closestPointToSegment_point1.distanceToSquared(_closestPointToSegment_point2);
      if (distSq < closestDistanceSq) {
        closestDistanceSq = distSq;
        if (target1) target1.copy(_closestPointToSegment_point1);
        if (target2) target2.copy(_closestPointToSegment_point2);
      }
    }

    // check end points
    this.closestPointToPoint(start, _closestPointToSegment_point1);
    distSq = start.distanceToSquared(_closestPointToSegment_point1);
    if (distSq < closestDistanceSq) {
      closestDistanceSq = distSq;
      if (target1) target1.copy(_closestPointToSegment_point1);
      if (target2) target2.copy(start);
    }

    this.closestPointToPoint(end, _closestPointToSegment_point1);
    distSq = end.distanceToSquared(_closestPointToSegment_point1);
    if (distSq < closestDistanceSq) {
      closestDistanceSq = distSq;
      if (target1) target1.copy(_closestPointToSegment_point1);
      if (target2) target2.copy(end);
    }

    return Math.sqrt(closestDistanceSq);
  }

  intersectsTriangle(otherTriangle: Triangle, target: Line3 | null = null, suppressLog = false) {
    if (this.needsUpdate) {
      this.update();
    }

    let other: ExtendedTriangle;
    if (isExtendedTriangle(otherTriangle)) {
      other = otherTriangle;
      if (other.needsUpdate) other.update();
    } else {
      _intersectsTriangle_saTri2.copy(otherTriangle);
      _intersectsTriangle_saTri2.update();
      other = _intersectsTriangle_saTri2;
    }

    const res = _intersectsTriangle_handleDegenerateCases(this, other, target, suppressLog);
    if (res !== undefined) {
      return res;
    }

    const plane1 = this.plane;
    const plane2 = other.plane;

    let a1Dist = plane2.distanceToPoint(this.a);
    let b1Dist = plane2.distanceToPoint(this.b);
    let c1Dist = plane2.distanceToPoint(this.c);

    if (isNearZero(a1Dist)) a1Dist = 0;

    if (isNearZero(b1Dist)) b1Dist = 0;

    if (isNearZero(c1Dist)) c1Dist = 0;

    const a1b1Dist = a1Dist * b1Dist;
    const a1c1Dist = a1Dist * c1Dist;
    if (a1b1Dist > 0 && a1c1Dist > 0) {
      return false;
    }

    let a2Dist = plane1.distanceToPoint(other.a);
    let b2Dist = plane1.distanceToPoint(other.b);
    let c2Dist = plane1.distanceToPoint(other.c);

    if (isNearZero(a2Dist)) a2Dist = 0;

    if (isNearZero(b2Dist)) b2Dist = 0;

    if (isNearZero(c2Dist)) c2Dist = 0;

    const a2b2Dist = a2Dist * b2Dist;
    const a2c2Dist = a2Dist * c2Dist;
    if (a2b2Dist > 0 && a2c2Dist > 0) {
      return false;
    }

    _intersectsTriangle_dir1.copy(plane1.normal);
    _intersectsTriangle_dir2.copy(plane2.normal);
    const intersectionLine = _intersectsTriangle_dir1.cross(_intersectsTriangle_dir2);

    let componentIndex = 0;
    let maxComponent = Math.abs(intersectionLine.x);
    const comp1 = Math.abs(intersectionLine.y);
    if (comp1 > maxComponent) {
      maxComponent = comp1;
      componentIndex = 1;
    }

    const comp2 = Math.abs(intersectionLine.z);
    if (comp2 > maxComponent) {
      componentIndex = 2;
    }

    const key = componentKeys[componentIndex];
    const a1Proj = this.a[key];
    const b1Proj = this.b[key];
    const c1Proj = this.c[key];

    const a2Proj = other.a[key];
    const b2Proj = other.b[key];
    const c2Proj = other.c[key];

    if (
      _intersectsTriangle_findIntersectionLineBounds(
        this,
        a1Proj,
        b1Proj,
        c1Proj,
        a1b1Dist,
        a1c1Dist,
        a1Dist,
        b1Dist,
        c1Dist,
        _intersectsTriangle_bounds1,
        _intersectsTriangle_edge1,
      )
    ) {
      return _intersectsTriangle_coplanarIntersectsTriangle(this, other, target, suppressLog);
    }

    if (
      _intersectsTriangle_findIntersectionLineBounds(
        other,
        a2Proj,
        b2Proj,
        c2Proj,
        a2b2Dist,
        a2c2Dist,
        a2Dist,
        b2Dist,
        c2Dist,
        _intersectsTriangle_bounds2,
        _intersectsTriangle_edge2,
      )
    ) {
      return _intersectsTriangle_coplanarIntersectsTriangle(this, other, target, suppressLog);
    }

    if (_intersectsTriangle_bounds1.y < _intersectsTriangle_bounds1.x) {
      const tmp = _intersectsTriangle_bounds1.y;
      _intersectsTriangle_bounds1.y = _intersectsTriangle_bounds1.x;
      _intersectsTriangle_bounds1.x = tmp;

      _intersectsTriangle_tempPoint.copy(_intersectsTriangle_edge1.start);
      _intersectsTriangle_edge1.start.copy(_intersectsTriangle_edge1.end);
      _intersectsTriangle_edge1.end.copy(_intersectsTriangle_tempPoint);
    }

    if (_intersectsTriangle_bounds2.y < _intersectsTriangle_bounds2.x) {
      const tmp = _intersectsTriangle_bounds2.y;
      _intersectsTriangle_bounds2.y = _intersectsTriangle_bounds2.x;
      _intersectsTriangle_bounds2.x = tmp;

      _intersectsTriangle_tempPoint.copy(_intersectsTriangle_edge2.start);
      _intersectsTriangle_edge2.start.copy(_intersectsTriangle_edge2.end);
      _intersectsTriangle_edge2.end.copy(_intersectsTriangle_tempPoint);
    }

    if (
      _intersectsTriangle_bounds1.y < _intersectsTriangle_bounds2.x ||
      _intersectsTriangle_bounds2.y < _intersectsTriangle_bounds1.x
    ) {
      return false;
    }

    if (target) {
      if (_intersectsTriangle_bounds2.x > _intersectsTriangle_bounds1.x) {
        target.start.copy(_intersectsTriangle_edge2.start);
      } else {
        target.start.copy(_intersectsTriangle_edge1.start);
      }

      if (_intersectsTriangle_bounds2.y < _intersectsTriangle_bounds1.y) {
        target.end.copy(_intersectsTriangle_edge2.end);
      } else {
        target.end.copy(_intersectsTriangle_edge1.end);
      }
    }

    return true;
  }

  distanceToPoint(point: Vector3) {
    this.closestPointToPoint(point, _distanceToPoint_target);
    return point.distanceTo(_distanceToPoint_target);
  }

  distanceToTriangle(other: Triangle, target1: Vector3 | null = null, target2: Vector3 | null = null) {
    const lineTarget = target1 || target2 ? _distanceToTriangle_line1 : null;
    // `intersectsTriangle` returns a zero-length segment for coplanar
    // intersecting triangles, which is fine for our purposes here. We
    // don't need the segment itself in this function. So we can suppress
    // the warning about coplanar triangles.
    if (this.intersectsTriangle(other, lineTarget, true)) {
      if (lineTarget) {
        if (target1) lineTarget.getCenter(target1);
        if (target2) lineTarget.getCenter(target2);
      }

      return 0;
    }

    let closestDistanceSq = Infinity;

    // check all point distances
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      let dist;
      const field = _distanceToTriangle_cornerFields[i];
      const otherVec = other[field];
      this.closestPointToPoint(otherVec, _distanceToTriangle_point);

      dist = otherVec.distanceToSquared(_distanceToTriangle_point);

      if (dist < closestDistanceSq) {
        closestDistanceSq = dist;
        if (target1) target1.copy(_distanceToTriangle_point);
        if (target2) target2.copy(otherVec);
      }

      const thisVec = this[field];
      other.closestPointToPoint(thisVec, _distanceToTriangle_point);

      dist = thisVec.distanceToSquared(_distanceToTriangle_point);

      if (dist < closestDistanceSq) {
        closestDistanceSq = dist;
        if (target1) target1.copy(thisVec);
        if (target2) target2.copy(_distanceToTriangle_point);
      }
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const f11 = _distanceToTriangle_cornerFields[i];
      const f12 = _distanceToTriangle_cornerFields[(i + 1) % 3];
      _distanceToTriangle_line1.set(this[f11], this[f12]);
      for (let i2 = 0; i2 < 3; i2++) {
        const f21 = _distanceToTriangle_cornerFields[i2];
        const f22 = _distanceToTriangle_cornerFields[(i2 + 1) % 3];
        _distanceToTriangle_line2.set(other[f21], other[f22]);

        closestPointsSegmentToSegment(
          _distanceToTriangle_line1,
          _distanceToTriangle_line2,
          _distanceToTriangle_point,
          _distanceToTriangle_point2,
        );

        const dist = _distanceToTriangle_point.distanceToSquared(_distanceToTriangle_point2);
        if (dist < closestDistanceSq) {
          closestDistanceSq = dist;
          if (target1) target1.copy(_distanceToTriangle_point);
          if (target2) target2.copy(_distanceToTriangle_point2);
        }
      }
    }

    return Math.sqrt(closestDistanceSq);
  }
}

const _closestPointToSegment_point1 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
const _closestPointToSegment_point2 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
const _closestPointToSegment_edge = /* @__PURE__ */ new Line3();

const _intersectsTriangle_saTri2 = /* @__PURE__ */ new ExtendedTriangle();
const _intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds = /* @__PURE__ */ new SeparatingAxisBounds();
const _intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds2 = /* @__PURE__ */ new SeparatingAxisBounds();
const _intersectsTriangle_tmpVec = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
const _intersectsTriangle_dir1 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
const _intersectsTriangle_dir2 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
const _intersectsTriangle_tempDir = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
const _intersectsTriangle_edge1 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Line3();
const _intersectsTriangle_edge2 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Line3();
const _intersectsTriangle_tempPoint = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
const _intersectsTriangle_bounds1 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector2();
const _intersectsTriangle_bounds2 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector2();

function _intersectsTriangle_coplanarIntersectsTriangle(
  self: ExtendedTriangle,
  other: ExtendedTriangle,
  target: Line3 | null,
  suppressLog: boolean,
) {
  // Perform separating axis intersection test only for coplanar triangles
  // There should be at least one non-degenerate triangle when calling this
  // Otherwise we won't know the plane normal
  const planeNormal = _intersectsTriangle_tmpVec;
  if (!self.isDegenerateIntoPoint && !self.isDegenerateIntoSegment) {
    planeNormal.copy(self.plane.normal);
  } else {
    planeNormal.copy(other.plane.normal);
  }

  const satBounds1 = self.satBounds;
  const satAxes1 = self.satAxes;
  for (let i = 1; i < 4; i++) {
    const sb = satBounds1[i];
    const sa = satAxes1[i];
    _intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds.setFromPoints(sa, other.points);
    if (sb.isSeparated(_intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds)) return false;

    _intersectsTriangle_tempDir.copy(planeNormal).cross(sa);
    _intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds.setFromPoints(_intersectsTriangle_tempDir, self.points);
    _intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds2.setFromPoints(_intersectsTriangle_tempDir, other.points);
    if (_intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds.isSeparated(_intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds2)) return false;
  }

  const satBounds2 = other.satBounds;
  const satAxes2 = other.satAxes;
  for (let i = 1; i < 4; i++) {
    const sb = satBounds2[i];
    const sa = satAxes2[i];
    _intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds.setFromPoints(sa, self.points);
    if (sb.isSeparated(_intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds)) return false;

    _intersectsTriangle_tempDir.crossVectors(planeNormal, sa);
    _intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds.setFromPoints(_intersectsTriangle_tempDir, self.points);
    _intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds2.setFromPoints(_intersectsTriangle_tempDir, other.points);
    if (_intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds.isSeparated(_intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds2)) return false;
  }

  if (target) {
    // TODO find two points that intersect on the edges and make that the result
    if (!suppressLog) {
      console.warn(
        "ExtendedTriangle.intersectsTriangle: Triangles are coplanar which does not support an output edge. Setting edge to 0, 0, 0.",
      );
    }

    target.start.set(0, 0, 0);
    target.end.set(0, 0, 0);
  }

  return true;
}

function _intersectsTriangle_findSingleBounds(
  a: Vector3,
  b: Vector3,
  c: Vector3,
  aProj: number,
  bProj: number,
  cProj: number,
  aDist: number,
  bDist: number,
  cDist: number,
  bounds: Vector2,
  edge: Line3,
) {
  let t = aDist / (aDist - bDist);
  bounds.x = aProj + (bProj - aProj) * t;
  edge.start.subVectors(b, a).multiplyScalar(t).add(a);

  t = aDist / (aDist - cDist);
  bounds.y = aProj + (cProj - aProj) * t;
  edge.end.subVectors(c, a).multiplyScalar(t).add(a);
}

/**
 * Calculates intersection segment of a triangle with intersection line.
 * Intersection line is snapped to its biggest component.
 * And triangle points are passed as a projection on that component.
 */
function _intersectsTriangle_findIntersectionLineBounds(
  self: ExtendedTriangle,
  aProj: number,
  bProj: number,
  cProj: number,
  abDist: number,
  acDist: number,
  aDist: number,
  bDist: number,
  cDist: number,
  bounds: Vector2,
  edge: Line3,
) {
  if (abDist > 0) {
    // then bcDist < 0
    _intersectsTriangle_findSingleBounds(
      self.c,
      self.a,
      self.b,
      cProj,
      aProj,
      bProj,
      cDist,
      aDist,
      bDist,
      bounds,
      edge,
    );
  } else if (acDist > 0) {
    _intersectsTriangle_findSingleBounds(
      self.b,
      self.a,
      self.c,
      bProj,
      aProj,
      cProj,
      bDist,
      aDist,
      cDist,
      bounds,
      edge,
    );
  } else if (bDist * cDist > 0 || aDist != 0) {
    _intersectsTriangle_findSingleBounds(
      self.a,
      self.b,
      self.c,
      aProj,
      bProj,
      cProj,
      aDist,
      bDist,
      cDist,
      bounds,
      edge,
    );
  } else if (bDist != 0) {
    _intersectsTriangle_findSingleBounds(
      self.b,
      self.a,
      self.c,
      bProj,
      aProj,
      cProj,
      bDist,
      aDist,
      cDist,
      bounds,
      edge,
    );
  } else if (cDist != 0) {
    _intersectsTriangle_findSingleBounds(
      self.c,
      self.a,
      self.b,
      cProj,
      aProj,
      bProj,
      cDist,
      aDist,
      bDist,
      bounds,
      edge,
    );
  } else {
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}

function _intersectsTriangle_intersectTriangleSegment(
  triangle: ExtendedTriangle,
  degenerateTriangle: ExtendedTriangle,
  target: Line3 | null,
  suppressLog: boolean,
) {
  const segment = degenerateTriangle.degenerateSegment;
  const startDist = triangle.plane.distanceToPoint(segment.start);
  const endDist = triangle.plane.distanceToPoint(segment.end);
  if (isNearZero(startDist)) {
    if (isNearZero(endDist)) {
      return _intersectsTriangle_coplanarIntersectsTriangle(triangle, degenerateTriangle, target, suppressLog);
    } else {
      // Is this fine to modify target even if there might be no intersection?
      if (target) {
        target.start.copy(segment.start);
        target.end.copy(segment.start);
      }

      return triangle.containsPoint(segment.start);
    }
  } else if (isNearZero(endDist)) {
    if (target) {
      target.start.copy(segment.end);
      target.end.copy(segment.end);
    }

    return triangle.containsPoint(segment.end);
  } else {
    if (triangle.plane.intersectLine(segment, _intersectsTriangle_tmpVec) != null) {
      if (target) {
        target.start.copy(_intersectsTriangle_tmpVec);
        target.end.copy(_intersectsTriangle_tmpVec);
      }

      return triangle.containsPoint(_intersectsTriangle_tmpVec);
    } else {
      return false;
    }
  }
}

function _intersectsTriangle_intersectTrianglePoint(
  triangle: ExtendedTriangle,
  degenerateTriangle: ExtendedTriangle,
  target: Line3 | null,
) {
  const point = degenerateTriangle.a;

  if (isNearZero(triangle.plane.distanceToPoint(point)) && triangle.containsPoint(point)) {
    if (target) {
      target.start.copy(point);
      target.end.copy(point);
    }

    return true;
  } else {
    return false;
  }
}

function _intersectsTriangle_intersectSegmentPoint(
  segmentTri: ExtendedTriangle,
  pointTri: ExtendedTriangle,
  target: Line3 | null,
) {
  const segment = segmentTri.degenerateSegment;
  const point = pointTri.a;

  segment.closestPointToPoint(point, true, _intersectsTriangle_tmpVec);

  if (point.distanceToSquared(_intersectsTriangle_tmpVec) < ZERO_EPSILON_SQR) {
    if (target) {
      target.start.copy(point);
      target.end.copy(point);
    }

    return true;
  } else {
    return false;
  }
}

function _intersectsTriangle_handleDegenerateCases(
  self: ExtendedTriangle,
  other: ExtendedTriangle,
  target: Line3 | null,
  suppressLog: boolean,
) {
  if (self.isDegenerateIntoSegment) {
    if (other.isDegenerateIntoSegment) {
      // TODO: replace with Line.distanceSqToLine3 after r179
      const segment1 = self.degenerateSegment;
      const segment2 = other.degenerateSegment;
      const delta1 = _intersectsTriangle_dir1;
      const delta2 = _intersectsTriangle_dir2;
      segment1.delta(delta1);
      segment2.delta(delta2);
      const startDelta = _intersectsTriangle_tmpVec.subVectors(segment2.start, segment1.start);

      const denom = delta1.x * delta2.y - delta1.y * delta2.x;
      if (isNearZero(denom)) {
        return false;
      }

      const t = (startDelta.x * delta2.y - startDelta.y * delta2.x) / denom;
      const u = -(delta1.x * startDelta.y - delta1.y * startDelta.x) / denom;

      if (t < 0 || t > 1 || u < 0 || u > 1) {
        return false;
      }

      const z1 = segment1.start.z + delta1.z * t;
      const z2 = segment2.start.z + delta2.z * u;

      if (isNearZero(z1 - z2)) {
        if (target) {
          target.start.copy(segment1.start).addScaledVector(delta1, t);
          target.end.copy(segment1.start).addScaledVector(delta1, t);
        }

        return true;
      } else {
        return false;
      }
    } else if (other.isDegenerateIntoPoint) {
      return _intersectsTriangle_intersectSegmentPoint(self, other, target);
    } else {
      return _intersectsTriangle_intersectTriangleSegment(other, self, target, suppressLog);
    }
  } else if (self.isDegenerateIntoPoint) {
    if (other.isDegenerateIntoPoint) {
      if (other.a.distanceToSquared(self.a) < ZERO_EPSILON_SQR) {
        if (target) {
          target.start.copy(self.a);
          target.end.copy(self.a);
        }

        return true;
      } else {
        return false;
      }
    } else if (other.isDegenerateIntoSegment) {
      return _intersectsTriangle_intersectSegmentPoint(other, self, target);
    } else {
      return _intersectsTriangle_intersectTrianglePoint(other, self, target);
    }
  } else {
    if (other.isDegenerateIntoPoint) {
      return _intersectsTriangle_intersectTrianglePoint(self, other, target);
    } else if (other.isDegenerateIntoSegment) {
      return _intersectsTriangle_intersectTriangleSegment(self, other, target, suppressLog);
    } /* else this is a general triangle-traingle case, so return undefined */
  }
}

const _distanceToPoint_target = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();

const _distanceToTriangle_point = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
const _distanceToTriangle_point2 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
const _distanceToTriangle_cornerFields = ["a", "b", "c"] as const;
const _distanceToTriangle_line1 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Line3();
const _distanceToTriangle_line2 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Line3();

function isExtendedTriangle(triangle: Triangle): triangle is ExtendedTriangle {
  return "isExtendedTriangle" in triangle && Boolean(triangle.isExtendedTriangle);
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/bvh/math/MathUtilities

```typescript
import { Vector3 } from "../../../../math/Vector3";
import { Vector2 } from "../../../../math/Vector2";
import { Plane } from "../../../../math/Plane";
import { Line3 } from "../../../../math/Line3";
import type { Sphere } from "../../../../math/Sphere";
import type { Triangle } from "../../../../math/Triangle";

export const closestPointLineToLine = (function () {
  // https://github.com/juj/MathGeoLib/blob/master/src/Geometry/Line.cpp#L56
  const dir1 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
  const dir2 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
  const v02 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
  return function closestPointLineToLine(l1: Line3, l2: Line3, result: Vector2) {
    const v0 = l1.start;
    const v10 = dir1;
    const v2 = l2.start;
    const v32 = dir2;

    v02.subVectors(v0, v2);
    dir1.subVectors(l1.end, l1.start);
    dir2.subVectors(l2.end, l2.start);

    // float d0232 = v02.Dot(v32);
    const d0232 = v02.dot(v32);

    // float d3210 = v32.Dot(v10);
    const d3210 = v32.dot(v10);

    // float d3232 = v32.Dot(v32);
    const d3232 = v32.dot(v32);

    // float d0210 = v02.Dot(v10);
    const d0210 = v02.dot(v10);

    // float d1010 = v10.Dot(v10);
    const d1010 = v10.dot(v10);

    // float denom = d1010*d3232 - d3210*d3210;
    const denom = d1010 * d3232 - d3210 * d3210;

    let d, d2;
    if (denom !== 0) {
      d = (d0232 * d3210 - d0210 * d3232) / denom;
    } else {
      d = 0;
    }

    d2 = (d0232 + d * d3210) / d3232;

    result.x = d;
    result.y = d2;
  };
})();

export const closestPointsSegmentToSegment = (function () {
  // https://github.com/juj/MathGeoLib/blob/master/src/Geometry/LineSegment.cpp#L187
  const paramResult = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector2();
  const temp1 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
  const temp2 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
  return function closestPointsSegmentToSegment(l1: Line3, l2: Line3, target1: Vector3, target2: Vector3) {
    closestPointLineToLine(l1, l2, paramResult);

    let d = paramResult.x;
    let d2 = paramResult.y;
    if (d >= 0 && d <= 1 && d2 >= 0 && d2 <= 1) {
      l1.at(d, target1);
      l2.at(d2, target2);

      return;
    } else if (d >= 0 && d <= 1) {
      // Only d2 is out of bounds.
      if (d2 < 0) {
        l2.at(0, target2);
      } else {
        l2.at(1, target2);
      }

      l1.closestPointToPoint(target2, true, target1);
      return;
    } else if (d2 >= 0 && d2 <= 1) {
      // Only d is out of bounds.
      if (d < 0) {
        l1.at(0, target1);
      } else {
        l1.at(1, target1);
      }

      l2.closestPointToPoint(target1, true, target2);
      return;
    } else {
      // Both u and u2 are out of bounds.
      let p;
      if (d < 0) {
        p = l1.start;
      } else {
        p = l1.end;
      }

      let p2;
      if (d2 < 0) {
        p2 = l2.start;
      } else {
        p2 = l2.end;
      }

      const closestPoint = temp1;
      const closestPoint2 = temp2;
      l1.closestPointToPoint(p2, true, temp1);
      l2.closestPointToPoint(p, true, temp2);

      if (closestPoint.distanceToSquared(p2) <= closestPoint2.distanceToSquared(p)) {
        target1.copy(closestPoint);
        target2.copy(p2);
        return;
      } else {
        target1.copy(p);
        target2.copy(closestPoint2);
        return;
      }
    }
  };
})();

export const sphereIntersectTriangle = (function () {
  // https://stackoverflow.com/questions/34043955/detect-collision-between-sphere-and-triangle-in-three-js
  const closestPointTemp = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
  const projectedPointTemp = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
  const planeTemp = /* @__PURE__ */ new Plane();
  const lineTemp = /* @__PURE__ */ new Line3();
  return function sphereIntersectTriangle(sphere: Sphere, triangle: Triangle) {
    const { radius, center } = sphere;
    const { a, b, c } = triangle;

    // phase 1
    lineTemp.start = a;
    lineTemp.end = b;
    const closestPoint1 = lineTemp.closestPointToPoint(center, true, closestPointTemp);
    if (closestPoint1.distanceTo(center) <= radius) return true;

    lineTemp.start = a;
    lineTemp.end = c;
    const closestPoint2 = lineTemp.closestPointToPoint(center, true, closestPointTemp);
    if (closestPoint2.distanceTo(center) <= radius) return true;

    lineTemp.start = b;
    lineTemp.end = c;
    const closestPoint3 = lineTemp.closestPointToPoint(center, true, closestPointTemp);
    if (closestPoint3.distanceTo(center) <= radius) return true;

    // phase 2
    const plane = triangle.getPlane(planeTemp);
    const dp = Math.abs(plane.distanceToPoint(center));
    if (dp <= radius) {
      const pp = plane.projectPoint(center, projectedPointTemp);
      const cp = triangle.containsPoint(pp);
      if (cp) return true;
    }

    return false;
  };
})();
```

## ek3d/addons/math/bvh/math/OrientedBox

```typescript
import { Vector3 } from "../../../../math/Vector3";
import { Matrix4 } from "../../../../math/Matrix4";
import { Line3 } from "../../../../math/Line3";
import type { Box3 } from "../../../../math/Box3";
import type { Triangle } from "../../../../math/Triangle";
import { SeparatingAxisBounds } from "./SeparatingAxisBounds";
import { ExtendedTriangle } from "./ExtendedTriangle";
import { closestPointsSegmentToSegment } from "./MathUtilities";

/**
 * An oriented version of three' Box3 class. A variety of derivative values are cached on the
 * object to accelerate the intersection functions. `.needsUpdate` must be set to true when
 * modifying the box parameters.
 *
 */
export class OrientedBox {
  isOrientedBox: boolean;
  min: Vector3;
  max: Vector3;
  matrix: Matrix4;
  invMatrix: Matrix4;
  points: Vector3[];
  satAxes: Vector3[];
  satBounds: SeparatingAxisBounds[];
  alignedSatBounds: SeparatingAxisBounds[];
  needsUpdate: boolean;

  constructor(min?: Vector3, max?: Vector3, matrix?: Matrix4) {
    this.isOrientedBox = true;

    this.min = new Vector3();

    this.max = new Vector3();

    /**
     * Matrix transformation applied to the box.
     */
    this.matrix = new Matrix4();
    this.invMatrix = new Matrix4();
    this.points = Array.from({ length: 8 }, () => new Vector3());
    this.satAxes = Array.from({ length: 3 }, () => new Vector3());
    this.satBounds = Array.from({ length: 3 }, () => new SeparatingAxisBounds());
    this.alignedSatBounds = Array.from({ length: 3 }, () => new SeparatingAxisBounds());
    /**
     * Indicates that the bounding box fields have changed so cached variables to accelerate
     * other function execution can be updated. Must be set to true after modifying the
     * oriented box `min`, `max`, `matrix` fields.
     */
    this.needsUpdate = false;

    if (min) this.min.copy(min);
    if (max) this.max.copy(max);
    if (matrix) this.matrix.copy(matrix);
  }

  /**
   * Sets the oriented box parameters.
   */
  set(min: Vector3, max: Vector3, matrix: Matrix4) {
    this.min.copy(min);
    this.max.copy(max);
    this.matrix.copy(matrix);
    this.needsUpdate = true;
  }

  copy(other: OrientedBox) {
    this.min.copy(other.min);
    this.max.copy(other.max);
    this.matrix.copy(other.matrix);
    this.needsUpdate = true;
  }

  update() {
    const matrix = this.matrix;
    const min = this.min;
    const max = this.max;

    const points = this.points;
    for (let x = 0; x <= 1; x++) {
      for (let y = 0; y <= 1; y++) {
        for (let z = 0; z <= 1; z++) {
          const i = ((1 << 0) * x) | ((1 << 1) * y) | ((1 << 2) * z);
          const v = points[i];
          v.x = x ? max.x : min.x;
          v.y = y ? max.y : min.y;
          v.z = z ? max.z : min.z;

          v.applyMatrix4(matrix);
        }
      }
    }

    const satBounds = this.satBounds;
    const satAxes = this.satAxes;
    const minVec = points[0];
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const axis = satAxes[i];
      const sb = satBounds[i];
      const index = 1 << i;
      const pi = points[index];

      axis.subVectors(minVec, pi);
      sb.setFromPoints(axis, points);
    }

    const alignedSatBounds = this.alignedSatBounds;
    alignedSatBounds[0].setFromPointsField(points, "x");
    alignedSatBounds[1].setFromPointsField(points, "y");
    alignedSatBounds[2].setFromPointsField(points, "z");

    this.invMatrix.copy(this.matrix).invert();
    this.needsUpdate = false;
  }

  intersectsBox(box: Box3) {
    // TODO: should this be doing SAT against the AABB?
    if (this.needsUpdate) {
      this.update();
    }

    const min = box.min;
    const max = box.max;
    const satBounds = this.satBounds;
    const satAxes = this.satAxes;
    const alignedSatBounds = this.alignedSatBounds;

    _intersectsBox_aabbBounds.min = min.x;
    _intersectsBox_aabbBounds.max = max.x;
    if (alignedSatBounds[0].isSeparated(_intersectsBox_aabbBounds)) return false;

    _intersectsBox_aabbBounds.min = min.y;
    _intersectsBox_aabbBounds.max = max.y;
    if (alignedSatBounds[1].isSeparated(_intersectsBox_aabbBounds)) return false;

    _intersectsBox_aabbBounds.min = min.z;
    _intersectsBox_aabbBounds.max = max.z;
    if (alignedSatBounds[2].isSeparated(_intersectsBox_aabbBounds)) return false;

    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const axis = satAxes[i];
      const sb = satBounds[i];
      _intersectsBox_aabbBounds.setFromBox(axis, box);
      if (sb.isSeparated(_intersectsBox_aabbBounds)) return false;
    }

    return true;
  }

  intersectsTriangle(inputTriangle: Triangle) {
    if (this.needsUpdate) {
      this.update();
    }

    let triangle: ExtendedTriangle;
    if (isExtendedTriangle(inputTriangle)) {
      triangle = inputTriangle;
      if (triangle.needsUpdate) triangle.update();
    } else {
      _intersectsTriangle_saTri.copy(inputTriangle);
      _intersectsTriangle_saTri.update();
      triangle = _intersectsTriangle_saTri;
    }

    const satBounds = this.satBounds;
    const satAxes = this.satAxes;

    _intersectsTriangle_pointsArr[0] = triangle.a;
    _intersectsTriangle_pointsArr[1] = triangle.b;
    _intersectsTriangle_pointsArr[2] = triangle.c;

    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const sb = satBounds[i];
      const sa = satAxes[i];
      _intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds.setFromPoints(sa, _intersectsTriangle_pointsArr);
      if (sb.isSeparated(_intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds)) return false;
    }

    const triSatBounds = triangle.satBounds;
    const triSatAxes = triangle.satAxes;
    const points = this.points;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const sb = triSatBounds[i];
      const sa = triSatAxes[i];
      _intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds.setFromPoints(sa, points);
      if (sb.isSeparated(_intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds)) return false;
    }

    // check crossed axes
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const sa1 = satAxes[i];
      for (let i2 = 0; i2 < 4; i2++) {
        const sa2 = triSatAxes[i2];
        _intersectsTriangle_cachedAxis.crossVectors(sa1, sa2);
        _intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds.setFromPoints(
          _intersectsTriangle_cachedAxis,
          _intersectsTriangle_pointsArr,
        );
        _intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds2.setFromPoints(_intersectsTriangle_cachedAxis, points);
        if (_intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds.isSeparated(_intersectsTriangle_cachedSatBounds2)) return false;
      }
    }

    return true;
  }

  closestPointToPoint(point: Vector3, target1: Vector3) {
    if (this.needsUpdate) {
      this.update();
    }

    target1.copy(point).applyMatrix4(this.invMatrix).clamp(this.min, this.max).applyMatrix4(this.matrix);

    return target1;
  }

  distanceToPoint(point: Vector3) {
    this.closestPointToPoint(point, _distanceToPoint_target);
    return point.distanceTo(_distanceToPoint_target);
  }

  distanceToBox(box: Box3, threshold = 0, target1: Vector3 | null = null, target2: Vector3 | null = null) {
    if (this.needsUpdate) {
      this.update();
    }

    if (this.intersectsBox(box)) {
      if (target1 || target2) {
        box.getCenter(_distanceToBox_point2);
        this.closestPointToPoint(_distanceToBox_point2, _distanceToBox_point1);
        box.clampPoint(_distanceToBox_point1, _distanceToBox_point2);

        if (target1) target1.copy(_distanceToBox_point1);
        if (target2) target2.copy(_distanceToBox_point2);
      }

      return 0;
    }

    const threshold2 = threshold * threshold;
    const min = box.min;
    const max = box.max;
    const points = this.points;

    // iterate over every edge and compare distances
    let closestDistanceSq = Infinity;

    // check over all these points
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const p = points[i];
      _distanceToBox_point2.copy(p).clamp(min, max);

      const dist = p.distanceToSquared(_distanceToBox_point2);
      if (dist < closestDistanceSq) {
        closestDistanceSq = dist;
        if (target1) target1.copy(p);
        if (target2) target2.copy(_distanceToBox_point2);

        if (dist < threshold2) return Math.sqrt(dist);
      }
    }

    // generate and check all line segment distances
    let count = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      for (let i1 = 0; i1 <= 1; i1++) {
        for (let i2 = 0; i2 <= 1; i2++) {
          const nextIndex = (i + 1) % 3;
          const nextIndex2 = (i + 2) % 3;

          // get obb line segments
          const index = (i1 << nextIndex) | (i2 << nextIndex2);
          const index2 = (1 << i) | (i1 << nextIndex) | (i2 << nextIndex2);
          const p1 = points[index];
          const p2 = points[index2];
          const line1 = _distanceToBox_segments1[count];
          line1.set(p1, p2);

          // get aabb line segments
          const f1 = _distanceToBox_xyzFields[i];
          const f2 = _distanceToBox_xyzFields[nextIndex];
          const f3 = _distanceToBox_xyzFields[nextIndex2];
          const line2 = _distanceToBox_segments2[count];
          const start = line2.start;
          const end = line2.end;

          start[f1] = min[f1];
          start[f2] = i1 ? min[f2] : max[f2];
          start[f3] = i2 ? min[f3] : max[f2];

          end[f1] = max[f1];
          end[f2] = i1 ? min[f2] : max[f2];
          end[f3] = i2 ? min[f3] : max[f2];

          count++;
        }
      }
    }

    // check all the other boxes point
    for (let x = 0; x <= 1; x++) {
      for (let y = 0; y <= 1; y++) {
        for (let z = 0; z <= 1; z++) {
          _distanceToBox_point2.x = x ? max.x : min.x;
          _distanceToBox_point2.y = y ? max.y : min.y;
          _distanceToBox_point2.z = z ? max.z : min.z;

          this.closestPointToPoint(_distanceToBox_point2, _distanceToBox_point1);
          const dist = _distanceToBox_point2.distanceToSquared(_distanceToBox_point1);
          if (dist < closestDistanceSq) {
            closestDistanceSq = dist;
            if (target1) target1.copy(_distanceToBox_point1);
            if (target2) target2.copy(_distanceToBox_point2);

            if (dist < threshold2) return Math.sqrt(dist);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      const l1 = _distanceToBox_segments1[i];
      for (let i2 = 0; i2 < 12; i2++) {
        const l2 = _distanceToBox_segments2[i2];
        closestPointsSegmentToSegment(l1, l2, _distanceToBox_point1, _distanceToBox_point2);
        const dist = _distanceToBox_point1.distanceToSquared(_distanceToBox_point2);
        if (dist < closestDistanceSq) {
          closestDistanceSq = dist;
          if (target1) target1.copy(_distanceToBox_point1);
          if (target2) target2.copy(_distanceToBox_point2);

          if (dist < threshold2) return Math.sqrt(dist);
        }
      }
    }

    return Math.sqrt(closestDistanceSq);
  }
}

const _intersectsBox_aabbBounds = /* @__PURE__ */ new SeparatingAxisBounds();

const _intersectsTriangle_saTri = /* @__PURE__ */ new ExtendedTriangle();
const _intersectsTriangle_pointsArr: Vector3[] = [];
_intersectsTriangle_pointsArr.length = 3;
```

## ek3d/addons/math/bvh/math/SeparatingAxisBounds

```typescript
import { Vector3 } from "../../../../math/Vector3";
import type { Box3 } from "../../../../math/Box3";

export class SeparatingAxisBounds {
  min: number;
  max: number;

  constructor() {
    this.min = Infinity;
    this.max = -Infinity;
  }

  setFromPointsField(points: Vector3[], field: "x" | "y" | "z") {
    let min = Infinity;
    let max = -Infinity;
    for (let i = 0, l = points.length; i < l; i++) {
      const p = points[i];
      const val = p[field];
      min = val < min ? val : min;
      max = val > max ? val : max;
    }

    this.min = min;
    this.max = max;
  }

  setFromPoints(axis: Vector3, points: Vector3[]) {
    let min = Infinity;
    let max = -Infinity;
    for (let i = 0, l = points.length; i < l; i++) {
      const p = points[i];
      const val = axis.dot(p);
      min = val < min ? val : min;
      max = val > max ? val : max;
    }

    this.min = min;
    this.max = max;
  }

  isSeparated(other: SeparatingAxisBounds) {
    return this.min > other.max || other.min > this.max;
  }

  setFromBox(axis: Vector3, box: Box3) {
    const boxMin = box.min;
    const boxMax = box.max;
    let min = Infinity;
    let max = -Infinity;
    for (let x = 0; x <= 1; x++) {
      for (let y = 0; y <= 1; y++) {
        for (let z = 0; z <= 1; z++) {
          _setFromBox_p.x = boxMin.x * x + boxMax.x * (1 - x);
          _setFromBox_p.y = boxMin.y * y + boxMax.y * (1 - y);
          _setFromBox_p.z = boxMin.z * z + boxMax.z * (1 - z);

          const val = axis.dot(_setFromBox_p);
          min = Math.min(val, min);
          max = Math.max(val, max);
        }
      }
    }

    this.min = min;
    this.max = max;
  }
}

const _setFromBox_p = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();

export const areIntersecting = (function () {
  const cacheSatBounds = /* @__PURE__ */ new SeparatingAxisBounds();
  return function areIntersecting(
    shape1: { points: Vector3[]; satAxes: Vector3[]; satBounds: SeparatingAxisBounds[] },
    shape2: { points: Vector3[]; satAxes: Vector3[]; satBounds: SeparatingAxisBounds[] },
  ) {
    const points1 = shape1.points;
    const satAxes1 = shape1.satAxes;
    const satBounds1 = shape1.satBounds;

    const points2 = shape2.points;
    const satAxes2 = shape2.satAxes;
    const satBounds2 = shape2.satBounds;

    // check axes of the first shape
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const sb = satBounds1[i];
      const sa = satAxes1[i];
      cacheSatBounds.setFromPoints(sa, points2);
      if (sb.isSeparated(cacheSatBounds)) return false;
    }

    // check axes of the second shape
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const sb = satBounds2[i];
      const sa = satAxes2[i];
      cacheSatBounds.setFromPoints(sa, points1);
      if (sb.isSeparated(cacheSatBounds)) return false;
    }
  };
})();
```

## ek3d/addons/math/bvh/objects/BVHHelper

```typescript
const boundingBox = /* @__PURE__ */ new Box3();
const matrix = /* @__PURE__ */ new Matrix4();
const vec = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();

class BVHRootHelper extends Object3D {
  material: LineBasicMaterial | MeshBasicMaterial;
  geometry: BufferGeometry;
  depth: number;
  displayParents: boolean;
  bvh: GeometryBVH | null;
  displayEdges: boolean;
  _group: number;

  get isMesh() {
    return !this.displayEdges;
  }

  get isLineSegments() {
    return this.displayEdges;
  }

  get isLine() {
    return this.displayEdges;
  }

  getVertexPosition(index: number, target: Vector3) {
    return target.fromBufferAttribute(this.geometry.getAttribute("position") as BufferAttribute, index);
  }

  constructor(bvh: GeometryBVH | null, material: LineBasicMaterial | MeshBasicMaterial, depth = 10, group = 0) {
    super();

    this.material = material;
    this.geometry = new BufferGeometry();
    this.name = "BVHRootHelper";
    this.depth = depth;
    this.displayParents = false;
    this.bvh = bvh;
    this.displayEdges = true;
    this._group = group;
  }

  raycast() {}

  update() {
    const boundsTree = this.bvh;
    this.geometry.dispose();
    this.visible = false;
    if (boundsTree) {
      this.geometry = this.getGeometry(boundsTree);
      this.visible = true;
    }
  }

  getGeometry(boundsTree: GeometryBVH) {
    const group = this._group;

    // fill in the position buffer with the bounds corners
    let positionArray: Float32Array;
    if (group !== -1) {
      positionArray = this.getBVHBoundPositions(boundsTree, group);
    } else {
      const positionArrays = boundsTree._roots.map((r, i) => this.getBVHBoundPositions(boundsTree, i));
      const total = positionArrays.reduce((v, arr) => v + arr.length, 0);
      positionArray = new Float32Array(total);

      let offset = 0;
      positionArrays.forEach((arr) => {
        positionArray.set(arr, offset);
        offset += arr.length;
      });
    }

    const indexArray = this.getBVHBoundIndices(positionArray);

    // update the geometry
    const geometry = new BufferGeometry();
    geometry.setIndex(new BufferAttribute(indexArray, 1, false));
    geometry.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(positionArray, 3, false));
    return geometry;
  }

  getBVHBoundIndices(positionArray: Float32Array) {
    const boundsCount = positionArray.length / (8 * 3);
    let indexArray;
    let indices;
    if (this.displayEdges) {
      // fill in the index buffer to point to the corner points
      indices = new Uint8Array([
        // x axis
        0, 4, 1, 5, 2, 6, 3, 7,

        // y axis
        0, 2, 1, 3, 4, 6, 5, 7,

        // z axis
        0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7,
      ]);
    } else {
      indices = new Uint8Array([
        // X-, X+
        0, 1, 2, 2, 1, 3,

        4, 6, 5, 6, 7, 5,

        // Y-, Y+
        1, 4, 5, 0, 4, 1,

        2, 3, 6, 3, 7, 6,

        // Z-, Z+
        0, 2, 4, 2, 6, 4,

        1, 5, 3, 3, 5, 7,
      ]);
    }

    if (positionArray.length > 65535) {
      indexArray = new Uint32Array(indices.length * boundsCount);
    } else {
      indexArray = new Uint16Array(indices.length * boundsCount);
    }

    const indexLength = indices.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < boundsCount; i++) {
      const posOffset = i * 8;
      const indexOffset = i * indexLength;
      for (let j = 0; j < indexLength; j++) {
        indexArray[indexOffset + j] = posOffset + indices[j];
      }
    }

    return indexArray;
  }

  getBVHBoundPositions(bvh: GeometryBVH, group = 0, matrix: Matrix4 | null = null) {
    // count the number of bounds required
    const targetDepth = this.depth - 1;
    const displayParents = this.displayParents;
    let boundsCount = 0;
    bvh.traverse((depth, isLeaf) => {
      if (depth >= targetDepth || isLeaf) {
        boundsCount++;
        return true;
      } else if (displayParents) {
        boundsCount++;
      }
    }, group);

    // fill in the position buffer with the bounds corners
    let posIndex = 0;
    const positionArray = new Float32Array(8 * 3 * boundsCount);
    bvh.traverse((depth, isLeaf, boundingData) => {
      const terminate = depth >= targetDepth || isLeaf;
      if (terminate || displayParents) {
        arrayToBox(0, boundingData, boundingBox);

        const { min, max } = boundingBox;
        for (let x = -1; x <= 1; x += 2) {
          const xVal = x < 0 ? min.x : max.x;
          for (let y = -1; y <= 1; y += 2) {
            const yVal = y < 0 ? min.y : max.y;
            for (let z = -1; z <= 1; z += 2) {
              const zVal = z < 0 ? min.z : max.z;
              vec.set(xVal, yVal, zVal);
              if (matrix) {
                vec.applyMatrix4(matrix);
              }

              vec.toArray(positionArray, posIndex);
              posIndex += 3;
            }
          }
        }

        return terminate;
      }
    }, group);

    return positionArray;
  }
}

/**
 * A `THREE.Group` that visualizes a BVH as wireframe bounding boxes or solid
 * face overlays. Attach it as a sibling of the mesh in the scene graph and
 * call `update()` whenever the mesh's BVH or world transform changes.
 */
export class BVHHelper extends Group {
  depth: number;
  mesh: Object3D | null;
  bvh: GeometryBVH | null;
  displayParents: boolean;
  displayEdges: boolean;
  instanceId: number;
  _roots: BVHRootHelper[];
  edgeMaterial: LineBasicMaterial;
  meshMaterial: MeshBasicMaterial;

  /**
   * Shortcut to `edgeMaterial.color`.
   */
  get color() {
    return this.edgeMaterial.color;
  }

  /**
   * Opacity applied to both edge and mesh materials.
   */
  get opacity() {
    return this.edgeMaterial.opacity;
  }

  set opacity(v: number) {
    this.edgeMaterial.opacity = v;
    this.meshMaterial.opacity = v;
  }

  get objectIndex() {
    console.warn('BVHHelper: "objectIndex" has been renamed "instanceId".');
    return this.instanceId;
  }

  set objectIndex(v: number) {
    console.warn('BVHHelper: "objectIndex" has been renamed "instanceId".');
    this.instanceId = v;
  }

  constructor(mesh: Object3D | GeometryBVH | null = null, bvh: GeometryBVH | number | null = null, depth = 10) {
    // handle bvh, depth signature
    if (mesh instanceof GeometryBVH) {
      depth = typeof bvh === "number" ? bvh || 10 : 10;
      bvh = mesh;
      mesh = null;
    }

    // handle mesh, depth signature
    if (typeof bvh === "number") {
      depth = bvh;
      bvh = null;
    }

    super();

    this.name = "BVHHelper";

    this.depth = depth;

    this.mesh = mesh;

    this.bvh = bvh;

    this.displayParents = false;

    this.displayEdges = true;

    this.instanceId = 0;

    this._roots = [];

    const edgeMaterial = new LineBasicMaterial({
      color: 0x00ff88,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.3,
      depthWrite: false,
    });

    const meshMaterial = new MeshBasicMaterial({
      color: 0x00ff88,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.3,
      depthWrite: false,
    });

    meshMaterial.color = edgeMaterial.color;

    /**
     * Material used when rendering in wireframe edge mode.
     */
    this.edgeMaterial = edgeMaterial;

    /**
     * Material used when rendering in solid face mode.
     */
    this.meshMaterial = meshMaterial;

    this.update();
  }

  /**
   * Rebuilds the helper's display geometry from the current BVH state. Must
   * be called after changes to the BVH, `depth`, `displayParents`, or
   * `displayEdges`.
   */
  update() {
    const mesh = this.mesh;
    const instanceId = this.instanceId;
    const source = mesh as (Object3D & { boundsTree?: GeometryBVH | null; geometry?: BVHGeometry }) | null;
    let bvh = this.bvh || source?.boundsTree || source?.geometry?.boundsTree || null;
    if (mesh instanceof BatchedMesh && (mesh as BVHBatchedMesh).boundsTrees && !bvh && instanceId >= 0) {
      // get the bvh from a batchedMesh if not provided
      // TODO: we should have an official way to get the geometry index cleanly
      const drawInfo = mesh._instanceInfo[instanceId];
      if (drawInfo) {
        bvh = (mesh as BVHBatchedMesh).boundsTrees![drawInfo.geometryIndex] || bvh;
      }
    }

    const totalRoots = bvh ? bvh._roots.length : 0;
    while (this._roots.length > totalRoots) {
      const root = this._roots.pop()!;
      root.geometry.dispose();
      this.remove(root);
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < totalRoots; i++) {
      const { depth, edgeMaterial, meshMaterial, displayParents, displayEdges } = this;

      if (i >= this._roots.length) {
        const root = new BVHRootHelper(bvh, edgeMaterial, depth, i);
        this.add(root);
        this._roots.push(root);
      }

      const root = this._roots[i];
      root.bvh = bvh;
      root.depth = depth;
      root.displayParents = displayParents;
      root.displayEdges = displayEdges;
      root.material = displayEdges ? edgeMaterial : meshMaterial;
      root.update();
    }
  }

  updateMatrixWorld(force?: boolean) {
    const mesh = this.mesh;
    const parent = this.parent;
    const instanceId = this.instanceId;

    if (mesh !== null) {
      mesh.updateWorldMatrix(true, false);

      if (parent) {
        this.matrix.copy(parent.matrixWorld).invert().multiply(mesh.matrixWorld);
      } else {
        this.matrix.copy(mesh.matrixWorld);
      }

      // handle batched and instanced mesh bvhs
      if ((mesh instanceof InstancedMesh || mesh instanceof BatchedMesh) && instanceId >= 0) {
        mesh.getMatrixAt(instanceId, matrix);
        this.matrix.multiply(matrix);
      }

      this.matrix.decompose(this.position, this.quaternion, this.scale);
    }

    super.updateMatrixWorld(force);
  }

  copy(source: Object3D): this {
    const helper = source as BVHHelper;

    this.depth = helper.depth;
    this.mesh = helper.mesh;
    this.bvh = helper.bvh;
    this.opacity = helper.opacity;
    this.color.copy(helper.color);

    return this;
  }

  clone(): this {
    return new BVHHelper().copy(this) as this;
  }

  /**
   * Disposes of the materials and geometries used by the helper.
   */
  dispose() {
    this.edgeMaterial.dispose();
    this.meshMaterial.dispose();

    const children = this.children;
    for (let i = 0, l = children.length; i < l; i++) {
      (children[i] as BVHRootHelper).geometry.dispose();
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
import type { Box3 } from "../../../../math/Box3";

export function arrayToBox(nodeIndex32: number, array: ArrayLike<number>, target: Box3) {
  target.min.x = array[nodeIndex32];
  target.min.y = array[nodeIndex32 + 1];
  target.min.z = array[nodeIndex32 + 2];

  target.max.x = array[nodeIndex32 + 3];
  target.max.y = array[nodeIndex32 + 4];
  target.max.z = array[nodeIndex32 + 5];

  return target;
}

export function makeEmptyBounds(target: Float32Array | Float64Array | number[]) {
  target[0] = target[1] = target[2] = Infinity;
  target[3] = target[4] = target[5] = -Infinity;
}

export function getLongestEdgeIndex(bounds: ArrayLike<number>) {
  let splitDimIdx = -1;
  let splitDist = -Infinity;

  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const dist = bounds[i + 3] - bounds[i];
    if (dist > splitDist) {
      splitDist = dist;
      splitDimIdx = i;
    }
  }

  return splitDimIdx;
}

// copies bounds a into bounds b
export function copyBounds(source: ArrayLike<number>, target: Float32Array | Float64Array) {
  target.set(source);
}

// sets bounds target to the union of bounds a and b
export function unionBounds(
  a: ArrayLike<number>,
  b: ArrayLike<number>,
  target: Float32Array | Float64Array | number[],
) {
  let aVal, bVal;
  for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++) {
    const d3 = d + 3;

    // set the minimum values
    aVal = a[d];
    bVal = b[d];
    target[d] = aVal < bVal ? aVal : bVal;

    // set the max values
    aVal = a[d3];
    bVal = b[d3];
    target[d3] = aVal > bVal ? aVal : bVal;
  }
}

// expands the given bounds by the provided primitive bounds
export function expandByPrimitiveBounds(
  startIndex: number,
  primitiveBounds: ArrayLike<number>,
  bounds: Float32Array | Float64Array | number[],
) {
  for (let d = 0; d < 3; d++) {
    const tCenter = primitiveBounds[startIndex + 2 * d];
    const tHalf = primitiveBounds[startIndex + 2 * d + 1];

    const tMin = tCenter - tHalf;
    const tMax = tCenter + tHalf;

    if (tMin < bounds[d]) {
      bounds[d] = tMin;
    }

    if (tMax > bounds[d + 3]) {
      bounds[d + 3] = tMax;
    }
  }
}

// compute bounds surface area
export function computeSurfaceArea(bounds: ArrayLike<number>) {
  const d0 = bounds[3] - bounds[0];
  const d1 = bounds[4] - bounds[1];
  const d2 = bounds[5] - bounds[2];

  return 2 * (d0 * d1 + d1 * d2 + d2 * d0);
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/bvh/utils/BufferUtils

```typescript
export function isSharedArrayBufferSupported() {
  return typeof SharedArrayBuffer !== "undefined";
}

type NumericArray =
  | Int8Array
  | Uint8Array
  | Uint8ClampedArray
  | Int16Array
  | Uint16Array
  | Int32Array
  | Uint32Array
  | Float16Array
  | Float32Array
  | Float64Array
  | BigInt64Array
  | BigUint64Array;
type BufferType = ArrayBuffer | SharedArrayBuffer;
type BufferConstructor = { new (byteLength: number): BufferType };
export function convertToBufferType<T extends NumericArray | BufferType | null>(
  array: T,
  BufferConstructor: BufferConstructor,
): T {
  if (array === null) return array;
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(array)) {
    const buffer = array.buffer;
    if (buffer.constructor === BufferConstructor) return array;
    const ArrayConstructor = array.constructor as { new (buffer: BufferType): NumericArray };
    const result = new ArrayConstructor(new BufferConstructor(buffer.byteLength));
    new Uint8Array(result.buffer, result.byteOffset, array.byteLength).set(
      new Uint8Array(array.buffer, array.byteOffset, array.byteLength),
    );
    return result as T;
  }
  if (array.constructor === BufferConstructor) return array;
  const result = new BufferConstructor(array.byteLength);
  new Uint8Array(result).set(new Uint8Array(array));
  return result as T;
}
```
