## ek3d/addons/math/bvh/utils/ExtensionUtilities

```typescript
import { Mesh } from "../../../../objects/Mesh";
import { Points } from "../../../../objects/Points";
import { Line } from "../../../../objects/Line";
import { LineLoop } from "../../../../objects/LineLoop";
import { LineSegments } from "../../../../objects/LineSegments";
import { BatchedMesh } from "../../../../objects/BatchedMesh";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { Intersection, Raycaster } from "../../../../core/Raycaster";
import { Box3 } from "../../../../math/Box3";
import { Sphere } from "../../../../math/Sphere";
import { MeshBasicMaterial } from "../../../../materials/MeshBasicMaterial";
import type { GeometryBVH } from "../core/GeometryBVH";
import { MeshBVH, type MeshBVHOptions } from "../core/MeshBVH";

export type BVHGeometry = BufferGeometry & { boundsTree?: GeometryBVH | null };
export type BVHRaycaster = Raycaster & { firstHitOnly?: boolean };
export type BVHBatchedMesh = BatchedMesh & { boundsTrees?: (MeshBVH | null)[] };
export type ComputeBVHOptions = MeshBVHOptions & {
  type?: new (geometry: BufferGeometry, options?: MeshBVHOptions) => GeometryBVH;
};

// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/unbound-method -- Called with the original mesh as this.
const meshRaycast = Mesh.prototype.raycast;
// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/unbound-method -- Called with the original line as this.
const lineRaycast = Line.prototype.raycast;
// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/unbound-method -- Called with the original line loop as this.
const lineLoopRaycast = LineLoop.prototype.raycast;
// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/unbound-method -- Called with the original line segments as this.
const lineSegmentsRaycast = LineSegments.prototype.raycast;
// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/unbound-method -- Called with the original points as this.
const pointsRaycast = Points.prototype.raycast;
// oxlint-disable-next-line typescript/unbound-method -- Called with the original batched mesh as this.
const batchedMeshRaycast = BatchedMesh.prototype.raycast;
const batchMesh = new Mesh(new BufferGeometry(), new MeshBasicMaterial());
const batchIntersects: Intersection[] = [];
const batchBox = new Box3();
const batchSphere = new Sphere();

export function acceleratedRaycast(
  this: Mesh | Points | Line | BatchedMesh,
  raycaster: BVHRaycaster,
  intersects: Intersection[],
): void {
  if (this instanceof BatchedMesh) {
    acceleratedBatchedMeshRaycast.call(this, raycaster, intersects);
    return;
  }
  const tree = (this.geometry as BVHGeometry).boundsTree;
  if (tree) {
    tree.raycastObject3D(this, raycaster, intersects);
  } else if (this instanceof Mesh) {
    meshRaycast.call(this, raycaster, intersects);
  } else if (this instanceof LineSegments) {
    lineSegmentsRaycast.call(this, raycaster, intersects);
  } else if (this instanceof LineLoop) {
    lineLoopRaycast.call(this, raycaster, intersects);
  } else if (this instanceof Line) {
    lineRaycast.call(this, raycaster, intersects);
  } else if (this instanceof Points) {
    pointsRaycast.call(this, raycaster, intersects);
  } else {
    throw new Error("BVH: Fallback raycast function not found.");
  }
}

function acceleratedBatchedMeshRaycast(
  this: BVHBatchedMesh,
  raycaster: BVHRaycaster,
  intersects: Intersection[],
): void {
  const trees = this.boundsTrees;
  if (!trees) {
    batchedMeshRaycast.call(this, raycaster, intersects);
    return;
  }

  const geometry = this.geometry as BVHGeometry;
  const oldTree = geometry.boundsTree;
  const oldDrawStart = geometry.drawRange.start;
  const oldDrawCount = geometry.drawRange.count;
  const oldBox = geometry.boundingBox;
  const oldSphere = geometry.boundingSphere;
  const oldMeshGeometry = batchMesh.geometry;
  const oldMeshMaterial = batchMesh.material;
  batchMesh.geometry = geometry;
  batchMesh.material = this.material;
  try {
    for (let i = 0; i < this._instanceInfo.length; i++) {
      const instance = this._instanceInfo[i];
      if (!instance.active || !instance.visible) continue;
      const geometryId = instance.geometryIndex;
      geometry.boundsTree = trees[geometryId];
      this.getMatrixAt(i, batchMesh.matrixWorld).premultiply(this.matrixWorld);
      if (!geometry.boundsTree) {
        geometry.boundingBox = batchBox;
        geometry.boundingSphere = batchSphere;
        this.getBoundingBoxAt(geometryId, batchBox);
        this.getBoundingSphereAt(geometryId, batchSphere);
        const range = this._geometryInfo[geometryId];
        geometry.setDrawRange(range.start, range.count);
      }
      acceleratedRaycast.call(batchMesh, raycaster, batchIntersects);
      for (const hit of batchIntersects) {
        hit.object = this;
        hit.batchId = i;
        intersects.push(hit);
      }
      batchIntersects.length = 0;
    }
  } finally {
    batchIntersects.length = 0;
    geometry.boundsTree = oldTree;
    geometry.setDrawRange(oldDrawStart, oldDrawCount);
    geometry.boundingBox = oldBox;
    geometry.boundingSphere = oldSphere;
    batchMesh.geometry = oldMeshGeometry;
    batchMesh.material = oldMeshMaterial;
  }
}

export function computeBoundsTree(this: BVHGeometry, options: ComputeBVHOptions = {}): GeometryBVH {
  const { type = MeshBVH } = options;
  this.boundsTree = new type(this, options);
  return this.boundsTree;
}

export function disposeBoundsTree(this: BVHGeometry): void {
  this.boundsTree = null;
}

export function computeBatchedBoundsTree(
  this: BVHBatchedMesh,
  index = -1,
  options: MeshBVHOptions = {},
): MeshBVH | (MeshBVH | null)[] | null {
  const ranges = this._geometryInfo;
  const geometryCount = this._geometryCount;
  if (!this.boundsTrees) this.boundsTrees = Array.from({ length: geometryCount }, () => null);
  const trees = this.boundsTrees;
  while (trees.length < geometryCount) trees.push(null);
  if (index < 0) {
    for (let i = 0; i < geometryCount; i++) {
      trees[i] = new MeshBVH(this.geometry, { ...options, range: ranges[i] });
    }
    return trees;
  }
  if (index < ranges.length) trees[index] = new MeshBVH(this.geometry, { ...options, range: ranges[index] });
  return trees[index] || null;
}

export function disposeBatchedBoundsTree(this: BVHBatchedMesh, index = -1): void {
  const trees = this.boundsTrees!;
  if (index < 0) trees.fill(null);
  else if (index < trees.length) trees[index] = null;
}
```

```typescript
import type { Object3D } from "../../../../core/Object3D";
import type { Raycaster, Intersection } from "../../../../core/Raycaster";

// Converts a local-space BVH hit to a world-space raycaster intersection.
export function convertRaycastIntersect<T extends Omit<Intersection, "object">>(
  hit: T | null,
  object: Object3D,
  raycaster: Raycaster,
): (T & Intersection) | null {
  if (hit === null) return null;
  hit.point.applyMatrix4(object.matrixWorld);
  hit.distance = hit.point.distanceTo(raycaster.ray.origin);
  return Object.assign(hit, { object });
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/bvh/utils/PrimitivePool

```typescript
export class PrimitivePool<T> {
  _getNewPrimitive: () => T;
  _primitives: T[];

  constructor(getNewPrimitive: () => T) {
    this._getNewPrimitive = getNewPrimitive;
    this._primitives = [];
  }

  getPrimitive() {
    const primitives = this._primitives;
    if (primitives.length === 0) {
      return this._getNewPrimitive();
    } else {
      return primitives.pop()!;
    }
  }

  releasePrimitive(primitive: T) {
    this._primitives.push(primitive);
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/bvh/utils/ThreeRayIntersectUtilities

```typescript
import { Vector3 } from "../../../../math/Vector3";
import { Vector2 } from "../../../../math/Vector2";
import { Triangle } from "../../../../math/Triangle";
import { Side } from "../../../../constants";
import type { BufferGeometry } from "../../../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { BufferAttribute } from "../../../../core/BufferAttribute";
import type { InterleavedBufferAttribute } from "../../../../core/InterleavedBufferAttribute";
import type { Ray } from "../../../../math/Ray";
import type { Material } from "../../../../materials/Material";
type Attribute = BufferAttribute | InterleavedBufferAttribute;
export interface RayIntersection {
  distance: number;
  point: Vector3;
  face: { a: number; b: number; c: number; normal: Vector3; materialIndex: number };
  faceIndex: number;
  uv?: Vector2;
  uv1?: Vector2;
  normal?: Vector3;
  barycoord?: Vector3;
}
type PartialHit = Omit<RayIntersection, "face" | "faceIndex"> & Partial<Pick<RayIntersection, "face" | "faceIndex">>;

// Ripped and modified From THREE.js Mesh raycast
// https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/0aa87c999fe61e216c1133fba7a95772b503eddf/src/objects/Mesh.js#L115
const _vA = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
const _vB = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
const _vC = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();

const _uvA = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector2();
const _uvB = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector2();
const _uvC = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector2();

const _normalA = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
const _normalB = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
const _normalC = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();

const _intersectionPoint = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
function checkIntersection(
  ray: Ray,
  pA: Vector3,
  pB: Vector3,
  pC: Vector3,
  point: Vector3,
  side: Side,
  near: number,
  far: number,
): PartialHit | null {
  let intersect;
  if (side === Side.Back) {
    intersect = ray.intersectTriangle(pC, pB, pA, true, point);
  } else {
    intersect = ray.intersectTriangle(pA, pB, pC, side !== Side.Double, point);
  }

  if (intersect === null) return null;

  const distance = ray.origin.distanceTo(point);

  if (distance < near || distance > far) return null;

  return {
    distance: distance,
    point: point.clone(),
  };
}

function checkBufferGeometryIntersection(
  ray: Ray,
  position: Attribute,
  normal: Attribute | undefined,
  uv: Attribute | undefined,
  uv1: Attribute | undefined,
  a: number,
  b: number,
  c: number,
  side: Side,
  near: number,
  far: number,
): RayIntersection | null {
  _vA.fromBufferAttribute(position, a);
  _vB.fromBufferAttribute(position, b);
  _vC.fromBufferAttribute(position, c);

  const intersection = checkIntersection(ray, _vA, _vB, _vC, _intersectionPoint, side, near, far);

  if (intersection) {
    if (uv) {
      _uvA.fromBufferAttribute(uv, a);
      _uvB.fromBufferAttribute(uv, b);
      _uvC.fromBufferAttribute(uv, c);

      intersection.uv = new Vector2();
      Triangle.getInterpolation(_intersectionPoint, _vA, _vB, _vC, _uvA, _uvB, _uvC, intersection.uv);
    }

    if (uv1) {
      _uvA.fromBufferAttribute(uv1, a);
      _uvB.fromBufferAttribute(uv1, b);
      _uvC.fromBufferAttribute(uv1, c);

      intersection.uv1 = new Vector2();
      Triangle.getInterpolation(_intersectionPoint, _vA, _vB, _vC, _uvA, _uvB, _uvC, intersection.uv1);
    }

    if (normal) {
      _normalA.fromBufferAttribute(normal, a);
      _normalB.fromBufferAttribute(normal, b);
      _normalC.fromBufferAttribute(normal, c);

      intersection.normal = new Vector3();
      Triangle.getInterpolation(_intersectionPoint, _vA, _vB, _vC, _normalA, _normalB, _normalC, intersection.normal);
      if (intersection.normal.dot(ray.direction) > 0) {
        intersection.normal.multiplyScalar(-1);
      }
    }

    const face = {
      a: a,
      b: b,
      c: c,
      normal: new Vector3(),
      materialIndex: 0,
    };

    Triangle.getNormal(_vA, _vB, _vC, face.normal);

    intersection.face = face;
    intersection.faceIndex = a;

    const barycoord = new Vector3();
    Triangle.getBarycoord(_intersectionPoint, _vA, _vB, _vC, barycoord);
    intersection.barycoord = barycoord;
  }

  return intersection as RayIntersection | null;
}

function getSide(materialOrSide: Material | Side) {
  return typeof materialOrSide === "number" ? materialOrSide : materialOrSide.side;
}

// https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/0aa87c999fe61e216c1133fba7a95772b503eddf/src/objects/Mesh.js#L258
export function intersectTri(
  geometry: BufferGeometry,
  materialOrSide: Material | Material[] | Side,
  ray: Ray,
  tri: number,
  intersections: RayIntersection[] | null,
  near: number,
  far: number,
) {
  const triOffset = tri * 3;
  let a = triOffset + 0;
  let b = triOffset + 1;
  let c = triOffset + 2;

  const { index, groups } = geometry;
  if (index) {
    a = index.getX(a);
    b = index.getX(b);
    c = index.getX(c);
  }

  const { position, normal, uv, uv1 } = geometry.attributes as Record<string, Attribute>;
  if (Array.isArray(materialOrSide)) {
    // check which groups a triangle is present in and run the intersections
    // TODO: we shouldn't need to run and intersection test multiple times
    const firstIndex = tri * 3;
    for (let i = 0, l = groups.length; i < l; i++) {
      const { start, count, materialIndex } = groups[i];
      if (firstIndex >= start && firstIndex < start + count) {
        const side = getSide(materialOrSide[materialIndex]);
        const intersection = checkBufferGeometryIntersection(ray, position, normal, uv, uv1, a, b, c, side, near, far);
        if (intersection) {
          intersection.faceIndex = tri;
          intersection.face.materialIndex = materialIndex;

          if (intersections) {
            intersections.push(intersection);
          } else {
            return intersection;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } else {
    // run the intersection for the single material
    const side = getSide(materialOrSide);
    const intersection = checkBufferGeometryIntersection(ray, position, normal, uv, uv1, a, b, c, side, near, far);
    if (intersection) {
      intersection.faceIndex = tri;
      intersection.face.materialIndex = 0;

      if (intersections) {
        intersections.push(intersection);
      } else {
        return intersection;
      }
    }
  }

  return null;
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/bvh/utils/TriangleUtilities

```typescript
import { Vector2 } from "../../../../math/Vector2";
import { Vector3 } from "../../../../math/Vector3";
import { Triangle } from "../../../../math/Triangle";
import type { BufferGeometry } from "../../../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { BufferAttribute } from "../../../../core/BufferAttribute";
import type { InterleavedBufferAttribute } from "../../../../core/InterleavedBufferAttribute";

type Attribute = BufferAttribute | InterleavedBufferAttribute;
export interface HitTriangleInfo {
  face: { a: number; b: number; c: number; materialIndex: number; normal: Vector3 };
  uv: Vector2 | null;
  barycoord: Vector3;
}

// sets the vertices of triangle `tri` with the 3 vertices after i
export function setTriangle(tri: Triangle, i: number, index: BufferAttribute | null, pos: Attribute) {
  const ta = tri.a;
  const tb = tri.b;
  const tc = tri.c;

  let i0 = i;
  let i1 = i + 1;
  let i2 = i + 2;
  if (index) {
    i0 = index.getX(i0);
    i1 = index.getX(i1);
    i2 = index.getX(i2);
  }

  ta.x = pos.getX(i0);
  ta.y = pos.getY(i0);
  ta.z = pos.getZ(i0);

  tb.x = pos.getX(i1);
  tb.y = pos.getY(i1);
  tb.z = pos.getZ(i1);

  tc.x = pos.getX(i2);
  tc.y = pos.getY(i2);
  tc.z = pos.getZ(i2);
}

const tempV1 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
const tempV2 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
const tempV3 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector3();
const tempUV1 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector2();
const tempUV2 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector2();
const tempUV3 = /* @__PURE__ */ new Vector2();

/**
 * Computes hit-point information for a point on a triangle within a `BufferGeometry`. Returns
 * the face vertex indices, face normal, material index, UV coordinates, and barycentric coordinates.
 * Useful for retrieving detailed hit data after a call to `MeshBVH.closestPointToPoint` or
 * `MeshBVH.closestPointToGeometry`.
 *
 */
export function getTriangleHitPointInfo(
  point: Vector3,
  geometry: BufferGeometry,
  triangleIndex: number,
  target?: { face?: Partial<HitTriangleInfo["face"]>; uv?: Vector2 | null; barycoord?: Vector3 },
): HitTriangleInfo {
  const indices = geometry.getIndex()!.array;
  const positions = geometry.getAttribute("position") as Attribute;
  const uvs = geometry.getAttribute("uv") as Attribute | undefined;

  const a = indices[triangleIndex * 3];
  const b = indices[triangleIndex * 3 + 1];
  const c = indices[triangleIndex * 3 + 2];

  tempV1.fromBufferAttribute(positions, a);
  tempV2.fromBufferAttribute(positions, b);
  tempV3.fromBufferAttribute(positions, c);

  // find the associated material index
  let materialIndex = 0;
  const groups = geometry.groups;
  const firstVertexIndex = triangleIndex * 3;
  for (let i = 0, l = groups.length; i < l; i++) {
    const group = groups[i];
    const { start, count } = group;
    if (firstVertexIndex >= start && firstVertexIndex < start + count) {
      materialIndex = group.materialIndex;
      break;
    }
  }

  // extract barycoord
  const barycoord = target && target.barycoord ? target.barycoord : new Vector3();
  Triangle.getBarycoord(point, tempV1, tempV2, tempV3, barycoord);

  // extract uvs
  let uv = null;
  if (uvs) {
    tempUV1.fromBufferAttribute(uvs, a);
    tempUV2.fromBufferAttribute(uvs, b);
    tempUV3.fromBufferAttribute(uvs, c);

    if (target && target.uv) uv = target.uv;
    else uv = new Vector2();

    Triangle.getInterpolation(point, tempV1, tempV2, tempV3, tempUV1, tempUV2, tempUV3, uv);
  }

  // adjust the provided target or create a new one
  if (target) {
    if (!target.face) target.face = {};
    target.face.a = a;
    target.face.b = b;
    target.face.c = c;
    target.face.materialIndex = materialIndex;
    if (!target.face.normal) target.face.normal = new Vector3();
    Triangle.getNormal(tempV1, tempV2, tempV3, target.face.normal);

    if (uv) target.uv = uv;
    target.barycoord = barycoord;

    return target as HitTriangleInfo;
  } else {
    return {
      face: {
        a: a,
        b: b,
        c: c,
        materialIndex: materialIndex,
        normal: Triangle.getNormal(tempV1, tempV2, tempV3, new Vector3()),
      },
      uv: uv,
      barycoord: barycoord,
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Mesh } from "../../../../objects/Mesh";
import { Matrix4 } from "../../../../math/Matrix4";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { BufferAttribute } from "../../../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { InterleavedBufferAttribute } from "../../../../core/InterleavedBufferAttribute";
import { MeshBasicMaterial } from "../../../../materials/MeshBasicMaterial";
import type { Material } from "../../../../materials/Material";
import { MeshBVH } from "../../bvh/core/MeshBVH";
import { HalfEdgeMap } from "./HalfEdgeMap";
import { areSharedArrayBuffersSupported, convertToSharedArrayBuffer, getTriCount } from "./utils/geometryUtils";

export type CSGGeometry = BufferGeometry & {
  boundsTree?: MeshBVH | null;
  halfEdges?: HalfEdgeMap | null;
  groupIndices?: Uint16Array | null;
};

export class Brush extends Mesh {
  isBrush: boolean;
  _previousMatrix: Matrix4;
  _halfEdges: HalfEdgeMap | null;
  _boundsTree: MeshBVH | null;
  _groupIndices: Uint16Array | null;
  _hash: string | null;

  constructor(
    geometry: BufferGeometry = new BufferGeometry(),
    material: Material | Material[] = new MeshBasicMaterial(),
  ) {
    super(geometry, material);
    this.isBrush = true;
    this._previousMatrix = new Matrix4();
    this._previousMatrix.elements.fill(0);
    this._halfEdges = null;
    this._boundsTree = null;
    this._groupIndices = null;
    this._hash = null;
  }

  markUpdated(): void {
    this._previousMatrix.copy(this.matrix);
  }

  isDirty(): boolean {
    const el1 = this.matrix.elements;
    const el2 = this._previousMatrix.elements;
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
      if (el1[i] !== el2[i]) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  prepareGeometry(): void {
    const geometry = this.geometry as CSGGeometry;
    const attributes = geometry.attributes;
    const useSharedArrayBuffer = areSharedArrayBuffersSupported();
    const index = geometry.index;
    const position = attributes.position as BufferAttribute | InterleavedBufferAttribute;
    if (position instanceof InterleavedBufferAttribute) {
      throw new Error("Brush: InterleavedBufferAttributes are not supported.");
    }
    const indexHash = index ? `${index.id}_${index.count}_${index.version}` : "-1_-1_-1";
    const posHash = `${position.id}_${position.count}_${position.version}`;
    const hash = `${geometry.uuid}_${indexHash}_${posHash}`;
    if (this._hash === hash) return;
    this._hash = hash;

    if (useSharedArrayBuffer) {
      for (const key in attributes) {
        const attribute = attributes[key] as BufferAttribute | InterleavedBufferAttribute;
        if (attribute instanceof InterleavedBufferAttribute) {
          throw new Error("Brush: InterleavedBufferAttributes are not supported.");
        }
        attribute.array = convertToSharedArrayBuffer(attribute.array);
      }
    }

    geometry.boundsTree = new MeshBVH(geometry, { maxLeafSize: 3, indirect: true, useSharedArrayBuffer });
    if (!geometry.halfEdges) geometry.halfEdges = new HalfEdgeMap();
    geometry.halfEdges.updateFrom(geometry);

    const triCount = getTriCount(geometry);
    if (!geometry.groupIndices || geometry.groupIndices.length !== triCount) {
      geometry.groupIndices = new Uint16Array(triCount);
    }
    const array = geometry.groupIndices;
    const groups = geometry.groups;
    for (let i = 0; i < groups.length; i++) {
      const { start, count } = groups[i];
      for (let g = start / 3; g < (start + count) / 3; g++) array[g] = i;
    }
  }

  disposeCacheData(): void {
    const geometry = this.geometry as CSGGeometry;
    geometry.halfEdges = null;
    geometry.boundsTree = null;
    geometry.groupIndices = null;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/csg/core/CDTTriangleSplitter

```typescript
import { Vector3 } from "../../../../math/Vector3";
import { Line3 } from "../../../../math/Line3";
import type { Triangle } from "../../../../math/Triangle";
import { ExtendedTriangle } from "../../bvh/math/ExtendedTriangle";
import cdt2d from "../triangulation/cdt2d";
import { Pool } from "./utils/Pool";

// relative tolerance factor — multiplied by the max absolute coordinate
// of the base triangle to get scale-appropriate thresholds
const RELATIVE_EPSILON = 1e-16;

// tolerance for merging nearby vertices (squared distance)
const VERTEX_MERGE_EPSILON = 1e-16;

const _vec = new Vector3();
const _vec2 = new Vector3();
const _paramPool = new Pool(() => ({ param: 0, index: 0 }));
const _vectorPool = new Pool(() => new Vector3());

function edgesToIndices(edges: Line3[], outputVertices: Vector3[], outputIndices: number[][], epsilonScale: number) {
  _paramPool.clear();

  outputVertices.length = 0;
  outputIndices.length = 0;

  // Add edge endpoints and find edge-edge intersection points
  for (let i = 0, l = edges.length; i < l; i++) {
    const edge0 = edges[i];
    getIndex(edge0.start);
    getIndex(edge0.end);
  }

  for (let i = 0, l = edges.length; i < l; i++) {
    const edge0 = edges[i];
    for (let i1 = i + 1; i1 < l; i1++) {
      const edge1 = edges[i1];
      const dist = edge0.distanceSqToLine3(edge1, _vec, _vec2);
      if (dist < RELATIVE_EPSILON * epsilonScale) {
        getIndex(_vec2);
      }
    }
  }

  // Build sub-segments by finding all vertices on each edge
  const arr: { param: number; index: number }[] = [];
  for (let i = 0, l = edges.length; i < l; i++) {
    arr.length = 0;

    const edge = edges[i];
    for (let v = 0, lv = outputVertices.length; v < lv; v++) {
      const vec = outputVertices[v];
      const param = edge.closestPointToPointParameter(vec, true);
      edge.at(param, _vec);
      if (vec.distanceToSquared(_vec) < RELATIVE_EPSILON * epsilonScale) {
        const entry = _paramPool.getInstance();
        entry.param = param;
        entry.index = v;
        arr.push(entry);
      }
    }

    arr.sort(paramSort);

    for (let a = 0, la = arr.length - 1; a < la; a++) {
      const i0 = arr[a].index;
      const i1 = arr[a + 1].index;

      // Skip self-loops (can arise when two endpoints merge)
      if (i0 === i1) continue;

      outputIndices.push([i0, i1]);
    }
  }

  // Remove duplicate edges
  const edgeSet = new Set();
  let ptr = 0;
  for (let i = 0, l = outputIndices.length; i < l; i++) {
    const e = outputIndices[i];
    const lo = Math.min(e[0], e[1]);
    const hi = Math.max(e[0], e[1]);
    const key = lo + "," + hi;
    if (!edgeSet.has(key)) {
      edgeSet.add(key);
      outputIndices[ptr++] = e;
    }
  }

  outputIndices.length = ptr;

  function paramSort(a: { param: number; index: number }, b: { param: number; index: number }) {
    return a.param - b.param;
  }

  function getIndex(v: Vector3) {
    for (let i = 0; i < outputVertices.length; i++) {
      const v2 = outputVertices[i];
      if (v === v2 || v.distanceToSquared(v2) < VERTEX_MERGE_EPSILON * epsilonScale) {
        return i;
      }
    }

    outputVertices.push(_vectorPool.getInstance().copy(v));
    return outputVertices.length - 1;
  }
}

export class CDTTriangleSplitter {
  trianglePool: Pool<ExtendedTriangle>;
  linePool: Pool<Line3>;
  triangles: ExtendedTriangle[];
  triangleIndices: (number | string | null)[][];
  constrainedEdges: Line3[];
  triangleConnectivity: number[][];
  normal: Vector3;
  projOrigin: Vector3;
  projU: Vector3;
  projV: Vector3;
  baseTri: ExtendedTriangle;
  baseIndices: (number | null)[];

  constructor() {
    this.trianglePool = new Pool(() => new ExtendedTriangle());
    this.linePool = new Pool(() => new Line3());
    // TODO: use array pool

    this.triangles = [];
    this.triangleIndices = [];
    this.constrainedEdges = [];
    this.triangleConnectivity = [];

    this.normal = new Vector3();
    this.projOrigin = new Vector3();
    this.projU = new Vector3();
    this.projV = new Vector3();
    this.baseTri = new ExtendedTriangle();
    this.baseIndices = [null, null, null];
  }

  // initialize the class with a triangle to be split
  initialize(tri: Triangle, i0: number | null = null, i1: number | null = null, i2: number | null = null) {
    this.reset();

    const { normal, baseTri, projU, projV, projOrigin, constrainedEdges, linePool, baseIndices } = this;
    tri.getNormal(normal);
    baseTri.copy(tri);
    baseTri.update();
    baseIndices[0] = i0;
    baseIndices[1] = i1;
    baseIndices[2] = i2;

    // initialize constrained edges to the triangle boundary
    constrainedEdges.length = 0;

    // inserting these edges in this order guarantee that indices a, b, c will be given the
    // indices 0, 1, 2 so we can infer base indices from them later.
    const e0 = linePool.getInstance();
    e0.start.copy(baseTri.a);
    e0.end.copy(baseTri.b);

    const e1 = linePool.getInstance();
    e1.start.copy(baseTri.b);
    e1.end.copy(baseTri.c);

    const e2 = linePool.getInstance();
    e2.start.copy(baseTri.c);
    e2.end.copy(baseTri.a);
    constrainedEdges.push(e0, e1, e2);

    // Build 2D projection frame from base triangle
    projOrigin.copy(baseTri.a);
    projU.subVectors(baseTri.b, baseTri.a).normalize();
    projV.crossVectors(normal, projU).normalize();
  }

  // Add a pre-computed constraint edge to the splitter
  addConstraintEdge(edge: Line3) {
    const { constrainedEdges, linePool } = this;
    const e = linePool.getInstance().copy(edge);
    constrainedEdges.push(e);
  }

  // Project a 3D point onto the 2D frame defined by _projOrigin / _projU / _projV
  _to2D(point: Vector3, target: Vector3) {
    const { projOrigin, projU, projV } = this;
    _vec.subVectors(point, projOrigin);
    return target.set(_vec.dot(projU), _vec.dot(projV), 0);
  }

  _from2D(u: number, v: number, target: Vector3) {
    const { projOrigin, projU, projV } = this;
    target.copy(projOrigin).addScaledVector(projU, u).addScaledVector(projV, v);
    return target;
  }

  // Run the CDT and populate this.triangles with the result
  triangulate() {
    const {
      triangles,
      trianglePool,
      triangleConnectivity,
      triangleIndices,
      linePool,
      baseTri,
      constrainedEdges,
      baseIndices,
    } = this;

    triangles.length = 0;
    trianglePool.clear();

    // Get the edges into a 2d frame
    const edges2d: Line3[] = [];
    for (let i = 0, l = constrainedEdges.length; i < l; i++) {
      const edge = constrainedEdges[i];
      const e2d = linePool.getInstance();
      this._to2D(edge.start, e2d.start);
      this._to2D(edge.end, e2d.end);
      edges2d.push(e2d);
    }

    // Precompute scale factor from base triangle for epsilon scaling
    let epsilonScale = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const v = this._to2D(baseTri.points[i], _vec);
      epsilonScale = Math.max(epsilonScale, Math.abs(v.x), Math.abs(v.y));
    }

    // Use custom deduplication and edge splitting
    const vertices: Vector3[] = [];
    const indices: number[][] = [];
    edgesToIndices(edges2d, vertices, indices, epsilonScale);

    const cdt2dPoints: number[][] = [];
    for (let i = 0, l = vertices.length; i < l; i++) {
      const vert = vertices[i];
      cdt2dPoints.push([vert.x, vert.y]);
    }

    // Run the CDT triangulation
    const triangulation = cdt2d(cdt2dPoints, indices, { exterior: false });

    // construct the half edge structure, marking the constrained edges as disconnected to
    // mark the polygon edges
    const halfEdgeMap = new Map<string, number>();
    for (let i = 0, l = indices.length; i < l; i++) {
      const pair = indices[i];
      halfEdgeMap.set(`${pair[0]}_${pair[1]}`, -1);
      halfEdgeMap.set(`${pair[1]}_${pair[0]}`, -1);
    }

    // create an index key to construct unique indices across the geometry
    const indexKeyPrefix = `${baseIndices[0]}_${baseIndices[1]}_${baseIndices[2]}_`;
    for (let ti = 0, l = triangulation.length; ti < l; ti++) {
      // covert back to 2d
      const indexList = triangulation[ti];
      const [i0, i1, i2] = indexList;
      const tri = trianglePool.getInstance();
      this._from2D(cdt2dPoints[i0][0], cdt2dPoints[i0][1], tri.a);
      this._from2D(cdt2dPoints[i1][0], cdt2dPoints[i1][1], tri.b);
      this._from2D(cdt2dPoints[i2][0], cdt2dPoints[i2][1], tri.c);
      triangles.push(tri);

      // construct the connectivity and custom index list
      const connected: number[] = [];
      triangleConnectivity.push(connected);

      const indexKeys: (number | string | null)[] = [];
      triangleIndices.push(indexKeys);
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        // use the original geometry index for base triangle corners,
        // otherwise construct a unique index key for constraint edge vertices
        const p0 = indexList[i];
        indexKeys.push(p0 < 3 ? baseIndices[p0] : indexKeyPrefix + p0);

        // find the connected triangles
        const p1 = indexList[(i + 1) % 3];
        const hash0 = `${p0}_${p1}`;
        if (halfEdgeMap.has(hash0)) {
          const index = halfEdgeMap.get(hash0);
          if (index !== undefined && index !== -1) {
            connected.push(index);
            triangleConnectivity[index].push(ti);
          }
        } else {
          const hash1 = `${p1}_${p0}`;
          halfEdgeMap.set(hash1, ti);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  reset() {
    this.trianglePool.clear();
    this.linePool.clear();
    this.triangles.length = 0;
    this.triangleIndices.length = 0;
    this.triangleConnectivity.length = 0;
    this.constrainedEdges.length = 0;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/csg/core/Evaluator

```typescript
import type { BufferGeometry } from "../../../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { Object3D } from "../../../../core/Object3D";
import { CDTTriangleSplitter } from "./CDTTriangleSplitter";
import { LegacyTriangleSplitter } from "./LegacyTriangleSplitter";
import { OperationDebugData } from "./debug/OperationDebugData";
import { performOperation } from "./operations/operations";
import { Operation } from "./operations/Operation";
import { OperationGroup } from "./operations/OperationGroup";
import { Brush } from "./Brush";
import type { CSGOperation } from "./constants";
import { GeometryBuilder } from "./operations/GeometryBuilder";
import * as GeometryUtils from "./operations/GeometryUtils";

export class Evaluator {
  triangleSplitter: LegacyTriangleSplitter | CDTTriangleSplitter;
  geometryBuilders: GeometryBuilder[];
  attributes: string[];
  useGroups: boolean;
  consolidateGroups: boolean;
  removeUnusedMaterials: boolean;
  debug: OperationDebugData;

  constructor() {
    this.triangleSplitter = new LegacyTriangleSplitter();
    this.geometryBuilders = [];
    this.attributes = ["position", "uv", "normal"];
    this.useGroups = true;
    this.consolidateGroups = true;
    this.removeUnusedMaterials = true;
    this.debug = new OperationDebugData();
  }

  get useCDTClipping(): boolean {
    return this.triangleSplitter instanceof CDTTriangleSplitter;
  }

  set useCDTClipping(value: boolean) {
    if (value !== this.useCDTClipping) {
      this.triangleSplitter = value ? new CDTTriangleSplitter() : new LegacyTriangleSplitter();
    }
  }

  getGroupRanges(geometry: BufferGeometry) {
    return !this.useGroups || geometry.groups.length === 0
      ? [{ start: 0, count: Infinity, materialIndex: 0 }]
      : geometry.groups.map((group) => ({ ...group }));
  }

  evaluate(a: Brush, b: Brush, operation: CSGOperation, target?: Brush): Brush;
  evaluate(a: Brush, b: Brush, operations: CSGOperation[], targets: Brush[]): Brush[];
  evaluate(
    a: Brush,
    b: Brush,
    operations: CSGOperation | CSGOperation[],
    targetBrushes: Brush | Brush[] = new Brush(),
  ): Brush | Brush[] {
    const operationList = Array.isArray(operations) ? operations : [operations];
    const wasArray = Array.isArray(targetBrushes);
    const targets = wasArray ? targetBrushes : [targetBrushes];
    if (targets.length !== operationList.length) {
      throw new Error("Evaluator: operations and target array passed as different sizes.");
    }
    a.prepareGeometry();
    b.prepareGeometry();
    const {
      triangleSplitter,
      geometryBuilders,
      attributes,
      useGroups,
      consolidateGroups,
      removeUnusedMaterials,
      debug,
    } = this;
    while (geometryBuilders.length < targets.length) geometryBuilders.push(new GeometryBuilder());
    targets.forEach((brush, i) => {
      geometryBuilders[i].initFromGeometry(a.geometry, attributes);
      GeometryUtils.trimAttributes(brush.geometry, attributes);
    });
    debug.init();
    performOperation(a, b, operationList, triangleSplitter, geometryBuilders, { useGroups });
    debug.complete();

    const aGroups = this.getGroupRanges(a.geometry);
    const aMaterials = GeometryUtils.getMaterialList(aGroups, a.material);
    const bGroups = this.getGroupRanges(b.geometry);
    const bMaterials = GeometryUtils.getMaterialList(bGroups, b.material);
    bGroups.forEach((group) => (group.materialIndex += aMaterials.length));
    const materials = [...aMaterials, ...bMaterials];
    let groups = [...aGroups, ...bGroups].map((group, index) => ({ ...group, index }));
    if (!useGroups) {
      groups = [{ start: 0, count: Infinity, index: 0, materialIndex: 0 }];
    } else if (consolidateGroups) {
      groups = GeometryUtils.useCommonMaterials(groups, materials);
      groups.sort((a, b) => a.materialIndex - b.materialIndex);
    }
    targets.forEach((brush, i) => {
      const targetGeometry = brush.geometry;
      geometryBuilders[i].buildGeometry(targetGeometry, groups);
      a.matrixWorld.decompose(brush.position, brush.quaternion, brush.scale);
      brush.updateMatrix();
      brush.matrixWorld.copy(a.matrixWorld);
      if (useGroups) {
        brush.material = materials;
        if (consolidateGroups) GeometryUtils.joinGroups(targetGeometry.groups);
        if (removeUnusedMaterials)
          brush.material = GeometryUtils.removeUnusedMaterials(targetGeometry.groups, materials);
      } else {
        brush.material = materials[0];
      }
    });
    return wasArray ? targets : targets[0];
  }

  evaluateHierarchy(root: Operation, target = new Brush()): Brush {
    root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
    const flatTraverse = (obj: Object3D, callback: (child: Operation) => void): void => {
      for (const child of obj.children) {
        if (child instanceof OperationGroup) flatTraverse(child, callback);
        else callback(child as Operation);
      }
    };
    const traverse = (brush: Operation | OperationGroup): boolean => {
      let didChange = false;
      for (const child of brush.children) didChange = traverse(child as Operation | OperationGroup) || didChange;
      const isDirty = brush.isDirty();
      if (isDirty) brush.markUpdated();
      if (didChange && !(brush instanceof OperationGroup)) {
        let result: Brush | undefined;
        flatTraverse(brush, (child) => {
          result = this.evaluate(result || brush, child, child.operation);
        });
        brush._cachedGeometry = result!.geometry;
        brush._cachedMaterials = result!.material;
        return true;
      }
      return didChange || isDirty;
    };
    traverse(root);
    target.geometry = root._cachedGeometry;
    target.material = root._cachedMaterials!;
    return target;
  }

  reset(): void {
    this.triangleSplitter.reset();
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/csg/core/HalfEdgeMap

```typescript
import { Vector2 } from "../../../../math/Vector2";
import { Vector3 } from "../../../../math/Vector3";
import { Vector4 } from "../../../../math/Vector4";
import type { BufferGeometry } from "../../../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { BufferAttribute } from "../../../../core/BufferAttribute";
import type { InterleavedBufferAttribute } from "../../../../core/InterleavedBufferAttribute";
import { hashNumber, hashVertex2, hashVertex3, hashVertex4 } from "./utils/hashUtils";
import { getTriCount } from "./utils/geometryUtils";
import { computeDisjointEdges } from "./utils/computeDisjointEdges";
import type { DisjointEdgesResult } from "./utils/computeDisjointEdges";

const vec2 = new Vector2();
const vec3 = new Vector3();
const vec4 = new Vector4();
const hashes = ["", "", ""];

export class HalfEdgeMap {
  data: Int32Array | null = null;
  disjointConnections: DisjointEdgesResult["disjointConnectivityMap"] | null = null;
  unmatchedDisjointEdges: DisjointEdgesResult["fragmentMap"] | null = null;
  unmatchedEdges: number = -1;
  matchedEdges: number = -1;
  useDrawRange: boolean = true;
  useAllAttributes: boolean = false;
  matchDisjointEdges: boolean = false;
  degenerateEpsilon: number = 1e-8;

  getSiblingTriangleIndex(triIndex: number, edgeIndex: number): number {
    const otherIndex = this.data![triIndex * 3 + edgeIndex];
    return otherIndex === -1 ? -1 : ~~(otherIndex / 3);
  }

  getSiblingEdgeIndex(triIndex: number, edgeIndex: number): number {
    const otherIndex = this.data![triIndex * 3 + edgeIndex];
    return otherIndex === -1 ? -1 : otherIndex % 3;
  }

  getDisjointSiblingTriangleIndices(triIndex: number, edgeIndex: number): number[] {
    const arr = this.disjointConnections!.get(triIndex * 3 + edgeIndex);
    return arr ? arr.map((i) => ~~(i / 3)) : [];
  }

  getDisjointSiblingEdgeIndices(triIndex: number, edgeIndex: number): number[] {
    const arr = this.disjointConnections!.get(triIndex * 3 + edgeIndex);
    return arr ? arr.map((i) => i % 3) : [];
  }

  isFullyConnected(): boolean {
    return this.unmatchedEdges === 0;
  }

  updateFrom(geometry: BufferGeometry): void {
    const { useAllAttributes, useDrawRange, matchDisjointEdges, degenerateEpsilon } = this;
    const hashFunction = useAllAttributes ? hashAllAttributes : hashPositionAttribute;
    const map = new Map<string, number>();
    const { attributes } = geometry;
    const attrKeys = useAllAttributes ? Object.keys(attributes) : [];
    const indexAttr = geometry.index;
    const posAttr = attributes.position as BufferAttribute | InterleavedBufferAttribute;
    let triCount = getTriCount(geometry);
    const maxTriCount = triCount;
    let offset = 0;
    if (useDrawRange) {
      offset = geometry.drawRange.start;
      if (geometry.drawRange.count !== Infinity) triCount = ~~(geometry.drawRange.count / 3);
    }
    let data = this.data;
    if (!data || data.length < 3 * maxTriCount) data = new Int32Array(3 * maxTriCount);
    data.fill(-1);
    let matchedEdges = 0;
    const unmatchedSet = new Set<number>();
    for (let i = offset, l = triCount * 3 + offset; i < l; i += 3) {
      for (let e = 0; e < 3; e++) {
        const vertexIndex = indexAttr ? indexAttr.getX(i + e) : i + e;
        hashes[e] = hashFunction(vertexIndex);
      }
      for (let e = 0; e < 3; e++) {
        const vh0 = hashes[e];
        const vh1 = hashes[(e + 1) % 3];
        const reverseHash = `${vh1}_${vh0}`;
        const otherIndex = map.get(reverseHash);
        if (otherIndex !== undefined) {
          const index = i + e;
          data[index] = otherIndex;
          data[otherIndex] = index;
          map.delete(reverseHash);
          matchedEdges += 2;
          unmatchedSet.delete(otherIndex);
        } else {
          const index = i + e;
          map.set(`${vh0}_${vh1}`, index);
          unmatchedSet.add(index);
        }
      }
    }
    if (matchDisjointEdges) {
      const { fragmentMap, disjointConnectivityMap } = computeDisjointEdges(geometry, unmatchedSet, degenerateEpsilon);
      unmatchedSet.clear();
      fragmentMap.forEach(({ forward, reverse }) => {
        forward.forEach(({ index }) => unmatchedSet.add(index));
        reverse.forEach(({ index }) => unmatchedSet.add(index));
      });
      this.unmatchedDisjointEdges = fragmentMap;
      this.disjointConnections = disjointConnectivityMap;
      matchedEdges = triCount * 3 - unmatchedSet.size;
    }
    this.matchedEdges = matchedEdges;
    this.unmatchedEdges = unmatchedSet.size;
    this.data = data;

    function hashPositionAttribute(i: number): string {
      return hashVertex3(vec3.fromBufferAttribute(posAttr, i));
    }
    function hashAllAttributes(i: number): string {
      let result = "";
      for (const key of attrKeys) {
        const attr = attributes[key] as BufferAttribute | InterleavedBufferAttribute;
        let str: string | number | undefined;
        switch (attr.itemSize) {
          case 1:
            str = hashNumber(attr.getX(i));
            break;
          case 2:
            str = hashVertex2(vec2.fromBufferAttribute(attr, i));
            break;
          case 3:
            str = hashVertex3(vec3.fromBufferAttribute(attr, i));
            break;
          case 4:
            str = hashVertex4(vec4.fromBufferAttribute(attr, i));
            break;
        }
        if (result !== "") result += "|";
        result += str;
      }
      return result;
    }
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/csg/core/IntersectionMap

```typescript
import type { Line3 } from "../../../../math/Line3";

export class IntersectionMap {
  coplanarSet: Map<number, Set<number>> = new Map();
  intersectionSet: Map<number, number[]> = new Map();
  edgeSet: Map<number, Set<Line3>> = new Map();
  ids: number[] = [];

  add(id: number, intersectionId: number, coplanar = false): void {
    let intersections = this.intersectionSet.get(id);
    if (!intersections) {
      intersections = [];
      this.intersectionSet.set(id, intersections);
      this.ids.push(id);
    }
    intersections.push(intersectionId);
    if (coplanar) {
      let set = this.coplanarSet.get(id);
      if (!set) {
        set = new Set();
        this.coplanarSet.set(id, set);
      }
      set.add(intersectionId);
    }
  }

  addIntersectionEdge(id: number, edge: Line3): void {
    let edges = this.edgeSet.get(id);
    if (!edges) {
      edges = new Set();
      this.edgeSet.set(id, edges);
    }
    edges.add(edge);
  }

  getIntersectionEdges(id: number): Set<Line3> | null {
    return this.edgeSet.get(id) || null;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/csg/core/LegacyTriangleSplitter

```typescript
import { Triangle } from "../../../../math/Triangle";
import { Line3 } from "../../../../math/Line3";
import { Vector3 } from "../../../../math/Vector3";
import { Plane } from "../../../../math/Plane";
import { ExtendedTriangle } from "../../bvh/math/ExtendedTriangle";
import { isTriDegenerate } from "./utils/triangleUtils";
import { Pool } from "./utils/Pool";

// NOTE: these epsilons likely should all be the same since they're used to measure the
// distance from a point to a plane which needs to be done consistently
const EPSILON = 1e-10;
const COPLANAR_EPSILON = 1e-10;
const _edge = new Line3();
const _foundEdge = new Line3();
const _vec = new Vector3();
const _triangleNormal = new Vector3();
const _planeNormal = new Vector3();
const _plane = new Plane();
const _splittingTriangle = new ExtendedTriangle();

// Utility class for splitting triangles
export class LegacyTriangleSplitter {
  trianglePool: Pool<Triangle & { coplanarCount?: number }>;
  triangles: (Triangle & { coplanarCount?: number })[];
  normal: Vector3;

  constructor() {
    this.trianglePool = new Pool(() => new Triangle());
    this.triangles = [];
    this.normal = new Vector3();
  }

  // initialize the class with a triangle
  initialize(tri: Triangle | Triangle[]) {
    this.reset();

    const { triangles, trianglePool, normal } = this;
    if (Array.isArray(tri)) {
      for (let i = 0, l = tri.length; i < l; i++) {
        const t = tri[i];
        if (i === 0) {
          t.getNormal(normal);
        } else if (Math.abs(1.0 - t.getNormal(_vec).dot(normal)) > EPSILON) {
          throw new Error("Triangle Splitter: Cannot initialize with triangles that have different normals.");
        }

        const poolTri = trianglePool.getInstance();
        poolTri.copy(t);
        triangles.push(poolTri);
      }
    } else {
      tri.getNormal(normal);

      const poolTri = trianglePool.getInstance();
      poolTri.copy(tri);
      triangles.push(poolTri);
    }
  }

  // Split the current set of triangles by passing a single triangle in. If the triangle is
  // coplanar it will attempt to split by the triangle edge planes
  splitByTriangle(triangle: Triangle, isCoplanar?: boolean) {
    const { triangles } = this;

    if (isCoplanar) {
      for (let i = 0, l = triangles.length; i < l; i++) {
        const t = triangles[i];
        t.coplanarCount = 0;
      }

      // if the triangle is coplanar then split by the edge planes
      const arr = [triangle.a, triangle.b, triangle.c];
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const nexti = (i + 1) % 3;

        const v0 = arr[i];
        const v1 = arr[nexti];

        // plane positive direction is toward triangle center
        triangle.getNormal(_triangleNormal).normalize();
        _vec.subVectors(v1, v0).normalize();
        _planeNormal.crossVectors(_triangleNormal, _vec);
        _plane.setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(_planeNormal, v0);

        this.splitByPlane(_plane, triangle);
      }
    } else {
      // otherwise split by the triangle plane
      triangle.getPlane(_plane);
      this.splitByPlane(_plane, triangle);
    }
  }

  // Split the triangles by the given plan. If a triangle is provided then we ensure we
  // intersect the triangle before splitting the plane
  splitByPlane(plane: Plane, clippingTriangle: Triangle) {
    const { triangles, trianglePool } = this;

    // init our triangle to check for intersection
    _splittingTriangle.copy(clippingTriangle);
    _splittingTriangle.needsUpdate = true;

    // try to split every triangle in the class
    for (let i = 0, l = triangles.length; i < l; i++) {
      const tri = triangles[i];

      // skip the triangle if we don't intersect with it
      if (!_splittingTriangle.intersectsTriangle(tri, _edge, true)) {
        continue;
      }

      const { a, b, c } = tri;
      let intersects = 0;
      let vertexSplitEnd = -1;
      let coplanarEdge = false;
      const posSideVerts: number[] = [];
      const negSideVerts: number[] = [];
      const arr = [a, b, c];
      for (let t = 0; t < 3; t++) {
        // get the triangle edge
        const tNext = (t + 1) % 3;
        _edge.start.copy(arr[t]);
        _edge.end.copy(arr[tNext]);

        // track if the start point sits on the plane or if it's on the positive side of it
        // so we can use that information to determine whether to split later.
        const startDist = plane.distanceToPoint(_edge.start);
        const endDist = plane.distanceToPoint(_edge.end);
        if (Math.abs(startDist) < COPLANAR_EPSILON && Math.abs(endDist) < COPLANAR_EPSILON) {
          coplanarEdge = true;
          break;
        }

        if (startDist > 0) {
          posSideVerts.push(t);
        } else {
          negSideVerts.push(t);
        }

        // we only don't consider this an intersection if the start points hits the plane
        if (Math.abs(startDist) < COPLANAR_EPSILON) {
          continue;
        }

        // double check the end point since the "intersectLine" function sometimes does not
        // return it as an intersection (see issue #28)
        // Because we ignore the start point intersection above we have to make sure we check the end
        // point intersection here.
        let didIntersect = !!plane.intersectLine(_edge, _vec);
        if (!didIntersect && Math.abs(endDist) < COPLANAR_EPSILON) {
          _vec.copy(_edge.end);
          didIntersect = true;
        }

        // check if we intersect the plane (ignoring the start point so we don't double count)
        if (didIntersect && !(_vec.distanceTo(_edge.start) < EPSILON)) {
          // if we intersect at the end point then we track that point as one that we
          // have to split down the middle
          if (_vec.distanceTo(_edge.end) < EPSILON) {
            vertexSplitEnd = t;
          }

          // track the split edge
          if (intersects === 0) {
            _foundEdge.start.copy(_vec);
          } else {
            _foundEdge.end.copy(_vec);
          }

          intersects++;
        }
      }

      // skip splitting if:
      // - we have two points on the plane then the plane intersects the triangle exactly on an edge
      // - the plane does not intersect on 2 points
      // - the intersection edge is too small
      // - we're not along a coplanar edge
      if (!coplanarEdge && intersects === 2 && _foundEdge.distance() > COPLANAR_EPSILON) {
        if (vertexSplitEnd !== -1) {
          vertexSplitEnd = (vertexSplitEnd + 1) % 3;

          // we're splitting along a vertex
          let otherVert1 = 0;
          if (otherVert1 === vertexSplitEnd) {
            otherVert1 = (otherVert1 + 1) % 3;
          }

          let otherVert2 = otherVert1 + 1;
          if (otherVert2 === vertexSplitEnd) {
            otherVert2 = (otherVert2 + 1) % 3;
          }

          const nextTri = trianglePool.getInstance();
          nextTri.a.copy(arr[otherVert2]);
          nextTri.b.copy(_foundEdge.end);
          nextTri.c.copy(_foundEdge.start);

          if (!isTriDegenerate(nextTri)) {
            triangles.push(nextTri);
          }

          tri.a.copy(arr[otherVert1]);
          tri.b.copy(_foundEdge.start);
          tri.c.copy(_foundEdge.end);

          // finish off the adjusted triangle
          if (isTriDegenerate(tri)) {
            triangles.splice(i, 1);
            i--;
            l--;
          }
        } else {
          // we're splitting with a quad and a triangle
          // TODO: what happens when we find that about the pos and negative
          // sides have only a single vertex?
          const singleVert = posSideVerts.length >= 2 ? negSideVerts[0] : posSideVerts[0];

          // swap the direction of the intersection edge depending on which
          // side of the plane the single vertex is on to align with the
          // correct winding order.
          if (singleVert === 0) {
            let tmp = _foundEdge.start;
            _foundEdge.start = _foundEdge.end;
            _foundEdge.end = tmp;
          }

          const nextVert1 = (singleVert + 1) % 3;
          const nextVert2 = (singleVert + 2) % 3;

          const nextTri1 = trianglePool.getInstance();
          const nextTri2 = trianglePool.getInstance();

          // choose the triangle that has the larger areas (shortest split distance)
          if (arr[nextVert1].distanceToSquared(_foundEdge.start) < arr[nextVert2].distanceToSquared(_foundEdge.end)) {
            nextTri1.a.copy(arr[nextVert1]);
            nextTri1.b.copy(_foundEdge.start);
            nextTri1.c.copy(_foundEdge.end);

            nextTri2.a.copy(arr[nextVert1]);
            nextTri2.b.copy(arr[nextVert2]);
            nextTri2.c.copy(_foundEdge.start);
          } else {
            nextTri1.a.copy(arr[nextVert2]);
            nextTri1.b.copy(_foundEdge.start);
            nextTri1.c.copy(_foundEdge.end);

            nextTri2.a.copy(arr[nextVert1]);
            nextTri2.b.copy(arr[nextVert2]);
            nextTri2.c.copy(_foundEdge.end);
          }

          tri.a.copy(arr[singleVert]);
          tri.b.copy(_foundEdge.end);
          tri.c.copy(_foundEdge.start);

          // don't add degenerate triangles to the list
          if (!isTriDegenerate(nextTri1)) {
            triangles.push(nextTri1);
          }

          if (!isTriDegenerate(nextTri2)) {
            triangles.push(nextTri2);
          }

          // finish off the adjusted triangle
          if (isTriDegenerate(tri)) {
            triangles.splice(i, 1);
            i--;
            l--;
          }
        }
      } else if (intersects === 3) {
        console.warn("TriangleClipper: Coplanar clip not handled");
      }
    }
  }

  reset() {
    this.triangles.length = 0;
    this.trianglePool.clear();
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/csg/core/TypeBackedArray

```typescript
import { areSharedArrayBuffersSupported } from "./utils/geometryUtils";

export type NumericArray =
  | Int8Array
  | Uint8Array
  | Uint8ClampedArray
  | Int16Array
  | Uint16Array
  | Int32Array
  | Uint32Array
  | Float32Array
  | Float64Array;
export interface NumericArrayConstructor {
  new (buffer: ArrayBufferLike): NumericArray;
  readonly BYTES_PER_ELEMENT: number;
}

function ceilToFourByteStride(byteLength: number): number {
  byteLength = ~~byteLength;
  return byteLength + 4 - (byteLength % 4);
}

export class TypeBackedArray {
  expansionFactor: number;
  type: NumericArrayConstructor;
  length: number;
  array: NumericArray;

  constructor(type: NumericArrayConstructor, initialSize = 500) {
    this.expansionFactor = 1.5;
    this.type = type;
    this.length = 0;
    const bufferType = areSharedArrayBuffersSupported() ? SharedArrayBuffer : ArrayBuffer;
    this.array = new type(new bufferType(ceilToFourByteStride(initialSize * type.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT)));
  }

  setType(type: NumericArrayConstructor): void {
    if (type === this.type) return;
    if (this.length !== 0)
      throw new Error("TypeBackedArray: Cannot change the type while there is used data in the buffer.");
    this.array = new type(this.array.buffer);
    this.type = type;
  }

  setSize(size: number): void {
    if (size === this.array.length) return;
    const type = this.type;
    const bufferType = areSharedArrayBuffersSupported() ? SharedArrayBuffer : ArrayBuffer;
    const newArray = new type(new bufferType(ceilToFourByteStride(size * type.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT)));
    newArray.set(this.array, 0);
    this.array = newArray;
  }

  expand(): void {
    this.setSize(this.array.length * this.expansionFactor);
  }

  push(...args: number[]): void {
    let { array, length } = this;
    if (length + args.length > array.length) {
      this.expand();
      array = this.array;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) array[length + i] = args[i];
    this.length += args.length;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.length = 0;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/csg/core/debug/OperationDebugData

```typescript
import { Triangle } from "../../../../../math/Triangle";
import type { Line3 } from "../../../../../math/Line3";
import { setDebugContext } from "../operations/operationsUtils";

class TriangleIntersectData {
  triangle: Triangle;
  intersects: Record<string, Triangle>;

  constructor(tri: Triangle) {
    this.triangle = new Triangle().copy(tri);
    this.intersects = {};
  }

  addTriangle(index: number, tri: Triangle): void {
    this.intersects[index] = new Triangle().copy(tri);
  }

  getIntersectArray(): Triangle[] {
    const array: Triangle[] = [];
    const { intersects } = this;
    for (const key in intersects) {
      array.push(intersects[key]);
    }
    return array;
  }
}

class TriangleIntersectionSets {
  data: Record<string, TriangleIntersectData>;

  constructor() {
    this.data = {};
  }

  addTriangleIntersection(ia: number, triA: Triangle, ib: number, triB: Triangle): void {
    const { data } = this;
    if (!data[ia]) {
      data[ia] = new TriangleIntersectData(triA);
    }
    data[ia].addTriangle(ib, triB);
  }

  getTrianglesAsArray(id: number | null = null): Triangle[] {
    const { data } = this;
    const arr: Triangle[] = [];
    if (id !== null) {
      if (id in data) {
        arr.push(data[id].triangle);
      }
    } else {
      for (const key in data) {
        arr.push(data[key].triangle);
      }
    }
    return arr;
  }

  getTriangleIndices(): number[] {
    return Object.keys(this.data).map((i) => parseInt(i));
  }

  getIntersectionIndices(id: number): number[] {
    const { data } = this;
    if (!data[id]) {
      return [];
    }
    return Object.keys(data[id].intersects).map((i) => parseInt(i));
  }

  getIntersectionsAsArray(id: number | null = null, id2: number | null = null): Triangle[] {
    const { data } = this;
    const triSet = new Set<string>();
    const arr: Triangle[] = [];
    const addTriangles = (key: string | number): void => {
      if (!data[key]) return;
      if (id2 !== null) {
        if (data[key].intersects[id2]) {
          arr.push(data[key].intersects[id2]);
        }
      } else {
        const intersects = data[key].intersects;
        for (const key2 in intersects) {
          if (!triSet.has(key2)) {
            triSet.add(key2);
            arr.push(intersects[key2]);
          }
        }
      }
    };
    if (id !== null) {
      addTriangles(id);
    } else {
      for (const key in data) {
        addTriangles(key);
      }
    }
    return arr;
  }

  reset(): void {
    this.data = {};
  }
}

export class OperationDebugData {
  enabled: boolean;
  triangleIntersectsA: TriangleIntersectionSets;
  triangleIntersectsB: TriangleIntersectionSets;
  intersectionEdges: Line3[];

  constructor() {
    this.enabled = false;
    this.triangleIntersectsA = new TriangleIntersectionSets();
    this.triangleIntersectsB = new TriangleIntersectionSets();
    this.intersectionEdges = [];
  }

  addIntersectingTriangles(ia: number, triA: Triangle, ib: number, triB: Triangle): void {
    this.triangleIntersectsA.addTriangleIntersection(ia, triA, ib, triB);
    this.triangleIntersectsB.addTriangleIntersection(ib, triB, ia, triA);
  }

  addEdge(edge: Line3): void {
    this.intersectionEdges.push(edge.clone());
  }

  reset(): void {
    this.triangleIntersectsA.reset();
    this.triangleIntersectsB.reset();
    this.intersectionEdges = [];
  }

  init(): void {
    if (this.enabled) {
      this.reset();
      setDebugContext(this);
    }
  }

  complete(): void {
    if (this.enabled) {
      setDebugContext(null);
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
export function getTriangleDefinitions(...triangles: Triangle[]): string[] {
  function getVectorDefinition(v: Vector3): string {
    return `new THREE.Vector3( ${v.x}, ${v.y}, ${v.z} )`;
  }

  return triangles.map((t) =>
    `
new THREE.Triangle(
	${getVectorDefinition(t.a)},
	${getVectorDefinition(t.b)},
	${getVectorDefinition(t.c)},
)
		`.trim(),
  );
}

export function logTriangleDefinitions(...triangles: Triangle[]): void {

}

export function generateRandomTriangleColors(geometry: BufferGeometry): void {
  const position = geometry.attributes.position;
  const array = new Float32Array(position.count * 3);
  const color = new Color();
  for (let i = 0, l = array.length; i < l; i += 9) {
    color.setHSL(Math.random(), lerp(0.5, 1.0, Math.random()), lerp(0.5, 0.75, Math.random()));
    array[i + 0] = color.r;
    array[i + 1] = color.g;
    array[i + 2] = color.b;
    array[i + 3] = color.r;
    array[i + 4] = color.g;
    array[i + 5] = color.b;
    array[i + 6] = color.r;
    array[i + 7] = color.g;
    array[i + 8] = color.b;
  }
  geometry.setAttribute("color", new BufferAttribute(array, 3));
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/csg/core/operations/GeometryBuilder

```typescript
import { TypeBackedArray } from "../TypeBackedArray";
import type { NumericArrayConstructor } from "../TypeBackedArray";
import type { CSGGeometry } from "../Brush";
import type { BufferGeometry } from "../../../../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { Matrix3 } from "../../../../../math/Matrix3";
import type { Matrix4 } from "../../../../../math/Matrix4";
import { Vector3 } from "../../../../../math/Vector3";
import { Vector4 } from "../../../../../math/Vector4";
import { BufferAttribute } from "../../../../../core/BufferAttribute";

const _vec3 = new Vector3();
const _vec3_0 = new Vector3();
const _vec3_1 = new Vector3();
const _vec3_2 = new Vector3();

const _vec4 = new Vector4();
const _vec4_0 = new Vector4();
const _vec4_1 = new Vector4();
const _vec4_2 = new Vector4();

function getBarycoordValue(
  a: Vector4,
  b: Vector4,
  c: Vector4,
  barycoord: Vector3,
  target: Vector4,
  normalize = false,
  invert = false,
) {
  target
    .set(0, 0, 0, 0)
    .addScaledVector(a, barycoord.x)
    .addScaledVector(b, barycoord.y)
    .addScaledVector(c, barycoord.z);

  if (normalize) {
    target.normalize();
  }

  if (invert) {
    target.multiplyScalar(-1);
  }

  return target;
}

function pushItemSize(vec: Vector4, itemSize: number, target: TypeBackedArray) {
  switch (itemSize) {
    case 1:
      target.push(vec.x);
      break;

    case 2:
      target.push(vec.x, vec.y);
      break;

    case 3:
      target.push(vec.x, vec.y, vec.z);
      break;

    case 4:
      target.push(vec.x, vec.y, vec.z, vec.w);
      break;
  }
}

class AttributeData extends TypeBackedArray {
  itemSize: number;
  normalized: boolean;

  get count() {
    return this.length / this.itemSize;
  }

  constructor(type: NumericArrayConstructor) {
    super(type);
    this.itemSize = 1;
    this.normalized = false;
  }
}

export class GeometryBuilder {
  attributeData: Record<string, AttributeData>;
  groupIndices: AttributeData[];
  forwardIndexMap: Map<number | string | null, number>;
  invertedIndexMap: Map<number | string | null, number>;
  interpolatedFields: Record<string, [Vector4, Vector4, Vector4]>;

  constructor() {
    this.attributeData = {};
    this.groupIndices = [];
    this.forwardIndexMap = new Map();
    this.invertedIndexMap = new Map();
    this.interpolatedFields = {};
  }

  initFromGeometry(referenceGeometry: BufferGeometry, relevantAttributes: string[]) {
    this.clear();

    // initialize and clear unused data from the attribute buffers and vice versa
    const { attributeData } = this;
    const refAttributes = referenceGeometry.attributes;
    for (let i = 0, l = relevantAttributes.length; i < l; i++) {
      const key = relevantAttributes[i];
      const refAttr = refAttributes[key] as BufferAttribute;
      const type = refAttr.array.constructor as NumericArrayConstructor;
      if (!attributeData[key]) {
        attributeData[key] = new AttributeData(type);
      }

      attributeData[key].setType(type);
      attributeData[key].itemSize = refAttr.itemSize;
      attributeData[key].normalized = refAttr.normalized;
    }

    for (const key in attributeData) {
      if (!relevantAttributes.includes(key)) {
        delete attributeData[key];
      }
    }
  }

  // init and cache all the attribute data for the given indices so we can use it to append interpolated attribute data
  initInterpolatedAttributeData(
    geometry: BufferGeometry,
    matrix: Matrix4,
    normalMatrix: Matrix3,
    i0: number,
    i1: number,
    i2: number,
  ) {
    const { attributeData, interpolatedFields } = this;
    const { attributes } = geometry;

    for (const key in attributeData) {
      const attr = attributes[key] as BufferAttribute;
      if (!attr) {
        throw new Error(`CSG Operations: Attribute ${key} not available on geometry.`);
      }

      // handle normals and positions specially because they require transforming
      let v0, v1, v2;
      if (key === "position") {
        v0 = _vec3_0.fromBufferAttribute(attr, i0).applyMatrix4(matrix);
        v1 = _vec3_1.fromBufferAttribute(attr, i1).applyMatrix4(matrix);
        v2 = _vec3_2.fromBufferAttribute(attr, i2).applyMatrix4(matrix);
      } else if (key === "normal") {
        v0 = _vec3_0.fromBufferAttribute(attr, i0).applyNormalMatrix(normalMatrix);
        v1 = _vec3_1.fromBufferAttribute(attr, i1).applyNormalMatrix(normalMatrix);
        v2 = _vec3_2.fromBufferAttribute(attr, i2).applyNormalMatrix(normalMatrix);
      } else if (key === "tangent") {
        v0 = _vec3_0.fromBufferAttribute(attr, i0).transformDirection(matrix);
        v1 = _vec3_1.fromBufferAttribute(attr, i1).transformDirection(matrix);
        v2 = _vec3_2.fromBufferAttribute(attr, i2).transformDirection(matrix);
      } else {
        v0 = _vec4_0.fromBufferAttribute(attr, i0);
        v1 = _vec4_1.fromBufferAttribute(attr, i1);
        v2 = _vec4_2.fromBufferAttribute(attr, i2);
      }

      if (!interpolatedFields[key]) {
        interpolatedFields[key] = [
          v0.clone() as unknown as Vector4,
          v1.clone() as unknown as Vector4,
          v2.clone() as unknown as Vector4,
        ];
      } else {
        const fields = interpolatedFields[key];
        fields[0].copy(v0);
        fields[1].copy(v1);
        fields[2].copy(v2);
      }
    }
  }

  // push data from the given barycoord onto the geometry
  appendInterpolatedAttributeData(
    group: number,
    barycoord: Vector3,
    index: number | string | null = null,
    invert = false,
  ) {
    const { groupIndices, attributeData, interpolatedFields, forwardIndexMap, invertedIndexMap } = this;
    while (groupIndices.length <= group) {
      groupIndices.push(new AttributeData(Uint32Array));
    }

    const indexMap = invert ? invertedIndexMap : forwardIndexMap;
    const indexData = groupIndices[group];
    if (index !== null && indexMap.has(index)) {
      indexData.push(indexMap.get(index)!);
    } else {
      indexMap.set(index, attributeData.position.count);
      indexData.push(attributeData.position.count);

      for (const key in interpolatedFields) {
        // handle normals and positions specially because they require transforming
        const arr = attributeData[key];
        const isDirection = key === "normal" || key === "tangent";
        const invertVector = invert && isDirection;
        const itemSize = arr.itemSize;
        const [v0, v1, v2] = interpolatedFields[key];
        getBarycoordValue(v0, v1, v2, barycoord, _vec4, isDirection, invertVector);
        pushItemSize(_vec4, itemSize, arr);
      }
    }
  }

  // append the given vertex index from the source geometry to this one
  appendIndexFromGeometry(
    geometry: BufferGeometry,
    matrix: Matrix4,
    normalMatrix: Matrix3,
    group: number,
    index: number,
    invert = false,
  ) {
    const { groupIndices, attributeData, forwardIndexMap, invertedIndexMap } = this;
    while (groupIndices.length <= group) {
      groupIndices.push(new AttributeData(Uint32Array));
    }

    const indexMap = invert ? invertedIndexMap : forwardIndexMap;
    const indexData = groupIndices[group];
    if (index !== null && indexMap.has(index)) {
      indexData.push(indexMap.get(index)!);
    } else {
      indexMap.set(index, attributeData.position.count);
      indexData.push(attributeData.position.count);

      const { attributes } = geometry;
      for (const key in attributeData) {
        const arr = attributeData[key];
        const attr = attributes[key] as BufferAttribute;
        if (!attr) {
          throw new Error(`CSG Operations: Attribute ${key} not available on geometry.`);
        }

        // specially handle the position and normal attributes because they require transforms
        const itemSize = attr.itemSize;
        if (key === "position") {
          _vec3.fromBufferAttribute(attr, index).applyMatrix4(matrix);
          arr.push(_vec3.x, _vec3.y, _vec3.z);
        } else if (key === "normal") {
          _vec3.fromBufferAttribute(attr, index).applyNormalMatrix(normalMatrix);
          if (invert) {
            _vec3.multiplyScalar(-1);
          }

          arr.push(_vec3.x, _vec3.y, _vec3.z);
        } else if (key === "tangent") {
          _vec3.fromBufferAttribute(attr, index).transformDirection(matrix);
          if (invert) {
            _vec3.multiplyScalar(-1);
          }

          arr.push(_vec3.x, _vec3.y, _vec3.z);
        } else {
          _vec4.fromBufferAttribute(attr, index);
          pushItemSize(_vec4, itemSize, arr);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  buildGeometry(target: BufferGeometry, groupOrder: { index: number; materialIndex: number }[]) {
    let needsDisposal = false;
    const { groupIndices, attributeData } = this;
    const { attributes, index } = target;
    for (const key in attributeData) {
      const arr = attributeData[key];
      const { type, itemSize, normalized, length, count } = arr;

      let attr = attributes[key] as BufferAttribute;
      if (!attr || attr.count < count || attr.array.constructor !== type) {
        // create the attribute if it doesn't exist yet
        attr = new BufferAttribute(new type(new ArrayBuffer(length * type.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT)), itemSize, normalized);
        target.setAttribute(key, attr);
        needsDisposal = true;
      }

      // copy the data
      attr.array.set(arr.array.subarray(0, length), 0);
      attr.needsUpdate = true;
    }

    // remove or update the index appropriately
    const indexCount = groupIndices.reduce((v, arr) => arr.count + v, 0);
    if (!target.index || index!.count < indexCount || index!.array.constructor !== Uint32Array) {
      target.setIndex(new BufferAttribute(new Uint32Array(indexCount), 1));
      needsDisposal = true;
    }

    // initialize the groups
    target.clearGroups();

    let offset = 0;
    for (let i = 0, l = Math.min(groupOrder.length, groupIndices.length); i < l; i++) {
      const { index, materialIndex } = groupOrder[i];
      const { count } = groupIndices[index];
      const buffer = groupIndices[index].array.buffer;
      if (count !== 0) {
        target.index!.array.set(new Uint32Array(buffer, 0, count), offset);
        target.addGroup(offset, count, materialIndex);
        offset += count;
      }
    }

    // update the draw range
    target.setDrawRange(0, offset);

    // remove the bounds tree if it exists because its now out of date
    // TODO: can we have this dispose in the same way that a brush does?
    // TODO: why are half edges and group indices not removed here?
    (target as CSGGeometry).boundsTree = null;
    target.boundingBox = null;
    target.boundingSphere = null;

    if (needsDisposal) {
      target.dispose();
    }
  }

  clearIndexMap() {
    this.forwardIndexMap.clear();
    this.invertedIndexMap.clear();
  }

  clear() {
    const { groupIndices, attributeData } = this;

    this.interpolatedFields = {};

    for (const key in attributeData) {
      attributeData[key].clear();
    }

    groupIndices.forEach((arr) => {
      arr.clear();
    });
    this.clearIndexMap();
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/csg/core/operations/GeometryUtils

```typescript
import type { BufferGeometry } from "../../../../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { Material } from "../../../../../materials/Material";

export interface GeometryGroup {
  start: number;
  count: number;
  materialIndex: number;
}

export function trimAttributes(targetGeometry: BufferGeometry, relevantAttributes: string[]) {
  for (const key in targetGeometry.attributes) {
    if (!relevantAttributes.includes(key)) {
      targetGeometry.deleteAttribute(key);
      targetGeometry.dispose();
    }
  }

  return targetGeometry;
}

// writes new groups to point to the same material index in the given materials array
export function useCommonMaterials<T extends GeometryGroup>(groups: T[], materials: Material[]) {
  const result: T[] = [];
  for (let i = 0, l = groups.length; i < l; i++) {
    const group = groups[i];
    const mat = materials[group.materialIndex];
    result.push({
      ...group,
      materialIndex: materials.indexOf(mat),
    });
  }

  return result;
}

// returns a new list of materials and modifies the groups in place to reference those materials
export function removeUnusedMaterials(groups: GeometryGroup[], materials: Material[]) {
  const newMaterials: Material[] = [];
  const indexMap = new Map<number, number>();
  for (let g = 0, lg = groups.length; g < lg; g++) {
    const group = groups[g];
    if (!indexMap.has(group.materialIndex)) {
      indexMap.set(group.materialIndex, newMaterials.length);
      newMaterials.push(materials[group.materialIndex]);
    }

    group.materialIndex = indexMap.get(group.materialIndex)!;
  }

  return newMaterials;
}

// merges groups with common material indices in place
export function joinGroups(groups: GeometryGroup[]) {
  for (let i = 0; i < groups.length - 1; i++) {
    const group = groups[i];
    const nextGroup = groups[i + 1];
    if (group.materialIndex === nextGroup.materialIndex) {
      const start = group.start;
      const end = nextGroup.start + nextGroup.count;
      nextGroup.start = start;
      nextGroup.count = end - start;

      groups.splice(i, 1);
      i--;
    }
  }
}

// Returns the list of materials used for the given set of groups
export function getMaterialList(groups: GeometryGroup[], materials: Material | Material[]) {
  let result: Material[];
  if (!Array.isArray(materials)) {
    result = [];
    groups.forEach((g) => {
      result[g.materialIndex] = materials;
    });
  } else {
    result = materials;
  }

  return result;
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/csg/core/operations/Operation

```typescript
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../../../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { Material } from "../../../../../materials/Material";
import type { Object3D } from "../../../../../core/Object3D";
import type { CSGOperation } from "../constants";
import { Brush } from "../Brush";
import { ADDITION } from "../constants";

export class Operation extends Brush {
  isOperation: boolean;
  operation: CSGOperation;
  _cachedGeometry: BufferGeometry;
  _cachedMaterials: Material | Material[] | null;
  _previousOperation: CSGOperation | null;

  constructor(...args: ConstructorParameters<typeof Brush>) {
    super(...args);

    this.isOperation = true;
    this.operation = ADDITION;

    this._cachedGeometry = new BufferGeometry();
    this._cachedMaterials = null;
    this._previousOperation = null;
  }

  markUpdated() {
    super.markUpdated();
    this._previousOperation = this.operation;
  }

  isDirty() {
    return this.operation !== this._previousOperation || super.isDirty();
  }

  insertBefore(brush: Object3D) {
    const parent = this.parent!;
    const index = parent.children.indexOf(this);
    parent.children.splice(index, 0, brush);
  }

  insertAfter(brush: Object3D) {
    const parent = this.parent!;
    const index = parent.children.indexOf(this);
    parent.children.splice(index + 1, 0, brush);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Group } from "../../../../../objects/Group";
import { Matrix4 } from "../../../../../math/Matrix4";

export class OperationGroup extends Group {
  isOperationGroup: boolean;
  _previousMatrix: Matrix4;

  constructor() {
    super();
    this.isOperationGroup = true;
    this._previousMatrix = new Matrix4();
  }

  markUpdated() {
    this._previousMatrix.copy(this.matrix);
  }

  isDirty() {
    const { matrix, _previousMatrix } = this;
    const el1 = matrix.elements;
    const el2 = _previousMatrix.elements;
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
      if (el1[i] !== el2[i]) {
        return true;
      }
    }

    return false;
  }
}
```
