```typescript
import { monotoneTriangulate } from "./monotone";
import { Triangulation, delaunayRefine } from "./mesh";
import { classifyFaces } from "./filter";

export interface TriangulationOptions {
  delaunay?: boolean;
  interior?: boolean;
  exterior?: boolean;
  infinity?: boolean;
}

export default function cdt2d(
  points: number[][],
  edgesOrOptions: number[][] | TriangulationOptions = [],
  options: TriangulationOptions = {},
): number[][] {
  const edges = Array.isArray(edgesOrOptions) ? edgesOrOptions : [];
  if (!Array.isArray(edgesOrOptions)) options = edgesOrOptions;
  const delaunay = options.delaunay === undefined ? true : !!options.delaunay;
  const interior = options.interior === undefined ? true : !!options.interior;
  const exterior = options.exterior === undefined ? true : !!options.exterior;
  const infinity = !!options.infinity;
  if ((!interior && !exterior) || points.length === 0) return [];
  const cells = monotoneTriangulate(points, edges);
  if (!delaunay && interior === exterior && !infinity) return cells;
  const canonicalEdges = edges.map((e) => [Math.min(e[0], e[1]), Math.max(e[0], e[1])]);
  canonicalEdges.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0] || a[1] - b[1]);
  const mesh = new Triangulation(points.length, canonicalEdges);
  for (const f of cells) mesh.addTriangle(f[0], f[1], f[2]);
  if (delaunay) delaunayRefine(points, mesh);
  if (!exterior) return classifyFaces(mesh, -1);
  if (!interior) return classifyFaces(mesh, 1, infinity);
  if (infinity) return classifyFaces(mesh, 0, true);
  return mesh.cells();
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/csg/triangulation/filter

```typescript
import type { Triangulation } from "./mesh";

function compareCell(a: number[], b: number[]): number {
  return a[0] - b[0] || a[1] - b[1] || a[2] - b[2];
}

function locate(cells: number[][], a: number, b: number, c: number): number {
  let x = a,
    y = b,
    z = c;
  if (b < c) {
    if (b < a) {
      x = b;
      y = c;
      z = a;
    }
  } else if (c < a) {
    x = c;
    y = a;
    z = b;
  }
  if (x < 0) return -1;
  const key = [x, y, z];
  let lo = 0,
    hi = cells.length;
  while (lo < hi) {
    const mid = (lo + hi) >>> 1,
      d = compareCell(cells[mid], key);
    if (d === 0) return mid;
    if (d < 0) lo = mid + 1;
    else hi = mid;
  }
  return -1;
}

export function classifyFaces(mesh: Triangulation, target: number, infinity = false): number[][] {
  const cells = mesh.cells();
  for (const c of cells) {
    const [x, y, z] = c;
    if (y < z) {
      if (y < x) {
        c[0] = y;
        c[1] = z;
        c[2] = x;
      }
    } else if (z < x) {
      c[0] = z;
      c[1] = x;
      c[2] = y;
    }
  }
  cells.sort(compareCell);
  const flags = Array.from({ length: cells.length }, () => 0);
  const neighbor: number[] = [];
  const constraint: boolean[] = [];
  const boundary: number[][] = [];
  let active: number[] = [],
    next: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) {
    const c = cells[i];
    for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
      const x = c[j],
        y = c[(j + 1) % 3];
      const a = (neighbor[3 * i + j] = locate(cells, y, x, mesh.opposite(y, x)));
      const b = (constraint[3 * i + j] = mesh.isConstraint(x, y));
      if (a < 0) {
        if (b) next.push(i);
        else {
          active.push(i);
          flags[i] = 1;
        }
        if (infinity) boundary.push([y, x, -1]);
      }
    }
  }
  if (target === 0) return infinity ? cells.concat(boundary) : cells;
  let side = 1;
  while (active.length > 0 || next.length > 0) {
    while (active.length > 0) {
      const t = active.pop()!;
      if (flags[t] === -side) continue;
      flags[t] = side;
      for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
        const f = neighbor[3 * t + j];
        if (f >= 0 && flags[f] === 0) {
          if (constraint[3 * t + j]) next.push(f);
          else {
            active.push(f);
            flags[f] = side;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    [active, next] = [next, active];
    next.length = 0;
    side = -side;
  }
  const result = cells.filter((_, i) => flags[i] === target);
  return infinity ? result.concat(boundary) : result;
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/csg/triangulation/mesh

```typescript
import { inCircle } from "./predicates";

export class Triangulation {
  stars: number[][];
  edges: number[][];

  constructor(count: number, edges: number[][]) {
    this.stars = Array.from({ length: count }, () => []);
    this.edges = edges;
  }

  isConstraint(i: number, j: number): boolean {
    const a = Math.min(i, j),
      b = Math.max(i, j);
    let lo = 0,
      hi = this.edges.length;
    while (lo < hi) {
      const mid = (lo + hi) >>> 1,
        edge = this.edges[mid];
      if (edge[0] < a || (edge[0] === a && edge[1] < b)) lo = mid + 1;
      else hi = mid;
    }
    return lo < this.edges.length && this.edges[lo][0] === a && this.edges[lo][1] === b;
  }

  removeTriangle(i: number, j: number, k: number): void {
    for (const [a, b, c] of [
      [i, j, k],
      [j, k, i],
      [k, i, j],
    ]) {
      const list = this.stars[a];
      for (let n = 1; n < list.length; n += 2) {
        if (list[n - 1] === b && list[n] === c) {
          list[n - 1] = list[list.length - 2];
          list[n] = list[list.length - 1];
          list.length -= 2;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  addTriangle(i: number, j: number, k: number): void {
    this.stars[i].push(j, k);
    this.stars[j].push(k, i);
    this.stars[k].push(i, j);
  }

  opposite(j: number, i: number): number {
    const list = this.stars[i];
    for (let k = 1; k < list.length; k += 2) if (list[k] === j) return list[k - 1];
    return -1;
  }

  flip(i: number, j: number): void {
    const a = this.opposite(i, j),
      b = this.opposite(j, i);
    this.removeTriangle(i, j, a);
    this.removeTriangle(j, i, b);
    this.addTriangle(i, b, a);
    this.addTriangle(j, a, b);
  }

  cells(): number[][] {
    const result: number[][] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < this.stars.length; i++) {
      const list = this.stars[i];
      for (let j = 0; j < list.length; j += 2) {
        const s = list[j],
          t = list[j + 1];
        if (i < Math.min(s, t)) result.push([i, s, t]);
      }
    }
    return result;
  }
}

function testFlip(points: number[][], mesh: Triangulation, stack: number[], a: number, b: number, x: number): void {
  let y = mesh.opposite(a, b);
  if (y < 0) return;
  if (b < a) {
    [a, b] = [b, a];
    [x, y] = [y, x];
  }
  if (!mesh.isConstraint(a, b) && inCircle(points[a], points[b], points[x], points[y]) < 0) stack.push(a, b);
}

export function delaunayRefine(points: number[][], mesh: Triangulation): void {
  const stack: number[] = [],
    stars = mesh.stars;
  for (let a = 0; a < points.length; a++) {
    const star = stars[a];
    for (let j = 1; j < star.length; j += 2) {
      const b = star[j];
      if (b < a || mesh.isConstraint(a, b)) continue;
      const x = star[j - 1];
      let y = -1;
      for (let k = 1; k < star.length; k += 2) {
        if (star[k - 1] === b) {
          y = star[k];
          break;
        }
      }
      if (y >= 0 && inCircle(points[a], points[b], points[x], points[y]) < 0) stack.push(a, b);
    }
  }
  while (stack.length > 0) {
    const b = stack.pop()!,
      a = stack.pop()!,
      star = stars[a];
    let x = -1,
      y = -1;
    for (let i = 1; i < star.length; i += 2) {
      const s = star[i - 1],
        t = star[i];
      if (s === b) y = t;
      else if (t === b) x = s;
    }
    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || inCircle(points[a], points[b], points[x], points[y]) >= 0) continue;
    mesh.flip(a, b);
    testFlip(points, mesh, stack, x, a, y);
    testFlip(points, mesh, stack, a, y, x);
    testFlip(points, mesh, stack, y, b, x);
    testFlip(points, mesh, stack, b, x, y);
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/csg/triangulation/monotone

```typescript
import { orient } from "./predicates";

interface Hull {
  a: number[];
  b: number[];
  idx: number;
  lowerIds: number[];
  upperIds: number[];
}
interface Event {
  a: number[];
  b: number[];
  type: number;
  idx: number;
}

function bound<T, U>(items: T[], value: U, compare: (a: T, b: U) => number, upper: boolean): number {
  let lo = 0,
    hi = items.length;
  while (lo < hi) {
    const mid = (lo + hi) >>> 1,
      d = compare(items[mid], value);
    if (d < 0 || (upper && d === 0)) lo = mid + 1;
    else hi = mid;
  }
  return lo;
}

function compareEvent(a: Event, b: Event): number {
  const d = a.a[0] - b.a[0] || a.a[1] - b.a[1] || a.type - b.type;
  if (d) return d;
  if (a.type !== 0) {
    const winding = orient(a.a, a.b, b.b);
    if (winding) return winding;
  }
  return a.idx - b.idx;
}

function findSplit(hull: Hull, edge: Event): number {
  let d = hull.a[0] < edge.a[0] ? orient(hull.a, hull.b, edge.a) : orient(edge.b, edge.a, hull.a);
  if (d) return d;
  d = edge.b[0] < hull.b[0] ? orient(hull.a, hull.b, edge.b) : orient(edge.b, edge.a, hull.b);
  return d || hull.idx - edge.idx;
}

export function monotoneTriangulate(points: number[][], edges: number[][]): number[][] {
  const events: Event[] = points.map((a, idx) => ({ a, b: [], type: 0, idx }));
  for (let i = 0; i < edges.length; i++) {
    const a = points[edges[i][0]],
      b = points[edges[i][1]];
    if (a[0] < b[0]) events.push({ a, b, type: 2, idx: i }, { a: b, b: a, type: 1, idx: i });
    else if (a[0] > b[0]) events.push({ a: b, b: a, type: 2, idx: i }, { a, b, type: 1, idx: i });
  }
  events.sort(compareEvent);
  const minX = events[0].a[0] - (1 + Math.abs(events[0].a[0])) * Math.pow(2, -52);
  const hulls: Hull[] = [{ a: [minX, 1], b: [minX, 0], idx: -1, lowerIds: [], upperIds: [] }];
  const cells: number[][] = [];
  for (const event of events) {
    if (event.type === 0) {
      const comparePoint = (hull: Hull, p: number[]) => orient(hull.a, hull.b, p);
      const lo = bound(hulls, event.a, comparePoint, false) - 1;
      const hi = bound(hulls, event.a, comparePoint, true);
      for (let i = lo; i < hi; i++) {
        const hull = hulls[i],
          lower = hull.lowerIds,
          upper = hull.upperIds;
        let m = lower.length;
        while (m > 1 && orient(points[lower[m - 2]], points[lower[m - 1]], event.a) > 0) {
          cells.push([lower[m - 1], lower[m - 2], event.idx]);
          m--;
        }
        lower.length = m;
        lower.push(event.idx);
        m = upper.length;
        while (m > 1 && orient(points[upper[m - 2]], points[upper[m - 1]], event.a) < 0) {
          cells.push([upper[m - 2], upper[m - 1], event.idx]);
          m--;
        }
        upper.length = m;
        upper.push(event.idx);
      }
    } else if (event.type === 2) {
      const index = bound(hulls, event, findSplit, true) - 1;
      const hull = hulls[index],
        upper = hull.upperIds,
        x = upper[upper.length - 1];
      hull.upperIds = [x];
      hulls.splice(index + 1, 0, { a: event.a, b: event.b, idx: event.idx, lowerIds: [x], upperIds: upper });
    } else {
      [event.a, event.b] = [event.b, event.a];
      const index = bound(hulls, event, findSplit, false);
      hulls[index - 1].upperIds = hulls[index].upperIds;
      hulls.splice(index, 1);
    }
  }
  return cells;
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/csg/triangulation/predicates

```typescript
const SPLITTER = 134217729;

function product(a: number, b: number, result: number[] = [0, 0]): number[] {
  const x = a * b;
  const c = SPLITTER * a,
    abig = c - a,
    ahi = c - abig,
    alo = a - ahi;
  const d = SPLITTER * b,
    bbig = d - b,
    bhi = d - bbig,
    blo = b - bhi;
  const err1 = x - ahi * bhi,
    err2 = err1 - alo * bhi,
    err3 = err2 - ahi * blo;
  result[0] = alo * blo - err3;
  result[1] = x;
  return result;
}

function sum(e: number[], f: number[]): number[] {
  const ne = e.length,
    nf = f.length;
  if (ne === 1 && nf === 1) {
    const a = e[0],
      b = f[0],
      x = a + b,
      bv = x - a;
    const y = a - (x - bv) + (b - bv);
    return y ? [y, x] : [x];
  }
  const g: number[] = [];
  let count = 0,
    eptr = 0,
    fptr = 0;
  let ei = e[eptr],
    ea = Math.abs(ei),
    fi = f[fptr],
    fa = Math.abs(fi);
  let a: number, b: number;
  if (ea < fa) {
    b = ei;
    if (++eptr < ne) {
      ei = e[eptr];
      ea = Math.abs(ei);
    }
  } else {
    b = fi;
    if (++fptr < nf) {
      fi = f[fptr];
      fa = Math.abs(fi);
    }
  }
  if ((eptr < ne && ea < fa) || fptr >= nf) {
    a = ei;
    if (++eptr < ne) {
      ei = e[eptr];
      ea = Math.abs(ei);
    }
  } else {
    a = fi;
    if (++fptr < nf) {
      fi = f[fptr];
      fa = Math.abs(fi);
    }
  }
  let x = a + b,
    bv = x - a,
    q0 = b - bv,
    q1 = x;
  while (eptr < ne && fptr < nf) {
    if (ea < fa) {
      a = ei;
      if (++eptr < ne) {
        ei = e[eptr];
        ea = Math.abs(ei);
      }
    } else {
      a = fi;
      if (++fptr < nf) {
        fi = f[fptr];
        fa = Math.abs(fi);
      }
    }
    b = q0;
    x = a + b;
    bv = x - a;
    const y = b - bv;
    if (y) g[count++] = y;
    const next = q1 + x,
      nbv = next - q1;
    q0 = q1 - (next - nbv) + (x - nbv);
    q1 = next;
  }
  while (eptr < ne) {
    a = ei;
    b = q0;
    x = a + b;
    bv = x - a;
    const y = b - bv;
    if (y) g[count++] = y;
    const next = q1 + x,
      nbv = next - q1;
    q0 = q1 - (next - nbv) + (x - nbv);
    q1 = next;
    if (++eptr < ne) ei = e[eptr];
  }
  while (fptr < nf) {
    a = fi;
    b = q0;
    x = a + b;
    bv = x - a;
    const y = b - bv;
    if (y) g[count++] = y;
    const next = q1 + x,
      nbv = next - q1;
    q0 = q1 - (next - nbv) + (x - nbv);
    q1 = next;
    if (++fptr < nf) fi = f[fptr];
  }
  if (q0) g[count++] = q0;
  if (q1) g[count++] = q1;
  if (!count) g[count++] = 0;
  g.length = count;
  return g;
}

function diff(a: number[], b: number[]): number[] {
  return sum(
    a,
    b.map((value) => -value),
  );
}

function scale(e: number[], value: number): number[] {
  const n = e.length;
  if (n === 1) {
    const ts = product(e[0], value);
    return ts[0] ? ts : [ts[1]];
  }
  const g: number[] = [],
    q = [0, 0],
    t = [0, 0];
  let count = 0;
  product(e[0], value, q);
  if (q[0]) g[count++] = q[0];
  for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
    product(e[i], value, t);
    const pq = q[1],
      x = pq + t[0],
      bv = x - pq;
    q[0] = pq - (x - bv) + (t[0] - bv);
    q[1] = x;
    if (q[0]) g[count++] = q[0];
    const a = t[1],
      b = q[1],
      next = a + b,
      y = b - (next - a);
    q[1] = next;
    if (y) g[count++] = y;
  }
  if (q[1]) g[count++] = q[1];
  if (!count) g[count++] = 0;
  g.length = count;
  return g;
}

export function orient(a: number[], b: number[], c: number[]): number {
  const l = (a[1] - c[1]) * (b[0] - c[0]);
  const r = (a[0] - c[0]) * (b[1] - c[1]);
  const det = l - r;
  let s: number;
  if (l > 0) {
    if (r <= 0) return det;
    s = l + r;
  } else if (l < 0) {
    if (r >= 0) return det;
    s = -(l + r);
  } else return det;
  const tolerance = (3 + 16 * 1.1102230246251565e-16) * 1.1102230246251565e-16 * s;
  if (det >= tolerance || det <= -tolerance) return det;
  const p = sum(sum(product(b[1], c[0]), product(-c[1], b[0])), sum(product(a[1], b[0]), product(-b[1], a[0])));
  const n = sum(product(a[1], c[0]), product(-c[1], a[0]));
  const exact = diff(p, n);
  return exact[exact.length - 1];
}

export function inCircle(m0: number[], m1: number[], m2: number[], m3: number[]): number {
  const w0 = sum(product(m0[0], m0[0]), product(m0[1], m0[1]));
  const w1 = sum(product(m1[0], m1[0]), product(m1[1], m1[1]));
  const w2 = sum(product(m2[0], m2[0]), product(m2[1], m2[1]));
  const w3 = sum(product(m3[0], m3[0]), product(m3[1], m3[1]));
  const w0m1 = scale(w0, m1[0]),
    w0m2 = scale(w0, m2[0]),
    w0m3 = scale(w0, m3[0]);
  const w1m0 = scale(w1, m0[0]),
    w1m2 = scale(w1, m2[0]),
    w1m3 = scale(w1, m3[0]);
  const w2m0 = scale(w2, m0[0]),
    w2m1 = scale(w2, m1[0]),
    w2m3 = scale(w2, m3[0]);
  const w3m0 = scale(w3, m0[0]),
    w3m1 = scale(w3, m1[0]),
    w3m2 = scale(w3, m2[0]);
  const p = sum(
    sum(scale(diff(w3m2, w2m3), m1[1]), sum(scale(diff(w3m1, w1m3), -m2[1]), scale(diff(w2m1, w1m2), m3[1]))),
    sum(scale(diff(w3m1, w1m3), m0[1]), sum(scale(diff(w3m0, w0m3), -m1[1]), scale(diff(w1m0, w0m1), m3[1]))),
  );
  const n = sum(
    sum(scale(diff(w3m2, w2m3), m0[1]), sum(scale(diff(w3m0, w0m3), -m2[1]), scale(diff(w2m0, w0m2), m3[1]))),
    sum(scale(diff(w2m1, w1m2), m0[1]), sum(scale(diff(w2m0, w0m2), -m1[1]), scale(diff(w1m0, w0m1), m2[1]))),
  );
  const exact = diff(p, n);
  return exact[exact.length - 1];
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/csg/utils/TimeLogger

```typescript
function pad(str: string, len: number, char = " ") {
  let res = str;
  while (res.length < len) {
    res += char;
  }

  return res;
}

export const TimeLogger = new (class {
  _running: Record<string, number>;
  _timing: Record<string, number>;

  constructor() {
    this._running = {};
    this._timing = {};
  }

  start(key: string) {
    const { _running, _timing } = this;
    if (key in _running) {
      console.warn(`TimeLogger: already tracking key ${key}`);
      return;
    }

    if (!(key in _timing)) {
      _timing[key] = 0;
    }

    _running[key] = window.performance.now();
  }

  end(key: string) {
    const { _running, _timing } = this;
    if (!(key in _running)) {
      console.warn(`TimeLogger: not tracking key ${key}`);
      return;
    }

    const delta = window.performance.now() - _running[key];
    _timing[key] += delta;
    delete _running[key];
  }

  log() {
    const { _timing } = this;
    for (const key in _timing) {
      console.log(`${pad(key, 20)} : ${_timing[key].toFixed(3)}ms`);
    }

    this._timing = {};
  }
})();
```

## ek3d/addons/math/csg/utils/computeMeshVolume

```typescript
import { Vector3 } from "../../../../math/Vector3";
import { Triangle } from "../../../../math/Triangle";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { BufferAttribute } from "../../../../core/BufferAttribute";
import type { InterleavedBufferAttribute } from "../../../../core/InterleavedBufferAttribute";
import type { Matrix4 } from "../../../../math/Matrix4";
import type { Mesh } from "../../../../objects/Mesh";
import { getTriCount } from "../core/utils/geometryUtils";

// https://stackoverflow.com/questions/1406029/how-to-calculate-the-volume-of-a-3d-mesh-object-the-surface-of-which-is-made-up
const _tri = new Triangle();
const _normal = new Vector3();
const _relPoint = new Vector3();
export function computeMeshVolume(mesh: Mesh | BufferGeometry) {
  // grab the matrix and the geometry
  let geometry;
  let matrix;
  if (mesh instanceof BufferGeometry) {
    geometry = mesh;
    matrix = null;
  } else {
    geometry = mesh.geometry;
    matrix = Math.abs(mesh.matrixWorld.determinant() - 1.0) < 1e-15 ? null : mesh.matrixWorld;
  }

  // determine the number of relevant draw range elements to use
  const index = geometry.index;
  const pos = geometry.attributes.position as BufferAttribute | InterleavedBufferAttribute;
  const drawRange = geometry.drawRange;
  const triCount = Math.min(getTriCount(geometry), drawRange.count / 3);

  // get a point relative to the position of the geometry to avoid floating point error
  _tri.setFromAttributeAndIndices(pos, 0, 1, 2);
  applyMatrix4ToTri(_tri, matrix);
  _tri.getNormal(_normal);
  _tri.getMidpoint(_relPoint).add(_normal);

  // iterate over all triangles
  let volume = 0;
  const startIndex = drawRange.start / 3;
  for (let i = startIndex, l = startIndex + triCount; i < l; i++) {
    let i0 = 3 * i + 0;
    let i1 = 3 * i + 1;
    let i2 = 3 * i + 2;
    if (index) {
      i0 = index.getX(i0);
      i1 = index.getX(i1);
      i2 = index.getX(i2);
    }

    // get the triangle
    _tri.setFromAttributeAndIndices(pos, i0, i1, i2);
    applyMatrix4ToTri(_tri, matrix);
    subVectorFromTri(_tri, _relPoint);

    // add the signed volume
    volume += signedVolumeOfTriangle(_tri.a, _tri.b, _tri.c);
  }

  return Math.abs(volume);
}

function signedVolumeOfTriangle(p1: Vector3, p2: Vector3, p3: Vector3) {
  const v321 = p3.x * p2.y * p1.z;
  const v231 = p2.x * p3.y * p1.z;
  const v312 = p3.x * p1.y * p2.z;
  const v132 = p1.x * p3.y * p2.z;
  const v213 = p2.x * p1.y * p3.z;
  const v123 = p1.x * p2.y * p3.z;
  return (1 / 6) * (-v321 + v231 + v312 - v132 - v213 + v123);
}

function subVectorFromTri(tri: Triangle, pos: Vector3) {
  tri.a.sub(pos);
  tri.b.sub(pos);
  tri.c.sub(pos);
}

function applyMatrix4ToTri(tri: Triangle, mat: Matrix4 | null = null) {
  if (mat !== null) {
    tri.a.applyMatrix4(mat);
    tri.b.applyMatrix4(mat);
    tri.c.applyMatrix4(mat);
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/math/csg/utils/isWaterTight

```typescript
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { Mesh } from "../../../../objects/Mesh";
import { HalfEdgeMap } from "../core/HalfEdgeMap";

export function isWaterTight(input: BufferGeometry | Mesh) {
  const geometry = input instanceof BufferGeometry ? input : input.geometry;

  const halfEdgeMap = new HalfEdgeMap();
  halfEdgeMap.matchDisjointEdges = true;
  halfEdgeMap.updateFrom(geometry);
  return halfEdgeMap.unmatchedEdges === 0;
}
```

## ek3d/addons/misc/ConvexObjectBreaker

```typescript
import type { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import type { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import type { Matrix4 } from "../../math/Matrix4";
import { Line3 } from "../../math/Line3";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import { Plane } from "../../math/Plane";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import { ConvexGeometry } from "../geometries/ConvexGeometry";

export interface ConvexObjectBreakerOutput {
  object1: Mesh | null;
  object2: Mesh | null;
  segmentedObject1?: Mesh | null;
  segmentedObject2?: Mesh | null;
}

const _v1 = new Vector3();

/**
 * This class can be used to subdivide a convex Geometry object into pieces.
 *
 * Use the function prepareBreakableObject to prepare a Mesh object to be broken.
 * Then, call the various functions to subdivide the object (subdivideByImpact, cutByPlane).
 * Sub-objects that are product of subdivision don't need prepareBreakableObject to be called on them.
 *
 * Requisites for the object:
 * - Mesh object must have a buffer geometry and a material.
 * - Vertex normals must be planar (not smoothed).
 * - The geometry must be convex (this is not checked in the library). You can create convex
 * geometries with {@link ConvexGeometry}. The {@link BoxGeometry}, {@link SphereGeometry} and other
 * convex primitives can also be used.
 *
 * Note: This lib adds member variables to object's userData member (see prepareBreakableObject function)
 * Use with caution and read the code when using with other libs.
 *
 */
export class ConvexObjectBreaker {
  minSizeForBreak: number;
  smallDelta: number;
  tempLine1: Line3;
  tempPlane1: Plane;
  tempPlane2: Plane;
  tempPlane_Cut: Plane;
  tempCM1: Vector3;
  tempCM2: Vector3;
  tempVector3: Vector3;
  tempVector3_2: Vector3;
  tempVector3_3: Vector3;
  tempVector3_P0: Vector3;
  tempVector3_P1: Vector3;
  tempVector3_P2: Vector3;
  tempVector3_N0: Vector3;
  tempVector3_N1: Vector3;
  tempVector3_AB: Vector3;
  tempVector3_CB: Vector3;
  tempResultObjects: ConvexObjectBreakerOutput;
  segments: boolean[];

  /**
   * Constructs a new convex object breaker.
   *
   * @param [minSizeForBreak=1.4] - Min size a debris can have to break.
   * @param [smallDelta=0.0001] - Max distance to consider that a point belongs to a plane.
   */
  constructor(minSizeForBreak: number = 1.4, smallDelta: number = 0.0001) {
    this.minSizeForBreak = minSizeForBreak;
    this.smallDelta = smallDelta;

    this.tempLine1 = new Line3();
    this.tempPlane1 = new Plane();
    this.tempPlane2 = new Plane();
    this.tempPlane_Cut = new Plane();
    this.tempCM1 = new Vector3();
    this.tempCM2 = new Vector3();
    this.tempVector3 = new Vector3();
    this.tempVector3_2 = new Vector3();
    this.tempVector3_3 = new Vector3();
    this.tempVector3_P0 = new Vector3();
    this.tempVector3_P1 = new Vector3();
    this.tempVector3_P2 = new Vector3();
    this.tempVector3_N0 = new Vector3();
    this.tempVector3_N1 = new Vector3();
    this.tempVector3_AB = new Vector3();
    this.tempVector3_CB = new Vector3();
    this.tempResultObjects = { object1: null, object2: null };

    this.segments = [];
    const n = 30 * 30;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) this.segments[i] = false;
  }

  /**
   * Must be called for all 3D objects that should be breakable.
   *
   * @param object - The 3D object. It must have a convex geometry.
   * @param mass - The 3D object's mass in kg. Must be greater than `0`.
   * @param velocity - The 3D object's velocity.
   * @param angularVelocity - The 3D object's angular velocity.
   * @param breakable - Whether the 3D object is breakable or not.
   */
  prepareBreakableObject(
    object: Object3D,
    mass: number,
    velocity: Vector3,
    angularVelocity: Vector3,
    breakable: boolean,
  ): void {
    // object is a Object3d (normally a Mesh), must have a buffer geometry, and it must be convex.
    // Its material property is propagated to its children (sub-pieces)
    // mass must be > 0

    const userData = object.userData;
    userData.mass = mass;
    userData.velocity = velocity.clone();
    userData.angularVelocity = angularVelocity.clone();
    userData.breakable = breakable;
  }

  /**
   * Subdivides the given 3D object into pieces by an impact (meaning another object hits
   * the given 3D object at a certain surface point).
   *
   * @param object - The 3D object to subdivide.
   * @param pointOfImpact - The point of impact.
   * @param normal - The impact normal.
   * @param maxRadialIterations - Iterations for radial cuts.
   * @param maxRandomIterations - Max random iterations for not-radial cuts.
   * @return The array of pieces.
   */
  subdivideByImpact(
    object: Mesh,
    pointOfImpact: Vector3,
    normal: Vector3,
    maxRadialIterations: number,
    maxRandomIterations: number,
  ): Mesh[] {
    const debris: Mesh[] = [];

    const tempPlane1 = this.tempPlane1;
    const tempPlane2 = this.tempPlane2;

    this.tempVector3.addVectors(pointOfImpact, normal);
    tempPlane1.setFromCoplanarPoints(pointOfImpact, object.position, this.tempVector3);

    const maxTotalIterations = maxRandomIterations + maxRadialIterations;

    const subdivideRadial = (subObject: Mesh, startAngle: number, endAngle: number, numIterations: number): void => {
      if (Math.random() < numIterations * 0.05 || numIterations > maxTotalIterations) {
        debris.push(subObject);

        return;
      }

      let angle = Math.PI;

      if (numIterations === 0) {
        tempPlane2.normal.copy(tempPlane1.normal);
        tempPlane2.constant = tempPlane1.constant;
      } else {
        if (numIterations <= maxRadialIterations) {
          angle = (endAngle - startAngle) * (0.2 + 0.6 * Math.random()) + startAngle;

          // Rotate tempPlane2 at impact point around normal axis and the angle
          this.tempVector3_2.copy(object.position).sub(pointOfImpact).applyAxisAngle(normal, angle).add(pointOfImpact);
          tempPlane2.setFromCoplanarPoints(pointOfImpact, this.tempVector3, this.tempVector3_2);
        } else {
          angle = (0.5 * (numIterations & 1) + 0.2 * (2 - Math.random())) * Math.PI;

          // Rotate tempPlane2 at object position around normal axis and the angle
          this.tempVector3_2
            .copy(pointOfImpact)
            .sub(subObject.position)
            .applyAxisAngle(normal, angle)
            .add(subObject.position);
          this.tempVector3_3.copy(normal).add(subObject.position);
          tempPlane2.setFromCoplanarPoints(subObject.position, this.tempVector3_3, this.tempVector3_2);
        }
      }

      // Perform the cut
      this.cutByPlane(subObject, tempPlane2, this.tempResultObjects);

      const obj1 = this.tempResultObjects.object1;
      const obj2 = this.tempResultObjects.object2;

      if (obj1) {
        subdivideRadial(obj1, startAngle, angle, numIterations + 1);
      }

      if (obj2) {
        subdivideRadial(obj2, angle, endAngle, numIterations + 1);
      }
    };

    subdivideRadial(object, 0, 2 * Math.PI, 0);

    return debris;
  }

  /**
   * Subdivides the given 3D object into pieces by a plane.
   *
   * @param object - The 3D object to subdivide.
   * @param plane - The plane to cut the 3D object.
   * @param output - An object that stores the pieces.
   * @return The number of pieces.
   */
  cutByPlane(object: Mesh, plane: Plane, output: ConvexObjectBreakerOutput): number {
    // Returns breakable objects in output.object1 and output.object2 members, the resulting 2 pieces of the cut.
    // object2 can be null if the plane doesn't cut the object.
    // object1 can be null only in case of internal error
    // Returned value is number of pieces, 0 for error.

    const geometry = object.geometry;
    const coords = (geometry.attributes.position as BufferAttribute).array;
    const normals = (geometry.attributes.normal as BufferAttribute).array;

    const numPoints = coords.length / 3;
    let numFaces = numPoints / 3;

    const indices = geometry.getIndex()?.array;

    if (indices) {
      numFaces = indices.length / 3;
    }

    function getVertexIndex(faceIdx: number, vert: number): number {
      // vert = 0, 1 or 2.

      const idx = faceIdx * 3 + vert;

      return indices ? indices[idx] : idx;
    }

    const points1: Vector3[] = [];
    const points2: Vector3[] = [];

    const delta = this.smallDelta;

    // Reset segments mark
    const numPointPairs = numPoints * numPoints;
    for (let i = 0; i < numPointPairs; i++) this.segments[i] = false;

    const p0 = this.tempVector3_P0;
    const p1 = this.tempVector3_P1;
    const n0 = this.tempVector3_N0;
    const n1 = this.tempVector3_N1;

    // Iterate through the faces to mark edges shared by coplanar faces
    for (let i = 0; i < numFaces - 1; i++) {
      const a1 = getVertexIndex(i, 0);
      const b1 = getVertexIndex(i, 1);
      const c1 = getVertexIndex(i, 2);

      // Assuming all 3 vertices have the same normal
      n0.set(normals[a1], normals[a1] + 1, normals[a1] + 2);

      for (let j = i + 1; j < numFaces; j++) {
        const a2 = getVertexIndex(j, 0);
        const b2 = getVertexIndex(j, 1);
        const c2 = getVertexIndex(j, 2);

        // Assuming all 3 vertices have the same normal
        n1.set(normals[a2], normals[a2] + 1, normals[a2] + 2);

        const coplanar = 1 - n0.dot(n1) < delta;

        if (coplanar) {
          if (a1 === a2 || a1 === b2 || a1 === c2) {
            if (b1 === a2 || b1 === b2 || b1 === c2) {
              this.segments[a1 * numPoints + b1] = true;
              this.segments[b1 * numPoints + a1] = true;
            } else {
              this.segments[c1 * numPoints + a1] = true;
              this.segments[a1 * numPoints + c1] = true;
            }
          } else if (b1 === a2 || b1 === b2 || b1 === c2) {
            this.segments[c1 * numPoints + b1] = true;
            this.segments[b1 * numPoints + c1] = true;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Transform the plane to object local space
    const localPlane = this.tempPlane_Cut;
    object.updateMatrix();
    ConvexObjectBreaker.transformPlaneToLocalSpace(plane, object.matrix, localPlane);

    // Iterate through the faces adding points to both pieces
    for (let i = 0; i < numFaces; i++) {
      const va = getVertexIndex(i, 0);
      const vb = getVertexIndex(i, 1);
      const vc = getVertexIndex(i, 2);

      for (let segment = 0; segment < 3; segment++) {
        const i0 = segment === 0 ? va : segment === 1 ? vb : vc;
        const i1 = segment === 0 ? vb : segment === 1 ? vc : va;

        const segmentState = this.segments[i0 * numPoints + i1];

        if (segmentState) continue; // The segment already has been processed in another face

        // Mark segment as processed (also inverted segment)
        this.segments[i0 * numPoints + i1] = true;
        this.segments[i1 * numPoints + i0] = true;

        p0.set(coords[3 * i0], coords[3 * i0 + 1], coords[3 * i0 + 2]);
        p1.set(coords[3 * i1], coords[3 * i1 + 1], coords[3 * i1 + 2]);

        // mark: 1 for negative side, 2 for positive side, 3 for coplanar point
        let mark0 = 0;

        let d = localPlane.distanceToPoint(p0);

        if (d > delta) {
          mark0 = 2;
          points2.push(p0.clone());
        } else if (d < -delta) {
          mark0 = 1;
          points1.push(p0.clone());
        } else {
          mark0 = 3;
          points1.push(p0.clone());
          points2.push(p0.clone());
        }

        // mark: 1 for negative side, 2 for positive side, 3 for coplanar point
        let mark1 = 0;

        d = localPlane.distanceToPoint(p1);

        if (d > delta) {
          mark1 = 2;
          points2.push(p1.clone());
        } else if (d < -delta) {
          mark1 = 1;
          points1.push(p1.clone());
        } else {
          mark1 = 3;
          points1.push(p1.clone());
          points2.push(p1.clone());
        }

        if ((mark0 === 1 && mark1 === 2) || (mark0 === 2 && mark1 === 1)) {
          // Intersection of segment with the plane

          this.tempLine1.start.copy(p0);
          this.tempLine1.end.copy(p1);

          const intersection = localPlane.intersectLine(this.tempLine1, new Vector3());

          if (intersection === null) {
            // Shouldn't happen
            console.error("Internal error: segment does not intersect plane.");
            output.segmentedObject1 = null;
            output.segmentedObject2 = null;
            return 0;
          }

          points1.push(intersection);
          points2.push(intersection.clone());
        }
      }
    }

    // Calculate debris mass (very fast and imprecise):
    const newMass = object.userData.mass * 0.5;

    // Calculate debris Center of Mass (again fast and imprecise)
    this.tempCM1.set(0, 0, 0);
    let radius1 = 0;
    const numPoints1 = points1.length;

    if (numPoints1 > 0) {
      for (let i = 0; i < numPoints1; i++) this.tempCM1.add(points1[i]);

      this.tempCM1.divideScalar(numPoints1);
      for (let i = 0; i < numPoints1; i++) {
        const p = points1[i];
        p.sub(this.tempCM1);
        radius1 = Math.max(radius1, p.x, p.y, p.z);
      }

      this.tempCM1.add(object.position);
    }

    this.tempCM2.set(0, 0, 0);
    let radius2 = 0;
    const numPoints2 = points2.length;
    if (numPoints2 > 0) {
      for (let i = 0; i < numPoints2; i++) this.tempCM2.add(points2[i]);

      this.tempCM2.divideScalar(numPoints2);
      for (let i = 0; i < numPoints2; i++) {
        const p = points2[i];
        p.sub(this.tempCM2);
        radius2 = Math.max(radius2, p.x, p.y, p.z);
      }

      this.tempCM2.add(object.position);
    }

    let object1 = null;
    let object2 = null;

    let numObjects = 0;

    if (numPoints1 > 4) {
      object1 = new Mesh(new ConvexGeometry(points1), object.material);
      object1.position.copy(this.tempCM1);
      object1.quaternion.copy(object.quaternion);

      this.prepareBreakableObject(
        object1,
        newMass,
        object.userData.velocity,
        object.userData.angularVelocity,
        2 * radius1 > this.minSizeForBreak,
      );

      numObjects++;
    }

    if (numPoints2 > 4) {
      object2 = new Mesh(new ConvexGeometry(points2), object.material);
      object2.position.copy(this.tempCM2);
      object2.quaternion.copy(object.quaternion);

      this.prepareBreakableObject(
        object2,
        newMass,
        object.userData.velocity,
        object.userData.angularVelocity,
        2 * radius2 > this.minSizeForBreak,
      );

      numObjects++;
    }

    output.object1 = object1;
    output.object2 = object2;

    return numObjects;
  }

  // internal helpers

  static transformFreeVector(v: Vector3, m: Matrix4): Vector3 {
    // input:
    // vector interpreted as a free vector
    // THREE.Matrix4 orthogonal matrix (matrix without scale)

    const x = v.x,
      y = v.y,
      z = v.z;
    const e = m.elements;

    v.x = e[0] * x + e[4] * y + e[8] * z;
    v.y = e[1] * x + e[5] * y + e[9] * z;
    v.z = e[2] * x + e[6] * y + e[10] * z;

    return v;
  }

  static transformFreeVectorInverse(v: Vector3, m: Matrix4): Vector3 {
    // input:
    // vector interpreted as a free vector
    // THREE.Matrix4 orthogonal matrix (matrix without scale)

    const x = v.x,
      y = v.y,
      z = v.z;
    const e = m.elements;

    v.x = e[0] * x + e[1] * y + e[2] * z;
    v.y = e[4] * x + e[5] * y + e[6] * z;
    v.z = e[8] * x + e[9] * y + e[10] * z;

    return v;
  }

  static transformTiedVectorInverse(v: Vector3, m: Matrix4): Vector3 {
    // input:
    // vector interpreted as a tied (ordinary) vector
    // THREE.Matrix4 orthogonal matrix (matrix without scale)

    const x = v.x,
      y = v.y,
      z = v.z;
    const e = m.elements;

    v.x = e[0] * x + e[1] * y + e[2] * z - e[12];
    v.y = e[4] * x + e[5] * y + e[6] * z - e[13];
    v.z = e[8] * x + e[9] * y + e[10] * z - e[14];

    return v;
  }

  static transformPlaneToLocalSpace(plane: Plane, m: Matrix4, resultPlane: Plane): void {
    resultPlane.normal.copy(plane.normal);
    resultPlane.constant = plane.constant;

    const referencePoint = ConvexObjectBreaker.transformTiedVectorInverse(plane.coplanarPoint(_v1), m);

    ConvexObjectBreaker.transformFreeVectorInverse(resultPlane.normal, m);

    // recalculate constant (like in setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint)
    resultPlane.constant = -referencePoint.dot(resultPlane.normal);
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/misc/GPUComputationRenderer

```typescript
import { Wrapping, TextureType, TextureFilter, PixelFormat } from "../../constants";
import { DataTexture } from "../../textures/DataTexture";
import type { Texture } from "../../textures/Texture";
import { ShaderMaterial } from "../../materials/ShaderMaterial";
import type { Material } from "../../materials/Material";
import { WebGLRenderTarget } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";
import { FullScreenQuad } from "../postprocessing/Pass";

export interface GPUComputationVariable {
  name: string;
  initialValueTexture: Texture;
  material: ShaderMaterial;
  dependencies: GPUComputationVariable[] | null;
  renderTargets: WebGLRenderTarget[];
  wrapS: Wrapping | null;
  wrapT: Wrapping | null;
  minFilter: TextureFilter;
  magFilter: TextureFilter;
}

/** Computes variables in float textures using ping-pong render targets. */
export class GPUComputationRenderer {
  variables: GPUComputationVariable[];
  currentTextureIndex: number;
  private sizeX: number;
  private sizeY: number;
  private renderer: WebGLRenderer;
  private dataType: TextureType;
  private passThruUniforms: { passThruTexture: { value: Texture | null } };
  private passThruShader: ShaderMaterial;
  private quad: FullScreenQuad;

  constructor(sizeX: number, sizeY: number, renderer: WebGLRenderer) {
    this.sizeX = sizeX;
    this.sizeY = sizeY;
    this.renderer = renderer;
    this.variables = [];
    this.currentTextureIndex = 0;
    this.dataType = TextureType.Float;
    this.passThruUniforms = { passThruTexture: { value: null } };
    this.passThruShader = this.createShaderMaterial(
      `
uniform sampler2D passThruTexture;
void main() {
  vec2 uv = gl_FragCoord.xy / resolution.xy;
  gl_FragColor = texture2D( passThruTexture, uv );
}`,
      this.passThruUniforms,
    );
    this.quad = new FullScreenQuad(this.passThruShader);
  }

  setDataType(type: TextureType): this {
    this.dataType = type;
    return this;
  }

  addVariable(name: string, computeFragmentShader: string, initialValueTexture: Texture): GPUComputationVariable {
    const variable: GPUComputationVariable = {
      name,
      initialValueTexture,
      material: this.createShaderMaterial(computeFragmentShader),
      dependencies: null,
      renderTargets: [],
      wrapS: null,
      wrapT: null,
      minFilter: TextureFilter.Nearest,
      magFilter: TextureFilter.Nearest,
    };
    this.variables.push(variable);
    return variable;
  }

  setVariableDependencies(variable: GPUComputationVariable, dependencies: GPUComputationVariable[]): void {
    variable.dependencies = dependencies;
  }

  init(): string | null {
    if (this.renderer.capabilities.maxVertexTextures === 0) return "No support for vertex shader textures.";
    for (const variable of this.variables) {
      variable.renderTargets[0] = this.createRenderTarget(
        this.sizeX,
        this.sizeY,
        variable.wrapS,
        variable.wrapT,
        variable.minFilter,
        variable.magFilter,
      );
      variable.renderTargets[1] = this.createRenderTarget(
        this.sizeX,
        this.sizeY,
        variable.wrapS,
        variable.wrapT,
        variable.minFilter,
        variable.magFilter,
      );
      this.renderTexture(variable.initialValueTexture, variable.renderTargets[0]);
      this.renderTexture(variable.initialValueTexture, variable.renderTargets[1]);
      if (variable.dependencies !== null) {
        for (const dependency of variable.dependencies) {
          if (
            dependency.name !== variable.name &&
            !this.variables.some((candidate) => candidate.name === dependency.name)
          ) {
            return `Variable dependency not found. Variable=${variable.name}, dependency=${dependency.name}`;
          }
          variable.material.uniforms[dependency.name] = { value: null };
          variable.material.fragmentShader =
            `\nuniform sampler2D ${dependency.name};\n` + variable.material.fragmentShader;
        }
      }
    }
    this.currentTextureIndex = 0;
    return null;
  }

  compute(): void {
    const current = this.currentTextureIndex;
    const next = current === 0 ? 1 : 0;
    for (const variable of this.variables) {
      if (variable.dependencies !== null) {
        for (const dependency of variable.dependencies) {
          variable.material.uniforms[dependency.name].value = dependency.renderTargets[current].texture;
        }
      }
      this.doRenderTarget(variable.material, variable.renderTargets[next]);
    }
    this.currentTextureIndex = next;
  }

  getCurrentRenderTarget(variable: GPUComputationVariable): WebGLRenderTarget {
    return variable.renderTargets[this.currentTextureIndex];
  }

  getAlternateRenderTarget(variable: GPUComputationVariable): WebGLRenderTarget {
    return variable.renderTargets[this.currentTextureIndex === 0 ? 1 : 0];
  }

  dispose(): void {
    this.quad.dispose();
    this.passThruShader.dispose();
    for (const variable of this.variables) {
      variable.initialValueTexture.dispose();
      for (const target of variable.renderTargets) target.dispose();
      variable.material.dispose();
    }
  }

  addResolutionDefine(material: ShaderMaterial): void {
    material.defines.resolution = `vec2( ${this.sizeX.toFixed(1)}, ${this.sizeY.toFixed(1)} )`;
  }

  createShaderMaterial(fragmentShader: string, uniforms: Record<string, { value: unknown }> = {}): ShaderMaterial {
    const material = new ShaderMaterial({
      name: "GPUComputationShader",
      uniforms,
      vertexShader: "void main() { gl_Position = vec4( position, 1.0 ); }",
      fragmentShader,
    });
    this.addResolutionDefine(material);
    return material;
  }

  createRenderTarget(
    width: number = this.sizeX,
    height: number = this.sizeY,
    wrapS: Wrapping | null = Wrapping.ClampToEdge,
    wrapT: Wrapping | null = Wrapping.ClampToEdge,
    minFilter: TextureFilter = TextureFilter.Nearest,
    magFilter: TextureFilter = TextureFilter.Nearest,
  ): WebGLRenderTarget {
    return new WebGLRenderTarget(width || this.sizeX, height || this.sizeY, {
      wrapS: wrapS || Wrapping.ClampToEdge,
      wrapT: wrapT || Wrapping.ClampToEdge,
      minFilter: minFilter || TextureFilter.Nearest,
      magFilter: magFilter || TextureFilter.Nearest,
      format: PixelFormat.RGBA,
      type: this.dataType,
      depthBuffer: false,
    });
  }

  createTexture(): DataTexture {
    const texture = new DataTexture(
      new Float32Array(this.sizeX * this.sizeY * 4),
      this.sizeX,
      this.sizeY,
      PixelFormat.RGBA,
      TextureType.Float,
    );
    texture.needsUpdate = true;
    return texture;
  }

  renderTexture(input: Texture, output: WebGLRenderTarget): void {
    this.passThruUniforms.passThruTexture.value = input;
    try {
      this.doRenderTarget(this.passThruShader, output);
    } finally {
      this.passThruUniforms.passThruTexture.value = null;
    }
  }

  doRenderTarget(material: Material, output: WebGLRenderTarget): void {
    const renderer = this.renderer;
    const currentTarget = renderer.getRenderTarget();
    const shadowMap = renderer.shadowMap;
    const shadowAutoUpdate = shadowMap?.autoUpdate;
    if (shadowMap) shadowMap.autoUpdate = false;
    this.quad.material = material;
    try {
      renderer.setRenderTarget(output);
      this.quad.render(renderer);
    } finally {
      this.quad.material = this.passThruShader;
      if (shadowMap && shadowAutoUpdate !== undefined) shadowMap.autoUpdate = shadowAutoUpdate;
      renderer.setRenderTarget(currentTarget);
    }
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/misc/Gyroscope

```typescript
import { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import { Quaternion } from "../../math/Quaternion";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";

const translationObject = new Vector3();
const quaternionObject = new Quaternion();
const scaleObject = new Vector3();
const translationWorld = new Vector3();
const quaternionWorld = new Quaternion();
const scaleWorld = new Vector3();

/** Inherits position and scale from its parent while retaining local world orientation. */
export class Gyroscope extends Object3D {
  override updateMatrixWorld(force?: boolean): void {
    if (this.matrixAutoUpdate) this.updateMatrix();
    if (this.matrixWorldNeedsUpdate || force) {
      if (this.parent !== null) {
        this.matrixWorld.multiplyMatrices(this.parent.matrixWorld, this.matrix);
        this.matrixWorld.decompose(translationWorld, quaternionWorld, scaleWorld);
        this.matrix.decompose(translationObject, quaternionObject, scaleObject);
        this.matrixWorld.compose(translationWorld, quaternionObject, scaleWorld);
      } else {
        this.matrixWorld.copy(this.matrix);
      }
      this.matrixWorldNeedsUpdate = false;
      force = true;
    }
    for (const child of this.children) child.updateMatrixWorld(force);
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/misc/MD2Character

```typescript
import { MD2Loader, type MD2Geometry } from "../loaders/MD2Loader";
import type { AnimationAction } from "../../animation/AnimationAction";
import { AnimationMixer } from "../../animation/AnimationMixer";
import { ColorSpace, Mapping } from "../../constants";
import type { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import { TextureLoader } from "../../loaders/TextureLoader";
import { MeshLambertMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshLambertMaterial";
import { Box3 } from "../../math/Box3";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import type { Texture } from "../../textures/Texture";

export interface MD2CharacterConfig {
  baseUrl: string;
  body: string;
  skins: string[];
  weapons: [string, string][];
}

export type MD2CharacterMesh = Mesh<MeshLambertMaterial> & {
  geometry: MD2Geometry;
  materialTexture: MeshLambertMaterial;
  materialWireframe: MeshLambertMaterial;
  activeAction: AnimationAction | null;
  clipOffset: number;
};

function createPart(geometry: MD2Geometry, skin: Texture | undefined): MD2CharacterMesh {
  const materialTexture = new MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, wireframe: false, map: skin });
  const mesh = Object.assign(new Mesh(geometry, materialTexture), {
    materialTexture,
    materialWireframe: new MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xffaa00, wireframe: true }),
    activeAction: null as AnimationAction | null,
    clipOffset: 0,
  }) as MD2CharacterMesh;
  mesh.rotation.y = -Math.PI / 2;
  mesh.castShadow = true;
  mesh.receiveShadow = true;
  return mesh;
}

/** Manages a body, skins, weapons and their synchronized MD2 animations. */
export class MD2Character {
  scale: number = 1;
  animationFPS: number = 6;
  root: Object3D = new Object3D();
  meshBody: MD2CharacterMesh | null = null;
  meshWeapon: MD2CharacterMesh | null = null;
  skinsBody: Texture[] = [];
  skinsWeapon: Texture[] = [];
  weapons: MD2CharacterMesh[] = [];
  activeAnimationClipName: string | null = null;
  activeClipName: string | null = null;
  mixer: AnimationMixer | null = null;
  onLoadComplete: () => void = () => {};
  onError: (error: unknown) => void = () => {};
  loadCounter: number = 0;
  private generation: number = 0;
  private disposed: boolean = false;

  loadParts(config: MD2CharacterConfig): void {
    this.dispose();
    this.disposed = false;
    const generation = this.generation;
    let failed = false;
    const current = (): boolean => !this.disposed && this.generation === generation;
    const complete = (): void => {
      if (!current() || failed) return;
      if (--this.loadCounter === 0) this.onLoadComplete();
    };
    const error = (reason: unknown): void => {
      if (!current() || failed) return;
      failed = true;
      this.onError(reason);
    };
    this.loadCounter = config.weapons.length * 2 + config.skins.length + 1;
    const textureLoader = new TextureLoader();
    const loadTextures = (names: string[]): Texture[] =>
      names.map((name) => {
        const texture = textureLoader.load(config.baseUrl + "skins/" + name, complete, undefined, error);
        texture.mapping = Mapping.UV;
        texture.name = name;
        texture.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB;
        return texture;
      });
    this.skinsBody = loadTextures(config.skins);
    this.skinsWeapon = loadTextures(config.weapons.map((weapon) => weapon[1]));
    const loader = new MD2Loader();
    loader.load(
      config.baseUrl + config.body,
      (geometry) => {
        if (!current() || failed) {
          geometry.dispose();
          return;
        }
        const bounds = new Box3().setFromBufferAttribute(geometry.attributes.position as BufferAttribute);
        this.root.position.y = -this.scale * bounds.min.y;
        const mesh = createPart(geometry, this.skinsBody[0]);
        mesh.scale.setScalar(this.scale);
        this.root.add(mesh);
        this.meshBody = mesh;
        this.activeAnimationClipName = geometry.animations[0]?.name ?? null;
        this.mixer = new AnimationMixer(mesh);
        complete();
      },
      undefined,
      error,
    );
    config.weapons.forEach(([name], index) => {
      loader.load(
        config.baseUrl + name,
        (geometry) => {
          if (!current() || failed) {
            geometry.dispose();
            return;
          }
          const mesh = createPart(geometry, this.skinsWeapon[index]);
          mesh.scale.setScalar(this.scale);
          mesh.visible = false;
          mesh.name = name;
          this.root.add(mesh);
          this.weapons[index] = mesh;
          this.meshWeapon = mesh;
          complete();
        },
        undefined,
        error,
      );
    });
  }

  setPlaybackRate(rate: number): void {
    if (this.mixer) this.mixer.timeScale = rate !== 0 ? 1 / rate : 0;
  }

  setWireframe(enabled: boolean): void {
    if (this.meshBody)
      this.meshBody.material = enabled ? this.meshBody.materialWireframe : this.meshBody.materialTexture;
    if (this.meshWeapon)
      this.meshWeapon.material = enabled ? this.meshWeapon.materialWireframe : this.meshWeapon.materialTexture;
  }

  setSkin(index: number): void {
    if (this.meshBody && !this.meshBody.material.wireframe) this.meshBody.material.map = this.skinsBody[index];
  }

  setWeapon(index: number): void {
    for (const weapon of this.weapons) if (weapon) weapon.visible = false;
    const weapon = this.weapons[index];
    if (weapon) {
      weapon.visible = true;
      this.meshWeapon = weapon;
      this.syncWeaponAnimation();
    }
  }

  setAnimation(clipName: string): void {
    if (this.meshBody && this.mixer) {
      this.meshBody.activeAction?.stop();
      this.meshBody.activeAction = this.mixer.clipAction(clipName, this.meshBody)?.play() ?? null;
    }
    this.activeClipName = clipName;
    this.syncWeaponAnimation();
  }

  syncWeaponAnimation(): void {
    if (!this.meshWeapon || !this.mixer || !this.activeClipName) return;
    this.meshWeapon.activeAction?.stop();
    const action = this.mixer.clipAction(this.activeClipName, this.meshWeapon);
    this.meshWeapon.activeAction =
      action && this.meshBody?.activeAction ? action.syncWith(this.meshBody.activeAction).play() : null;
  }

  update(delta: number): void {
    this.mixer?.update(delta);
  }

  dispose(): void {
    if (this.disposed) return;
    this.disposed = true;
    this.generation++;
    this.mixer?.stopAllAction();
    const parts = [this.meshBody, ...this.weapons];
    for (const part of parts) {
      if (!part) continue;
      this.mixer?.uncacheRoot(part);
      this.root.remove(part);
      part.geometry.dispose();
      part.materialTexture.dispose();
      part.materialWireframe.dispose();
    }
    for (const texture of [...this.skinsBody, ...this.skinsWeapon]) texture.dispose();
    this.meshBody = null;
    this.meshWeapon = null;
    this.mixer = null;
    this.weapons = [];
    this.skinsBody = [];
    this.skinsWeapon = [];
    this.activeClipName = null;
    this.activeAnimationClipName = null;
    this.loadCounter = 0;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/misc/MD2CharacterComplex

```typescript
import { ColorSpace, Mapping } from "../../constants";
import type { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import type { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";

import { Box3 } from "../../math/Box3";
import { clamp } from "../../math/MathUtils";
import type { Texture } from "../../textures/Texture";
import { MD2Loader } from "../loaders/MD2Loader";
import { MorphBlendMesh } from "./MorphBlendMesh";

export interface MD2CharacterControls {
  moveForward: boolean;
  moveBackward: boolean;
  moveLeft: boolean;
  moveRight: boolean;
  crouch?: boolean;
  jump?: boolean;
  attack?: boolean;
}
export interface MD2CharacterAnimations {
  [name: string]: string | undefined;
  move?: string;
  idle?: string;
  jump?: string;
  attack?: string;
  crouchMove?: string;
  crouchIdle?: string;

}
export interface MD2CharacterComplexConfig {

  body: string;
  skins: string[];

export class MD2CharacterComplexPart extends MorphBlendMesh<MeshLambertMaterial> {
  materialTexture: MeshLambertMaterial;
  materialWireframe: MeshLambertMaterial;
  duration: number | undefined;

    const materialTexture = new MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, wireframe: false, map: skinMap ?? null });
```
