```typescript
}

export class MD2CharacterComplex {
  scale: number = 1;
  animationFPS: number = 6;
  transitionFrames: number = 15;
  maxSpeed: number = 275;
  maxReverseSpeed: number = -275;
  frontAcceleration: number = 600;
  backAcceleration: number = 600;
  frontDeceleration: number = 600;
  angularSpeed: number = 2.5;
  root: Object3D = new Object3D();
  meshBody: MD2CharacterComplexPart | null = null;
  meshWeapon: MD2CharacterComplexPart | null = null;
  controls: MD2CharacterControls | null = null;
  skinsBody: Texture[] = [];
  skinsWeapon: Texture[] = [];
  weapons: MD2CharacterComplexPart[] = [];
  currentSkin: number | undefined;
  onLoadComplete: () => void = () => {};
  onError: (error: unknown) => void = () => {};
  meshes: MD2CharacterComplexPart[] = [];
  animations: MD2CharacterAnimations = {};
  loadCounter: number = 0;
  speed: number = 0;
  bodyOrientation: number = 0;
  walkSpeed: number = this.maxSpeed;
  crouchSpeed: number = this.maxSpeed * 0.5;
  activeAnimation: string | null = null;
  oldAnimation: string | null = null;
  blendCounter: number = 0;
  private generation: number = 0;
  private disposed: boolean = false;
  private ownedGeometries: BufferGeometry[] = [];
  private ownedTextures: Texture[] = [];

  enableShadows(enable: boolean): void {
    for (const mesh of this.meshes) {
      mesh.castShadow = enable;
      mesh.receiveShadow = enable;
    }
  }
  setVisible(enable: boolean): void {
    for (const mesh of this.meshes) mesh.visible = enable;
  }
  shareParts(original: MD2CharacterComplex): void {
    if (!original.meshBody) throw new Error("Cannot share parts before the body is loaded");
    this.animations = original.animations;
    this.walkSpeed = original.walkSpeed;
    this.crouchSpeed = original.crouchSpeed;
    this.skinsBody = original.skinsBody;
    this.skinsWeapon = original.skinsWeapon;
    const mesh = this._createPart(original.meshBody.geometry, this.skinsBody[0]);
    mesh.scale.setScalar(this.scale);
    this.root.position.y = original.root.position.y;
    this.root.add(mesh);
    this.meshBody = mesh;
    this.meshes.push(mesh);
    for (let i = 0; i < original.weapons.length; i++) {
      const weapon = this._createPart(original.weapons[i].geometry, this.skinsWeapon[i]);
      weapon.scale.setScalar(this.scale);
      weapon.visible = false;
      weapon.name = original.weapons[i].name;
      this.root.add(weapon);
      this.weapons[i] = weapon;
      this.meshWeapon = weapon;
      this.meshes.push(weapon);
    }
  }
  loadParts(config: MD2CharacterComplexConfig): void {
    if (this.disposed) return;
    this.clearParts();
    const generation = ++this.generation;
    let failed = false;
    const current = (): boolean => !this.disposed && this.generation === generation;
    const complete = (): void => {
      if (!current() || failed) return;
      if (--this.loadCounter === 0) this.onLoadComplete();
    };
    const error = (reason: unknown): void => {
      if (!current() || failed) return;
      failed = true;
      this.onError(reason);
    };
    this.animations = config.animations;
    this.walkSpeed = config.walkSpeed;
    this.crouchSpeed = config.crouchSpeed;
    this.loadCounter = config.weapons.length * 2 + config.skins.length + 1;
    const textureLoader = new TextureLoader();
    const loadTextures = (names: string[]): Texture[] =>
      names.map((name) => {
        const texture = textureLoader.load(
          config.baseUrl + "skins/" + name,
          (loaded) => {
            if (!current()) {
              loaded.dispose();
              return;
            }
            complete();
          },
          undefined,
          error,
        );
        texture.mapping = Mapping.UV;
        texture.name = name;
        texture.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB;
        this.ownedTextures.push(texture);
        return texture;
      });
    this.skinsBody = loadTextures(config.skins);
    this.skinsWeapon = loadTextures(config.weapons.map((weapon) => weapon[1]));
    const loader = new MD2Loader();
    loader.load(
      config.baseUrl + config.body,
      (geometry) => {
        if (!current()) {
          geometry.dispose();
          return;
        }
        this.ownedGeometries.push(geometry);
        const box = new Box3().setFromBufferAttribute(geometry.attributes.position as BufferAttribute);
        this.root.position.y = -this.scale * box.min.y;
        const mesh = this._createPart(geometry, this.skinsBody[0]);
        mesh.scale.setScalar(this.scale);
        this.root.add(mesh);
        this.meshBody = mesh;
        this.meshes.push(mesh);
        complete();
      },
      undefined,
      error,
    );
    config.weapons.forEach(([name], index) => {
      loader.load(
        config.baseUrl + name,
        (geometry) => {
          if (!current()) {
            geometry.dispose();
            return;
          }
          this.ownedGeometries.push(geometry);
          const mesh = this._createPart(geometry, this.skinsWeapon[index]);
          mesh.scale.setScalar(this.scale);
          mesh.visible = false;
          mesh.name = name;
          this.root.add(mesh);
          this.weapons[index] = mesh;
          this.meshWeapon = mesh;
          this.meshes.push(mesh);
          complete();
        },
        undefined,
        error,
      );
    });
  }
  setPlaybackRate(rate: number): void {
    if (this.meshBody) this.meshBody.duration = (this.meshBody.baseDuration ?? NaN) / rate;
    if (this.meshWeapon) this.meshWeapon.duration = (this.meshWeapon.baseDuration ?? NaN) / rate;
  }
  setWireframe(enabled: boolean): void {
    if (this.meshBody)
      this.meshBody.material = enabled ? this.meshBody.materialWireframe : this.meshBody.materialTexture;
    if (this.meshWeapon)
      this.meshWeapon.material = enabled ? this.meshWeapon.materialWireframe : this.meshWeapon.materialTexture;
  }
  setSkin(index: number): void {
    if (this.meshBody && !this.meshBody.material.wireframe) {
      this.meshBody.material.map = this.skinsBody[index];
      this.currentSkin = index;
    }
  }
  setWeapon(index: number): void {
    for (const weapon of this.weapons) if (weapon) weapon.visible = false;
    const weapon = this.weapons[index];
    if (weapon) {
      weapon.visible = true;
      this.meshWeapon = weapon;
      if (this.activeAnimation) {
        weapon.playAnimation(this.activeAnimation);
        weapon.setAnimationTime(this.activeAnimation, this.meshBody!.getAnimationTime(this.activeAnimation));
      }
    }
  }
  setAnimation(name: string | undefined): void {
    if (name === this.activeAnimation || !name) return;
    if (this.meshBody) {
      this.meshBody.setAnimationWeight(name, 0);
      this.meshBody.playAnimation(name);
      this.oldAnimation = this.activeAnimation;
      this.activeAnimation = name;
      this.blendCounter = this.transitionFrames;
    }
    if (this.meshWeapon) {
      this.meshWeapon.setAnimationWeight(name, 0);
      this.meshWeapon.playAnimation(name);
    }
  }
  update(delta: number): void {
    if (this.controls) {
      this.updateMovementModel(delta);
      this.updateBehaviors();
    }
    this.updateAnimations(delta);
  }
  updateAnimations(delta: number): void {
    let mix = 1;
    if (this.blendCounter > 0) {
      mix = (this.transitionFrames - this.blendCounter) / this.transitionFrames;
      this.blendCounter--;
    }
    if (this.meshBody) {
      this.meshBody.update(delta);
      this.meshBody.setAnimationWeight(this.activeAnimation, mix);
      this.meshBody.setAnimationWeight(this.oldAnimation, 1 - mix);
    }
    if (this.meshWeapon) {
      this.meshWeapon.update(delta);
      this.meshWeapon.setAnimationWeight(this.activeAnimation, mix);
      this.meshWeapon.setAnimationWeight(this.oldAnimation, 1 - mix);
    }
  }
  updateBehaviors(): void {
    const controls = this.controls;
    if (!controls) return;
    const animations = this.animations;
    let move = controls.crouch ? animations.crouchMove : animations.move;
    let idle = controls.crouch ? animations.crouchIdle : animations.idle;
    if (controls.jump) move = idle = animations.jump;
    if (controls.attack) move = idle = controls.crouch ? animations.crouchAttack : animations.attack;
    if (controls.moveForward || controls.moveBackward || controls.moveLeft || controls.moveRight) {
      if (this.activeAnimation !== move) this.setAnimation(move);
    }
    if (
      Math.abs(this.speed) < 0.2 * this.maxSpeed &&
      !(controls.moveLeft || controls.moveRight || controls.moveForward || controls.moveBackward)
    ) {
      if (this.activeAnimation !== idle) this.setAnimation(idle);
    }
    if (controls.moveForward) {
      this.meshBody?.setAnimationDirectionForward(this.activeAnimation);
      this.meshBody?.setAnimationDirectionForward(this.oldAnimation);
      this.meshWeapon?.setAnimationDirectionForward(this.activeAnimation);
      this.meshWeapon?.setAnimationDirectionForward(this.oldAnimation);
    }
    if (controls.moveBackward) {
      this.meshBody?.setAnimationDirectionBackward(this.activeAnimation);
      this.meshBody?.setAnimationDirectionBackward(this.oldAnimation);
      this.meshWeapon?.setAnimationDirectionBackward(this.activeAnimation);
      this.meshWeapon?.setAnimationDirectionBackward(this.oldAnimation);
    }
  }
  updateMovementModel(delta: number): void {
    const controls = this.controls;
    if (!controls) return;
    this.maxSpeed = controls.crouch ? this.crouchSpeed : this.walkSpeed;
    this.maxReverseSpeed = -this.maxSpeed;
    if (controls.moveForward)
      this.speed = clamp(this.speed + delta * this.frontAcceleration, this.maxReverseSpeed, this.maxSpeed);
    if (controls.moveBackward)
      this.speed = clamp(this.speed - delta * this.backAcceleration, this.maxReverseSpeed, this.maxSpeed);
    if (controls.moveLeft) {
      this.bodyOrientation += delta * this.angularSpeed;
      this.speed = clamp(this.speed + delta * this.frontAcceleration, this.maxReverseSpeed, this.maxSpeed);
    }
    if (controls.moveRight) {
      this.bodyOrientation -= delta * this.angularSpeed;
      this.speed = clamp(this.speed + delta * this.frontAcceleration, this.maxReverseSpeed, this.maxSpeed);
    }
    if (!(controls.moveForward || controls.moveBackward)) {
      if (this.speed > 0) {
        const k = this.speed / this.maxSpeed;
        this.speed = clamp(
          this.speed - (k === 1 ? 1 : 1 - Math.pow(2, -10 * k)) * delta * this.frontDeceleration,
          0,
          this.maxSpeed,
        );
      } else {
        const k = this.speed / this.maxReverseSpeed;
        this.speed = clamp(
          this.speed + (k === 1 ? 1 : 1 - Math.pow(2, -10 * k)) * delta * this.backAcceleration,
          this.maxReverseSpeed,
          0,
        );
      }
    }
    const forwardDelta = this.speed * delta;
    this.root.position.x += Math.sin(this.bodyOrientation) * forwardDelta;
    this.root.position.z += Math.cos(this.bodyOrientation) * forwardDelta;
    this.root.rotation.y = this.bodyOrientation;
  }
  _createPart(geometry: BufferGeometry, skinMap: Texture | undefined): MD2CharacterComplexPart {
    const mesh = new MD2CharacterComplexPart(geometry, skinMap);
    mesh.autoCreateAnimations(this.animationFPS);
    return mesh;
  }
  private clearParts(): void {
    for (const mesh of this.meshes) {
      this.root.remove(mesh);
      mesh.materialTexture.dispose();
      mesh.materialWireframe.dispose();
    }
    for (const geometry of this.ownedGeometries) geometry.dispose();
    for (const texture of this.ownedTextures) texture.dispose();
    this.meshes = [];
    this.weapons = [];
    this.skinsBody = [];
    this.skinsWeapon = [];
    this.meshBody = null;
    this.meshWeapon = null;
    this.ownedGeometries = [];
    this.ownedTextures = [];
  }
  dispose(): void {
    if (this.disposed) return;
    this.disposed = true;
    this.generation++;
    this.clearParts();
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/misc/MorphAnimMesh

```typescript
import { AnimationClip } from "../../animation/AnimationClip";
import { AnimationMixer } from "../../animation/AnimationMixer";
import type { AnimationAction } from "../../animation/AnimationAction";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { Material } from "../../materials/Material";
import { MeshBasicMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshBasicMaterial";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";

export class MorphAnimMesh extends Mesh {
  mixer: AnimationMixer;
  activeAction: AnimationAction | null;

  constructor(
    geometry: BufferGeometry = new BufferGeometry(),
    material: Material | Material[] = new MeshBasicMaterial(),
  ) {
    super(geometry, material);

    this.type = "MorphAnimMesh";

    this.mixer = new AnimationMixer(this);

    this.activeAction = null;
  }

  setDirectionForward() {
    this.mixer.timeScale = 1.0;
  }

  setDirectionBackward() {
    this.mixer.timeScale = -1.0;
  }

  playAnimation(label: string, fps: number) {
    if (this.activeAction) {
      this.activeAction.stop();
      this.activeAction = null;
    }

    const clip = AnimationClip.findByName(this, label);

    if (clip) {
      const action = this.mixer.clipAction(clip);
      action.timeScale = (clip.tracks.length * fps) / clip.duration;
      this.activeAction = action.play();
    } else {
      throw new Error("THREE.MorphAnimMesh: animations[" + label + "] undefined in .playAnimation()");
    }
  }

  updateAnimation(delta: number) {
    this.mixer.update(delta);
  }

  copy(source: this, recursive?: boolean) {
    super.copy(source, recursive);

    this.mixer = new AnimationMixer(this);

    return this;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/misc/MorphBlendMesh

```typescript
import type { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { Material } from "../../materials/Material";
import { clamp } from "../../math/MathUtils";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";

export interface MorphBlendAnimation {
  start: number;
  end: number;
  length: number;
  fps: number;
  duration: number;
  lastFrame: number;
  currentFrame: number;
  active: boolean;
  time: number;
  direction: number;
  weight: number;
  directionBackwards: boolean;
  mirroredLoop: boolean;
}

export class MorphBlendMesh<TMaterial extends Material | Material[] = Material | Material[]> extends Mesh<TMaterial> {
  animationsMap: Record<string, MorphBlendAnimation> = {};
  animationsList: MorphBlendAnimation[] = [];
  firstAnimation: string | undefined;

  constructor(geometry: BufferGeometry, material: TMaterial) {
    super(geometry, material);
    const numFrames = Object.keys(this.morphTargetDictionary ?? {}).length;
    this.createAnimation("__default", 0, numFrames - 1, numFrames);
    this.setAnimationWeight("__default", 1);
  }

  createAnimation(name: string, start: number, end: number, fps: number): void {
    const animation: MorphBlendAnimation = {
      start,
      end,
      length: end - start + 1,
      fps,
      duration: (end - start) / fps,
      lastFrame: 0,
      currentFrame: 0,
      active: false,
      time: 0,
      direction: 1,
      weight: 1,
      directionBackwards: false,
      mirroredLoop: false,
    };
    this.animationsMap[name] = animation;
    this.animationsList.push(animation);
  }

  autoCreateAnimations(fps: number): void {
    const ranges: Record<string, { start: number; end: number }> = {};
    let firstAnimation: string | undefined;
    let i = 0;
    for (const key in this.morphTargetDictionary) {
      const chunks = key.match(/([a-z]+)_?(\d+)/i);
      if (chunks && chunks.length > 1) {
        const name = chunks[1];
        const range = (ranges[name] ??= { start: Infinity, end: -Infinity });
        if (i < range.start) range.start = i;
        if (i > range.end) range.end = i;
        if (!firstAnimation) firstAnimation = name;
      }
      i++;
    }
    for (const name in ranges) this.createAnimation(name, ranges[name].start, ranges[name].end, fps);
    this.firstAnimation = firstAnimation;
  }

  setAnimationDirectionForward(name: string | null): void {
    const animation = name === null ? undefined : this.animationsMap[name];
    if (animation) {
      animation.direction = 1;
      animation.directionBackwards = false;
    }
  }
  setAnimationDirectionBackward(name: string | null): void {
    const animation = name === null ? undefined : this.animationsMap[name];
    if (animation) {
      animation.direction = -1;
      animation.directionBackwards = true;
    }
  }
  setAnimationFPS(name: string, fps: number): void {
    const animation = this.animationsMap[name];
    if (animation) {
      animation.fps = fps;
      animation.duration = (animation.end - animation.start) / fps;
    }
  }
  setAnimationDuration(name: string, duration: number): void {
    const animation = this.animationsMap[name];
    if (animation) {
      animation.duration = duration;
      animation.fps = (animation.end - animation.start) / duration;
    }
  }
  setAnimationWeight(name: string | null, weight: number): void {
    const animation = name === null ? undefined : this.animationsMap[name];
    if (animation) animation.weight = weight;
  }
  setAnimationTime(name: string, time: number): void {
    const animation = this.animationsMap[name];
    if (animation) animation.time = time;
  }
  getAnimationTime(name: string): number {
    return this.animationsMap[name]?.time ?? 0;
  }
  getAnimationDuration(name: string): number {
    return this.animationsMap[name]?.duration ?? -1;
  }
  playAnimation(name: string): void {
    const animation = this.animationsMap[name];
    if (animation) {
      animation.time = 0;
      animation.active = true;
    } else console.warn(`THREE.MorphBlendMesh: animation[${name}] undefined in .playAnimation()`);
  }
  stopAnimation(name: string): void {
    const animation = this.animationsMap[name];
    if (animation) animation.active = false;
  }
  update(delta: number): void {
    for (const animation of this.animationsList) {
      if (!animation.active) continue;
      const frameTime = animation.duration / animation.length;
      animation.time += animation.direction * delta;
      if (animation.mirroredLoop) {
        if (animation.time > animation.duration || animation.time < 0) {
          animation.direction *= -1;
          if (animation.time > animation.duration) {
            animation.time = animation.duration;
            animation.directionBackwards = true;
          }
          if (animation.time < 0) {
            animation.time = 0;
            animation.directionBackwards = false;
          }
        }
      } else {
        animation.time %= animation.duration;
        if (animation.time < 0) animation.time += animation.duration;
      }
      const keyframe = animation.start + clamp(Math.floor(animation.time / frameTime), 0, animation.length - 1);
      const weight = animation.weight;
      const influences = this.morphTargetInfluences!;
      if (keyframe !== animation.currentFrame) {
        influences[animation.lastFrame] = 0;
        influences[animation.currentFrame] = weight;
        influences[keyframe] = 0;
        animation.lastFrame = animation.currentFrame;
        animation.currentFrame = keyframe;
      }
      let mix = (animation.time % frameTime) / frameTime;
      if (animation.directionBackwards) mix = 1 - mix;
      if (animation.currentFrame !== animation.lastFrame) {
        influences[animation.currentFrame] = mix * weight;
        influences[animation.lastFrame] = (1 - mix) * weight;
      } else influences[animation.currentFrame] = weight;
    }
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/misc/ProgressiveLightMap

```typescript
import type { Camera } from "../../cameras/Camera";
import { Side, TextureType } from "../../constants";
import { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { InterleavedBufferAttribute } from "../../core/InterleavedBufferAttribute";
import type { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import { PlaneGeometry } from "../../geometries/PlaneGeometry";
import { Light } from "../../lights/Light";
import { MeshBasicMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshBasicMaterial";
import { MeshPhongMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshPhongMaterial";
import { MeshLambertMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshLambertMaterial";
import { MeshStandardMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshStandardMaterial";
import type { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";
import { WebGLRenderTarget } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";
import { Scene } from "../../scenes/Scene";
import type { Texture } from "../../textures/Texture";

export interface LightMapBox {
  w: number;
  h: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  index: number;
}

type LightMapMaterial = MeshPhongMaterial | MeshBasicMaterial | MeshStandardMaterial | MeshLambertMaterial;
export type LightMapPacker = (boxes: LightMapBox[]) => { w: number; h: number };

/** Accumulates shadowed lighting into a packed, progressively refined UV lightmap. */
export class ProgressiveLightMap {
  readonly scene: Scene = new Scene();
  readonly progressiveLightMap1: WebGLRenderTarget;
  readonly progressiveLightMap2: WebGLRenderTarget;
  readonly uvMat: MeshPhongMaterial = new MeshPhongMaterial();
  readonly lightMapContainers: { basicMat: LightMapMaterial; object: Mesh<LightMapMaterial> }[] = [];
  readonly uv_boxes: LightMapBox[] = [];
  buffer1Active: boolean = false;
  firstUpdate: boolean = true;
  labelMesh: Mesh<MeshBasicMaterial> | null = null;
  blurringPlane: Mesh<MeshBasicMaterial> | null = null;
  private readonly previous: { value: Texture | null } = { value: null };
  private readonly averaging: { value: number } = { value: 100 };
  private readonly blurPrevious: { value: Texture | null } = { value: null };

  constructor(
    readonly renderer: WebGLRenderer,
    readonly potpack: LightMapPacker,
    readonly res: number = 1024,
  ) {
    const format =
      typeof navigator !== "undefined" && /(Android|iPad|iPhone|iPod)/g.test(navigator.userAgent)
        ? TextureType.HalfFloat
        : TextureType.Float;
    this.progressiveLightMap1 = new WebGLRenderTarget(res, res, { type: format });
    this.progressiveLightMap2 = new WebGLRenderTarget(res, res, { type: format });
    this.progressiveLightMap2.texture.channel = 1;
    this.previous.value = this.progressiveLightMap1.texture;
    this.uvMat.onBeforeCompile = (shader) => {
      shader.vertexShader = shader.vertexShader.trimEnd();
      shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader.trimEnd();
      shader.vertexShader =
        "attribute vec2 uv1;\n#define USE_LIGHTMAP\n#define LIGHTMAP_UV uv1\n" +
        shader.vertexShader.slice(0, -1) +
        " gl_Position = vec4((LIGHTMAP_UV - 0.5) * 2.0, 1.0, 1.0); }";
      const start = shader.fragmentShader.indexOf("void main() {");
      shader.fragmentShader =
        "#define USE_LIGHTMAP\n" +
        shader.fragmentShader.slice(0, start) +
        "uniform sampler2D previousShadowMap;\nuniform float averagingWindow;\n" +
        shader.fragmentShader.slice(start - 1, -1) +
        "\nvec3 texelOld = texture2D(previousShadowMap, vLightMapUv).rgb;\ngl_FragColor.rgb = mix(texelOld, gl_FragColor.rgb, 1.0/averagingWindow);\n}";
      shader.uniforms.previousShadowMap = this.previous;
      shader.uniforms.averagingWindow = this.averaging;
    };
  }

  addObjectsToLightMap(objects: Object3D[]): void {
    this.uv_boxes.length = 0;
    const padding = 3 / this.res;
    objects.forEach((object, index) => {
      if (object instanceof Light) {
        this.scene.attach(object);
        return;
      }
      if (
        !(object instanceof Mesh) ||
        !(
          object.material instanceof MeshPhongMaterial ||
          object.material instanceof MeshBasicMaterial ||
          object.material instanceof MeshStandardMaterial ||
          object.material instanceof MeshLambertMaterial
        )
      )
        return;
      if (!object.geometry.hasAttribute("uv")) {
        console.warn("THREE.ProgressiveLightMap: All lightmap objects need uvs.");
        return;
      }
      if (!object.geometry.hasAttribute("normal")) {
        console.warn("THREE.ProgressiveLightMap: All lightmap objects need normals.");
        return;
      }
      if (!this.blurringPlane) this.initializeBlurPlane();
      object.material.lightMap = this.progressiveLightMap2.texture;
      object.material.dithering = true;
      object.castShadow = object.receiveShadow = true;
      object.renderOrder = 1000 + index;
      this.uv_boxes.push({ w: 1 + padding * 2, h: 1 + padding * 2, x: 0, y: 0, index });
      this.lightMapContainers.push({ basicMat: object.material, object: object as Mesh<LightMapMaterial> });
    });
    const dimensions = this.potpack(this.uv_boxes);
    for (const box of this.uv_boxes) {
      const object = objects[box.index];
      if (!(object instanceof Mesh)) continue;
      const source = object.geometry.getAttribute("uv");
      if (!(source instanceof BufferAttribute || source instanceof InterleavedBufferAttribute)) continue;
      const uv1 = new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(source.count * 2), 2);
      for (let i = 0; i < source.count; i++)
        uv1.setXY(
          i,
          (source.getX(i) + box.x + padding) / dimensions.w,
          (source.getY(i) + box.y + padding) / dimensions.h,
        );
      object.geometry.setAttribute("uv1", uv1);
      uv1.needsUpdate = true;
    }
  }

  update(camera: Camera, blendWindow = 100, blurEdges = true): void {
    if (!this.blurringPlane) return;
    const oldTarget = this.renderer.getRenderTarget();
    this.blurringPlane.visible = blurEdges;
    const saved = this.lightMapContainers.map(({ object }) => ({
      parent: object.parent,
      culled: object.frustumCulled,
    }));
    for (const { object } of this.lightMapContainers) this.scene.attach(object);
    if (this.firstUpdate) {
      this.renderer.compile(this.scene, camera);
      this.firstUpdate = false;
    }
    this.averaging.value = blendWindow;
    for (const { object } of this.lightMapContainers) {
      object.material = this.uvMat;
      object.frustumCulled = false;
    }
    const active = this.buffer1Active ? this.progressiveLightMap1 : this.progressiveLightMap2;
    const inactive = this.buffer1Active ? this.progressiveLightMap2 : this.progressiveLightMap1;
    this.renderer.setRenderTarget(active);
    this.previous.value = this.blurPrevious.value = inactive.texture;
    this.buffer1Active = !this.buffer1Active;
    this.renderer.render(this.scene, camera);
    this.lightMapContainers.forEach(({ object, basicMat }, i) => {
      object.frustumCulled = saved[i].culled;
      object.material = basicMat;
      saved[i].parent?.attach(object);
    });
    this.renderer.setRenderTarget(oldTarget);
  }

  showDebugLightmap(visible: boolean, position?: Vector3): void {
    if (!this.lightMapContainers.length) {
      console.warn("THREE.ProgressiveLightMap: Call .showDebugLightmap() after adding the objects.");
      return;
    }
    if (!this.labelMesh) {
      this.labelMesh = new Mesh(
        new PlaneGeometry(100, 100),
        new MeshBasicMaterial({ map: this.progressiveLightMap1.texture, side: Side.Double }),
      );
      this.labelMesh.position.y = 250;
      this.lightMapContainers[0].object.parent?.add(this.labelMesh);
    }
    if (position) this.labelMesh.position.copy(position);
    this.labelMesh.visible = visible;
  }

  private initializeBlurPlane(): void {
    const material = new MeshBasicMaterial();
    material.onBeforeCompile = (shader) => {
      shader.vertexShader = shader.vertexShader.trimEnd();
      shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader.trimEnd();
      shader.vertexShader =
        "#define USE_UV\n" + shader.vertexShader.slice(0, -1) + " gl_Position = vec4((uv - 0.5) * 2.0, 1.0, 1.0); }";
      const start = shader.fragmentShader.indexOf("void main() {");
      shader.fragmentShader =
        "#define USE_UV\n" +
        shader.fragmentShader.slice(0, start) +
        "uniform sampler2D previousShadowMap;\nuniform float pixelOffset;\n" +
        shader.fragmentShader.slice(start - 1, -1) +
        ` gl_FragColor.rgb = (texture2D(previousShadowMap, vUv + vec2(pixelOffset, 0.0)).rgb + texture2D(previousShadowMap, vUv + vec2(0.0, pixelOffset)).rgb + texture2D(previousShadowMap, vUv + vec2(0.0, -pixelOffset)).rgb + texture2D(previousShadowMap, vUv + vec2(-pixelOffset, 0.0)).rgb + texture2D(previousShadowMap, vUv + vec2(pixelOffset, pixelOffset)).rgb + texture2D(previousShadowMap, vUv + vec2(-pixelOffset, pixelOffset)).rgb + texture2D(previousShadowMap, vUv + vec2(pixelOffset, -pixelOffset)).rgb + texture2D(previousShadowMap, vUv + vec2(-pixelOffset, -pixelOffset)).rgb)/8.0; }`;
      shader.uniforms.previousShadowMap = this.blurPrevious;
      shader.uniforms.pixelOffset = { value: 0.5 / this.res };
    };
    material.depthWrite = false;
    this.blurringPlane = new Mesh(new PlaneGeometry(1, 1), material);
    this.blurringPlane.name = "Blurring Plane";
    this.blurringPlane.frustumCulled = false;
    this.scene.add(this.blurringPlane);
  }

  dispose(): void {
    this.progressiveLightMap1.dispose();
    this.progressiveLightMap2.dispose();
    this.uvMat.dispose();
    if (this.blurringPlane) {
      this.blurringPlane.geometry.dispose();
      this.blurringPlane.material.dispose();
    }
    if (this.labelMesh) {
      this.labelMesh.removeFromParent();
      this.labelMesh.geometry.dispose();
      this.labelMesh.material.dispose();
    }
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/misc/RollerCoaster

```typescript
import { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Quaternion } from "../../math/Quaternion";
import { Raycaster } from "../../core/Raycaster";
import { ColorSpace } from "../../constants";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import type { Curve } from "../../extras/core/Curve";
import type { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";

export class RollerCoasterGeometry extends BufferGeometry {
  constructor(curve: Curve<Vector3>, divisions: number) {
    super();

    const vertices: number[] = [];
    const normals: number[] = [];
    const colors: number[] = [];

    const color1 = [1, 1, 1];
    const color2 = [1, 1, 0];

    const up = new Vector3(0, 1, 0);
    const forward = new Vector3();
    const right = new Vector3();

    const quaternion = new Quaternion();
    const prevQuaternion = new Quaternion();
    prevQuaternion.setFromAxisAngle(up, Math.PI / 2);

    const point = new Vector3();
    const prevPoint = new Vector3();
    prevPoint.copy(curve.getPointAt(0));

    // shapes

    const step = [
      new Vector3(-0.225, 0, 0),
      new Vector3(0, -0.05, 0),
      new Vector3(0, -0.175, 0),

      new Vector3(0, -0.05, 0),
      new Vector3(0.225, 0, 0),
      new Vector3(0, -0.175, 0),
    ];

    const PI2 = Math.PI * 2;

    let sides = 5;
    const tube1: Vector3[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const angle = (i / sides) * PI2;
      tube1.push(new Vector3(Math.sin(angle) * 0.06, Math.cos(angle) * 0.06, 0));
    }

    sides = 6;
    const tube2: Vector3[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const angle = (i / sides) * PI2;
      tube2.push(new Vector3(Math.sin(angle) * 0.025, Math.cos(angle) * 0.025, 0));
    }

    const vector = new Vector3();
    const normal = new Vector3();

    function drawShape(shape: Vector3[], color: number[]) {
      normal.set(0, 0, -1).applyQuaternion(quaternion);

      for (let j = 0; j < shape.length; j++) {
        vector.copy(shape[j]);
        vector.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        vector.add(point);

        vertices.push(vector.x, vector.y, vector.z);
        normals.push(normal.x, normal.y, normal.z);
        colors.push(color[0], color[1], color[2]);
      }

      normal.set(0, 0, 1).applyQuaternion(quaternion);

      for (let j = shape.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
        vector.copy(shape[j]);
        vector.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        vector.add(point);

        vertices.push(vector.x, vector.y, vector.z);
        normals.push(normal.x, normal.y, normal.z);
        colors.push(color[0], color[1], color[2]);
      }
    }

    const vector1 = new Vector3();
    const vector2 = new Vector3();
    const vector3 = new Vector3();
    const vector4 = new Vector3();

    const normal1 = new Vector3();
    const normal2 = new Vector3();
    const normal3 = new Vector3();
    const normal4 = new Vector3();

    function extrudeShape(shape: Vector3[], offset: Vector3, color: number[]) {
      for (let j = 0, jl = shape.length; j < jl; j++) {
        const point1 = shape[j];
        const point2 = shape[(j + 1) % jl];

        vector1.copy(point1).add(offset);
        vector1.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        vector1.add(point);

        vector2.copy(point2).add(offset);
        vector2.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        vector2.add(point);

        vector3.copy(point2).add(offset);
        vector3.applyQuaternion(prevQuaternion);
        vector3.add(prevPoint);

        vector4.copy(point1).add(offset);
        vector4.applyQuaternion(prevQuaternion);
        vector4.add(prevPoint);

        vertices.push(vector1.x, vector1.y, vector1.z);
        vertices.push(vector2.x, vector2.y, vector2.z);
        vertices.push(vector4.x, vector4.y, vector4.z);

        vertices.push(vector2.x, vector2.y, vector2.z);
        vertices.push(vector3.x, vector3.y, vector3.z);
        vertices.push(vector4.x, vector4.y, vector4.z);

        //

        normal1.copy(point1);
        normal1.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        normal1.normalize();

        normal2.copy(point2);
        normal2.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        normal2.normalize();

        normal3.copy(point2);
        normal3.applyQuaternion(prevQuaternion);
        normal3.normalize();

        normal4.copy(point1);
        normal4.applyQuaternion(prevQuaternion);
        normal4.normalize();

        normals.push(normal1.x, normal1.y, normal1.z);
        normals.push(normal2.x, normal2.y, normal2.z);
        normals.push(normal4.x, normal4.y, normal4.z);

        normals.push(normal2.x, normal2.y, normal2.z);
        normals.push(normal3.x, normal3.y, normal3.z);
        normals.push(normal4.x, normal4.y, normal4.z);

        colors.push(color[0], color[1], color[2]);
        colors.push(color[0], color[1], color[2]);
        colors.push(color[0], color[1], color[2]);

        colors.push(color[0], color[1], color[2]);
        colors.push(color[0], color[1], color[2]);
        colors.push(color[0], color[1], color[2]);
      }
    }

    const offset = new Vector3();

    const sample1 = new Vector3();
    const sample2 = new Vector3();
    const rollQuaternion = new Quaternion();

    for (let i = 1; i <= divisions; i++) {
      point.copy(curve.getPointAt(i / divisions));

      up.set(0, 1, 0);

      forward.subVectors(point, prevPoint).normalize();
      right.crossVectors(up, forward).normalize();
      up.crossVectors(forward, right);

      const angle = Math.atan2(forward.x, forward.z);

      quaternion.setFromAxisAngle(up, angle);

      // banking

      const bankDelta = 0.01;
      const t = i / divisions;

      sample1.copy(curve.getTangentAt((((t - bankDelta) % 1) + 1) % 1));
      sample2.copy(curve.getTangentAt((t + bankDelta) % 1));

      let headingChange = Math.atan2(sample2.x, sample2.z) - Math.atan2(sample1.x, sample1.z);
      if (headingChange > Math.PI) headingChange -= Math.PI * 2;
      if (headingChange < -Math.PI) headingChange += Math.PI * 2;

      quaternion.premultiply(rollQuaternion.setFromAxisAngle(forward, -Math.atan(headingChange * 8) * 0.5));

      if (i % 2 === 0) {
        drawShape(step, color2);
      }

      extrudeShape(tube1, offset.set(0, -0.125, 0), color2);
      extrudeShape(tube2, offset.set(0.2, 0, 0), color1);
      extrudeShape(tube2, offset.set(-0.2, 0, 0), color1);

      prevPoint.copy(point);
      prevQuaternion.copy(quaternion);
    }

    this.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(vertices), 3));
    this.setAttribute("normal", new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(normals), 3));
    this.setAttribute("color", new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(colors), 3));
  }
}

export class RollerCoasterLiftersGeometry extends BufferGeometry {
  constructor(curve: Curve<Vector3>, divisions: number) {
    super();

    const vertices: number[] = [];
    const normals: number[] = [];

    const quaternion = new Quaternion();

    const up = new Vector3(0, 1, 0);

    const point = new Vector3();
    const tangent = new Vector3();

    // shapes

    const tube1 = [new Vector3(0, 0.05, -0.05), new Vector3(0, 0.05, 0.05), new Vector3(0, -0.05, 0)];

    const tube2 = [new Vector3(-0.05, 0, 0.05), new Vector3(-0.05, 0, -0.05), new Vector3(0.05, 0, 0)];

    const tube3 = [new Vector3(0.05, 0, -0.05), new Vector3(0.05, 0, 0.05), new Vector3(-0.05, 0, 0)];

    const vector1 = new Vector3();
    const vector2 = new Vector3();
    const vector3 = new Vector3();
    const vector4 = new Vector3();

    const normal1 = new Vector3();
    const normal2 = new Vector3();
    const normal3 = new Vector3();
    const normal4 = new Vector3();

    function extrudeShape(shape: Vector3[], fromPoint: Vector3, toPoint: Vector3) {
      for (let j = 0, jl = shape.length; j < jl; j++) {
        const point1 = shape[j];
        const point2 = shape[(j + 1) % jl];

        vector1.copy(point1);
        vector1.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        vector1.add(fromPoint);

        vector2.copy(point2);
        vector2.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        vector2.add(fromPoint);

        vector3.copy(point2);
        vector3.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        vector3.add(toPoint);

        vector4.copy(point1);
        vector4.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        vector4.add(toPoint);

        vertices.push(vector1.x, vector1.y, vector1.z);
        vertices.push(vector2.x, vector2.y, vector2.z);
        vertices.push(vector4.x, vector4.y, vector4.z);

        vertices.push(vector2.x, vector2.y, vector2.z);
        vertices.push(vector3.x, vector3.y, vector3.z);
        vertices.push(vector4.x, vector4.y, vector4.z);

        //

        normal1.copy(point1);
        normal1.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        normal1.normalize();

        normal2.copy(point2);
        normal2.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        normal2.normalize();

        normal3.copy(point2);
        normal3.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        normal3.normalize();

        normal4.copy(point1);
        normal4.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        normal4.normalize();

        normals.push(normal1.x, normal1.y, normal1.z);
        normals.push(normal2.x, normal2.y, normal2.z);
        normals.push(normal4.x, normal4.y, normal4.z);

        normals.push(normal2.x, normal2.y, normal2.z);
        normals.push(normal3.x, normal3.y, normal3.z);
        normals.push(normal4.x, normal4.y, normal4.z);
      }
    }

    const fromPoint = new Vector3();
    const toPoint = new Vector3();

    const sample1 = new Vector3();
    const sample2 = new Vector3();
    const bankedQuaternion = new Quaternion();
    const rollQuaternion = new Quaternion();

    for (let i = 1; i <= divisions; i++) {
      point.copy(curve.getPointAt(i / divisions));
      tangent.copy(curve.getTangentAt(i / divisions));

      const angle = Math.atan2(tangent.x, tangent.z);

      quaternion.setFromAxisAngle(up, angle);

      // banking

      const bankDelta = 0.01;
      const t = i / divisions;

      sample1.copy(curve.getTangentAt((((t - bankDelta) % 1) + 1) % 1));
      sample2.copy(curve.getTangentAt((t + bankDelta) % 1));

      let headingChange = Math.atan2(sample2.x, sample2.z) - Math.atan2(sample1.x, sample1.z);
      if (headingChange > Math.PI) headingChange -= Math.PI * 2;
      if (headingChange < -Math.PI) headingChange += Math.PI * 2;

      bankedQuaternion.copy(quaternion);
      rollQuaternion.setFromAxisAngle(tangent, -Math.atan(headingChange * 8) * 0.5);
      bankedQuaternion.premultiply(rollQuaternion);

      //

      if (point.y > 10) {
        fromPoint.set(-0.75, -0.35, 0);
        fromPoint.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        fromPoint.add(point);

        toPoint.set(0.75, -0.35, 0);
        toPoint.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        toPoint.add(point);

        extrudeShape(tube1, fromPoint, toPoint);

        fromPoint.set(-0.7, -0.3, 0);
        fromPoint.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        fromPoint.add(point);

        toPoint.set(-0.7, -point.y, 0);
        toPoint.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        toPoint.add(point);

        extrudeShape(tube2, fromPoint, toPoint);

        fromPoint.set(0.7, -0.3, 0);
        fromPoint.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        fromPoint.add(point);

        toPoint.set(0.7, -point.y, 0);
        toPoint.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
        toPoint.add(point);

        extrudeShape(tube3, fromPoint, toPoint);
      } else {
        fromPoint.set(0, -0.2, 0);
        fromPoint.applyQuaternion(bankedQuaternion);
        fromPoint.add(point);

        toPoint.copy(fromPoint);
        toPoint.y = 0;

        extrudeShape(tube3, fromPoint, toPoint);
      }
    }

    this.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(vertices), 3));
    this.setAttribute("normal", new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(normals), 3));
  }
}

export class RollerCoasterShadowGeometry extends BufferGeometry {
  constructor(curve: Curve<Vector3>, divisions: number) {
    super();

    const vertices: number[] = [];

    const up = new Vector3(0, 1, 0);
    const forward = new Vector3();

    const quaternion = new Quaternion();
    const prevQuaternion = new Quaternion();
    prevQuaternion.setFromAxisAngle(up, Math.PI / 2);

    const point = new Vector3();

    const prevPoint = new Vector3();
    prevPoint.copy(curve.getPointAt(0));
    prevPoint.y = 0;

    const vector1 = new Vector3();
    const vector2 = new Vector3();
    const vector3 = new Vector3();
    const vector4 = new Vector3();

    for (let i = 1; i <= divisions; i++) {
      point.copy(curve.getPointAt(i / divisions));
      point.y = 0;

      forward.subVectors(point, prevPoint);

      const angle = Math.atan2(forward.x, forward.z);

      quaternion.setFromAxisAngle(up, angle);

      vector1.set(-0.3, 0, 0);
      vector1.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
      vector1.add(point);

      vector2.set(0.3, 0, 0);
      vector2.applyQuaternion(quaternion);
      vector2.add(point);

      vector3.set(0.3, 0, 0);
      vector3.applyQuaternion(prevQuaternion);
      vector3.add(prevPoint);

      vector4.set(-0.3, 0, 0);
      vector4.applyQuaternion(prevQuaternion);
      vector4.add(prevPoint);

      vertices.push(vector1.x, vector1.y, vector1.z);
      vertices.push(vector2.x, vector2.y, vector2.z);
      vertices.push(vector4.x, vector4.y, vector4.z);

      vertices.push(vector2.x, vector2.y, vector2.z);
      vertices.push(vector3.x, vector3.y, vector3.z);
      vertices.push(vector4.x, vector4.y, vector4.z);

      prevPoint.copy(point);
      prevQuaternion.copy(quaternion);
    }

    this.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(vertices), 3));
  }
}

export class SkyGeometry extends BufferGeometry {
  constructor() {
    super();

    const vertices: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
      const x = Math.random() * 800 - 400;
      const y = Math.random() * 50 + 50;
      const z = Math.random() * 800 - 400;

      const size = Math.random() * 40 + 20;

      vertices.push(x - size, y, z - size);
      vertices.push(x + size, y, z - size);
      vertices.push(x - size, y, z + size);

      vertices.push(x + size, y, z - size);
      vertices.push(x + size, y, z + size);
      vertices.push(x - size, y, z + size);
    }

    this.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(vertices), 3));
  }
}

export class TreesGeometry extends BufferGeometry {
  constructor(landscape: Mesh) {
    super();

    const vertices: number[] = [];
    const colors: number[] = [];

    const raycaster = new Raycaster();
    raycaster.ray.direction.set(0, -1, 0);

    const _color = new Color();

    for (let i = 0; i < 2000; i++) {
      const x = Math.random() * 500 - 250;
      const z = Math.random() * 500 - 250;

      raycaster.ray.origin.set(x, 50, z);

      const intersections = raycaster.intersectObject(landscape);

      if (intersections.length === 0) continue;

      const y = intersections[0].point.y;

      const height = Math.random() * 5 + 0.5;

      let angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;

      vertices.push(x + Math.sin(angle), y, z + Math.cos(angle));
      vertices.push(x, y + height, z);
      vertices.push(x + Math.sin(angle + Math.PI), y, z + Math.cos(angle + Math.PI));

      angle += Math.PI / 2;

      vertices.push(x + Math.sin(angle), y, z + Math.cos(angle));
      vertices.push(x, y + height, z);
      vertices.push(x + Math.sin(angle + Math.PI), y, z + Math.cos(angle + Math.PI));

      const random = Math.random() * 0.1;

      for (let j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
        _color.setRGB(0.2 + random, 0.4 + random, 0, ColorSpace.SRGB);

        colors.push(_color.r, _color.g, _color.b);
      }
    }

    this.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(vertices), 3));
    this.setAttribute("color", new BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(colors), 3));
  }
}
```

function validateUnitInterval(name: string, value: number) {
  if (Number.isFinite(value) === false || value < 0 || value > 1) {
