              // Check Edges have even Opposite Points
              if (params.preserveEdges) {
                const edgeSet = existingEdges[positionHash];
                let hasPair = true;
                for (const edgeHash of edgeSet) {
                  if (flatOpposites[edgeHash].length % 2 !== 0) hasPair = false;
                }
                if (!hasPair) continue;
              }

              // Number of Neighbors
              const k = Object.keys(neighbors).length;

              // Loop's formula.
              const beta = (1 / k) * (5 / 8 - Math.pow(3 / 8 + (1 / 4) * Math.cos((2 * Math.PI) / k), 2));

              const heavy = 1 / k / k;

              const weight = lerp(heavy, beta, params.weight as number);

              const startWeight = 1.0 - weight * k;
              _vertex[v].multiplyScalar(startWeight);

              for (let neighborHash in neighbors) {
                const neighborIndices = neighbors[neighborHash];

                _average.set(0, 0, 0);
                for (let j = 0; j < neighborIndices.length; j++) {
                  _average.add(_temp.fromBufferAttribute(existingAttribute, neighborIndices[j]));
                }
                _average.divideScalar(neighborIndices.length);

                _average.multiplyScalar(weight);
                _vertex[v].add(_average);
              }
            } else if (opposites && opposites.length === 2) {
              const k = opposites.length;
              const beta = 0.125; /* 1/8 */
              const startWeight = 1.0 - beta * k;
              _vertex[v].multiplyScalar(startWeight);

              opposites.forEach((oppositeIndex) => {
                _average.fromBufferAttribute(existingAttribute, oppositeIndex);
                _average.multiplyScalar(beta);
                _vertex[v].add(_average);
              });
            }
          }
        }

        // Add New Triangle Position
        setTriangle(floatArray, index, flattenedAttribute.itemSize, _vertex[0], _vertex[1], _vertex[2]);
        index += flattenedAttribute.itemSize * 3;
      }

      return floatArray;
    }
  }
}

const _positionShift = Math.pow(10, POSITION_DECIMALS);

/** Compares two numbers to see if they're almost the same */
function fuzzy(a: number, b: number, tolerance = 0.00001) {
  return a < b + tolerance && a > b - tolerance;
}

/** Generates hash strong from Number */
function hashFromNumber(num: number, shift = _positionShift) {
  let roundedNumber = round(num * shift);
  if (roundedNumber == 0) roundedNumber = 0; /* prevent -0 (signed 0 can effect Math.atan2(), etc.) */
  return `${roundedNumber}`;
}

/** Generates hash strong from Vector3 */
function hashFromVector(vector: Vector3, shift = _positionShift) {
  return `${hashFromNumber(vector.x, shift)},${hashFromNumber(vector.y, shift)},${hashFromNumber(vector.z, shift)}`;
}

function lerp(x: number, y: number, t: number) {
  return (1 - t) * x + t * y;
}

function round(x: number) {
  return (x + (x > 0 ? 0.5 : -0.5)) << 0;
}

function calcNormal(target: Vector3, vec1: Vector3, vec2: Vector3, vec3: Vector3) {
  _temp.subVectors(vec1, vec2);
  target.subVectors(vec2, vec3);
  target.cross(_temp).normalize();
}

function gatherAttributes(geometry: BufferGeometry) {
  const desired = ["position", "normal", "uv"];
  const contains = Object.keys(geometry.attributes);
  const attributeList = Array.from(new Set(desired.concat(contains)));
  return attributeList;
}

function setTriangle(
  positions: NumericArray,
  index: number,
  step: number,
  vec0: Vector3,
  vec1: Vector3,
  vec2: Vector3,
) {
  if (step >= 1) {
    positions[index] = vec0.x;
    positions[index + 0 + step * 1] = vec1.x;
    positions[index + 0 + step * 2] = vec2.x;
  }
  if (step >= 2) {
    positions[index + 1] = vec0.y;
    positions[index + 1 + step * 1] = vec1.y;
    positions[index + 1 + step * 2] = vec2.y;
  }
  if (step >= 3) {
    positions[index + 2] = vec0.z;
    positions[index + 2 + step * 1] = vec1.z;
    positions[index + 2 + step * 2] = vec2.z;
  }
  if (step >= 4) {
    positions[index + 3] = NaN;
    positions[index + 3 + step * 1] = NaN;
    positions[index + 3 + step * 2] = NaN;
  }
}

function verifyGeometry(geometry: BufferGeometry) {
  if (geometry === undefined) {
    console.warn(`LoopSubdivision: Geometry provided is undefined`);
    return false;
  }

  if (!geometry.isBufferGeometry) {
    console.warn(`LoopSubdivision: Geometry provided is not 'BufferGeometry' type`);
    return false;
  }

  if (geometry.attributes.position === undefined) {
    console.warn(`LoopSubdivision: Geometry provided missing required 'position' attribute`);
    return false;
  }

  if (geometry.attributes.normal === undefined) {
    geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  }
  return true;
}
```

## ek3d/addons/modifiers/SimplifyModifier

````typescript
import { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { GLBufferAttribute } from "../../core/GLBufferAttribute";
import type { InterleavedBufferAttribute } from "../../core/InterleavedBufferAttribute";
import { mergeVertices } from "../utils/BufferGeometryUtils";

type Attribute = BufferAttribute | InterleavedBufferAttribute;

type IndexArray = Uint16Array | Uint32Array | Int16Array | Int32Array;

type AttributeArray =
  | Int8Array
  | Uint8Array
  | Uint8ClampedArray
  | Int16Array
  | Uint16Array
  | Int32Array
  | Uint32Array
  | Float32Array
  | Float64Array;

type AttributeArrayConstructor = new (length: number) => AttributeArray;

/** meshopt accepts only 16/32-bit indices; glTF may deliver an 8-bit index buffer. */
function toSimplifierIndices(array: AttributeArray): IndexArray {
  return array instanceof Uint16Array ||
    array instanceof Uint32Array ||
    array instanceof Int16Array ||
    array instanceof Int32Array
    ? array
    : Uint32Array.from(array);
}

/** Returns a CPU-readable attribute; GPU-only buffers cannot be simplified. */
function readAttribute(geometry: BufferGeometry, name: string): Attribute | undefined {
  const attribute = geometry.getAttribute(name);
  return attribute instanceof GLBufferAttribute ? undefined : attribute;
}

/**
 * The subset of the meshoptimizer simplifier module used by {@link SimplifyModifier}.
 *
 * The vendor module is not bundled: the consumer loads `meshopt_simplifier.module.js`
 * and passes its `MeshoptSimplifier` export to {@link SimplifyModifier#setSimplifier}.
 */
export interface MeshoptSimplifierLike {
  supported: boolean;
  ready: Promise<unknown>;
  simplify(
    indices: IndexArray,
    vertexPositions: Float32Array,
    vertexPositionsStride: number,
    targetIndexCount: number,
    targetError: number,
    flags?: string[],
  ): [IndexArray, number];
  simplifyWithAttributes(
    indices: IndexArray,
    vertexPositions: Float32Array,
    vertexPositionsStride: number,
    vertexAttributes: Float32Array,
    vertexAttributesStride: number,
    attributeWeights: number[],
    vertexLock: Uint8Array | null,
    targetIndexCount: number,
    targetError: number,
    flags?: string[],
  ): [IndexArray, number];
  compactMesh(indices: IndexArray): [Uint32Array, number];
}

/**
 * This class can be used to modify a geometry by simplifying it. A typical use
 * case for such a modifier is automatic LOD generation.
 *
 * The implementation is based on [meshoptimizer]{@link https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer}.
 * The simplifier runtime is supplied by the consumer; this class never bundles or
 * fetches it, matching the other explicit vendor-runtime integrations.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { SimplifyModifier, type MeshoptSimplifierLike } from 'ek3d/addons/modifiers/SimplifyModifier';
 * import type { BufferGeometry } from 'ek3d/core/BufferGeometry';
 *
 * async function simplify( geometry: BufferGeometry, runtime: MeshoptSimplifierLike ): Promise<BufferGeometry> {
 *   const modifier = new SimplifyModifier().setSimplifier( runtime );
 *   return modifier.modify( geometry, 100 );
 * }
 * ```
 *
 */
export class SimplifyModifier {
  simplifier: MeshoptSimplifierLike | null;

  /**
   * Constructs a new simplify modifier without a simplifier runtime.
   */
  constructor() {
    this.simplifier = null;
  }

  /**
   * Sets the meshoptimizer simplifier runtime used for `modify()`.
   *
   * @param simplifier - The `MeshoptSimplifier` export of the vendor module, or `null` to clear it.
   * @return A reference to this modifier.
   */
  setSimplifier(simplifier: MeshoptSimplifierLike | null): this {
    this.simplifier = simplifier;
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * Returns a new, simplified version of the given geometry. The vertex buffers
   * of the result only contain vertices referenced by the simplified index.
   *
   * @param geometry - The geometry to modify.
   * @param count - The approximate number of vertices to remove.
   * @return A promise that resolves with the new, modified geometry.
   */
  async modify(geometry: BufferGeometry, count: number): Promise<BufferGeometry> {
    const simplifier = this.simplifier;
    if (simplifier === null || simplifier.supported !== true) {
      throw new Error(
        "SimplifyModifier: setSimplifier() must be called with a supported meshoptimizer simplifier before modify() (vendor runtime supplied by the consumer).",
      );
    }

    await simplifier.ready;

    // non-indexed geometries must be welded so the simplifier can collapse edges

    if (geometry.getIndex() === null) geometry = mergeVertices(geometry);

    const index = geometry.getIndex();
    if (index === null) throw new Error("SimplifyModifier: the geometry has no index after welding.");

    const positionAttribute = readAttribute(geometry, "position");
    if (positionAttribute === undefined) {
      throw new Error("SimplifyModifier: the geometry needs a CPU-readable position attribute.");
    }

    // the simplifier requires tightly packed positions

    const positions = new Float32Array(positionAttribute.count * 3);

    for (let i = 0; i < positionAttribute.count; i++) {
      positions[i * 3 + 0] = positionAttribute.getX(i);
      positions[i * 3 + 1] = positionAttribute.getY(i);
      positions[i * 3 + 2] = positionAttribute.getZ(i);
    }

    const ratio = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, 1 - count / positionAttribute.count));
    const targetIndexCount = Math.max(3, Math.floor((index.count * ratio) / 3) * 3);

    // normals and uvs, when present, contribute to the error metric so collapses
    // that would distort shading or texture seams are penalized

    const normalAttribute = readAttribute(geometry, "normal");
    const uvAttribute = readAttribute(geometry, "uv");
    const attributeStride = (normalAttribute ? 3 : 0) + (uvAttribute ? 2 : 0);

    let indices: IndexArray;
    const sourceIndices = toSimplifierIndices(index.array);

    if (attributeStride > 0) {
      const vertexAttributes = new Float32Array(positionAttribute.count * attributeStride);
      const attributeWeights: number[] = [];

      if (normalAttribute) attributeWeights.push(0.25, 0.25, 0.25);
      if (uvAttribute) attributeWeights.push(0.5, 0.5);

      for (let i = 0, o = 0; i < positionAttribute.count; i++) {
        if (normalAttribute) {
          vertexAttributes[o++] = normalAttribute.getX(i);
          vertexAttributes[o++] = normalAttribute.getY(i);
          vertexAttributes[o++] = normalAttribute.getZ(i);
        }

        if (uvAttribute) {
          vertexAttributes[o++] = uvAttribute.getX(i);
          vertexAttributes[o++] = uvAttribute.getY(i);
        }
      }

      indices = simplifier.simplifyWithAttributes(
        sourceIndices,
        positions,
        3,
        vertexAttributes,
        attributeStride,
        attributeWeights,
        null,
        targetIndexCount,
        1,
      )[0];
    } else {
      indices = simplifier.simplify(sourceIndices, positions, 3, targetIndexCount, 1)[0];
    }

    // drop vertices that are no longer referenced and rebuild the attributes

    const [remap, unique] = simplifier.compactMesh(indices); // rewrites indices in place

    const simplifiedGeometry = new BufferGeometry();

    for (const name in geometry.attributes) {
      const attribute = readAttribute(geometry, name);
      if (attribute === undefined) {
        throw new Error(`SimplifyModifier: attribute "${name}" is not CPU-readable.`);
      }

      const itemSize = attribute.itemSize;
      const Constructor = attribute.array.constructor as AttributeArrayConstructor;
      const newAttribute = new BufferAttribute(new Constructor(unique * itemSize), itemSize, attribute.normalized);

      // scatter each vertex to its new slot; 0xffffffff marks unreferenced vertices

      for (let i = 0; i < remap.length; i++) {
        const target = remap[i];

        if (target === 0xffffffff) continue;

        for (let k = 0; k < itemSize; k++) newAttribute.setComponent(target, k, attribute.getComponent(i, k));
      }

      simplifiedGeometry.setAttribute(name, newAttribute);
    }

    simplifiedGeometry.setIndex(new BufferAttribute(indices, 1));

    return simplifiedGeometry;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/modifiers/TessellateModifier

```typescript
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { BufferAttribute, Float32BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";

/** Splits the longest edge of each triangle until it is short enough. */
export class TessellateModifier {
  maxEdgeLength: number;
  maxIterations: number;

  constructor(maxEdgeLength = 0.1, maxIterations = 6) {
    this.maxEdgeLength = maxEdgeLength;
    this.maxIterations = maxIterations;
  }

  modify(geometry: BufferGeometry): BufferGeometry {
    const source = geometry.index === null ? geometry : geometry.toNonIndexed();
    const names = ["position", "normal", "color", "uv", "uv1"].filter(
      (name) => source.getAttribute(name) !== undefined,
    );
    let arrays = names.map((name) =>
      Array.from((source.getAttribute(name) as BufferAttribute).array as ArrayLike<number>),
    );
    const sizes = names.map((name) => (name === "uv" || name === "uv1" ? 2 : 3));
    const maxSquared = this.maxEdgeLength * this.maxEdgeLength;
    for (let iteration = 0; iteration < this.maxIterations; iteration++) {
      const next = names.map((): number[] => []);
      let split = false;
      const positions = arrays[0];
      for (let face = 0; face < positions.length / 9; face++) {
        const distance = (a: number, b: number): number => {
          const i = face * 9 + a * 3,
            j = face * 9 + b * 3;
          return (
            (positions[i] - positions[j]) ** 2 +
            (positions[i + 1] - positions[j + 1]) ** 2 +
            (positions[i + 2] - positions[j + 2]) ** 2
          );
        };
        const ab = distance(0, 1),
          bc = distance(1, 2),
          ac = distance(0, 2);
        let triangles = [0, 1, 2];
        let edge = [0, 1];
        if (ab > maxSquared || bc > maxSquared || ac > maxSquared) {
          split = true;
          if (ab >= bc && ab >= ac) triangles = [0, 3, 2, 3, 1, 2];
          else if (bc >= ab && bc >= ac) {
            edge = [1, 2];
            triangles = [0, 1, 3, 3, 2, 0];
          } else {
            edge = [0, 2];
            triangles = [0, 1, 3, 3, 1, 2];
          }
        }
        for (let attribute = 0; attribute < names.length; attribute++) {
          const values = arrays[attribute],
            size = sizes[attribute],
            offset = face * 3 * size;
          for (const vertex of triangles)
            for (let component = 0; component < size; component++) {
              next[attribute].push(
                vertex === 3
                  ? (values[offset + edge[0] * size + component] + values[offset + edge[1] * size + component]) / 2
                  : values[offset + vertex * size + component],
              );
            }
        }
      }
      arrays = next;
      if (!split) break;
    }
    const result = new BufferGeometry();
    names.forEach((name, i) => result.setAttribute(name, new Float32BufferAttribute(arrays[i], sizes[i])));
    if (source !== geometry) source.dispose();
    return result;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/objects/EnhancedBatchedMesh

```typescript
import { CoordinateSystem } from "../../constants";
import type { Camera } from "../../cameras/Camera";
import type { PerspectiveCamera } from "../../cameras/PerspectiveCamera";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { Intersection, Raycaster } from "../../core/Raycaster";
import type { Material, MaterialProperties } from "../../materials/Material";
import { Box3 } from "../../math/Box3";
import { Frustum } from "../../math/Frustum";
import { Matrix4 } from "../../math/Matrix4";
import { Ray } from "../../math/Ray";
import { Sphere } from "../../math/Sphere";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import { BatchedMesh, type BatchedMeshDrawRange, type BatchedMeshSortFunction } from "../../objects/BatchedMesh";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import { MeshBasicMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshBasicMaterial";
import { BatchBVH, type BatchBVHNode } from "../math/bvh/BatchBVH";
import { MeshBVH, type MeshBVHOptions } from "../math/bvh/core/MeshBVH";
import { acceleratedRaycast, computeBatchedBoundsTree, type BVHGeometry } from "../math/bvh/utils/ExtensionUtilities";
import { radixSort } from "../utils/SortUtils";

export interface BatchLOD {
  start: number;
  count: number;
  metric: number;
  metricSquared: number;
}

const box = new Box3();
const sphere = new Sphere();
const matrix = new Matrix4();
const projection = new Matrix4();
const inverse = new Matrix4();
const cameraPosition = new Vector3();
const forward = new Vector3();
const frustum = new Frustum();
const localRay = new Ray();
const rayMesh = new Mesh<Material | Material[]>(new BufferGeometry(), new MeshBasicMaterial());
const hits: Intersection[] = [];

export class BatchedMeshBVH {
  readonly target: EnhancedBatchedMesh;
  readonly bvh: BatchBVH;
  readonly nodesMap: Map<number, BatchBVHNode> = new Map();
  readonly margin: number;
  accurateCulling: boolean;
  private readonly origin: Float32Array = new Float32Array(3);
  private readonly direction: Float32Array = new Float32Array(3);
  private readonly boxArray: Float32Array = new Float32Array(6);

  constructor(target: EnhancedBatchedMesh, coordinateSystem: CoordinateSystem, margin = 0, accurateCulling = true) {
    this.target = target;
    this.bvh = new BatchBVH(coordinateSystem);
    this.margin = margin;
    this.accurateCulling = accurateCulling;
  }
  private getBox(id: number, array: Float32Array): Float32Array {
    const info = this.target._instanceInfo[id];
    this.target.getBoundingBoxAt(info.geometryIndex, box)!.applyMatrix4(this.target.getMatrixAt(id, matrix));
    array[0] = box.min.x;
    array[1] = box.max.x;
    array[2] = box.min.y;
    array[3] = box.max.y;
    array[4] = box.min.z;
    array[5] = box.max.z;
    return array;
  }
  create(): void {
    this.clear();
    const objects = new Uint32Array(this.target.instanceCount);
    const boxes: Float32Array[] = [];
    let count = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.target._instanceInfo.length; i++) {
      if (!this.target._instanceInfo[i].active) continue;
      objects[count++] = i;
      boxes.push(this.getBox(i, new Float32Array(6)));
    }
    this.bvh.createFromArray(objects, boxes, (node) => this.nodesMap.set(node.object, node), this.margin);
  }
  insert(id: number): void {
    this.nodesMap.set(id, this.bvh.insert(id, this.getBox(id, new Float32Array(6)), this.margin));
  }
  insertRange(ids: ArrayLike<number>): void {
    const boxes: Float32Array[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) boxes.push(this.getBox(ids[i], new Float32Array(6)));
    this.bvh.insertRange(ids, boxes, this.margin, (node) => this.nodesMap.set(node.object, node));
  }
  move(id: number): void {
    const node = this.nodesMap.get(id);
    if (node) {
      this.getBox(id, node.box);
      this.bvh.move(node, this.margin);
    }
  }
  delete(id: number): void {
    const node = this.nodesMap.get(id);
    if (node) {
      this.bvh.delete(node);
      this.nodesMap.delete(id);
    }
  }
  clear(): void {
    this.bvh.clear();
    this.nodesMap.clear();
  }
  frustumCulling(
    proj: Matrix4,
    callback: (node: BatchBVHNode) => void,
    coordinateSystem = this.bvh.frustum.coordinateSystem,
    reversedDepth = false,
  ): void {
    this.bvh.frustumCulling(
      proj.elements,
      (node, f, mask) => {
        if (!this.accurateCulling || this.margin <= 0 || f.isIntersectedMargin(node.box, mask, this.margin))
          callback(node);
      },
      coordinateSystem,
      reversedDepth,
    );
  }
  raycast(ray: Ray, callback: (id: number) => void): void {
    ray.origin.toArray(this.origin);
    ray.direction.toArray(this.direction);
    this.bvh.rayIntersections(this.direction, this.origin, callback);
  }
  intersectBox(target: Box3, callback: (id: number) => boolean): boolean {
    const a = this.boxArray;
    a[0] = target.min.x;
    a[1] = target.max.x;
    a[2] = target.min.y;
    a[3] = target.max.y;
    a[4] = target.min.z;
    a[5] = target.max.z;
    return this.bvh.intersectsBox(a, callback);
  }
}

export class EnhancedBatchedMesh extends BatchedMesh {
  bvh: BatchedMeshBVH | null = null;
  boundsTrees: (MeshBVH | null)[] = [];
  useDistanceForLOD: boolean = false;
  onFrustumEnter: ((id: number, camera: Camera, cameraLOD?: Camera, lodIndex?: number) => boolean) | null = null;
  private readonly lods: Map<number, BatchLOD[] | null> = new Map();
  private readonly drawList: BatchedMeshDrawRange[] = [];
  private readonly drawPool: BatchedMeshDrawRange[] = [];

  addInstance(geometryId: number): number {
    const id = super.addInstance(geometryId);
    this.boundingBox = null;
    this.boundingSphere = null;
    this.bvh?.insert(id);
    return id;
  }
  setMatrixAt(instanceId: number, value: Matrix4): this {
    super.setMatrixAt(instanceId, value);
    this.boundingBox = null;
    this.boundingSphere = null;
    this.bvh?.move(instanceId);
    this._visibilityChanged = true;
    return this;
  }
  deleteInstance(instanceId: number): this {
    super.deleteInstance(instanceId);
    this.boundingBox = null;
    this.boundingSphere = null;
    this.bvh?.delete(instanceId);
    return this;
  }
  setGeometryIdAt(instanceId: number, geometryId: number): this {
    super.setGeometryIdAt(instanceId, geometryId);
    this.boundingBox = null;
    this.boundingSphere = null;
    this.bvh?.move(instanceId);
    return this;
  }
  setGeometryAt(geometryId: number, geometry: BufferGeometry): number {
    const id = super.setGeometryAt(geometryId, geometry);
    this.boundingBox = null;
    this.boundingSphere = null;
    this.lods.delete(id);
    this.boundsTrees[id] = null;
    if (this.bvh) {
      for (let i = 0; i < this._instanceInfo.length; i++) {
        const instance = this._instanceInfo[i];
        if (instance.active && instance.geometryIndex === id) this.bvh.move(i);
      }
    }
    return id;
  }
  deleteGeometry(geometryId: number): this {
    super.deleteGeometry(geometryId);
    this.lods.delete(geometryId);
    this.boundsTrees[geometryId] = null;
    return this;
  }
  optimize(): this {
    const starts = this._geometryInfo.map((info) => info.start);
    super.optimize();
    for (const [id, levels] of this.lods) {
      if (levels) {
        const delta = this._geometryInfo[id].start - starts[id];
        for (const level of levels) level.start += delta;
      }
    }
    this.boundsTrees.fill(null);
    return this;
  }
  setGeometrySize(maxVertexCount: number, maxIndexCount: number): void {
    super.setGeometrySize(maxVertexCount, maxIndexCount);
    this.boundsTrees.fill(null);
  }
  copy(source: BatchedMesh, recursive = true): this {
    if (source === this) return this;
    super.copy(source, recursive);
    this.bvh = null;
    this.boundsTrees = [];
    this.lods.clear();
    if (source instanceof EnhancedBatchedMesh) {
      for (const [id, levels] of source.lods) {
        this.lods.set(id, levels?.map((level) => ({ ...level })) ?? null);
      }
      this.useDistanceForLOD = source.useDistanceForLOD;
      this.onFrustumEnter = source.onFrustumEnter;
    } else {
      this.useDistanceForLOD = false;
      this.onFrustumEnter = null;
    }
    return this;
  }

  computeBVH(coordinateSystem: CoordinateSystem, config: { margin?: number; accurateCulling?: boolean } = {}): void {
    this.bvh = new BatchedMeshBVH(this, coordinateSystem, config.margin, config.accurateCulling);
    this.bvh.create();
  }
  computeBoundsTree(index = -1, options: MeshBVHOptions = {}): MeshBVH | (MeshBVH | null)[] | null {
    return computeBatchedBoundsTree.call(this, index, options);
  }
  getGeometryLOD(id: number): BatchLOD[] | null {
    return this.lods.get(id) ?? null;
  }
  setGeometryLOD(id: number, levels: BatchLOD[] | null): void {
    this.lods.set(id, levels);
    this._visibilityChanged = true;
  }
  addGeometryLOD(id: number, geometry: BufferGeometry | ArrayLike<number>, metric: number): void {
    const info = this._geometryInfo[id];
    const source =
      "isBufferGeometry" in geometry ? (geometry as BufferGeometry).getIndex()!.array : (geometry as ArrayLike<number>);
    const levels = this.getGeometryLOD(id) ?? [
      { start: info.start, count: info.count, metric: Infinity, metricSquared: Infinity },
    ];
    const last = levels[levels.length - 1];
    const start = last.start + last.count;
    if (start - info.start + source.length > info.reservedIndexCount)
      throw new Error("BatchedMesh LOD: Reserved space request exceeds the maximum buffer size.");
    const index = this.geometry.getIndex();
    if (!index) throw new Error("BatchedMesh LOD requires indexed geometry.");
    for (let i = 0; i < source.length; i++) index.array[start + i] = source[i] + info.vertexStart;
    index.addUpdateRange(start, source.length);
    index.needsUpdate = true;
    levels.push({ start, count: source.length, metric, metricSquared: metric * metric });
    this.setGeometryLOD(id, levels);
  }
  getLODIndex(levels: BatchLOD[], metric: number, squared = false): number {
    for (let i = levels.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const threshold = squared ? levels[i].metricSquared : levels[i].metric;
      if (this.useDistanceForLOD ? metric >= threshold : metric <= threshold) return i;
    }
    return 0;
  }
  _updateDrawParameters(camera: Camera, geometry: BufferGeometry, material: Material): void {
    if (!this._visibilityChanged && !this.perObjectFrustumCulled && !this.sortObjects && this.lods.size === 0) return;
    const index = geometry.getIndex();
    let bytes = index ? index.array.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT : 1;
    let multiplier = 1;
    if ((material as Material & MaterialProperties).wireframe) {
      multiplier = 2;
      bytes = geometry.getAttribute("position")!.count > 65535 ? 4 : 2;
    }
    inverse.copy(this.matrixWorld).invert();
    cameraPosition.setFromMatrixPosition(camera.matrixWorld).applyMatrix4(inverse);
    forward.set(0, 0, -1).transformDirection(camera.matrixWorld).transformDirection(inverse);
    projection.multiplyMatrices(camera.projectionMatrix, camera.matrixWorldInverse).multiply(this.matrixWorld);
    frustum.setFromProjectionMatrix(projection, camera.coordinateSystem, camera.reversedDepth);
    const perspective = camera as PerspectiveCamera;
    const isPerspective = perspective.isPerspectiveCamera === true;
    const projectionScale = camera.projectionMatrix.elements[5];
    const viewSize = 2 / projectionScale;
    const indirect = this._indirectTexture!;
    const array = indirect.image.data!;
    const list = this.drawList;
    let count = 0;
    const add = (id: number): void => {
      const instance = this._instanceInfo[id];
      if (!instance.active || !instance.visible) return;
      const info = this._geometryInfo[instance.geometryIndex];
      this.getBoundingSphereAt(instance.geometryIndex, sphere)!.applyMatrix4(this.getMatrixAt(id, matrix));
      if (this.perObjectFrustumCulled && !this.bvh && !frustum.intersectsSphere(sphere)) return;
      let start = info.start,
        length = info.count;
      const levels = this.getGeometryLOD(instance.geometryIndex);
      if (levels) {
        const distance = sphere.center.distanceToSquared(cameraPosition);
        if (!isPerspective && this.useDistanceForLOD)
          throw new Error("BatchedMesh: useDistanceForLOD cannot be used with orthographic camera.");
        const metric = isPerspective
          ? this.useDistanceForLOD
            ? distance
            : (sphere.radius ** 2 * projectionScale ** 2) / distance
          : (sphere.radius * 2) / viewSize;
        const lod = this.getLODIndex(levels, metric, isPerspective);
        if (this.onFrustumEnter && !this.onFrustumEnter(id, camera, camera, lod)) return;
        start = levels[lod].start;
        length = levels[lod].count;
      } else if (this.onFrustumEnter && !this.onFrustumEnter(id, camera)) return;
      if (this.sortObjects) {
        const item =
          this.drawPool[list.length] ?? (this.drawPool[list.length] = { start: 0, count: 0, z: 0, index: 0 });
        item.start = start;
        item.count = length;
        item.index = id;
        item.z = sphere.center.sub(cameraPosition).dot(forward);
        list.push(item);
      } else {
        this._multiDrawStarts[count] = start * bytes * multiplier;
        this._multiDrawCounts[count] = length * multiplier;
        array[count++] = id;
      }
    };
    if (this.perObjectFrustumCulled && this.bvh)
      this.bvh.frustumCulling(projection, (node) => add(node.object), camera.coordinateSystem, camera.reversedDepth);
    else for (let i = 0; i < this._instanceInfo.length; i++) add(i);
    if (this.sortObjects) {
      if (this.customSort) this.customSort.call(this, list, camera);
      else list.sort(material.transparent ? (a, b) => b.z - a.z : (a, b) => a.z - b.z);
      for (const item of list) {
        this._multiDrawStarts[count] = item.start * bytes * multiplier;
        this._multiDrawCounts[count] = item.count * multiplier;
        array[count++] = item.index;
      }
      list.length = 0;
    }
    indirect.needsUpdate = true;
    this._multiDrawCount = count;
    this._multiDrawBytesPerElement = bytes;
    this._visibilityChanged = false;
  }
  raycast(raycaster: Raycaster, result: Intersection[]): void {
    const geometry = this.geometry as BVHGeometry;
    const oldTree = geometry.boundsTree,
      oldBox = geometry.boundingBox,
      oldSphere = geometry.boundingSphere;
    const oldStart = geometry.drawRange.start,
      oldCount = geometry.drawRange.count;
    const oldGeometry = rayMesh.geometry,
      oldMaterial = rayMesh.material;
    rayMesh.geometry = geometry;
    rayMesh.material = this.material;
    const check = (id: number): void => {
      const instance = this._instanceInfo[id];
      if (!instance.active || !instance.visible) return;
      const geometryId = instance.geometryIndex;
      geometry.boundsTree = this.boundsTrees[geometryId];
      this.getMatrixAt(id, rayMesh.matrixWorld).premultiply(this.matrixWorld);
      if (!geometry.boundsTree) {
        geometry.boundingBox = box;
        geometry.boundingSphere = sphere;
        this.getBoundingBoxAt(geometryId, box);
        this.getBoundingSphereAt(geometryId, sphere);
        const info = this._geometryInfo[geometryId];
        geometry.setDrawRange(info.start, info.count);
      }
      acceleratedRaycast.call(rayMesh, raycaster, hits);
      for (const hit of hits) {
        hit.object = this;
        hit.batchId = id;
        result.push(hit);
      }
      hits.length = 0;
    };
    try {
      if (this.bvh) {
        inverse.copy(this.matrixWorld).invert();
        localRay.copy(raycaster.ray).applyMatrix4(inverse);
        this.bvh.raycast(localRay, check);
      } else for (let i = 0; i < this._instanceInfo.length; i++) check(i);
    } finally {
      hits.length = 0;
      geometry.boundsTree = oldTree;
      geometry.boundingBox = oldBox;
      geometry.boundingSphere = oldSphere;
      geometry.drawRange.start = oldStart;
      geometry.drawRange.count = oldCount;
      rayMesh.geometry = oldGeometry;
      rayMesh.material = oldMaterial;
    }
  }
}

export function getBatchedMeshLODCount(geometryLOD: BufferGeometry[][]): {
  vertexCount: number;
  indexCount: number;
  LODIndexCount: number[];
} {
  let vertexCount = 0,
    indexCount = 0;
  const LODIndexCount: number[] = [];
  for (const geometries of geometryLOD) {
    let count = 0;
    for (const geometry of geometries) {
      const n = geometry.getIndex()!.count;
      count += n;
      indexCount += n;
      vertexCount += geometry.getAttribute("position")!.count;
    }
    LODIndexCount.push(count);
  }
  return { vertexCount, indexCount, LODIndexCount };
}

export function createRadixSort(target: BatchedMesh): BatchedMeshSortFunction {
  const aux: BatchedMeshDrawRange[] = [];
  return function (list): void {
    let min = Infinity,
      max = -Infinity;
    for (const item of list) {
      min = Math.min(min, item.z);
      max = Math.max(max, item.z);
    }
    const factor = max === min ? 0 : 0xffffffff / (max - min);
    for (const item of list) (item as BatchedMeshDrawRange & { zSort: number }).zSort = (item.z - min) * factor;
    const material = Array.isArray(target.material) ? target.material[0] : target.material;
    radixSort(list, {
      aux,
      get: (item) => (item as BatchedMeshDrawRange & { zSort: number }).zSort,
      reversed: material.transparent,
    });
  };
}
```

## ek3d/addons/objects/GroundedSkybox

````typescript
import { MeshBasicMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshBasicMaterial";
import type { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import { SphereGeometry } from "../../geometries/SphereGeometry";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import type { Texture } from "../../textures/Texture";

/**
 * A ground-projected skybox.
 *
 * By default the object is centered at the camera, so it is often helpful to set
 * `skybox.position.y = height` to put the ground at the origin.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const height = 15, radius = 100;
 *
 * const skybox = new GroundedSkybox( envMap, height, radius );
 * skybox.position.y = height;
 * scene.add( skybox );
 * ```
 *
 * @augments Mesh
 */
export class GroundedSkybox extends Mesh<MeshBasicMaterial> {
  /**
   * Constructs a new ground-projected skybox.
   *
   * @param map - The environment map to use.
   * @param height - The height is how far the camera that took the photo was above the ground.
   * A larger value will magnify the downward part of the image.
   * @param radius - The radius of the skybox. Must be large enough to ensure the scene's camera stays inside.
   * @param resolution - The geometry resolution of the skybox.
   */
  constructor(map: Texture, height: number, radius: number, resolution: number = 128) {
    if (height <= 0 || radius <= 0 || resolution <= 0) {
      throw new Error("THREE.GroundedSkybox: height, radius, and resolution must be positive.");
    }

    const geometry = new SphereGeometry(radius, 2 * resolution, resolution);
    geometry.scale(1, 1, -1);

    const pos = geometry.getAttribute("position") as BufferAttribute;
    const tmp = new Vector3();

    for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; ++i) {
      tmp.fromBufferAttribute(pos, i);
      if (tmp.y < 0) {
        // Smooth out the transition from flat floor to sphere:
        const y1 = (-height * 3) / 2;
        const f = tmp.y < y1 ? -height / tmp.y : 1 - (tmp.y * tmp.y) / (3 * y1 * y1);
        tmp.multiplyScalar(f);
        tmp.toArray(pos.array, 3 * i);
      }
    }

    pos.needsUpdate = true;

    super(geometry, new MeshBasicMaterial({ map, depthWrite: false }));
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/objects/Lensflare

```typescript
import type { Camera } from "../../cameras/Camera";
import type { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";
import { Blending, TextureType } from "../../constants";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { InterleavedBuffer } from "../../core/InterleavedBuffer";
import { InterleavedBufferAttribute } from "../../core/InterleavedBufferAttribute";
import { MeshBasicMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshBasicMaterial";
import { RawShaderMaterial } from "../../materials/RawShaderMaterial";

import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Vector2 } from "../../math/Vector2";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import { Vector4 } from "../../math/Vector4";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import { FramebufferTexture } from "../../textures/FramebufferTexture";
import type { Texture } from "../../textures/Texture";

/** A flare texture, pixel size, normalized distance from the light and color. */
export class LensflareElement {
  static Shader: {
    name: string;
    uniforms: Record<string, { value: null }>;
    vertexShader: string;
    fragmentShader: string;
  } = {
    name: "LensflareElementShader",
    uniforms: {
      map: { value: null },
      occlusionMap: { value: null },
      color: { value: null },
      scale: { value: null },
      screenPosition: { value: null },
    },
    vertexShader: /* glsl */ `
        precision highp float;
        uniform vec3 screenPosition;
        uniform vec2 scale;
        uniform sampler2D occlusionMap;
        attribute vec3 position;
        attribute vec2 uv;
        varying vec2 vUV;
        varying float vVisibility;
        void main() {
          vUV = uv;
          vec2 pos = position.xy;
          vec4 visibility = texture2D( occlusionMap, vec2( 0.1, 0.1 ) );
          visibility += texture2D( occlusionMap, vec2( 0.5, 0.1 ) );
          visibility += texture2D( occlusionMap, vec2( 0.9, 0.1 ) );
          visibility += texture2D( occlusionMap, vec2( 0.9, 0.5 ) );
          visibility += texture2D( occlusionMap, vec2( 0.9, 0.9 ) );
          visibility += texture2D( occlusionMap, vec2( 0.5, 0.9 ) );
          visibility += texture2D( occlusionMap, vec2( 0.1, 0.9 ) );
          visibility += texture2D( occlusionMap, vec2( 0.1, 0.5 ) );
          visibility += texture2D( occlusionMap, vec2( 0.5, 0.5 ) );
          vVisibility = visibility.r / 9.0;
          vVisibility *= 1.0 - visibility.g / 9.0;
          vVisibility *= visibility.b / 9.0;
          gl_Position = vec4( ( pos * scale + screenPosition.xy ).xy, screenPosition.z, 1.0 );
        }`,
    fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `
        precision highp float;
        uniform sampler2D map;
        uniform vec3 color;
        varying vec2 vUV;
        varying float vVisibility;
        void main() {
          vec4 texture = texture2D( map, vUV );
          texture.a *= vVisibility;
          gl_FragColor = texture;
          gl_FragColor.rgb *= color;
        }`,
  };
  texture: Texture;
  size: number;
  distance: number;
  color: Color;

  constructor(texture: Texture, size = 1, distance = 0, color = new Color(0xffffff)) {
    this.texture = texture;
    this.size = size;
    this.distance = distance;
    this.color = color;
  }
}

/** A WebGL lens flare that tracks its world position and is occluded by scene depth.
 * Dispose the instance when finished; its element textures are also disposed.
 */
export class Lensflare extends Mesh<MeshBasicMaterial> {
  static Geometry: BufferGeometry = (() => {
    const geometry = new BufferGeometry();
    const buffer = new InterleavedBuffer(
      new Float32Array([-1, -1, 0, 0, 0, 1, -1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1, -1, 1, 0, 0, 1]),
      5,
    );
    geometry.setIndex([0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3]);
    geometry.setAttribute("position", new InterleavedBufferAttribute(buffer, 3, 0, false));
    geometry.setAttribute("uv", new InterleavedBufferAttribute(buffer, 2, 3, false));
    return geometry;
  })();
  readonly isLensflare: boolean = true;
  addElement: (element: LensflareElement) => void;
  dispose: () => void;

  constructor() {
    super(Lensflare.Geometry, new MeshBasicMaterial({ opacity: 0, transparent: true }));
    this.type = "Lensflare";
    this.frustumCulled = false;
    this.renderOrder = Infinity;
    const positionScreen = new Vector3(),
      positionView = new Vector3();
    const tempMap = new FramebufferTexture(16, 16),
      occlusionMap = new FramebufferTexture(16, 16);
    let currentType: number = TextureType.UnsignedByte;
    const geometry = Lensflare.Geometry;
    const material1a = new RawShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: { scale: { value: null }, screenPosition: { value: null } },
      vertexShader: /* glsl */ `
        precision highp float;
        uniform vec3 screenPosition;
        uniform vec2 scale;
        attribute vec3 position;
        void main() { gl_Position = vec4( position.xy * scale + screenPosition.xy, screenPosition.z, 1.0 ); }`,
      fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `
        precision highp float;
        void main() { gl_FragColor = vec4( 1.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0 ); }`,
      depthTest: true,
      depthWrite: false,
      transparent: false,
    });
    const material1b = new RawShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: { map: { value: tempMap }, scale: { value: null }, screenPosition: { value: null } },
      vertexShader: /* glsl */ `
        precision highp float;
        uniform vec3 screenPosition;
        uniform vec2 scale;
        attribute vec3 position;
        attribute vec2 uv;
        varying vec2 vUV;
        void main() { vUV = uv; gl_Position = vec4( position.xy * scale + screenPosition.xy, screenPosition.z, 1.0 ); }`,
      fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `
        precision highp float;
        uniform sampler2D map;
        varying vec2 vUV;
        void main() { gl_FragColor = texture2D( map, vUV ); }`,
      depthTest: false,
      depthWrite: false,
      transparent: false,
    });
    const mesh1 = new Mesh(geometry, material1a);
    const elements: LensflareElement[] = [];
    const shader = LensflareElement.Shader;
    const elementColor = new Color(0xffffff),
      elementScale = new Vector2(),
      elementPosition = new Vector3();
    const material2 = new RawShaderMaterial({
      name: shader.name,
      uniforms: {
        map: { value: null },
        occlusionMap: { value: occlusionMap },
        color: { value: elementColor },
        scale: { value: elementScale },
        screenPosition: { value: elementPosition },
      },
      vertexShader: shader.vertexShader,
      fragmentShader: shader.fragmentShader,
      blending: Blending.Additive,
      transparent: true,
      depthWrite: false,
    });
    const mesh2 = new Mesh(geometry, material2);
    this.addElement = (element: LensflareElement): void => {
      elements.push(element);
    };
    const scale = new Vector2(),
      screenPositionPixels = new Vector2(),
      validArea = new Box2(),
      viewport = new Vector4();
    this.onBeforeRender = (renderer: WebGLRenderer, _scene: Object3D, camera: Camera): void => {
      renderer.getCurrentViewport(viewport);
      const renderTarget = renderer.getRenderTarget();
      const type = renderTarget !== null ? renderTarget.texture.type : TextureType.UnsignedByte;
      if (currentType !== type) {
        tempMap.dispose();
        occlusionMap.dispose();
        tempMap.type = occlusionMap.type = type;
        currentType = type;
      }
      const invAspect = viewport.w / viewport.z;
      const halfWidth = viewport.z / 2,
        halfHeight = viewport.w / 2;
      let size = 16 / viewport.w;
      scale.set(size * invAspect, size);
      validArea.min.set(viewport.x, viewport.y);
      validArea.max.set(viewport.x + viewport.z - 16, viewport.y + viewport.w - 16);
      positionView.setFromMatrixPosition(this.matrixWorld).applyMatrix4(camera.matrixWorldInverse);
      if (positionView.z > 0) return;
      positionScreen.copy(positionView).applyMatrix4(camera.projectionMatrix);
      screenPositionPixels.set(
        viewport.x + positionScreen.x * halfWidth + halfWidth - 8,
        viewport.y + positionScreen.y * halfHeight + halfHeight - 8,
      );
      if (!validArea.containsPoint(screenPositionPixels)) return;
      renderer.copyFramebufferToTexture(tempMap, screenPositionPixels);
      material1a.uniforms.scale.value = scale;
      material1a.uniforms.screenPosition.value = positionScreen;
      renderer.renderBufferDirect(camera, null, geometry, material1a, mesh1, null);
      renderer.copyFramebufferToTexture(occlusionMap, screenPositionPixels);
      material1b.uniforms.scale.value = scale;
      material1b.uniforms.screenPosition.value = positionScreen;
      renderer.renderBufferDirect(camera, null, geometry, material1b, mesh1, null);
      const vecX = -positionScreen.x * 2,
        vecY = -positionScreen.y * 2;
      for (const element of elements) {
        elementColor.copy(element.color);
        material2.uniforms.map.value = element.texture;
        elementPosition.x = positionScreen.x + vecX * element.distance;
        elementPosition.y = positionScreen.y + vecY * element.distance;
        size = element.size / viewport.w;
        elementScale.set(size * invAspect, size);
        material2.uniformsNeedUpdate = true;
        renderer.renderBufferDirect(camera, null, geometry, material2, mesh2, null);
      }
    };
    this.dispose = (): void => {
      material1a.dispose();
      material1b.dispose();
      material2.dispose();
      this.material.dispose();
      tempMap.dispose();
      occlusionMap.dispose();
      for (const element of elements) element.texture.dispose();
    };
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/objects/MarchingCubes

```typescript
import { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { BufferUsage } from "../../constants";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Sphere } from "../../math/Sphere";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import type { Material } from "../../materials/Material";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";

/**
 * A marching cubes implementation.
 *
 * Port of: {@link http://webglsamples.org/blob/blob.html}
 *
 */
export class MarchingCubes extends Mesh<Material> {
  isMarchingCubes: boolean = true;
  enableUvs: boolean;
  enableColors: boolean;
  resolution: number = 0;
  isolation: number = 80;
  size: number = 0;
  size2: number = 0;
  size3: number = 0;
  halfsize: number = 0;
  delta: number = 0;
  yd: number = 0;
  zd: number = 0;
  count: number = 0;
  field: Float32Array = new Float32Array(0);
  normal_cache: Float32Array = new Float32Array(0);
  palette: Float32Array = new Float32Array(0);
  positionArray: Float32Array = new Float32Array(0);
  normalArray: Float32Array = new Float32Array(0);
  uvArray: Float32Array = new Float32Array(0);
  colorArray: Float32Array = new Float32Array(0);
  init: (resolution: number) => void;
  addBall: (
    x: number,
    y: number,
    z: number,
    strength: number,
    subtract: number,
    colors?: Color | number | string | [number, number, number] | null,
  ) => void;
  addPlaneX: (strength: number, subtract: number) => void;
  addPlaneY: (strength: number, subtract: number) => void;
  addPlaneZ: (strength: number, subtract: number) => void;
  setCell: (x: number, y: number, z: number, value: number) => void;
  getCell: (x: number, y: number, z: number) => number;
  blur: (intensity?: number) => void;
  reset: () => void;
  update: () => void;

  /**
   * Constructs a new marching cubes instance.
   *
   * @param resolution - The effect's resolution.
   * @param material - The cube's material.
   * @param [enableUvs=false] - Whether texture coordinates should be animated or not.
   * @param [enableColors=false] - Whether colors should be animated or not.
   * @param [maxPolyCount=10000] - The maximum size of the geometry buffers.
   */
  constructor(resolution: number, material: Material, enableUvs = false, enableColors = false, maxPolyCount = 10000) {
    const geometry = new BufferGeometry();

    super(geometry, material);

    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isMarchingCubes = true;

    // temp buffers used in polygonize

    const vlist = new Float32Array(12 * 3);
    const nlist = new Float32Array(12 * 3);
    const clist = new Float32Array(12 * 3);

    /**
     * Whether texture coordinates should be animated or not.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.enableUvs = enableUvs;

    /**
     * Whether colors should be animated or not.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.enableColors = enableColors;

    // functions have to be object properties
    // prototype functions kill performance
    // (tested and it was 4x slower !!!)

    this.init = (resolution: number) => {
      if (this.positionArray.length) geometry.dispose();

      this.resolution = resolution;

      // parameters

      this.isolation = 80.0;

      // size of field, 32 is pushing it in Javascript :)

      this.size = resolution;
      this.size2 = this.size * this.size;
      this.size3 = this.size2 * this.size;
      this.halfsize = this.size / 2.0;

      // deltas

      this.delta = 2.0 / this.size;
      this.yd = this.size;
      this.zd = this.size2;

      this.field = new Float32Array(this.size3);
      this.normal_cache = new Float32Array(this.size3 * 3);
      this.palette = new Float32Array(this.size3 * 3);

      //

      this.count = 0;

      const maxVertexCount = maxPolyCount * 3;

      this.positionArray = new Float32Array(maxVertexCount * 3);
      const positionAttribute = new BufferAttribute(this.positionArray, 3);
      positionAttribute.setUsage(BufferUsage.DynamicDraw);
      geometry.setAttribute("position", positionAttribute);

      this.normalArray = new Float32Array(maxVertexCount * 3);
      const normalAttribute = new BufferAttribute(this.normalArray, 3);
      normalAttribute.setUsage(BufferUsage.DynamicDraw);
      geometry.setAttribute("normal", normalAttribute);

      if (enableUvs || this.enableUvs || geometry.getAttribute("uv")) {
        this.uvArray = new Float32Array(maxVertexCount * 2);
        const uvAttribute = new BufferAttribute(this.uvArray, 2);
        uvAttribute.setUsage(BufferUsage.DynamicDraw);
        geometry.setAttribute("uv", uvAttribute);
      }

      if (enableColors || this.enableColors || geometry.getAttribute("color")) {
        this.colorArray = new Float32Array(maxVertexCount * 3);
        const colorAttribute = new BufferAttribute(this.colorArray, 3);
        colorAttribute.setUsage(BufferUsage.DynamicDraw);
        geometry.setAttribute("color", colorAttribute);
      }

      geometry.boundingSphere = new Sphere(new Vector3(), 1);
    };

    ///////////////////////
    // Polygonization
    ///////////////////////

    const lerp = (a: number, b: number, t: number) => {
      return a + (b - a) * t;
    };

    const VIntX = (
      q: number,
      offset: number,
      isol: number,
      x: number,
      y: number,
      z: number,
      valp1: number,
      valp2: number,
      c_offset1: number,
      c_offset2: number,
    ) => {
      const mu = (isol - valp1) / (valp2 - valp1),
        nc = this.normal_cache;

      vlist[offset + 0] = x + mu * this.delta;
      vlist[offset + 1] = y;
      vlist[offset + 2] = z;

      nlist[offset + 0] = lerp(nc[q + 0], nc[q + 3], mu);
      nlist[offset + 1] = lerp(nc[q + 1], nc[q + 4], mu);
      nlist[offset + 2] = lerp(nc[q + 2], nc[q + 5], mu);

      clist[offset + 0] = lerp(this.palette[c_offset1 * 3 + 0], this.palette[c_offset2 * 3 + 0], mu);
      clist[offset + 1] = lerp(this.palette[c_offset1 * 3 + 1], this.palette[c_offset2 * 3 + 1], mu);
      clist[offset + 2] = lerp(this.palette[c_offset1 * 3 + 2], this.palette[c_offset2 * 3 + 2], mu);
    };

    const VIntY = (
      q: number,
      offset: number,
      isol: number,
      x: number,
      y: number,
      z: number,
      valp1: number,
      valp2: number,
      c_offset1: number,
      c_offset2: number,
    ) => {
      const mu = (isol - valp1) / (valp2 - valp1),
        nc = this.normal_cache;

      vlist[offset + 0] = x;
      vlist[offset + 1] = y + mu * this.delta;
      vlist[offset + 2] = z;

      const q2 = q + this.yd * 3;

      nlist[offset + 0] = lerp(nc[q + 0], nc[q2 + 0], mu);
      nlist[offset + 1] = lerp(nc[q + 1], nc[q2 + 1], mu);
      nlist[offset + 2] = lerp(nc[q + 2], nc[q2 + 2], mu);

      clist[offset + 0] = lerp(this.palette[c_offset1 * 3 + 0], this.palette[c_offset2 * 3 + 0], mu);
      clist[offset + 1] = lerp(this.palette[c_offset1 * 3 + 1], this.palette[c_offset2 * 3 + 1], mu);
      clist[offset + 2] = lerp(this.palette[c_offset1 * 3 + 2], this.palette[c_offset2 * 3 + 2], mu);
    };

    const VIntZ = (
      q: number,
      offset: number,
      isol: number,
      x: number,
      y: number,
      z: number,
      valp1: number,
      valp2: number,
      c_offset1: number,
      c_offset2: number,
    ) => {
      const mu = (isol - valp1) / (valp2 - valp1),
        nc = this.normal_cache;

      vlist[offset + 0] = x;
      vlist[offset + 1] = y;
      vlist[offset + 2] = z + mu * this.delta;

      const q2 = q + this.zd * 3;

      nlist[offset + 0] = lerp(nc[q + 0], nc[q2 + 0], mu);
      nlist[offset + 1] = lerp(nc[q + 1], nc[q2 + 1], mu);
      nlist[offset + 2] = lerp(nc[q + 2], nc[q2 + 2], mu);

      clist[offset + 0] = lerp(this.palette[c_offset1 * 3 + 0], this.palette[c_offset2 * 3 + 0], mu);
      clist[offset + 1] = lerp(this.palette[c_offset1 * 3 + 1], this.palette[c_offset2 * 3 + 1], mu);
      clist[offset + 2] = lerp(this.palette[c_offset1 * 3 + 2], this.palette[c_offset2 * 3 + 2], mu);
    };

    const compNorm = (q: number) => {
      const q3 = q * 3;

      if (this.normal_cache[q3] === 0.0) {
        this.normal_cache[q3 + 0] = this.field[q - 1] - this.field[q + 1];
        this.normal_cache[q3 + 1] = this.field[q - this.yd] - this.field[q + this.yd];
        this.normal_cache[q3 + 2] = this.field[q - this.zd] - this.field[q + this.zd];
      }
    };

    // Returns total number of triangles. Fills triangles.
    // (this is where most of time is spent - it's inner work of O(n3) loop )

    const polygonize = (fx: number, fy: number, fz: number, q: number, isol: number) => {
      // cache indices
      const q1 = q + 1,
        qy = q + this.yd,
        qz = q + this.zd,
        q1y = q1 + this.yd,
        q1z = q1 + this.zd,
        qyz = q + this.yd + this.zd,
        q1yz = q1 + this.yd + this.zd;

      let cubeindex = 0;
      const field0 = this.field[q],
        field1 = this.field[q1],
        field2 = this.field[qy],
        field3 = this.field[q1y],
        field4 = this.field[qz],
        field5 = this.field[q1z],
        field6 = this.field[qyz],
        field7 = this.field[q1yz];

      if (field0 < isol) cubeindex |= 1;
      if (field1 < isol) cubeindex |= 2;
      if (field2 < isol) cubeindex |= 8;
      if (field3 < isol) cubeindex |= 4;
      if (field4 < isol) cubeindex |= 16;
      if (field5 < isol) cubeindex |= 32;
      if (field6 < isol) cubeindex |= 128;
      if (field7 < isol) cubeindex |= 64;

      // if cube is entirely in/out of the surface - bail, nothing to draw

      const bits = edgeTable[cubeindex];
      if (bits === 0) return 0;

      const d = this.delta,
        fx2 = fx + d,
        fy2 = fy + d,
        fz2 = fz + d;

      // top of the cube

      if (bits & 1) {
        compNorm(q);
        compNorm(q1);
        VIntX(q * 3, 0, isol, fx, fy, fz, field0, field1, q, q1);
      }

      if (bits & 2) {
        compNorm(q1);
        compNorm(q1y);
        VIntY(q1 * 3, 3, isol, fx2, fy, fz, field1, field3, q1, q1y);
      }

      if (bits & 4) {
        compNorm(qy);
        compNorm(q1y);
        VIntX(qy * 3, 6, isol, fx, fy2, fz, field2, field3, qy, q1y);
      }

      if (bits & 8) {
        compNorm(q);
        compNorm(qy);
        VIntY(q * 3, 9, isol, fx, fy, fz, field0, field2, q, qy);
      }

      // bottom of the cube

      if (bits & 16) {
        compNorm(qz);
        compNorm(q1z);
        VIntX(qz * 3, 12, isol, fx, fy, fz2, field4, field5, qz, q1z);
      }

      if (bits & 32) {
        compNorm(q1z);
        compNorm(q1yz);
        VIntY(q1z * 3, 15, isol, fx2, fy, fz2, field5, field7, q1z, q1yz);
      }

      if (bits & 64) {
        compNorm(qyz);
        compNorm(q1yz);
        VIntX(qyz * 3, 18, isol, fx, fy2, fz2, field6, field7, qyz, q1yz);
      }

      if (bits & 128) {
        compNorm(qz);
        compNorm(qyz);
        VIntY(qz * 3, 21, isol, fx, fy, fz2, field4, field6, qz, qyz);
      }

      // vertical lines of the cube
      if (bits & 256) {
        compNorm(q);
        compNorm(qz);
        VIntZ(q * 3, 24, isol, fx, fy, fz, field0, field4, q, qz);
      }

      if (bits & 512) {
        compNorm(q1);
        compNorm(q1z);
        VIntZ(q1 * 3, 27, isol, fx2, fy, fz, field1, field5, q1, q1z);
      }

      if (bits & 1024) {
        compNorm(q1y);
        compNorm(q1yz);
        VIntZ(q1y * 3, 30, isol, fx2, fy2, fz, field3, field7, q1y, q1yz);
      }

      if (bits & 2048) {
        compNorm(qy);
        compNorm(qyz);
        VIntZ(qy * 3, 33, isol, fx, fy2, fz, field2, field6, qy, qyz);
      }

      cubeindex <<= 4; // re-purpose cubeindex into an offset into triTable

      let o1,
        o2,
        o3,
        numtris = 0,
        i = 0;

      // here is where triangles are created

      while (triTable[cubeindex + i] != -1) {
        o1 = cubeindex + i;
        o2 = o1 + 1;
        o3 = o1 + 2;

        posnormtriv(vlist, nlist, clist, 3 * triTable[o1], 3 * triTable[o2], 3 * triTable[o3]);

        i += 3;
        numtris++;
      }

      return numtris;
    };

    const posnormtriv = (
      pos: Float32Array,
      norm: Float32Array,
      colors: Float32Array,
      o1: number,
      o2: number,
      o3: number,
    ) => {
      const c = this.count * 3;

      // positions

      this.positionArray[c + 0] = pos[o1];
      this.positionArray[c + 1] = pos[o1 + 1];
      this.positionArray[c + 2] = pos[o1 + 2];

      this.positionArray[c + 3] = pos[o2];
      this.positionArray[c + 4] = pos[o2 + 1];
      this.positionArray[c + 5] = pos[o2 + 2];

      this.positionArray[c + 6] = pos[o3];
      this.positionArray[c + 7] = pos[o3 + 1];
      this.positionArray[c + 8] = pos[o3 + 2];

      // normals

      if ("flatShading" in this.material && this.material.flatShading === true) {
        const nx = (norm[o1 + 0] + norm[o2 + 0] + norm[o3 + 0]) / 3;
        const ny = (norm[o1 + 1] + norm[o2 + 1] + norm[o3 + 1]) / 3;
        const nz = (norm[o1 + 2] + norm[o2 + 2] + norm[o3 + 2]) / 3;

        this.normalArray[c + 0] = nx;
        this.normalArray[c + 1] = ny;
        this.normalArray[c + 2] = nz;

        this.normalArray[c + 3] = nx;
        this.normalArray[c + 4] = ny;
        this.normalArray[c + 5] = nz;

        this.normalArray[c + 6] = nx;
        this.normalArray[c + 7] = ny;
        this.normalArray[c + 8] = nz;
      } else {
        this.normalArray[c + 0] = norm[o1 + 0];
        this.normalArray[c + 1] = norm[o1 + 1];
        this.normalArray[c + 2] = norm[o1 + 2];

        this.normalArray[c + 3] = norm[o2 + 0];
        this.normalArray[c + 4] = norm[o2 + 1];
        this.normalArray[c + 5] = norm[o2 + 2];

        this.normalArray[c + 6] = norm[o3 + 0];
        this.normalArray[c + 7] = norm[o3 + 1];
        this.normalArray[c + 8] = norm[o3 + 2];
      }

      // uvs

      if (this.enableUvs) {
        const d = this.count * 2;

        this.uvArray[d + 0] = pos[o1 + 0];
        this.uvArray[d + 1] = pos[o1 + 2];

        this.uvArray[d + 2] = pos[o2 + 0];
        this.uvArray[d + 3] = pos[o2 + 2];

        this.uvArray[d + 4] = pos[o3 + 0];
        this.uvArray[d + 5] = pos[o3 + 2];
      }

      // colors

      if (this.enableColors) {
        this.colorArray[c + 0] = colors[o1 + 0];
        this.colorArray[c + 1] = colors[o1 + 1];
        this.colorArray[c + 2] = colors[o1 + 2];

        this.colorArray[c + 3] = colors[o2 + 0];
        this.colorArray[c + 4] = colors[o2 + 1];
        this.colorArray[c + 5] = colors[o2 + 2];

        this.colorArray[c + 6] = colors[o3 + 0];
        this.colorArray[c + 7] = colors[o3 + 1];
        this.colorArray[c + 8] = colors[o3 + 2];
      }

      this.count += 3;
    };

    /////////////////////////////////////
    // Metaballs
    /////////////////////////////////////

    /**
     * Adds a reciprocal ball (nice and blobby) that, to be fast, fades to zero after
     * a fixed distance, determined by strength and subtract.
     *
     * @param ballx - The x-coordinate of the ball.
     * @param bally - The y-coordinate of the ball.
     * @param ballz - The z-coordinate of the ball.
     * @param strength - The strength factor.
     * @param subtract - The subtract factor.
     * @param colors - The color.
     */
    this.addBall = (
      ballx: number,
      bally: number,
      ballz: number,
      strength: number,
      subtract: number,
      colors?: Color | number | string | [number, number, number] | null,
    ) => {
      const sign = Math.sign(strength);
      strength = Math.abs(strength);
      const userDefineColor = !(colors === undefined || colors === null);
      let ballColor = new Color(ballx, bally, ballz);

      if (userDefineColor && colors != null) {
        try {
          ballColor =
            colors instanceof Color
              ? colors
              : Array.isArray(colors)
                ? new Color(
                    Math.min(Math.abs(colors[0]), 1),
                    Math.min(Math.abs(colors[1]), 1),
                    Math.min(Math.abs(colors[2]), 1),
                  )
                : new Color(colors);
        } catch {
          ballColor = new Color(ballx, bally, ballz);
        }
      }

      // Let's solve the equation to find the radius:
      // 1.0 / (0.000001 + radius^2) * strength - subtract = 0
      // strength / (radius^2) = subtract
      // strength = subtract * radius^2
      // radius^2 = strength / subtract
      // radius = sqrt(strength / subtract)

      const radius = this.size * Math.sqrt(strength / subtract),
        zs = ballz * this.size,
        ys = bally * this.size,
        xs = ballx * this.size;

      let min_z = Math.floor(zs - radius);
      if (min_z < 1) min_z = 1;
      let max_z = Math.floor(zs + radius);
      if (max_z > this.size - 1) max_z = this.size - 1;
      let min_y = Math.floor(ys - radius);
      if (min_y < 1) min_y = 1;
      let max_y = Math.floor(ys + radius);
      if (max_y > this.size - 1) max_y = this.size - 1;
      let min_x = Math.floor(xs - radius);
      if (min_x < 1) min_x = 1;
      let max_x = Math.floor(xs + radius);
      if (max_x > this.size - 1) max_x = this.size - 1;

      // Don't polygonize in the outer layer because normals aren't
      // well-defined there.

      let x, y, z, y_offset, z_offset, fx, fy, fz, fz2, fy2, val;

      for (z = min_z; z < max_z; z++) {
        z_offset = this.size2 * z;
        fz = z / this.size - ballz;
        fz2 = fz * fz;

        for (y = min_y; y < max_y; y++) {
          y_offset = z_offset + this.size * y;
          fy = y / this.size - bally;
          fy2 = fy * fy;

          for (x = min_x; x < max_x; x++) {
            fx = x / this.size - ballx;
            val = strength / (0.000001 + fx * fx + fy2 + fz2) - subtract;
            if (val > 0.0) {
              this.field[y_offset + x] += val * sign;

              // optimization
              // http://www.geisswerks.com/ryan/BLOBS/blobs.html
              const ratio = Math.sqrt((x - xs) * (x - xs) + (y - ys) * (y - ys) + (z - zs) * (z - zs)) / radius;
              const contrib = 1 - ratio * ratio * ratio * (ratio * (ratio * 6 - 15) + 10);
              this.palette[(y_offset + x) * 3 + 0] += ballColor.r * contrib;
              this.palette[(y_offset + x) * 3 + 1] += ballColor.g * contrib;
              this.palette[(y_offset + x) * 3 + 2] += ballColor.b * contrib;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    };

    /**
     * Adds a plane along the x-axis.
     *
     * @param strength - The strength factor.
     * @param subtract - The subtract factor.
     */
    this.addPlaneX = (strength: number, subtract: number) => {
      // cache attribute lookups
      const size = this.size,
        yd = this.yd,
        zd = this.zd,
        field = this.field;

      let x,
        y,
        z,
        xx,
        val,
        xdiv,
        cxy,
        dist = size * Math.sqrt(strength / subtract);

      if (dist > size) dist = size;

      for (x = 0; x < dist; x++) {
        xdiv = x / size;
        xx = xdiv * xdiv;
        val = strength / (0.0001 + xx) - subtract;

        if (val > 0.0) {
          for (y = 0; y < size; y++) {
            cxy = x + y * yd;

            for (z = 0; z < size; z++) {
              field[zd * z + cxy] += val;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    };

    /**
     * Adds a plane along the y-axis.
     *
     * @param strength - The strength factor.
     * @param subtract - The subtract factor.
     */
    this.addPlaneY = (strength: number, subtract: number) => {
      // cache attribute lookups
      const size = this.size,
        yd = this.yd,
        zd = this.zd,
        field = this.field;

      let x,
        y,
        z,
        yy,
        val,
        ydiv,
        cy,
        cxy,
        dist = size * Math.sqrt(strength / subtract);

      if (dist > size) dist = size;

      for (y = 0; y < dist; y++) {
        ydiv = y / size;
        yy = ydiv * ydiv;
        val = strength / (0.0001 + yy) - subtract;

        if (val > 0.0) {
          cy = y * yd;

          for (x = 0; x < size; x++) {
            cxy = cy + x;

            for (z = 0; z < size; z++) field[zd * z + cxy] += val;
          }
        }
      }
    };

    /**
     * Adds a plane along the z-axis.
     *
     * @param strength - The strength factor.
     * @param subtract - The subtract factor.
     */
    this.addPlaneZ = (strength: number, subtract: number) => {
      // cache attribute lookups

      const size = this.size,
        yd = this.yd,
        zd = this.zd,
        field = this.field;

      let x,
        y,
        z,
        zz,
        val,
        zdiv,
        cz,
        cyz,
        dist = size * Math.sqrt(strength / subtract);

      if (dist > size) dist = size;

      for (z = 0; z < dist; z++) {
        zdiv = z / size;
        zz = zdiv * zdiv;
        val = strength / (0.0001 + zz) - subtract;
        if (val > 0.0) {
          cz = zd * z;

          for (y = 0; y < size; y++) {
            cyz = cz + y * yd;

            for (x = 0; x < size; x++) field[cyz + x] += val;
          }
        }
      }
    };

    /////////////////////////////////////
    // Updates
    /////////////////////////////////////

    /**
     * Sets the cell value for the given coordinates.
     *
     * @param x - The x value.
     * @param y - The y value.
     * @param z - The z value.
     * @param value - The value to set.
     */
    this.setCell = (x: number, y: number, z: number, value: number) => {
      const index = this.size2 * z + this.size * y + x;
      this.field[index] = value;
    };

    /**
     * Returns the cell value for the given coordinates.
     *
     * @param x - The x value.
     * @param y - The y value.
     * @param z - The z value.
     * @return The value.
     */
    this.getCell = (x: number, y: number, z: number) => {
      const index = this.size2 * z + this.size * y + x;
      return this.field[index];
    };

    /**
     * Applies a blur with the given intensity.
     *
     * @param [intensity=1] - The intensity of the blur.
     */
    this.blur = (intensity = 1) => {
      const field = this.field;
      const fieldCopy = field.slice();
      const size = this.size;
      const size2 = this.size2;
      for (let x = 0; x < size; x++) {
        for (let y = 0; y < size; y++) {
          for (let z = 0; z < size; z++) {
            const index = size2 * z + size * y + x;
            let val = fieldCopy[index];
            let count = 1;

            for (let x2 = -1; x2 <= 1; x2 += 2) {
              const x3 = x2 + x;
              if (x3 < 0 || x3 >= size) continue;

              for (let y2 = -1; y2 <= 1; y2 += 2) {
                const y3 = y2 + y;
                if (y3 < 0 || y3 >= size) continue;

                for (let z2 = -1; z2 <= 1; z2 += 2) {
                  const z3 = z2 + z;
                  if (z3 < 0 || z3 >= size) continue;

                  const index2 = size2 * z3 + size * y3 + x3;
                  const val2 = fieldCopy[index2];

                  count++;
                  val += (intensity * (val2 - val)) / count;
                }
              }
            }

            field[index] = val;
          }
        }
      }
    };

    /**
     * Resets the effect.
     */
    this.reset = () => {
      // wipe the normal cache

      for (let i = 0; i < this.size3; i++) {
        this.normal_cache[i * 3] = 0.0;
        this.field[i] = 0.0;
        this.palette[i * 3] = this.palette[i * 3 + 1] = this.palette[i * 3 + 2] = 0.0;
      }
    };

    /**
     * Updates the effect.
     */
    this.update = () => {
      if (this.enableUvs && !geometry.getAttribute("uv")) {
        this.uvArray = new Float32Array(maxPolyCount * 6);
        geometry.setAttribute("uv", new BufferAttribute(this.uvArray, 2).setUsage(BufferUsage.DynamicDraw));
      }
      if (this.enableColors && !geometry.getAttribute("color")) {
        this.colorArray = new Float32Array(maxPolyCount * 9);
        geometry.setAttribute("color", new BufferAttribute(this.colorArray, 3).setUsage(BufferUsage.DynamicDraw));
      }

      this.count = 0;

      // Triangulate. Yeah, this is slow.

      const smin2 = this.size - 2;

      for (let z = 1; z < smin2; z++) {
        const z_offset = this.size2 * z;
        const fz = (z - this.halfsize) / this.halfsize; //+ 1

        for (let y = 1; y < smin2; y++) {
          const y_offset = z_offset + this.size * y;
          const fy = (y - this.halfsize) / this.halfsize; //+ 1

          for (let x = 1; x < smin2; x++) {
            const fx = (x - this.halfsize) / this.halfsize; //+ 1
            const q = y_offset + x;

            polygonize(fx, fy, fz, q, this.isolation);
          }
        }
      }

      // set the draw range to only the processed triangles

      this.geometry.setDrawRange(0, this.count);

      // update geometry data

      (geometry.getAttribute("position") as BufferAttribute).needsUpdate = true;
      (geometry.getAttribute("normal") as BufferAttribute).needsUpdate = true;

      if (this.enableUvs) (geometry.getAttribute("uv") as BufferAttribute).needsUpdate = true;
      if (this.enableColors) (geometry.getAttribute("color") as BufferAttribute).needsUpdate = true;

      // safety check

      if (this.count / 3 > maxPolyCount)
        console.warn(
          "THREE.MarchingCubes: Geometry buffers too small for rendering. Please create an instance with a higher poly count.",
        );
    };

    this.init(resolution);
  }
}

/////////////////////////////////////
