      material.uniforms["tFlowMap"] = flowMapUniform;
    } else {
      const flowDirectionUniform: TypedUniform = {
        type: "v2",
        value: flowDirection,
      };

      material.uniforms["flowDirection"] = flowDirectionUniform;
    }

    // maps

    normalMap0.wrapS = normalMap0.wrapT = Wrapping.Repeat;
    normalMap1.wrapS = normalMap1.wrapT = Wrapping.Repeat;

    material.uniforms["tReflectionMap"].value = reflector.getRenderTarget().texture;
    material.uniforms["tRefractionMap"].value = refractor.getRenderTarget().texture;
    material.uniforms["tNormalMap0"].value = normalMap0;
    material.uniforms["tNormalMap1"].value = normalMap1;

    // water

    material.uniforms["color"].value = color;
    material.uniforms["reflectivity"].value = reflectivity;
    material.uniforms["textureMatrix"].value = textureMatrix;

    // initial values

    const config = material.uniforms["config"].value as Vector4;
    config.x = 0; // flowMapOffset0
    config.y = halfCycle; // flowMapOffset1
    config.z = halfCycle; // halfCycle
    config.w = scale; // scale

    super(geometry, material);

    this.type = "Water";
    this._reflector = reflector;
    this._refractor = refractor;
    this._textureMatrix = textureMatrix;
    this._timer = timer;
    this._ownedNormalMap0 = options.normalMap0 ? undefined : normalMap0;
    this._ownedNormalMap1 = options.normalMap1 ? undefined : normalMap1;

    this._flowSpeed = flowSpeed;
    this._cycle = cycle;
    this._halfCycle = halfCycle;
  }

  /** The flow map speed per second. */
  _flowSpeed: number;
  /** A full flow map phase length. */
  _cycle: number;
  /** Half of the flow map phase, also the offset distance between the two maps. */
  _halfCycle: number;

  /**
   * Copies the scene camera transform into the projective texture matrix.
   *
   * @param camera - The scene's camera.
   */
  updateTextureMatrix(camera: Camera): void {
    const textureMatrix = this._textureMatrix;

    textureMatrix.set(0.5, 0.0, 0.0, 0.5, 0.0, 0.5, 0.0, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0, 0.5, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);

    textureMatrix.multiply(camera.projectionMatrix);
    textureMatrix.multiply(camera.matrixWorldInverse);
    textureMatrix.multiply(this.matrixWorld);
  }

  /**
   * Advances the two flow map offsets inside one cycle.
   */
  updateFlow(): void {
    const delta = this._timer.getDelta();
    const cycle = this._cycle;
    const halfCycle = this._halfCycle;
    const config = this.material.uniforms["config"].value as Vector4;

    config.x += this._flowSpeed * delta; // flowMapOffset0
    config.y = config.x + halfCycle; // flowMapOffset1

    // Important: The distance between offsets should be always the value of "halfCycle".
    // Moreover, both offsets should be in the range of [ 0, cycle ].
    // This approach ensures a smooth water flow and avoids "reset" effects.

    if (config.x >= cycle) {
      config.x = 0;
      config.y = halfCycle;
    } else if (config.y >= cycle) {
      config.y = config.y - cycle;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Renders the reflection and refraction maps before drawing the water surface.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param scene - The scene to render.
   * @param camera - The scene's camera.
   */
  override onBeforeRender(
    renderer: WebGLRenderer,
    scene: Object3D,
    camera: Camera,
    _geometry?: BufferGeometry,
    _material?: unknown,
    _group?: unknown,
  ): void {
    this._timer.update();

    this.updateTextureMatrix(camera);
    this.updateFlow();

    const visible = this.visible;

    this.visible = false;

    try {
      this._reflector.matrixWorld.copy(this.matrixWorld);
      this._refractor.matrixWorld.copy(this.matrixWorld);
      this._reflector.onBeforeRender(renderer, scene, camera);
      this._refractor.onBeforeRender(renderer, scene, camera);
    } finally {
      this.visible = visible;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Returns the reflector used for the reflection map.
   *
   * @return The internal reflector.
   */
  getReflector(): Reflector {
    return this._reflector;
  }

  /**
   * Returns the refractor used for the refraction map.
   *
   * @return The internal refractor.
   */
  getRefractor(): Refractor {
    return this._refractor;
  }

  /**
   * Frees the GPU-related resources allocated by this instance. Call this
   * method whenever this instance is no longer used in your app.
   */
  override dispose(): void {
    this._timer.dispose();
    this._reflector.dispose();
    this._refractor.dispose();
    this.material.dispose();
    this._ownedNormalMap0?.dispose();
    this._ownedNormalMap1?.dispose();
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/offscreen/jank

```typescript
/** Toggles the upstream CPU workload so the two rendering threads can be compared. */
export function initJank(button: HTMLElement, result: HTMLElement): () => void {
  let interval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  function toggle(): void {
    if (interval === null) {
      interval = setInterval(() => {
        let number = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 10000000; i++) number += Math.random();
        result.textContent = String(number);
      }, 1000 / 60);
      button.textContent = "STOP JANK";
    } else {
      clearInterval(interval);
      interval = null;
      button.textContent = "START JANK";
      result.textContent = "";
    }
  }
  button.addEventListener("click", toggle);
  return () => {
    clearInterval(interval ?? undefined);
    button.removeEventListener("click", toggle);
  };
}
```

## ek3d/addons/offscreen/offscreen

```typescript
import { initScene } from "./scene";
import type { OffscreenScene } from "./scene";

interface StartMessage {
  canvas: OffscreenCanvas;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  pixelRatio: number;
  port: MessagePort;
}

type Command = { type: "resize"; width: number; height: number; pixelRatio: number } | { type: "dispose" };

self.addEventListener("message", (event: MessageEvent<StartMessage>) => {
  const { canvas, width, height, pixelRatio, port } = event.data;
  let scene: OffscreenScene | null = null;
  port.onmessage = (message: MessageEvent<Command>) => {
    const command = message.data;
    if (command.type === "dispose") {
      scene?.dispose();
      port.postMessage({ type: "disposed" });
      port.close();
      self.close();
    } else {
      scene?.resize(command.width, command.height, command.pixelRatio);
    }
  };
  try {
    scene = initScene(
      canvas,
      width,
      height,
      pixelRatio,
      (frames) => port.postMessage({ type: "frame", frames }),
      (error) => port.postMessage({ type: "error", error: String(error) }),
    );
  } catch (error) {
    port.postMessage({ type: "error", error: String(error) });
  }
});
```

## ek3d/addons/offscreen/scene

```typescript
import { PerspectiveCamera } from "../../cameras/PerspectiveCamera";
import { IcosahedronGeometry } from "../../geometries/IcosahedronGeometry";
import { ImageBitmapLoader } from "../../loaders/ImageBitmapLoader";
import { MeshMatcapMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshMatcapMaterial";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Group } from "../../objects/Group";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";
import { matcapShader } from "../../renderers/shaders/MatcapShader";
import { Fog } from "../../scenes/Fog";
import { Scene } from "../../scenes/Scene";
import { Texture } from "../../textures/Texture";

export interface OffscreenScene {
  resize(width: number, height: number, pixelRatio: number): void;
  dispose(): void;
}

/** Starts the same matcap scene on a regular or transferred canvas. */
export function initScene(
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement | OffscreenCanvas,
  width: number,
  height: number,
  pixelRatio: number,
  onFrame: (frames: number) => void,
  onError: (error: unknown) => void,
): OffscreenScene {
  const camera = new PerspectiveCamera(40, width / height, 1, 1000);
  camera.position.z = 200;
  const scene = new Scene();
  scene.fog = new Fog(0x444466, 100, 400);
  scene.background = new Color(0x444466);
  const group = new Group();
  scene.add(group);
  const renderer = new WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true, shaders: { MeshMatcapMaterial: matcapShader } });
  renderer.setPixelRatio(pixelRatio);
  renderer.setSize(width, height, false);
  let disposed = false;
  let frames = 0;
  let bitmap: ImageBitmap | null = null;
  let texture: Texture | null = null;
  let geometry: IcosahedronGeometry | null = null;
  let materials: MeshMatcapMaterial[] = [];
  let seed = 1;
  function random(): number {
    const x = Math.sin(seed++) * 10000;
    return x - Math.floor(x);
  }
  const loader = new ImageBitmapLoader();
  loader.setOptions({ imageOrientation: "flipY" });
  loader.load(
    "/examples/textures/matcaps/matcap-porcelain-white.jpg",
    (image) => {
      if (disposed) {
        image.close();
        return;
      }
      bitmap = image;
      texture = new Texture(image);
      texture.needsUpdate = true;
      geometry = new IcosahedronGeometry(5, 8);
      materials = [0xaa24df, 0x605d90, 0xe04a3f, 0xe30456].map(
        (color) => new MeshMatcapMaterial({ color, matcap: texture }),
      );
      for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        const mesh = new Mesh(geometry, materials[i % materials.length]);
        mesh.position.set(random() * 200 - 100, random() * 200 - 100, random() * 200 - 100);
        mesh.scale.setScalar(random() + 1);
        group.add(mesh);
      }
      renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => {
        group.rotation.y = -Date.now() / 4000;
        renderer.render(scene, camera);
        onFrame(++frames);
      });
    },
    undefined,
    (error) => {
      if (!disposed) onError(error);
    },
  );
  return {
    resize(newWidth, newHeight, ratio) {
      camera.aspect = newWidth / newHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setPixelRatio(ratio);
      renderer.setSize(newWidth, newHeight, false);
    },
    dispose() {
      if (disposed) return;
      disposed = true;
      renderer.setAnimationLoop(null);
      geometry?.dispose();
      for (const material of materials) material.dispose();
      texture?.dispose();
      bitmap?.close();
      renderer.dispose();
    },
  };
}
```

## ek3d/addons/physics/AmmoPhysics

```typescript
import { BoxGeometry } from "../../geometries/BoxGeometry";
import { IcosahedronGeometry } from "../../geometries/IcosahedronGeometry";
import { SphereGeometry } from "../../geometries/SphereGeometry";
import type { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import type { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import { InstancedMesh } from "../../objects/InstancedMesh";

export interface AmmoVector {
  x(): number;
  y(): number;
  z(): number;
}
export interface AmmoQuaternion extends AmmoVector {
  w(): number;
}
export interface AmmoTransform {
  setIdentity(): void;
  setOrigin(value: AmmoVector): void;
  setRotation(value: AmmoQuaternion): void;
  setFromOpenGLMatrix(value: ArrayLike<number>): void;
  getOrigin(): AmmoVector;
  getRotation(): AmmoQuaternion;
}
export interface AmmoShape {
  setMargin(value: number): void;
  calculateLocalInertia(mass: number, inertia: AmmoVector): void;
}
export interface AmmoMotionState {
  getWorldTransform(transform: AmmoTransform): void;
}
export interface AmmoBody {
  getMotionState(): AmmoMotionState;
  setAngularVelocity(value: AmmoVector): void;
  setLinearVelocity(value: AmmoVector): void;
  setWorldTransform(value: AmmoTransform): void;
}
export interface AmmoWorld {
  setGravity(value: AmmoVector): void;
  addRigidBody(body: AmmoBody): void;
  removeRigidBody(body: AmmoBody): void;
  stepSimulation(delta: number, maxSubSteps: number): void;
}
export interface AmmoRuntime {
  btDefaultCollisionConfiguration: new () => object;
  btCollisionDispatcher: new (configuration: object) => object;
  btDbvtBroadphase: new () => object;
  btSequentialImpulseConstraintSolver: new () => object;
  btDiscreteDynamicsWorld: new (
    dispatcher: object,
    broadphase: object,
    solver: object,
    configuration: object,
  ) => AmmoWorld;
  btVector3: new (x: number, y: number, z: number) => AmmoVector;
  btQuaternion: new (x: number, y: number, z: number, w: number) => AmmoQuaternion;
  btTransform: new () => AmmoTransform;
  btBoxShape: new (halfExtents: AmmoVector) => AmmoShape;
  btSphereShape: new (radius: number) => AmmoShape;
  btDefaultMotionState: new (transform: AmmoTransform) => AmmoMotionState;
  btRigidBodyConstructionInfo: new (
    mass: number,
    state: AmmoMotionState,
    shape: AmmoShape,
    inertia: AmmoVector,
  ) => { set_m_restitution(value: number): void };
  btRigidBody: new (info: { set_m_restitution(value: number): void }) => AmmoBody;
  destroy(value: object): void;
}

/** Creates an Ammo simulation using a caller-provided initialized runtime. */
export function AmmoPhysics(ammo: AmmoRuntime): {
  addScene(scene: Object3D): void;
  addMesh(mesh: Mesh, mass?: number, restitution?: number): void;
  setMeshPosition(mesh: Mesh, position: Vector3, index?: number): void;
  dispose(): void;
} {
  const configuration = new ammo.btDefaultCollisionConfiguration();
  const dispatcher = new ammo.btCollisionDispatcher(configuration);
  const broadphase = new ammo.btDbvtBroadphase();
  const solver = new ammo.btSequentialImpulseConstraintSolver();
  const world = new ammo.btDiscreteDynamicsWorld(dispatcher, broadphase, solver, configuration);
  const gravity = new ammo.btVector3(0, -9.8, 0);
  world.setGravity(gravity);
  ammo.destroy(gravity);
  const worldTransform = new ammo.btTransform();
  const entries: { mesh: Mesh; bodies: AmmoBody[] }[] = [];
  const bodiesByMesh = new WeakMap<Mesh, AmmoBody[]>();
  const resources: { body: AmmoBody; state: AmmoMotionState }[] = [];
  const shapes: AmmoShape[] = [];
  let disposed = false;

  function addMesh(mesh: Mesh, mass = 0, restitution = 0): void {
    if (disposed) throw new Error("AmmoPhysics is disposed");
    const geometry = mesh.geometry;
    let shape: AmmoShape;
    if (geometry instanceof BoxGeometry) {
      const { width, height, depth } = geometry.parameters;
      const size = new ammo.btVector3(width / 2, height / 2, depth / 2);
      shape = new ammo.btBoxShape(size);
      ammo.destroy(size);
    } else if (geometry instanceof SphereGeometry || geometry instanceof IcosahedronGeometry) {
      shape = new ammo.btSphereShape(geometry.parameters.radius ?? 1);
    } else {
      console.error("AmmoPhysics: Unsupported geometry type:", geometry.type);
      return;
    }
    shape.setMargin(0.05);
    shapes.push(shape);
    const bodies: AmmoBody[] = [];
    const count = mesh instanceof InstancedMesh ? mesh.count : 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const transform = new ammo.btTransform();
      if (mesh instanceof InstancedMesh) {
        transform.setFromOpenGLMatrix(mesh.instanceMatrix.array.slice(i * 16, i * 16 + 16));
      } else {
        transform.setIdentity();
        const position = new ammo.btVector3(mesh.position.x, mesh.position.y, mesh.position.z);
        const q = mesh.quaternion;
        const rotation = new ammo.btQuaternion(q.x, q.y, q.z, q.w);
        transform.setOrigin(position);
        transform.setRotation(rotation);
        ammo.destroy(position);
        ammo.destroy(rotation);
      }
      const state = new ammo.btDefaultMotionState(transform);
      ammo.destroy(transform);
      const inertia = new ammo.btVector3(0, 0, 0);
      shape.calculateLocalInertia(mass, inertia);
      const info = new ammo.btRigidBodyConstructionInfo(mass, state, shape, inertia);
      info.set_m_restitution(restitution);
      const body = new ammo.btRigidBody(info);
      ammo.destroy(info);
      ammo.destroy(inertia);
      world.addRigidBody(body);
      bodies.push(body);
      resources.push({ body, state });
    }
    if (mass > 0) {
      entries.push({ mesh, bodies });
      bodiesByMesh.set(mesh, bodies);
    }
  }
  function addScene(scene: Object3D): void {
    scene.traverse((child) => {
      if (child instanceof Mesh && child.userData.physics) {
        const physics = child.userData.physics as { mass?: number; restitution?: number };
        addMesh(child, physics.mass, physics.restitution);
      }
    });
  }
  function setMeshPosition(mesh: Mesh, position: Vector3, index = 0): void {
    const body = bodiesByMesh.get(mesh)?.[mesh instanceof InstancedMesh ? index : 0];
    if (disposed || body === undefined) throw new Error("AmmoPhysics: mesh or instance is not dynamic");
    const zero = new ammo.btVector3(0, 0, 0);
    body.setAngularVelocity(zero);
    body.setLinearVelocity(zero);
    ammo.destroy(zero);
    worldTransform.setIdentity();
    const origin = new ammo.btVector3(position.x, position.y, position.z);
    worldTransform.setOrigin(origin);
    ammo.destroy(origin);
    body.setWorldTransform(worldTransform);
  }
  let lastTime = 0;
  const interval = setInterval(() => {
    const time = performance.now();
    if (lastTime > 0) {
      world.stepSimulation((time - lastTime) / 1000, 10);
      for (const { mesh, bodies } of entries) {
        for (let i = 0; i < bodies.length; i++) {
          bodies[i].getMotionState().getWorldTransform(worldTransform);
          const position = worldTransform.getOrigin();
          const quaternion = worldTransform.getRotation();
          if (mesh instanceof InstancedMesh) {
            compose(position, quaternion, mesh.instanceMatrix.array, i * 16);
          } else {
            mesh.position.set(position.x(), position.y(), position.z());
            mesh.quaternion.set(quaternion.x(), quaternion.y(), quaternion.z(), quaternion.w());
          }
        }
        if (mesh instanceof InstancedMesh) {
          mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
          mesh.computeBoundingSphere();
        }
      }
    }
    lastTime = time;
  }, 1000 / 60);
  function dispose(): void {
    if (disposed) return;
    disposed = true;
    clearInterval(interval);
    for (const { body, state } of resources) {
      world.removeRigidBody(body);
      ammo.destroy(body);
      ammo.destroy(state);
    }
    for (const shape of shapes) ammo.destroy(shape);
    ammo.destroy(worldTransform);
    ammo.destroy(world);
    ammo.destroy(solver);
    ammo.destroy(broadphase);
    ammo.destroy(dispatcher);
    ammo.destroy(configuration);
    entries.length = 0;
    resources.length = 0;
    shapes.length = 0;
  }
  return { addScene, addMesh, setMeshPosition, dispose };
}

function compose(
  position: AmmoVector,
  quaternion: AmmoQuaternion,
  array: { [index: number]: number },
  index: number,
): void {
  const x = quaternion.x(),
    y = quaternion.y(),
    z = quaternion.z(),
    w = quaternion.w();
  const x2 = x + x,
    y2 = y + y,
    z2 = z + z;
  const xx = x * x2,
    xy = x * y2,
    xz = x * z2;
  const yy = y * y2,
    yz = y * z2,
    zz = z * z2;
  const wx = w * x2,
    wy = w * y2,
    wz = w * z2;
  array[index] = 1 - (yy + zz);
  array[index + 1] = xy + wz;
  array[index + 2] = xz - wy;
  array[index + 3] = 0;
  array[index + 4] = xy - wz;
  array[index + 5] = 1 - (xx + zz);
  array[index + 6] = yz + wx;
  array[index + 7] = 0;
  array[index + 8] = xz + wy;
  array[index + 9] = yz - wx;
  array[index + 10] = 1 - (xx + yy);
  array[index + 11] = 0;
  array[index + 12] = position.x();
  array[index + 13] = position.y();
  array[index + 14] = position.z();
  array[index + 15] = 1;
}
```

## ek3d/addons/physics/JoltPhysics

```typescript
import { Timer } from "../../core/Timer";
import type { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import { BoxGeometry } from "../../geometries/BoxGeometry";
import { IcosahedronGeometry } from "../../geometries/IcosahedronGeometry";
import { SphereGeometry } from "../../geometries/SphereGeometry";
import { Matrix4 } from "../../math/Matrix4";
import { Quaternion } from "../../math/Quaternion";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import { InstancedMesh } from "../../objects/InstancedMesh";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";

export interface JoltVector {
  GetX(): number;
  GetY(): number;
  GetZ(): number;
}
export interface JoltQuaternion extends JoltVector {
  GetW(): number;
}
export interface JoltShape {
  AddRef(): void;
  Release(): void;
}
export interface JoltBody {
  GetID(): object;
  GetPosition(): JoltVector;
  GetRotation(): JoltQuaternion;
}
export interface JoltBodyInterface {
  CreateBody(settings: object): JoltBody;
  AddBody(id: object, activation: number): void;
  RemoveBody(id: object): void;
  DestroyBody(id: object): void;
  SetPositionAndRotation(id: object, position: JoltVector, rotation: JoltQuaternion, activation: number): void;
  SetLinearAndAngularVelocity(id: object, linear: JoltVector, angular: JoltVector): void;
  SetLinearVelocity(id: object, velocity: JoltVector): void;
  ActivateBody(id: object): void;
}
export interface JoltSettings {
  mObjectLayerPairFilter: object;
  mBroadPhaseLayerInterface: object;
  mObjectVsBroadPhaseLayerFilter: object;
}
export interface JoltWorld {
  GetPhysicsSystem(): { GetBodyInterface(): JoltBodyInterface };
  Step(delta: number, collisionSteps: number): void;
}
export interface JoltRuntime {
  Vec3: new (x: number, y: number, z: number) => JoltVector;
  RVec3: new (x: number, y: number, z: number) => JoltVector;
  Quat: new (x: number, y: number, z: number, w: number) => JoltQuaternion;
  BoxShape: new (halfExtents: JoltVector, convexRadius: number, material: null) => JoltShape;
  SphereShape: new (radius: number, material: null) => JoltShape;
  ObjectLayerPairFilterTable: new (layers: number) => { EnableCollision(a: number, b: number): void };
  BroadPhaseLayer: new (value: number) => object;
  BroadPhaseLayerInterfaceTable: new (
    objectLayers: number,
    broadPhaseLayers: number,
  ) => {
    MapObjectToBroadPhaseLayer(layer: number, broadPhaseLayer: object): void;
  };
  ObjectVsBroadPhaseLayerFilterTable: new (
    broadPhase: object,
    broadPhaseLayers: number,
    objectFilter: object,
    objectLayers: number,
  ) => object;
  JoltSettings: new () => JoltSettings;
  JoltInterface: new (settings: JoltSettings) => JoltWorld;
  BodyCreationSettings: new (
    shape: JoltShape,
    position: JoltVector,
    rotation: JoltQuaternion,
    motion: number,
    layer: number,
  ) => { mRestitution: number };
  EMotionType_Dynamic: number;
  EMotionType_Static: number;
  EActivation_Activate: number;
  destroy(value: object): void;
}

/** Creates a simulation with a caller-owned initialized Jolt runtime. Dispose it before releasing the runtime. */
export function JoltPhysics(jolt: JoltRuntime): {
  addScene(scene: Object3D): void;
  addMesh(mesh: Mesh, mass?: number, restitution?: number): void;
  setMeshPosition(mesh: Mesh, position: Vector3, index?: number): void;
  setMeshVelocity(mesh: Mesh, velocity: Vector3, index?: number): void;
  dispose(): void;
} {
  const settings = new jolt.JoltSettings();
  const filter = new jolt.ObjectLayerPairFilterTable(2);
  filter.EnableCollision(0, 1);
  filter.EnableCollision(1, 1);
  const broadPhase = new jolt.BroadPhaseLayerInterfaceTable(2, 2);
  for (let layer = 0; layer < 2; layer++) {
    const value = new jolt.BroadPhaseLayer(layer);
    broadPhase.MapObjectToBroadPhaseLayer(layer, value);
    jolt.destroy(value);
  }
  settings.mObjectLayerPairFilter = filter;
  settings.mBroadPhaseLayerInterface = broadPhase;
  settings.mObjectVsBroadPhaseLayerFilter = new jolt.ObjectVsBroadPhaseLayerFilterTable(broadPhase, 2, filter, 2);
  // JoltInterface takes ownership of the three collision filters.
  const world = new jolt.JoltInterface(settings);
  jolt.destroy(settings);
  const bodyInterface = world.GetPhysicsSystem().GetBodyInterface();
  const entries = new Map<Mesh, { bodies: JoltBody[]; dynamic: boolean }>();
  const position = new Vector3();
  const rotation = new Quaternion();
  const scale = new Vector3();
  const matrix = new Matrix4();
  const timer = new Timer();
  let disposed = false;

  function addMesh(mesh: Mesh, mass = 0, restitution = 0): void {
    if (disposed) throw new Error("JoltPhysics is disposed");
    if (entries.has(mesh)) throw new Error("JoltPhysics: Mesh already added");
    const geometry = mesh.geometry;
    let shape: JoltShape;
    if (geometry instanceof BoxGeometry) {
      const { width, height, depth } = geometry.parameters;
      const half = new jolt.Vec3(width / 2, height / 2, depth / 2);
      shape = new jolt.BoxShape(half, 0.025 * Math.min(width, height, depth), null);
      jolt.destroy(half);
    } else if (geometry instanceof SphereGeometry || geometry instanceof IcosahedronGeometry) {
      shape = new jolt.SphereShape(geometry.parameters.radius, null);
    } else {
      console.error("JoltPhysics: Unsupported geometry type:", geometry.type);
      return;
    }
    shape.AddRef();
    const bodies: JoltBody[] = [];
    try {
      const count = mesh instanceof InstancedMesh ? mesh.count : 1;
      for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) {
        if (mesh instanceof InstancedMesh) {
          matrix.fromArray(mesh.instanceMatrix.array, index * 16).decompose(position, rotation, scale);
        } else {
          position.copy(mesh.position);
          rotation.copy(mesh.quaternion);
        }
        const p = new jolt.RVec3(position.x, position.y, position.z);
        const q = new jolt.Quat(rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z, rotation.w);
        const creation = new jolt.BodyCreationSettings(
          shape,
          p,
          q,
          mass > 0 ? jolt.EMotionType_Dynamic : jolt.EMotionType_Static,
          mass > 0 ? 1 : 0,
        );
        jolt.destroy(p);
        jolt.destroy(q);
        creation.mRestitution = restitution;
        let body: JoltBody;
        try {
          body = bodyInterface.CreateBody(creation);
        } finally {
          jolt.destroy(creation);
        }
        bodies.push(body);
        bodyInterface.AddBody(body.GetID(), jolt.EActivation_Activate);
      }
      entries.set(mesh, { bodies, dynamic: mass > 0 });
    } catch (error) {
      for (const body of bodies) {
        bodyInterface.RemoveBody(body.GetID());
        bodyInterface.DestroyBody(body.GetID());
      }
      throw error;
    } finally {
      shape.Release();
    }
  }

  function addScene(scene: Object3D): void {
    scene.traverse((child) => {
      if (child instanceof Mesh && child.userData.physics) {
        const physics = child.userData.physics as { mass?: number; restitution?: number };
        addMesh(child, physics.mass, physics.restitution);
      }
    });
  }

  function getBody(mesh: Mesh, index: number): JoltBody {
    if (disposed) throw new Error("JoltPhysics is disposed");
    const body = entries.get(mesh)?.bodies[index];
    if (!body) throw new Error("JoltPhysics: Mesh or instance is not registered");
    return body;
  }

  function setMeshPosition(mesh: Mesh, value: Vector3, index = 0): void {
    const body = getBody(mesh, index);
    const p = new jolt.RVec3(value.x, value.y, value.z);
    const q = new jolt.Quat(0, 0, 0, 1);
    const zero = new jolt.Vec3(0, 0, 0);
    try {
      bodyInterface.SetPositionAndRotation(body.GetID(), p, q, jolt.EActivation_Activate);
      bodyInterface.SetLinearAndAngularVelocity(body.GetID(), zero, zero);
      syncMesh(mesh, entries.get(mesh)!.bodies);
    } finally {
      jolt.destroy(p);
      jolt.destroy(q);
      jolt.destroy(zero);
    }
  }

  function setMeshVelocity(mesh: Mesh, value: Vector3, index = 0): void {
    const body = getBody(mesh, index);
    const velocity = new jolt.Vec3(value.x, value.y, value.z);
    try {
      bodyInterface.SetLinearVelocity(body.GetID(), velocity);
      bodyInterface.ActivateBody(body.GetID());
    } finally {
      jolt.destroy(velocity);
    }
  }

  function syncMesh(mesh: Mesh, bodies: JoltBody[]): void {
    for (let index = 0; index < bodies.length; index++) {
      const body = bodies[index];
      const p = body.GetPosition();
      const q = body.GetRotation();
      position.set(p.GetX(), p.GetY(), p.GetZ());
      rotation.set(q.GetX(), q.GetY(), q.GetZ(), q.GetW());
      if (mesh instanceof InstancedMesh) {
        mesh.getMatrixAt(index, matrix);
        scale.setFromMatrixScale(matrix);
        matrix.compose(position, rotation, scale).toArray(mesh.instanceMatrix.array, index * 16);
      } else {
        mesh.position.copy(position);
        mesh.quaternion.copy(rotation);
      }
    }
    if (mesh instanceof InstancedMesh) {
      mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
      mesh.computeBoundingSphere();
    }
  }

  function step(): void {
    timer.update();
    const delta = Math.min(timer.getDelta(), 1 / 30);
    world.Step(delta, delta > 1 / 55 ? 2 : 1);
    for (const [mesh, entry] of entries) {
      if (entry.dynamic) syncMesh(mesh, entry.bodies);
    }
  }
  const interval = setInterval(step, 1000 / 60);
  return {
    addScene,
    addMesh,
    setMeshPosition,
    setMeshVelocity,
    dispose(): void {
      if (disposed) return;
      disposed = true;
      clearInterval(interval);
      timer.dispose();
      for (const { bodies } of entries.values()) {
        for (const body of bodies) {
          bodyInterface.RemoveBody(body.GetID());
          bodyInterface.DestroyBody(body.GetID());
        }
      }
      entries.clear();
      jolt.destroy(world);
    },
  };
}
```

## ek3d/addons/physics/RapierPhysics

```typescript
import { Timer } from "../../core/Timer";
import { GLBufferAttribute } from "../../core/GLBufferAttribute";
import type { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import { Matrix4 } from "../../math/Matrix4";
import { Quaternion } from "../../math/Quaternion";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import { InstancedMesh } from "../../objects/InstancedMesh";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";

export interface RapierVector {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  z: number;
}
export interface RapierRotation extends RapierVector {
  w: number;
}
export interface RapierBody {
  translation(): RapierVector;
  linvel(): RapierVector;
  rotation(): RapierRotation;
  setTranslation(value: RapierVector, wake: boolean): void;
  setRotation(value: RapierRotation, wake: boolean): void;
  setLinvel(value: RapierVector, wake: boolean): void;
  setAngvel(value: RapierVector, wake: boolean): void;
  applyImpulse(value: RapierVector, wake: boolean): void;
  setAngularDamping(value: number): void;
  isSleeping(): boolean;
  wakeUp(): void;
}
export interface RapierCollider {
  translation(): RapierVector;
  setTranslation(value: RapierVector): void;
}
export interface RapierColliderDesc {
  setMass(value: number): RapierColliderDesc;
  setRestitution(value: number): RapierColliderDesc;
  setTranslation(x: number, y: number, z: number): RapierColliderDesc;
}
export interface RapierBodyDesc {
  setTranslation(x: number, y: number, z: number): RapierBodyDesc;
  setRotation(value: RapierRotation): RapierBodyDesc;
}
export interface RapierCharacterController {
  setApplyImpulsesToDynamicBodies(value: boolean): void;
  setCharacterMass(value: number): void;
  computeColliderMovement(collider: RapierCollider, translation: RapierVector): void;
  computedMovement(): RapierVector;
}
export interface RapierVehicleController {
  addWheel(
    position: RapierVector,
    direction: RapierVector,
    axle: RapierVector,
    restLength: number,
    radius: number,
  ): void;
  setWheelSuspensionStiffness(index: number, value: number): void;
  setWheelFrictionSlip(index: number, value: number): void;
  setWheelSteering(index: number, value: number): void;
  setWheelEngineForce(index: number, value: number): void;
  setWheelBrake(index: number, value: number): void;
  wheelAxleCs(index: number): RapierVector | null;
  wheelChassisConnectionPointCs(index: number): RapierVector | null;
  wheelSuspensionLength(index: number): number | null;
  wheelSteering(index: number): number | null;
  wheelRotation(index: number): number | null;
  updateVehicle(delta: number): void;
}
export interface RapierWorld {
  timestep: number;
  createRigidBody(desc: RapierBodyDesc): RapierBody;
  createCollider(desc: RapierColliderDesc, body?: RapierBody): RapierCollider;
  removeRigidBody(body: RapierBody): void;
  removeCollider(collider: RapierCollider, wakeUp: boolean): void;
  createImpulseJoint(data: object, body1: RapierBody, body2: RapierBody, wakeUp: boolean): object;
  createCharacterController(offset: number): RapierCharacterController;
  removeCharacterController(controller: RapierCharacterController): void;
  createVehicleController(body: RapierBody): RapierVehicleController;
  removeVehicleController(controller: RapierVehicleController): void;
  debugRender(): { vertices: Float32Array; colors: Float32Array };
  step(): void;
  free(): void;
}
export interface RapierRuntime {
  World: new (gravity: RapierVector) => RapierWorld;
  Vector3: new (x: number, y: number, z: number) => RapierVector;
  Quaternion: new (x: number, y: number, z: number, w: number) => RapierRotation;
  RigidBodyDesc: { dynamic(): RapierBodyDesc; fixed(): RapierBodyDesc };
  ColliderDesc: {
    roundCuboid(x: number, y: number, z: number, radius: number): RapierColliderDesc;
    cuboid(x: number, y: number, z: number): RapierColliderDesc;
    ball(radius: number): RapierColliderDesc;
    cylinder(halfHeight: number, radius: number): RapierColliderDesc;
    capsule(halfHeight: number, radius: number): RapierColliderDesc;
    trimesh(vertices: Float32Array, indices: Uint32Array): RapierColliderDesc;
    heightfield(width: number, depth: number, heights: Float32Array, scale: RapierVector): RapierColliderDesc;
  };
  JointData: { spherical(anchor1: RapierVector, anchor2: RapierVector): object };
}

/** Creates a Rapier world using an initialized, caller-owned runtime. */
export function RapierPhysics(RAPIER: RapierRuntime) {
  const world = new RAPIER.World({ x: 0, y: -9.81, z: 0 });
  const entries = new Map<Mesh, { bodies: RapierBody[]; colliders: RapierCollider[]; dynamic: boolean }>();
  const timer = new Timer();
  const matrix = new Matrix4();
  const position = new Vector3();
  const rotation = new Quaternion();
  const scale = new Vector3();
  const zero = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
  let disposed = false;

  function shapeFor(geometry: BufferGeometry): RapierColliderDesc | null {
    const p = (geometry as BufferGeometry & { parameters?: Record<string, number> }).parameters ?? {};
    switch (geometry.type) {
      case "RoundedBoxGeometry": {
        const r = p.radius ?? 0.1;
        return RAPIER.ColliderDesc.roundCuboid(
          (p.width ?? 1) / 2 - r,
          (p.height ?? 1) / 2 - r,
          (p.depth ?? 1) / 2 - r,
          r,
        );
      }
      case "BoxGeometry":
        return RAPIER.ColliderDesc.cuboid((p.width ?? 1) / 2, (p.height ?? 1) / 2, (p.depth ?? 1) / 2);
      case "SphereGeometry":
      case "IcosahedronGeometry":
        return RAPIER.ColliderDesc.ball(p.radius ?? 1);
      case "CylinderGeometry":
        return RAPIER.ColliderDesc.cylinder((p.height ?? 0.5) / 2, p.radiusBottom ?? 0.5);
      case "CapsuleGeometry":
        return RAPIER.ColliderDesc.capsule((p.height ?? 0.5) / 2, p.radius ?? 0.5);
      case "BufferGeometry": {
        const attribute = geometry.getAttribute("position");
        if (!attribute || attribute instanceof GLBufferAttribute)
          throw new Error("RapierPhysics: Geometry requires a CPU position attribute");
        const vertices = new Float32Array(attribute.count * 3);
        for (let i = 0; i < attribute.count; i++) {
          vertices[i * 3] = attribute.getX(i);
          vertices[i * 3 + 1] = attribute.getY(i);
          vertices[i * 3 + 2] = attribute.getZ(i);
        }
        const index = geometry.getIndex();
        const indices = index
          ? Uint32Array.from(index.array)
          : Uint32Array.from({ length: attribute.count }, (_, i) => i);
        return RAPIER.ColliderDesc.trimesh(vertices, indices);
      }
      default:
        console.error("RapierPhysics: Unsupported geometry type:", geometry.type);
        return null;
    }
  }

  function check(mesh: Mesh): void {
    if (disposed) throw new Error("RapierPhysics is disposed");
    if (entries.has(mesh)) throw new Error("RapierPhysics: Mesh already added");
  }
  function createBody(
    p: RapierVector,
    q: RapierRotation,
    mass: number,
    shape: RapierColliderDesc,
  ): { body: RapierBody; collider: RapierCollider } {
    const desc = mass > 0 ? RAPIER.RigidBodyDesc.dynamic() : RAPIER.RigidBodyDesc.fixed();
    desc.setTranslation(p.x, p.y, p.z);
    desc.setRotation(q);
    const body = world.createRigidBody(desc);
    try {
      return { body, collider: world.createCollider(shape, body) };
    } catch (error) {
      world.removeRigidBody(body);
      throw error;
    }
  }
  function register(mesh: Mesh, bodies: RapierBody[], colliders: RapierCollider[], dynamic: boolean): void {
    entries.set(mesh, { bodies, colliders, dynamic });
    if (!mesh.userData.physics) mesh.userData.physics = {};
    mesh.userData.physics.body = mesh instanceof InstancedMesh ? bodies : bodies[0];
    mesh.userData.physics.collider = mesh instanceof InstancedMesh ? colliders : colliders[0];
  }
  function addMesh(mesh: Mesh, mass = 0, restitution = 0): void {
    check(mesh);
    const shape = shapeFor(mesh.geometry);
    if (!shape) return;
    shape.setMass(mass);
    shape.setRestitution(restitution);
    const bodies: RapierBody[] = [],
      colliders: RapierCollider[] = [];
    try {
      const count = mesh instanceof InstancedMesh ? mesh.count : 1;
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        if (mesh instanceof InstancedMesh) mesh.getMatrixAt(i, matrix).decompose(position, rotation, scale);
        else {
          position.copy(mesh.position);
          rotation.copy(mesh.quaternion);
        }
        const result = createBody(position, rotation, mass, shape);
        bodies.push(result.body);
        colliders.push(result.collider);
      }
      register(mesh, bodies, colliders, mass > 0);
    } catch (error) {
      for (const body of bodies) world.removeRigidBody(body);
      throw error;
    }
  }
  function addScene(scene: Object3D): void {
    scene.traverse((child) => {
      if (child instanceof Mesh && child.userData.physics) {
        const data = child.userData.physics as { mass?: number; restitution?: number };
        addMesh(child, data.mass, data.restitution);
      }
    });
  }
  function removeMesh(mesh: Mesh): void {
    const entry = entries.get(mesh);
    if (!entry) return;
    entries.delete(mesh);
    for (const body of entry.bodies) world.removeRigidBody(body);
    const data = mesh.userData.physics as
      | { body?: RapierBody | RapierBody[]; collider?: RapierCollider | RapierCollider[] }
      | undefined;
    if (data) {
      if (data.body === entry.bodies || data.body === entry.bodies[0]) delete data.body;
      if (data.collider === entry.colliders || data.collider === entry.colliders[0]) delete data.collider;
    }
  }
  function getBody(mesh: Mesh, index: number): RapierBody {
    if (disposed) throw new Error("RapierPhysics is disposed");
    const body = entries.get(mesh)?.bodies[index];
    if (!body) throw new Error("RapierPhysics: Mesh or instance is not registered");
    return body;
  }
  function setMeshPosition(mesh: Mesh, value: RapierVector, index = 0): void {
    const body = getBody(mesh, index);
    body.setAngvel(zero, true);
    body.setLinvel(zero, true);
    body.setTranslation(value, true);
  }
  function setMeshVelocity(mesh: Mesh, value: RapierVector, index = 0): void {
    getBody(mesh, index).setLinvel(value, true);
  }
  function applyImpulse(mesh: Mesh, value: RapierVector, index = 0): void {
    getBody(mesh, index).applyImpulse(value, true);
  }
  function addHeightfield(
    mesh: Mesh,
    width: number,
    depth: number,
    heights: Float32Array,
    size: RapierVector,
  ): RapierBody {
    check(mesh);
    const shape = RAPIER.ColliderDesc.heightfield(width, depth, heights, size);
    const { body, collider } = createBody(mesh.position, mesh.quaternion, 0, shape);
    register(mesh, [body], [collider], false);
    return body;
  }
  function step(delta?: number): void {
    if (disposed) return;
    if (delta === undefined) {
      timer.update();
      delta = timer.getDelta();
    }
    world.timestep = Math.min(delta, 1 / 30);
    world.step();
    for (const [mesh, entry] of entries) {
      if (!entry.dynamic) continue;
      for (let i = 0; i < entry.bodies.length; i++) {
        const body = entry.bodies[i];
        if (mesh instanceof InstancedMesh) {
          mesh.getMatrixAt(i, matrix).decompose(position, rotation, scale);
          const p = body.translation(),
            q = body.rotation();
          position.set(p.x, p.y, p.z);
          rotation.set(q.x, q.y, q.z, q.w);
          matrix.compose(position, rotation, scale);
          mesh.setMatrixAt(i, matrix);
        } else {
          const p = body.translation(),
            q = body.rotation();
          mesh.position.set(p.x, p.y, p.z);
          mesh.quaternion.set(q.x, q.y, q.z, q.w);
        }
      }
      if (mesh instanceof InstancedMesh) {
        mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
        mesh.computeBoundingSphere();
      }
    }
  }
  const interval = setInterval(step, 1000 / 60);
  function dispose(): void {
    if (disposed) return;
    clearInterval(interval);
    timer.dispose();
    for (const mesh of entries.keys()) removeMesh(mesh);
    disposed = true;
    world.free();
  }
  return {
    RAPIER,
    world,
    addScene,
    addMesh,
    removeMesh,
    setMeshPosition,
    setMeshVelocity,
    applyImpulse,
    addHeightfield,
    step,
    dispose,
  };
}
```

## ek3d/addons/postprocessing/AfterimagePass

````typescript
import { TextureType, TextureFilter, Blending } from "../../constants";
import { ShaderMaterial } from "../../materials/ShaderMaterial";
import { cloneUniforms } from "../../renderers/shaders/UniformsUtils";
import { WebGLRenderTarget } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";
import { CopyShader } from "../shaders/CopyShader";
import { AfterimageShader } from "../shaders/AfterimageShader";
import { Pass, FullScreenQuad } from "./Pass";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";

/**
 * Pass for a basic after image effect.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const afterimagePass = new AfterimagePass( 0.9 );
 * composer.addPass( afterimagePass );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class AfterimagePass extends Pass {
  uniforms: Record<string, { value: any; needsUpdate?: boolean }>;
  compFsMaterial: ShaderMaterial;
  copyFsMaterial: ShaderMaterial;
  _compFsQuad: FullScreenQuad;
  _copyFsQuad: FullScreenQuad;
  _textureComp: WebGLRenderTarget;
  _textureOld: WebGLRenderTarget;

  /**
   * Constructs a new after image pass.
   *
   * @param damp - The damping intensity. A higher value means a stronger after image effect.
   */
  constructor(damp: number = 0.96) {
    super();
    /**
     * The pass uniforms. Use this object if you want to update the
     * `damp` value at runtime.
     * ```ts
     * pass.uniforms.damp.value = 0.9;
     * ```
     */
    this.uniforms = cloneUniforms(AfterimageShader.uniforms);

    this.damp = damp;

    /**
     * The composition material.
     */
    this.compFsMaterial = new ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: this.uniforms,
      vertexShader: AfterimageShader.vertexShader,
      fragmentShader: AfterimageShader.fragmentShader,
    });

    /**
     * The copy material.
     */
    this.copyFsMaterial = new ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: cloneUniforms(CopyShader.uniforms),
      vertexShader: CopyShader.vertexShader,
      fragmentShader: CopyShader.fragmentShader,
      blending: Blending.No,
      depthTest: false,
      depthWrite: false,
    });

    // internals

    this._textureComp = new WebGLRenderTarget(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight, {
      magFilter: TextureFilter.Nearest,
      type: TextureType.HalfFloat,
      depthBuffer: false,
    });

    this._textureOld = new WebGLRenderTarget(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight, {
      magFilter: TextureFilter.Nearest,
      type: TextureType.HalfFloat,
      depthBuffer: false,
    });

    this._compFsQuad = new FullScreenQuad(this.compFsMaterial);
    this._copyFsQuad = new FullScreenQuad(this.copyFsMaterial);
  }

  /**
   * The damping intensity, from 0.0 to 1.0. A higher value means a stronger after image effect.
   */
  get damp(): number {
    return this.uniforms["damp"].value;
  }

  set damp(value: number) {
    this.uniforms["damp"].value = value;
  }

  /**
   * Performs the after image pass.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param writeBuffer - The write buffer. This buffer is intended as the rendering
   * destination for the pass.
   * @param readBuffer - The read buffer. The pass can access the result from the
   * previous pass from this buffer.
   * @param deltaTime - The delta time in seconds.
   * @param maskActive - Whether masking is active or not.
   */
  render(
    renderer: WebGLRenderer,
    writeBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    readBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    _deltaTime: number,
    _maskActive: boolean,
  ): void {
    this.uniforms["tOld"].value = this._textureOld.texture;
    this.uniforms["tNew"].value = readBuffer.texture;

    renderer.setRenderTarget(this._textureComp);
    this._compFsQuad.render(renderer);

    this._copyFsQuad.material = this.copyFsMaterial;
    this.copyFsMaterial.uniforms.tDiffuse.value = this._textureComp.texture;

    if (this.renderToScreen) {
      renderer.setRenderTarget(null);
      this._copyFsQuad.render(renderer);
    } else {
      renderer.setRenderTarget(writeBuffer);

      if (this.clear) renderer.clear();

      this._copyFsQuad.render(renderer);
    }

    // Swap buffers.
    const temp = this._textureOld;
    this._textureOld = this._textureComp;
    this._textureComp = temp;
    // Now textureOld contains the latest image, ready for the next frame.
  }

  /**
   * Sets the size of the pass.
   *
   * @param width - The width to set.
   * @param height - The height to set.
   */
  setSize(width: number, height: number): void {
    this._textureComp.setSize(width, height);
    this._textureOld.setSize(width, height);
  }

  /**
   * Frees the GPU-related resources allocated by this instance. Call this
   * method whenever the pass is no longer used in your app.
   */
  dispose(): void {
    this._textureComp.dispose();
    this._textureOld.dispose();

    this.compFsMaterial.dispose();
    this.copyFsMaterial.dispose();

    this._compFsQuad.dispose();
    this._copyFsQuad.dispose();
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/postprocessing/BloomPass

````typescript
import { Blending, TextureType } from "../../constants";
import { ShaderMaterial } from "../../materials/ShaderMaterial";
import { cloneUniforms } from "../../renderers/shaders/UniformsUtils";
import { Vector2 } from "../../math/Vector2";
import { WebGLRenderTarget } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";
import { ConvolutionShader } from "../shaders/ConvolutionShader";
import { Pass, FullScreenQuad } from "./Pass";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";

/**
 * A pass for a basic Bloom effect.
 *
 * {@link https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/dev/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js | UnrealBloomPass}
 * produces a more advanced Bloom but is also more expensive.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const effectBloom = new BloomPass( 0.75 );
 * composer.addPass( effectBloom );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class BloomPass extends Pass {
  combineUniforms: Record<string, { value: any; needsUpdate?: boolean }>;
  materialCombine: ShaderMaterial;
  convolutionUniforms: Record<string, { value: any; needsUpdate?: boolean }>;
  materialConvolution: ShaderMaterial;
  needsSwap: boolean;
  _fsQuad: FullScreenQuad;
  _renderTargetX: WebGLRenderTarget;
  _renderTargetY: WebGLRenderTarget;

  /**
   * Static blur increments along the image X and Y axes, shared by all instances.
   */
  static blurX: Vector2 = new Vector2(0.001953125, 0.0);
  static blurY: Vector2 = new Vector2(0.0, 0.001953125);

  /**
   * Constructs a new Bloom pass.
   *
   * @param strength - The bloom strength. A higher value increases the effect.
   * @param kernelSize - The convolution kernel size, used for the blur quality.
   * @param sigma - The sigma of the gaussian kernel; a higher value means a stronger blur.
   */
  constructor(strength: number = 1, kernelSize: number = 25, sigma: number = 4) {
    super();

    // combine material

    /**
     * The combine pass uniforms.
     */
    this.combineUniforms = cloneUniforms(CombineShader.uniforms);
    this.combineUniforms["strength"].value = strength;

    /**
     * The combine pass material.
     */
    this.materialCombine = new ShaderMaterial({
      name: CombineShader.name,
      uniforms: this.combineUniforms,
      vertexShader: CombineShader.vertexShader,
      fragmentShader: CombineShader.fragmentShader,
      blending: Blending.Additive,
      transparent: true,
    });

    // convolution material

    const convolutionShader = ConvolutionShader;

    /**
     * The convolution pass uniforms.
     */
    this.convolutionUniforms = cloneUniforms(convolutionShader.uniforms);

    this.convolutionUniforms["uImageIncrement"].value = BloomPass.blurX;
    this.convolutionUniforms["cKernel"].value = buildKernel(sigma);

    /**
     * The convolution pass material.
     */
    this.materialConvolution = new ShaderMaterial({
      name: convolutionShader.name,
      uniforms: this.convolutionUniforms,
      vertexShader: convolutionShader.vertexShader,
      fragmentShader: convolutionShader.fragmentShader,
      defines: {
        KERNEL_SIZE_FLOAT: kernelSize.toFixed(1),
        KERNEL_SIZE_INT: kernelSize.toFixed(0),
      },
    });

    /**
     * Overwritten to disable the swap.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.needsSwap = false;

    // internals

    this._renderTargetX = new WebGLRenderTarget(1, 1, { type: TextureType.HalfFloat, depthBuffer: false }); // will be resized later
    this._renderTargetX.texture.name = "BloomPass.x";
    this._renderTargetY = new WebGLRenderTarget(1, 1, { type: TextureType.HalfFloat, depthBuffer: false }); // will be resized later
    this._renderTargetY.texture.name = "BloomPass.y";

    this._fsQuad = new FullScreenQuad(null);
  }

  /**
   * Performs the Bloom pass.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param writeBuffer - The write buffer. This buffer is intended as the rendering
   * destination for the pass.
   * @param readBuffer - The read buffer. The pass can access the result from the
   * previous pass from this buffer.
   * @param deltaTime - The delta time in seconds.
   * @param maskActive - Whether masking is active or not.
   */
  render(
    renderer: WebGLRenderer,
    writeBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    readBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    deltaTime: number,
    maskActive: boolean,
  ): void {
    if (maskActive) renderer.state.buffers.stencil.setTest(false);

    // Render quad with blurred scene into texture (convolution pass 1)

    this._fsQuad.material = this.materialConvolution;

    this.convolutionUniforms["tDiffuse"].value = readBuffer.texture;
    this.convolutionUniforms["uImageIncrement"].value = BloomPass.blurX;

    renderer.setRenderTarget(this._renderTargetX);
    renderer.clear();
    this._fsQuad.render(renderer);

    // Render quad with blurred scene into texture (convolution pass 2)

    this.convolutionUniforms["tDiffuse"].value = this._renderTargetX.texture;
    this.convolutionUniforms["uImageIncrement"].value = BloomPass.blurY;

    renderer.setRenderTarget(this._renderTargetY);
    renderer.clear();
    this._fsQuad.render(renderer);

    // Render original scene with superimposed blur to texture

    this._fsQuad.material = this.materialCombine;

    this.combineUniforms["tDiffuse"].value = this._renderTargetY.texture;

    if (maskActive) renderer.state.buffers.stencil.setTest(true);

    renderer.setRenderTarget(readBuffer);
    if (this.clear) renderer.clear();
    this._fsQuad.render(renderer);
  }

  /**
   * Sets the size of the pass.
   *
   * @param width - The width to set.
   * @param height - The height to set.
   */
  setSize(width: number, height: number): void {
    this._renderTargetX.setSize(width, height);
    this._renderTargetY.setSize(width, height);
  }

  /**
   * Frees the GPU-related resources allocated by this instance. Call this
   * method whenever the pass is no longer used in your app.
   */
  dispose(): void {
    this._renderTargetX.dispose();
    this._renderTargetY.dispose();

    this.materialCombine.dispose();
    this.materialConvolution.dispose();

    this._fsQuad.dispose();
  }
}

const CombineShader = {
  name: "CombineShader",

  uniforms: {
    tDiffuse: { value: null },
    strength: { value: 1.0 },
  },

  vertexShader: /* glsl */ `

		varying vec2 vUv;

		void main() {

			vUv = uv;
			gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4( position, 1.0 );

		}`,

  fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `

		uniform float strength;

		uniform sampler2D tDiffuse;

		varying vec2 vUv;

		void main() {

			vec4 texel = texture2D( tDiffuse, vUv );
			gl_FragColor = strength * texel;

		}`,
};

function gauss(x: number, sigma: number): number {
  return Math.exp(-(x * x) / (2.0 * sigma * sigma));
}

function buildKernel(sigma: number): number[] {
  // We loop off the sqrt(2 * pi) * sigma term, since we're going to normalize anyway.

  const kMaxKernelSize = 25;
  let kernelSize = 2 * Math.ceil(sigma * 3.0) + 1;

  if (kernelSize > kMaxKernelSize) kernelSize = kMaxKernelSize;

  const halfWidth = (kernelSize - 1) * 0.5;

  const values: number[] = [];
  let sum = 0.0;
  for (let i = 0; i < kernelSize; ++i) {
    values[i] = gauss(i - halfWidth, sigma);
    sum += values[i];
  }

  // normalize the kernel

  for (let i = 0; i < kernelSize; ++i) values[i] /= sum;

  return values;
}
````

## ek3d/addons/postprocessing/BokehPass

````typescript
import { TextureType, TextureFilter, Blending, DepthPacking } from "../../constants";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { MeshDepthMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshDepthMaterial";
import { ShaderMaterial } from "../../materials/ShaderMaterial";
import { cloneUniforms } from "../../renderers/shaders/UniformsUtils";
import { WebGLRenderTarget } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";
import { BokehShader } from "../shaders/BokehShader";
import { Pass, FullScreenQuad } from "./Pass";
import type { PerspectiveCamera } from "../../cameras/PerspectiveCamera";
import type { Scene } from "../../scenes/Scene";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";
import type { WebGLRenderTarget as RT } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";

/** Bokeh pass options. */
export interface BokehPassOptions {
  /** The focus distance along the camera's look direction in world units. */
  focus?: number;
  /** The aperture. */
  aperture?: number;
  /** The maximum blur. */
  maxblur?: number;
}

/**
 * Pass for creating depth of field (DOF) effect.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const bokehPass = new BokehPass( scene, camera, {
 * 	focus: 500
 * 	aperture: 5,
 * 	maxblur: 0.01
 * } );
 * composer.addPass( bokehPass );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class BokehPass extends Pass {
  scene: Scene;
  camera: PerspectiveCamera;
  uniforms: Record<string, { value: any; needsUpdate?: boolean }>;
  materialBokeh: ShaderMaterial;
  _fsQuad: FullScreenQuad;
  _renderTargetDepth: WebGLRenderTarget;
  _materialDepth: MeshDepthMaterial;
  _oldClearColor: Color;

  /**
   * Constructs a new Bokeh pass.
   *
   * @param scene - The scene to render the DOF for.
   * @param camera - The camera.
   * @param params - The pass options.
   */
  constructor(scene: Scene, camera: PerspectiveCamera, params: BokehPassOptions) {
    super();
    /**
     * The scene to render the DOF for.
     */
    this.scene = scene;

    /**
     * The camera.
     */
    this.camera = camera;

    const focus = params.focus !== undefined ? params.focus : 1.0;
    const aperture = params.aperture !== undefined ? params.aperture : 0.025;
    const maxblur = params.maxblur !== undefined ? params.maxblur : 1.0;

    // render targets

    this._renderTargetDepth = new WebGLRenderTarget(1, 1, {
      // will be resized later
      minFilter: TextureFilter.Nearest,
      magFilter: TextureFilter.Nearest,
      type: TextureType.HalfFloat,
    });

    this._renderTargetDepth.texture.name = "BokehPass.depth";

    // depth material

    this._materialDepth = new MeshDepthMaterial();
    this._materialDepth.depthPacking = DepthPacking.RGBA;
    this._materialDepth.blending = Blending.No;

    // bokeh material

    const bokehUniforms = cloneUniforms(BokehShader.uniforms) as Record<string, { value: any; needsUpdate?: boolean }>;

    bokehUniforms["tDepth"].value = this._renderTargetDepth.texture;

    bokehUniforms["focus"].value = focus;
    bokehUniforms["aspect"].value = camera.aspect;
    bokehUniforms["aperture"].value = aperture;
    bokehUniforms["maxblur"].value = maxblur;
    bokehUniforms["nearClip"].value = camera.near;
    bokehUniforms["farClip"].value = camera.far;

    /**
     * The pass bokeh material.
     */
    this.materialBokeh = new ShaderMaterial({
      defines: { ...BokehShader.defines },
      uniforms: bokehUniforms,
      vertexShader: BokehShader.vertexShader,
      fragmentShader: BokehShader.fragmentShader,
    });

    /**
     * The pass uniforms. Use this object if you want to update the
     * `focus`, `aperture` or `maxblur` values at runtime.
     *
     * ```ts
     * pass.uniforms.focus.value = focus;
     * pass.uniforms.aperture.value = aperture;
     * pass.uniforms.maxblur.value = maxblur;
     * ```
     */
    this.uniforms = bokehUniforms;

    // internals

    this._fsQuad = new FullScreenQuad(this.materialBokeh);

    this._oldClearColor = new Color();
  }

  /**
   * Performs the Bokeh pass.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param writeBuffer - The write buffer. This buffer is intended as the rendering
   * destination for the pass.
   * @param readBuffer - The read buffer. The pass can access the result from the
   * previous pass from this buffer.
   * @param deltaTime - The delta time in seconds.
   * @param maskActive - Whether masking is active or not.
   */
  render(renderer: WebGLRenderer, writeBuffer: RT, readBuffer: RT, _deltaTime: number, _maskActive: boolean): void {
    // Render depth into texture

    this.scene.overrideMaterial = this._materialDepth;

    renderer.getClearColor(this._oldClearColor);
    const oldClearAlpha = renderer.getClearAlpha();
    const oldAutoClear = renderer.autoClear;
    renderer.autoClear = false;

    renderer.setClearColor(0xffffff);
    renderer.setClearAlpha(1.0);
    renderer.setRenderTarget(this._renderTargetDepth);
    renderer.clear();
    renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);

    // Render bokeh composite

    this.uniforms["tColor"].value = readBuffer.texture;
    this.uniforms["nearClip"].value = this.camera.near;
    this.uniforms["farClip"].value = this.camera.far;

    if (this.renderToScreen) {
      renderer.setRenderTarget(null);
      this._fsQuad.render(renderer);
    } else {
      renderer.setRenderTarget(writeBuffer);
      renderer.clear();
      this._fsQuad.render(renderer);
    }

    this.scene.overrideMaterial = null;
    renderer.setClearColor(this._oldClearColor);
    renderer.setClearAlpha(oldClearAlpha);
    renderer.autoClear = oldAutoClear;
  }

  /**
   * Sets the size of the pass.
   *
   * @param width - The width to set.
   * @param height - The height to set.
   */
  setSize(width: number, height: number): void {
    this.materialBokeh.uniforms["aspect"].value = width / height;

    this._renderTargetDepth.setSize(width, height);
  }

  /**
   * Frees the GPU-related resources allocated by this instance. Call this
   * method whenever the pass is no longer used in your app.
   */
  dispose(): void {
    this._renderTargetDepth.dispose();

    this._materialDepth.dispose();
    this.materialBokeh.dispose();

    this._fsQuad.dispose();
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/postprocessing/ClearPass

````typescript
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Pass } from "./Pass";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";
import type { WebGLRenderTarget } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";

/**
 * This pass can be used to force a clear operation for the current read or
 * default framebuffer (when rendering to screen).
 *
 * ```ts
 * const clearPass = new ClearPass();
 * composer.addPass( clearPass );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class ClearPass extends Pass {
  needsSwap: boolean;
  clearColor: number | Color | string;
  clearAlpha: number;
  _oldClearColor: Color;

  /**
   * Constructs a new clear pass.
   *
   * @param clearColor - The clear color.
   * @param clearAlpha - The clear alpha.
   */
  constructor(clearColor: number | Color | string = 0x000000, clearAlpha: number = 0) {
    super();
    /**
     * Overwritten to disable the swap.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.needsSwap = false;
    /**
     * The clear color.
     *
     * @default 0x000000
     */
    this.clearColor = clearColor;
    /**
     * The clear alpha.
     *
     * @default 0
     */
    this.clearAlpha = clearAlpha;

    // internals

    this._oldClearColor = new Color();
  }

  /**
   * Performs the clear operation. This affects the current read or the default framebuffer.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param writeBuffer - The write buffer. This buffer is intended as the rendering
   * destination for the pass.
   * @param readBuffer - The read buffer. The pass can access the result from the
   * previous pass from this buffer.
   * @param deltaTime - The delta time in seconds.
   * @param maskActive - Whether masking is active or not.
   */
  render(
    renderer: WebGLRenderer,
    writeBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    readBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    _deltaTime: number,
    _maskActive: boolean,
  ): void {
    let oldClearAlpha: number | undefined;

    if (this.clearColor) {
      renderer.getClearColor(this._oldClearColor);
      oldClearAlpha = renderer.getClearAlpha();

      renderer.setClearColor(this.clearColor, this.clearAlpha);
    }

    renderer.setRenderTarget(this.renderToScreen ? null : readBuffer);
    renderer.clear();

    if (this.clearColor) {
      renderer.setClearColor(this._oldClearColor, oldClearAlpha);
    }
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/postprocessing/CubeTexturePass

````typescript
import { Side } from "../../constants";
import { BoxGeometry } from "../../geometries/BoxGeometry";
import { ShaderMaterial } from "../../materials/ShaderMaterial";
import { cloneUniforms } from "../../renderers/shaders/UniformsUtils";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import { PerspectiveCamera } from "../../cameras/PerspectiveCamera";
import { Scene } from "../../scenes/Scene";
import { Pass } from "./Pass";
import type { CubeTexture } from "../../textures/CubeTexture";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";
import type { WebGLRenderTarget } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";
import chunk_common from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/common.glsl";
import chunk_begin_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/begin_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_project_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/project_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_tonemapping_fragment from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/tonemapping_fragment.glsl";
import chunk_colorspace_fragment from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/colorspace_fragment.glsl";

// The upstream `ShaderLib.cube` shader, inlined because this package has no ShaderLib barrel.
const cubeShader = {
  uniforms: {
    tCube: { value: null },
    tFlip: { value: -1 },
    opacity: { value: 1.0 },
  },

  vertexShader: /* glsl */ `
varying vec3 vWorldDirection;

${chunk_common}

void main() {

	vWorldDirection = transformDirection( position, modelMatrix );

	${chunk_begin_vertex}
	${chunk_project_vertex}

	gl_Position.z = gl_Position.w; // set z to camera.far

}
`,

  fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `
uniform samplerCube tCube;
uniform float tFlip;
uniform float opacity;

varying vec3 vWorldDirection;

void main() {

	vec4 texColor = textureCube( tCube, vec3( tFlip * vWorldDirection.x, vWorldDirection.yz ) );

	gl_FragColor = texColor;
	gl_FragColor.a *= opacity;

	${chunk_tonemapping_fragment}
	${chunk_colorspace_fragment}

}
`,
};

/**
 * This pass can be used to render a cube texture over the entire screen.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const cubeMap = new CubeTextureLoader().load( urls );
 *
 * const cubeTexturePass = new CubeTexturePass( camera, cubemap );
 * composer.addPass( cubeTexturePass );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class CubeTexturePass extends Pass {
  camera: PerspectiveCamera;
  tCube: CubeTexture | null;
  opacity: number;
  needsSwap: boolean;
  _cubeMesh: Mesh<ShaderMaterial>;
  _cubeScene: Scene;
  _cubeCamera: PerspectiveCamera;

  /**
   * Constructs a new cube texture pass.
   *
   * @param camera - The camera.
   * @param tCube - The cube texture to render.
   * @param opacity - The opacity.
   */
  constructor(camera: PerspectiveCamera, tCube: CubeTexture | null, opacity: number = 1) {
    super();
    /**
     * The camera.
     */
    this.camera = camera;

    /**
     * The cube texture to render.
     */
    this.tCube = tCube;

    /**
     * The opacity.
     *
     * @default 1
     */
    this.opacity = opacity;

    /**
     * Overwritten to disable the swap.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.needsSwap = false;

    // internals

    const material = new ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: cloneUniforms(cubeShader.uniforms),
      vertexShader: cubeShader.vertexShader,
      fragmentShader: cubeShader.fragmentShader,
      depthTest: false,
      depthWrite: false,
      side: Side.Back,
    });

    // The renderer samples the envMap uniform for background-like materials.
    Object.defineProperty(material, "envMap", {
      get: function () {
        return material.uniforms.tCube.value;
      },
    });

    // The mesh's envMap getter keeps upstream naming.
    this._cubeMesh = new Mesh(new BoxGeometry(10, 10, 10), material);

    this._cubeScene = new Scene();
    this._cubeCamera = new PerspectiveCamera();
    this._cubeScene.add(this._cubeMesh);
  }

  /**
   * Performs the cube texture pass.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param writeBuffer - The write buffer. This buffer is intended as the rendering
   * destination for the pass.
   * @param readBuffer - The read buffer. The pass can access the result from the
   * previous pass from this buffer.
   * @param deltaTime - The delta time in seconds.
   * @param maskActive - Whether masking is active or not.
   */
  render(
    renderer: WebGLRenderer,
    writeBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    readBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    _deltaTime: number,
    _maskActive: boolean,
  ): void {
    const oldAutoClear = renderer.autoClear;
    renderer.autoClear = false;

    this._cubeCamera.projectionMatrix.copy(this.camera.projectionMatrix);
    this._cubeCamera.quaternion.setFromRotationMatrix(this.camera.matrixWorld);

    const material = this._cubeMesh.material;
    material.uniforms.tCube.value = this.tCube;
    material.uniforms.tFlip.value =
      this.tCube !== null && this.tCube.isCubeTexture === true && this.tCube.isRenderTargetTexture === false ? -1 : 1;
    material.uniforms.opacity.value = this.opacity;
    material.transparent = this.opacity < 1.0;

    renderer.setRenderTarget(this.renderToScreen ? null : readBuffer);
    if (this.clear) renderer.clear();
    renderer.render(this._cubeScene, this._cubeCamera);

    renderer.autoClear = oldAutoClear;
  }

  /**
   * Frees the GPU-related resources allocated by this instance. Call this
   * method whenever the pass is no longer used in your app.
   */
  dispose(): void {
    this._cubeMesh.geometry.dispose();
    this._cubeMesh.material.dispose();
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/postprocessing/DotScreenPass

````typescript
import { ShaderMaterial } from "../../materials/ShaderMaterial";
import { cloneUniforms } from "../../renderers/shaders/UniformsUtils";
import { Vector2 } from "../../math/Vector2";
import { DotScreenShader } from "../shaders/DotScreenShader";
import { Pass, FullScreenQuad } from "./Pass";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";
import type { WebGLRenderTarget } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";

/**
 * Pass for creating a dot-screen effect.
 *
 * ```typescript
 * const pass = new DotScreenPass( new Vector2( 0, 0 ), 0.5, 0.8 );
 * composer.addPass( pass );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class DotScreenPass extends Pass {
  uniforms: typeof DotScreenShader.uniforms;
  material: ShaderMaterial;
  _fsQuad: FullScreenQuad;

  /**
   * Constructs a new dot screen pass.
   *
   * @param center - The center point.
   * @param angle - The rotation of the effect in radians.
   * @param scale - The scale of the effect. A higher value means smaller dots.
   */
  constructor(center?: Vector2, angle?: number, scale?: number) {
    super();
    /**
     * The pass uniforms. Use this object if you want to update the
     * `center`, `angle` or `scale` value at runtime.
     * ```typescript
     * pass.uniforms.center.value.set( 0.25, 0.25 );
     * ```
     */
    this.uniforms = cloneUniforms(DotScreenShader.uniforms);

    if (center !== undefined) this.uniforms["center"].value.copy(center);
    if (angle !== undefined) this.uniforms["angle"].value = angle;
    if (scale !== undefined) this.uniforms["scale"].value = scale;

    /**
     * The pass material.
     */
    this.material = new ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: this.uniforms,
      vertexShader: DotScreenShader.vertexShader,
      fragmentShader: DotScreenShader.fragmentShader,
    });

    // internals

    this._fsQuad = new FullScreenQuad(this.material);
  }

  /**
   * Performs the dot screen pass.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param writeBuffer - The write buffer. This buffer is intended as the rendering
   * destination for the pass.
   * @param readBuffer - The read buffer. The pass can access the result from the
   * previous pass from this buffer.
   * @param deltaTime - The delta time in seconds.
   * @param maskActive - Whether masking is active or not.
   */
  render(
    renderer: WebGLRenderer,
    writeBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    readBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    _deltaTime: number,
    _maskActive: boolean,
  ): void {
    this.uniforms["tDiffuse"].value = readBuffer.texture;
    this.uniforms["tSize"].value.set(readBuffer.width, readBuffer.height);

    if (this.renderToScreen) {
      renderer.setRenderTarget(null);
      this._fsQuad.render(renderer);
    } else {
      renderer.setRenderTarget(writeBuffer);
      if (this.clear) renderer.clear();
      this._fsQuad.render(renderer);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Frees the GPU-related resources allocated by this instance. Call this
   * method whenever the pass is no longer used in your app.
   */
  dispose(): void {
    this.material.dispose();

    this._fsQuad.dispose();
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/postprocessing/EffectComposer

````typescript
import { GL } from "../../GL";
import { TextureType, Blending } from "../../constants";
import { Timer } from "../../core/Timer";
import { Vector2 } from "../../math/Vector2";
import { WebGLRenderTarget } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";
import { CopyShader } from "../shaders/CopyShader";
import { ShaderPass } from "./ShaderPass";
import { ClearMaskPass, MaskPass } from "./MaskPass";
import type { Pass } from "./Pass";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";

/**
 * Used to implement post-processing effects in three.js.
 * The class manages a chain of post-processing passes to produce the final visual result.
 * Post-processing passes are executed in order of their addition/insertion.
 * The last pass is automatically rendered to screen.
 *
 * This module can only be used with {@link WebGLRenderer}.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const composer = new EffectComposer( renderer );
 *
 * // adding some passes
 * const renderPass = new RenderPass( scene, camera );
 * composer.addPass( renderPass );
 *
 * const glitchPass = new GlitchPass();
 * composer.addPass( glitchPass );
 *
 * const outputPass = new OutputPass()
 * composer.addPass( outputPass );
 *
 * function animate() {
 *
 * 	composer.render(); // instead of renderer.render()
 *
 * }
 * ```
 *
 */
export class EffectComposer {
  renderer: WebGLRenderer;
  _pixelRatio: number;
  _width: number;
  _height: number;
  renderTarget1: WebGLRenderTarget;
  renderTarget2: WebGLRenderTarget;
  writeBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget;
  readBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget;
  renderToScreen: boolean;
  passes: Pass[];
  copyPass: ShaderPass;
  timer: Timer;

  /**
   * Constructs a new effect composer.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param renderTarget - This render target and a clone will
   * be used as the internal read and write buffers. If not given, the composer creates
   * the buffers automatically.
   */
  constructor(renderer: WebGLRenderer, renderTarget?: WebGLRenderTarget) {
    /**
     * The renderer.
     */
    this.renderer = renderer;

    this._pixelRatio = renderer.getPixelRatio();

    if (renderTarget === undefined) {
      const size = renderer.getSize(new Vector2());
      this._width = size.width;
      this._height = size.height;

      renderTarget = new WebGLRenderTarget(this._width * this._pixelRatio, this._height * this._pixelRatio, {
        type: TextureType.HalfFloat,
      });
      renderTarget.texture.name = "EffectComposer.rt1";
    } else {
      this._width = renderTarget.width;
      this._height = renderTarget.height;
    }

    this.renderTarget1 = renderTarget;
    this.renderTarget2 = renderTarget.clone();
    this.renderTarget2.texture.name = "EffectComposer.rt2";

    /**
     * A reference to the internal write buffer. Passes usually write
     * their result into this buffer.
     */
    this.writeBuffer = this.renderTarget1;

    /**
     * A reference to the internal read buffer. Passes usually read
     * the previous render result from this buffer.
     */
    this.readBuffer = this.renderTarget2;

    /**
     * Whether the final pass is rendered to the screen (default framebuffer) or not.
     *
     * @default true
     */
    this.renderToScreen = true;

    /**
     * An array representing the (ordered) chain of post-processing passes.
     */
    this.passes = [];

    /**
     * A copy pass used for internal swap operations.
     *
     * @private
     */
    this.copyPass = new ShaderPass(CopyShader);
    this.copyPass.material!.blending = Blending.No;

    /**
     * The internal timer for managing time data.
     *
     * @private
     */
    this.timer = new Timer();
  }

  /**
   * Swaps the internal read/write buffers.
   */
  swapBuffers(): void {
    const tmp = this.readBuffer;
    this.readBuffer = this.writeBuffer;
    this.writeBuffer = tmp;
  }

  /**
   * Adds the given pass to the pass chain.
   *
   * @param pass - The pass to add.
   */
  addPass(pass: Pass): void {
    this.passes.push(pass);
    pass.setSize(this._width * this._pixelRatio, this._height * this._pixelRatio);
  }

  /**
   * Inserts the given pass at a given index.
   *
   * @param pass - The pass to insert.
   * @param index - The index into the pass chain.
   */
  insertPass(pass: Pass, index: number): void {
    this.passes.splice(index, 0, pass);
    pass.setSize(this._width * this._pixelRatio, this._height * this._pixelRatio);
  }

  /**
   * Removes the given pass from the pass chain.
   *
   * @param pass - The pass to remove.
   */
  removePass(pass: Pass): void {
    const index = this.passes.indexOf(pass);

    if (index !== -1) {
      this.passes.splice(index, 1);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Returns `true` if the pass for the given index is the last enabled pass in the pass chain.
   *
   * @param passIndex - The pass index.
   * @return Whether the pass for the given index is the last pass in the pass chain.
   */
  isLastEnabledPass(passIndex: number): boolean {
    for (let i = passIndex + 1; i < this.passes.length; i++) {
      if (this.passes[i].enabled) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Executes all enabled post-processing passes in order to produce the final frame.
   *
   * @param deltaTime - The delta time in seconds. If not given, the composer computes
   * its own time delta value.
   */
  render(deltaTime?: number): void {
    // deltaTime value is in seconds

    this.timer.update();

    if (deltaTime === undefined) {
      deltaTime = this.timer.getDelta();
    }

    const currentRenderTarget = this.renderer.getRenderTarget();

    let maskActive = false;

    for (let i = 0, il = this.passes.length; i < il; i++) {
      const pass = this.passes[i];

      if (pass.enabled === false) continue;

      pass.renderToScreen = this.renderToScreen && this.isLastEnabledPass(i);
      pass.render(this.renderer, this.writeBuffer, this.readBuffer, deltaTime, maskActive);

      if (pass.needsSwap) {
        if (maskActive) {
          const stencil = this.renderer.state.buffers.stencil;

          stencil.setFunc(GL.NOTEQUAL, 1, 0xffffffff);

          this.copyPass.render(this.renderer, this.writeBuffer, this.readBuffer, deltaTime, maskActive);

          stencil.setFunc(GL.EQUAL, 1, 0xffffffff);
        }

        this.swapBuffers();
      }

      if (pass instanceof MaskPass) {
        maskActive = true;
      } else if (pass instanceof ClearMaskPass) {
        maskActive = false;
      }
    }

    this.renderer.setRenderTarget(currentRenderTarget);
  }

  /**
   * Resets the internal state of the EffectComposer.
   *
   * @param renderTarget - This render target has the same purpose like
   * the one from the constructor. If set, it is used to setup the read and write buffers.
   */
  reset(renderTarget?: WebGLRenderTarget): void {
    if (renderTarget === undefined) {
      const size = this.renderer.getSize(new Vector2());
      this._pixelRatio = this.renderer.getPixelRatio();
      this._width = size.width;
      this._height = size.height;

      renderTarget = this.renderTarget1.clone();
      renderTarget.setSize(this._width * this._pixelRatio, this._height * this._pixelRatio);
    }

    this.renderTarget1.dispose();
    this.renderTarget2.dispose();
    this.renderTarget1 = renderTarget;
    this.renderTarget2 = renderTarget.clone();

    this.writeBuffer = this.renderTarget1;
    this.readBuffer = this.renderTarget2;
  }

  /**
   * Resizes the internal read and write buffers as well as all passes. Similar to {@link WebGLRenderer#setSize},
   * this method honors the current pixel ration.
   *
   * @param width - The width in logical pixels.
   * @param height - The height in logical pixels.
   */
  setSize(width: number, height: number): void {
    this._width = width;
    this._height = height;

    const effectiveWidth = this._width * this._pixelRatio;
    const effectiveHeight = this._height * this._pixelRatio;

    this.renderTarget1.setSize(effectiveWidth, effectiveHeight);
    this.renderTarget2.setSize(effectiveWidth, effectiveHeight);

    for (let i = 0; i < this.passes.length; i++) {
      this.passes[i].setSize(effectiveWidth, effectiveHeight);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Sets device pixel ratio. This is usually used for HiDPI device to prevent blurring output.
   * Setting the pixel ratio will automatically resize the composer.
   *
   * @param pixelRatio - The pixel ratio to set.
   */
