  setPixelRatio(pixelRatio: number): void {
    this._pixelRatio = pixelRatio;

    this.setSize(this._width, this._height);
  }

  /**
   * Frees the GPU-related resources allocated by this instance. Call this
   * method whenever the composer is no longer used in your app.
   */
  dispose(): void {
    this.renderTarget1.dispose();
    this.renderTarget2.dispose();

    this.copyPass.dispose();
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/postprocessing/FilmPass

````typescript
import { ShaderMaterial } from "../../materials/ShaderMaterial";
import { cloneUniforms } from "../../renderers/shaders/UniformsUtils";
import { FilmShader } from "../shaders/FilmShader";
import { Pass, FullScreenQuad } from "./Pass";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";
import type { WebGLRenderTarget } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";

/**
 * This pass can be used to create a film grain effect.
 *
 * ```typescript
 * const filmPass = new FilmPass();
 * composer.addPass( filmPass );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class FilmPass extends Pass {
  uniforms: typeof FilmShader.uniforms;
  material: ShaderMaterial;
  _fsQuad: FullScreenQuad;

  /**
   * Constructs a new film pass.
   *
   * @param intensity - The grain intensity in the range `[0,1]` (0 = no effect, 1 = full effect).
   * @param grayscale - Whether to apply a grayscale effect or not.
   */
  constructor(intensity: number = 0.5, grayscale: boolean = false) {
    super();
    const shader = FilmShader;

    /**
     * The pass uniforms. Use this object if you want to update the
     * `intensity` or `grayscale` value at runtime.
     * ```typescript
     * pass.uniforms.intensity.value = 0.25;
     * pass.uniforms.grayscale.value = true;
     * ```
     */
    this.uniforms = cloneUniforms(shader.uniforms);

    /**
     * The pass material.
     */
    this.material = new ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: this.uniforms,
      vertexShader: shader.vertexShader,
      fragmentShader: shader.fragmentShader,
    });

    this.uniforms.intensity.value = intensity;
    this.uniforms.grayscale.value = grayscale;

    // internals

    this._fsQuad = new FullScreenQuad(this.material);
  }

  /**
   * Performs the film pass.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param writeBuffer - The write buffer. This buffer is intended as the rendering
   * destination for the pass.
   * @param readBuffer - The read buffer. The pass can access the result from the
   * previous pass from this buffer.
   * @param deltaTime - The delta time in seconds.
   * @param maskActive - Whether masking is active or not.
   */
  render(
    renderer: WebGLRenderer,
    writeBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    readBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    deltaTime: number,
    _maskActive: boolean,
  ): void {
    this.uniforms["tDiffuse"].value = readBuffer.texture;
    this.uniforms["time"].value += deltaTime;

    if (this.renderToScreen) {
      renderer.setRenderTarget(null);
      this._fsQuad.render(renderer);
    } else {
      renderer.setRenderTarget(writeBuffer);
      if (this.clear) renderer.clear();
      this._fsQuad.render(renderer);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Frees the GPU-related resources allocated by this instance. Call this
   * method whenever the pass is no longer used in your app.
   */
  dispose(): void {
    this.material.dispose();

    this._fsQuad.dispose();
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/postprocessing/GTAOPass

````typescript
import { Equation, Blending, PixelFormat, Factor, TextureType, TextureFilter, Wrapping } from "../../constants";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { DataTexture } from "../../textures/DataTexture";
import { DepthTexture } from "../../textures/DepthTexture";
import type { Texture } from "../../textures/Texture";
import { MeshNormalMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshNormalMaterial";
import { ShaderMaterial } from "../../materials/ShaderMaterial";
import { cloneUniforms } from "../../renderers/shaders/UniformsUtils";
import { WebGLRenderTarget } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";
import { Pass, FullScreenQuad } from "./Pass";
import { GTAODepthShader, GTAOBlendShader, GTAOShader, generateMagicSquareNoise } from "../shaders/GTAOShader";
import { PoissonDenoiseShader, generatePdSamplePointInitializer } from "../shaders/PoissonDenoiseShader";
import { CopyShader } from "../shaders/CopyShader";
import { SimplexNoise } from "../math/SimplexNoise";
import type { Box3 } from "../../math/Box3";
import type { PerspectiveCamera } from "../../cameras/PerspectiveCamera";
import type { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import type { Scene } from "../../scenes/Scene";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";
import type { WebGLRenderTarget as RT } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";
import type { Line } from "../../objects/Line";
import type { Points } from "../../objects/Points";
import type { Material } from "../../materials/Material";

/** GTAO material parameters. */
export interface GTAOMaterialParameters {
  radius?: number;
  distanceExponent?: number;
  thickness?: number;
  distanceFallOff?: number;
  scale?: number;
  samples?: number;
  screenSpaceRadius?: boolean;
}

/** Poisson denoise parameters. */
export interface GTAODenoiseParameters {
  lumaPhi?: number;
  depthPhi?: number;
  normalPhi?: number;
  radius?: number;
  radiusExponent?: number;
  rings?: number;
  samples?: number;
}

/** GTAO pass constructor parameters. */
export interface GTAOPassParameters {
  depthTexture?: DepthTexture;
  normalTexture?: Texture;
}

/**
 * A GTAO implementation of the Horizon Based Indirect Lighting (HBIL) algorithm.
 *
 * `GTAOPass` provides better quality than {@link SSAOPass} but is also more expensive.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const gtaoPass = new GTAOPass( scene, camera, width, height );
 * gtaoPass.output = GTAOPass.OUTPUT.Denoise;
 * composer.addPass( gtaoPass );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class GTAOPass extends Pass {
  scene: Scene;
  camera: PerspectiveCamera;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  output: number;
  blendIntensity: number;
  pdRings: number;
  pdRadiusExponent: number;
  pdSamples: number;
  radius: number | undefined;
  gtaoNoiseTexture: DataTexture;
  pdNoiseTexture: DataTexture;
  gtaoRenderTarget: WebGLRenderTarget;
  pdRenderTarget: WebGLRenderTarget;
  normalRenderTarget: WebGLRenderTarget | undefined;
  normalTexture: Texture | null | undefined;
  depthTexture: DepthTexture | null | undefined;
  gtaoMaterial: ShaderMaterial;
  normalMaterial: MeshNormalMaterial;
  pdMaterial: ShaderMaterial;
  depthRenderMaterial: ShaderMaterial;
  copyMaterial: ShaderMaterial;
  blendMaterial: ShaderMaterial;
  _fsQuad: FullScreenQuad;
  _originalClearColor: Color;
  _renderGBuffer: boolean;
  _visibilityCache: Object3D[];

  /** Output modes. */
  static OUTPUT: {
    Off: number;
    Default: number;
    Diffuse: number;
    Depth: number;
    Normal: number;
    AO: number;
    Denoise: number;
  } = {
    Off: -1,
    Default: 0,
    Diffuse: 1,
    Depth: 2,
    Normal: 3,
    AO: 4,
    Denoise: 5,
  };

  /**
   * Constructs a new GTAO pass.
   *
   * @param scene - The scene to compute the AO for.
   * @param camera - The camera.
   * @param width - The width of the effect.
   * @param height - The height of the effect.
   * @param parameters - The pass parameters.
   * @param aoParameters - The AO parameters.
   * @param pdParameters - The denoise parameters.
   */
  constructor(
    scene: Scene,
    camera: PerspectiveCamera,
    width: number = 512,
    height: number = 512,
    parameters?: GTAOPassParameters,
    aoParameters?: GTAOMaterialParameters,
    pdParameters?: GTAODenoiseParameters,
  ) {
    super();
    /**
     * The width of the effect.
     *
     * @default 512
     */
    this.width = width;

    /**
     * The height of the effect.
     *
     * @default 512
     */
    this.height = height;

    /**
     * Overwritten to perform a clear operation by default.
     *
     * @default true
     */
    this.clear = true;

    /**
     * The camera.
     */
    this.camera = camera;

    /**
     * The scene to render the AO for.
     */
    this.scene = scene;

    /**
     * The output configuration.
     *
     * @default 0
     */
    this.output = 0;
    this._renderGBuffer = true;
    this._visibilityCache = [];

    /**
     * The AO blend intensity.
     *
     * @default 1
     */
    this.blendIntensity = 1.0;

    /**
     * The number of Poisson Denoise rings.
     *
     * @default 2
     */
    this.pdRings = 2.0;

    /**
     * The Poisson Denoise radius exponent.
     *
     * @default 2
     */
    this.pdRadiusExponent = 2.0;

    /**
     * The Poisson Denoise sample count.
     *
     * @default 16
     */
    this.pdSamples = 16;
    this.radius = undefined;

    this.gtaoNoiseTexture = generateMagicSquareNoise();
    this.pdNoiseTexture = this._generateNoise();

    this.gtaoRenderTarget = new WebGLRenderTarget(this.width, this.height, {
      type: TextureType.HalfFloat,
      depthBuffer: false,
    });
    this.pdRenderTarget = this.gtaoRenderTarget.clone();

    this.gtaoMaterial = new ShaderMaterial({
      defines: { ...GTAOShader.defines },
      uniforms: cloneUniforms(GTAOShader.uniforms) as Record<string, { value: any; needsUpdate?: boolean }>,
      vertexShader: GTAOShader.vertexShader,
      fragmentShader: GTAOShader.fragmentShader,
      blending: Blending.No,
      depthTest: false,
      depthWrite: false,
    } as never);
    this.gtaoMaterial.defines.PERSPECTIVE_CAMERA = this.camera.isPerspectiveCamera ? 1 : 0;
    this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["tNoise"].value = this.gtaoNoiseTexture;
    this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["resolution"].value.set(this.width, this.height);
    this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["cameraNear"].value = this.camera.near;
    this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["cameraFar"].value = this.camera.far;

    this.normalMaterial = new MeshNormalMaterial();
    this.normalMaterial.blending = Blending.No;

    this.pdMaterial = new ShaderMaterial({
      defines: { ...PoissonDenoiseShader.defines },
      uniforms: cloneUniforms(PoissonDenoiseShader.uniforms) as Record<string, { value: any; needsUpdate?: boolean }>,
      vertexShader: PoissonDenoiseShader.vertexShader,
      fragmentShader: PoissonDenoiseShader.fragmentShader,
      depthTest: false,
      depthWrite: false,
    } as never);
    this.pdMaterial.uniforms!["tDiffuse"].value = this.gtaoRenderTarget.texture;
    this.pdMaterial.uniforms!["tNoise"].value = this.pdNoiseTexture;
    this.pdMaterial.uniforms!["resolution"].value.set(this.width, this.height);
    this.pdMaterial.uniforms!["lumaPhi"].value = 10;
    this.pdMaterial.uniforms!["depthPhi"].value = 2;
    this.pdMaterial.uniforms!["normalPhi"].value = 3;
    this.pdMaterial.uniforms!["radius"].value = 8;

    this.depthRenderMaterial = new ShaderMaterial({
      defines: { ...GTAODepthShader.defines },
      uniforms: cloneUniforms(GTAODepthShader.uniforms) as Record<string, { value: any; needsUpdate?: boolean }>,
      vertexShader: GTAODepthShader.vertexShader,
      fragmentShader: GTAODepthShader.fragmentShader,
      blending: Blending.No,
    } as never);
    this.depthRenderMaterial.uniforms!["cameraNear"].value = this.camera.near;
    this.depthRenderMaterial.uniforms!["cameraFar"].value = this.camera.far;

    this.copyMaterial = new ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: cloneUniforms(CopyShader.uniforms) as Record<string, { value: any; needsUpdate?: boolean }>,
      vertexShader: CopyShader.vertexShader,
      fragmentShader: CopyShader.fragmentShader,
      transparent: true,
      depthTest: false,
      depthWrite: false,
      blendSrc: Factor.DstColor,
      blendDst: Factor.Zero,
      blendEquation: Equation.Add,
      blendSrcAlpha: Factor.DstAlpha,
      blendDstAlpha: Factor.Zero,
      blendEquationAlpha: Equation.Add,
    } as never);

    this.blendMaterial = new ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: cloneUniforms(GTAOBlendShader.uniforms) as Record<string, { value: any; needsUpdate?: boolean }>,
      vertexShader: GTAOBlendShader.vertexShader,
      fragmentShader: GTAOBlendShader.fragmentShader,
      transparent: true,
      depthTest: false,
      depthWrite: false,
      blending: Blending.Custom,
      blendSrc: Factor.DstColor,
      blendDst: Factor.Zero,
      blendEquation: Equation.Add,
      blendSrcAlpha: Factor.DstAlpha,
      blendDstAlpha: Factor.Zero,
      blendEquationAlpha: Equation.Add,
    } as never);

    this._fsQuad = new FullScreenQuad(null);

    this._originalClearColor = new Color();

    this.setGBuffer(
      parameters ? parameters.depthTexture : undefined,
      parameters ? parameters.normalTexture : undefined,
    );

    if (aoParameters !== undefined) {
      this.updateGtaoMaterial(aoParameters);
    }

    if (pdParameters !== undefined) {
      this.updatePdMaterial(pdParameters);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Sets the size of the pass.
   *
   * @param width - The width to set.
   * @param height - The height to set.
   */
  setSize(width: number, height: number): void {
    this.width = width;
    this.height = height;

    this.gtaoRenderTarget.setSize(width, height);
    if (this.normalRenderTarget) this.normalRenderTarget.setSize(width, height);
    this.pdRenderTarget.setSize(width, height);

    this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["resolution"].value.set(width, height);
    this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["cameraProjectionMatrix"].value.copy(this.camera.projectionMatrix);
    this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["cameraProjectionMatrixInverse"].value.copy(this.camera.projectionMatrixInverse);

    this.pdMaterial.uniforms!["resolution"].value.set(width, height);
    this.pdMaterial.uniforms!["cameraProjectionMatrixInverse"].value.copy(this.camera.projectionMatrixInverse);
  }

  /**
   * Frees the GPU-related resources allocated by this instance. Call this
   * method whenever the pass is no longer used in your app.
   */
  dispose(): void {
    this.gtaoNoiseTexture.dispose();
    this.pdNoiseTexture.dispose();
    if (this.normalRenderTarget) this.normalRenderTarget.dispose();
    this.gtaoRenderTarget.dispose();
    this.pdRenderTarget.dispose();
    this.normalMaterial.dispose();
    this.pdMaterial.dispose();
    this.copyMaterial.dispose();
    this.depthRenderMaterial.dispose();
    this._fsQuad.dispose();
  }

  /**
   * A texture holding the computed AO.
   */
  get gtaoMap(): Texture {
    return this.pdRenderTarget.texture;
  }

  /**
   * Configures the GBuffer of this pass. If no arguments are passed,
   * the pass creates an internal render target for holding depth
   * and normal data. External depth and normal data must use separate
   * textures and remain owned by the caller.
   * If no normal texture is supplied, normals are reconstructed from depth
   * for AO and denoising, and the normal output displays black.
   *
   * @param depthTexture - The depth texture.
   * @param normalTexture - The normal texture.
   */
  setGBuffer(depthTexture?: DepthTexture, normalTexture?: Texture): void {
    if (depthTexture !== undefined) {
      this.depthTexture = depthTexture;
      this.normalTexture = normalTexture;
      this._renderGBuffer = false;
    } else {
      if (this.normalRenderTarget === undefined) {
        const depthTextureInternal = new DepthTexture(
          this.width,
          this.height,
          TextureType.UnsignedInt248,
          undefined,
          undefined,
          undefined,
          TextureFilter.Nearest,
          TextureFilter.Nearest,
          undefined,
          PixelFormat.DepthStencil,
        );
        this.normalRenderTarget = new WebGLRenderTarget(this.width, this.height, {
          minFilter: TextureFilter.Nearest,
          magFilter: TextureFilter.Nearest,
          type: TextureType.HalfFloat,
          depthTexture: depthTextureInternal,
        });
      }

      this.depthTexture = this.normalRenderTarget.depthTexture;
      this.normalTexture = this.normalRenderTarget.texture;
      this._renderGBuffer = true;
    }

    const normalVectorType = this.normalTexture ? 1 : 0;

    this.gtaoMaterial.defines.NORMAL_VECTOR_TYPE = normalVectorType;
    this.gtaoMaterial.needsUpdate = true;
    this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["tNormal"].value = this.normalTexture;
    this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["tDepth"].value = this.depthTexture;

    this.pdMaterial.defines.NORMAL_VECTOR_TYPE = normalVectorType;
    this.pdMaterial.needsUpdate = true;
    this.pdMaterial.uniforms!["tNormal"].value = this.normalTexture;
    this.pdMaterial.uniforms!["tDepth"].value = this.depthTexture;

    this.depthRenderMaterial.uniforms!["tDepth"].value = this.depthTexture;
  }

  /**
   * Configures the clip box of the GTAO shader with the given AABB.
   *
   * @param box - The AABB enclosing the scene that should receive AO. When passing
   * `null`, to clip box is used.
   */
  setSceneClipBox(box: Box3 | null): void {
    if (box) {
      this.gtaoMaterial.needsUpdate = this.gtaoMaterial.defines.SCENE_CLIP_BOX !== 1;
      this.gtaoMaterial.defines.SCENE_CLIP_BOX = 1;
      this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["sceneBoxMin"].value.copy(box.min);
      this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["sceneBoxMax"].value.copy(box.max);
    } else {
      this.gtaoMaterial.needsUpdate = this.gtaoMaterial.defines.SCENE_CLIP_BOX === 0;
      this.gtaoMaterial.defines.SCENE_CLIP_BOX = 0;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Updates the GTAO material from the given parameter object.
   *
   * @param parameters - The GTAO material parameters.
   */
  updateGtaoMaterial(parameters: GTAOMaterialParameters): void {
    if (parameters.radius !== undefined) {
      this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["radius"].value = parameters.radius;
    }

    if (parameters.distanceExponent !== undefined) {
      this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["distanceExponent"].value = parameters.distanceExponent;
    }

    if (parameters.thickness !== undefined) {
      this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["thickness"].value = parameters.thickness;
    }

    if (parameters.distanceFallOff !== undefined) {
      this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["distanceFallOff"].value = parameters.distanceFallOff;
      this.gtaoMaterial.needsUpdate = true;
    }

    if (parameters.scale !== undefined) {
      this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["scale"].value = parameters.scale;
    }

    if (parameters.samples !== undefined && parameters.samples !== this.gtaoMaterial.defines.SAMPLES) {
      this.gtaoMaterial.defines.SAMPLES = parameters.samples;
      this.gtaoMaterial.needsUpdate = true;
    }

    if (
      parameters.screenSpaceRadius !== undefined &&
      (parameters.screenSpaceRadius ? 1 : 0) !== this.gtaoMaterial.defines.SCREEN_SPACE_RADIUS
    ) {
      this.gtaoMaterial.defines.SCREEN_SPACE_RADIUS = parameters.screenSpaceRadius ? 1 : 0;
      this.gtaoMaterial.needsUpdate = true;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Updates the Denoise material from the given parameter object.
   *
   * @param parameters - The denoise parameters.
   */
  updatePdMaterial(parameters: GTAODenoiseParameters): void {
    let updateShader = false;

    if (parameters.lumaPhi !== undefined) {
      this.pdMaterial.uniforms!["lumaPhi"].value = parameters.lumaPhi;
    }

    if (parameters.depthPhi !== undefined) {
      this.pdMaterial.uniforms!["depthPhi"].value = parameters.depthPhi;
    }

    if (parameters.normalPhi !== undefined) {
      this.pdMaterial.uniforms!["normalPhi"].value = parameters.normalPhi;
    }

    if (parameters.radius !== undefined && parameters.radius !== this.radius) {
      this.pdMaterial.uniforms!["radius"].value = parameters.radius;
    }

    if (parameters.radiusExponent !== undefined && parameters.radiusExponent !== this.pdRadiusExponent) {
      this.pdRadiusExponent = parameters.radiusExponent;
      updateShader = true;
    }

    if (parameters.rings !== undefined && parameters.rings !== this.pdRings) {
      this.pdRings = parameters.rings;
      updateShader = true;
    }

    if (parameters.samples !== undefined && parameters.samples !== this.pdSamples) {
      this.pdSamples = parameters.samples;
      updateShader = true;
    }

    if (updateShader) {
      this.pdMaterial.defines.SAMPLES = this.pdSamples;
      this.pdMaterial.defines.SAMPLE_VECTORS = generatePdSamplePointInitializer(
        this.pdSamples,
        this.pdRings,
        this.pdRadiusExponent,
      );
      this.pdMaterial.needsUpdate = true;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Performs the GTAO pass.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param writeBuffer - The write buffer. This buffer is intended as the rendering
   * destination for the pass.
   * @param readBuffer - The read buffer. The pass can access the result from the
   * previous pass from this buffer.
   * @param deltaTime - The delta time in seconds.
   * @param maskActive - Whether masking is active or not.
   */
  render(renderer: WebGLRenderer, writeBuffer: RT, readBuffer: RT, _deltaTime: number, _maskActive: boolean): void {
    // render normals and depth (honor only meshes, points and lines do not contribute to AO)

    if (this._renderGBuffer) {
      this._overrideVisibility();
      this._renderOverride(renderer, this.normalMaterial, this.normalRenderTarget!, 0x7777ff, 1.0);
      this._restoreVisibility();
    }

    // render AO

    this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["cameraNear"].value = this.camera.near;
    this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["cameraFar"].value = this.camera.far;
    this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["cameraProjectionMatrix"].value.copy(this.camera.projectionMatrix);
    this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["cameraProjectionMatrixInverse"].value.copy(this.camera.projectionMatrixInverse);
    this.gtaoMaterial.uniforms!["cameraWorldMatrix"].value.copy(this.camera.matrixWorld);
    this._renderPass(renderer, this.gtaoMaterial, this.gtaoRenderTarget, 0xffffff, 1.0);

    // render poisson denoise

    this.pdMaterial.uniforms!["cameraProjectionMatrixInverse"].value.copy(this.camera.projectionMatrixInverse);
    this._renderPass(renderer, this.pdMaterial, this.pdRenderTarget, 0xffffff, 1.0);

    // output result to screen

    switch (this.output) {
      case GTAOPass.OUTPUT.Off:
        break;

      case GTAOPass.OUTPUT.Diffuse:
        this.copyMaterial.uniforms["tDiffuse"].value = readBuffer.texture;
        this.copyMaterial.blending = Blending.No;
        this._renderPass(renderer, this.copyMaterial, this.renderToScreen ? null : writeBuffer);
        break;

      case GTAOPass.OUTPUT.AO:
        this.copyMaterial.uniforms["tDiffuse"].value = this.gtaoRenderTarget.texture;
        this.copyMaterial.blending = Blending.No;
        this._renderPass(renderer, this.copyMaterial, this.renderToScreen ? null : writeBuffer);
        break;

      case GTAOPass.OUTPUT.Denoise:
        this.copyMaterial.uniforms["tDiffuse"].value = this.pdRenderTarget.texture;
        this.copyMaterial.blending = Blending.No;
        this._renderPass(renderer, this.copyMaterial, this.renderToScreen ? null : writeBuffer);
        break;

      case GTAOPass.OUTPUT.Depth:
        this.depthRenderMaterial.uniforms["cameraNear"].value = this.camera.near;
        this.depthRenderMaterial.uniforms["cameraFar"].value = this.camera.far;
        this._renderPass(renderer, this.depthRenderMaterial, this.renderToScreen ? null : writeBuffer);
        break;

      case GTAOPass.OUTPUT.Normal:
        this.copyMaterial.uniforms["tDiffuse"].value = this.normalTexture || null;
        this.copyMaterial.blending = Blending.No;
        this._renderPass(renderer, this.copyMaterial, this.renderToScreen ? null : writeBuffer);
        break;

      case GTAOPass.OUTPUT.Default:
        this.copyMaterial.uniforms["tDiffuse"].value = readBuffer.texture;
        this.copyMaterial.blending = Blending.No;
        this._renderPass(renderer, this.copyMaterial, this.renderToScreen ? null : writeBuffer);

        this.blendMaterial.uniforms["intensity"].value = this.blendIntensity;
        this.blendMaterial.uniforms["tDiffuse"].value = this.pdRenderTarget.texture;
        this._renderPass(renderer, this.blendMaterial, this.renderToScreen ? null : writeBuffer);
        break;

      default:
        console.warn("THREE.GTAOPass: Unknown output type.");
    }
  }

  // internals

  _renderPass(
    renderer: WebGLRenderer,
    passMaterial: Material | null,
    renderTarget: RT | null,
    clearColor?: number | null,
    clearAlpha?: number,
  ): void {
    // save original state
    renderer.getClearColor(this._originalClearColor);
    const originalClearAlpha = renderer.getClearAlpha();
    const originalAutoClear = renderer.autoClear;

    renderer.setRenderTarget(renderTarget);

    // setup pass state
    renderer.autoClear = false;
    if (clearColor !== undefined && clearColor !== null) {
      renderer.setClearColor(clearColor);
      renderer.setClearAlpha(clearAlpha || 0.0);
      renderer.clear();
    }

    this._fsQuad.material = passMaterial;
    this._fsQuad.render(renderer);

    // restore original state
    renderer.autoClear = originalAutoClear;
    renderer.setClearColor(this._originalClearColor);
    renderer.setClearAlpha(originalClearAlpha);
  }

  _renderOverride(
    renderer: WebGLRenderer,
    overrideMaterial: Material,
    renderTarget: RT,
    clearColor?: number | null,
    clearAlpha?: number,
  ): void {
    renderer.getClearColor(this._originalClearColor);
    const originalClearAlpha = renderer.getClearAlpha();
    const originalAutoClear = renderer.autoClear;

    renderer.setRenderTarget(renderTarget);
    renderer.autoClear = false;

    clearColor = (overrideMaterial as any).clearColor || clearColor;
    clearAlpha = (overrideMaterial as any).clearAlpha || clearAlpha;

    if (clearColor !== undefined && clearColor !== null) {
      renderer.setClearColor(clearColor);
      renderer.setClearAlpha(clearAlpha || 0.0);
      renderer.clear();
    }

    this.scene.overrideMaterial = overrideMaterial;
    renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
    this.scene.overrideMaterial = null;

    renderer.autoClear = originalAutoClear;
    renderer.setClearColor(this._originalClearColor);
    renderer.setClearAlpha(originalClearAlpha);
  }

  _overrideVisibility(): void {
    const scene = this.scene;
    const cache = this._visibilityCache;

    scene.traverse(function (object: Object3D) {
      if ((object as Points).isPoints === true || (object as Line).isLine === true) {
        if (object.visible) {
          object.visible = false;
          cache.push(object);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  _restoreVisibility(): void {
    const cache = this._visibilityCache;

    for (let i = 0; i < cache.length; i++) {
      cache[i].visible = true;
    }

    cache.length = 0;
  }

  _generateNoise(size: number = 64): DataTexture {
    const simplex = new SimplexNoise();

    const arraySize = size * size * 4;
    const data = new Uint8Array(arraySize);

    for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
      for (let j = 0; j < size; j++) {
        const x = i;
        const y = j;

        data[(i * size + j) * 4] = (simplex.noise(x, y) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255;
        data[(i * size + j) * 4 + 1] = (simplex.noise(x + size, y) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255;
        data[(i * size + j) * 4 + 2] = (simplex.noise(x, y + size) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255;
        data[(i * size + j) * 4 + 3] = (simplex.noise(x + size, y + size) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255;
      }
    }

    const noiseTexture = new DataTexture(data, size, size, PixelFormat.RGBA, TextureType.UnsignedByte);
    noiseTexture.wrapS = Wrapping.Repeat;
    noiseTexture.wrapT = Wrapping.Repeat;
    noiseTexture.needsUpdate = true;

    return noiseTexture;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/postprocessing/GlitchPass

````typescript
import { TextureType, PixelFormat } from "../../constants";
import { DataTexture } from "../../textures/DataTexture";
import { randFloat, randInt } from "../../math/MathUtils";
import { ShaderMaterial } from "../../materials/ShaderMaterial";
import { cloneUniforms } from "../../renderers/shaders/UniformsUtils";
import { DigitalGlitch } from "../shaders/DigitalGlitch";
import { Pass, FullScreenQuad } from "./Pass";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";
import type { WebGLRenderTarget } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";

/**
 * Pass for a glitch effect, based on the DigitalGlitch shader.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const glitchPass = new GlitchPass();
 * composer.addPass( glitchPass );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class GlitchPass extends Pass {
  uniforms: Record<string, { value: any; needsUpdate?: boolean }>;
  material: ShaderMaterial;
  goWild: boolean;
  _fsQuad: FullScreenQuad;
  _curF: number;
  _randX: number;
  _heightMap: DataTexture;

  /**
   * Constructs a new glitch pass.
   *
   * @param dtSize - The size of the displacement texture
   * for digital glitch squares.
   */
  constructor(dtSize: number = 64) {
    super();
    /**
     * The pass uniforms.
     */
    this.uniforms = cloneUniforms(DigitalGlitch.uniforms);

    /**
     * The pass material.
     */
    this.material = new ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: this.uniforms,
      vertexShader: DigitalGlitch.vertexShader,
      fragmentShader: DigitalGlitch.fragmentShader,
    });

    /**
     * Whether to noticeably increase the effect intensity or not.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.goWild = false;

    // internals

    this._heightMap = this._generateHeightmap(dtSize);
    this.uniforms["tDisp"].value = this._heightMap;

    this._fsQuad = new FullScreenQuad(this.material);

    this._curF = 0;
    this._randX = 0;

    this._generateTrigger();
  }

  /**
   * Performs the glitch pass.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param writeBuffer - The write buffer. This buffer is intended as the rendering
   * destination for the pass.
   * @param readBuffer - The read buffer. The pass can access the result from the
   * previous pass from this buffer.
   * @param deltaTime - The delta time in seconds.
   * @param maskActive - Whether masking is active or not.
   */
  render(
    renderer: WebGLRenderer,
    writeBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    readBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    _deltaTime: number,
    _maskActive: boolean,
  ): void {
    this.uniforms["tDiffuse"].value = readBuffer.texture;
    this.uniforms["seed"].value = Math.random(); // default seeding
    this.uniforms["byp"].value = 0;

    if (this._curF % this._randX == 0 || this.goWild == true) {
      this.uniforms["amount"].value = Math.random() / 30;
      this.uniforms["angle"].value = randFloat(-Math.PI, Math.PI);
      this.uniforms["seed_x"].value = randFloat(-1, 1);
      this.uniforms["seed_y"].value = randFloat(-1, 1);
      this.uniforms["distortion_x"].value = randFloat(0, 1);
      this.uniforms["distortion_y"].value = randFloat(0, 1);
      this._curF = 0;
      this._generateTrigger();
    } else if (this._curF % this._randX < this._randX / 5) {
      this.uniforms["amount"].value = Math.random() / 90;
      this.uniforms["angle"].value = randFloat(-Math.PI, Math.PI);
      this.uniforms["distortion_x"].value = randFloat(0, 1);
      this.uniforms["distortion_y"].value = randFloat(0, 1);
      this.uniforms["seed_x"].value = randFloat(-0.3, 0.3);
      this.uniforms["seed_y"].value = randFloat(-0.3, 0.3);
    } else if (this.goWild == false) {
      this.uniforms["byp"].value = 1;
    }

    this._curF++;

    if (this.renderToScreen) {
      renderer.setRenderTarget(null);
      this._fsQuad.render(renderer);
    } else {
      renderer.setRenderTarget(writeBuffer);
      if (this.clear) renderer.clear();
      this._fsQuad.render(renderer);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Frees the GPU-related resources allocated by this instance. Call this
   * method whenever the pass is no longer used in your app.
   */
  dispose(): void {
    this.material.dispose();

    this._heightMap.dispose();

    this._fsQuad.dispose();
  }

  // internals

  _generateTrigger(): void {
    this._randX = randInt(120, 240);
  }

  _generateHeightmap(dtSize: number): DataTexture {
    const dataArr = new Float32Array(dtSize * dtSize);
    const length = dtSize * dtSize;

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const val = randFloat(0, 1);
      dataArr[i] = val;
    }

    const texture = new DataTexture(dataArr, dtSize, dtSize, PixelFormat.Red, TextureType.Float);
    texture.needsUpdate = true;
    return texture;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/postprocessing/GodraysPass

```typescript
import { DepthPacking, PixelFormat, TextureType, TextureFilter } from "../../constants";
import { PerspectiveCamera } from "../../cameras/PerspectiveCamera";
import { DirectionalLight } from "../../lights/DirectionalLight";
import { PointLight } from "../../lights/PointLight";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Frustum } from "../../math/Frustum";
import { Matrix4 } from "../../math/Matrix4";
import { Plane } from "../../math/Plane";
import { Vector2 } from "../../math/Vector2";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import { ShaderMaterial } from "../../materials/ShaderMaterial";
import { WebGLRenderTarget } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";
import { DepthTexture } from "../../textures/DepthTexture";
import type { Texture } from "../../textures/Texture";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";
import { FullScreenQuad, Pass } from "./Pass";
import {
  bilateralFilter_default,
  compositor_default,
  compositor_default2,
  godrays_default,
  godrays_default2,
} from "./GodraysShaders";

// Adapted from three-good-godrays 0.12.0; the original license is in GodraysShaders.ts.
export const enum GodraysUpsampleQuality {
  LOW = 0,
  HIGH = 1,
}

export interface GodraysBlurParams {
  variance: number;
  kernelSize: number;
}
export interface AdaptiveStepsParams {
  stepSize: number;
  minSteps?: number;
  maxSteps?: number;
}
export interface GodraysPassParams {
  density: number;
  maxDensity: number;
  distanceAttenuation: number;
  color: Color;
  raymarchSteps: number;
  blur: boolean | Partial<GodraysBlurParams>;
  gammaCorrection: boolean;
  resolutionScale: number;
  upsampleQuality: GodraysUpsampleQuality;
  adaptiveSteps?: AdaptiveStepsParams;
  debugSteps?: boolean;
}

const directions: Vector3[] = [
  new Vector3(1, 0, 0),
  new Vector3(-1, 0, 0),
  new Vector3(0, 1, 0),
  new Vector3(0, -1, 0),
  new Vector3(0, 0, 1),
  new Vector3(0, 0, -1),
];
const defaults: GodraysPassParams = {
  density: 1 / 128,
  maxDensity: 0.5,
  distanceAttenuation: 2,
  color: new Color(0xffffff),
  raymarchSteps: 60,
  blur: true,
  gammaCorrection: true,
  resolutionScale: 0.5,
  upsampleQuality: GodraysUpsampleQuality.HIGH,
};

/** Volumetric shadow-map raymarching and depth-aware upsampling. The input buffer needs a depth texture unless one is supplied with setDepthTexture. */
export class GodraysPass extends Pass {
  light: PointLight | DirectionalLight;
  camera: PerspectiveCamera;
  params: GodraysPassParams;
  depthTexture: Texture | null = null;
  illumination: ShaderMaterial;
  blur: ShaderMaterial;
  composite: ShaderMaterial;
  quad: FullScreenQuad;
  rays: WebGLRenderTarget;
  blurred: WebGLRenderTarget;
  depthCopy: WebGLRenderTarget | null = null;
  shadowCopy: WebGLRenderTarget | null = null;
  width: number = 1;
  height: number = 1;
  lightPosition: Vector3 = new Vector3();
  cameraPosition: Vector3 = new Vector3();
  matrix: Matrix4 = new Matrix4();
  frustum: Frustum = new Frustum();
  scratch: Vector3 = new Vector3();
  scratch2: Vector3 = new Vector3();
  scratch3: Vector3 = new Vector3();
  plane: Plane = new Plane();

  constructor(
    light: PointLight | DirectionalLight,
    camera: PerspectiveCamera,
    params: Partial<GodraysPassParams> = {},
  ) {
    super();
    this.light = light;
    this.camera = camera;
    this.params = { ...defaults, color: defaults.color.clone() };
    const targetOptions = {
      minFilter: TextureFilter.Nearest,
      magFilter: TextureFilter.Nearest,
      format: PixelFormat.RGBA,
      type: TextureType.HalfFloat,
      generateMipmaps: false,
    };
    this.rays = new WebGLRenderTarget(1, 1, targetOptions);
    this.blurred = new WebGLRenderTarget(1, 1, targetOptions);
    this.illumination = new ShaderMaterial({
      vertexShader: godrays_default2,
      fragmentShader: godrays_default,
      depthTest: false,
      depthWrite: false,
      defines:
        light instanceof PointLight
          ? { IS_POINT_LIGHT: "", USE_CUBE_SHADOWMAP: "" }
          : { IS_DIRECTIONAL_LIGHT: "", USE_UNPACKED_DEPTH: "" },
      uniforms: {
        sceneDepth: { value: null },
        shadowMap: { value: null },
        lightPos: { value: this.lightPosition },
        cameraPos: { value: this.cameraPosition },
        resolution: { value: new Vector2() },
        cameraProjectionMatrixInv: { value: camera.projectionMatrixInverse },
        cameraMatrixWorld: { value: camera.matrixWorld },
        premultipliedLightCameraMatrix: { value: this.matrix },
        texelSizeY: { value: 1 },
        lightCameraNear: { value: 0.1 },
        lightCameraFar: { value: 1000 },
        near: { value: camera.near },
        far: { value: camera.far },
        density: { value: 0 },
        maxDensity: { value: 0 },
        distanceAttenuation: { value: 0 },
        fNormals: { value: directions.map(() => new Vector3()) },
        fConstants: { value: directions.map(() => 0) },
        raymarchSteps: { value: 60 },
        raymarchStepSize: { value: 0 },
        minSteps: { value: 8 },
        maxSteps: { value: 125 },
        shadowTexelWorldSize: { value: 0 },
      },
    });
    this.blur = new ShaderMaterial({
      vertexShader: compositor_default,
      fragmentShader: bilateralFilter_default,
      depthTest: false,
      depthWrite: false,
      defines: { KSIZE_ENUM: 1 },
      uniforms: { tInput: { value: this.rays.texture }, resolution: { value: new Vector2() }, bSigma: { value: 0.1 } },
    });
    this.composite = new ShaderMaterial({
      vertexShader: compositor_default,
      fragmentShader: compositor_default2,
      depthTest: false,
      depthWrite: false,
      defines: { JBU_EXTENT: "1", JBU_SPATIAL_SIGMA: "1.0", JBU_DEPTH_SIGMA: "0.02" },
      uniforms: {
        godrays: { value: this.rays.texture },
        sceneDiffuse: { value: null },
        sceneDepth: { value: null },
        near: { value: camera.near },
        far: { value: camera.far },
        color: { value: this.params.color },
        resolution: { value: new Vector2() },
        godraysResolution: { value: new Vector2() },
        gammaCorrection: { value: true },
      },
    });
    this.quad = new FullScreenQuad(this.illumination);
    this.setParams(params);
  }

  setParams(partial: Partial<GodraysPassParams>): void {
    if ("raymarchSteps" in partial && "adaptiveSteps" in partial)
      throw new Error("Cannot specify both raymarchSteps and adaptiveSteps");
    this.params = { ...defaults, ...partial, color: (partial.color ?? defaults.color).clone() };
    const p = this.params;
    const u = this.illumination.uniforms;
    u.density.value = p.density;
    u.maxDensity.value = p.maxDensity;
    u.distanceAttenuation.value = p.distanceAttenuation;
    u.raymarchSteps.value = p.raymarchSteps;
    u.raymarchStepSize.value = p.adaptiveSteps?.stepSize ?? 0;
    u.minSteps.value = p.adaptiveSteps?.minSteps ?? 8;
    u.maxSteps.value = p.adaptiveSteps?.maxSteps ?? 125;
    this.composite.uniforms.color.value = p.color;
    this.composite.uniforms.gammaCorrection.value = p.gammaCorrection;
    const extent = p.upsampleQuality >= 1 ? 1 : 0;
    this.composite.defines.JBU_EXTENT = String(extent);
    this.composite.defines.JBU_SPATIAL_SIGMA = extent ? "1.0" : "0.5";
    const blur = typeof p.blur === "object" ? p.blur : {};
    this.blur.uniforms.bSigma.value = blur.variance ?? 0.1;
    this.blur.defines.KSIZE_ENUM = blur.kernelSize ?? 1;
    for (const material of [this.illumination, this.blur, this.composite]) {
      if (p.debugSteps) material.defines.DEBUG_STEPS = "";
      else delete material.defines.DEBUG_STEPS;
      material.needsUpdate = true;
    }
    this.setSize(this.width, this.height);
  }

  setDepthTexture(depthTexture: Texture, depthPacking: DepthPacking = DepthPacking.Basic): void {
    if (depthPacking !== DepthPacking.Basic) throw new Error("Only BasicDepthPacking is supported");
    this.depthTexture = depthTexture;
  }

  setSize(width: number, height: number): void {
    this.width = width;
    this.height = height;
    const w = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(width * this.params.resolutionScale));
    const h = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(height * this.params.resolutionScale));
    this.rays.setSize(w, h);
    this.blurred.setSize(w, h);
    this.illumination.uniforms.resolution.value.set(w, h);
    this.blur.uniforms.resolution.value.set(w, h);
    this.composite.uniforms.resolution.value.set(width, height);
    this.composite.uniforms.godraysResolution.value.set(w, h);
  }

  private copyDepth(
    renderer: WebGLRenderer,
    source: Texture,
    target: WebGLRenderTarget | null,
    width: number,
    height: number,
  ): WebGLRenderTarget {
    if (!target || target.width !== width || target.height !== height) {
      target?.depthTexture?.dispose();
      target?.dispose();
      target = new WebGLRenderTarget(width, height);
      target.depthTexture = new DepthTexture(width, height, TextureType.UnsignedInt);
      target.depthTexture.format = PixelFormat.Depth;
      target.depthTexture.compareFunction = null;
      target.depthTexture.minFilter = TextureFilter.Nearest;
      target.depthTexture.magFilter = TextureFilter.Nearest;
    }
    renderer.initRenderTarget(target);
    renderer.copyTextureToTexture(source, target.depthTexture!);
    return target;
  }

  render(renderer: WebGLRenderer, writeBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget, readBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget): void {
    const sceneDepth = this.depthTexture ?? readBuffer.depthTexture;
    if (!sceneDepth) throw new Error("GodraysPass requires a scene depth texture");
    const shadow = this.light.shadow;
    if (!shadow.map) throw new Error("GodraysPass requires a rendered shadow-casting light");
    const u = this.illumination.uniforms;
    const camera = this.camera;
    this.light.getWorldPosition(this.lightPosition);
    camera.getWorldPosition(this.cameraPosition);
    u.near.value = camera.near;
    u.far.value = camera.far;
    u.lightCameraNear.value = shadow.camera.near;
    u.lightCameraFar.value = shadow.camera.far;
    u.texelSizeY.value = 1 / (shadow.map.height * 2);
    this.matrix.multiplyMatrices(shadow.camera.projectionMatrix, shadow.camera.matrixWorldInverse);
    const far = shadow.camera.far;
    const attenuation = this.params.distanceAttenuation;
    const effectiveFar = attenuation <= 0 ? far : far * (1 - Math.pow(0.005, 1 / attenuation));
    if (this.light instanceof PointLight) {
      u.shadowMap.value = shadow.map.texture;
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        this.scratch.copy(this.lightPosition).addScaledVector(directions[i], effectiveFar);
        this.plane.setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(directions[i], this.scratch);
        u.fNormals.value[i].copy(this.plane.normal);
        u.fConstants.value[i] = this.plane.constant;
      }
      u.shadowTexelWorldSize.value = (2 * far) / shadow.mapSize.x;
    } else {
      const depth = shadow.map.depthTexture;
      if (!depth) throw new Error("GodraysPass requires a directional shadow depth texture");
      if (depth.compareFunction !== null) {
        this.shadowCopy = this.copyDepth(renderer, depth, this.shadowCopy, shadow.map.width, shadow.map.height);
        u.shadowMap.value = this.shadowCopy.depthTexture;
      } else u.shadowMap.value = depth;
      this.frustum.setFromProjectionMatrix(this.matrix);
      if (effectiveFar < far) {
        shadow.camera.getWorldDirection(this.scratch2);
        shadow.camera.getWorldPosition(this.scratch3);
        this.scratch.copy(this.scratch3).addScaledVector(this.scratch2, effectiveFar);
        this.frustum.planes[4].setFromNormalAndCoplanarPoint(this.scratch2.negate(), this.scratch);
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        u.fNormals.value[i].copy(this.frustum.planes[i].normal).multiplyScalar(-1);
        u.fConstants.value[i] = -this.frustum.planes[i].constant;
      }
      const shadowCamera = this.light.shadow.camera;
      u.shadowTexelWorldSize.value = (shadowCamera.right - shadowCamera.left) / shadow.mapSize.x;
    }
    let depth: Texture = sceneDepth;
    if (!this.renderToScreen && writeBuffer.depthTexture === depth) {
      this.depthCopy = this.copyDepth(renderer, depth, this.depthCopy, writeBuffer.width, writeBuffer.height);
      depth = this.depthCopy.depthTexture!;
    }
    u.sceneDepth.value = depth;
    this.quad.material = this.illumination;
    renderer.setRenderTarget(this.rays);
    this.quad.render(renderer);
    if (this.params.blur) {
      this.quad.material = this.blur;
      renderer.setRenderTarget(this.blurred);
      this.quad.render(renderer);
    }
    this.composite.uniforms.godrays.value = this.params.blur ? this.blurred.texture : this.rays.texture;
    this.composite.uniforms.sceneDiffuse.value = readBuffer.texture;
    this.composite.uniforms.sceneDepth.value = depth;
    this.composite.uniforms.near.value = camera.near;
    this.composite.uniforms.far.value = camera.far;
    this.quad.material = this.composite;
    renderer.setRenderTarget(this.renderToScreen ? null : writeBuffer);
    this.quad.render(renderer);
  }

  dispose(): void {
    this.rays.dispose();
    this.blurred.dispose();
    this.depthCopy?.depthTexture?.dispose();
    this.depthCopy?.dispose();
    this.shadowCopy?.depthTexture?.dispose();
    this.shadowCopy?.dispose();
    this.illumination.dispose();
    this.blur.dispose();
    this.composite.dispose();
    this.quad.dispose();
  }
}
```

#if (KSIZE_ENUM == 0)

export const compositor_default: string = `varying vec2 vUv;void main(){vUv=uv;gl_Position=projectionMatrix*modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.0);}`;

export const compositor_default2: string = `${common}
uniform sampler2D godrays;uniform sampler2D sceneDiffuse;uniform sampler2D sceneDepth;uniform vec2 resolution;uniform vec2 godraysResolution;uniform float near;uniform float far;uniform vec3 color;uniform bool gammaCorrection;varying vec2 vUv;
#define DITHERING
${dithering_pars_fragment}
float linearize_depth(float depth,float zNear,float zFar){
#if defined( USE_LOGDEPTHBUF )
float d=pow(2.0,depth*log2(far+1.0))-1.0;float a=far/(far-near);float b=far*near/(near-far);depth=a+b/d;
#endif
return zNear*zFar/(zFar+depth*(zNear-zFar));}vec4 LinearTosRGB_(in vec4 value){return vec4(mix(pow(value.rgb,vec3(0.41666))*1.055-vec3(0.055),value.rgb*12.92,vec3(lessThanEqual(value.rgb,vec3(0.0031308)))),value.a);}void main(){float rawDepth=texture2D(sceneDepth,vUv).x;float correctDepth=linearize_depth(rawDepth,near,far);vec2 texelSize=1.0/godraysResolution;vec2 texelPos=vUv*godraysResolution-0.5;vec2 base=floor(texelPos);vec2 f=texelPos-base;float totalWeight=0.0;float totalIllum=0.0;for(int y=-JBU_EXTENT;y<=1+JBU_EXTENT;y++){for(int x=-JBU_EXTENT;x<=1+JBU_EXTENT;x++){vec2 sampleUv=(base+vec2(float(x),float(y))+0.5)*texelSize;vec4 data=texture2D(godrays,sampleUv);float sampleDepth=data.a;vec2 d=vec2(float(x),float(y))-f;float spatialW=exp(-dot(d,d)/(2.0*JBU_SPATIAL_SIGMA*JBU_SPATIAL_SIGMA));float depthDiff=(sampleDepth-correctDepth)/max(correctDepth,0.001);float depthW=exp(-0.5*depthDiff*depthDiff/(JBU_DEPTH_SIGMA*JBU_DEPTH_SIGMA));float w=spatialW*depthW;totalWeight+=w;totalIllum+=data.r*w;}}float bestChoice=totalWeight>0.0?totalIllum/totalWeight:0.0;vec4 diffuse=texture2D(sceneDiffuse,vUv);
#if defined(DEBUG_STEPS)
vec3 totalColor=vec3(0.0);float totalColorWeight=0.0;for(int y=-JBU_EXTENT;y<=1+JBU_EXTENT;y++){for(int x=-JBU_EXTENT;x<=1+JBU_EXTENT;x++){vec2 sampleUv=(base+vec2(float(x),float(y))+0.5)*texelSize;vec4 data=texture2D(godrays,sampleUv);float sampleDepth=data.a;vec2 d=vec2(float(x),float(y))-f;float spatialW=exp(-dot(d,d)/(2.0*JBU_SPATIAL_SIGMA*JBU_SPATIAL_SIGMA));float depthDiff=(sampleDepth-correctDepth)/max(correctDepth,0.001);float depthW=exp(-0.5*depthDiff*depthDiff/(JBU_DEPTH_SIGMA*JBU_DEPTH_SIGMA));float w=spatialW*depthW;totalColorWeight+=w;totalColor+=data.rgb*w;}}gl_FragColor=vec4(totalColorWeight>0.0?totalColor/totalColorWeight:vec3(0.0),diffuse.a);
#else
gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(diffuse.rgb,color,bestChoice),diffuse.a);
#endif
${dithering_fragment}
if(gammaCorrection){gl_FragColor=LinearTosRGB_(gl_FragColor);}}`;

export const godrays_default: string = `varying vec2 vUv;varying vec3 vWorldRay;uniform sampler2D sceneDepth;uniform vec3 lightPos;uniform vec3 cameraPos;uniform vec2 resolution;uniform mat4 cameraProjectionMatrixInv;uniform mat4 cameraMatrixWorld;
#if defined(USE_CUBE_SHADOWMAP)
uniform samplerCube shadowMap;
#else
uniform sampler2D shadowMap;
#endif
uniform float texelSizeY;uniform float lightCameraNear;uniform float lightCameraFar;uniform float near;uniform float far;uniform float density;uniform float maxDensity;uniform float distanceAttenuation;uniform vec3[6]fNormals;uniform float[6]fConstants;uniform float raymarchSteps;uniform float raymarchStepSize;uniform float minSteps;uniform float maxSteps;uniform float shadowTexelWorldSize;uniform mat4 premultipliedLightCameraMatrix;
${packing}
float linearize_depth(float depth,float zNear,float zFar){
#if defined( USE_LOGDEPTHBUF )
float d=pow(2.0,depth*log2(zFar+1.0))-1.0;float a=zFar/(zFar-zNear);float b=zFar*zNear/(zNear-zFar);depth=a+b/d;
#endif
return zNear*zFar/(zFar+depth*(zNear-zFar));}vec3 WorldPosFromDepth(float depth){
#if defined( USE_LOGDEPTHBUF )
float d=pow(2.0,depth*log2(far+1.0))-1.0;float a=far/(far-near);float b=far*near/(near-far);depth=a+b/d;
#endif
float ndcZ=depth*2.0-1.0;float invW=1.0/(cameraProjectionMatrixInv[2][3]*ndcZ+cameraProjectionMatrixInv[3][3]);return vWorldRay*invW+cameraMatrixWorld[3].xyz;}vec2 cubeToUV(vec3 v){vec3 absV=abs(v);float scaleToCube=1.0/max(absV.x,max(absV.y,absV.z));absV*=scaleToCube;v*=scaleToCube*(1.0-2.0*texelSizeY);vec2 planar=v.xy;float almostATexel=1.5*texelSizeY;float almostOne=1.0-almostATexel;if(absV.z>=almostOne){if(v.z>0.0)planar.x=4.0-v.x;}else if(absV.x>=almostOne){float signX=sign(v.x);planar.x=v.z*signX+2.0*signX;}else if(absV.y>=almostOne){float signY=sign(v.y);planar.x=v.x+2.0*signY+2.0;planar.y=v.z*signY-2.0;}return vec2(0.125,0.25)*planar+vec2(0.375,0.75);}vec3 projectToShadowMap(vec3 worldPos){vec4 lightSpacePos=premultipliedLightCameraMatrix*vec4(worldPos,1.0);lightSpacePos/=lightSpacePos.w;lightSpacePos=lightSpacePos*0.5+0.5;return lightSpacePos.xyz;}vec2 inShadow(vec3 worldPos){
#if defined(USE_CUBE_SHADOWMAP)
vec3 lightToPos=worldPos-lightPos;float lightDist=length(lightToPos);float shadowMapDepth=textureCube(shadowMap,lightToPos).r;float depth=lightCameraNear+(lightCameraFar-lightCameraNear)*shadowMapDepth;return vec2(float(lightDist>depth+0.005),lightDist);
#else
#if defined(IS_POINT_LIGHT)
vec2 shadowMapUV=cubeToUV(normalize(worldPos-lightPos));
#elif defined(IS_DIRECTIONAL_LIGHT)
vec3 shadowMapUV=projectToShadowMap(worldPos);bool isOutsideShadowMap=shadowMapUV.x<0.0||shadowMapUV.x>1.0||shadowMapUV.y<0.0||shadowMapUV.y>1.0||shadowMapUV.z<0.0||shadowMapUV.z>1.0;if(isOutsideShadowMap){return vec2(1.0,0.0);}
#endif
vec4 packedDepth=texture2D(shadowMap,shadowMapUV.xy);
#if defined( USE_UNPACKED_DEPTH )
#if defined(IS_DIRECTIONAL_LIGHT)
float depth=packedDepth.x;
#else
float depth=1.-packedDepth.x;
#endif
#else
float depth=unpackRGBAToDepth(packedDepth);
#endif
depth=lightCameraNear+(lightCameraFar-lightCameraNear)*depth;
#if defined(IS_POINT_LIGHT)
float lightDist=distance(worldPos,lightPos);
#elif defined(IS_DIRECTIONAL_LIGHT)
float lightDist=(lightCameraNear+(lightCameraFar-lightCameraNear)*shadowMapUV.z);
#endif
float difference=lightDist-depth;return vec2(float(difference>0.0),lightDist);
#endif
}float sdPlane(vec3 p,vec3 n,float h){return dot(p,n)+h;}void main(){float depth=texture2D(sceneDepth,vUv).x;float linearDepth=linearize_depth(depth,near,far);vec3 worldPos=WorldPosFromDepth(depth);vec3 direction=normalize(worldPos-cameraPos);float distToTarget=distance(worldPos,cameraPos);float tEntry=0.0;float tExit=distToTarget;bool missed=false;for(int i=0;i<6;i++){float denom=dot(fNormals[i],direction);float dist=sdPlane(cameraPos,fNormals[i],fConstants[i]);if(abs(denom)<1e-6){if(dist>0.0){missed=true;break;}}else{float t=-dist/denom;if(denom<0.0){tEntry=max(tEntry,t);}else{tExit=min(tExit,t);}}}if(missed||tEntry>=tExit){gl_FragColor=vec4(0.0,0.0,0.0,linearDepth);return;}float startOffset=tEntry>0.0?0.001:0.0;vec3 startPos=cameraPos+(tEntry+startOffset)*direction;worldPos=cameraPos+tExit*direction;float illum=0.0;float rayLength=distance(startPos,worldPos);float densityFactor=rayLength*density;float baseSteps;if(raymarchStepSize>0.0){float effectiveStepSize=max(raymarchStepSize,shadowTexelWorldSize*0.5);baseSteps=clamp(rayLength/effectiveStepSize,minSteps,maxSteps);}else{baseSteps=raymarchSteps;}float noise=fract(52.9829189*fract(0.06711056*gl_FragCoord.x+0.00583715*gl_FragCoord.y));float samplesFloat=round(baseSteps+((baseSteps/8.0)+2.0)*noise);int samples=int(samplesFloat);float earlyOutThreshold=-log(1.0-maxDensity)*samplesFloat;int stepsTaken=samples;for(int i=0;i<samples;i++){vec3 samplePos=mix(startPos,worldPos,float(i)/samplesFloat);vec2 shadowInfo=inShadow(samplePos);float shadowAmount=1.0-shadowInfo.x;illum+=shadowAmount*densityFactor*pow(1.0-shadowInfo.y/lightCameraFar,distanceAttenuation);if(illum>earlyOutThreshold){stepsTaken=i+1;break;}}illum/=samplesFloat;
#if defined(DEBUG_STEPS)
float t=clamp(float(stepsTaken)/150.0,0.0,1.0);gl_FragColor=vec4(0.0,t,0.0,linearDepth);
#else
gl_FragColor=vec4(vec3(clamp(1.0-exp(-illum),0.0,maxDensity)),linearDepth);
#endif
}`;

export const godrays_default2: string = `varying vec2 vUv;varying vec3 vWorldRay;uniform mat4 cameraProjectionMatrixInv;uniform mat4 cameraMatrixWorld;void main(){vec2 ndcXY=position.xy;vUv=ndcXY*0.5+0.5;vec3 viewRay=vec3(cameraProjectionMatrixInv[0][0]*ndcXY.x+cameraProjectionMatrixInv[3][0],cameraProjectionMatrixInv[1][1]*ndcXY.y+cameraProjectionMatrixInv[3][1],cameraProjectionMatrixInv[3][2]);vWorldRay=mat3(cameraMatrixWorld)*viewRay;gl_Position=vec4(ndcXY,1.0,1.0);}`;
```

## ek3d/addons/postprocessing/HalftonePass

````typescript
import { ShaderMaterial } from "../../materials/ShaderMaterial";
import { cloneUniforms } from "../../renderers/shaders/UniformsUtils";
import { HalftoneShader } from "../shaders/HalftoneShader";
import { Pass, FullScreenQuad } from "./Pass";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";
import type { WebGLRenderTarget } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";

/**
 * Pass for creating a RGB halftone effect.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const params = {
 * 	shape: 1,
 * 	radius: 4,
 * 	rotateR: Math.PI / 12,
 * 	rotateB: Math.PI / 12 * 2,
 * 	rotateG: Math.PI / 12 * 3,
 * 	scatter: 0,
 * 	blending: 1,
 * 	blendingMode: 1,
 * 	greyscale: false,
 * 	disable: false
 * };
 * const halftonePass = new HalftonePass( params );
 * composer.addPass( halftonePass );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class HalftonePass extends Pass {
  uniforms: Record<string, { value: any; needsUpdate?: boolean }>;
  material: ShaderMaterial;
  _fsQuad: FullScreenQuad;

  /**
   * Constructs a new halftone pass.
   *
   * @param params - The halftone shader parameters; keys matching uniform
   * names overwrite their default values.
   */
  constructor(params: Record<string, any> = {}) {
    super();
    /**
     * The pass uniforms.
     */
    this.uniforms = cloneUniforms(HalftoneShader.uniforms);

    /**
     * The pass material.
     */
    this.material = new ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: this.uniforms,
      fragmentShader: HalftoneShader.fragmentShader,
      vertexShader: HalftoneShader.vertexShader,
    });

    for (const key in params) {
      if (
        Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(params, key) &&
        Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(this.uniforms, key)
      ) {
        this.uniforms[key].value = params[key];
      }
    }

    // internals

    this._fsQuad = new FullScreenQuad(this.material);
  }

  /**
   * Performs the halftone pass.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param writeBuffer - The write buffer. This buffer is intended as the rendering
   * destination for the pass.
   * @param readBuffer - The read buffer. The pass can access the result from the
   * previous pass from this buffer.
   * @param deltaTime - The delta time in seconds.
   * @param maskActive - Whether masking is active or not.
   */
  render(
    renderer: WebGLRenderer,
    writeBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    readBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    _deltaTime: number,
    _maskActive: boolean,
  ): void {
    this.material.uniforms["tDiffuse"].value = readBuffer.texture;

    if (this.renderToScreen) {
      renderer.setRenderTarget(null);
      this._fsQuad.render(renderer);
    } else {
      renderer.setRenderTarget(writeBuffer);
      if (this.clear) renderer.clear();
      this._fsQuad.render(renderer);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Sets the size of the pass.
   *
   * @param width - The width to set.
   * @param height - The height to set.
   */
  setSize(width: number, height: number): void {
    this.uniforms["width"].value = width;
    this.uniforms["height"].value = height;
  }

  /**
   * Frees the GPU-related resources allocated by this instance. Call this
   * method whenever the pass is no longer used in your app.
   */
  dispose(): void {
    this.material.dispose();

    this._fsQuad.dispose();
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/postprocessing/LUTPass

````typescript
import { ShaderPass } from "./ShaderPass";
import type { Data3DTexture } from "../../textures/Data3DTexture";

const LUTShader = {
  name: "LUTShader",

  uniforms: {
    lut: { value: null },
    lutSize: { value: 0 },

    tDiffuse: { value: null },
    intensity: { value: 1.0 },
  },

  vertexShader: /* glsl */ `

		varying vec2 vUv;

		void main() {

			vUv = uv;
			gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4( position, 1.0 );

		}

	`,

  fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `

		uniform float lutSize;
		uniform sampler3D lut;

		varying vec2 vUv;
		uniform float intensity;
		uniform sampler2D tDiffuse;
		void main() {

			vec4 val = texture2D( tDiffuse, vUv );
			vec4 lutVal;

			// pull the sample in by half a pixel so the sample begins
			// at the center of the edge pixels.
			float pixelWidth = 1.0 / lutSize;
			float halfPixelWidth = 0.5 / lutSize;
			vec3 uvw = vec3( halfPixelWidth ) + val.rgb * ( 1.0 - pixelWidth );


			lutVal = vec4( texture( lut, uvw ).rgb, val.a );

			gl_FragColor = vec4( mix( val, lutVal, intensity ) );

		}

	`,
};

/** LUT pass options. */
export interface LUTPassOptions {
  /** The LUT as a 3D texture. */
  lut?: Data3DTexture | null;
  /** The blend intensity. */
  intensity?: number;
}

/**
 * Pass for color grading via lookup tables.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const lutPass = new LUTPass( { lut: lut.texture3D } );
 * composer.addPass( lutPass );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class LUTPass extends ShaderPass {
  /**
   * Constructs a LUT pass.
   *
   * @param options - The pass options.
   */
  constructor(options: LUTPassOptions = {}) {
    super(LUTShader);

    this.lut = options.lut || null;
    this.intensity = options.intensity ?? 1;
  }

  /**
   * The LUT as a 3D texture.
   */
  get lut(): Data3DTexture | null {
    return this.material!.uniforms.lut.value;
  }

  set lut(v: Data3DTexture | null) {
    if (v !== this.material!.uniforms.lut.value) {
      this.material!.uniforms.lut.value = null;

      if (v) {
        this.material!.uniforms.lutSize.value = v.image.width;
        this.material!.uniforms.lut.value = v;
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * The intensity.
   */
  get intensity(): number {
    return this.material!.uniforms.intensity.value;
  }

  set intensity(v: number) {
    this.material!.uniforms.intensity.value = v;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/postprocessing/MaskPass

````typescript
import { GL } from "../../GL";
import { Pass } from "./Pass";
import type { Camera } from "../../cameras/Camera";
import type { Scene } from "../../scenes/Scene";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";
import type { WebGLRenderTarget } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";

/**
 * This pass can be used to define a mask during post processing.
 * Meaning only areas of subsequent post processing are affected
 * which lie in the masking area of this pass. Internally, the masking
 * is implemented with the stencil buffer.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const maskPass = new MaskPass( scene, camera );
 * composer.addPass( maskPass );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class MaskPass extends Pass {
  scene: Scene;
  camera: Camera;
  clear: boolean;
  needsSwap: boolean;
  inverse: boolean;

  /**
   * Constructs a new mask pass.
   *
   * @param scene - The scene that defines the mask.
   * @param camera - The camera.
   */
  constructor(scene: Scene, camera: Camera) {
    super();
    /**
     * The scene that defines the mask.
     */
    this.scene = scene;
    /**
     * The camera.
     */
    this.camera = camera;
    /**
     * Overwritten to perform a clear operation by default.
     *
     * @default true
     */
    this.clear = true;
    /**
     * Overwritten to disable the swap.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.needsSwap = false;
    /**
     * Whether to inverse the mask or not.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.inverse = false;
  }

  /**
   * Performs a mask pass with the configured scene and camera.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param writeBuffer - The write buffer. This buffer is intended as the rendering
   * destination for the pass.
   * @param readBuffer - The read buffer. The pass can access the result from the
   * previous pass from this buffer.
   * @param deltaTime - The delta time in seconds.
   * @param maskActive - Whether masking is active or not.
   */
  render(
    renderer: WebGLRenderer,
    writeBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    readBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    _deltaTime: number,
    _maskActive: boolean,
  ): void {
    const state = renderer.state;

    // don't update color or depth

    state.buffers.color.setMask(false);
    state.buffers.depth.setMask(false);

    // lock buffers

    state.buffers.color.setLocked(true);
    state.buffers.depth.setLocked(true);

    // set up stencil

    let writeValue: number, clearValue: number;

    if (this.inverse) {
      writeValue = 0;
      clearValue = 1;
    } else {
      writeValue = 1;
      clearValue = 0;
    }

    state.buffers.stencil.setTest(true);
    state.buffers.stencil.setOp(GL.REPLACE, GL.REPLACE, GL.REPLACE);
    state.buffers.stencil.setFunc(GL.ALWAYS, writeValue, 0xffffffff);
    state.buffers.stencil.setClear(clearValue);
    state.buffers.stencil.setLocked(true);

    // draw into the stencil buffer

    renderer.setRenderTarget(readBuffer);
    if (this.clear) renderer.clear();
    renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);

    renderer.setRenderTarget(writeBuffer);
    if (this.clear) renderer.clear();
    renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);

    // unlock color and depth buffer and make them writable for subsequent rendering/clearing

    state.buffers.color.setLocked(false);
    state.buffers.depth.setLocked(false);

    state.buffers.color.setMask(true);
    state.buffers.depth.setMask(true);

    // only render where stencil is set to 1

    state.buffers.stencil.setLocked(false);
    state.buffers.stencil.setFunc(GL.EQUAL, 1, 0xffffffff); // draw if == 1
    state.buffers.stencil.setOp(GL.KEEP, GL.KEEP, GL.KEEP);
    state.buffers.stencil.setLocked(true);
  }
}

/**
 * This pass can be used to clear a mask previously defined with {@link MaskPass}.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const clearPass = new ClearMaskPass();
 * composer.addPass( clearPass );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class ClearMaskPass extends Pass {
  needsSwap: boolean;

  /**
   * Constructs a new clear mask pass.
   */
  constructor() {
    super();
    /**
     * Overwritten to disable the swap.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.needsSwap = false;
  }

  /**
   * Performs the clear of the currently defined mask.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param writeBuffer - The write buffer. This buffer is intended as the rendering
   * destination for the pass.
   * @param readBuffer - The read buffer. The pass can access the result from the
   * previous pass from this buffer.
   * @param deltaTime - The delta time in seconds.
   * @param maskActive - Whether masking is active or not.
   */
  render(
    renderer: WebGLRenderer,
    _writeBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    _readBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget,
    _deltaTime: number,
    _maskActive: boolean,
  ): void {
    renderer.state.buffers.stencil.setLocked(false);
    renderer.state.buffers.stencil.setTest(false);
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/postprocessing/OutlinePass

````typescript
import { Blending, Side, TextureType, DepthPacking } from "../../constants";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Matrix4 } from "../../math/Matrix4";
import { Vector2 } from "../../math/Vector2";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import { MeshDepthMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshDepthMaterial";
import { ShaderMaterial } from "../../materials/ShaderMaterial";
import { cloneUniforms } from "../../renderers/shaders/UniformsUtils";
import { WebGLRenderTarget } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";
import { CopyShader } from "../shaders/CopyShader";
import { Pass, FullScreenQuad } from "./Pass";
import type { PerspectiveCamera } from "../../cameras/PerspectiveCamera";
import type { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import type { Scene } from "../../scenes/Scene";
import type { Texture } from "../../textures/Texture";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";
import type { WebGLRenderTarget as RT } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderTarget";
import type { Line } from "../../objects/Line";
import type { LineSegments } from "../../objects/LineSegments";
import type { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import type { Points } from "../../objects/Points";
import type { Sprite } from "../../objects/Sprite";
import chunk_batching_pars_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/batching_pars_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_morphtarget_pars_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/morphtarget_pars_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_skinning_pars_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/skinning_pars_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_batching_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/batching_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_skinning_base_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/skinbase_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_begin_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/begin_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_morphtarget_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/morphtarget_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_skinning_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/skinning_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_project_vertex from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/project_vertex.glsl";
import chunk_packing from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/packing.glsl";
import chunk_common from "../../renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/common.glsl";

/** Internal object kinds tracked while changing outline visibility. */
type OutlineObject = Mesh | Points | Sprite | Line | (LineSegments & { isLine2?: boolean });

/**
 * A pass for rendering outlines around selected objects.
 *
 * ```ts
 * const resolution = new Vector2( window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight );
 * const outlinePass = new OutlinePass( resolution, scene, camera );
 * composer.addPass( outlinePass );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class OutlinePass extends Pass {
  renderScene: Scene;
  renderCamera: PerspectiveCamera;
  selectedObjects: Object3D[];
  visibleEdgeColor: Color;
  hiddenEdgeColor: Color;
  edgeGlow: number;
  usePatternTexture: boolean;
  patternTexture: Texture | null;
  edgeThickness: number;
  edgeStrength: number;
  downSampleRatio: number;
  pulsePeriod: number;
  resolution: Vector2;
  renderTargetMaskBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget;
  depthMaterial: MeshDepthMaterial;
  prepareMaskMaterial: ShaderMaterial;
  renderTargetDepthBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget;
  renderTargetMaskDownSampleBuffer: WebGLRenderTarget;
  renderTargetBlurBuffer1: WebGLRenderTarget;
  renderTargetBlurBuffer2: WebGLRenderTarget;
  edgeDetectionMaterial: ShaderMaterial;
  renderTargetEdgeBuffer1: WebGLRenderTarget;
  renderTargetEdgeBuffer2: WebGLRenderTarget;
  separableBlurMaterial1: ShaderMaterial;
  separableBlurMaterial2: ShaderMaterial;
  overlayMaterial: ShaderMaterial;
  copyUniforms: Record<string, { value: any; needsUpdate?: boolean }>;
  materialCopy: ShaderMaterial;
  _oldClearColor: Color;
  oldClearAlpha: number;
  _fsQuad: FullScreenQuad;
  tempPulseColor1: Color;
  tempPulseColor2: Color;
  textureMatrix: Matrix4;
  _visibilityCache: Map<OutlineObject, boolean>;
  _selectionCache: Set<Mesh>;

  /** Static blur directions, shared by all instances. */
  static BlurDirectionX: Vector2 = new Vector2(1.0, 0.0);
  static BlurDirectionY: Vector2 = new Vector2(0.0, 1.0);

  /**
   * Constructs a new outline pass.
   *
   * @param resolution - The effect's resolution.
   * @param scene - The scene to render.
   * @param camera - The camera.
   * @param selectedObjects - The selected 3D objects that should receive an outline.
   */
  constructor(resolution?: Vector2, scene?: Scene, camera?: PerspectiveCamera, selectedObjects?: Object3D[]) {
    super();
    /**
     * The scene to render.
     */
    this.renderScene = scene!;

    /**
     * The camera.
     */
    this.renderCamera = camera!;

    /**
     * The selected 3D objects that should receive an outline.
     */
    this.selectedObjects = selectedObjects !== undefined ? selectedObjects : [];

    /**
     * The visible edge color.
     *
     * @default (1,1,1)
     */
    this.visibleEdgeColor = new Color(1, 1, 1);

    /**
     * The hidden edge color.
     *
     * @default (0.1,0.04,0.02)
     */
    this.hiddenEdgeColor = new Color(0.1, 0.04, 0.02);

    /**
     * Can be used for an animated glow/pulse effect.
     *
     * @default 0
     */
    this.edgeGlow = 0.0;

    /**
     * Whether to use a pattern texture for to highlight selected
     * 3D objects or not.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.usePatternTexture = false;

    /**
     * Can be used to highlight selected 3D objects. Requires to set
     * {@link OutlinePass#usePatternTexture} to `true`.
     *
     * @default null
     */
    this.patternTexture = null;

    /**
     * The edge thickness.
     *
     * @default 1
     */
    this.edgeThickness = 1.0;

    /**
     * The edge strength.
     *
     * @default 3
     */
    this.edgeStrength = 3.0;

    /**
     * The downsample ratio. The effect can be rendered in a much
     * lower resolution than the beauty pass.
     *
     * @default 2
     */
    this.downSampleRatio = 2;

    /**
     * The pulse period.
     *
     * @default 0
     */
    this.pulsePeriod = 0;

    this._visibilityCache = new Map();
    this._selectionCache = new Set();

    /**
     * The effect's resolution.
     *
     * @default (256,256)
     */
    this.resolution = resolution !== undefined ? new Vector2(resolution.x, resolution.y) : new Vector2(256, 256);

    const resx = Math.round(this.resolution.x / this.downSampleRatio);
    const resy = Math.round(this.resolution.y / this.downSampleRatio);

    this.renderTargetMaskBuffer = new WebGLRenderTarget(this.resolution.x, this.resolution.y);
    this.renderTargetMaskBuffer.texture.name = "OutlinePass.mask";
    this.renderTargetMaskBuffer.texture.generateMipmaps = false;

    this.depthMaterial = new MeshDepthMaterial();
    this.depthMaterial.side = Side.Double;
    this.depthMaterial.depthPacking = DepthPacking.RGBA;
    this.depthMaterial.blending = Blending.No;

    this.prepareMaskMaterial = this._getPrepareMaskMaterial();
    this.prepareMaskMaterial.side = Side.Double;
    this.prepareMaskMaterial.fragmentShader = replaceDepthToViewZ(
      this.prepareMaskMaterial.fragmentShader,
      this.renderCamera,
    );

    this.renderTargetDepthBuffer = new WebGLRenderTarget(this.resolution.x, this.resolution.y, {
      type: TextureType.HalfFloat,
    });
    this.renderTargetDepthBuffer.texture.name = "OutlinePass.depth";
    this.renderTargetDepthBuffer.texture.generateMipmaps = false;

    this.renderTargetMaskDownSampleBuffer = new WebGLRenderTarget(resx, resy, {
      type: TextureType.HalfFloat,
      depthBuffer: false,
    });
    this.renderTargetMaskDownSampleBuffer.texture.name = "OutlinePass.depthDownSample";
    this.renderTargetMaskDownSampleBuffer.texture.generateMipmaps = false;

    this.renderTargetBlurBuffer1 = new WebGLRenderTarget(resx, resy, {
      type: TextureType.HalfFloat,
      depthBuffer: false,
    });
    this.renderTargetBlurBuffer1.texture.name = "OutlinePass.blur1";
    this.renderTargetBlurBuffer1.texture.generateMipmaps = false;
    this.renderTargetBlurBuffer2 = new WebGLRenderTarget(Math.round(resx / 2), Math.round(resy / 2), {
      type: TextureType.HalfFloat,
      depthBuffer: false,
    });
    this.renderTargetBlurBuffer2.texture.name = "OutlinePass.blur2";
    this.renderTargetBlurBuffer2.texture.generateMipmaps = false;

    this.edgeDetectionMaterial = this._getEdgeDetectionMaterial();
    this.renderTargetEdgeBuffer1 = new WebGLRenderTarget(resx, resy, {
      type: TextureType.HalfFloat,
      depthBuffer: false,
    });
    this.renderTargetEdgeBuffer1.texture.name = "OutlinePass.edge1";
    this.renderTargetEdgeBuffer1.texture.generateMipmaps = false;
    this.renderTargetEdgeBuffer2 = new WebGLRenderTarget(Math.round(resx / 2), Math.round(resy / 2), {
      type: TextureType.HalfFloat,
      depthBuffer: false,
    });
    this.renderTargetEdgeBuffer2.texture.name = "OutlinePass.edge2";
    this.renderTargetEdgeBuffer2.texture.generateMipmaps = false;

    const MAX_EDGE_THICKNESS = 4;
    const MAX_EDGE_GLOW = 4;

    this.separableBlurMaterial1 = this._getSeparableBlurMaterial(MAX_EDGE_THICKNESS);
    this.separableBlurMaterial1.uniforms["texSize"].value.set(resx, resy);
    this.separableBlurMaterial1.uniforms["kernelRadius"].value = 1;
    this.separableBlurMaterial2 = this._getSeparableBlurMaterial(MAX_EDGE_GLOW);
    this.separableBlurMaterial2.uniforms["texSize"].value.set(Math.round(resx / 2), Math.round(resy / 2));
    this.separableBlurMaterial2.uniforms["kernelRadius"].value = MAX_EDGE_GLOW;

    // Overlay material
    this.overlayMaterial = this._getOverlayMaterial();

    // copy material

    const copyShader = CopyShader;

    this.copyUniforms = cloneUniforms(copyShader.uniforms) as Record<string, { value: any; needsUpdate?: boolean }>;

    this.materialCopy = new ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: this.copyUniforms,
      vertexShader: copyShader.vertexShader,
      fragmentShader: copyShader.fragmentShader,
      blending: Blending.No,
      depthTest: false,
      depthWrite: false,
    } as never);

    this.enabled = true;
    this.needsSwap = false;

    this._oldClearColor = new Color();
    this.oldClearAlpha = 1;

    this._fsQuad = new FullScreenQuad(null);

    this.tempPulseColor1 = new Color();
    this.tempPulseColor2 = new Color();
    this.textureMatrix = new Matrix4();

    function replaceDepthToViewZ(string: string, camera: PerspectiveCamera): string {
      const type = camera.isPerspectiveCamera ? "perspective" : "orthographic";

      return string.replace(/DEPTH_TO_VIEW_Z/g, type + "DepthToViewZ");
    }
  }

  /**
   * Frees the GPU-related resources allocated by this instance. Call this
   * method whenever the pass is no longer used in your app.
   */
  dispose(): void {
    this.renderTargetMaskBuffer.dispose();
    this.renderTargetDepthBuffer.dispose();
    this.renderTargetMaskDownSampleBuffer.dispose();
    this.renderTargetBlurBuffer1.dispose();
    this.renderTargetBlurBuffer2.dispose();
    this.renderTargetEdgeBuffer1.dispose();
    this.renderTargetEdgeBuffer2.dispose();

    this.depthMaterial.dispose();
    this.prepareMaskMaterial.dispose();
    this.edgeDetectionMaterial.dispose();
    this.separableBlurMaterial1.dispose();
    this.separableBlurMaterial2.dispose();
    this.overlayMaterial.dispose();
    this.materialCopy.dispose();

    this._fsQuad.dispose();
  }

  /**
   * Sets the size of the pass.
   *
   * @param width - The width to set.
   * @param height - The height to set.
   */
  setSize(width: number, height: number): void {
    this.renderTargetMaskBuffer.setSize(width, height);
    this.renderTargetDepthBuffer.setSize(width, height);

    let resx = Math.round(width / this.downSampleRatio);
    let resy = Math.round(height / this.downSampleRatio);
    this.renderTargetMaskDownSampleBuffer.setSize(resx, resy);
    this.renderTargetBlurBuffer1.setSize(resx, resy);
    this.renderTargetEdgeBuffer1.setSize(resx, resy);
    this.separableBlurMaterial1.uniforms["texSize"].value.set(resx, resy);

    resx = Math.round(resx / 2);
    resy = Math.round(resy / 2);

    this.renderTargetBlurBuffer2.setSize(resx, resy);
    this.renderTargetEdgeBuffer2.setSize(resx, resy);

    this.separableBlurMaterial2.uniforms["texSize"].value.set(resx, resy);
  }

  /**
   * Performs the Outline pass.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param writeBuffer - The write buffer. This buffer is intended as the rendering
   * destination for the pass.
   * @param readBuffer - The read buffer. The pass can access the result from the
   * previous pass from this buffer.
   * @param deltaTime - The delta time in seconds.
   * @param maskActive - Whether masking is active or not.
   */
  render(renderer: WebGLRenderer, writeBuffer: RT, readBuffer: RT, deltaTime: number, maskActive: boolean): void {
    if (this.selectedObjects.length > 0) {
      renderer.getClearColor(this._oldClearColor);
      this.oldClearAlpha = renderer.getClearAlpha();
      const oldAutoClear = renderer.autoClear;

      renderer.autoClear = false;

      if (maskActive) renderer.state.buffers.stencil.setTest(false);

      renderer.setClearColor(0xffffff, 1);

      this._updateSelectionCache();

      // Make selected objects invisible
      this._changeVisibilityOfSelectedObjects(false);

      const currentBackground = this.renderScene.background;
      const currentOverrideMaterial = this.renderScene.overrideMaterial;
      this.renderScene.background = null;

      // 1. Draw Non Selected objects in the depth buffer
      this.renderScene.overrideMaterial = this.depthMaterial;
      renderer.setRenderTarget(this.renderTargetDepthBuffer);
      renderer.clear();
      renderer.render(this.renderScene, this.renderCamera);

      // Make selected objects visible
      this._changeVisibilityOfSelectedObjects(true);
      this._visibilityCache.clear();

      // Update Texture Matrix for Depth compare
      this._updateTextureMatrix();

      // Make non selected objects invisible, and draw only the selected objects, by comparing the depth buffer of non selected objects
      this._changeVisibilityOfNonSelectedObjects(false);
      this.renderScene.overrideMaterial = this.prepareMaskMaterial;
      this.prepareMaskMaterial.uniforms["cameraNearFar"].value.set(this.renderCamera.near, this.renderCamera.far);
      this.prepareMaskMaterial.uniforms["depthTexture"].value = this.renderTargetDepthBuffer.texture;
      this.prepareMaskMaterial.uniforms["textureMatrix"].value = this.textureMatrix;
      renderer.setRenderTarget(this.renderTargetMaskBuffer);
      renderer.clear();
      renderer.render(this.renderScene, this.renderCamera);
      this._changeVisibilityOfNonSelectedObjects(true);
      this._visibilityCache.clear();
      this._selectionCache.clear();

      this.renderScene.background = currentBackground;
      this.renderScene.overrideMaterial = currentOverrideMaterial;
