## ek3d/addons/utils/LDrawUtils

````typescript
import { mergeGeometries } from "./BufferGeometryUtils";
import { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { LineSegments } from "../../objects/LineSegments";
import { LineSegments as LineSegmentsImpl } from "../../objects/LineSegments";
import { Matrix3 } from "../../math/Matrix3";
import { Mesh as MeshImpl } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import type { Group } from "../../objects/Group";
import { Group as GroupImpl } from "../../objects/Group";

/**
 * Utility class for LDraw models.
 *
 * ```ts
 * model = LDrawUtils.mergeObject( model );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class LDrawUtils {
  /**
   * Merges geometries in the given object by materials and returns a new group object.
   * Use on not indexed geometries. The object buffers reference the old object ones.
   * Special treatment is done to the conditional lines generated by {@link LDrawLoader}.
   *
   * @param object - The object to merge.
   * @returns The merged object.
   */
  static mergeObject(object: Group): Group {
    // Extracts a group from a geometry as a new geometry (with attribute buffers referencing original buffers)

    function extractGroup(
      geometry: BufferGeometry,
      group: { count: number; start: number },
      elementSize: number,
      isConditionalLine: boolean,
    ): BufferGeometry {
      const newGeometry = new BufferGeometry();

      const originalPositions = (geometry.getAttribute("position") as BufferAttribute).array as Float32Array;
      const originalNormalsAttr =
        elementSize === 3 ? (geometry.getAttribute("normal") as BufferAttribute | undefined) : undefined;
      const originalNormals = originalNormalsAttr !== undefined ? (originalNormalsAttr.array as Float32Array) : null;

      const numVertsGroup = Math.min(group.count, Math.floor(originalPositions.length / 3) - group.start);
      const vertStart = group.start * 3;
      const vertEnd = (group.start + numVertsGroup) * 3;

      const positions = originalPositions.subarray(vertStart, vertEnd);
      const normals = originalNormals !== null ? originalNormals.subarray(vertStart, vertEnd) : null;

      newGeometry.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(positions as never, 3));
      if (normals !== null) newGeometry.setAttribute("normal", new BufferAttribute(normals as never, 3));

      if (isConditionalLine) {
        const controlArray0 = ((geometry.getAttribute("control0") as BufferAttribute).array as Float32Array).subarray(
          vertStart,
          vertEnd,
        );
        const controlArray1 = ((geometry.getAttribute("control1") as BufferAttribute).array as Float32Array).subarray(
          vertStart,
          vertEnd,
        );
        const directionArray = ((geometry.getAttribute("direction") as BufferAttribute).array as Float32Array).subarray(
          vertStart,
          vertEnd,
        );

        newGeometry.setAttribute("control0", new BufferAttribute(controlArray0 as never, 3, false));
        newGeometry.setAttribute("control1", new BufferAttribute(controlArray1 as never, 3, false));
        newGeometry.setAttribute("direction", new BufferAttribute(directionArray as never, 3, false));
      }

      return newGeometry;
    }

    type GeometryBucket = { mat: unknown; arr: BufferGeometry[] };

    function addGeometry(mat: unknown, geometry: BufferGeometry, geometries: Record<string, GeometryBucket>): void {
      const geoms = geometries[(mat as { uuid: string }).uuid];
      if (!geoms) {
        geometries[(mat as { uuid: string }).uuid] = {
          mat: mat,
          arr: [geometry],
        };
      } else {
        geoms.arr.push(geometry);
      }
    }

    function permuteAttribute(attribute: BufferAttribute | undefined, elemSize: number): void {
      // Permutes first two vertices of each attribute element

      if (!attribute) return;

      const verts = attribute.array as Float32Array;
      const numVerts = Math.floor(verts.length / 3);
      let offset = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < numVerts; i++) {
        const x = verts[offset];
        const y = verts[offset + 1];
        const z = verts[offset + 2];

        verts[offset] = verts[offset + 3];
        verts[offset + 1] = verts[offset + 4];
        verts[offset + 2] = verts[offset + 5];

        verts[offset + 3] = x;
        verts[offset + 4] = y;
        verts[offset + 5] = z;

        offset += elemSize * 3;
      }
    }

    // Traverse the object hierarchy collecting geometries and transforming them to world space

    const meshGeometries: Record<string, GeometryBucket> = {};
    const linesGeometries: Record<string, GeometryBucket> = {};
    const condLinesGeometries: Record<string, GeometryBucket> = {};

    object.updateMatrixWorld(true);
    const normalMatrix = new Matrix3();

    object.traverse((c) => {
      const holder = c as unknown as {
        isMesh?: boolean;
        isLineSegments?: boolean;
        isConditionalLine?: boolean;
        matrixWorld: import("../../math/Matrix4").Matrix4;
        geometry: BufferGeometry;
        material?: unknown;
      };

      if (holder.isMesh || holder.isLineSegments) {
        const elemSize = holder.isMesh ? 3 : 2;

        const geometry = holder.geometry.clone();
        const matrixIsInverted = holder.matrixWorld.determinant() < 0;
        if (matrixIsInverted) {
          permuteAttribute(geometry.getAttribute("position") as BufferAttribute, elemSize);
          permuteAttribute(geometry.getAttribute("normal") as BufferAttribute, elemSize);
        }

        geometry.applyMatrix4(holder.matrixWorld);

        if (holder.isConditionalLine) {
          (geometry.getAttribute("control0") as BufferAttribute).applyMatrix4(holder.matrixWorld);
          (geometry.getAttribute("control1") as BufferAttribute).applyMatrix4(holder.matrixWorld);
          normalMatrix.getNormalMatrix(holder.matrixWorld);
          (geometry.getAttribute("direction") as BufferAttribute).applyNormalMatrix(normalMatrix);
        }

        const geometries = holder.isMesh
          ? meshGeometries
          : holder.isConditionalLine
            ? condLinesGeometries
            : linesGeometries;

        if (Array.isArray(holder.material)) {
          for (const group of geometry.groups) {
            const mat = (holder.material as unknown[])[group.materialIndex!];
            const newGeometry = extractGroup(geometry, group, elemSize, holder.isConditionalLine === true);
            addGeometry(mat, newGeometry, geometries);
          }
        } else {
          addGeometry(holder.material, geometry, geometries);
        }
      }
    });

    // Create object with merged geometries

    const mergedObject = new GroupImpl();

    const meshMaterialsIds = Object.keys(meshGeometries);
    for (const meshMaterialsId of meshMaterialsIds) {
      const meshGeometry = meshGeometries[meshMaterialsId]!;
      const mergedGeometry = mergeGeometries(meshGeometry.arr as never);
      mergedObject.add(new MeshImpl(mergedGeometry as never, meshGeometry.mat as never));
    }

    const linesMaterialsIds = Object.keys(linesGeometries);
    for (const linesMaterialsId of linesMaterialsIds) {
      const lineGeometry = linesGeometries[linesMaterialsId]!;
      const mergedGeometry = mergeGeometries(lineGeometry.arr as never);
      mergedObject.add(new LineSegmentsImpl(mergedGeometry as never, lineGeometry.mat as never));
    }

    const condLinesMaterialsIds = Object.keys(condLinesGeometries);
    for (const condLinesMaterialsId of condLinesMaterialsIds) {
      const condLineGeometry = condLinesGeometries[condLinesMaterialsId]!;
      const mergedGeometry = mergeGeometries(condLineGeometry.arr as never);
      const condLines = new LineSegmentsImpl(mergedGeometry as never, condLineGeometry.mat as never) as LineSegments & {
        isConditionalLine: boolean;
      };
      condLines.isConditionalLine = true;
      mergedObject.add(condLines);
    }

    (mergedObject.userData as { constructionStep: number; numConstructionSteps: number }).constructionStep = 0;
    (mergedObject.userData as { constructionStep: number; numConstructionSteps: number }).numConstructionSteps = 1;

    return mergedObject;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/addons/utils/SVGStroke

```typescript
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { Float32BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { ShapeUtils } from "../../extras/ShapeUtils";
import { Vector2 } from "../../math/Vector2";

interface StrokeStyle {
  strokeColor: string;
  strokeWidth: number;
  strokeLineJoin: string;
  strokeLineCap: string;
  strokeMiterLimit: number;
}

// Stroke tessellation from the pinned three.js SVGLoader.
export class SVGStroke {
  static getStrokeStyle(width = 1, color = "#000", lineJoin = "miter", lineCap = "butt", miterLimit = 4) {
    width = width !== undefined ? width : 1;
    color = color !== undefined ? color : "#000";
    lineJoin = lineJoin !== undefined ? lineJoin : "miter";
    lineCap = lineCap !== undefined ? lineCap : "butt";
    miterLimit = miterLimit !== undefined ? miterLimit : 4;

    return {
      strokeColor: color,
      strokeWidth: width,
      strokeLineJoin: lineJoin,
      strokeLineCap: lineCap,
      strokeMiterLimit: miterLimit,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Creates a stroke from an array of points.
   *
   * @param points - The points in 2D space. Minimum 2 points. The path can be open or closed (last point equals to first point).
   * @param style - SVG stroke properties returned by `SVGStroke.getStrokeStyle()`.
   * @param arcDivisions - Arc divisions for round joins and endcaps.
   * @param minDistance - Points closer to this distance will be merged.
   * @return The stroke geometry. UV coordinates run along and across the path.
   * Returns `null` if not geometry was generated.
   */
  static pointsToStroke(
    points: Vector2[],
    style: StrokeStyle,
    arcDivisions = 12,
    minDistance = 0.001,
  ): BufferGeometry | null {
    const vertices: number[] = [];
    const normals: number[] = [];
    const uvs: number[] = [];

    if (SVGStroke.pointsToStrokeWithBuffers(points, style, arcDivisions, minDistance, vertices, normals, uvs) === 0) {
      return null;
    }

    const geometry = new BufferGeometry();
    geometry.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(vertices, 3));
    geometry.setAttribute("normal", new Float32BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
    geometry.setAttribute("uv", new Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2));

    return geometry;
  }

  /**
   * Creates a stroke from an array of points.
   *
   * @param points - The points in 2D space. Minimum 2 points.
   * @param style - SVG stroke properties returned by `SVGStroke.getStrokeStyle()`.
   * @param arcDivisions - Arc divisions for round joins and endcaps.
   * @param minDistance - Points closer to this distance will be merged.
   * @param vertices - An array holding vertices.
   * @param normals - An array holding normals.
   * @param uvs - An array holding UVs.
   * @param vertexOffset - The vertex offset.
   * @return The number of vertices.
   */
  static pointsToStrokeWithBuffers(
    points: Vector2[],
    style: StrokeStyle,
    arcDivisions: number,
    minDistance: number,
    vertices: number[],
    normals: number[],
    uvs: number[],
    vertexOffset = 0,
  ): number {
    // This function can be called to update existing arrays or buffers.
    // Accepts same parameters as pointsToStroke, plus the buffers and optional offset.
    // Param vertexOffset: Offset vertices to start writing in the buffers (3 elements/vertex for vertices and normals, and 2 elements/vertex for uvs)
    // Returns number of written vertices / normals / uvs pairs
    // if 'vertices' parameter is undefined no triangles will be generated, but the returned vertices count will still be valid (useful to preallocate the buffers)
    // 'normals' and 'uvs' buffers are optional

    const tempV2_1 = new Vector2();
    const tempV2_2 = new Vector2();
    const tempV2_3 = new Vector2();
    const tempV2_4 = new Vector2();
    const tempV2_5 = new Vector2();
    const tempV2_6 = new Vector2();
    const tempV2_7 = new Vector2();
    const lastPointL = new Vector2();
    const lastPointR = new Vector2();
    const point0L = new Vector2();
    const point0R = new Vector2();
    const currentPointL = new Vector2();
    const currentPointR = new Vector2();
    const nextPointL = new Vector2();
    const nextPointR = new Vector2();
    const innerPoint = new Vector2();
    const outerPoint = new Vector2();

    arcDivisions = arcDivisions !== undefined ? arcDivisions : 12;
    minDistance = minDistance !== undefined ? minDistance : 0.001;
    vertexOffset = vertexOffset !== undefined ? vertexOffset : 0;

    // First ensure there are no duplicated points
    points = removeDuplicatedPoints(points);

    const numPoints = points.length;

    if (numPoints < 2) return 0;

    const isClosed = points[0].equals(points[numPoints - 1]);

    let currentPoint = points[0];
    let previousPoint = points[0];
    let nextPoint: Vector2 | undefined;

    const strokeWidth2 = style.strokeWidth / 2;

    const deltaU = 1 / (numPoints - 1);
    let u0 = 0,
      u1 = 0;

    let innerSideModified = false;
    let joinIsOnLeftSide = false;
    let isMiter = false;
    let initialJoinIsOnLeftSide = false;

    let numVertices = 0;
    let currentCoordinate = vertexOffset * 3;
    let currentCoordinateUV = vertexOffset * 2;

    // Get initial left and right stroke points
    getNormal(points[0], points[1], tempV2_1).multiplyScalar(strokeWidth2);
    lastPointL.copy(points[0]).sub(tempV2_1);
    lastPointR.copy(points[0]).add(tempV2_1);
    point0L.copy(lastPointL);
    point0R.copy(lastPointR);

    for (let iPoint = 1; iPoint < numPoints; iPoint++) {
      currentPoint = points[iPoint];

      // Get next point
      if (iPoint === numPoints - 1) {
        if (isClosed) {
          // Skip duplicated initial point
          nextPoint = points[1];
        } else nextPoint = undefined;
      } else {
        nextPoint = points[iPoint + 1];
      }

      // Normal of previous segment in tempV2_1
      const normal1 = tempV2_1;
      getNormal(previousPoint, currentPoint, normal1);

      tempV2_3.copy(normal1).multiplyScalar(strokeWidth2);
      currentPointL.copy(currentPoint).sub(tempV2_3);
      currentPointR.copy(currentPoint).add(tempV2_3);

      u1 = u0 + deltaU;

      innerSideModified = false;

      if (nextPoint !== undefined) {
        // Normal of next segment in tempV2_2
        getNormal(currentPoint, nextPoint, tempV2_2);

        tempV2_3.copy(tempV2_2).multiplyScalar(strokeWidth2);
        nextPointL.copy(currentPoint).sub(tempV2_3);
        nextPointR.copy(currentPoint).add(tempV2_3);

        joinIsOnLeftSide = true;
        tempV2_3.subVectors(nextPoint, previousPoint);
        if (normal1.dot(tempV2_3) < 0) {
          joinIsOnLeftSide = false;
        }

        if (iPoint === 1) initialJoinIsOnLeftSide = joinIsOnLeftSide;

        tempV2_3.subVectors(nextPoint, currentPoint);
        tempV2_3.normalize();
        const dot = Math.abs(normal1.dot(tempV2_3));

        // If path is straight, don't create join
        if (dot > Number.EPSILON) {
          // Compute inner and outer segment intersections
          const miterSide = strokeWidth2 / dot;
          tempV2_3.multiplyScalar(-miterSide);
          tempV2_4.subVectors(currentPoint, previousPoint);
          tempV2_5.copy(tempV2_4).setLength(miterSide).add(tempV2_3);
          innerPoint.copy(tempV2_5).negate();
          const miterLength2 = tempV2_5.length();
          const segmentLengthPrev = tempV2_4.length();
          tempV2_4.divideScalar(segmentLengthPrev);
          tempV2_6.subVectors(nextPoint, currentPoint);
          const segmentLengthNext = tempV2_6.length();
          tempV2_6.divideScalar(segmentLengthNext);
          // Check that previous and next segments doesn't overlap with the innerPoint of intersection
          if (tempV2_4.dot(innerPoint) < segmentLengthPrev && tempV2_6.dot(innerPoint) < segmentLengthNext) {
            innerSideModified = true;
          }

          outerPoint.copy(tempV2_5).add(currentPoint);
          innerPoint.add(currentPoint);

          // in-loop fold detection to mitigate #25326
          if (innerSideModified) {
            //  when the second triangle's signed area would flip, snap innerPoint to the previous inner-side vertex

            const refPt = joinIsOnLeftSide ? lastPointR : lastPointL;
            const foldCross =
              (outerPoint.x - refPt.x) * (innerPoint.y - refPt.y) - (outerPoint.y - refPt.y) * (innerPoint.x - refPt.x);
            if ((joinIsOnLeftSide && foldCross < 0) || (!joinIsOnLeftSide && foldCross > 0)) {
              innerPoint.copy(refPt);
            }
          }

          isMiter = false;

          if (innerSideModified) {
            if (joinIsOnLeftSide) {
              nextPointR.copy(innerPoint);
              currentPointR.copy(innerPoint);
            } else {
              nextPointL.copy(innerPoint);
              currentPointL.copy(innerPoint);
            }
          } else {
            // The segment triangles are generated here if there was overlapping

            makeSegmentTriangles();
          }

          switch (style.strokeLineJoin) {
            case "bevel":
              makeSegmentWithBevelJoin(joinIsOnLeftSide, innerSideModified, u1);

              break;

            case "round":
              // Segment triangles

              createSegmentTrianglesWithMiddleSection(joinIsOnLeftSide, innerSideModified);

              // Join triangles

              if (joinIsOnLeftSide) {
                makeCircularSector(currentPoint, currentPointL, nextPointL, u1, 0);
              } else {
                makeCircularSector(currentPoint, nextPointR, currentPointR, u1, 1);
              }

              break;

            case "miter":
            case "miter-clip":
            default:
              const miterFraction = (strokeWidth2 * style.strokeMiterLimit) / miterLength2;

              if (miterFraction < 1) {
                // The join miter length exceeds the miter limit

                if (style.strokeLineJoin !== "miter-clip") {
                  makeSegmentWithBevelJoin(joinIsOnLeftSide, innerSideModified, u1);
                  break;
                } else {
                  // Segment triangles

                  createSegmentTrianglesWithMiddleSection(joinIsOnLeftSide, innerSideModified);

                  // Miter-clip join triangles

                  if (joinIsOnLeftSide) {
                    tempV2_6.subVectors(outerPoint, currentPointL).multiplyScalar(miterFraction).add(currentPointL);
                    tempV2_7.subVectors(outerPoint, nextPointL).multiplyScalar(miterFraction).add(nextPointL);

                    addVertex(currentPointL, u1, 0);
                    addVertex(tempV2_6, u1, 0);
                    addVertex(currentPoint, u1, 0.5);

                    addVertex(currentPoint, u1, 0.5);
                    addVertex(tempV2_6, u1, 0);
                    addVertex(tempV2_7, u1, 0);

                    addVertex(currentPoint, u1, 0.5);
                    addVertex(tempV2_7, u1, 0);
                    addVertex(nextPointL, u1, 0);
                  } else {
                    tempV2_6.subVectors(outerPoint, currentPointR).multiplyScalar(miterFraction).add(currentPointR);
                    tempV2_7.subVectors(outerPoint, nextPointR).multiplyScalar(miterFraction).add(nextPointR);

                    addVertex(currentPointR, u1, 1);
                    addVertex(tempV2_6, u1, 1);
                    addVertex(currentPoint, u1, 0.5);

                    addVertex(currentPoint, u1, 0.5);
                    addVertex(tempV2_6, u1, 1);
                    addVertex(tempV2_7, u1, 1);

                    addVertex(currentPoint, u1, 0.5);
                    addVertex(tempV2_7, u1, 1);
                    addVertex(nextPointR, u1, 1);
                  }
                }
              } else {
                // Miter join segment triangles

                if (innerSideModified) {
                  // Optimized segment + join triangles

                  if (joinIsOnLeftSide) {
                    addVertex(lastPointR, u0, 1);
                    addVertex(lastPointL, u0, 0);
                    addVertex(outerPoint, u1, 0);

                    addVertex(lastPointR, u0, 1);
                    addVertex(outerPoint, u1, 0);
                    addVertex(innerPoint, u1, 1);
                  } else {
                    addVertex(lastPointR, u0, 1);
                    addVertex(lastPointL, u0, 0);
                    addVertex(outerPoint, u1, 1);

                    addVertex(lastPointL, u0, 0);
                    addVertex(innerPoint, u1, 0);
                    addVertex(outerPoint, u1, 1);
                  }

                  if (joinIsOnLeftSide) {
                    nextPointL.copy(outerPoint);
                  } else {
                    nextPointR.copy(outerPoint);
                  }
                } else {
                  // Add extra miter join triangles

                  if (joinIsOnLeftSide) {
                    addVertex(currentPointL, u1, 0);
                    addVertex(outerPoint, u1, 0);
                    addVertex(currentPoint, u1, 0.5);

                    addVertex(currentPoint, u1, 0.5);
                    addVertex(outerPoint, u1, 0);
                    addVertex(nextPointL, u1, 0);
                  } else {
                    addVertex(currentPointR, u1, 1);
                    addVertex(outerPoint, u1, 1);
                    addVertex(currentPoint, u1, 0.5);

                    addVertex(currentPoint, u1, 0.5);
                    addVertex(outerPoint, u1, 1);
                    addVertex(nextPointR, u1, 1);
                  }
                }

                isMiter = true;
              }

              break;
          }
        } else {
          // The segment triangles are generated here when two consecutive points are collinear

          makeSegmentTriangles();
        }
      } else {
        // The segment triangles are generated here if it is the ending segment

        makeSegmentTriangles();
      }

      if (!isClosed && iPoint === numPoints - 1) {
        // Start line endcap
        addCapGeometry(points[0], point0L, point0R, joinIsOnLeftSide, true, u0);
      }

      // Increment loop variables

      u0 = u1;

      previousPoint = currentPoint;

      lastPointL.copy(nextPointL);
      lastPointR.copy(nextPointR);
    }

    if (!isClosed) {
      // Ending line endcap
      addCapGeometry(currentPoint, currentPointL, currentPointR, joinIsOnLeftSide, false, u1);
    } else if (innerSideModified && vertices) {
      // Modify path first segment vertices to adjust to the segments inner and outer intersections

      let lastOuter = outerPoint;
      let lastInner = innerPoint;

      if (initialJoinIsOnLeftSide !== joinIsOnLeftSide) {
        lastOuter = innerPoint;
        lastInner = outerPoint;
      }

      if (joinIsOnLeftSide) {
        if (isMiter || initialJoinIsOnLeftSide) {
          lastInner.toArray(vertices, 0);
          lastInner.toArray(vertices, 3 * 3);

          if (isMiter) {
            lastOuter.toArray(vertices, 1 * 3);
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (isMiter || !initialJoinIsOnLeftSide) {
          lastInner.toArray(vertices, 1 * 3);
          lastInner.toArray(vertices, 3 * 3);

          if (isMiter) {
            lastOuter.toArray(vertices, 0);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Second fix for #25326: Scan for reamining flipped (CW) triangles and collapse them to
    // degenerated ones. This is safe and leaves no "holes" in the stroke because the flipped
    // triangle's area is covered by neighbouring (CCW) triangles.

    if (vertices) {
      const tri = [new Vector2(), new Vector2(), new Vector2()];
      const startFloat = vertexOffset * 3;

      for (let t = startFloat; t < currentCoordinate; t += 9) {
        tri[0].set(vertices[t], vertices[t + 1]);
        tri[1].set(vertices[t + 3], vertices[t + 4]);
        tri[2].set(vertices[t + 6], vertices[t + 7]);

        if (ShapeUtils.area(tri) < 0) {
          vertices[t + 3] = tri[0].x;
          vertices[t + 4] = tri[0].y;
        }
      }
    }

    return numVertices;

    // -- End of algorithm

    // -- Functions

    function getNormal(p1: Vector2, p2: Vector2, result: Vector2) {
      result.subVectors(p2, p1);
      return result.set(-result.y, result.x).normalize();
    }

    function addVertex(position: Vector2, u: number, v: number) {
      if (vertices) {
        vertices[currentCoordinate] = position.x;
        vertices[currentCoordinate + 1] = position.y;
        vertices[currentCoordinate + 2] = 0;

        if (normals) {
          normals[currentCoordinate] = 0;
          normals[currentCoordinate + 1] = 0;
          normals[currentCoordinate + 2] = 1;
        }

        currentCoordinate += 3;

        if (uvs) {
          uvs[currentCoordinateUV] = u;
          uvs[currentCoordinateUV + 1] = v;

          currentCoordinateUV += 2;
        }
      }

      numVertices += 3;
    }

    function makeCircularSector(center: Vector2, p1: Vector2, p2: Vector2, u: number, v: number) {
      // param p1, p2: Points in the circle arc.
      // p1 and p2 are in clockwise direction.

      tempV2_1.copy(p1).sub(center).normalize();
      tempV2_2.copy(p2).sub(center).normalize();

      let angle = Math.PI;
      const dot = tempV2_1.dot(tempV2_2);
      if (Math.abs(dot) < 1) angle = Math.abs(Math.acos(dot));

      angle /= arcDivisions;

      tempV2_3.copy(p1);

      for (let i = 0, il = arcDivisions - 1; i < il; i++) {
        tempV2_4.copy(tempV2_3).rotateAround(center, angle);

        addVertex(tempV2_3, u, v);
        addVertex(tempV2_4, u, v);
        addVertex(center, u, 0.5);

        tempV2_3.copy(tempV2_4);
      }

      addVertex(tempV2_3, u, v);
      addVertex(p2, u, v);
      addVertex(center, u, 0.5);
    }

    function makeSegmentTriangles() {
      addVertex(lastPointR, u0, 1);
      addVertex(lastPointL, u0, 0);
      addVertex(currentPointL, u1, 0);

      addVertex(lastPointR, u0, 1);
      addVertex(currentPointL, u1, 0);
      addVertex(currentPointR, u1, 1);
    }

    function makeSegmentWithBevelJoin(joinIsOnLeftSide: boolean, innerSideModified: boolean, u: number) {
      if (innerSideModified) {
        // Optimized segment + bevel triangles

        if (joinIsOnLeftSide) {
          // Path segments triangles

          addVertex(lastPointR, u0, 1);
          addVertex(lastPointL, u0, 0);
          addVertex(currentPointL, u1, 0);

          addVertex(lastPointR, u0, 1);
          addVertex(currentPointL, u1, 0);
          addVertex(innerPoint, u1, 1);

          // Bevel join triangle

          addVertex(currentPointL, u, 0);
          addVertex(nextPointL, u, 0);
          addVertex(innerPoint, u, 0.5);
        } else {
          // Path segments triangles

          addVertex(lastPointR, u0, 1);
          addVertex(lastPointL, u0, 0);
          addVertex(currentPointR, u1, 1);

          addVertex(lastPointL, u0, 0);
          addVertex(innerPoint, u1, 0);
          addVertex(currentPointR, u1, 1);

          // Bevel join triangle

          addVertex(currentPointR, u, 1);
          addVertex(innerPoint, u, 0);
          addVertex(nextPointR, u, 1);
        }
      } else {
        // Bevel join triangle. The segment triangles are done in the main loop

        if (joinIsOnLeftSide) {
          addVertex(currentPointL, u, 0);
          addVertex(nextPointL, u, 0);
          addVertex(currentPoint, u, 0.5);
        } else {
          addVertex(currentPointR, u, 1);
          addVertex(nextPointR, u, 0);
          addVertex(currentPoint, u, 0.5);
        }
      }
    }

    function createSegmentTrianglesWithMiddleSection(joinIsOnLeftSide: boolean, innerSideModified: boolean) {
      if (innerSideModified) {
        if (joinIsOnLeftSide) {
          addVertex(lastPointR, u0, 1);
          addVertex(lastPointL, u0, 0);
          addVertex(currentPointL, u1, 0);

          addVertex(lastPointR, u0, 1);
          addVertex(currentPointL, u1, 0);
          addVertex(innerPoint, u1, 1);

          addVertex(currentPointL, u0, 0);
          addVertex(currentPoint, u1, 0.5);
          addVertex(innerPoint, u1, 1);

          addVertex(currentPoint, u1, 0.5);
          addVertex(nextPointL, u0, 0);
          addVertex(innerPoint, u1, 1);
        } else {
          addVertex(lastPointR, u0, 1);
          addVertex(lastPointL, u0, 0);
          addVertex(currentPointR, u1, 1);

          addVertex(lastPointL, u0, 0);
          addVertex(innerPoint, u1, 0);
          addVertex(currentPointR, u1, 1);

          addVertex(currentPointR, u0, 1);
          addVertex(innerPoint, u1, 0);
          addVertex(currentPoint, u1, 0.5);

          addVertex(currentPoint, u1, 0.5);
          addVertex(innerPoint, u1, 0);
          addVertex(nextPointR, u0, 1);
        }
      }
    }

    function addCapGeometry(
      center: Vector2,
      p1: Vector2,
      p2: Vector2,
      joinIsOnLeftSide: boolean,
      start: boolean,
      u: number,
    ) {
      // param center: End point of the path
      // param p1, p2: Left and right cap points

      switch (style.strokeLineCap) {
        case "round":
          if (start) {
            makeCircularSector(center, p2, p1, u, 0.5);
          } else {
            makeCircularSector(center, p1, p2, u, 0.5);
          }

          break;

        case "square":
          if (start) {
            tempV2_1.subVectors(p1, center);
            tempV2_2.set(tempV2_1.y, -tempV2_1.x);

            tempV2_3.addVectors(tempV2_1, tempV2_2).add(center);
            tempV2_4.subVectors(tempV2_2, tempV2_1).add(center);

            // Modify already existing vertices
            if (joinIsOnLeftSide) {
              tempV2_3.toArray(vertices, 1 * 3);
              tempV2_4.toArray(vertices, 0);
              tempV2_4.toArray(vertices, 3 * 3);
            } else {
              tempV2_3.toArray(vertices, 1 * 3);
              // using tempV2_4 to update 3rd vertex if the uv.y of 3rd vertex is 1
              if (uvs[3 * 2 + 1] === 1) tempV2_4.toArray(vertices, 3 * 3);
              else tempV2_3.toArray(vertices, 3 * 3);
              tempV2_4.toArray(vertices, 0);
            }
          } else {
            tempV2_1.subVectors(p2, center);
            tempV2_2.set(tempV2_1.y, -tempV2_1.x);

            tempV2_3.addVectors(tempV2_1, tempV2_2).add(center);
            tempV2_4.subVectors(tempV2_2, tempV2_1).add(center);

            const vl = vertices.length;

            // Modify already existing vertices
            if (joinIsOnLeftSide) {
              tempV2_3.toArray(vertices, vl - 1 * 3);
              tempV2_4.toArray(vertices, vl - 2 * 3);
              tempV2_4.toArray(vertices, vl - 4 * 3);
            } else {
              tempV2_4.toArray(vertices, vl - 2 * 3);
              tempV2_3.toArray(vertices, vl - 1 * 3);
              tempV2_4.toArray(vertices, vl - 4 * 3);
            }
          }

          break;

        case "butt":
        default:
          // Nothing to do here
          break;
      }
    }

    function removeDuplicatedPoints(points: Vector2[]) {
      // Creates a new array if necessary with duplicated points removed.
      // This does not remove duplicated initial and ending points of a closed path.

      let dupPoints = false;
      for (let i = 1, n = points.length - 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (points[i].distanceTo(points[i + 1]) < minDistance) {
          dupPoints = true;
          break;
        }
      }

      if (!dupPoints) return points;

      const newPoints = [];
      newPoints.push(points[0]);

      for (let i = 1, n = points.length - 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (points[i].distanceTo(points[i + 1]) >= minDistance) {
          newPoints.push(points[i]);
        }
      }

      newPoints.push(points[points.length - 1]);

      return newPoints;
    }
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/utils/SceneOptimizer

```typescript
import { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import type { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import type { Material } from "../../materials/Material";
import { ShaderMaterial } from "../../materials/ShaderMaterial";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Matrix4 } from "../../math/Matrix4";
import { BatchedMesh } from "../../objects/BatchedMesh";
import { Group } from "../../objects/Group";
import { InstancedMesh } from "../../objects/InstancedMesh";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import { SkinnedMesh } from "../../objects/SkinnedMesh";
import type { Scene } from "../../scenes/Scene";
import { Texture } from "../../textures/Texture";

export interface SceneOptimizerOptions {
  debug?: boolean;
}
type ColorMaterial = Material & { color: Color };
interface BatchGroup {
  meshes: Mesh<ColorMaterial>[];
  geometryStats: Map<BufferGeometry, { vertices: number; indices: number; geometry: BufferGeometry }>;
  totalInstances: number;
  materialProps: ColorMaterial;
}
interface OptimizationStats {
  originalMeshes: number;
  batchedMeshes: number;
  singleMeshes: number;
  drawCalls: number;
  uniqueGeometries: number;
  reductionRatio: string;
}

/** Experimental destructive batching of compatible static meshes. Source geometries and materials are disposed. */
export class SceneOptimizer {
  scene: Scene;
  debug: boolean;

  constructor(scene: Scene, options: SceneOptimizerOptions = {}) {
    this.scene = scene;
    this.debug = options.debug || false;
  }

  _bufferToHash(buffer: ArrayBuffer | ArrayBufferView): number {
    const bytes = ArrayBuffer.isView(buffer)
      ? new Uint8Array(buffer.buffer, buffer.byteOffset, buffer.byteLength)
      : new Uint8Array(buffer);
    let hash = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) hash = ((hash << 5) - hash + bytes[i]) | 0;
    return hash;
  }

  _getMaterialPropertiesHash(material: Material): string {
    const properties = material as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
    const maps = [
      "map",
      "alphaMap",
      "aoMap",
      "bumpMap",
      "displacementMap",
      "emissiveMap",
      "envMap",
      "lightMap",
      "metalnessMap",
      "normalMap",
      "roughnessMap",
    ]
      .map((name) => {
        const map = properties[name];
        return map instanceof Texture
          ? `${map.uuid}_${map.offset.x}_${map.offset.y}_${map.repeat.x}_${map.repeat.y}_${map.rotation}`
          : 0;
      })
      .join("|");
    const physical = [
      "transparent",
      "opacity",
      "alphaTest",
      "alphaToCoverage",
      "side",
      "vertexColors",
      "visible",
      "blending",
      "wireframe",
      "flatShading",
      "premultipliedAlpha",
      "dithering",
      "toneMapped",
      "depthTest",
      "depthWrite",
      "metalness",
      "roughness",
      "clearcoat",
      "clearcoatRoughness",
      "sheen",
      "sheenRoughness",
      "transmission",
      "thickness",
      "attenuationDistance",
      "ior",
      "iridescence",
      "iridescenceIOR",
      "iridescenceThicknessMinimum",
      "iridescenceThicknessMaximum",
      "reflectivity",
    ]
      .map((name) => properties[name]?.toString() ?? 0)
      .join("|");
    const colors = ["emissive", "attenuationColor", "sheenColor"].map((name) => {
      const color = properties[name];
      return color instanceof Color ? color.getHexString() : 0;
    });
    return [material.type, physical, maps, ...colors].join("_");
  }

  _getAttributesSignature(geometry: BufferGeometry): string {
    return Object.keys(geometry.attributes)
      .sort()
      .map((name) => {
        const attribute = geometry.attributes[name];
        const storage =
          attribute instanceof BufferAttribute ? attribute.array.constructor.name : attribute.constructor.name;
        return `${name}_${attribute.itemSize}_${attribute.normalized}_${storage}_${geometry.index !== null}`;
      })
      .join("|");
  }

  _getGeometryHash(geometry: BufferGeometry): string {
    const index = geometry.index ? this._bufferToHash(geometry.index.array) : "noIndex";
    const position = geometry.attributes.position;
    if (!("array" in position)) throw new Error("SceneOptimizer: geometry needs CPU position data");
    return `${index}_${this._bufferToHash(position.array)}_${this._getAttributesSignature(geometry)}`;
  }

  _getBatchKey(materialProps: string, attributesSignature: string): string {
    return `${materialProps}_${attributesSignature}`;
  }

  _analyzeModel(): {
    batchGroups: Map<string, BatchGroup>;
    singleGroups: Map<string, BatchGroup>;
    uniqueGeometries: number;
  } {
    const batchGroups = new Map<string, BatchGroup>();
    const singleGroups = new Map<string, BatchGroup>();
    const uniqueGeometries = new Set<BufferGeometry>();
    this.scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);
    this.scene.traverse((node) => {
      // Batching cannot preserve skinning, morph animation, instance transforms or child attachments.
      if (
        !(node instanceof Mesh) ||
        node instanceof SkinnedMesh ||
        node instanceof InstancedMesh ||
        node instanceof BatchedMesh ||
        Array.isArray(node.material) ||
        node.children.length ||
        node.morphTargetInfluences ||
        !node.visible ||
        Object.values(node.geometry.attributes).some((attribute) => !(attribute instanceof BufferAttribute))
      )
        return;
      const material = node.material;
      if (!("color" in material) || !(material.color instanceof Color) || material instanceof ShaderMaterial) return;
      const key = this._getBatchKey(
        this._getMaterialPropertiesHash(material),
        this._getAttributesSignature(node.geometry),
      );
      // Keep render state and visibility inherited from parents distinct.
      const batchKey = `${key}_${node.parent?.uuid}_${node.castShadow}_${node.receiveShadow}_${node.renderOrder}_${node.layers.mask}_${node.frustumCulled}`;
      uniqueGeometries.add(node.geometry);
      let group = batchGroups.get(batchKey);
      if (!group) {
        group = { meshes: [], geometryStats: new Map(), totalInstances: 0, materialProps: material as ColorMaterial };
        batchGroups.set(batchKey, group);
      }
      group.meshes.push(node as Mesh<ColorMaterial>);
      group.totalInstances++;
      if (!group.geometryStats.has(node.geometry))
        group.geometryStats.set(node.geometry, {
          vertices: node.geometry.attributes.position.count,
          indices: node.geometry.index?.count ?? 0,
          geometry: node.geometry,
        });
    });
    for (const [key, group] of batchGroups) {
      if (group.totalInstances === 1) {
        singleGroups.set(key, group);
        batchGroups.delete(key);
      }
    }
    return { batchGroups, singleGroups, uniqueGeometries: uniqueGeometries.size };
  }

  _createBatchedMeshes(batchGroups: Map<string, BatchGroup>): Set<Mesh> {
    const meshesToRemove = new Set<Mesh>();
    const localMatrix = new Matrix4();
    for (const group of batchGroups.values()) {
      let vertices = 0,
        indices = 0;
      for (const stats of group.geometryStats.values()) {
        vertices += stats.vertices;
        indices += stats.indices;
      }
      const material = group.materialProps.clone();
      material.color.setRGB(1, 1, 1);
      const batchedMesh = new BatchedMesh(group.totalInstances, vertices, indices, material);
      const reference = group.meshes[0];
      batchedMesh.name = `${reference.name}_batch`;
      batchedMesh.castShadow = reference.castShadow;
      batchedMesh.receiveShadow = reference.receiveShadow;
      batchedMesh.renderOrder = reference.renderOrder;
      batchedMesh.layers.mask = reference.layers.mask;
      batchedMesh.frustumCulled = reference.frustumCulled;
      const inverseParentMatrix = new Matrix4();
      if (reference.parent) inverseParentMatrix.copy(reference.parent.matrixWorld).invert();
      const geometryIds = new Map<BufferGeometry, number>();
      for (const mesh of group.meshes) {
        let geometryId = geometryIds.get(mesh.geometry);
        if (geometryId === undefined) {
          geometryId = batchedMesh.addGeometry(mesh.geometry);
          geometryIds.set(mesh.geometry, geometryId);
        }
        const instanceId = batchedMesh.addInstance(geometryId);
        localMatrix.copy(mesh.matrixWorld).premultiply(inverseParentMatrix);
        batchedMesh.setMatrixAt(instanceId, localMatrix);
        batchedMesh.setColorAt(instanceId, mesh.material.color);
        meshesToRemove.add(mesh);
      }
      reference.parent?.add(batchedMesh);
    }
    return meshesToRemove;
  }

  removeEmptyNodes(object: Object3D): void {
    for (let i = 0; i < object.children.length;) {
      const child = object.children[i];
      this.removeEmptyNodes(child);
      if ((child instanceof Group || child.constructor === Object3D) && child.children.length === 0) {
        object.remove(child);
      } else {
        i++;
      }
    }
  }

  /** Removes meshes and disposes source resources not used by surviving meshes. */
  disposeMeshes(meshesToRemove: Set<Mesh>): void {
    const retained = new Set<BufferGeometry | Material>();
    this.scene.traverse((node) => {
      if (!(node instanceof Mesh) || meshesToRemove.has(node)) return;
      retained.add(node.geometry);
      for (const material of Array.isArray(node.material) ? node.material : [node.material]) retained.add(material);
    });
    const disposed = new Set<BufferGeometry | Material>();
    for (const mesh of meshesToRemove) {
      mesh.removeFromParent();
      const resources = [mesh.geometry, ...(Array.isArray(mesh.material) ? mesh.material : [mesh.material])];
      for (const resource of resources) {
        if (!retained.has(resource) && !disposed.has(resource)) {
          resource.dispose();
          disposed.add(resource);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  _logDebugInfo(stats: OptimizationStats): void {
    console.group("Scene Optimization Results");
    console.log(`Original meshes: ${stats.originalMeshes}`);
    console.log(`Batched into: ${stats.batchedMeshes} BatchedMesh`);
    console.log(`Single meshes: ${stats.singleMeshes} Mesh`);
    console.log(`Total draw calls: ${stats.drawCalls}`);
    console.log(`Reduction Ratio: ${stats.reductionRatio}% fewer draw calls`);
    console.groupEnd();
  }

  /** Replaces compatible meshes with batches and returns the modified scene. */
  toBatchedMesh(): Scene {
    const { batchGroups, singleGroups, uniqueGeometries } = this._analyzeModel();
    const meshesToRemove = this._createBatchedMeshes(batchGroups);
    this.disposeMeshes(meshesToRemove);
    this.removeEmptyNodes(this.scene);
    if (this.debug) {
      const originalMeshes = meshesToRemove.size + singleGroups.size;
      const drawCalls = batchGroups.size + singleGroups.size;
      this._logDebugInfo({
        originalMeshes,
        batchedMeshes: batchGroups.size,
        singleMeshes: singleGroups.size,
        drawCalls,
        uniqueGeometries,
        reductionRatio: (originalMeshes ? (1 - drawCalls / originalMeshes) * 100 : 0).toFixed(1),
      });
    }
    return this.scene;
  }

  /** InstancedMesh optimization is unsupported, as in the pinned upstream implementation. */
  toInstancingMesh(): never {
    throw new Error("SceneOptimizer: InstancedMesh optimization not implemented yet");
  }
}
```

## ek3d/addons/utils/SceneUtils

```typescript
import { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import type { InterleavedBufferAttribute } from "../../core/InterleavedBufferAttribute";
import { InstancedBufferAttribute } from "../../core/InstancedBufferAttribute";
import type { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import type { Material } from "../../materials/Material";
import { Color } from "../../math/Color";
import { Matrix4 } from "../../math/Matrix4";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import { Group } from "../../objects/Group";
import { InstancedMesh } from "../../objects/InstancedMesh";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import { SkinnedMesh } from "../../objects/SkinnedMesh";
import { deepCloneAttribute, mergeGroups } from "./BufferGeometryUtils";

const matrix = new Matrix4();
const color = new Color();

export function createMeshesFromInstancedMesh(instancedMesh: InstancedMesh): Group {
  const group = new Group();
  for (let i = 0; i < instancedMesh.count; i++) {
    const mesh = new Mesh(instancedMesh.geometry, instancedMesh.material);
    instancedMesh.getMatrixAt(i, mesh.matrix);
    mesh.matrix.decompose(mesh.position, mesh.quaternion, mesh.scale);
    group.add(mesh);
  }
  group.copy(instancedMesh);
  group.updateMatrixWorld();
  return group;
}

export function createMeshesFromMultiMaterialMesh(mesh: Mesh): Group | Mesh {
  if (!Array.isArray(mesh.material)) {
    console.warn("THREE.SceneUtils.createMeshesFromMultiMaterialMesh(): The given mesh has no multiple materials.");
    return mesh;
  }
  const object = new Group();
  object.copy(mesh);
  const geometry = mergeGroups(mesh.geometry);
  const index = geometry.index!;
  for (const group of geometry.groups) {
    const result = new BufferGeometry();
    for (const name of Object.keys(geometry.attributes)) {
      const attribute = geometry.attributes[name] as BufferAttribute | InterleavedBufferAttribute;
      const ArrayType = attribute.array.constructor as new (length: number) => BufferAttribute["array"];
      const output = new BufferAttribute(
        new ArrayType(group.count * attribute.itemSize),
        attribute.itemSize,
        attribute.normalized,
      );
      for (let k = group.start, n = 0; k < group.start + group.count; k++, n++) {
        const source = index.getX(k);
        if (attribute.itemSize >= 1) output.setX(n, attribute.getX(source));
        if (attribute.itemSize >= 2) output.setY(n, attribute.getY(source));
        if (attribute.itemSize >= 3) output.setZ(n, attribute.getZ(source));
        if (attribute.itemSize >= 4) output.setW(n, attribute.getW(source));
      }
      result.setAttribute(name, output);
    }
    object.add(new Mesh(result, mesh.material[group.materialIndex]));
  }
  return object;
}

export function createMultiMaterialObject(geometry: BufferGeometry, materials: Material[]): Group {
  const group = new Group();
  for (const material of materials) group.add(new Mesh(geometry, material));
  return group;
}

export function reduceVertices<T>(object: Object3D, func: (value: T, vertex: Vector3) => T, initialValue: T): T {
  let value = initialValue;
  const vertex = new Vector3();
  object.updateWorldMatrix(true, true);
  object.traverseVisible((child) => {
    const geometry = (child as Object3D & { geometry?: BufferGeometry }).geometry;
    const position = geometry?.attributes.position as BufferAttribute | InterleavedBufferAttribute | undefined;
    if (!position) return;
    for (let i = 0; i < position.count; i++) {
      if (child instanceof Mesh) child.getVertexPosition(i, vertex);
      else vertex.fromBufferAttribute(position, i);
      if (!(child instanceof SkinnedMesh)) vertex.applyMatrix4(child.matrixWorld);
      value = func(value, vertex);
    }
  });
  return value;
}

export function sortInstancedMesh(mesh: InstancedMesh, compareFn: (a: number, b: number) => number): void {
  const matrices = deepCloneAttribute(mesh.instanceMatrix);
  const colors = mesh.instanceColor ? deepCloneAttribute(mesh.instanceColor) : null;
  const attributes = new Map<InstancedBufferAttribute, BufferAttribute>();
  for (const attribute of Object.values(mesh.geometry.attributes)) {
    if (attribute instanceof InstancedBufferAttribute) attributes.set(attribute, deepCloneAttribute(attribute));
  }
  const tokens = Array.from({ length: mesh.count }, (_, i) => i).sort(compareFn);
  for (let i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
    const source = tokens[i];
    matrix.fromArray(matrices.array, source * mesh.instanceMatrix.itemSize);
    matrix.toArray(mesh.instanceMatrix.array, i * mesh.instanceMatrix.itemSize);
    if (mesh.instanceColor && colors) {
      color.fromArray(colors.array, source * mesh.instanceColor.itemSize);
      color.toArray(mesh.instanceColor.array, i * mesh.instanceColor.itemSize);
    }
    for (const [attribute, copy] of attributes) {
      attribute.setX(i, copy.getX(source));
      if (attribute.itemSize > 1) attribute.setY(i, copy.getY(source));
      if (attribute.itemSize > 2) attribute.setZ(i, copy.getZ(source));
      if (attribute.itemSize > 3) attribute.setW(i, copy.getW(source));
    }
  }
}

export function* traverseGenerator(object: Object3D): Generator<Object3D> {
  yield object;
  for (const child of object.children) yield* traverseGenerator(child);
}

export function* traverseVisibleGenerator(object: Object3D): Generator<Object3D> {
  if (!object.visible) return;
  yield object;
  for (const child of object.children) yield* traverseVisibleGenerator(child);
}

export function* traverseAncestorsGenerator(object: Object3D): Generator<Object3D> {
  if (object.parent !== null) {
    yield object.parent;
    yield* traverseAncestorsGenerator(object.parent);
  }
}

## ek3d/addons/utils/ShadowMapViewer

```typescript
import { OrthographicCamera } from "../../cameras/OrthographicCamera";
import { Side } from "../../constants";
import { PlaneGeometry } from "../../geometries/PlaneGeometry";
import { MeshBasicMaterial } from "../../materials/MeshBasicMaterial";
import { ShaderMaterial } from "../../materials/ShaderMaterial";
import { Mesh } from "../../objects/Mesh";
import { Scene } from "../../scenes/Scene";
import { CanvasTexture } from "../../textures/CanvasTexture";
import type { DirectionalLight } from "../../lights/DirectionalLight";
import type { SpotLight } from "../../lights/SpotLight";
import type { WebGLRenderer } from "../../renderers/WebGLRenderer";

/** Displays a directional or spot light's shadow map as an overlay. */
export class ShadowMapViewer {
  enabled: boolean = true;
  size: { width: number; height: number; set(width: number, height: number): void };
  position: { x: number; y: number; set(x: number, y: number): void };
  private camera: OrthographicCamera;
  private scene: Scene;
  private mesh: Mesh<ShaderMaterial>;
  private label: Mesh<MeshBasicMaterial> | null = null;
  private light: DirectionalLight | SpotLight;

  constructor(light: DirectionalLight | SpotLight) {
    this.light = light;
    this.camera = new OrthographicCamera(
      -window.innerWidth / 2,
      window.innerWidth / 2,
      window.innerHeight / 2,
      -window.innerHeight / 2,
      1,
      10,
    );
    this.camera.position.z = 2;
    this.scene = new Scene();
    this.mesh = new Mesh<ShaderMaterial>(
      new PlaneGeometry(256, 256),
      new ShaderMaterial({
        uniforms: { tDiffuse: { value: null }, opacity: { value: 1 } },
        vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv;
void main() { vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); }`,
        fragmentShader: `uniform float opacity;
uniform sampler2D tDiffuse;
varying vec2 vUv;
void main() {
  float depth = texture2D(tDiffuse, vUv).r;
#ifdef USE_REVERSED_DEPTH_BUFFER
  gl_FragColor = vec4(vec3(depth), opacity);
#else
  gl_FragColor = vec4(vec3(1.0 - depth), opacity);
#endif
}`,
      }),
    );
    this.scene.add(this.mesh);
    if (light.name) {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      if (!context) throw new Error("Unable to create shadow map label canvas");
      context.font = "Bold 20px Arial";
      canvas.width = context.measureText(light.name).width;
      canvas.height = 25;
      context.font = "Bold 20px Arial";
      context.fillStyle = "rgba( 255, 0, 0, 1 )";
      context.fillText(light.name, 0, 20);
      this.label = new Mesh<MeshBasicMaterial>(
        new PlaneGeometry(canvas.width, canvas.height),
        new MeshBasicMaterial({ map: new CanvasTexture(canvas), side: Side.Double, transparent: true }),
      );
      this.scene.add(this.label);
    }
    this.position = {
      x: 10,
      y: 10,
      set: (x, y) => {
        this.position.x = x;
        this.position.y = y;
        this.mesh.position.set(
          -window.innerWidth / 2 + this.size.width / 2 + x,
          window.innerHeight / 2 - this.size.height / 2 - y,
          0,
        );
        if (this.label)
          this.label.position.set(this.mesh.position.x, this.mesh.position.y - this.size.height / 2 + 12.5, 0);
      },
    };
    this.size = {
      width: 256,
      height: 256,
      set: (width, height) => {
        this.size.width = width;
        this.size.height = height;
        this.mesh.scale.set(width / 256, height / 256, 1);
        this.position.set(this.position.x, this.position.y);
      },
    };
    this.update();
  }

  render(renderer: WebGLRenderer): void {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    this.mesh.material.uniforms.tDiffuse.value = this.light.shadow.map!.texture;
    const autoClear = renderer.autoClear;
    renderer.autoClear = false;
    try {
      renderer.clearDepth();
      renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
    } finally {
      renderer.autoClear = autoClear;
    }
  }

  updateForWindowResize(): void {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    this.camera.left = -window.innerWidth / 2;
    this.camera.right = window.innerWidth / 2;
    this.camera.top = window.innerHeight / 2;
    this.camera.bottom = -window.innerHeight / 2;
    this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    this.update();
  }

  update(): void {
    this.position.set(this.position.x, this.position.y);
    this.size.set(this.size.width, this.size.height);
  }

  dispose(): void {
    this.mesh.geometry.dispose();
    this.mesh.material.dispose();
    if (this.label) {
      this.label.geometry.dispose();
      this.label.material.map?.dispose();
      this.label.material.dispose();
    }
  }
}

## ek3d/addons/utils/SimplifyGeometryLOD

```typescript
import { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import type { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";

// Adapted from @three.ez/simplify-geometry 0.0.1, MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 Andrea Gargaro.

export type SimplifyFlag = "LockBorder" | "Sparse" | "ErrorAbsolute" | "Prune";
export interface MeshoptSimplifierRuntime {
  ready: Promise<void>;
  simplify(
    indices: Uint32Array,
    positions: Float32Array,
    stride: number,
    targetCount: number,
    error: number,
    flags?: SimplifyFlag[],
  ): [Uint32Array, number];
}
export interface SimplifyParams {
  ratio: number;
  error?: number;
  lockBorder?: boolean;
  sparse?: boolean;
  errorAbsolute?: boolean;
  prune?: boolean;
  logAppearanceError?: boolean;
  optimizeMemory?: boolean;
}
export const performanceRangeLOD: number[] = [0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1];
export const balancedRangeLOD: number[] = [0.007, 0.015, 0.04, 0.08];
export const qualityRangeLOD: number[] = [0.004, 0.01, 0.035, 0.07];

export async function simplifyGeometry(
  geometry: BufferGeometry,
  params: SimplifyParams,
  runtime: MeshoptSimplifierRuntime,
): Promise<BufferGeometry> {
  if (!geometry.index) throw new Error("simplifyGeometry: non-indexed geometries are not currently supported.");
  if (geometry.groups.length > 0) throw new Error("simplifyGeometry: geometry groups are not currently supported.");
  const position = geometry.attributes.position;
  if (!(position instanceof BufferAttribute) || !(position.array instanceof Float32Array))
    throw new Error("simplifyGeometry: positions must be a Float32 buffer attribute.");
  await runtime.ready;
  const flags: SimplifyFlag[] = [];
  if (params.lockBorder) flags.push("LockBorder");
  if (params.sparse) flags.push("Sparse");
  if (params.errorAbsolute) flags.push("ErrorAbsolute");
  if (params.prune) flags.push("Prune");
  const source = geometry.index.array;
  const indices = source instanceof Uint32Array ? source : new Uint32Array(source);
  const [result, error] = runtime.simplify(
    indices,
    position.array,
    3,
    3 * Math.floor(params.ratio * (indices.length / 3)),
    params.error ?? 1,
    flags,
  );
  if (result.length === indices.length) console.error("Simplify: simplification failed");
  if (params.logAppearanceError) console.log(`Simplify: appearance error: ${error}`);
  let output: Uint32Array | Uint16Array | Uint8Array = result;
  const vertices = position.array.length / 3;
  if (params.optimizeMemory && vertices <= 65535)
    output = vertices <= 255 ? new Uint8Array(result) : new Uint16Array(result);
  const clone = geometry.clone();
  clone.index = new BufferAttribute(output, 1);
  return clone;
}

export async function simplifyGeometriesByErrorLOD(
  geometries: BufferGeometry[],
  count: number,
  range: number[],
  runtime: MeshoptSimplifierRuntime,
): Promise<BufferGeometry[][]> {
  const result: BufferGeometry[][] = [];
  for (const geometry of geometries) {
    const levels = [geometry];
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++)
      levels.push(await simplifyGeometry(geometry, { ratio: 0, error: range[i] }, runtime));
    result.push(levels);
  }
  return result;
}

## ek3d/addons/utils/SkeletonUtils

```typescript
import { AnimationClip } from "../../animation/AnimationClip";
import { AnimationMixer } from "../../animation/AnimationMixer";
import { Matrix4 } from "../../math/Matrix4";
import { Quaternion } from "../../math/Quaternion";
import { QuaternionKeyframeTrack } from "../../animation/tracks/QuaternionKeyframeTrack";
import { VectorKeyframeTrack } from "../../animation/tracks/VectorKeyframeTrack";
import type { KeyframeTrack } from "../../animation/KeyframeTrack";
import { Vector3 } from "../../math/Vector3";
import { SkeletonHelper } from "../../helpers/SkeletonHelper";
import type { Skeleton } from "../../objects/Skeleton";
import type { Object3D } from "../../core/Object3D";
import type { SkinnedMesh } from "../../objects/SkinnedMesh";
import type { Bone } from "../../objects/Bone";
import type { NumericAnimationBuffer } from "../../math/Interpolant";

/**
 * @module SkeletonUtils
 */

/** An object holding a skeleton, i.e. a skinned mesh or SkeletonHelper. */
type SkeletonHolder = { skeleton: Skeleton; isObject3D: true };

type BoneData = {
  bone: Bone;
  pos?: { times: NumericAnimationBuffer; values: NumericAnimationBuffer };
  quat?: { times: NumericAnimationBuffer; values: NumericAnimationBuffer };
};

/** Retarget options of `SkeletonUtils`. */
export interface RetargetOptions {
  /** Whether to use the position of the first frame or not. */
  useFirstFramePosition?: boolean;
  /** The FPS of the clip. */
  fps?: number;
  /** A dictionary for mapping target to source bone names. */
  names?: Record<string, string>;
  /** A function for mapping bone names. Alternative to `names`. */
  getBoneName?(bone: Bone): string;
  /** Whether to trim the clip or not. If set the array should hold two values for the start and end. */
  trim?: number[];
  /** Whether to preserve bone matrices or not. */
  preserveBoneMatrix?: boolean;
  /** Whether to preserve bone positions or not. */
  preserveBonePositions?: boolean;
  /** Whether to use the target matrix or not. */
  useTargetMatrix?: boolean;
  /** The name of the source's hip bone. */
  hip?: string;
  /** The hip influence. */
  hipInfluence?: Vector3;
  /** The scale. */
  scale?: number;
  /** Per-bone local offset matrices, keyed by bone name. */
  localOffsets?: Record<string, Matrix4>;
  /** An additional position offset applied to the hip bone. */
  hipPosition?: Vector3;
}

type RetargetTarget = Object3D | Skeleton;

function getBoneName(bone: Bone, options: RetargetOptions): string | undefined {
  if (options.getBoneName !== undefined) {
    return options.getBoneName(bone);
  }

  return options.names![bone.name];
}

/**
 * Retargets the skeleton from the given source to the target.
 *
 * Both `target` and `source` can be a 3D object with a skeleton property (e.g. a skinned mesh)
 * or a {@link Skeleton} directly.
 *
 * @param target - The target object.
 * @param source - The source object.
 * @param options - The options.
 */
export function retarget(target: RetargetTarget, source: RetargetTarget, options: RetargetOptions = {}): void {
  const quat = new Quaternion(),
    scale = new Vector3(),
    relativeMatrix = new Matrix4(),
    globalMatrix = new Matrix4();

  options.preserveBoneMatrix = options.preserveBoneMatrix !== undefined ? options.preserveBoneMatrix : true;
  options.preserveBonePositions = options.preserveBonePositions !== undefined ? options.preserveBonePositions : true;
  options.useTargetMatrix = options.useTargetMatrix !== undefined ? options.useTargetMatrix : false;
  options.hip = options.hip !== undefined ? options.hip : "hip";
  options.hipInfluence = options.hipInfluence !== undefined ? options.hipInfluence : new Vector3(1, 1, 1);
  options.scale = options.scale !== undefined ? options.scale : 1;
  options.names = options.names || {};

  const sourceObject = source as Object3D & { skeleton?: Skeleton };
  const targetObject = target as Object3D & { skeleton?: Skeleton };
  const sourceBones = sourceObject.isObject3D ? sourceObject.skeleton!.bones : getBones(source as Skeleton),
    bones = targetObject.isObject3D ? targetObject.skeleton!.bones : getBones(target as Skeleton);

  let bone: Bone, name: string | undefined, boneTo: Bone | undefined, bonesPosition: Vector3[] | undefined;

  // reset bones

  if (targetObject.isObject3D) {
    targetObject.skeleton!.pose();
  } else {
    options.useTargetMatrix = true;
    options.preserveBoneMatrix = false;
  }

  if (options.preserveBonePositions) {
    bonesPosition = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < bones.length; i++) {
      bonesPosition.push(bones[i].position.clone());
    }
  }

  if (options.preserveBoneMatrix) {
    // reset matrix

    (target as Object3D).updateMatrixWorld();

    (target as Object3D).matrixWorld.identity();

    // reset children matrix

    for (let i = 0; i < (target as Object3D).children.length; ++i) {
      (target as Object3D).children[i].updateMatrixWorld(true);
    }
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < bones.length; ++i) {
    bone = bones[i];
    name = getBoneName(bone, options);

    boneTo = getBoneByName(name!, sourceBones);

    globalMatrix.copy(bone.matrixWorld);

    if (boneTo) {
      boneTo.updateMatrixWorld();

      if (options.useTargetMatrix) {
        relativeMatrix.copy(boneTo.matrixWorld);
      } else {
        relativeMatrix.copy((target as Object3D).matrixWorld).invert();
        relativeMatrix.multiply(boneTo.matrixWorld);
      }

      // ignore scale to extract rotation

      scale.setFromMatrixScale(relativeMatrix);
      relativeMatrix.scale(scale.set(1 / scale.x, 1 / scale.y, 1 / scale.z));

      // apply to global matrix

      globalMatrix.makeRotationFromQuaternion(quat.setFromRotationMatrix(relativeMatrix));

      if (targetObject.isObject3D) {
        if (options.localOffsets) {
          if (options.localOffsets[bone.name]) {
            globalMatrix.multiply(options.localOffsets[bone.name]);
          }
        }
      }

      globalMatrix.copyPosition(relativeMatrix);
    }

    if (name === options.hip) {
      globalMatrix.elements[12] *= options.scale * options.hipInfluence.x;
      globalMatrix.elements[13] *= options.scale * options.hipInfluence.y;
      globalMatrix.elements[14] *= options.scale * options.hipInfluence.z;

      if (options.hipPosition !== undefined) {
        globalMatrix.elements[12] += options.hipPosition.x * options.scale;
        globalMatrix.elements[13] += options.hipPosition.y * options.scale;
        globalMatrix.elements[14] += options.hipPosition.z * options.scale;
      }
    }

    if (bone.parent) {
      bone.matrix.copy(bone.parent.matrixWorld).invert();
      bone.matrix.multiply(globalMatrix);
    } else {
      bone.matrix.copy(globalMatrix);
    }

    bone.matrix.decompose(bone.position, bone.quaternion, bone.scale);

    bone.updateMatrixWorld();
  }

  if (options.preserveBonePositions) {
    for (let i = 0; i < bones.length; ++i) {
      bone = bones[i];
      name = getBoneName(bone, options) || bone.name;

      if (name !== options.hip) {
        bone.position.copy(bonesPosition![i]);
      }
    }
  }

  if (options.preserveBoneMatrix) {
    // restore matrix

    (target as Object3D).updateMatrixWorld(true);
  }
}

/**
 * Retargets the animation clip of the source to the target 3D object.
 *
 * The `source` can be a 3D object with a skeleton property (e.g. a skinned mesh)
 * or a {@link Skeleton} directly.
 *
 * @param target - The target 3D object. Must have a `skeleton` property.
 * @param source - The source object.
 * @param clip - The animation clip.
 * @param options - The options.
 * @return The retargeted animation clip.
 */
export function retargetClip(
  target: Object3D,
  source: RetargetTarget,
  clip: AnimationClip,
  options: RetargetOptions = {},
): AnimationClip {
  options.useFirstFramePosition = options.useFirstFramePosition !== undefined ? options.useFirstFramePosition : false;

  // Calculate fps from the clip; the actual upstream sample rate comes from the caller.
  if (options.fps === undefined) {
    throw new Error("THREE.SkeletonUtils.retargetClip: options.fps is required.");
  }

  options.names = options.names || {};

  const sourceObject: Object3D =
    (source as Object3D).isObject3D === true ? (source as Object3D) : getHelperFromSkeleton(source as Skeleton);

  const numFrames = Math.round(((clip.duration * options.fps) / 1000) * 1000),
    delta = clip.duration / (numFrames - 1),
    convertedTracks: KeyframeTrack[] = [],
    mixer = new AnimationMixer(sourceObject),
    bones = getBones(getSkeleton(target)!),
    boneDatas: BoneData[] = [];

  let positionOffset: Vector3 | undefined, bone: Bone, boneTo: Bone | undefined, boneData, name: string | undefined;

  mixer.clipAction(clip).play();

  // trim

  let start = 0,
    end = numFrames;

  if (options.trim !== undefined) {
    start = Math.round(options.trim[0] * options.fps);
    end = Math.min(Math.round(options.trim[1] * options.fps), numFrames) - start;

    mixer.update(options.trim[0]);
  } else {
    mixer.update(0);
  }

  sourceObject.updateMatrixWorld();

  //

  for (let frame = 0; frame < end; ++frame) {
    const time = frame * delta;

    retarget(target as unknown as RetargetTarget, sourceObject, options);

    for (let j = 0; j < bones.length; ++j) {
      bone = bones[j];
      name = getBoneName(bone, options) || bone.name;
      boneTo = getBoneByName(name!, getSkeleton(sourceObject)!.bones);

      if (boneTo) {
        boneData = boneDatas[j] = boneDatas[j] || { bone: bone };

        if (options.hip === name) {
          if (!boneData.pos) {
            boneData.pos = {
              times: new Float32Array(end),
              values: new Float32Array(end * 3),
            };
          }

          if (options.useFirstFramePosition) {
            if (frame === 0) {
              positionOffset = bone.position.clone();
            }

            bone.position.sub(positionOffset!);
          }

          boneData.pos.times[frame] = time;

          const posValues = [0, 0, 0];
          bone.position.toArray(posValues);
          (boneData.pos.values as Float32Array).set(posValues, frame * 3);
        }

        if (!boneData.quat) {
          boneData.quat = {
            times: new Float32Array(end),
            values: new Float32Array(end * 4),
          };
        }

        boneData.quat.times[frame] = time;

        const quatValues = [0, 0, 0, 1];
        bone.quaternion.toArray(quatValues);
        (boneData.quat.values as Float32Array).set(quatValues, frame * 4);
      }
    }

    if (frame === end - 2) {
      // last mixer update before final loop iteration
      // make sure we do not go over or equal to clip duration
      mixer.update(delta - 0.0000001);
    } else {
      mixer.update(delta);
    }

    sourceObject.updateMatrixWorld();
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < boneDatas.length; ++i) {
    boneData = boneDatas[i];

    if (boneData) {
      if (boneData.pos) {
        convertedTracks.push(
          new VectorKeyframeTrack(
            ".bones[" + boneData.bone.name + "].position",
            boneData.pos.times,
            boneData.pos.values,
          ),
        );
      }

      convertedTracks.push(
        new QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
          ".bones[" + boneData.bone.name + "].quaternion",
          boneData.quat!.times,
          boneData.quat!.values,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  mixer.uncacheAction(clip);

  return new AnimationClip(clip.name, -1, convertedTracks);
}

/**
 * Clones the given 3D object and its descendants, ensuring that any `SkinnedMesh` instances are
 * correctly associated with their bones. Bones are also cloned, and must be descendants of the
 * object passed to this method. Other data, like geometries and materials, are reused by reference.
 *
 * @param source - The 3D object to clone.
 * @return The cloned 3D object.
 */
export function clone(source: Object3D): Object3D {
  const sourceLookup = new Map<Object3D, Object3D>();
  const cloneLookup = new Map<Object3D, Object3D>();

  const clone = source.clone();

  parallelTraverse(source, clone, (sourceNode, clonedNode) => {
    sourceLookup.set(clonedNode, sourceNode);
    cloneLookup.set(sourceNode, clonedNode);
  });

  clone.traverse((node) => {
    if (!(node as SkinnedMesh).isSkinnedMesh) return;

    const clonedMesh = node as SkinnedMesh;
    const sourceMesh = sourceLookup.get(node) as SkinnedMesh;
    const sourceBones = sourceMesh.skeleton.bones;

    clonedMesh.skeleton = sourceMesh.skeleton.clone();
    clonedMesh.bindMatrix.copy(sourceMesh.bindMatrix);

    clonedMesh.skeleton.bones = sourceBones.map<Bone>((bone) => cloneLookup.get(bone) as Bone);

    clonedMesh.bind(clonedMesh.skeleton, clonedMesh.bindMatrix);
  });

  return clone;
}

// internal helpers

function getBoneByName(name: string, bones: Bone[]): Bone | undefined {
  for (let i = 0; i < bones.length; i++) {
    if (name === bones[i].name) return bones[i];
  }
}

function getBones(skeleton: Skeleton | Bone[]): Bone[] {
  return Array.isArray(skeleton) ? skeleton : skeleton.bones;
}

function getSkeleton(object: Object3D | null | undefined): Skeleton | null {
  const holder = object as unknown as SkeletonHolder;
  return holder.isObject3D === true && holder.skeleton ? holder.skeleton : null;
}

function getHelperFromSkeleton(skeleton: Skeleton): SkeletonHelper & { skeleton: Skeleton } {
  const source = new SkeletonHelper(skeleton.bones[0]) as SkeletonHelper & { skeleton: Skeleton };
  source.skeleton = skeleton;

  return source;
}

function parallelTraverse(a: Object3D, b: Object3D, callback: (a: Object3D, b: Object3D) => void): void {
  callback(a, b);

  for (let i = 0; i < a.children.length; i++) {
    parallelTraverse(a.children[i], b.children[i], callback);
  }
}

## ek3d/addons/utils/SortUtils

```typescript
/** Mutable array or typed array sorted by unsigned 32-bit keys. */
export interface RadixArray<T> {
  readonly length: number;
  [index: number]: T;
}
export interface RadixSortOptions<T> {
  aux?: RadixArray<T>;
  get?: (value: T) => number;
  reversed?: boolean;
}

const POWER = 3;
const BIT_MAX = 32;
const BIN_BITS = 1 << POWER;
const BIN_SIZE = 1 << BIN_BITS;
const BIN_MAX = BIN_SIZE - 1;
const ITERATIONS = BIT_MAX / BIN_BITS;

const bins: Uint32Array[] = [];
const bins_buffer = new ArrayBuffer((ITERATIONS + 1) * BIN_SIZE * 4);

let c = 0;
for (let i = 0; i < ITERATIONS + 1; i++) {
  bins[i] = new Uint32Array(bins_buffer, c, BIN_SIZE);
  c += BIN_SIZE * 4;
}

export function radixSort<T extends number>(arr: RadixArray<T>, opt?: RadixSortOptions<T>): void;
export function radixSort<T>(arr: RadixArray<T>, opt: RadixSortOptions<T> & { get(value: T): number }): void;
export function radixSort<T>(arr: RadixArray<T>, opt?: RadixSortOptions<T>): void {
  const len = arr.length;

  const options = opt || {};
  const aux: RadixArray<T> = options.aux || [];
  const get = options.get || ((value: T) => value as number);

  const data: [RadixArray<T>, RadixArray<T>] = [arr, aux];

  let compare: (a: number, b: number) => boolean;
  let accumulate: (bin: Uint32Array) => void;
  let recurse: (cache: Uint32Array, depth: number, start: number) => void;

  if (options.reversed) {
    compare = (a, b) => a < b;
    accumulate = (bin) => {
      for (let j = BIN_SIZE - 2; j >= 0; j--) bin[j] += bin[j + 1];
    };

    recurse = (cache, depth, start) => {
      let prev = 0;
      for (let j = BIN_MAX; j >= 0; j--) {
        const cur = cache[j],
          diff = cur - prev;
        if (diff != 0) {
          if (diff > 32) radixSortBlock(depth + 1, start + prev, diff);
          else insertionSortBlock(depth + 1, start + prev, diff);
          prev = cur;
        }
      }
    };
  } else {
    compare = (a, b) => a > b;
    accumulate = (bin) => {
      for (let j = 1; j < BIN_SIZE; j++) bin[j] += bin[j - 1];
    };

    recurse = (cache, depth, start) => {
      let prev = 0;
      for (let j = 0; j < BIN_SIZE; j++) {
        const cur = cache[j],
          diff = cur - prev;
        if (diff != 0) {
          if (diff > 32) radixSortBlock(depth + 1, start + prev, diff);
          else insertionSortBlock(depth + 1, start + prev, diff);
          prev = cur;
        }
      }
    };
  }

  const insertionSortBlock = (depth: number, start: number, len: number) => {
    const a = data[depth & 1];
    const b = data[(depth + 1) & 1];

    for (let j = start + 1; j < start + len; j++) {
      const p = a[j],
        t = get(p) >>> 0;
      let i = j;
      while (i > start) {
        if (compare(get(a[i - 1]) >>> 0, t)) a[i] = a[--i];
        else break;
      }

      a[i] = p;
    }

    if ((depth & 1) == 1) {
      for (let i = start; i < start + len; i++) b[i] = a[i];
    }
  };

  const radixSortBlock = (depth: number, start: number, len: number) => {
    const a = data[depth & 1];
    const b = data[(depth + 1) & 1];

    const shift = (3 - depth) << POWER;
    const end = start + len;

    const cache = bins[depth];
    const bin = bins[depth + 1];

    bin.fill(0);

    for (let j = start; j < end; j++) bin[(get(a[j]) >>> shift) & BIN_MAX]++;

    accumulate(bin);

    cache.set(bin);

    for (let j = end - 1; j >= start; j--) b[start + --bin[(get(a[j]) >>> shift) & BIN_MAX]] = a[j];

    if (depth == ITERATIONS - 1) return;

    recurse(cache, depth, start);
  };

  radixSortBlock(0, 0, len);
}
```

## ek3d/addons/utils/UVsDebug

````typescript
import { BufferAttribute } from "../../core/BufferAttribute";
import { InterleavedBufferAttribute } from "../../core/InterleavedBufferAttribute";
import type { BufferGeometry } from "../../core/BufferGeometry";
import { Vector2 } from "../../math/Vector2";

/**
 * Draws triangle contours, face numbers and vertex labels in UV space.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { SphereGeometry } from "ek3d/geometries/SphereGeometry";
 * import { UVsDebug } from "ek3d/addons/utils/UVsDebug";
 * document.body.appendChild(UVsDebug(new SphereGeometry()));
 * ```
 *
 * Only horizontal UV wrapping is visualized, matching upstream.
 */
export function UVsDebug(geometry: BufferGeometry, size = 1024): HTMLCanvasElement {
  const abc = "abc";
  const center = new Vector2();
  const midpoint = new Vector2();
  const uvs = [new Vector2(), new Vector2(), new Vector2()];
  const face: number[] = [];
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = canvas.height = size;
  const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (!context) throw new Error("UVsDebug requires a 2D canvas context.");
  const ctx = context;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgb(63, 63, 63)";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgb(255, 255, 255)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
  const index = geometry.index;
  const uvAttribute = geometry.attributes.uv;
  if (!(uvAttribute instanceof BufferAttribute || uvAttribute instanceof InterleavedBufferAttribute)) {
    throw new Error("UVsDebug requires CPU-readable UV coordinates.");
  }
  for (let i = 0, count = index ? index.count : uvAttribute.count; i < count; i += 3) {
    for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
      face[j] = index ? index.getX(i + j) : i + j;
      uvs[j].fromBufferAttribute(uvAttribute, face[j]);
    }
    processFace(i / 3);
  }
  return canvas;

  function processFace(index: number): void {
    ctx.beginPath();
    center.set(0, 0);
    for (let j = 0; j < uvs.length; j++) {
      const uv = uvs[j];
      center.add(uv);
      const x = uv.x * (size - 2) + 0.5;
      const y = (1 - uv.y) * (size - 2) + 0.5;
      if (j === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.stroke();
    center.divideScalar(uvs.length);
    ctx.font = "18px Arial";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgb(63, 63, 63)";
    ctx.fillText(String(index), center.x * size, (1 - center.y) * size);
    if (center.x > 0.95) ctx.fillText(String(index), (center.x % 1) * size, (1 - center.y) * size);
    ctx.font = "12px Arial";
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgb(191, 191, 191)";
    for (let j = 0; j < uvs.length; j++) {
      midpoint.addVectors(center, uvs[j]).divideScalar(2);
      const label = abc[j] + face[j];
      ctx.fillText(label, midpoint.x * size, (1 - midpoint.y) * size);
      if (midpoint.x > 0.95) ctx.fillText(label, (midpoint.x % 1) * size, (1 - midpoint.y) * size);
    }
  }
}
