   * @param object - The 3D object.
   * @param camera - The camera that is used to render the scene.
   * @param shadowCamera - The shadow camera.
   * @param geometry - The 3D object's geometry.
   * @param depthMaterial - The depth material.
   * @param group - The geometry group data.
   */
  onBeforeShadow(
    renderer: WebGLRenderer,
    object: Object3D,
    camera: Camera,
    shadowCamera: Camera,
    geometry: BufferGeometry,
    depthMaterial: Material,
    group: { start: number; count: number; materialIndex?: number } | null,
  ): void;
  onBeforeShadow(/* renderer, object, camera, shadowCamera, geometry, depthMaterial, group */) {}
  /**
   * A callback that is executed immediately after a 3D object is rendered to a shadow map.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param object - The 3D object.
   * @param camera - The camera that is used to render the scene.
   * @param shadowCamera - The shadow camera.
   * @param geometry - The 3D object's geometry.
   * @param depthMaterial - The depth material.
   * @param group - The geometry group data.
   */
  onAfterShadow(
    renderer: WebGLRenderer,
    object: Object3D,
    camera: Camera,
    shadowCamera: Camera,
    geometry: BufferGeometry,
    depthMaterial: Material,
    group: { start: number; count: number; materialIndex?: number } | null,
  ): void;
  onAfterShadow(/* renderer, object, camera, shadowCamera, geometry, depthMaterial, group */) {}
  /**
   * A callback that is executed immediately before a 3D object is rendered.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param scene - The scene.
   * @param camera - The camera that is used to render the scene.
   * @param geometry - The 3D object's geometry.
   * @param material - The 3D object's material.
   * @param group - The geometry group data.
   */
  onBeforeRender(...args: any[]): void;
  onBeforeRender(/* renderer, scene, camera, geometry, material, group */) {}
  /**
   * A callback that is executed immediately after a 3D object is rendered.
   *
   * @param renderer - The renderer.
   * @param scene - The scene.
   * @param camera - The camera that is used to render the scene.
   * @param geometry - The 3D object's geometry.
   * @param material - The 3D object's material.
   * @param group - The geometry group data.
   */
  onAfterRender(...args: any[]): void;
  onAfterRender(/* renderer, scene, camera, geometry, material, group */) {}
  /**
   * Applies the given transformation matrix to the object and updates the object's position,
   * rotation and scale.
   *
   * @param matrix - The transformation matrix.
   */
  applyMatrix4(matrix: Matrix4) {
    if (this.matrixAutoUpdate) this.updateMatrix();
    this.matrix.premultiply(matrix);
    this.matrix.decompose((this as any).position, (this as any).quaternion, (this as any).scale);
    if (this.pivot !== null) {
      // the matrix maps the pivot to position + pivot, see updateMatrix()
      (this as any).position.copy(this.pivot).applyMatrix4(this.matrix).sub(this.pivot);
    }
  }
  /**
   * Applies a rotation represented by given the quaternion to the 3D object.
   *
   * @param q - The quaternion.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  applyQuaternion(q: Quaternion): Object3D {
    (this as any).quaternion.premultiply(q);
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Sets the given rotation represented as an axis/angle couple to the 3D object.
   *
   * @param axis - The (normalized) axis vector.
   * @param angle - The angle in radians.
   */
  setRotationFromAxisAngle(axis: Vector3, angle: number) {
    // assumes axis is normalized
    (this as any).quaternion.setFromAxisAngle(axis, angle);
  }
  /**
   * Sets the given rotation represented as Euler angles to the 3D object.
   *
   * @param euler - The Euler angles.
   */
  setRotationFromEuler(euler: Euler) {
    (this as any).quaternion.setFromEuler(euler, true);
  }
  /**
   * Sets the given rotation represented as rotation matrix to the 3D object.
   *
   * @param m - Although a 4x4 matrix is expected, the upper 3x3 portion must be
   * a pure rotation matrix (i.e, unscaled).
   */
  setRotationFromMatrix(m: Matrix4) {
    // assumes the upper 3x3 of m is a pure rotation matrix (i.e, unscaled)
    (this as any).quaternion.setFromRotationMatrix(m);
  }
  /**
   * Sets the given rotation represented as a Quaternion to the 3D object.
   *
   * @param q - The Quaternion
   */
  setRotationFromQuaternion(q: Quaternion) {
    // assumes q is normalized
    (this as any).quaternion.copy(q);
  }
  /**
   * Rotates the 3D object along an axis in local space.
   *
   * @param axis - The (normalized) axis vector.
   * @param angle - The angle in radians.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  rotateOnAxis(axis: Vector3, angle: number): Object3D {
    // rotate object on axis in object space
    // axis is assumed to be normalized
    _q1.setFromAxisAngle(axis, angle);
    (this as any).quaternion.multiply(_q1);
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Rotates the 3D object along an axis in world space.
   *
   * @param axis - The (normalized) axis vector.
   * @param angle - The angle in radians.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  rotateOnWorldAxis(axis: Vector3, angle: number): Object3D {
    // rotate object on axis in world space
    // axis is assumed to be normalized
    // method assumes no rotated parent
    _q1.setFromAxisAngle(axis, angle);
    (this as any).quaternion.premultiply(_q1);
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Rotates the 3D object around its X axis in local space.
   *
   * @param angle - The angle in radians.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  rotateX(angle: number): Object3D {
    return this.rotateOnAxis(_xAxis, angle);
  }
  /**
   * Rotates the 3D object around its Y axis in local space.
   *
   * @param angle - The angle in radians.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  rotateY(angle: number): Object3D {
    return this.rotateOnAxis(_yAxis, angle);
  }
  /**
   * Rotates the 3D object around its Z axis in local space.
   *
   * @param angle - The angle in radians.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  rotateZ(angle: number): Object3D {
    return this.rotateOnAxis(_zAxis, angle);
  }
  /**
   * Translate the 3D object by a distance along the given axis in local space.
   *
   * @param axis - The (normalized) axis vector.
   * @param distance - The distance in world units.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  translateOnAxis(axis: Vector3, distance: number): Object3D {
    // translate object by distance along axis in object space
    // axis is assumed to be normalized
    _v1.copy(axis).applyQuaternion((this as any).quaternion);
    (this as any).position.add(_v1.multiplyScalar(distance));
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Translate the 3D object by a distance along its X-axis in local space.
   *
   * @param distance - The distance in world units.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  translateX(distance: number): Object3D {
    return this.translateOnAxis(_xAxis, distance);
  }
  /**
   * Translate the 3D object by a distance along its Y-axis in local space.
   *
   * @param distance - The distance in world units.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  translateY(distance: number): Object3D {
    return this.translateOnAxis(_yAxis, distance);
  }
  /**
   * Translate the 3D object by a distance along its Z-axis in local space.
   *
   * @param distance - The distance in world units.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  translateZ(distance: number): Object3D {
    return this.translateOnAxis(_zAxis, distance);
  }
  /**
   * Converts the given vector from this 3D object's local space to world space.
   *
   * @param vector - The vector to convert.
   * @return The converted vector.
   */
  localToWorld(vector: Vector3): Vector3 {
    this.updateWorldMatrix(true, false);
    return vector.applyMatrix4(this.matrixWorld);
  }
  /**
   * Converts the given vector from this 3D object's world space to local space.
   *
   * @param vector - The vector to convert.
   * @return The converted vector.
   */
  worldToLocal(vector: Vector3): Vector3 {
    this.updateWorldMatrix(true, false);
    return vector.applyMatrix4(_m1.copy(this.matrixWorld).invert());
  }
  /**
   * Rotates the object to face a point in world space.
   *
   * This method does not support objects having non-uniformly-scaled parent(s).
   *
   * @param x - The x coordinate in world space. Alternatively, a vector representing a position in world space
   * @param [y] - The y coordinate in world space.
   * @param [z] - The z coordinate in world space.
   */
  lookAt(x: number | Vector3, y?: number, z?: number): void;
  lookAt(x?: any, y?: number, z?: number) {
    // This method does not support objects having non-uniformly-scaled parent(s)
    if ((x as any).isVector3) {
      _target.copy(x);
    } else {
      _target.set(x, y!, z!);
    }
    const parent = this.parent;
    this.updateWorldMatrix(true, false);
    _position.setFromMatrixPosition(this.matrixWorld);
    if ((this as any).isCamera || (this as any).isLight) {
      _m1.lookAt(_position, _target, this.up);
    } else {
      _m1.lookAt(_target, _position, this.up);
    }
    (this as any).quaternion.setFromRotationMatrix(_m1);
    if (parent) {
      _m1.extractRotation(parent.matrixWorld);
      _q1.setFromRotationMatrix(_m1);
      (this as any).quaternion.premultiply(_q1.invert());
    }
  }
  /**
   * Adds the given 3D object as a child to this 3D object. An arbitrary number of
   * objects may be added. Any current parent on an object passed in here will be
   * removed, since an object can have at most one parent.
   *
   * @fires Object3D#added
   * @fires Object3D#childadded
   * @param object - The 3D object to add.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  add(...objects: TChild[]): this;
  add(object?: TChild): Object3D {
    if (arguments.length > 1) {
      for (let i = 0; i < arguments.length; i++) {
        this.add((arguments as any)[i]);
      }
      return this;
    }
    if (object === (this as Object3D)) {
      error("Object3D.add: object can't be added as a child of itself.", object!);
      return this;
    }
    if (object! && object!.isObject3D) {
      object!.removeFromParent();
      object!.parent = this;
      this.children.push(object!);
      object!.dispatchEvent(_addedEvent);
      _childaddedEvent.child = object!;
      this.dispatchEvent(_childaddedEvent);
      _childaddedEvent.child = null;
    } else {
      error("Object3D.add: object not an instance of THREE.Object3D.", object!);
    }
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Removes the given 3D object as child from this 3D object.
   * An arbitrary number of objects may be removed.
   *
   * @fires Object3D#removed
   * @fires Object3D#childremoved
   * @param object - The 3D object to remove.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  remove(...objects: Object3D[]): this;
  remove(object?: Object3D): Object3D {
    if (arguments.length > 1) {
      for (let i = 0; i < arguments.length; i++) {
        this.remove((arguments as any)[i]);
      }
      return this;
    }
    const index = this.children.indexOf(object! as TChild);
    if (index !== -1) {
      object!.parent = null;
      this.children.splice(index, 1);
      object!.dispatchEvent(_removedEvent);
      _childremovedEvent.child = object!;
      this.dispatchEvent(_childremovedEvent);
      _childremovedEvent.child = null;
    }
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Removes this 3D object from its current parent.
   *
   * @fires Object3D#removed
   * @fires Object3D#childremoved
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  removeFromParent(): Object3D {
    const parent = this.parent;
    if (parent !== null) {
      parent.remove(this);
    }
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Removes all child objects.
   *
   * @fires Object3D#removed
   * @fires Object3D#childremoved
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  clear(): Object3D {
    return this.remove(...this.children);
  }
  /**
   * Adds the given 3D object as a child of this 3D object, while maintaining the object's world
   * transform. This method does not support scene graphs having non-uniformly-scaled nodes(s).
   *
   * @fires Object3D#added
   * @fires Object3D#childadded
   * @param object - The 3D object to attach.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  attach(object: TChild): Object3D {
    // adds object as a child of this, while maintaining the object's world transform
    // Note: This method does not support scene graphs having non-uniformly-scaled nodes(s)
    this.updateWorldMatrix(true, false);
    _m1.copy(this.matrixWorld).invert();
    if (object.parent !== null) {
      object.parent.updateWorldMatrix(true, false);
      _m1.multiply(object.parent.matrixWorld);
    }
    object.applyMatrix4(_m1);
    object.removeFromParent();
    object.parent = this;
    this.children.push(object);
    object.updateWorldMatrix(false, true);
    object.dispatchEvent(_addedEvent);
    _childaddedEvent.child = object;
    this.dispatchEvent(_childaddedEvent);
    _childaddedEvent.child = null;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Searches through the 3D object and its children, starting with the 3D object
   * itself, and returns the first with a matching ID.
   *
   * @param id - The id.
   * @return The found 3D object. Returns `undefined` if no 3D object has been found.
   */
  getObjectById(id: number): Object3D | undefined {
    return this.getObjectByProperty("id", id);
  }
  /**
   * Searches through the 3D object and its children, starting with the 3D object
   * itself, and returns the first with a matching name.
   *
   * @param name - The name.
   * @return The found 3D object. Returns `undefined` if no 3D object has been found.
   */
  getObjectByName(name: string): Object3D | undefined {
    return this.getObjectByProperty("name", name);
  }
  /**
   * Searches through the 3D object and its children, starting with the 3D object
   * itself, and returns the first with a matching property value.
   *
   * @param name - The name of the property.
   * @param value - The value.
   * @return The found 3D object. Returns `undefined` if no 3D object has been found.
   */
  getObjectByProperty(name: string, value?: any): Object3D | undefined {
    if ((this as any)[name] === value) return this;
    for (let i = 0, l = this.children.length; i < l; i++) {
      const child = this.children[i];
      const object = child.getObjectByProperty(name, value);
      if (object !== undefined) {
        return object;
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  }
  /**
   * Searches through the 3D object and its children, starting with the 3D object
   * itself, and returns all 3D objects with a matching property value.
   *
   * @param name - The name of the property.
   * @param value - The value.
   * @param result - The method stores the result in this array.
   * @return The found 3D objects.
   */
  getObjectsByProperty(name: string, value?: any, result: Object3D[] = []): Object3D[] {
    if ((this as any)[name] === value) result.push(this);
    const children = this.children;
    for (let i = 0, l = children.length; i < l; i++) {
      children[i].getObjectsByProperty(name, value, result);
    }
    return result;
  }
  /**
   * Returns a vector representing the position of the 3D object in world space.
   *
   * @param target - The target vector the result is stored to.
   * @return The 3D object's position in world space.
   */
  getWorldPosition(target: Vector3): Vector3 {
    this.updateWorldMatrix(true, false);
    return target.setFromMatrixPosition(this.matrixWorld);
  }
  /**
   * Returns a Quaternion representing the position of the 3D object in world space.
   *
   * @param target - The target Quaternion the result is stored to.
   * @return The 3D object's rotation in world space.
   */
  getWorldQuaternion(target: Quaternion): Quaternion {
    this.updateWorldMatrix(true, false);
    this.matrixWorld.decompose(_position, target, _scale);
    return target;
  }
  /**
   * Returns a vector representing the scale of the 3D object in world space.
   *
   * @param target - The target vector the result is stored to.
   * @return The 3D object's scale in world space.
   */
  getWorldScale(target: Vector3): Vector3 {
    this.updateWorldMatrix(true, false);
    this.matrixWorld.decompose(_position, _quaternion, target);
    return target;
  }
  /**
   * Returns a vector representing the ("look") direction of the 3D object in world space.
   *
   * @param target - The target vector the result is stored to.
   * @return The 3D object's direction in world space.
   */
  getWorldDirection(target: Vector3): Vector3 {
    this.updateWorldMatrix(true, false);
    const e = this.matrixWorld.elements;
    return target.set(e[8], e[9], e[10]).normalize();
  }
  /**
   * Abstract method to get intersections between a casted ray and this
   * 3D object. Renderable 3D objects such as {@link Mesh}, {@link Line} or {@link Points}
   * implement this method in order to use raycasting.
   *
   * @abstract
   * @param raycaster - The raycaster.
   * @param intersects - An array holding the result of the method.
   */
  raycast(raycaster: Raycaster, intersects: Intersection[]): boolean | void;
  raycast(/* raycaster, intersects */) {}
  /**
   * Returns `true` if this 3D object intersects the given frustum. Renderable 3D objects
   * such as {@link Mesh}, {@link Line} or {@link Points} override this method in order
   * to use frustum culling. The default implementation always returns `true`.
   *
   * @param frustum - The frustum to test.
   * @return Whether this 3D object intersects the given frustum or not.
   */
  intersectsFrustum(...args: any[]): boolean;
  intersectsFrustum(/* frustum */): boolean {
    return true;
  }
  /**
   * Executes the callback on this 3D object and all descendants.
   *
   * Note: Modifying the scene graph inside the callback is discouraged.
   *
   * @param callback - A callback function that allows to process the current 3D object.
   */
  traverse(callback: (object: Object3D) => void) {
    callback(this);
    const children = this.children;
    for (let i = 0, l = children.length; i < l; i++) {
      children[i].traverse(callback);
    }
  }
  /**
   * Like {@link Object3D#traverse}, but the callback will only be executed for visible 3D objects.
   * Descendants of invisible 3D objects are not traversed.
   *
   * Note: Modifying the scene graph inside the callback is discouraged.
   *
   * @param callback - A callback function that allows to process the current 3D object.
   */
  traverseVisible(callback: (object: Object3D) => void) {
    if (this.visible === false) return;
    callback(this);
    const children = this.children;
    for (let i = 0, l = children.length; i < l; i++) {
      children[i].traverseVisible(callback);
    }
  }
  /**
   * Like {@link Object3D#traverse}, but the callback will only be executed for all ancestors.
   *
   * Note: Modifying the scene graph inside the callback is discouraged.
   *
   * @param callback - A callback function that allows to process the current 3D object.
   */
  traverseAncestors(callback: (object: Object3D) => void) {
    const parent = this.parent;
    if (parent !== null) {
      callback(parent);
      parent.traverseAncestors(callback);
    }
  }
  /**
   * Updates the transformation matrix in local space by computing it from the current
   * position, rotation and scale values.
   */
  updateMatrix() {
    this.matrix.compose((this as any).position, (this as any).quaternion, (this as any).scale);
    const pivot = this.pivot;
    if (pivot !== null) {
      const px = pivot.x,
        py = pivot.y,
        pz = pivot.z;
      const te = this.matrix.elements;
      te[12] += px - te[0] * px - te[4] * py - te[8] * pz;
      te[13] += py - te[1] * px - te[5] * py - te[9] * pz;
      te[14] += pz - te[2] * px - te[6] * py - te[10] * pz;
    }
    this.matrixWorldNeedsUpdate = true;
  }
  /**
   * Updates the transformation matrix in world space of this 3D objects and its descendants.
   *
   * To ensure correct results, this method also recomputes the 3D object's transformation matrix in
   * local space. The computation of the local and world matrix can be controlled with the
   * {@link Object3D#matrixAutoUpdate} and {@link Object3D#matrixWorldAutoUpdate} flags which are both
   * `true` by default.  Set these flags to `false` if you need more control over the update matrix process.
   *
   * @param [force=false] - When set to `true`, a recomputation of world matrices is forced even
   * when {@link Object3D#matrixWorldNeedsUpdate} is `false`.
   */
  updateMatrixWorld(force?: boolean) {
    if (this.matrixAutoUpdate) this.updateMatrix();
    if (this.matrixWorldNeedsUpdate || force!) {
      if (this.matrixWorldAutoUpdate === true) {
        if (this.parent === null) {
          this.matrixWorld.copy(this.matrix);
        } else {
          this.matrixWorld.multiplyMatrices(this.parent.matrixWorld, this.matrix);
        }
      }
      this.matrixWorldNeedsUpdate = false;
      force! = true;
    }
    // make sure descendants are updated if required
    const children = this.children;
    for (let i = 0, l = children.length; i < l; i++) {
      const child = children[i];
      child.updateMatrixWorld(force!);
    }
  }
  /**
   * An alternative version of {@link Object3D#updateMatrixWorld} with more control over the
   * update of ancestor and descendant nodes.
   *
   * @param [updateParents=false] Whether ancestor nodes should be updated or not.
   * @param [updateChildren=false] Whether descendant nodes should be updated or not.
   * @param [force=false] - When set to `true`, a recomputation of world matrices is forced even
   * when {@link Object3D#matrixWorldNeedsUpdate} is `false`.
   */
  updateWorldMatrix(updateParents?: boolean, updateChildren?: boolean, force: boolean = false) {
    const parent = this.parent;
    if (updateParents! === true && parent !== null) {
      parent.updateWorldMatrix(true, false);
    }
    if (this.matrixAutoUpdate) this.updateMatrix();
    if (this.matrixWorldNeedsUpdate || force) {
      if (this.matrixWorldAutoUpdate === true) {
        if (this.parent === null) {
          this.matrixWorld.copy(this.matrix);
        } else {
          this.matrixWorld.multiplyMatrices(this.parent.matrixWorld, this.matrix);
        }
      }
      this.matrixWorldNeedsUpdate = false;
      force = true;
    }
    // make sure descendants are updated
    if (updateChildren! === true) {
      const children = this.children;
      for (let i = 0, l = children.length; i < l; i++) {
        const child = children[i];
        child.updateWorldMatrix(false, true, force);
      }
    }
  }
  /**
   * Serializes the 3D object into JSON.
   *
   * @param meta - An optional value holding meta information about the serialization.
   * @return A JSON object representing the serialized 3D object.
   * @see {@link ObjectLoader#parse}
   */
  toJSON(meta?: any) {
    // meta is a string when called from JSON.stringify
    const isRootObject = meta === undefined || typeof meta === "string";
    const output: any = {};
    // meta is a hash used to collect geometries, materials.
    // not providing it implies that this is the root object
    // being serialized.
    if (isRootObject) {
      // initialize meta obj
      meta = {
        geometries: {},
        materials: {},
        textures: {},
        images: {},
        shapes: {},
        skeletons: {},
        animations: {},
      };
      output.metadata = {
        version: 4.7,
        type: "Object",
        generator: "Object3D.toJSON",
      };
    }
    // standard Object3D serialization
    const object: any = {};
    object.uuid = this.uuid;
    object.type = this.type;
    object.name = this.name;
    object.castShadow = this.castShadow;
    object.receiveShadow = this.receiveShadow;
    object.visible = this.visible;
    object.frustumCulled = this.frustumCulled;
    object.renderOrder = this.renderOrder;
    object.matrixAutoUpdate = this.matrixAutoUpdate;
    if (Object.keys(this.userData).length > 0) object.userData = this.userData;
    object.layers = this.layers.mask;
    object.matrix = this.matrix.toArray();
    object.up = this.up.toArray();
    if (this.pivot !== null) object.pivot = this.pivot.toArray();
    if ((this as any).morphTargetDictionary !== undefined)
      object.morphTargetDictionary = Object.assign({}, (this as any).morphTargetDictionary);
    if ((this as any).morphTargetInfluences !== undefined)
      object.morphTargetInfluences = (this as any).morphTargetInfluences.slice();
    // object specific properties
    if ((this as any).isInstancedMesh) {
      object.type = "InstancedMesh";
      object.count = (this as any).count;
      object.instanceMatrix = (this as any).instanceMatrix.toJSON();
      if ((this as any).instanceColor !== null) object.instanceColor = (this as any).instanceColor.toJSON();
    }
    if ((this as any).isBatchedMesh) {
      object.type = "BatchedMesh";
      object.perObjectFrustumCulled = (this as any).perObjectFrustumCulled;
      object.sortObjects = (this as any).sortObjects;
      object.drawRanges = (this as any)._drawRanges;
      object.reservedRanges = (this as any)._reservedRanges;
      object.geometryInfo = (this as any)._geometryInfo.map((info?: any) => ({
        ...info,
        boundingBox: info.boundingBox ? info.boundingBox.toJSON() : undefined,
        boundingSphere: info.boundingSphere ? info.boundingSphere.toJSON() : undefined,
      }));
      object.instanceInfo = (this as any)._instanceInfo.map((info?: any) => ({ ...info }));
      object.availableInstanceIds = (this as any)._availableInstanceIds.slice();
      object.availableGeometryIds = (this as any)._availableGeometryIds.slice();
      object.nextIndexStart = (this as any)._nextIndexStart;
      object.nextVertexStart = (this as any)._nextVertexStart;
      object.geometryCount = (this as any)._geometryCount;
      object.maxInstanceCount = (this as any)._maxInstanceCount;
      object.maxVertexCount = (this as any)._maxVertexCount;
      object.maxIndexCount = (this as any)._maxIndexCount;
      object.geometryInitialized = (this as any)._geometryInitialized;
      object.matricesTexture = (this as any)._matricesTexture.toJSON(meta);
      object.indirectTexture = (this as any)._indirectTexture.toJSON(meta);
      if ((this as any)._colorsTexture !== null) {
        object.colorsTexture = (this as any)._colorsTexture.toJSON(meta);
      }
      if ((this as any).boundingSphere !== null) {
        object.boundingSphere = (this as any).boundingSphere.toJSON();
      }
      if ((this as any).boundingBox !== null) {
        object.boundingBox = (this as any).boundingBox.toJSON();
      }
    }
    //
    function serialize(library: any, element?: any) {
      if (library[element.uuid] === undefined) {
        library[element.uuid] = element.toJSON(meta);
      }
      return element.uuid;
    }
    if ((this as any).isScene) {
      if ((this as any).background) {
        if ((this as any).background.isColor) {
          object.background = (this as any).background.toJSON();
        } else if ((this as any).background.isTexture) {
          object.background = (this as any).background.toJSON(meta).uuid;
        }
      }
      if (
        (this as any).environment &&
        (this as any).environment.isTexture &&
        (this as any).environment.isRenderTargetTexture !== true
      ) {
        object.environment = (this as any).environment.toJSON(meta).uuid;
      }
    } else if ((this as any).isMesh || (this as any).isLine || (this as any).isPoints) {
      object.geometry = serialize(meta.geometries, (this as any).geometry);
      const parameters = (this as any).geometry.parameters;
      if (parameters !== undefined && parameters.shapes !== undefined) {
        const shapes = parameters.shapes;
        if (Array.isArray(shapes)) {
          for (let i = 0, l = shapes.length; i < l; i++) {
            const shape = shapes[i];
            serialize(meta.shapes, shape);
          }
        } else {
          serialize(meta.shapes, shapes);
        }
      }
    }
    if ((this as any).isSkinnedMesh) {
      object.bindMode = (this as any).bindMode;
      object.bindMatrix = (this as any).bindMatrix.toArray();
      if ((this as any).skeleton !== undefined) {
        serialize(meta.skeletons, (this as any).skeleton);
        object.skeleton = (this as any).skeleton.uuid;
      }
    }
    if ((this as any).material !== undefined) {
      if (Array.isArray((this as any).material)) {
        const uuids: any[] = [];
        for (let i = 0, l = (this as any).material.length; i < l; i++) {
          uuids.push(serialize(meta.materials, (this as any).material[i]));
        }
        object.material = uuids;
      } else {
        object.material = serialize(meta.materials, (this as any).material);
      }
    }
    //
    if (this.children.length > 0) {
      object.children = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < this.children.length; i++) {
        object.children.push(this.children[i].toJSON(meta).object);
      }
    }
    //
    if (this.animations.length > 0) {
      object.animations = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < this.animations.length; i++) {
        const animation = this.animations[i];
        object.animations.push(serialize(meta.animations, animation));
      }
    }
    if (isRootObject) {
      const geometries = extractFromCache(meta.geometries);
      const materials = extractFromCache(meta.materials);
      const textures = extractFromCache(meta.textures);
      const images = extractFromCache(meta.images);
      const shapes = extractFromCache(meta.shapes);
      const skeletons = extractFromCache(meta.skeletons);
      const animations = extractFromCache(meta.animations);
      if (geometries.length > 0) output.geometries = geometries;
      if (materials.length > 0) output.materials = materials;
      if (textures.length > 0) output.textures = textures;
      if (images.length > 0) output.images = images;
      if (shapes.length > 0) output.shapes = shapes;
      if (skeletons.length > 0) output.skeletons = skeletons;
      if (animations.length > 0) output.animations = animations;
    }
    output.object = object;
    return output;
    // extract data from the cache hash
    // remove metadata on each item
    // and return as array
    function extractFromCache(cache?: any) {
      const values: any[] = [];
      for (const key in cache) {
        const data = cache[key];
        delete data.metadata;
        values.push(data);
      }
      return values;
    }
  }
  /**
   * Returns a new 3D object with copied values from this instance.
   *
   * @param [recursive=true] - When set to `true`, descendants of the 3D object are also cloned.
   * @return A clone of this instance.
   */
  clone(recursive?: boolean): this {
    return new (this.constructor as any)().copy(this, recursive!);
  }
  /**
   * Copies the values of the given 3D object to this instance.
   *
   * @param source - The 3D object to copy.
   * @param [recursive=true] - When set to `true`, descendants of the 3D object are cloned.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  copy(source: Object3D<TChild>, recursive: boolean = true): this {
    this.name = source.name;
    this.up.copy(source.up);
    (this as any).position.copy((source as any).position);
    (this as any).rotation.order = (source as any).rotation.order;
    (this as any).quaternion.copy((source as any).quaternion);
    (this as any).scale.copy((source as any).scale);
    this.pivot = source.pivot !== null ? source.pivot.clone() : null;
    this.matrix.copy(source.matrix);
    this.matrixWorld.copy(source.matrixWorld);
    this.matrixAutoUpdate = source.matrixAutoUpdate;
    this.matrixWorldAutoUpdate = source.matrixWorldAutoUpdate;
    this.matrixWorldNeedsUpdate = source.matrixWorldNeedsUpdate;
    this.layers.mask = source.layers.mask;
    this.visible = source.visible;
    this.castShadow = source.castShadow;
    this.receiveShadow = source.receiveShadow;
    this.frustumCulled = source.frustumCulled;
    this.renderOrder = source.renderOrder;
    this.animations = source.animations.slice();
    this.userData = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(source.userData));
    if (recursive === true) {
      for (let i = 0; i < source.children.length; i++) {
        const child = source.children[i];
        this.add(child.clone());
      }
    }
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Frees the GPU-related resources allocated by this instance. Call this
   * method whenever this instance is no longer used in your app.
   *
   * Geometries, materials and textures are potentially shared with other
   * 3D objects and must be disposed of separately.
   *
   * @fires Object3D#dispose
   */
  dispose() {
    /**
     * Fires when the 3D object has been disposed of.
     *
     * @event Object3D#dispose
     */
    this.dispatchEvent({ type: "dispose" });
  }
}
/**
 * The default up direction for objects, also used as the default
 * position for {@link DirectionalLight} and {@link HemisphereLight}.
 *
 * @static
 * @default (0,1,0)
 */
Object3D.DEFAULT_UP = /*@__PURE__*/ new Vector3(0, 1, 0);
/**
 * The default setting for {@link Object3D#matrixAutoUpdate} for
 * newly created 3D objects.
 *
 * @static
 * @default true
 */
Object3D.DEFAULT_MATRIX_AUTO_UPDATE = true;
/**
 * The default setting for {@link Object3D#matrixWorldAutoUpdate} for
 * newly created 3D objects.
 *
 * @static
 * @default true
 */
Object3D.DEFAULT_MATRIX_WORLD_AUTO_UPDATE = true;
```

## ek3d/core/Raycaster

````typescript
import type { Camera } from "../cameras/Camera";
import type { Object3D } from "./Object3D";
import type { Vector2 } from "../math/Vector2";
import type { Vector3 } from "../math/Vector3";
import { Ray } from "../math/Ray";
import { Layers } from "./Layers";
import { error } from "../utils";

/**
 * The intersection point of a raycaster intersection test.
 * - `distance`: The distance from the ray's origin to the intersection point.
 * - `distanceToRay`: Some 3D objects e.g. {@link Points} provide the distance of the
 * intersection to the nearest point on the ray. For other objects it will be `undefined`.
 * - `point`: The intersection point, in world coordinates.
 * - `face`: The face that has been intersected.
 * - `faceIndex`: The face index.
 * - `object`: The 3D object that has been intersected.
 * - `uv`: U,V coordinates at point of intersection.
 * - `uv1`: Second set of U,V coordinates at point of intersection.
 * - `normal`: Interpolated normal vector at point of intersection.
 * - `instanceId`: The index number of the instance where the ray
 * intersects the {@link InstancedMesh}.
 * - `batchId`: The index number of the instance where the ray
 * intersects the {@link BatchedMesh}.
 */
export interface Intersection {
  distance: number;
  point: Vector3;
  pointOnLine?: Vector3;
  object: Object3D;
  distanceToRay?: number;
  face?: { a: number; b: number; c: number; normal: Vector3; materialIndex: number } | null;
  faceIndex?: number | null;
  index?: number;
  barycoord?: Vector3 | null;
  uv?: Vector2;
  uv1?: Vector2;
  normal?: Vector3;
  instanceId?: number;
  batchId?: number;
}
/**
 * This class is designed to assist with raycasting. Raycasting is used for
 * mouse picking (working out what objects in the 3d space the mouse is over)
 * amongst other things.
 */
export class Raycaster {
  ray: Ray;
  near: number;
  far: number;
  camera: Camera | null;
  layers: Layers;
  params: {
    Mesh: Record<string, unknown>;
    Line: { threshold: number };
    Line2?: { threshold?: number };
    LOD: Record<string, unknown>;
    Points: { threshold: number };
    Sprite: Record<string, unknown>;
  };

  /**
   * Constructs a new raycaster.
   *
   * @param origin - The origin vector where the ray casts from.
   * @param direction - The (normalized) direction vector that gives direction to the ray.
   * @param [near=0] - All results returned are further away than near. Near can't be negative.
   * @param [far=Infinity] - All results returned are closer than far. Far can't be lower than near.
   */
  constructor(origin?: Vector3, direction?: Vector3, near: number = 0, far: number = Infinity) {
    /**
     * The ray used for raycasting.
     *
     */
    this.ray = new Ray(origin, direction);
    /**
     * All results returned are further away than near. Near can't be negative.
     *
     * @default 0
     */
    this.near = near;
    /**
     * All results returned are closer than far. Far can't be lower than near.
     *
     * @default Infinity
     */
    this.far = far;
    /**
     * The camera to use when raycasting against view-dependent objects such as
     * billboarded objects like sprites. This field can be set manually or
     * is set when calling `setFromCamera()`.
     *
     * @default null
     */
    this.camera = null;
    /**
     * Allows to selectively ignore 3D objects when performing intersection tests.
     * The following code example ensures that only 3D objects on layer `1` will be
     * honored by raycaster.
     * ```ts
     * import { Raycaster } from 'ek3d/core/Raycaster';
     * import { Object3D } from 'ek3d/core/Object3D';
     *
     * const raycaster = new Raycaster();
     * const object = new Object3D();
     * raycaster.layers.set( 1 );
     * object.layers.enable( 1 );
     * ```
     *
     */
    this.layers = new Layers();
    /**
     * A parameter object that configures the raycasting. It has the structure:
     *
     * ```ts
     * const params = {
     * 	Mesh: {},
     * 	Line: { threshold: 1 },
     * 	LOD: {},
     * 	Points: { threshold: 1 },
     * 	Sprite: {}
     * };
     * ```
     * Where `threshold` is the precision of the raycaster when intersecting objects, in world units.
     *
     */
    this.params = {
      Mesh: {},
      Line: { threshold: 1 },
      LOD: {},
      Points: { threshold: 1 },
      Sprite: {},
    };
  }
  /**
   * Updates the ray with a new origin and direction by copying the values from the arguments.
   *
   * @param origin - The origin vector where the ray casts from.
   * @param direction - The (normalized) direction vector that gives direction to the ray.
   */
  set(origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3) {
    // direction is assumed to be normalized (for accurate distance calculations)
    this.ray.set(origin, direction);
  }
  /**
   * Uses the given coordinates and camera to compute a new origin and direction for the internal ray.
   *
   * @param coords - 2D coordinates of the mouse, in normalized device coordinates (NDC).
   * X and Y components should be between `-1` and `1`.
   * @param camera - The camera from which the ray should originate.
   */
  setFromCamera(coords: Vector2, camera: Camera) {
    if ((camera as any).isPerspectiveCamera) {
      this.ray.origin.setFromMatrixPosition(camera.matrixWorld);
      this.ray.direction.set(coords.x, coords.y, 0.5).unproject(camera).sub(this.ray.origin).normalize();
      this.camera = camera;
    } else if ((camera as any).isOrthographicCamera) {
      this.ray.origin.set(coords.x, coords.y, camera.projectionMatrix.elements[14]).unproject(camera); // set origin in plane of camera
      this.ray.direction.set(0, 0, -1).transformDirection(camera.matrixWorld);
      this.camera = camera;
    } else {
      error("Raycaster: Unsupported camera type: " + camera.type);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Checks all intersection between the ray and the object with or without the
   * descendants. Intersections are returned sorted by distance, closest first.
   *
   * `Raycaster` delegates to the `raycast()` method of the passed 3D object, when
   * evaluating whether the ray intersects the object or not. This allows meshes to respond
   * differently to ray casting than lines or points.
   *
   * Note that for meshes, faces must be pointed towards the origin of the ray in order
   * to be detected; intersections of the ray passing through the back of a face will not
   * be detected. To raycast against both faces of an object, you'll want to set  {@link Material#side}
   * to `THREE.Side.Double`.
   *
   * Note that a ray hitting a triangle mesh exactly along an edge shared by two faces may be
   * reported by both faces, resulting in two coincident intersections (identical point and
   * distance) in the returned array.
   *
   * @param object - The 3D object to check for intersection with the ray.
   * @param [recursive=true] - If set to `true`, it also checks all descendants.
   * Otherwise it only checks intersection with the object.
   * @param [intersects=[]] The target array that holds the result of the method.
   * @return An array holding the intersection points.
   */
  intersectObject(object: Object3D, recursive: boolean = true, intersects: Intersection[] = []): Intersection[] {
    intersect(object, this, intersects, recursive);
    intersects.sort(ascSort);
    return intersects;
  }
  /**
   * Checks all intersection between the ray and the objects with or without
   * the descendants. Intersections are returned sorted by distance, closest first.
   *
   * @param objects - The 3D objects to check for intersection with the ray.
   * @param [recursive=true] - If set to `true`, it also checks all descendants.
   * Otherwise it only checks intersection with the object.
   * @param [intersects=[]] The target array that holds the result of the method.
   * @return An array holding the intersection points.
   */
  intersectObjects(objects: Object3D[], recursive: boolean = true, intersects: Intersection[] = []): Intersection[] {
    for (let i = 0, l = objects.length; i < l; i++) {
      intersect(objects[i], this, intersects, recursive);
    }
    intersects.sort(ascSort);
    return intersects;
  }
}
function ascSort(a: Intersection, b: Intersection) {
  return a.distance - b.distance;
}
function intersect(object: Object3D, raycaster: Raycaster, intersects: Intersection[], recursive: boolean) {
  let propagate = true;
  if (object.layers.test(raycaster.layers)) {
    const result = object.raycast(raycaster, intersects);
    if (result === false) propagate = false;
  }
  if (propagate === true && recursive === true) {
    const children = object.children;
    for (let i = 0, l = children.length; i < l; i++) {
      intersect(children[i], raycaster, intersects, true);
    }
  }
}
````

## ek3d/core/RenderTarget

```typescript
import type { DepthTexture } from "../textures/DepthTexture";
import { EventDispatcher } from "./EventDispatcher";
import { Texture } from "../textures/Texture";
import { TextureFilter, Wrapping, Mapping } from "../constants";
import { Vector4 } from "../math/Vector4";
import { TextureSource } from "../textures/TextureSource";

/**
 * Render target options.
 * - `generateMipmaps=false`: Whether to generate mipmaps or not.
 * - `mipmapsAutoUpdate=true`: Whether to regenerate mipmaps automatically after rendering or not.
 * - `magFilter=TextureFilter.Linear`: The mag filter.
 * - `minFilter=TextureFilter.Linear`: The min filter.
 * - `format=PixelFormat.RGBA`: The texture format.
 * - `type=TextureType.UnsignedByte`: The texture type.
 * - `internalFormat=null`: The texture's internal format.
 * - `wrapS=Wrapping.ClampToEdge`: The texture's uv wrapping mode.
 * - `wrapT=Wrapping.ClampToEdge`: The texture's uv wrapping mode.
 * - `anisotropy=1`: The texture's anisotropy value.
 * - `colorSpace=ColorSpace.No`: The texture's color space.
 * - `depthBuffer=true`: Whether to allocate a depth buffer or not.
 * - `stencilBuffer=false`: Whether to allocate a stencil buffer or not.
 * - `resolveColorBuffer=true`: Whether to resolve the color buffer or not. Only relevant for multisampled render targets.
 * - `resolveDepthBuffer=true`: Whether to resolve the depth buffer or not. Only relevant for multisampled render targets.
 * - `resolveStencilBuffer=true`: Whether to resolve the stencil buffer or not. Only relevant for multisampled render targets.
 * - `storeMultisampledColorBuffer=true`: Whether to store the multisampled color buffer or not. Setting to `false` saves memory bandwidth when the multisampled data are not needed after a render pass.
 * - `storeMultisampledDepthBuffer=true`: Whether to store the multisampled depth buffer or not. Setting to `false` saves memory bandwidth when the multisampled data are not needed after a render pass.
 * - `storeMultisampledStencilBuffer=true`: Whether to store the multisampled stencil buffer or not. Setting to `false` saves memory bandwidth when the multisampled data are not needed after a render pass.
 * - `depthTexture=null`: Reference to a depth texture.
 * - `samples=0`: The MSAA samples count.
 * - `count=1`: Defines the number of color attachments.
 * - `depth=1`: The texture depth.
 * - `multiview=false`: Whether this target is used for multiview rendering (WebGL OVR_multiview2 extension).
 * - `useArrayDepthTexture=false`: Whether to create the depth texture as an array texture for per-layer depth testing. This is separate from multiview so layered render targets can use array depth without the multiview extension.
 */
export type RenderTargetOptions = { wrapR?: Wrapping; mapping?: Mapping; flipY?: boolean } & Pick<
  Partial<Texture>,
  | "generateMipmaps"
  | "mipmapsAutoUpdate"
  | "magFilter"
  | "minFilter"
  | "format"
  | "type"
  | "internalFormat"
  | "wrapS"
  | "wrapT"
  | "anisotropy"
  | "colorSpace"
> & {
    depthBuffer?: boolean;
    stencilBuffer?: boolean;
    resolveColorBuffer?: boolean;
    resolveDepthBuffer?: boolean;
    resolveStencilBuffer?: boolean;
    storeMultisampledColorBuffer?: boolean;
    storeMultisampledDepthBuffer?: boolean;
    storeMultisampledStencilBuffer?: boolean;
    depthTexture?: DepthTexture | null;
    samples?: number;
    count?: number;
    depth?: number;
    multiview?: boolean;
    useArrayDepthTexture?: boolean;
  };
/**
 * A render target is a buffer where the video card draws pixels for a scene
 * that is being rendered in the background. It is used in different effects,
 * such as applying postprocessing to a rendered image before displaying it
 * on the screen.
 *
 */
export class RenderTarget extends EventDispatcher {
  isRenderTarget: boolean;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  depth: number;
  scissor: Vector4;
  scissorTest: boolean;
  viewport: Vector4;
  textures: Texture[];
  depthBuffer: boolean;
  stencilBuffer: boolean;
  resolveColorBuffer: boolean;
  resolveDepthBuffer: boolean;
  resolveStencilBuffer: boolean;
  storeMultisampledColorBuffer: boolean;
  storeMultisampledDepthBuffer: boolean;
  storeMultisampledStencilBuffer: boolean;
  _depthTexture: DepthTexture | null;
  samples: number;
  multiview: boolean;
  useArrayDepthTexture: boolean;

  /**
   * Constructs a new render target.
   *
   * @param [width=1] - The width of the render target.
   * @param [height=1] - The height of the render target.
   * @param [options] - The configuration object.
   */
  constructor(width: number = 1, height: number = 1, options: RenderTargetOptions = {}) {
    super();
    options = Object.assign(
      {
        generateMipmaps: false,
        internalFormat: null,
        minFilter: TextureFilter.Linear,
        depthBuffer: true,
        stencilBuffer: false,
        resolveColorBuffer: true,
        resolveDepthBuffer: true,
        resolveStencilBuffer: true,
        storeMultisampledColorBuffer: true,
        storeMultisampledDepthBuffer: true,
        storeMultisampledStencilBuffer: true,
        depthTexture: null,
        samples: 0,
        count: 1,
        depth: 1,
        multiview: false,
        useArrayDepthTexture: false,
      },
      options,
    );
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isRenderTarget = true;
    /**
     * The width of the render target.
     *
     * @default 1
     */
    this.width = width;
    /**
     * The height of the render target.
     *
     * @default 1
     */
    this.height = height;
    /**
     * The depth of the render target.
     *
     * @default 1
     */
    this.depth = (options as any).depth;
    /**
     * A rectangular area inside the render target's viewport. Fragments that are
     * outside the area will be discarded.
     *
     * @default (0,0,width,height)
     */
    this.scissor = new Vector4(0, 0, width, height);
    /**
     * Indicates whether the scissor test should be enabled when rendering into
     * this render target or not.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.scissorTest = false;
    /**
     * A rectangular area representing the render target's viewport.
     *
     * @default (0,0,width,height)
     */
    this.viewport = new Vector4(0, 0, width, height);
    /**
     * An array of textures. Each color attachment is represented as a separate texture.
     * Has at least a single entry for the default color attachment.
     *
     */
    this.textures = [];
    const count = (options as any).count;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      this.textures[i] = new Texture({ width: width, height: height, depth: this.depth });
      this.textures[i].isRenderTargetTexture = true;
      this.textures[i].renderTarget = this;
    }
    this._setTextureOptions(options);
    /**
     * Whether to allocate a depth buffer or not.
     *
     * @default true
     */
    this.depthBuffer = (options as any).depthBuffer;
    /**
     * Whether to allocate a stencil buffer or not.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.stencilBuffer = (options as any).stencilBuffer;
    /**
     * Whether to resolve the color buffer or not. When set to `false`, the color
     * attachments do not receive the resolved (single-sampled) output of a render
     * pass and the render target's textures are left untouched. The rendered
     * content is then only accessible within the render pass itself.
     *
     * Only relevant for multisampled render targets.
     *
     * @default true
     */
    this.resolveColorBuffer = (options as any).resolveColorBuffer;
    /**
     * Whether to resolve the depth buffer or not. When set to `false`, the depth
     * texture does not receive the resolved depth output of a render pass which
     * saves memory bandwidth. Use this setting when the depth data of a render
     * pass are not required afterwards.
     *
     * Only relevant for multisampled render targets.
     *
     * @default true
     */
    this.resolveDepthBuffer = (options as any).resolveDepthBuffer;
    /**
     * Whether to resolve the stencil buffer or not. Analogous to
     * {@link RenderTarget#resolveDepthBuffer} but for the stencil aspect.
     *
     * @default true
     */
    this.resolveStencilBuffer = (options as any).resolveStencilBuffer;
    /**
     * Whether to store the multisampled color buffer or not. When set to `false`,
     * the multisampled data are discarded at the end of a render pass, right after
     * they have been resolved. This saves memory bandwidth, especially on tile-based
     * GPUs, and is the recommended setting for render targets that are fully redrawn
     * each frame and whose output is only accessed via the resolved textures (e.g.
     * scene passes in post-processing chains).
     *
     * Must be kept `true` when the multisampled data are needed after the render
     * pass ends, e.g. when rendering into the target without clearing or when the
     * scene contains transmissive objects which require a mid-pass framebuffer copy.
     *
     * @default true
     */
    this.storeMultisampledColorBuffer = (options as any).storeMultisampledColorBuffer;
    /**
     * Whether to store the multisampled depth buffer or not. When set to `false`,
     * the multisampled depth data are discarded at the end of a render pass which
     * saves memory bandwidth.
     *
     * @default true
     */
    this.storeMultisampledDepthBuffer = (options as any).storeMultisampledDepthBuffer;
    /**
     * Whether to store the multisampled stencil buffer or not. Analogous to
     * {@link RenderTarget#storeMultisampledDepthBuffer} but for the stencil aspect.
     *
     * @default true
     */
    this.storeMultisampledStencilBuffer = (options as any).storeMultisampledStencilBuffer;
    this._depthTexture = null;
    this.depthTexture = (options as any).depthTexture;
    /**
     * The number of MSAA samples.
     *
     * A value of `0` disables MSAA.
     *
     * @default 0
     */
    this.samples = (options as any).samples;
    /**
     * Whether to this target is used in multiview rendering.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.multiview = (options as any).multiview;
    /**
     * Whether to create the depth texture as an array texture for per-layer depth testing.
     * This is separate from multiview so layered render targets can use array depth without
     * the multiview extension.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.useArrayDepthTexture = (options as any).useArrayDepthTexture;
  }
  _setTextureOptions(options: any = {}) {
    const values: any = {
      minFilter: TextureFilter.Linear,
      generateMipmaps: false,
      flipY: false,
      internalFormat: null,
    };
    if ((options as any).mapping !== undefined) (values as any).mapping = (options as any).mapping;
    if ((options as any).wrapS !== undefined) (values as any).wrapS = (options as any).wrapS;
    if ((options as any).wrapT !== undefined) (values as any).wrapT = (options as any).wrapT;
    if ((options as any).wrapR !== undefined) (values as any).wrapR = (options as any).wrapR;
    if ((options as any).magFilter !== undefined) (values as any).magFilter = (options as any).magFilter;
    if ((options as any).minFilter !== undefined) values.minFilter = (options as any).minFilter;
    if ((options as any).format !== undefined) (values as any).format = (options as any).format;
    if ((options as any).type !== undefined) (values as any).type = (options as any).type;
    if ((options as any).anisotropy !== undefined) (values as any).anisotropy = (options as any).anisotropy;
    if ((options as any).colorSpace !== undefined) (values as any).colorSpace = (options as any).colorSpace;
    if ((options as any).flipY !== undefined) values.flipY = (options as any).flipY;
    if ((options as any).generateMipmaps !== undefined) values.generateMipmaps = (options as any).generateMipmaps;
    if ((options as any).mipmapsAutoUpdate !== undefined)
      (values as any).mipmapsAutoUpdate = (options as any).mipmapsAutoUpdate;
    if ((options as any).internalFormat !== undefined) values.internalFormat = (options as any).internalFormat;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.textures.length; i++) {
      const texture = this.textures[i];
      texture.setValues(values);
    }
  }
  /**
   * The texture representing the default color attachment.
   *
   */
  get texture(): Texture {
    return this.textures[0];
  }
  set texture(value: Texture) {
    this.textures[0] = value;
  }
  set depthTexture(current: DepthTexture | null) {
    if (this._depthTexture !== null && this._depthTexture.renderTarget === this) this._depthTexture.renderTarget = null;
    if (current !== null && current.renderTarget === null) current.renderTarget = this;
    this._depthTexture = current;
  }
  /**
   * Instead of saving the depth in a renderbuffer, a texture
   * can be used instead which is useful for further processing
   * e.g. in context of post-processing.
   *
   * @default null
   */
  get depthTexture() {
    return this._depthTexture;
  }
  /**
   * Sets the size of this render target.
   *
   * @param width - The width.
   * @param height - The height.
   * @param [depth=1] - The depth.
   */
  setSize(width: number, height: number, depth: number = 1) {
    if (this.width !== width || this.height !== height || this.depth !== depth) {
      this.width = width;
      this.height = height;
      this.depth = depth;
      for (let i = 0, il = this.textures.length; i < il; i++) {
        this.textures[i].image.width = width;
        this.textures[i].image.height = height;
        this.textures[i].image.depth = depth;
        if ((this.textures[i] as any).isData3DTexture !== true) {
          // Fix for #31693
          // TODO: Reconsider setting isArrayTexture flag here and in the ctor of Texture.
          // Maybe a method `isArrayTexture()` or just a getter could replace a flag since
          // both are evaluated on each call?
          this.textures[i].isArrayTexture = this.textures[i].image.depth > 1;
        }
      }
      this.dispose();
    }
    this.viewport.set(0, 0, width, height);
    this.scissor.set(0, 0, width, height);
  }
  /**
   * Returns a new render target with copied values from this instance.
   *
   * @return A clone of this instance.
   */
  clone(): this {
    return new (this.constructor as any)().copy(this);
  }
  /**
   * Copies the settings of the given render target. This is a structural copy so
   * no resources are shared between render targets after the copy. That includes
   * all MRT textures and the depth texture.
   *
   * @param source - The render target to copy.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  copy(source: RenderTarget): this {
    this.width = source.width;
    this.height = source.height;
    this.depth = source.depth;
    this.scissor.copy(source.scissor);
    this.scissorTest = source.scissorTest;
    this.viewport.copy(source.viewport);
    this.textures.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0, il = source.textures.length; i < il; i++) {
      this.textures[i] = source.textures[i].clone();
      this.textures[i].isRenderTargetTexture = true;
      this.textures[i].renderTarget = this;
      // ensure image object is not shared, see #20328
      const image = Object.assign({}, source.textures[i].image);
      this.textures[i].source = new TextureSource(image);
    }
    this.depthBuffer = source.depthBuffer;
    this.stencilBuffer = source.stencilBuffer;
    this.resolveColorBuffer = source.resolveColorBuffer;
    this.resolveDepthBuffer = source.resolveDepthBuffer;
    this.resolveStencilBuffer = source.resolveStencilBuffer;
    this.storeMultisampledColorBuffer = source.storeMultisampledColorBuffer;
    this.storeMultisampledDepthBuffer = source.storeMultisampledDepthBuffer;
    this.storeMultisampledStencilBuffer = source.storeMultisampledStencilBuffer;
    if (source.depthTexture !== null) {
      if (source.depthTexture.renderTarget === source) {
        const depthTexture = source.depthTexture.clone();
        depthTexture.renderTarget = null;
        this.depthTexture = depthTexture;
      } else {
        this.depthTexture = source.depthTexture;
      }
    } else {
      this.depthTexture = null;
    }
    this.samples = source.samples;
    this.multiview = source.multiview;
    this.useArrayDepthTexture = source.useArrayDepthTexture;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Frees the GPU-related resources allocated by this instance. Call this
   * method whenever this instance is no longer used in your app.
   *
   * This also frees the resources of the render target's textures. There is
   * no need to dispose them separately.
   *
   * @fires RenderTarget#dispose
   */
  dispose() {
    this.dispatchEvent({ type: "dispose" });
  }
}
```

## ek3d/core/Timer

````typescript
/**
 * This class is an alternative to {@link Clock} with a different API design and behavior.
 * The goal is to avoid the conceptual flaws that became apparent in `Clock` over time.
 *
 * - `Timer` has an `update()` method that updates its internal state. That makes it possible to
 * call `getDelta()` and `getElapsed()` multiple times per simulation step without getting different values.
 * - The class can make use of the Page Visibility API to avoid large time delta values when the app
 * is inactive (e.g. tab switched or browser hidden).
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { Timer } from 'ek3d/core/Timer';
 *
 * const timer = new Timer();
 * timer.connect( document ); // use Page Visibility API
 * ```
 */
export class Timer {
  _previousTime: number;
  _currentTime: number;
  _startTime: number;
  _delta: number;
  _elapsed: number;
  _timescale: number;
  _document: Document | null;
  _pageVisibilityHandler: (() => void) | null;

  /**
   * Constructs a new timer.
   */
  constructor() {
    this._previousTime = 0;
    this._currentTime = 0;
    this._startTime = performance.now();
    this._delta = 0;
    this._elapsed = 0;
    this._timescale = 1;
    this._document = null;
    this._pageVisibilityHandler = null;
  }
  /**
   * Connect the timer to the given document.Calling this method is not mandatory to
   * use the timer but enables the usage of the Page Visibility API to avoid large time
   * delta values.
   *
   * @param document - The document.
   */
  connect(document: Document) {
    this._document = document;
    // use Page Visibility API to avoid large time delta values
    if (document.hidden !== undefined) {
      this._pageVisibilityHandler = handleVisibilityChange.bind(this);
      document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", this._pageVisibilityHandler, false);
    }
  }
  /**
   * Disconnects the timer from the DOM and also disables the usage of the Page Visibility API.
   */
  disconnect() {
    if (this._pageVisibilityHandler !== null) {
      this._document!.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", this._pageVisibilityHandler);
      this._pageVisibilityHandler = null;
    }
    this._document = null;
  }
  /**
   * Returns the time delta in seconds.
   *
   * @return The time delta in second.
   */
  getDelta(): number {
    return this._delta / 1000;
  }
  /**
   * Returns the elapsed time in seconds.
   *
   * @return The elapsed time in second.
   */
  getElapsed(): number {
    return this._elapsed / 1000;
  }
  /**
   * Returns the timescale.
   *
   * @return The timescale.
   */
  getTimescale(): number {
    return this._timescale;
  }
  /**
   * Sets the given timescale which scale the time delta computation
   * in `update()`.
   *
   * @param timescale - The timescale to set.
   * @return A reference to this timer.
   */
  setTimescale(timescale: number): Timer {
    this._timescale = timescale;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Resets the time computation for the current simulation step.
   *
   * @return A reference to this timer.
   */
  reset(): Timer {
    this._currentTime = performance.now() - this._startTime;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Can be used to free all internal resources. Usually called when
   * the timer instance isn't required anymore.
   */
  dispose() {
    this.disconnect();
  }
  /**
   * Updates the internal state of the timer. This method should be called
   * once per simulation step and before you perform queries against the timer
   * (e.g. via `getDelta()`).
   *
   * @param timestamp - The current time in milliseconds. Can be obtained
   * from the `requestAnimationFrame` callback argument. If not provided, the current
   * time will be determined with `performance.now`.
   * @return A reference to this timer.
   */
  update(timestamp?: number): Timer {
    if (this._pageVisibilityHandler !== null && this._document!.hidden === true) {
      this._delta = 0;
    } else {
      this._previousTime = this._currentTime;
      this._currentTime = (timestamp !== undefined ? timestamp : performance.now()) - this._startTime;
      this._delta = (this._currentTime - this._previousTime) * this._timescale;
      this._elapsed += this._delta; // _elapsed is the accumulation of all previous deltas
    }
    return this;
  }
}
function handleVisibilityChange(this: Timer) {
  if (this._document!.hidden === false) this.reset();
}
````

## ek3d/core/Uniform

````typescript
/**
 * Represents a uniform which is a global shader variable. They are passed to shader programs.
 *
 * When declaring a uniform of a {@link ShaderMaterial}, it is declared by value or by object.
 * ```ts
 * import { Uniform } from 'ek3d/core/Uniform';
 * import { Vector2 } from 'ek3d/math/Vector2';
 *
 * const uniforms = {
 * 	time: { value: 1.0 },
 * 	resolution: new Uniform( new Vector2() )
 * };
 * ```
 * Since this class can only be used in context of {@link ShaderMaterial}, it is only supported
 * in {@link WebGLRenderer}.
 */
export class Uniform<T = unknown> {
  value: T;
  type?: "float" | "int" | "uint";

  /**
   * Constructs a new uniform.
   *
   * @param value - The uniform value.
   */
  constructor(value: T) {
    /**
     * The uniform value.
     *
     */
    this.value = value;
  }
  /**
   * Returns a new uniform with copied values from this instance.
   * If the value has a `clone()` method, the value is cloned as well.
   *
   * @return A clone of this instance.
   */
  clone(): Uniform<T> {
    return new Uniform(
      (this.value as T & { clone(): T }).clone === undefined ? this.value : (this.value as T & { clone(): T }).clone(),
    );
  }
}

## ek3d/core/UniformsGroup

```typescript
import type { Uniform } from "./Uniform";
import { EventDispatcher } from "./EventDispatcher";
import { BufferUsage } from "../constants";
let _id = 0;
/**
 * A class for managing multiple uniforms in a single group. The renderer will process
 * such a definition as a single UBO.
 *
 * Since this class can only be used in context of {@link ShaderMaterial}, it is only supported
 * in {@link WebGLRenderer}.
 *
 */
export class UniformsGroup extends EventDispatcher {
  isUniformsGroup: boolean;
  name: string;
  usage: BufferUsage;
  uniforms: (Uniform | Uniform[])[];
  id!: number;

  /**
   * Constructs a new uniforms group.
   */
  constructor() {
    super();
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isUniformsGroup = true;
    /**
     * The ID of the 3D object.
     *
     * @name UniformsGroup#id
     * @readonly
     */
    Object.defineProperty(this, "id", { enumerable: false, configurable: false, writable: false, value: _id++ });
    /**
     * The name of the uniforms group.
     *
     */
    this.name = "";
    /**
     * The buffer usage.
     *
     * @default BufferUsage.StaticDraw
     */
    this.usage = BufferUsage.StaticDraw;
    /**
     * An array holding the uniforms.
     *
     */
    this.uniforms = [];
  }
  /**
   * Adds the given uniform to this uniforms group.
   *
   * @param uniform - The uniform to add.
   * @return A reference to this uniforms group.
   */
  add(uniform: Uniform | Uniform[]): UniformsGroup {
    this.uniforms.push(uniform);
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Removes the given uniform from this uniforms group.
   *
   * @param uniform - The uniform to remove.
   * @return A reference to this uniforms group.
   */
  remove(uniform: Uniform | Uniform[]): UniformsGroup {
    const index = this.uniforms.indexOf(uniform);
    if (index !== -1) this.uniforms.splice(index, 1);
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Sets the name of this uniforms group.
   *
   * @param name - The name to set.
   * @return A reference to this uniforms group.
   */
  setName(name: string): UniformsGroup {
    this.name = name;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Sets the usage of this uniforms group.
   *
   * @param value - The usage to set.
   * @return A reference to this uniforms group.
   */
  setUsage(value: BufferUsage): UniformsGroup {
    this.usage = value;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Frees the GPU-related resources allocated by this instance. Call this
   * method whenever this instance is no longer used in your app.
   *
   * @fires Texture#dispose
   */
  dispose() {
    this.dispatchEvent({ type: "dispose" });
  }
  /**
   * Copies the values of the given uniforms group to this instance.
   *
   * @param source - The uniforms group to copy.
   * @return A reference to this uniforms group.
   */
  copy(source: UniformsGroup): UniformsGroup {
    this.name = source.name;
    this.usage = source.usage;
    const uniformsSource = source.uniforms;
    this.uniforms.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0, l = uniformsSource.length; i < l; i++) {
      const uniform = uniformsSource[i];
      if (Array.isArray(uniform)) {
        this.uniforms.push(uniform.map((u) => u.clone()));
      } else {
        this.uniforms.push(uniform.clone());
      }
    }
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Returns a new uniforms group with copied values from this instance.
   *
   * @return A clone of this instance.
   */
  clone(): UniformsGroup {
    return new (this.constructor as any)().copy(this);
  }
}

## ek3d/extras/Controls

```typescript
import type { Object3D } from "../core/Object3D";
import { EventDispatcher } from "../core/EventDispatcher";
import type { MOUSE, TOUCH } from "../constants";

/**
 * Abstract base class for controls.
 *
 * The generic parameter preserves the concrete object type managed by a control so
 * subclasses can narrow it without redeclaring inherited fields.
 *
 *
 * @abstract
 */
export abstract class Controls<TObject extends Object3D = Object3D> extends EventDispatcher {
  /**
   * The object that is managed by the controls.
   */
  object: TObject;

  /**
   * The HTML element used for event listeners.
   *
   * @default null
   */
  domElement: HTMLElement | null;

  /**
   * Whether the controls respond to user input or not.
   *
   * @default true
   */
  enabled: boolean = true;

  /**
   * The internal state of the controls.
   *
   * @default -1
   */
  state: number = -1;

  /**
   * This object defines the keyboard input of the controls. Camera controls keep named
   * bindings (`Record<string, string>`); key-driven controls like TrackballControls use
   * positional key codes (`string[]`).
   */
  keys: Record<string, string> | string[] = {};

  /**
   * This object defines what type of actions are assigned to the available mouse buttons.
   * It depends on the control implementation what kind of mouse buttons and actions are supported.
   */
  mouseButtons: { LEFT: MOUSE | null; MIDDLE: MOUSE | null; RIGHT: MOUSE | null } = {
    LEFT: null,
    MIDDLE: null,
    RIGHT: null,
  };

  /**
   * This object defines what type of actions are assigned to what kind of touch interaction.
   * It depends on the control implementation what kind of touch interaction and actions are supported.
   */
  touches: { ONE: TOUCH | null; TWO: TOUCH | null } = { ONE: null, TWO: null };

  /**
   * Constructs a new controls instance.
   *
   * @param object - The object that is managed by the controls.
   * @param domElement - The HTML element used for event listeners.
   */
  constructor(object: TObject, domElement: HTMLElement | null = null) {
    super();
    this.object = object;
    this.domElement = domElement;
  }

  /**
   * Connects the controls to the DOM. This method has so called "side effects" since
   * it adds the module's event listeners to the DOM.
   *
   * @param element - The DOM element to connect to.
   */
  connect(element: HTMLElement): void {
    if (this.domElement !== null) this.disconnect();
    this.domElement = element;
  }

  /**
   * Disconnects the controls from the DOM and removes their event listeners.
   */
  abstract disconnect(): void;

  /**
   * Call this method if you no longer want to use the controls. It frees all internal
   * resources and removes all event listeners.
   */
  abstract dispose(): void;

  /**
   * Controls should implement this method if they have to update their internal state
   * per simulation step.
   *
   * @param deltaTime - The time delta in seconds.
   */
  abstract update(deltaTime?: number): void;
}

## ek3d/extras/DataUtils

```typescript
import { clamp } from "../math/MathUtils";
import { warn } from "../utils";
// Fast Half Float Conversions, http://www.fox-toolkit.org/ftp/fasthalffloatconversion.pdf
const _tables = /*@__PURE__*/ _generateTables();
function _generateTables() {
  // float32 to float16 helpers
  const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(4);
  const floatView = new Float32Array(buffer);
  const uint32View = new Uint32Array(buffer);
  const baseTable = new Uint32Array(512);
  const shiftTable = new Uint32Array(512);
  for (let i = 0; i < 256; ++i) {
    const e = i - 127;
    // very small number (0, -0)
    if (e < -27) {
      (baseTable as any)[i] = 0x0000;
      (baseTable as any)[i | 0x100] = 0x8000;
      (shiftTable as any)[i] = 24;
      (shiftTable as any)[i | 0x100] = 24;
      // small number (denorm)
    } else if (e < -14) {
      (baseTable as any)[i] = 0x0400 >> (-e - 14);
      (baseTable as any)[i | 0x100] = (0x0400 >> (-e - 14)) | 0x8000;
      (shiftTable as any)[i] = -e - 1;
      (shiftTable as any)[i | 0x100] = -e - 1;
      // normal number
    } else if (e <= 15) {
      (baseTable as any)[i] = (e + 15) << 10;
      (baseTable as any)[i | 0x100] = ((e + 15) << 10) | 0x8000;
      (shiftTable as any)[i] = 13;
      (shiftTable as any)[i | 0x100] = 13;
      // large number (Infinity, -Infinity)
    } else if (e < 128) {
      (baseTable as any)[i] = 0x7c00;
      (baseTable as any)[i | 0x100] = 0xfc00;
      (shiftTable as any)[i] = 24;
      (shiftTable as any)[i | 0x100] = 24;
      // stay (NaN, Infinity, -Infinity)
    } else {
      (baseTable as any)[i] = 0x7c00;
      (baseTable as any)[i | 0x100] = 0xfc00;
      (shiftTable as any)[i] = 13;
      (shiftTable as any)[i | 0x100] = 13;
    }
  }
  // float16 to float32 helpers
  const mantissaTable = new Uint32Array(2048);
  const exponentTable = new Uint32Array(64);
  const offsetTable = new Uint32Array(64);
  for (let i = 1; i < 1024; ++i) {
    let m = i << 13; // zero pad mantissa bits
    let e = 0; // zero exponent
    // normalized
    while ((m & 0x00800000) === 0) {
      m <<= 1;
      e -= 0x00800000; // decrement exponent
    }
    m &= ~0x00800000; // clear leading 1 bit
    e += 0x38800000; // adjust bias
    (mantissaTable as any)[i] = m | e;
  }
  for (let i = 1024; i < 2048; ++i) {
    (mantissaTable as any)[i] = 0x38000000 + ((i - 1024) << 13);
  }
  for (let i = 1; i < 31; ++i) {
    (exponentTable as any)[i] = i << 23;
  }
  (exponentTable as any)[31] = 0x47800000;
  (exponentTable as any)[32] = 0x80000000;
  for (let i = 33; i < 63; ++i) {
    (exponentTable as any)[i] = 0x80000000 + ((i - 32) << 23);
  }
  (exponentTable as any)[63] = 0xc7800000;
  for (let i = 1; i < 64; ++i) {
    if (i !== 32) {
      (offsetTable as any)[i] = 1024;
    }
  }
  return {
    floatView: floatView,
    uint32View: uint32View,
    baseTable: baseTable,
    shiftTable: shiftTable,
    mantissaTable: mantissaTable,
    exponentTable: exponentTable,
    offsetTable: offsetTable,
  };
}
/**
 * Returns a half precision floating point value (FP16) from the given single
 * precision floating point value (FP32).
 *
 * @param val - A single precision floating point value.
 * @return The FP16 value.
 */
export function toHalfFloat(val: number): number {
  if (Math.abs(val) > 65504) warn("DataUtils.toHalfFloat(): Value out of range.");
  val = clamp(val, -65504, 65504);
  (_tables.floatView as any)[0] = val;
  const f = (_tables.uint32View as any)[0];
  const e = (f >> 23) & 0x1ff;
  return (_tables.baseTable as any)[e] + ((f & 0x007fffff) >> (_tables.shiftTable as any)[e]);
}
/**
 * Returns a single precision floating point value (FP32) from the given half
 * precision floating point value (FP16).
 *
 * @param val - A half precision floating point value.
 * @return The FP32 value.
 */
export function fromHalfFloat(val: number): number {
  const m = val >> 10;
  (_tables.uint32View as any)[0] =
    (_tables.mantissaTable as any)[(_tables.offsetTable as any)[m] + (val & 0x3ff)] + (_tables.exponentTable as any)[m];
  return (_tables.floatView as any)[0];
}

 * @hideconstructor
 */

import { earcut } from "./lib/earcut";

## ek3d/extras/ImageUtils

```typescript
import { createElementNS, warn } from "../utils";
import { SRGBToLinear } from "../math/ColorManagement";
let _canvas: any;
/**
 * A class containing utility functions for images.
 *
 * @hideconstructor
 */
export class ImageUtils {
  /**
   * Returns a data URI containing a representation of the given image.
   *
   * @param image - The image object.
   * @param [type='image/png'] - Indicates the image format.
   * @return The data URI.
   */
  static getDataURL(image: HTMLCanvasElement | HTMLImageElement | ImageBitmap, type?: string): string;
  static getDataURL(image?: any, type: string = "image/png"): string {
    if (/^data:/i.test((image as any).src)) {
      return (image as any).src;
    }
    if (typeof HTMLCanvasElement === "undefined") {
      return (image as any).src;
    }
    let canvas: any;
    if (image instanceof HTMLCanvasElement) {
      canvas = image;
    } else {
      if (_canvas === undefined) _canvas = createElementNS("canvas") as HTMLCanvasElement;
      _canvas.width = image.width;
      _canvas.height = image.height;
      const context = _canvas.getContext("2d");
      if (image instanceof ImageData) {
        context.putImageData(image, 0, 0);
      } else {
        context.drawImage(image, 0, 0, image.width, image.height);
      }
      canvas = _canvas;
    }
    return canvas.toDataURL(type);
  }
  /**
   * Converts the given sRGB image data to linear color space.
   *
   * @param image - The image object.
   * @return The converted image.
   */
  static sRGBToLinear(image?: any) {
    if (
      (typeof HTMLImageElement !== "undefined" && image instanceof HTMLImageElement) ||
      (typeof HTMLCanvasElement !== "undefined" && image instanceof HTMLCanvasElement) ||
      (typeof ImageBitmap !== "undefined" && image instanceof ImageBitmap)
    ) {
      const canvas = createElementNS("canvas") as HTMLCanvasElement;
      (canvas as any).width = image.width;
      (canvas as any).height = image.height;
      const context = (canvas as any).getContext("2d");
      context.drawImage(image, 0, 0, image.width, image.height);
      const imageData = context.getImageData(0, 0, image.width, image.height);
      const data = imageData.data;
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
        data[i] = SRGBToLinear(data[i] / 255) * 255;
      }
      context.putImageData(imageData, 0, 0);
      return canvas;
    } else if (image.data) {
      const data = image.data.slice(0);
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
        if (data instanceof Uint8Array || data instanceof Uint8ClampedArray) {
          (data as any)[i] = Math.floor(SRGBToLinear((data as any)[i] / 255) * 255);
        } else {
          // assuming float
          data[i] = SRGBToLinear(data[i]);
        }
      }
      return {
        data: data,
        width: image.width,
        height: image.height,
      };
    } else {
      warn("ImageUtils.sRGBToLinear(): Unsupported image type. No color space conversion applied.");
      return image;
    }
  }
}
