## ek3d/lights/LightProbe

```typescript
import { SphericalHarmonics3 } from "../math/SphericalHarmonics3";
import { Light } from "./Light";
/**
 * Light probes are an alternative way of adding light to a 3D scene. Unlike
 * classical light sources (e.g. directional, point or spot lights), light
 * probes do not emit light. Instead they store information about light
 * passing through 3D space. During rendering, the light that hits a 3D
 * object is approximated by using the data from the light probe.
 *
 * Light probes are usually created from (radiance) environment maps. The
 * class {@link LightProbeGenerator} can be used to create light probes from
 * cube textures or render targets, or supplied directly as spherical harmonic coefficients.
 *
 * The current probe implementation in three.js supports so-called diffuse
 * light probes. This type of light probe is functionally equivalent to an
 * irradiance environment map.
 *
 */
export class LightProbe extends Light {
  isLightProbe: boolean;

  sh: SphericalHarmonics3;

  /**
   * Constructs a new light probe.
   *
   * @param sh - The spherical harmonics which represents encoded lighting information.
   * @param [intensity=1] - The light's strength/intensity.
   */
  constructor(sh: SphericalHarmonics3 = new SphericalHarmonics3(), intensity: number = 1) {
    super(undefined, intensity);
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isLightProbe = true;
    this.type = "LightProbe";
    /**
     * A light probe uses spherical harmonics to encode lighting information.
     *
     */
    this.sh = sh;
  }
  copy(source: LightProbe): this {
    super.copy(source);
    this.sh.copy(source.sh);
    return this;
  }
  toJSON(meta?: any) {
    const data = super.toJSON(meta);
    data.object.sh = this.sh.toArray();
    return data;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/lights/LightShadow

```typescript
import type { Camera } from "../cameras/Camera";
import type { Light } from "./Light";
import type { RenderTarget } from "../core/RenderTarget";
import { Matrix4 } from "../math/Matrix4";
import { Vector2 } from "../math/Vector2";
import { Vector3 } from "../math/Vector3";
import { Vector4 } from "../math/Vector4";
import { Frustum } from "../math/Frustum";
import { TextureType } from "../constants";
const _projScreenMatrix = /*@__PURE__*/ new Matrix4();
const _lightPositionWorld = /*@__PURE__*/ new Vector3();
const _lookTarget = /*@__PURE__*/ new Vector3();
/**
 * Abstract base class for light shadow classes. These classes
 * represent the shadow configuration for different light types.
 *
 * @abstract
 */
export class LightShadow<TCamera extends Camera = Camera> {
  camera: TCamera;
  intensity: number;
  bias: number;
  normalBias: number;
  radius: number;
  blurSamples: number;
  mapSize: Vector2;
  mapType: TextureType;
  map: RenderTarget | null;
  mapPass: RenderTarget | null;
  matrix: Matrix4;
  autoUpdate: boolean;
  needsUpdate: boolean;
  _frustum: Frustum;
  _frameExtents: Vector2;
  _viewportCount: number;
  _viewports: Vector4[];

  /**
   * Constructs a new light shadow.
   *
   * @param camera - The light's view of the world.
   */
  constructor(camera: NoInfer<TCamera>) {
    /**
     * The light's view of the world.
     *
     */
    this.camera = camera;
    /**
     * The intensity of the shadow. The default is `1`.
     * Valid values are in the range `[0, 1]`.
     *
     * @default 1
     */
    this.intensity = 1;
    /**
     * Shadow map bias, how much to add or subtract from the normalized depth
     * when deciding whether a surface is in shadow.
     *
     * The default is `0`. Very tiny adjustments here (in the order of `0.0001`)
     * may help reduce artifacts in shadows.
     *
     * @default 0
     */
    this.bias = 0;
    /**
     * Defines how much the position used to query the shadow map is offset along
     * the object normal. The default is `0`. Increasing this value can be used to
     * reduce shadow acne especially in large scenes where light shines onto
     * geometry at a shallow angle. The cost is that shadows may appear distorted.
     *
     * @default 0
     */
    this.normalBias = 0;
    /**
     * Setting this to values greater than 1 will blur the edges of the shadow.
     * High values will cause unwanted banding effects in the shadows - a greater
     * map size will allow for a higher value to be used here before these effects
     * become visible.
     *
     * The property has no effect when the shadow map type is `ShadowMap.Basic`.
     *
     * @default 1
     */
    this.radius = 1;
    /**
     * The amount of samples to use when blurring a VSM shadow map.
     *
     * @default 8
     */
    this.blurSamples = 8;
    /**
     * Defines the width and height of the shadow map. Higher values give better quality
     * shadows at the cost of computation time. Values must be powers of two.
     *
     * @default (512,512)
     */
    this.mapSize = new Vector2(512, 512);
    /**
     * The type of shadow texture. The default is `TextureType.UnsignedByte`.
     *
     * @default TextureType.UnsignedByte
     */
    this.mapType = TextureType.UnsignedByte;
    /**
     * The depth map generated using the internal camera; a location beyond a
     * pixel's depth is in shadow. Computed internally during rendering.
     *
     * @default null
     */
    this.map = null;
    /**
     * The distribution map generated using the internal camera; an occlusion is
     * calculated based on the distribution of depths. Computed internally during
     * rendering.
     *
     * @default null
     */
    this.mapPass = null;
    /**
     * Model to shadow camera space, to compute location and depth in shadow map.
     * This is computed internally during rendering.
     *
     */
    this.matrix = new Matrix4();
    /**
     * Enables automatic updates of the light's shadow. If you do not require dynamic
     * lighting / shadows, you may set this to `false`.
     *
     * @default true
     */
    this.autoUpdate = true;
    /**
     * When set to `true`, shadow maps will be updated in the next `render` call.
     * If you have set {@link LightShadow#autoUpdate} to `false`, you will need to
     * set this property to `true` and then make a render call to update the light's shadow.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.needsUpdate = false;
    this._frustum = new Frustum();
    this._frameExtents = new Vector2(1, 1);
    this._viewportCount = 1;
    this._viewports = [new Vector4(0, 0, 1, 1)];
  }
  /**
   * Used internally by the renderer to get the number of viewports that need
   * to be rendered for this shadow.
   *
   * @return The viewport count.
   */
  getViewportCount(): number {
    return this._viewportCount;
  }
  /**
   * Used internally by the renderer to get the camera that renders the given viewport.
   *
   * @param [viewportIndex=0] - The viewport index.
   * @return The shadow camera.
   */
  getCamera(/* viewportIndex */): Camera {
    return this.camera;
  }
  /**
   * Gets the shadow cameras frustum. Used internally by the renderer to cull objects.
   *
   * @return The shadow camera frustum.
   */
  getFrustum(): Frustum {
    return this._frustum;
  }
  /**
   * Update the matrices for the camera and shadow, used internally by the renderer.
   *
   * @param light - The light for which the shadow is being rendered.
   */
  updateMatrices(light: Light) {
    const shadowCamera = this.camera;
    _lightPositionWorld.setFromMatrixPosition(light.matrixWorld);
    shadowCamera.position.copy(_lightPositionWorld);
    _lookTarget.setFromMatrixPosition((light as any).target.matrixWorld);
    shadowCamera.lookAt(_lookTarget);
    shadowCamera.updateMatrixWorld();
    this._updateMatrix(shadowCamera, this.matrix, this._frustum);
  }
  /**
   * Updates a shadow projection matrix and its corresponding frustum.
   *
   * @private
   * @param shadowCamera - The shadow camera.
   * @param shadowMatrix - The target shadow matrix.
   * @param frustum - The target frustum.
   * @param [viewport] - The viewport within the shadow atlas.
   */
  _updateMatrix(shadowCamera: Camera, shadowMatrix: Matrix4, frustum: Frustum, viewport?: Vector4) {
    _projScreenMatrix.multiplyMatrices(shadowCamera.projectionMatrix, shadowCamera.matrixWorldInverse);
    frustum.setFromProjectionMatrix(_projScreenMatrix, shadowCamera.coordinateSystem, shadowCamera.reversedDepth);
    const frameExtents = this._frameExtents;
    const scaleX = viewport ? viewport.z / frameExtents.x : 1;
    const scaleY = viewport ? viewport.w / frameExtents.y : 1;
    const offsetX = viewport ? viewport.x / frameExtents.x : 0;
    const offsetY = viewport ? viewport.y / frameExtents.y : 0;
    if (shadowCamera.reversedDepth) {
      shadowMatrix.set(
        0.5 * scaleX,
        0.0,
        0.0,
        0.5 * scaleX + offsetX,
        0.0,
        0.5 * scaleY,
        0.0,
        0.5 * scaleY + offsetY,
        0.0,
        0.0,
        1.0,
        0.0, // Identity Z (preserving the correct [0, 1] range from the projection matrix)
        0.0,
        0.0,
        0.0,
        1.0,
      );
    } else {
      shadowMatrix.set(
        0.5 * scaleX,
        0.0,
        0.0,
        0.5 * scaleX + offsetX,
        0.0,
        0.5 * scaleY,
        0.0,
        0.5 * scaleY + offsetY,
        0.0,
        0.0,
        0.5,
        0.5,
        0.0,
        0.0,
        0.0,
        1.0,
      );
    }
    shadowMatrix.multiply(_projScreenMatrix);
  }
  /**
   * Returns a viewport definition for the given viewport index.
   *
   * @param viewportIndex - The viewport index.
   * @return The viewport.
   */
  getViewport(viewportIndex: number): Vector4 {
    return this._viewports[viewportIndex];
  }
  /**
   * Returns the frame extends.
   *
   * @return The frame extends.
   */
  getFrameExtents(): Vector2 {
    return this._frameExtents;
  }
  /**
   * Frees the GPU-related resources allocated by this instance. Call this
   * method whenever this instance is no longer used in your app.
   */
  dispose() {
    if (this.map) {
      this.map.dispose();
    }
    if (this.mapPass) {
      this.mapPass.dispose();
    }
  }
  /**
   * Copies the values of the given light shadow instance to this instance.
   *
   * @param source - The light shadow to copy.
   * @return A reference to this light shadow instance.
   */
  copy(source: LightShadow): this {
    this.camera = source.camera.clone() as TCamera;
    this.intensity = source.intensity;
    this.bias = source.bias;
    this.radius = source.radius;
    this.autoUpdate = source.autoUpdate;
    this.needsUpdate = source.needsUpdate;
    this.normalBias = source.normalBias;
    this.blurSamples = source.blurSamples;
    this.mapSize.copy(source.mapSize);
    this.mapType = source.mapType;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Returns a new light shadow instance with copied values from this instance.
   *
   * @return A clone of this instance.
   */
  clone(_recursive?: boolean): this {
    return new (this.constructor as any)().copy(this);
  }
  /**
   * Serializes the light shadow into JSON.
   *
   * @return A JSON object representing the serialized light shadow.
   * @see {@link ObjectLoader#parse}
   */
  toJSON() {
    const object: any = {};
    object.intensity = this.intensity;
    object.bias = this.bias;
    object.normalBias = this.normalBias;
    object.radius = this.radius;
    object.blurSamples = this.blurSamples;
    object.mapSize = this.mapSize.toArray();
    object.mapType = this.mapType;
    object.camera = this.camera.toJSON(false).object;
    delete object.camera.matrix;
    return object;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/lights/PointLight

````typescript
import type { Color } from "../math/Color";
import { Light } from "./Light";
import { PointLightShadow } from "./PointLightShadow";
/**
 * A light that gets emitted from a single point in all directions. A common
 * use case for this is to replicate the light emitted from a bare
 * lightbulb.
 *
 * This light can cast shadows - see the {@link PointLightShadow} for details.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { PointLight } from 'ek3d/lights/PointLight';
 * import { Scene } from 'ek3d/scenes/Scene';
 *
 * const scene = new Scene();
 *
 * const light = new PointLight( 0xff0000, 1, 100 );
 * light.position.set( 50, 50, 50 );
 * scene.add( light );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class PointLight extends Light {
  isPointLight: boolean;

  distance: number;
  decay: number;
  shadow: PointLightShadow;

  /**
   * Constructs a new point light.
   *
   * @param [color=0xffffff] - The light's color.
   * @param [intensity=1] - The light's strength/intensity measured in candela (cd).
   * @param [distance=0] - Maximum range of the light. `0` means no limit.
   * @param [decay=2] - The amount the light dims along the distance of the light.
   */
  constructor(color?: number | Color | string, intensity?: number, distance: number = 0, decay: number = 2) {
    super(color, intensity);
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isPointLight = true;
    this.type = "PointLight";
    /**
     * When distance is zero, light will attenuate according to inverse-square
     * law to infinite distance. When distance is non-zero, light will attenuate
     * according to inverse-square law until near the distance cutoff, where it
     * will then attenuate quickly and smoothly to 0. Inherently, cutoffs are not
     * physically correct.
     *
     * @default 0
     */
    this.distance = distance;
    /**
     * The amount the light dims along the distance of the light. In context of
     * physically-correct rendering the default value should not be changed.
     *
     * @default 2
     */
    this.decay = decay;
    /**
     * This property holds the light's shadow configuration.
     *
     */
    this.shadow = new PointLightShadow();
  }
  /**
   * The light's power. Power is the luminous power of the light measured in lumens (lm).
   * Changing the power will also change the light's intensity.
   *
   */
  get power() {
    // compute the light's luminous power (in lumens) from its intensity (in candela)
    // for an isotropic light source, luminous power (lm) = 4 π luminous intensity (cd)
    return this.intensity * 4 * Math.PI;
  }
  set power(power: number) {
    // set the light's intensity (in candela) from the desired luminous power (in lumens)
    this.intensity = power / (4 * Math.PI);
  }
  dispose() {
    super.dispose();
    this.shadow.dispose();
  }
  copy(source: any, recursive?: any): this {
    super.copy(source, recursive);
    this.distance = source.distance;
    this.decay = source.decay;
    this.shadow = source.shadow.clone();
    return this;
  }
  toJSON(meta?: any) {
    const data = super.toJSON(meta);
    data.object.distance = this.distance;
    data.object.decay = this.decay;
    data.object.shadow = this.shadow.toJSON();
    return data;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/lights/RectAreaLight

````typescript
import type { Color } from "../math/Color";
import { Light } from "./Light";
/**
 * This class emits light uniformly across the face a rectangular plane.
 * This light type can be used to simulate light sources such as bright
 * windows or strip lighting.
 *
 * Important Notes:
 *
 * - There is no shadow support.
 * - Only PBR materials are supported.
 * - Pass caller-owned textures from `createLTCTextures()` as the renderer `ltcTextures` option.
 * Dispose all four textures when they are no longer used.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { RectAreaLight } from 'ek3d/lights/RectAreaLight';
 * import { Scene } from 'ek3d/scenes/Scene';
 * import { WebGLRenderer } from 'ek3d/renderers/WebGLRenderer';
 * import { createDFGLUT } from 'ek3d/renderers/shaders/DFGLUTData';
 * import { createLTCTextures } from 'ek3d/renderers/shaders/LTCTextures';
 * import { standardShader } from 'ek3d/renderers/shaders/StandardShader';
 *
 * const scene = new Scene();
 *
 * const ltcTextures = createLTCTextures();
 * const dfgLUT = createDFGLUT();
 * const renderer = new WebGLRenderer( { ltcTextures, getDFGLUT: () => dfgLUT, shaders: { MeshStandardMaterial: standardShader } } );
 *
 * const intensity = 1; const width = 10; const height = 10;
 * const rectLight = new RectAreaLight( 0xffffff, intensity, width, height );
 * rectLight.position.set( 5, 5, 0 );
 * rectLight.lookAt( 0, 0, 0 );
 * scene.add( rectLight )
 * ```
 *
 */
export class RectAreaLight extends Light {
  isRectAreaLight: boolean;

  width: number;
  height: number;

  /**
   * Constructs a new area light.
   *
   * @param [color=0xffffff] - The light's color.
   * @param [intensity=1] - The light's strength/intensity.
   * @param [width=10] - The width of the light.
   * @param [height=10] - The height of the light.
   */
  constructor(color?: number | Color | string, intensity?: number, width: number = 10, height: number = 10) {
    super(color, intensity);
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isRectAreaLight = true;
    this.type = "RectAreaLight";
    /**
     * The width of the light.
     *
     * @default 10
     */
    this.width = width;
    /**
     * The height of the light.
     *
     * @default 10
     */
    this.height = height;
  }
  /**
   * The light's power. Power is the luminous power of the light measured in lumens (lm).
   * Changing the power will also change the light's intensity.
   *
   */
  get power() {
    // compute the light's luminous power (in lumens) from its intensity (in nits)
    return this.intensity * this.width * this.height * Math.PI;
  }
  set power(power: number) {
    // set the light's intensity (in nits) from the desired luminous power (in lumens)
    this.intensity = power / (this.width * this.height * Math.PI);
  }
  copy(source: RectAreaLight): this {
    super.copy(source);
    this.width = source.width;
    this.height = source.height;
    return this;
  }
  toJSON(meta?: any) {
    const data = super.toJSON(meta);
    data.object.width = this.width;
    data.object.height = this.height;
    return data;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/lights/SpotLight

````typescript
import type { Color } from "../math/Color";
import type { Texture } from "../textures/Texture";
import { Light } from "./Light";
import { SpotLightShadow } from "./SpotLightShadow";
import { Object3D } from "../core/Object3D";
/**
 * This light gets emitted from a single point in one direction, along a cone
 * that increases in size the further from the light it gets.
 *
 * This light can cast shadows - see the {@link SpotLightShadow} for details.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { SpotLight } from 'ek3d/lights/SpotLight';
 * import { TextureLoader } from 'ek3d/loaders/TextureLoader';
 *
 * // white spotlight shining from the side, modulated by a texture
 * const spotLight = new SpotLight( 0xffffff );
 * spotLight.position.set( 100, 1000, 100 );
 * spotLight.map = new TextureLoader().load( 'spotlight.png' );
 *
 * spotLight.castShadow = true;
 * spotLight.shadow.mapSize.width = 1024;
 * spotLight.shadow.mapSize.height = 1024;
 * spotLight.shadow.camera.near = 500;
 * spotLight.shadow.camera.far = 4000;
 * spotLight.shadow.camera.fov = 30;
 * ```
 *
 */
export class SpotLight extends Light {
  isSpotLight: boolean;

  target: Object3D;
  distance: number;
  angle: number;
  penumbra: number;
  decay: number;
  map: Texture | null;
  shadow: SpotLightShadow;

  /**
   * Constructs a new spot light.
   *
   * @param [color=0xffffff] - The light's color.
   * @param [intensity=1] - The light's strength/intensity measured in candela (cd).
   * @param [distance=0] - Maximum range of the light. `0` means no limit.
   * @param [angle=Math.PI/3] - Maximum angle of light dispersion from its direction whose upper bound is `Math.PI/2`.
   * @param [penumbra=0] - Percent of the spotlight cone that is attenuated due to penumbra. Value range is `[0,1]`.
   * @param [decay=2] - The amount the light dims along the distance of the light.
   */
  constructor(
    color?: number | Color | string,
    intensity?: number,
    distance: number = 0,
    angle: number = Math.PI / 3,
    penumbra: number = 0,
    decay: number = 2,
  ) {
    super(color, intensity);
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isSpotLight = true;
    this.type = "SpotLight";
    (this as any).position.copy(Object3D.DEFAULT_UP);
    this.updateMatrix();
    /**
     * The spot light points from its position to the
     * target's position.
     *
     * For the target's position to be changed to anything other
     * than the default, it must be added to the scene.
     *
     * It is also possible to set the target to be another 3D object
     * in the scene. The light will now track the target object.
     *
     */
    this.target = new Object3D();
    /**
     * Maximum range of the light. `0` means no limit.
     *
     * @default 0
     */
    this.distance = distance;
    /**
     * Maximum angle of light dispersion from its direction whose upper bound is `Math.PI/2`.
     *
     * @default Math.PI/3
     */
    this.angle = angle;
    /**
     * Percent of the spotlight cone that is attenuated due to penumbra.
     * Value range is `[0,1]`.
     *
     * @default 0
     */
    this.penumbra = penumbra;
    /**
     * The amount the light dims along the distance of the light. In context of
     * physically-correct rendering the default value should not be changed.
     *
     * @default 2
     */
    this.decay = decay;
    /**
     * A texture whose RGB multiplies the spot light color in WebGL; alpha is ignored.
     *
     * The texture also works when {@link Object3D#castShadow} is `false`.
     *
     * @default null
     */
    this.map = null;
    /**
     * This property holds the light's shadow configuration.
     *
     */
    this.shadow = new SpotLightShadow();
  }
  /**
   * The light's power. Power is the luminous power of the light measured in lumens (lm).
   *  Changing the power will also change the light's intensity.
   *
   */
  get power() {
    // compute the light's luminous power (in lumens) from its intensity (in candela)
    // by convention for a spotlight, luminous power (lm) = π * luminous intensity (cd)
    return this.intensity * Math.PI;
  }
  set power(power: number) {
    // set the light's intensity (in candela) from the desired luminous power (in lumens)
    this.intensity = power / Math.PI;
  }
  dispose() {
    super.dispose();
    this.shadow.dispose();
  }
  copy(source: SpotLight, recursive?: boolean): this {
    super.copy(source, recursive);
    this.distance = source.distance;
    this.angle = source.angle;
    this.penumbra = source.penumbra;
    this.decay = source.decay;
    this.target = source.target.clone();
    this.map = source.map;
    this.shadow = source.shadow.clone();
    return this;
  }
  toJSON(meta?: any) {
    const data = super.toJSON(meta);
    data.object.distance = this.distance;
    data.object.angle = this.angle;
    data.object.decay = this.decay;
    data.object.penumbra = this.penumbra;
    data.object.target = this.target.uuid;
    if (this.map && this.map.isTexture) data.object.map = this.map.toJSON(meta).uuid;
    data.object.shadow = this.shadow.toJSON();
    return data;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/lights/SpotLightShadow

```typescript
import type { SpotLight } from "./SpotLight";
import { LightShadow } from "./LightShadow";
import { RAD2DEG } from "../math/MathUtils";
import { PerspectiveCamera } from "../cameras/PerspectiveCamera";
/**
 * Represents the shadow configuration of directional lights.
 *
 */
export class SpotLightShadow extends LightShadow<PerspectiveCamera> {
  isSpotLightShadow: boolean;
  focus: number;
  aspect: number;

  /**
   * Constructs a new spot light shadow.
   */
  constructor() {
    super(new PerspectiveCamera(50, 1, 0.5, 500));
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isSpotLightShadow = true;
    /**
     * Used to focus the shadow camera. The camera's field of view is set as a
     * percentage of the spotlight's field-of-view. Range is `[0, 1]`.
     *
     * @default 1
     */
    this.focus = 1;
    /**
     * Texture aspect ratio.
     *
     * @default 1
     */
    this.aspect = 1;
  }
  updateMatrices(light: SpotLight) {
    const camera = this.camera;
    const fov = RAD2DEG * 2 * light.angle * this.focus;
    const aspect = (this.mapSize.width / this.mapSize.height) * this.aspect;
    const far = light.distance || camera.far;
    if (fov !== camera.fov || aspect !== camera.aspect || far !== camera.far) {
      camera.fov = fov;
      camera.aspect = aspect;
      camera.far = far;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    }
    super.updateMatrices(light);
  }
  copy(source: SpotLightShadow): this {
    super.copy(source);
    this.focus = source.focus;
    this.aspect = source.aspect;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Serializes the light shadow into JSON.
   *
   * @return A JSON object representing the serialized light shadow.
   * @see {@link ObjectLoader#parse}
   */
  toJSON() {
    const object = super.toJSON();
    object.focus = this.focus;
    object.aspect = this.aspect;
    return object;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/loaders/AnimationLoader

````typescript
import type { LoadingManager } from "./LoadingManager";
import { AnimationClip } from "../animation/AnimationClip";
import { FileLoader } from "./FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "./Loader";
import { error } from "../utils";
/**
 * Class for loading animation clips in the JSON format. The files are internally
 * loaded via {@link FileLoader}.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { AnimationLoader } from 'ek3d/loaders/AnimationLoader';
 *
 * const loader = new AnimationLoader();
 * const animations = await loader.loadAsync( 'animations/animation.js' );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class AnimationLoader extends Loader<AnimationClip[]> {
  /**
   * Constructs a new animation loader.
   *
   * @param [manager] - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
  }
  /**
   * Starts loading from the given URL and pass the loaded animations as an array
   * holding instances of {@link AnimationClip} to the `onLoad()` callback.
   *
   * @param url - The path/URL of the file to be loaded. This can also be a data URI.
   * @param onLoad - Executed when the loading process has been finished.
   * @param onProgress - Executed while the loading is in progress.
   * @param onError - Executed when errors occur.
   */
  load(
    url: string,
    onLoad: (value: AnimationClip[]) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ) {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (text?: any) => {
        try {
          onLoad(this.parse(JSON.parse(text as string)));
        } catch (e: any) {
          if (onError) {
            onError(e);
          } else {
            error(e);
          }
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }
  /**
   * Parses the given JSON object and returns an array of animation clips.
   *
   * @param json - The serialized animation clips.
   * @return The parsed animation clips.
   */
  parse(json?: any): AnimationClip[] {
    const animations: any[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < json.length; i++) {
      const clip = AnimationClip.parse(json[i]);
      animations.push(clip);
    }
    return animations;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/loaders/AudioLoader

```typescript
import { AudioContext } from "../audio/AudioContext";
import { error } from "../utils";
import { FileLoader } from "./FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "./Loader";

/** Loads and decodes audio without detaching FileLoader's cached buffer. */
export class AudioLoader extends Loader<AudioBuffer> {
  load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (buffer: AudioBuffer) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    const handleError = (cause: unknown): void => {
      if (onError) onError(cause);
      else error(cause);
      this.manager.itemError(url);
    };
    loader.load(
      url,
      (buffer) => {
        const decodeUrl = `${url}#decode`;
        let started = false;
        try {
          if (!(buffer instanceof ArrayBuffer)) throw new Error("AudioLoader: expected an ArrayBuffer");
          const bufferCopy = buffer.slice(0);
          const context = AudioContext.getContext();
          this.manager.itemStart(decodeUrl);
          started = true;
          void context
            .decodeAudioData(bufferCopy)
            .then((decoded) => onLoad?.(decoded))
            .catch(handleError)
            .finally(() => this.manager.itemEnd(decodeUrl));
        } catch (cause) {
          try {
            handleError(cause);
          } finally {
            if (started) this.manager.itemEnd(decodeUrl);
          }
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }
}
```

## ek3d/loaders/BufferGeometryLoader

````typescript
import type { LoadingManager } from "./LoadingManager";
import { InstancedInterleavedBuffer } from "../core/InstancedInterleavedBuffer";
import { Sphere } from "../math/Sphere";
import { BufferAttribute } from "../core/BufferAttribute";
import { BufferGeometry } from "../core/BufferGeometry";
import { FileLoader } from "./FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "./Loader";
import { InstancedBufferGeometry } from "../core/InstancedBufferGeometry";
import { InstancedBufferAttribute } from "../core/InstancedBufferAttribute";
import { InterleavedBufferAttribute } from "../core/InterleavedBufferAttribute";
import { InterleavedBuffer } from "../core/InterleavedBuffer";
import { getTypedArray, error } from "../utils";
/**
 * Class for loading geometries. The files are internally
 * loaded via {@link FileLoader}.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { BufferGeometryLoader } from 'ek3d/loaders/BufferGeometryLoader';
 * import { MeshBasicMaterial } from 'ek3d/materials/MeshBasicMaterial';
 * import { Mesh } from 'ek3d/objects/Mesh';
 * import { Scene } from 'ek3d/scenes/Scene';
 *
 * const scene = new Scene();
 * const loader = new BufferGeometryLoader();
 * const geometry = await loader.loadAsync( 'models/json/pressure.json' );
 *
 * const material = new MeshBasicMaterial( { color: 0xF5F5F5 } );
 * const object = new Mesh( geometry, material );
 * scene.add( object );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class BufferGeometryLoader extends Loader<BufferGeometry> {
  /**
   * Constructs a new geometry loader.
   *
   * @param [manager] - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
  }
  /**
   * Starts loading from the given URL and pass the loaded geometry to the `onLoad()` callback.
   *
   * @param url - The path/URL of the file to be loaded. This can also be a data URI.
   * @param onLoad - Executed when the loading process has been finished.
   * @param onProgress - Executed while the loading is in progress.
   * @param onError - Executed when errors occur.
   */
  load(
    url: string,
    onLoad: (value: BufferGeometry) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ) {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (text?: any) => {
        try {
          onLoad(this.parse(JSON.parse(text as string)));
        } catch (e: any) {
          if (onError) {
            onError(e);
          } else {
            error(e);
          }
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }
  /**
   * Parses the given JSON object and returns a geometry.
   *
   * @param json - The serialized geometry.
   * @return The parsed geometry.
   */
  parse(json?: any): BufferGeometry {
    if (json.type !== undefined && json.type !== "BufferGeometry" && json.type !== "InstancedBufferGeometry")
      throw new Error('BufferGeometryLoader: Unknown geometry type "' + json.type + '".');
    const interleavedBufferMap: any = {};
    const arrayBufferMap: any = {};
    function getInterleavedBuffer(json: any, uuid?: any) {
      if ((interleavedBufferMap as any)[uuid] !== undefined) return (interleavedBufferMap as any)[uuid];
      const interleavedBuffers = json.interleavedBuffers;
      const interleavedBuffer = interleavedBuffers[uuid];
      const buffer = getArrayBuffer(json, interleavedBuffer.buffer);
      const array = getTypedArray(interleavedBuffer.type, buffer);
      const ib = interleavedBuffer.isInstancedInterleavedBuffer
        ? new InstancedInterleavedBuffer(array, interleavedBuffer.stride, interleavedBuffer.meshPerAttribute)
        : new InterleavedBuffer(array, interleavedBuffer.stride);
      ib.uuid = interleavedBuffer.uuid;
      if (interleavedBuffer.usage !== undefined) ib.setUsage(interleavedBuffer.usage);
      (interleavedBufferMap as any)[uuid] = ib;
      return ib;
    }
    function getArrayBuffer(json: any, uuid?: any) {
      if ((arrayBufferMap as any)[uuid] !== undefined) return (arrayBufferMap as any)[uuid];
      const arrayBuffers = json.arrayBuffers;
      const arrayBuffer = arrayBuffers[uuid];
      const ab = new Uint32Array(arrayBuffer).buffer;
      (arrayBufferMap as any)[uuid] = ab;
      return ab;
    }
    const geometry = json.isInstancedBufferGeometry ? new InstancedBufferGeometry() : new BufferGeometry();
    if (json.instanceCount !== undefined) (geometry as any).instanceCount = json.instanceCount;
    const index = json.data.index;
    if (index !== undefined) {
      const typedArray = getTypedArray(index.type, index.array);
      geometry.setIndex(new BufferAttribute(typedArray, 1));
    }
    const attributes = json.data.attributes;
    for (const key in attributes) {
      const attribute = attributes[key];
      let bufferAttribute: any;
      if (attribute.isInterleavedBufferAttribute) {
        const interleavedBuffer = getInterleavedBuffer(json.data, attribute.data);
        bufferAttribute = new InterleavedBufferAttribute(
          interleavedBuffer,
          attribute.itemSize,
          attribute.offset,
          attribute.normalized,
        );
      } else {
        const typedArray = getTypedArray(attribute.type, attribute.array);
        bufferAttribute = attribute.isInstancedBufferAttribute
          ? new InstancedBufferAttribute(
              typedArray,
              attribute.itemSize,
              attribute.normalized,
              attribute.meshPerAttribute,
            )
          : new BufferAttribute(typedArray, attribute.itemSize, attribute.normalized);
      }
      if (attribute.name !== undefined) bufferAttribute.name = attribute.name;
      if (attribute.usage !== undefined) (bufferAttribute as any).setUsage(attribute.usage);
      if (attribute.gpuType !== undefined) (bufferAttribute as any).gpuType = attribute.gpuType;
      geometry.setAttribute(key, bufferAttribute);
    }
    const morphAttributes = json.data.morphAttributes;
    if (morphAttributes) {
      for (const key in morphAttributes) {
        const attributeArray = morphAttributes[key];
        const array: any[] = [];
        for (let i = 0, il = attributeArray.length; i < il; i++) {
          const attribute = attributeArray[i];
          let bufferAttribute: any;
          if (attribute.isInterleavedBufferAttribute) {
            const interleavedBuffer = getInterleavedBuffer(json.data, attribute.data);
            bufferAttribute = new InterleavedBufferAttribute(
              interleavedBuffer,
              attribute.itemSize,
              attribute.offset,
              attribute.normalized,
            );
          } else {
            const typedArray = getTypedArray(attribute.type, attribute.array);
            bufferAttribute = new BufferAttribute(typedArray, attribute.itemSize, attribute.normalized);
          }
          if (attribute.name !== undefined) bufferAttribute.name = attribute.name;
          if (attribute.usage !== undefined) (bufferAttribute as any).setUsage(attribute.usage);
          if (attribute.gpuType !== undefined) (bufferAttribute as any).gpuType = attribute.gpuType;
          array.push(bufferAttribute);
        }
        geometry.morphAttributes[key] = array;
      }
    }
    const morphTargetsRelative = json.data.morphTargetsRelative;
    if (morphTargetsRelative) {
      geometry.morphTargetsRelative = true;
    }
    const groups = json.data.groups || json.data.drawcalls || json.data.offsets;
    if (groups !== undefined) {
      for (let i = 0, n = groups.length; i !== n; ++i) {
        const group = groups[i];
        geometry.addGroup(group.start, group.count, group.materialIndex);
      }
    }
    const boundingSphere = json.data.boundingSphere;
    if (boundingSphere !== undefined) {
      geometry.boundingSphere = new Sphere().fromJSON(boundingSphere);
    }
    if (json.uuid !== undefined) geometry.uuid = json.uuid;
    if (json.name) geometry.name = json.name;
    if (json.userData) geometry.userData = json.userData;
    return geometry;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/loaders/Cache

```typescript
/**
 * @class
 * @classdesc A simple caching system, used internally by {@link FileLoader}.
 * Each LoadingManager owns a cache. Enable it with `manager.cache.enabled = true`; clear it explicitly when releasing assets. Clearing does not close shared ImageBitmaps.
 */
export class Cache {
  enabled: boolean;
  files: Record<string, unknown>;

  constructor() {
    this.enabled = false;
    this.files = Object.create(null);
  }
  add(key: string, file: unknown): void {
    if (this.enabled === false) return;
    if (isBlobURL(key)) return;
    // log( 'Cache', 'Adding key:', key );
    this.files[key] = file;
  }
  get<T = unknown>(key: string): T | undefined {
    if (this.enabled === false) return;
    if (isBlobURL(key)) return;
    // log( 'Cache', 'Checking key:', key );
    return this.files[key] as T | undefined;
  }
  remove(key: string): void {
    delete this.files[key];
  }
  clear() {
    this.files = Object.create(null);
  }
}
/**
 * Returns true if the given cache key contains the blob: scheme.
 *
 * @private
 * @param key - The cache key.
 * @return Whether the given cache key contains the blob: scheme or not.
 */
function isBlobURL(key: string): boolean {
  try {
    const urlString = key.slice(key.indexOf(":") + 1); // remove type identifier
    const url = new URL(urlString);
    return url.protocol === "blob:";
  } catch {
    // If the string is not a valid URL, it throws an error
    return false;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/loaders/CompressedTextureLoader

```typescript
import type { LoadingManager } from "./LoadingManager";
import { TextureFilter, PixelFormat } from "../constants";
import { FileLoader } from "./FileLoader";
import { CompressedTexture } from "../textures/CompressedTexture";
import type { CompressedTextureFace } from "../textures/CompressedTexture";
import { Loader } from "./Loader";
import { error } from "../utils";
/**
 * Abstract base class for loading compressed texture formats S3TC, ASTC or ETC.
 * Textures are internally loaded via {@link FileLoader}.
 *
 * Derived classes have to implement the `parse()` method which holds the parsing
 * for the respective format.
 *
 * @abstract
 */
export abstract class CompressedTextureLoader extends Loader<CompressedTexture, string | string[]> {
  /** Parses the raw texture data, optionally including mipmaps. */
  abstract parse(buffer: ArrayBuffer, loadMipmaps?: boolean): CompressedTextureData;
  /**
   * Constructs a new compressed texture loader.
   *
   * @param [manager] - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
  }
  /**
   * Starts loading from the given URL and passes the loaded compressed texture
   * to the `onLoad()` callback. The method also returns a new texture object which can
   * directly be used for material creation. If you do it this way, the texture
   * may pop up in your scene once the respective loading process is finished.
   *
   * @param url - The path/URL of the file to be loaded. This can also be a data URI.
   * @param onLoad - Executed when the loading process has been finished.
   * @param onProgress - Executed while the loading is in progress.
   * @param onError - Executed when errors occur.
   * @return The compressed texture.
   */
  load(
    url: string | string[],
    onLoad?: (value: CompressedTexture) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): CompressedTexture {
    const images: CompressedTextureFace[] = [];
    const texture = new CompressedTexture();
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    let loaded = 0;
    // Like DataTextureLoader, a parse failure is a load error: without this the throw escapes
    // the FileLoader callback and loadAsync() never settles.
    const reportParseError = (e: unknown) => {
      if (onError !== undefined) onError(e);
      else error(e);
    };
    const parseData = (buffer: unknown): CompressedTextureData => {
      if (!(buffer instanceof ArrayBuffer)) {
        throw new TypeError("CompressedTextureLoader: Expected an ArrayBuffer response.");
      }
      return this.parse(buffer, true);
    };
    const urls = Array.isArray(url) ? url : [];
    const loadTexture = (i: number) => {
      loader.load(
        urls[i],
        (buffer: unknown) => {
          let texDatas: CompressedTextureData;
          try {
            texDatas = parseData(buffer);
          } catch (e) {
            reportParseError(e);
            return;
          }
          images[i] = {
            width: texDatas.width,
            height: texDatas.height,
            mipmaps: texDatas.mipmaps,
          };
          loaded += 1;
          if (loaded === 6) {
            if (texDatas.mipmapCount === 1) texture.minFilter = TextureFilter.Linear;
            texture.image = images;
            texture.format = texDatas.format;
            texture.needsUpdate = true;
            if (onLoad) onLoad(texture);
          }
        },
        onProgress,
        onError,
      );
    };
    if (Array.isArray(url)) {
      for (let i = 0, il = urls.length; i < il; ++i) {
        loadTexture(i);
      }
    } else {
      // compressed cubemap texture stored in a single DDS file
      loader.load(
        url,
        (buffer: unknown) => {
          let texDatas: CompressedTextureData;
          try {
            texDatas = parseData(buffer);
          } catch (e) {
            reportParseError(e);
            return;
          }
          if (texDatas.isCubemap) {
            const faces = texDatas.mipmaps.length / texDatas.mipmapCount;
            for (let f = 0; f < faces; f++) {
              images[f] = { mipmaps: [], width: texDatas.width, height: texDatas.height };
              for (let i = 0; i < texDatas.mipmapCount; i++) {
                images[f].mipmaps.push(texDatas.mipmaps[f * texDatas.mipmapCount + i]);
              }
            }
            texture.image = images;
          } else {
            texture.image = { width: texDatas.width, height: texDatas.height };
            texture.mipmaps = texDatas.mipmaps;
          }
          if (texDatas.mipmapCount === 1) {
            texture.minFilter = TextureFilter.Linear;
          }
          texture.format = texDatas.format;
          texture.needsUpdate = true;
          if (onLoad) onLoad(texture);
        },
        onProgress,
        onError,
      );
    }
    return texture;
  }
}

/** Parsed compressed texture data for the loader's format. */
export interface CompressedTextureData {
  /** Width of the base mip level. */
  width: number;
  /** Height of the base mip level. */
  height: number;
  /** Texture format. */
  format: PixelFormat;
  /** Texture data and dimensions for each mip level. */
  mipmaps: CompressedTexture["mipmaps"];
  /** Number of mip levels per face. */
  mipmapCount: number;
  /** Whether the data represents a cube map. */
  isCubemap?: boolean;
}
```

## ek3d/loaders/CubeTextureLoader

````typescript
import type { LoadingManager } from "./LoadingManager";
import { ImageLoader } from "./ImageLoader";
import { CubeTexture } from "../textures/CubeTexture";
import { Loader } from "./Loader";
import { ColorSpace } from "../constants";
/**
 * Class for loading cube textures. Images are internally loaded via {@link ImageLoader}.
 *
 * The loader returns an instance of {@link CubeTexture} and expects the cube map to
 * be defined as six separate images representing the sides of a cube. Other cube map definitions
 * like vertical and horizontal cross, column and row layouts are not supported.
 *
 * Note that, by convention, cube maps are specified in a coordinate system
 * in which positive-x is to the right when looking up the positive-z axis --
 * in other words, using a left-handed coordinate system. Since three.js uses
 * a right-handed coordinate system, environment maps used in three.js will
 * have pos-x and neg-x swapped.
 *
 * The loaded cube texture is in sRGB color space. Meaning {@link Texture#colorSpace}
 * is set to `ColorSpace.SRGB` by default.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { CubeTextureLoader } from 'ek3d/loaders/CubeTextureLoader';
 * import { Scene } from 'ek3d/scenes/Scene';
 *
 * const scene = new Scene();
 * const loader = new CubeTextureLoader().setPath( 'textures/cubeMaps/' );
 * const cubeTexture = await loader.loadAsync( [
 * 	'px.png', 'nx.png', 'py.png', 'ny.png', 'pz.png', 'nz.png'
 * ] );
 * scene.background = cubeTexture;
 * ```
 *
 */
export class CubeTextureLoader extends Loader<CubeTexture, string[]> {
  /**
   * Constructs a new cube texture loader.
   *
   * @param [manager] - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
  }
  /**
   * Starts loading from the given URL and pass the fully loaded cube texture
   * to the `onLoad()` callback. The method also returns a new cube texture object which can
   * directly be used for material creation. If you do it this way, the cube texture
   * may pop up in your scene once the respective loading process is finished.
   *
   * @param urls - Array of 6 URLs to images, one for each side of the
   * cube texture. The urls should be specified in the following order: pos-x,
   * neg-x, pos-y, neg-y, pos-z, neg-z. An array of data URIs are allowed as well.
   * @param onLoad - Executed when the loading process has been finished.
   * @param onProgress - Unsupported in this loader.
   * @param onError - Executed when errors occur.
   * @return The cube texture.
   */
  load(
    urls: string[],
    onLoad?: (value: CubeTexture) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): CubeTexture {
    const texture = new CubeTexture();
    texture.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB;
    const loader = new ImageLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setCrossOrigin(this.crossOrigin);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    let loaded = 0;
    function loadTexture(i?: any) {
      loader.load(
        urls[i],
        function (image?: any) {
          texture.images[i] = image;
          loaded++;
          if (loaded === 6) {
            texture.needsUpdate = true;
            if (onLoad) onLoad(texture);
          }
        },
        undefined,
        onError,
      );
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < urls.length; ++i) {
      loadTexture(i);
    }
    return texture;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/loaders/DataTextureLoader

```typescript
import type { LoadingManager } from "./LoadingManager";
import { TextureFilter, Wrapping } from "../constants";
import { FileLoader } from "./FileLoader";
import { DataTexture } from "../textures/DataTexture";
import type { DataTextureImage, DataTextureImageData } from "../textures/DataTexture";
import { Loader } from "./Loader";
import { error } from "../utils";
/**
 * Abstract base class for loading binary texture formats RGBE, EXR or TGA.
 * Textures are internally loaded via {@link FileLoader}.
 *
 * Derived classes have to implement the `parse()` method which holds the parsing
 * for the respective format.
 *
 * @abstract
 */
export abstract class DataTextureLoader extends Loader<DataTexture, string> {
  /** Parses the raw texture data for the loader's format. */
  abstract parse(buffer: ArrayBuffer): DataTextureData;
  /**
   * Constructs a new data texture loader.
   *
   * @param [manager] - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
  }
  /**
   * Starts loading from the given URL and passes the loaded data texture
   * to the `onLoad()` callback. The method also returns a new texture object which can
   * directly be used for material creation. If you do it this way, the texture
   * may pop up in your scene once the respective loading process is finished.
   *
   * @param url - The path/URL of the file to be loaded. This can also be a data URI.
   * @param onLoad - Executed when the loading process has been finished.
   * @param onProgress - Executed while the loading is in progress.
   * @param onError - Executed when errors occur.
   * @return The data texture.
   */
  load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (value: DataTexture, texData?: DataTextureData) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): DataTexture {
    const texture = new DataTexture();
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setResponseType("arraybuffer");
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (buffer?: any) => {
        let texData: any;
        try {
          texData = this.parse(buffer);
        } catch (e: any) {
          if (onError !== undefined) {
            onError(e);
          } else {
            error(e);
          }
          return;
        }
        this._applyTexData(texture, texData);
        if (onLoad) onLoad(texture, texData);
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
    return texture;
  }
  /**
   * Parses the given buffer and returns a configured data texture. Use this method
   * for parsing texture data that is already in memory (e.g. drag and drop or data
   * loaded from a server) without going through {@link DataTextureLoader#load}.
   *
   * @param buffer - The raw texture data.
   * @return The data texture.
   */
  createDataTexture(buffer: ArrayBuffer): DataTexture {
    const texture = new DataTexture();
    this._applyTexData(texture, this.parse(buffer));
    return texture;
  }
  /**
   * Applies the given parsed texture data to the given data texture.
   *
   * @private
   * @param texture - The data texture.
   * @param texData - The parsed texture data.
   */
  _applyTexData(texture: DataTexture, texData?: any) {
    if (texData.image !== undefined) {
      texture.image = texData.image;
    } else if (texData.data !== undefined) {
      texture.image.width = texData.width;
      texture.image.height = texData.height;
      texture.image.data = texData.data;
    }
    texture.wrapS = texData.wrapS !== undefined ? texData.wrapS : Wrapping.ClampToEdge;
    texture.wrapT = texData.wrapT !== undefined ? texData.wrapT : Wrapping.ClampToEdge;
    texture.magFilter = texData.magFilter !== undefined ? texData.magFilter : TextureFilter.Linear;
    texture.minFilter = texData.minFilter !== undefined ? texData.minFilter : TextureFilter.Linear;
    texture.anisotropy = texData.anisotropy !== undefined ? texData.anisotropy : 1;
    if (texData.colorSpace !== undefined) {
      texture.colorSpace = texData.colorSpace;
    }
    if (texData.flipY !== undefined) {
      texture.flipY = texData.flipY;
    }
    if (texData.format !== undefined) {
      texture.format = texData.format;
    }
    if (texData.type !== undefined) {
      texture.type = texData.type;
    }
    if (texData.mipmaps !== undefined) {
      texture.mipmaps = texData.mipmaps;
      texture.minFilter = TextureFilter.LinearMipmapLinear; // presumably...
    }
    if (texData.mipmapCount === 1) {
      texture.minFilter = TextureFilter.Linear;
    }
    if (texData.generateMipmaps !== undefined) {
      texture.generateMipmaps = texData.generateMipmaps;
    }
    texture.needsUpdate = true;
  }
}

/** Parsed texture pixels and optional upload settings. */
export interface DataTextureData {
  /** Image containing dimensions and texture data, instead of separate data fields. */
  image?: DataTextureImage;
  /** Raw texture pixels. */
  data?: NonNullable<DataTextureImageData>;
  /** Width of the base mip level. */
  width?: number;
  /** Height of the base mip level. */
  height?: number;
  /** Format-specific metadata: an RGBE header string or a structured EXR header. */
  header?: string | Record<string, unknown>;
  /** Gamma value parsed from the format header, if any. */
  gamma?: number;
  /** Exposure value parsed from the format header, if any. */
  exposure?: number;
  /** Horizontal wrapping mode. Defaults to Wrapping.ClampToEdge. */
  wrapS?: Wrapping;
  /** Vertical wrapping mode. Defaults to Wrapping.ClampToEdge. */
  wrapT?: Wrapping;
  /** Magnification filter. Defaults to TextureFilter.Linear. */
  magFilter?: TextureFilter;
  /** Minification filter. Defaults to TextureFilter.Linear; supplied mipmaps select TextureFilter.LinearMipmapLinear. */
  minFilter?: TextureFilter;
  /** Anisotropic filtering level. Defaults to 1. */
  anisotropy?: number;
  /** Color space of the texture pixels. */
  colorSpace?: string;
  /** Whether to flip the pixels vertically during GPU upload. */
  flipY?: boolean;
  /** Texture format. */
  format?: number;
  /** Texture data type. */
  type?: number;
  /** Texture data and dimensions for each mip level. */
  mipmaps?: DataTexture["mipmaps"];
  /** Number of mip levels; one selects TextureFilter.Linear. */
  mipmapCount?: number;
  /** Whether the GPU should generate mipmaps. */
  generateMipmaps?: boolean;
}
```

## ek3d/loaders/FileLoader

````typescript
import type { LoadingManager } from "./LoadingManager";
import { Loader } from "./Loader";
import { warn } from "../utils";
class HttpError extends Error {
  response: Response;

  constructor(message: string, response: Response) {
    super(message);
    this.response = response;
  }
}
/**
 * A low level class for loading resources with the Fetch API, used internally by
 * most loaders. It can also be used directly to load any file type that does
 * not have a loader.
 *
 * This loader supports caching. If you want to use it, set `manager.cache.enabled = true;`
 * once to your application.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { FileLoader } from 'ek3d/loaders/FileLoader';
 *
 * const loader = new FileLoader();
 * const data = await loader.loadAsync( 'example.txt' );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class FileLoader extends Loader<unknown, string> {
  mimeType: string;
  responseType: string;
  _abortController: AbortController;

  /**
   * Constructs a new file loader.
   *
   * @param [manager] - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
    /**
     * The expected mime type. Valid values can be found
     * [here](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/DOMParser/parseFromString#mimetype)
     *
     */
    this.mimeType = "";
    /**
     * The expected response type.
     *
     * @default ''
     */
    this.responseType = "";
    /**
     * Used for aborting requests.
     *
     * @private
     */
    this._abortController = new AbortController();
  }
  /**
   * Starts loading from the given URL and pass the loaded response to the `onLoad()` callback.
   *
   * @param url - The path/URL of the file to be loaded. This can also be a data URI.
   * @param onLoad - Executed when the loading process has been finished.
   * @param [onProgress] - Executed while the loading is in progress.
   * @param [onError] - Executed when errors occur.
   */
  load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (value: unknown) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const loading = this.manager.fileRequests;
    if (url === undefined) url = "";
    if (this.path !== undefined) url = this.path + url;
    url = this.manager.resolveURL(url);
    const cached = this.manager.cache.get(`file:${url}`);
    if (cached !== undefined) {
      this.manager.itemStart(url);
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (onLoad) onLoad(cached);
        this.manager.itemEnd(url);
      }, 0);
      return;
    }
    // Check if request is duplicate
    if (loading[url] !== undefined) {
      loading[url].push({
        onLoad: onLoad,
        onProgress: onProgress,
        onError: onError,
      });
      return;
    }
    // Initialise array for duplicate requests
    loading[url] = [];
    loading[url].push({
      onLoad: onLoad,
      onProgress: onProgress,
      onError: onError,
    });
    // create request
    const req = new Request(url, {
      headers: new Headers(this.requestHeader),
      credentials: this.withCredentials ? "include" : "same-origin",
      priority: this.priority,
      cache: this.cache,
      signal:
        typeof AbortSignal.any === "function"
          ? AbortSignal.any([this._abortController.signal, this.manager.abortController.signal])
          : this._abortController.signal,
    });
    // record states ( avoid data race )
    const mimeType = this.mimeType;
    const responseType = this.responseType;
    // start the fetch
    fetch(req)
      .then((response?: any) => {
        if (response.status === 200 || response.status === 0) {
          // Some browsers return HTTP Status 0 when using non-http protocol
          // e.g. 'file://' or 'data://'. Handle as success.
          if (response.status === 0) {
            warn("FileLoader: HTTP Status 0 received.");
          }
          // Workaround: Checking if response.body === undefined for Alipay browser #23548
          if (
            typeof ReadableStream === "undefined" ||
            response.body === undefined ||
            response.body.getReader === undefined
          ) {
            return response;
          }
          const callbacks = loading[url];
          const reader = response.body.getReader();
          // Nginx needs X-File-Size check
          // https://serverfault.com/questions/482875/why-does-nginx-remove-content-length-header-for-chunked-content
          const contentLength = response.headers.get("X-File-Size") || response.headers.get("Content-Length");
          const total = contentLength ? parseInt(contentLength) : 0;
          const lengthComputable = total !== 0;
          let loaded = 0;
          // periodically read data into the new stream tracking while download progress
          const stream = new ReadableStream({
            start(controller?: any) {
              readData();
              function readData() {
                reader.read().then(
                  ({ done, value }: any) => {
                    if (done) {
                      controller.close();
                    } else {
                      loaded += value.byteLength;
                      const event = new ProgressEvent("progress", { lengthComputable, loaded, total });
                      for (let i = 0, il = callbacks.length; i < il; i++) {
                        const callback = callbacks[i];
                        if (callback.onProgress) callback.onProgress(event);
                      }
                      controller.enqueue(value);
                      readData();
                    }
                  },
                  (e?: any) => {
                    controller.error(e);
                  },
                );
              }
            },
          });
          return new Response(stream);
        } else {
          throw new HttpError(
            `fetch for "${response.url}" responded with ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`,
            response,
          );
        }
      })
      .then((response?: any) => {
        switch (responseType) {
          case "arraybuffer":
            return response.arrayBuffer();
          case "blob":
            return response.blob();
          case "document":
            return response.text().then((text: string) => {
              const parser = new DOMParser();
              return parser.parseFromString(text, mimeType as DOMParserSupportedType);
            });
          case "json":
            return response.json();
          default:
            if (mimeType === "") {
              return response.text();
            } else {
              // sniff encoding
              const re = /charset="?([^;"\s]*)"?/i;
              const exec = re.exec(mimeType);
              const label = exec && (exec as any)[1] ? (exec as any)[1].toLowerCase() : undefined;
              const decoder = new TextDecoder(label);
              return response.arrayBuffer().then((ab: ArrayBuffer) => decoder.decode(ab));
            }
        }
      })
      .then((data?: any) => {
        // Add to cache only on HTTP success, so that we do not cache
        // error response bodies as proper responses to requests.
        this.manager.cache.add(`file:${url}`, data);
        const callbacks = loading[url];
        delete loading[url];
        for (let i = 0, il = callbacks.length; i < il; i++) {
          const callback = callbacks[i];
          if (callback.onLoad) callback.onLoad(data);
        }
      })
      .catch((err?: any) => {
        // Abort errors and other errors are handled the same
        const callbacks = loading[url];
        if (callbacks === undefined) {
          // When onLoad was called and url was deleted in `loading`
          this.manager.itemError(url);
          throw err;
        }
        delete loading[url];
        for (let i = 0, il = callbacks.length; i < il; i++) {
          const callback = callbacks[i];
          if (callback.onError) callback.onError(err);
        }
        this.manager.itemError(url);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        this.manager.itemEnd(url);
      });
    this.manager.itemStart(url);
  }
  /**
   * Sets the expected response type.
   *
   * @param value - The response type.
   * @return A reference to this file loader.
   */
  setResponseType(value?: any): this {
    this.responseType = value;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Sets the expected mime type of the loaded file.
   *
   * @param value - The mime type.
   * @return A reference to this file loader.
   */
  setMimeType(value: string): this {
    this.mimeType = value;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Aborts ongoing fetch requests.
   *
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  abort(): this {
    this._abortController.abort();
    this._abortController = new AbortController();
    return this;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/loaders/ImageBitmapLoader

````typescript
import type { LoadingManager } from "./LoadingManager";
import { Loader } from "./Loader";
import { warn } from "../utils";
/**
 * A loader for loading images as an [ImageBitmap](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/ImageBitmap).
 * An `ImageBitmap` provides an asynchronous and resource efficient pathway to prepare
 * textures for rendering.
 *
 * Note that {@link Texture#flipY} and {@link Texture#premultiplyAlpha} are ignored with image bitmaps.
 * These options need to be configured via {@link ImageBitmapLoader#setOptions} prior to loading,
 * unlike regular images which can be configured on the Texture to set these options on GPU upload instead.
 *
 * To match the default behaviour of {@link Texture}, the following options are needed:
 *
 * ```ts
 * const options: ImageBitmapOptions = { imageOrientation: 'flipY', premultiplyAlpha: 'none' };
 * ```
 *
 * Also note that unlike {@link FileLoader}, this loader will only avoid multiple concurrent requests to the same URL if {@link Cache} is enabled.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { ImageBitmapLoader } from 'ek3d/loaders/ImageBitmapLoader';
 * import { Texture } from 'ek3d/textures/Texture';
 *
 * const loader = new ImageBitmapLoader();
 * loader.setOptions( { imageOrientation: 'flipY' } ); // set options if needed
 * const imageBitmap = await loader.loadAsync( 'image.png' );
 *
 * const texture = new Texture( imageBitmap );
 * texture.needsUpdate = true;
 * ```
 *
 */
export class ImageBitmapLoader extends Loader<ImageBitmap, string> {
  isImageBitmapLoader: boolean;
  options: ImageBitmapOptions;
  _abortController: AbortController;

  /**
   * Constructs a new image bitmap loader.
   *
   * @param [manager] - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isImageBitmapLoader = true;
    if (typeof createImageBitmap === "undefined") {
      warn("ImageBitmapLoader: createImageBitmap() not supported.");
    }
    if (typeof fetch === "undefined") {
      warn("ImageBitmapLoader: fetch() not supported.");
    }
    /**
     * Represents the loader options.
     *
     * @default {premultiplyAlpha:'none'}
     */
    this.options = { premultiplyAlpha: "none" };
    /**
     * Used for aborting requests.
     *
     * @private
     */
    this._abortController = new AbortController();
  }
  /**
   * Sets the given loader options. The structure of the object must match the `options` parameter of
   * [createImageBitmap](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Window/createImageBitmap).
   *
   * Note: When caching is enabled, the cache key is based on the URL only. Loading the same URL with
   * different options will return the cached result of the first request.
   *
   * @param options - The loader options to set.
   * @return A reference to this image bitmap loader.
   */
  setOptions(options: ImageBitmapOptions): this {
    this.options = options;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Starts loading from the given URL and pass the loaded image bitmap to the `onLoad()` callback.
   *
   * @param url - The path/URL of the file to be loaded. This can also be a data URI.
   * @param onLoad - Executed when the loading process has been finished.
   * @param onProgress - Unsupported in this loader.
   * @param onError - Executed when errors occur.
   */
  load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (value: ImageBitmap) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): void {
    const _errorMap = this.manager.bitmapErrors;
    if (url === undefined) url = "";
    if (this.path !== undefined) url = this.path + url;
    url = this.manager.resolveURL(url);
    const cached = this.manager.cache.get<ImageBitmap | Promise<ImageBitmap | void>>(`image-bitmap:${url}`);
    if (cached !== undefined) {
      this.manager.itemStart(url);
      // If cached is a promise, wait for it to resolve
      if ("then" in cached) {
        cached.then(
          (imageBitmap) => {
            // check if there is an error for the cached promise
            if (_errorMap.has(cached) === true) {
              if (onError) onError(_errorMap.get(cached));
              this.manager.itemError(url);
              this.manager.itemEnd(url);
            } else {
              if (onLoad) onLoad(imageBitmap as ImageBitmap);
              this.manager.itemEnd(url);
            }
          },
          (error: unknown) => {
            this.manager.cache.remove(`image-bitmap:${url}`);
            if (onError) onError(error);
            this.manager.itemError(url);
            this.manager.itemEnd(url);
          },
        );
        return;
      }
      // If cached is not a promise (i.e., it's already an imageBitmap)
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (onLoad) onLoad(cached);
        this.manager.itemEnd(url);
      }, 0);
      return;
    }
    const fetchOptions: RequestInit = {};
    fetchOptions.credentials = this.withCredentials || this.crossOrigin !== "anonymous" ? "include" : "same-origin";
    fetchOptions.headers = this.requestHeader;
    fetchOptions.priority = this.priority;
    fetchOptions.cache = this.cache;
    fetchOptions.signal =
      typeof AbortSignal.any === "function"
        ? AbortSignal.any([this._abortController.signal, this.manager.abortController.signal])
        : this._abortController.signal;
    const promise = fetch(url, fetchOptions)
      .then(function (res?: any) {
        return res.blob();
      })
      .then((blob: Blob) => {
        return createImageBitmap(blob, Object.assign({}, this.options, { colorSpaceConversion: "none" }));
      })
      .then((imageBitmap: ImageBitmap) => {
        this.manager.cache.add(`image-bitmap:${url}`, imageBitmap);
        if (onLoad) onLoad(imageBitmap as ImageBitmap);
        this.manager.itemEnd(url);
        return imageBitmap; // see #34150
      })
      .catch((e: unknown) => {
        if (onError) onError(e);
        _errorMap.set(promise, e);
        this.manager.cache.remove(`image-bitmap:${url}`);
        this.manager.itemError(url);
        this.manager.itemEnd(url);
      });
    this.manager.cache.add(`image-bitmap:${url}`, promise);
    this.manager.itemStart(url);
  }
  /**
   * Aborts ongoing fetch requests.
   *
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  abort(): this {
    this._abortController.abort();
    this._abortController = new AbortController();
    return this;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/loaders/ImageLoader

````typescript
import type { LoadingManager } from "./LoadingManager";
import { Loader } from "./Loader";
import { createElementNS } from "../utils";
/**
 * A loader for loading images. The class loads images with the HTML `Image` API.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { ImageLoader } from 'ek3d/loaders/ImageLoader';
 *
 * const loader = new ImageLoader();
 * const image = await loader.loadAsync( 'image.png' );
 * ```
 * Please note that `ImageLoader` has dropped support for progress
 * events in `r84`. For an `ImageLoader` that supports progress events, see
 * [this thread](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/issues/10439#issuecomment-275785639).
 *
 */
export class ImageLoader extends Loader<HTMLImageElement, string> {
  /**
   * Constructs a new image loader.
   *
   * @param [manager] - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
  }
  /**
   * Starts loading from the given URL and passes the loaded image
   * to the `onLoad()` callback. The method also returns a new `Image` object which can
   * directly be used for texture creation. If you do it this way, the texture
   * may pop up in your scene once the respective loading process is finished.
   *
   * @param url - The path/URL of the file to be loaded. This can also be a data URI.
   * @param onLoad - Executed when the loading process has been finished.
   * @param onProgress - Unsupported in this loader.
   * @param onError - Executed when errors occur.
   * @return The image.
   */
  load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (value: HTMLImageElement) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): HTMLImageElement {
    const _loading = this.manager.imageRequests;
    if (this.path !== undefined) url = this.path + url;
    url = this.manager.resolveURL(url);
    const cached = this.manager.cache.get<HTMLImageElement>(`image:${url}`);
    if (cached !== undefined) {
      if (cached.complete === true) {
        this.manager.itemStart(url);
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (onLoad) onLoad(cached);
          this.manager.itemEnd(url);
        }, 0);
      } else {
        let arr = _loading.get(cached);
        if (arr === undefined) {
          arr = [];
          _loading.set(cached, arr);
        }
        arr.push({ onLoad, onError });
      }
      return cached;
    }
    const image = createElementNS("img") as HTMLImageElement;
    const onImageLoad = () => {
      removeEventListeners();
      if (onLoad) onLoad(image);
      //
      const callbacks = _loading.get(image) || [];
      for (let i = 0; i < callbacks.length; i++) {
        const callback = callbacks[i];
        if (callback.onLoad) callback.onLoad(image);
      }
      _loading.delete(image);
      this.manager.itemEnd(url);
    };
    const onImageError = (event: Event) => {
      removeEventListeners();
      if (onError) onError(event);
      this.manager.cache.remove(`image:${url}`);
      //
      const callbacks = _loading.get(image) || [];
      for (let i = 0; i < callbacks.length; i++) {
        const callback = callbacks[i];
        if (callback.onError) callback.onError(event);
      }
      _loading.delete(image);
      this.manager.itemError(url);
      this.manager.itemEnd(url);
    };
    function removeEventListeners() {
      image.removeEventListener("load", onImageLoad, false);
      image.removeEventListener("error", onImageError, false);
    }
    image.addEventListener("load", onImageLoad, false);
    image.addEventListener("error", onImageError, false);
    if (url.slice(0, 5) !== "data:") {
      if (this.crossOrigin !== undefined) (image as any).crossOrigin = this.crossOrigin;
    }
    this.manager.cache.add(`image:${url}`, image);
    this.manager.itemStart(url);
    (image as any).fetchPriority = this.priority;
    (image as any).src = url;
    return image;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/loaders/Loader

```typescript
import { LoadingManager } from "./LoadingManager";
/**
 * Abstract base class for loaders.
 *
 * @abstract
 */
export abstract class Loader<T = unknown, U = string> {
  manager: LoadingManager;
  crossOrigin: string;
  withCredentials: boolean;
  path: string;
  resourcePath: string;
  requestHeader: Record<string, string>;
  priority: "high" | "low" | "auto";
  cache: RequestCache;
  /**
   * The default material name used when creating materials for loaded objects.
   * Not all loaders honor this setting.
   */
  static DEFAULT_MATERIAL_NAME: string = "__DEFAULT";

  /**
   * Constructs a new loader.
   *
   * @param [manager] - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    /**
     * The loading manager.
     *
     * @default A new LoadingManager instance
     */
    this.manager = manager !== undefined ? manager : new LoadingManager();
    /**
     * The crossOrigin string to implement CORS for loading the url from a
     * different domain that allows CORS.
     *
     * @default 'anonymous'
     */
    this.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
    /**
     * Whether the XMLHttpRequest uses credentials.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.withCredentials = false;
    /**
     * The base path from which the asset will be loaded.
     *
     */
    this.path = "";
    /**
     * The base path from which additional resources like textures will be loaded.
     *
     */
    this.resourcePath = "";
    /**
     * The [request header](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/Request_header)
     * used in HTTP request.
     *
     */
    this.requestHeader = {};
    /**
     * The request priority hint. Image loaders use `HTMLImageElement.fetchPriority`.
     *
     * @default 'auto'
     */
    this.priority = "auto";
    /**
     * The HTTP cache mode passed to `fetch()`. This does not affect {@link Cache}
     * or loaders using `HTMLImageElement`.
     *
     * @default 'default'
     */
    this.cache = "default";
  }
  /**
   * This method needs to be implemented by all concrete loaders. It holds the
   * logic for loading assets from the backend.
   *
   * @abstract
   * @param url - The path/URL of the file to be loaded.
   * @param onLoad - Executed when the loading process has been finished.
   * @param [onProgress] - Executed while the loading is in progress.
   * @param [onError] - Executed when errors occur.
   */
  abstract load(
    url: U,
    onLoad?: (value: T) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): unknown;
  /**
   * A async version of {@link Loader#load}.
   *
   * @param url - The path/URL of the file to be loaded.
   * @param [onProgress] - Executed while the loading is in progress.
   * @return A Promise that resolves when the asset has been loaded.
   */
  loadAsync(url: U, onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void): Promise<T> {
    return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
      this.load(url, resolve, onProgress, reject);
    });
  }
  /**
   * Sets the `crossOrigin` String to implement CORS for loading the URL
   * from a different domain that allows CORS.
   *
   * @param crossOrigin - The `crossOrigin` value.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  setCrossOrigin(crossOrigin: string): this {
    this.crossOrigin = crossOrigin;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Whether the XMLHttpRequest uses credentials such as cookies, authorization
   * headers or TLS client certificates, see [XMLHttpRequest.withCredentials](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/XMLHttpRequest/withCredentials).
   *
   * Note: This setting has no effect if you are loading files locally or from the same domain.
   *
   * @param value - The `withCredentials` value.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  setWithCredentials(value: boolean): this {
    this.withCredentials = value;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Sets the base path for the asset.
   *
   * @param path - The base path.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  setPath(path: string): this {
    this.path = path;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Sets the base path for dependent resources like textures.
   *
   * @param resourcePath - The resource path.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  setResourcePath(resourcePath: string): this {
    this.resourcePath = resourcePath;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Sets the given request header.
   *
   * @param requestHeader - A [request header](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/Request_header)
   * for configuring the HTTP request.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  setRequestHeader(requestHeader: Record<string, string>): this {
    this.requestHeader = requestHeader;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Sets a browser scheduling hint. Browsers may ignore this hint.
   * Internally created loaders inherit it. Loaders supplied by the application
   * (for example decoder loaders or loading manager handlers) retain their own settings.
   *
   * @param value - The request priority hint.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  setPriority(value: "high" | "low" | "auto"): this {
    this.priority = value;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Sets the HTTP cache mode for fetch requests. `no-cache` revalidates cached
