   * responses; `no-store` bypasses the HTTP cache. This does not affect
   * {@link Cache} or image element requests.
   *
   * @param value - The HTTP cache mode.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  setCache(value: RequestCache): this {
    this.cache = value;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * This method can be implemented in loaders for aborting ongoing requests.
   *
   * @abstract
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  abort(): this {
    return this;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/loaders/LoaderUtils

```typescript
/**
 * A class with loader utility functions.
 */
export class LoaderUtils {
  /**
   * Extracts the base URL from the given URL.
   *
   * @param url -The URL to extract the base URL from.
   * @return The extracted base URL.
   */
  static extractUrlBase(url: string): string {
    const index = url.lastIndexOf("/");
    if (index === -1) return "./";
    return url.slice(0, index + 1);
  }
  /**
   * Resolves relative URLs against the given path. Absolute paths, data urls,
   * and blob URLs will be returned as is. Invalid URLs will return an empty
   * string.
   *
   * @param url -The URL to resolve.
   * @param path - The base path for relative URLs to be resolved against.
   * @return The resolved URL.
   */
  static resolveURL(url: string, path: string): string {
    // Invalid URL
    if (typeof url !== "string" || url === "") return "";
    // Host Relative URL
    if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(path) && url.startsWith("/")) {
      path = path.replace(/(^https?:\/\/[^/]+).*/i, "$1");
    }
    // Absolute URL http://,https://,//
    if (/^(https?:)?\/\//i.test(url)) return url;
    // Data URI
    if (/^data:.*,.*$/i.test(url)) return url;
    // Blob URL
    if (/^blob:.*$/i.test(url)) return url;
    // Relative URL
    return path + url;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/loaders/LoadingManager

````typescript
import type { Loader } from "./Loader";
import { Cache } from "./Cache";
/**
 * Owns loading progress, the optional resource cache, and in-flight requests.
 * Loaders share state only when explicitly supplied the same manager.
 *
 * In general that should be sufficient, however there are times when it can
 * be useful to have separate loaders - for example if you want to show
 * separate loading bars for objects and textures.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { FileLoader } from 'ek3d/loaders/FileLoader';
 * import { LoadingManager } from 'ek3d/loaders/LoadingManager';
 * import { TextureLoader } from 'ek3d/loaders/TextureLoader';
 *
 * const manager = new LoadingManager();
 * manager.onLoad = () => console.log( 'Loading complete!' );
 *
 * const loader1 = new FileLoader( manager );
 * const loader2 = new TextureLoader( manager );
 * ```
 */
export class LoadingManager {
  cache: Cache;
  fileRequests: Record<
    string,
    {
      onLoad?: (value: unknown) => void;
      onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void;
      onError?: (error: unknown) => void;
    }[]
  >;
  imageRequests: WeakMap<
    HTMLImageElement,
    { onLoad?: (image: HTMLImageElement) => void; onError?: (error: Event) => void }[]
  >;
  bitmapErrors: WeakMap<Promise<unknown>, unknown>;
  onStart: ((url: string, loaded: number, total: number) => void) | undefined;
  onLoad: (() => void) | undefined;
  onProgress: ((url: string, loaded: number, total: number) => void) | undefined;
  onError: ((url: string) => void) | undefined;
  _abortController: AbortController | null;
  itemStart: (url: string) => void;
  itemEnd: (url: string) => void;
  itemError: (url: string) => void;
  resolveURL: (url: string) => string;
  setURLModifier: (transform: (url: string) => string) => LoadingManager;
  addHandler: (regex: RegExp, loader: Loader) => LoadingManager;
  removeHandler: (regex: RegExp) => LoadingManager;
  getHandler: (file: string) => Loader | null;
  abort: () => LoadingManager;

  /**
   * Constructs a new loading manager.
   *
   * @param [onLoad] - Executes when all items have been loaded.
   * @param [onProgress] - Executes when single items have been loaded.
   * @param [onError] - Executes when an error occurs.
   */
  constructor(
    onLoad?: () => void,
    onProgress?: (url: string, loaded: number, total: number) => void,
    onError?: (url: string) => void,
  ) {
    this.cache = new Cache();
    this.fileRequests = Object.create(null);
    this.imageRequests = new WeakMap();
    this.bitmapErrors = new WeakMap();
    let isLoading = false;
    let itemsLoaded = 0;
    let itemsTotal = 0;
    let urlModifier: ((url: string) => string) | undefined = undefined;
    const handlers: any[] = [];
    // Refer to #5689 for the reason why we don't set .onStart
    // in the constructor
    /**
     * Executes when an item starts loading.
     *
     * @default undefined
     */
    this.onStart = undefined;
    /**
     * Executes when all items have been loaded.
     *
     * @default undefined
     */
    this.onLoad = onLoad;
    /**
     * Executes when single items have been loaded.
     *
     * @default undefined
     */
    this.onProgress = onProgress;
    /**
     * Executes when an error occurs.
     *
     * @default undefined
     */
    this.onError = onError;
    /**
     * Used for aborting ongoing requests in loaders using this manager.
     *
     * @private
     */
    this._abortController = null;
    /**
     * This should be called by any loader using the manager when the loader
     * starts loading an item.
     *
     * @param url - The URL to load.
     */
    this.itemStart = (url: string) => {
      itemsTotal++;
      if (isLoading === false) {
        if (this.onStart !== undefined) {
          this.onStart(url, itemsLoaded, itemsTotal);
        }
      }
      isLoading = true;
    };
    /**
     * This should be called by any loader using the manager when the loader
     * ended loading an item.
     *
     * @param url - The URL of the loaded item.
     */
    this.itemEnd = (url: string) => {
      itemsLoaded++;
      if (this.onProgress !== undefined) {
        this.onProgress(url, itemsLoaded, itemsTotal);
      }
      if (itemsLoaded === itemsTotal) {
        isLoading = false;
        if (this.onLoad !== undefined) {
          this.onLoad();
        }
      }
    };
    /**
     * This should be called by any loader using the manager when the loader
     * encounters an error when loading an item.
     *
     * @param url - The URL of the item that produces an error.
     */
    this.itemError = (url: string) => {
      if (this.onError !== undefined) {
        this.onError(url);
      }
    };
    /**
     * Given a URL, uses the URL modifier callback (if any) and returns a
     * resolved URL. If no URL modifier is set, returns the original URL.
     *
     * @param url - The URL to load.
     * @return The resolved URL.
     */
    this.resolveURL = function (url: string): string {
      // Normalize to NFC so that Unicode URIs (e.g. from glTF)
      // are percent-encoded correctly per RFC 3987.
      url = url.normalize("NFC");
      if (urlModifier) {
        return urlModifier(url);
      }
      return url;
    };
    /**
     * If provided, the callback will be passed each resource URL before a
     * request is sent. The callback may return the original URL, or a new URL to
     * override loading behavior. This behavior can be used to load assets from
     * .ZIP files, drag-and-drop APIs, and Data URIs.
     *
     * ```ts
     * import { FileLoader } from 'ek3d/loaders/FileLoader';
     * import { LoadingManager } from 'ek3d/loaders/LoadingManager';
     *
     * const blobs: Record<string, Blob> = {
     *   'message.txt': new Blob( [ 'Hello from an in-memory asset.' ], { type: 'text/plain' } ),
     * };
     * const manager = new LoadingManager();
     * const objectURLs: string[] = [];
     * manager.setURLModifier( ( url ) => {
     *   const blob = blobs[ url ];
     *   if ( blob === undefined ) return url;
     *   const objectURL = URL.createObjectURL( blob );
     *   objectURLs.push( objectURL );
     *   return objectURL;
     * } );
     *
     * try {
     *   const text = await new FileLoader( manager ).loadAsync( 'message.txt' );
     *   console.log( text );
     * } finally {
     *   objectURLs.forEach( ( url ) => URL.revokeObjectURL( url ) );
     * }
     * ```
     *
     * @param transform - URL modifier callback. Called with an URL and must return a resolved URL.
     * @return A reference to this loading manager.
     */
    this.setURLModifier = function (this: LoadingManager, transform: (url: string) => string): LoadingManager {
      urlModifier = transform;
      return this;
    };
    /**
     * Registers a loader with the given regular expression. Can be used to
     * define what loader should be used in order to load specific files. A
     * typical use case is to overwrite the default loader for textures.
     *
     * ```ts
     * import { LoadingManager } from 'ek3d/loaders/LoadingManager';
     * import { TextureLoader } from 'ek3d/loaders/TextureLoader';
     *
     * const manager = new LoadingManager();
     * manager.addHandler( /\.png$/i, new TextureLoader( manager ) );
     * ```
     *
     * @param regex - A regular expression.
     * @param loader - A loader that should handle matched cases.
     * @return A reference to this loading manager.
     */
    this.addHandler = function (this: LoadingManager, regex: RegExp, loader: Loader): LoadingManager {
      handlers.push(regex, loader);
      return this;
    };
    /**
     * Removes the loader for the given regular expression.
     *
     * @param regex - A regular expression.
     * @return A reference to this loading manager.
     */
    this.removeHandler = function (this: LoadingManager, regex: RegExp): LoadingManager {
      const index = handlers.indexOf(regex);
      if (index !== -1) {
        handlers.splice(index, 2);
      }
      return this;
    };
    /**
     * Can be used to retrieve the registered loader for the given file path.
     *
     * @param file - The file path.
     * @return The registered loader. Returns `null` if no loader was found.
     */
    this.getHandler = function (file: string): Loader | null {
      for (let i = 0, l = handlers.length; i < l; i += 2) {
        const regex = handlers[i];
        const loader = handlers[i + 1];
        if (regex.global) regex.lastIndex = 0; // see #17920
        if (regex.test(file)) {
          return loader;
        }
      }
      return null;
    };
    /**
     * Can be used to abort ongoing loading requests in loaders using this manager.
     * The abort only works if the loaders implement {@link Loader#abort} and `AbortSignal.any()`
     * is supported in the browser.
     *
     * @return A reference to this loading manager.
     */
    this.abort = function (this: any): LoadingManager {
      (this as any).abortController.abort();
      this._abortController = null;
      return this;
    };
  }
  // TODO: Revert this back to a single member variable once this issue has been fixed
  // https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/issues/3657
  /**
   * Used for aborting ongoing requests in loaders using this manager.
   *
   */
  get abortController() {
    if (!this._abortController) {
      this._abortController = new AbortController();
    }
    return this._abortController;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/loaders/MaterialLoader

````typescript
import type { Texture } from "../textures/Texture";
import type { LoadingManager } from "./LoadingManager";
import type { Material } from "../materials/Material";
import { FileLoader } from "./FileLoader";
import { Loader } from "./Loader";
import { error } from "../utils";
export type MaterialConstructors = Readonly<Record<string, new () => Material>>;
/**
 * Class for loading materials. The files are internally
 * loaded via {@link FileLoader}.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { MaterialLoader } from 'ek3d/loaders/MaterialLoader';
 * import { MeshBasicMaterial } from 'ek3d/materials/MeshBasicMaterial';
 *
 * const loader = new MaterialLoader( undefined, { MeshBasicMaterial } );
 * const material = await loader.loadAsync( 'material.json' );
 * ```
 * Supply the material constructors required by the serialized data explicitly.
 *
 */
export class MaterialLoader extends Loader<Material> {
  textures: Record<string, Texture>;
  constructors: MaterialConstructors;

  /**
   * Constructs a new material loader.
   *
   * @param [manager] - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager, constructors: MaterialConstructors = {}) {
    super(manager);
    this.textures = {};
    this.constructors = constructors;
  }
  /**
   * Starts loading from the given URL and pass the loaded material to the `onLoad()` callback.
   *
   * @param url - The path/URL of the file to be loaded. This can also be a data URI.
   * @param onLoad - Executed when the loading process has been finished.
   * @param onProgress - Executed while the loading is in progress.
   * @param onError - Executed when errors occur.
   */
  load(
    url: string,
    onLoad: (value: Material) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ) {
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (text?: any) => {
        try {
          onLoad(this.parse(JSON.parse(text as string)));
        } catch (e: any) {
          if (onError) {
            onError(e);
          } else {
            error(e);
          }
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }
  /**
   * Parses the given JSON object and returns a material.
   *
   * @param json - The serialized material.
   * @return The parsed material.
   */
  parse(json?: any): Material {
    const material = this.createMaterialFromType(json.type);
    material.fromJSON(json, this.textures);
    return material;
  }
  /**
   * Textures are not embedded in the material JSON so they have
   * to be injected before the loading process starts.
   *
   * @param value - A dictionary holding textures for material properties.
   * @return A reference to this material loader.
   */
  setTextures(value: Record<string, Texture>): MaterialLoader {
    this.textures = value;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Creates a material for the given type.
   *
   * @param type - The material type.
   * @return The new material.
   */
  createMaterialFromType(type: string): Material {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(this.constructors, type))
      throw new Error('MaterialLoader: Unknown material type "' + type + '".');
    return new (this.constructors as any)[type]();
  }
}
````

## ek3d/loaders/ObjectLoader

````typescript
import type { MaterialConstructors } from "./MaterialLoader";
import type { CurveFactory } from "../extras/core/Curve";
import type { Vector2 } from "../math/Vector2";
import type { BufferGeometry } from "../core/BufferGeometry";
import { Mapping, Wrapping, TextureFilter } from "../constants";
import { InstancedBufferAttribute } from "../core/InstancedBufferAttribute";
import { Color } from "../math/Color";
import { Vector3 } from "../math/Vector3";
import { Object3D } from "../core/Object3D";
import { Skeleton } from "../objects/Skeleton";
import { Shape } from "../extras/core/Shape";
import { Fog } from "../scenes/Fog";
import { FogExp2 } from "../scenes/FogExp2";
import { CubeTexture } from "../textures/CubeTexture";
import { Texture } from "../textures/Texture";
import { TextureSource } from "../textures/TextureSource";
import { DataTexture } from "../textures/DataTexture";
import { ImageLoader } from "./ImageLoader";
import { LoadingManager } from "./LoadingManager";
import { AnimationClip } from "../animation/AnimationClip";
import { MaterialLoader } from "./MaterialLoader";
import { LoaderUtils } from "./LoaderUtils";
import { BufferGeometryLoader } from "./BufferGeometryLoader";
import { Loader } from "./Loader";
import { FileLoader } from "./FileLoader";
import { getTypedArray, error, warn } from "../utils";
import { Box3 } from "../math/Box3";
import { Sphere } from "../math/Sphere";
import { SphericalHarmonics3 } from "../math/SphericalHarmonics3";

export interface ObjectLoaderFactories {
  objects?: Readonly<Record<string, new (...args: never[]) => Object3D>>;
  materials?: MaterialConstructors;
  geometries?: Readonly<Record<string, { fromJSON(data: unknown, shapes: Record<string, Shape>): BufferGeometry }>>;
  createCurve?: CurveFactory<Vector2>;
}
function missingCurve(json?: any) {
  throw new Error('ObjectLoader: Unknown curve type "' + json.type + '"; provide createCurve.');
}
/**
 * A loader for loading a JSON resource in the [JSON Object/Scene format](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/wiki/JSON-Object-Scene-format-4).
 * The files are internally loaded via {@link FileLoader}.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { ObjectLoader } from 'ek3d/loaders/ObjectLoader';
 * import { MeshBasicMaterial } from 'ek3d/materials/MeshBasicMaterial';
 * import { Mesh } from 'ek3d/objects/Mesh';
 * import { Scene } from 'ek3d/scenes/Scene';
 * import { BoxGeometry } from 'ek3d/geometries/BoxGeometry';
 *
 * const scene = new Scene();
 * const loader = new ObjectLoader( undefined, {
 *   objects: { Scene, Mesh },
 *   materials: { MeshBasicMaterial },
 *   geometries: { BoxGeometry },
 * } );
 * const obj = await loader.loadAsync( 'models/json/example.json' );
 * scene.add( obj );
 *
 * // Alternatively, fetch JSON separately before parsing it.
 * const json = await fetch( 'models/json/example.json' ).then( response => response.json() );
 * const object = await loader.parseAsync( json );
 * scene.add( object );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class ObjectLoader extends Loader<Object3D> {
  factories: ObjectLoaderFactories;

  /**
   * Constructs a new object loader.
   *
   * @param [manager] - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager, factories: ObjectLoaderFactories = {}) {
    super(manager);
    this.factories = factories;
  }
  createObject(type?: any, ...args: any[]) {
    const constructors = (this.factories as any).objects;
    if (!constructors || !Object.hasOwn(constructors, type))
      throw new Error('ObjectLoader: Unknown object type "' + type + '".');
    return new (constructors[type] as unknown as new (...args: unknown[]) => Object3D)(...args);
  }
  /**
   * Starts loading from the given URL and pass the loaded 3D object to the `onLoad()` callback.
   *
   * @param url - The path/URL of the file to be loaded. This can also be a data URI.
   * @param onLoad - Executed when the loading process has been finished.
   * @param onProgress - Executed while the loading is in progress.
   * @param onError - Executed when errors occur.
   */
  load(
    url: string,
    onLoad: (value: Object3D) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ) {
    const path = this.path === "" ? LoaderUtils.extractUrlBase(url) : this.path;
    this.resourcePath = this.resourcePath || path;
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    loader.load(
      url,
      (text?: any) => {
        try {
          const json = JSON.parse(text as string);
          if (
            json.metadata === undefined ||
            json.metadata.type === undefined ||
            json.metadata.type.toLowerCase() === "geometry"
          ) {
            throw new Error("ObjectLoader: Can't load " + url);
          }
          this.parse(json, onLoad, onError);
        } catch (e: any) {
          if (onError !== undefined) onError(e);
          else error(e);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
  }
  /**
   * Async version of {@link ObjectLoader#load}.
   *
   * @async
   * @param url - The path/URL of the file to be loaded. This can also be a data URI.
   * @param onProgress - Executed while the loading is in progress.
   * @return A Promise that resolves with the loaded 3D object.
   */
  async loadAsync(url: string, onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void): Promise<Object3D> {
    const path = this.path === "" ? LoaderUtils.extractUrlBase(url) : this.path;
    this.resourcePath = this.resourcePath || path;
    const loader = new FileLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.setRequestHeader(this.requestHeader);
    loader.setWithCredentials(this.withCredentials);
    const text = await loader.loadAsync(url, onProgress);
    let json: any;
    try {
      json = JSON.parse(text as string);
    } catch (e: any) {
      throw new Error("THREE.ObjectLoader: Can't parse " + url + ". " + e.message);
    }
    const metadata = json.metadata;
    if (metadata === undefined || metadata.type === undefined || metadata.type.toLowerCase() === "geometry") {
      throw new Error("THREE.ObjectLoader: Can't load " + url);
    }
    return await this.parseAsync(json);
  }
  /**
   * Parses the given JSON. This is used internally by {@link ObjectLoader#load}
   * but can also be used directly to parse a previously loaded JSON structure.
   *
   * @param json - The serialized 3D object.
   * @param onLoad - Executed when all resources (e.g. textures) have been fully loaded.
   * @return The parsed 3D object.
   */
  parse(json: any, onLoad?: (value: Object3D) => void, onError?: (error: unknown) => void): Object3D {
    const animations = this.parseAnimations(json.animations);
    const shapes = this.parseShapes(json.shapes);
    const geometries = this.parseGeometries(json.geometries, shapes);
    const images = this.parseImages(
      json.images,
      function () {
        if (onLoad !== undefined) onLoad(object);
      },
      onError,
    );
    const textures = this.parseTextures(json.textures, images);
    const materials = this.parseMaterials(json.materials, textures);
    const object = this.parseObject(json.object, geometries, materials, textures, animations);
    const skeletons = this.parseSkeletons(json.skeletons, object);
    this.bindSkeletons(object, skeletons);
    this.bindLightTargets(object);
    //
    if (onLoad !== undefined) {
      let hasImages = false;
      for (const uuid in images) {
        if (
          (images as any)[uuid].data instanceof HTMLImageElement ||
          (Array.isArray((images as any)[uuid].data) &&
            (images as any)[uuid].data.some((image?: any) => image instanceof HTMLImageElement))
        ) {
          hasImages = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (hasImages === false) onLoad(object);
    }
    return object;
  }
  /**
   * Async version of {@link ObjectLoader#parse}.
   *
   * @param json - The serialized 3D object.
   * @return A Promise that resolves with the parsed 3D object.
   */
  async parseAsync(json?: any): Promise<Object3D> {
    const animations = this.parseAnimations(json.animations);
    const shapes = this.parseShapes(json.shapes);
    const geometries = this.parseGeometries(json.geometries, shapes);
    const images = await this.parseImagesAsync(json.images);
    const textures = this.parseTextures(json.textures, images);
    const materials = this.parseMaterials(json.materials, textures);
    const object = this.parseObject(json.object, geometries, materials, textures, animations);
    const skeletons = this.parseSkeletons(json.skeletons, object);
    this.bindSkeletons(object, skeletons);
    this.bindLightTargets(object);
    return object;
  }
  // internals
  parseShapes(json?: any) {
    const shapes: any = {};
    if (json !== undefined) {
      for (let i = 0, l = json.length; i < l; i++) {
        const shape = new Shape().fromJSON(json[i], (this.factories as any).createCurve || missingCurve);
        (shapes as any)[shape.uuid] = shape;
      }
    }
    return shapes;
  }
  parseSkeletons(json: any, object?: any) {
    const skeletons: any = {};
    const bones: any = {};
    // generate bone lookup table
    object.traverse(function (child?: any) {
      if (child.isBone) (bones as any)[child.uuid] = child;
    });
    // create skeletons
    if (json !== undefined) {
      for (let i = 0, l = json.length; i < l; i++) {
        const skeleton = new Skeleton().fromJSON(json[i], bones);
        (skeletons as any)[skeleton.uuid] = skeleton;
      }
    }
    return skeletons;
  }
  parseGeometries(json: any, shapes?: any) {
    const geometries: any = {};
    if (json !== undefined) {
      const bufferGeometryLoader = new BufferGeometryLoader(this.manager);
      for (let i = 0, l = json.length; i < l; i++) {
        let geometry: any;
        const data = json[i];
        switch (data.type) {
          case "BufferGeometry":
          case "InstancedBufferGeometry":
            geometry = bufferGeometryLoader.parse(data);
            break;
          default: {
            const factory = (this.factories as any).geometries;
            if (!factory || !Object.hasOwn(factory, data.type))
              throw new Error('ObjectLoader: Unknown geometry type "' + data.type + '".');
            geometry = factory[data.type].fromJSON(data, shapes);
          }
        }
        geometry.uuid = data.uuid;
        if (data.name !== undefined) geometry.name = data.name;
        if (data.userData !== undefined) geometry.userData = data.userData;
        (geometries as any)[data.uuid] = geometry;
      }
    }
    return geometries;
  }
  parseMaterials(json: any, textures?: any) {
    const cache: any = {}; // MultiMaterial
    const materials: any = {};
    if (json !== undefined) {
      const loader = new MaterialLoader(this.manager, (this.factories as any).materials);
      loader.setTextures(textures);
      for (let i = 0, l = json.length; i < l; i++) {
        const data = json[i];
        if ((cache as any)[data.uuid] === undefined) {
          (cache as any)[data.uuid] = loader.parse(data);
        }
        (materials as any)[data.uuid] = (cache as any)[data.uuid];
      }
    }
    return materials;
  }
  parseAnimations(json?: any) {
    const animations: any = {};
    if (json !== undefined) {
      for (let i = 0; i < json.length; i++) {
        const data = json[i];
        const clip = AnimationClip.parse(data);
        (animations as any)[clip.uuid] = clip;
      }
    }
    return animations;
  }
  parseImages(json: any, onLoad: any, onError?: (error: unknown) => void) {
    const images: any = {};
    let loader: any;
    let failed = false;
    const loadImage = (url?: any) => {
      url = this.manager.resolveURL(url);
      this.manager.itemStart(url);
      return loader.load(
        url,
        () => {
          this.manager.itemEnd(url);
        },
        undefined,
        (event?: any) => {
          failed = true;
          if (onError !== undefined) onError(event);
          this.manager.itemError(url);
          this.manager.itemEnd(url);
        },
      );
    };
    const deserializeImage = (image?: any) => {
      if (typeof image === "string") {
        const url = image;
        const path = /^(\/\/)|([a-z]+:(\/\/)?)/i.test(url) ? url : this.resourcePath + url;
        return loadImage(path);
      } else {
        if (image.data) {
          return {
            data: getTypedArray(image.type, image.data),
            width: image.width,
            height: image.height,
          };
        } else {
          return null;
        }
      }
    };
    if (json !== undefined && json.length > 0) {
      const manager = new LoadingManager(function () {
        if (!failed && onLoad !== undefined) onLoad();
      });
      loader = new ImageLoader(manager);
      loader.setPriority(this.priority);
      loader.setCache(this.cache);
      loader.setCrossOrigin(this.crossOrigin);
      for (let i = 0, il = json.length; i < il; i++) {
        const image = json[i];
        const url = image.url;
        if (Array.isArray(url)) {
          // load array of images e.g CubeTexture
          const imageArray: any[] = [];
          for (let j = 0, jl = url.length; j < jl; j++) {
            const currentUrl = url[j];
            const deserializedImage = deserializeImage(currentUrl);
            if (deserializedImage !== null) {
              if (deserializedImage instanceof HTMLImageElement) {
                imageArray.push(deserializedImage);
              } else {
                // special case: handle array of data textures for cube textures
                imageArray.push(
                  new DataTexture(deserializedImage.data, deserializedImage.width, deserializedImage.height),
                );
              }
            }
          }
          (images as any)[image.uuid] = new TextureSource(imageArray);
        } else {
          // load single image
          const deserializedImage = deserializeImage(image.url);
          (images as any)[image.uuid] = new TextureSource(deserializedImage);
        }
      }
    }
    for (const uuid in images) (images as any)[uuid].uuid = uuid;
    return images;
  }
  async parseImagesAsync(json?: any) {
    const images: any = {};
    let loader: any;
    const deserializeImage = async (image?: any) => {
      if (typeof image === "string") {
        const url = image;
        const path = /^(\/\/)|([a-z]+:(\/\/)?)/i.test(url) ? url : this.resourcePath + url;
        return await loader.loadAsync(path);
      } else {
        if (image.data) {
          return {
            data: getTypedArray(image.type, image.data),
            width: image.width,
            height: image.height,
          };
        } else {
          return null;
        }
      }
    };
    if (json !== undefined && json.length > 0) {
      loader = new ImageLoader(this.manager);
      loader.setPriority(this.priority);
      loader.setCache(this.cache);
      loader.setCrossOrigin(this.crossOrigin);
      for (let i = 0, il = json.length; i < il; i++) {
        const image = json[i];
        const url = image.url;
        if (Array.isArray(url)) {
          // load array of images e.g CubeTexture
          const imageArray: any[] = [];
          for (let j = 0, jl = url.length; j < jl; j++) {
            const currentUrl = url[j];
            const deserializedImage = await deserializeImage(currentUrl);
            if (deserializedImage !== null) {
              if (deserializedImage instanceof HTMLImageElement) {
                imageArray.push(deserializedImage);
              } else {
                // special case: handle array of data textures for cube textures
                imageArray.push(
                  new DataTexture(deserializedImage.data, deserializedImage.width, deserializedImage.height),
                );
              }
            }
          }
          (images as any)[image.uuid] = new TextureSource(imageArray);
        } else {
          // load single image
          const deserializedImage = await deserializeImage(image.url);
          (images as any)[image.uuid] = new TextureSource(deserializedImage);
        }
      }
    }
    for (const uuid in images) (images as any)[uuid].uuid = uuid;
    return images;
  }
  parseTextures(json: any, images?: any) {
    function parseConstant(value: any, type?: any) {
      if (typeof value === "number") return value;
      warn("ObjectLoader.parseTexture: Constant should be in numeric form.", value);
      return type[value];
    }
    const textures: any = {};
    if (json !== undefined) {
      for (let i = 0, l = json.length; i < l; i++) {
        const data = json[i];
        if (data.image === undefined) {
          warn('ObjectLoader: No "image" specified for', data.uuid);
        }
        if (images[data.image] === undefined) {
          warn("ObjectLoader: Undefined image", data.image);
        }
        const source = images[data.image];
        const image = source.data;
        let texture: any;
        if (Array.isArray(image)) {
          texture = new CubeTexture();
          if (image.length === 6) texture.needsUpdate = true;
        } else {
          if (image && image.data) {
            texture = new DataTexture();
          } else {
            texture = new Texture();
          }
          if (image) texture.needsUpdate = true; // textures can have undefined image data
        }
        texture.source = source;
        texture.uuid = data.uuid;
        if (data.name !== undefined) texture.name = data.name;
        if (data.mapping !== undefined) texture.mapping = parseConstant(data.mapping, TEXTURE_MAPPING);
        if (data.channel !== undefined) texture.channel = data.channel;
        if (data.offset !== undefined) texture.offset.fromArray(data.offset);
        if (data.repeat !== undefined) texture.repeat.fromArray(data.repeat);
        if (data.center !== undefined) texture.center.fromArray(data.center);
        if (data.rotation !== undefined) texture.rotation = data.rotation;
        if (data.wrap !== undefined) {
          texture.wrapS = parseConstant(data.wrap[0], TEXTURE_WRAPPING);
          texture.wrapT = parseConstant(data.wrap[1], TEXTURE_WRAPPING);
        }
        if (data.format !== undefined) texture.format = data.format;
        if (data.internalFormat !== undefined) texture.internalFormat = data.internalFormat;
        if (data.type !== undefined) texture.type = data.type;
        if (data.colorSpace !== undefined) texture.colorSpace = data.colorSpace;
        if (data.minFilter !== undefined) texture.minFilter = parseConstant(data.minFilter, TEXTURE_FILTER);
        if (data.magFilter !== undefined) texture.magFilter = parseConstant(data.magFilter, TEXTURE_FILTER);
        if (data.anisotropy !== undefined) texture.anisotropy = data.anisotropy;
        if (data.flipY !== undefined) texture.flipY = data.flipY;
        if (data.generateMipmaps !== undefined) texture.generateMipmaps = data.generateMipmaps;
        if (data.mipmapsAutoUpdate !== undefined) texture.mipmapsAutoUpdate = data.mipmapsAutoUpdate;
        if (data.premultiplyAlpha !== undefined) texture.premultiplyAlpha = data.premultiplyAlpha;
        if (data.unpackAlignment !== undefined) texture.unpackAlignment = data.unpackAlignment;
        if (data.compareFunction !== undefined) (texture as any).compareFunction = data.compareFunction;
        if (data.normalized !== undefined) texture.normalized = data.normalized;
        if (data.userData !== undefined) texture.userData = data.userData;
        (textures as any)[data.uuid] = texture;
      }
    }
    return textures;
  }
  parseObject(data?: any, geometries: any = {}, materials: any = {}, textures: any = {}, animations: any = {}) {
    let object: any;
    function getGeometry(name?: any) {
      if ((geometries as any)[name] === undefined) {
        warn("ObjectLoader: Undefined geometry", name);
      }
      return (geometries as any)[name];
    }
    function getMaterial(name?: any) {
      if (name === undefined) return undefined;
      if (Array.isArray(name)) {
        const array: any[] = [];
        for (let i = 0, l = name.length; i < l; i++) {
          const uuid = name[i];
          if ((materials as any)[uuid] === undefined) {
            warn("ObjectLoader: Undefined material", uuid);
          }
          array.push((materials as any)[uuid]);
        }
        return array;
      }
      if ((materials as any)[name] === undefined) {
        warn("ObjectLoader: Undefined material", name);
      }
      return (materials as any)[name];
    }
    function getTexture(uuid?: any) {
      if ((textures as any)[uuid] === undefined) {
        warn("ObjectLoader: Undefined texture", uuid);
      }
      return (textures as any)[uuid];
    }
    let geometry: any, material: any;
    switch (data.type) {
      case "Scene":
        object = this.createObject("Scene");
        if (data.background !== undefined) {
          if (Number.isInteger(data.background)) {
            object.background = new Color(data.background);
          } else {
            object.background = getTexture(data.background);
          }
        }
        if (data.environment !== undefined) {
          object.environment = getTexture(data.environment);
        }
        if (data.fog !== undefined) {
          if (data.fog.type === "Fog") {
            object.fog = new Fog(data.fog.color, data.fog.near, data.fog.far);
          } else if (data.fog.type === "FogExp2") {
            object.fog = new FogExp2(data.fog.color, data.fog.density);
          }
          if (data.fog.name !== "") {
            object.fog.name = data.fog.name;
          }
        }
        if (data.backgroundBlurriness !== undefined) object.backgroundBlurriness = data.backgroundBlurriness;
        if (data.backgroundIntensity !== undefined) object.backgroundIntensity = data.backgroundIntensity;
        if (data.backgroundRotation !== undefined) object.backgroundRotation.fromArray(data.backgroundRotation);
        if (data.environmentIntensity !== undefined) object.environmentIntensity = data.environmentIntensity;
        if (data.environmentRotation !== undefined) object.environmentRotation.fromArray(data.environmentRotation);
        break;
      case "PerspectiveCamera":
        object = this.createObject("PerspectiveCamera", data.fov, data.aspect, data.near, data.far);
        if (data.focus !== undefined) object.focus = data.focus;
        if (data.zoom !== undefined) object.zoom = data.zoom;
        if (data.filmGauge !== undefined) object.filmGauge = data.filmGauge;
        if (data.filmOffset !== undefined) object.filmOffset = data.filmOffset;
        if (data.view !== undefined) object.view = Object.assign({}, data.view);
        break;
      case "OrthographicCamera":
        object = this.createObject(
          "OrthographicCamera",
          data.left,
          data.right,
          data.top,
          data.bottom,
          data.near,
          data.far,
        );
        if (data.zoom !== undefined) object.zoom = data.zoom;
        if (data.view !== undefined) object.view = Object.assign({}, data.view);
        break;
      case "AmbientLight":
        object = this.createObject("AmbientLight", data.color, data.intensity);
        break;
      case "DirectionalLight":
        object = this.createObject("DirectionalLight", data.color, data.intensity);
        object.target = data.target || "";
        break;
      case "PointLight":
        object = this.createObject("PointLight", data.color, data.intensity, data.distance, data.decay);
        break;
      case "RectAreaLight":
        object = this.createObject("RectAreaLight", data.color, data.intensity, data.width, data.height);
        break;
      case "SpotLight":
        object = this.createObject(
          "SpotLight",
          data.color,
          data.intensity,
          data.distance,
          data.angle,
          data.penumbra,
          data.decay,
        );
        object.target = data.target || "";
        if (data.map !== undefined) object.map = getTexture(data.map);
        break;
      case "HemisphereLight":
        object = this.createObject("HemisphereLight", data.color, data.groundColor, data.intensity);
        break;
      case "LightProbe":
        const sh = new SphericalHarmonics3().fromArray(data.sh);
        object = this.createObject("LightProbe", sh, data.intensity);
        break;
      case "SkinnedMesh":
        geometry = getGeometry(data.geometry);
        material = getMaterial(data.material);
        object = this.createObject("SkinnedMesh", geometry, material);
        if (data.bindMode !== undefined) object.bindMode = data.bindMode;
        if (data.bindMatrix !== undefined) object.bindMatrix.fromArray(data.bindMatrix);
        if (data.skeleton !== undefined) object.skeleton = data.skeleton;
        break;
      case "Mesh":
        geometry = getGeometry(data.geometry);
        material = getMaterial(data.material);
        object = this.createObject("Mesh", geometry, material);
        break;
      case "InstancedMesh":
        geometry = getGeometry(data.geometry);
        material = getMaterial(data.material);
        const count = data.count;
        const instanceMatrix = data.instanceMatrix;
        const instanceColor = data.instanceColor;
        object = this.createObject("InstancedMesh", geometry, material, count);
        object.instanceMatrix = new InstancedBufferAttribute(new Float32Array(instanceMatrix.array), 16);
        if (instanceColor !== undefined)
          object.instanceColor = new InstancedBufferAttribute(
            new Float32Array(instanceColor.array),
            instanceColor.itemSize,
          );
        break;
      case "BatchedMesh":
        geometry = getGeometry(data.geometry);
        material = getMaterial(data.material);
        object = this.createObject(
          "BatchedMesh",
          data.maxInstanceCount,
          data.maxVertexCount,
          data.maxIndexCount,
          material,
        );
        object.geometry = geometry;
        object.perObjectFrustumCulled = data.perObjectFrustumCulled;
        object.sortObjects = data.sortObjects;
        object._drawRanges = data.drawRanges;
        object._reservedRanges = data.reservedRanges;
        object._geometryInfo = data.geometryInfo.map((info?: any) => {
          let box: any = null;
          let sphere: any = null;
          if (info.boundingBox !== undefined) {
            box = new Box3().fromJSON(info.boundingBox);
          }
          if (info.boundingSphere !== undefined) {
            sphere = new Sphere().fromJSON(info.boundingSphere);
          }
          return {
            ...info,
            boundingBox: box,
            boundingSphere: sphere,
          };
        });
        object._instanceInfo = data.instanceInfo;
        object._availableInstanceIds = data.availableInstanceIds;
        object._availableGeometryIds = data.availableGeometryIds;
        object._nextIndexStart = data.nextIndexStart;
        object._nextVertexStart = data.nextVertexStart;
        object._geometryCount = data.geometryCount;
        object._maxInstanceCount = data.maxInstanceCount;
        object._maxVertexCount = data.maxVertexCount;
        object._maxIndexCount = data.maxIndexCount;
        object._geometryInitialized = data.geometryInitialized;
        object._matricesTexture = getTexture(data.matricesTexture.uuid);
        object._indirectTexture = getTexture(data.indirectTexture.uuid);
        if (data.colorsTexture !== undefined) {
          object._colorsTexture = getTexture(data.colorsTexture.uuid);
        }
        if (data.boundingSphere !== undefined) {
          object.boundingSphere = new Sphere().fromJSON(data.boundingSphere);
        }
        if (data.boundingBox !== undefined) {
          object.boundingBox = new Box3().fromJSON(data.boundingBox);
        }
        break;
      case "LOD":
        object = this.createObject("LOD");
        break;
      case "Line":
        object = this.createObject("Line", getGeometry(data.geometry), getMaterial(data.material));
        break;
      case "LineLoop":
        object = this.createObject("LineLoop", getGeometry(data.geometry), getMaterial(data.material));
        break;
      case "LineSegments":
        object = this.createObject("LineSegments", getGeometry(data.geometry), getMaterial(data.material));
        break;
      case "PointCloud":
      case "Points":
        object = this.createObject("Points", getGeometry(data.geometry), getMaterial(data.material));
        break;
      case "Sprite":
        object = this.createObject("Sprite", getMaterial(data.material));
        if (data.center !== undefined) object.center.fromArray(data.center);
        break;
      case "Group":
        object = this.createObject("Group");
        break;
      case "Bone":
        object = this.createObject("Bone");
        break;
      default:
        object = this.createObject(data.type);
    }
    object.uuid = data.uuid;
    if (data.name !== undefined) object.name = data.name;
    if (data.pivot !== undefined) object.pivot = new Vector3().fromArray(data.pivot);
    if (data.matrix !== undefined) {
      object.matrix.fromArray(data.matrix);
      if (data.matrixAutoUpdate !== undefined) object.matrixAutoUpdate = data.matrixAutoUpdate;
      if (object.matrixAutoUpdate) {
        object.matrix.decompose(object.position, object.quaternion, object.scale);
        if (object.pivot !== null) object.position.copy(object.pivot).applyMatrix4(object.matrix).sub(object.pivot);
      }
    } else {
      if (data.position !== undefined) object.position.fromArray(data.position);
      if (data.rotation !== undefined) object.rotation.fromArray(data.rotation);
      if (data.quaternion !== undefined) object.quaternion.fromArray(data.quaternion);
      if (data.scale !== undefined) object.scale.fromArray(data.scale);
    }
    if (data.up !== undefined) object.up.fromArray(data.up);
    if (data.morphTargetDictionary !== undefined)
      object.morphTargetDictionary = Object.assign({}, data.morphTargetDictionary);
    if (data.morphTargetInfluences !== undefined) object.morphTargetInfluences = data.morphTargetInfluences.slice();
    if (data.castShadow !== undefined) object.castShadow = data.castShadow;
    if (data.receiveShadow !== undefined) object.receiveShadow = data.receiveShadow;
    if (data.shadow) {
      if (data.shadow.intensity !== undefined) object.shadow.intensity = data.shadow.intensity;
      if (data.shadow.bias !== undefined) object.shadow.bias = data.shadow.bias;
      if (data.shadow.normalBias !== undefined) object.shadow.normalBias = data.shadow.normalBias;
      if (data.shadow.radius !== undefined) object.shadow.radius = data.shadow.radius;
      if (data.shadow.blurSamples !== undefined) object.shadow.blurSamples = data.shadow.blurSamples;
      if (data.shadow.focus !== undefined) object.shadow.focus = data.shadow.focus;
      if (data.shadow.aspect !== undefined) object.shadow.aspect = data.shadow.aspect;
      if (data.shadow.mapSize !== undefined) object.shadow.mapSize.fromArray(data.shadow.mapSize);
      if (data.shadow.mapType !== undefined) object.shadow.mapType = data.shadow.mapType;
      if (data.shadow.camera !== undefined) object.shadow.camera = this.parseObject(data.shadow.camera);
    }
    if (data.visible !== undefined) object.visible = data.visible;
    if (data.frustumCulled !== undefined) object.frustumCulled = data.frustumCulled;
    if (data.renderOrder !== undefined) object.renderOrder = data.renderOrder;
    if (data.static !== undefined) object.static = data.static;
    if (data.userData !== undefined) object.userData = data.userData;
    if (data.layers !== undefined) object.layers.mask = data.layers;
    if (data.children !== undefined) {
      const children = data.children;
      for (let i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
        object.add(this.parseObject(children[i], geometries, materials, textures, animations));
      }
    }
    if (data.animations !== undefined) {
      const objectAnimations = data.animations;
      for (let i = 0; i < objectAnimations.length; i++) {
        const uuid = objectAnimations[i];
        object.animations.push((animations as any)[uuid]);
      }
    }
    if (data.type === "LOD") {
      if (data.autoUpdate !== undefined) object.autoUpdate = data.autoUpdate;
      const levels = data.levels;
      for (let l = 0; l < levels.length; l++) {
        const level = levels[l];
        const child = object.getObjectByProperty("uuid", level.object);
        if (child !== undefined) {
          object.addLevel(child, level.distance, level.hysteresis);
        }
      }
    }
    return object;
  }
  bindSkeletons(object: any, skeletons?: any) {
    if (Object.keys(skeletons).length === 0) return;
    object.traverse(function (child?: any) {
      if (child.isSkinnedMesh === true && child.skeleton !== undefined) {
        const skeleton = skeletons[child.skeleton];
        if (skeleton === undefined) {
          warn("ObjectLoader: No skeleton found with UUID:", child.skeleton);
        } else {
          child.bind(skeleton, child.bindMatrix);
        }
      }
    });
  }
  bindLightTargets(object?: any) {
    object.traverse(function (child?: any) {
      if (child.isDirectionalLight || child.isSpotLight) {
        const uuid = child.target;
        const target = object.getObjectByProperty("uuid", uuid);
        if (target !== undefined) {
          child.target = target;
        } else {
          child.target = new Object3D();
        }
      }
    });
  }
}
const TEXTURE_MAPPING = {
  UVMapping: Mapping.UV,
  CubeReflectionMapping: Mapping.CubeReflection,
  CubeRefractionMapping: Mapping.CubeRefraction,
  EquirectangularReflectionMapping: Mapping.EquirectangularReflection,
  EquirectangularRefractionMapping: Mapping.EquirectangularRefraction,
};
const TEXTURE_WRAPPING = {
  RepeatWrapping: Wrapping.Repeat,
  ClampToEdgeWrapping: Wrapping.ClampToEdge,
  MirroredRepeatWrapping: Wrapping.MirroredRepeat,
};
const TEXTURE_FILTER = {
  NearestFilter: TextureFilter.Nearest,
  NearestMipmapNearestFilter: TextureFilter.NearestMipmapNearest,
  NearestMipmapLinearFilter: TextureFilter.NearestMipmapLinear,
  LinearFilter: TextureFilter.Linear,
  LinearMipmapNearestFilter: TextureFilter.LinearMipmapNearest,
  LinearMipmapLinearFilter: TextureFilter.LinearMipmapLinear,
};
````

## ek3d/loaders/TextureLoader

````typescript
import type { LoadingManager } from "./LoadingManager";
import { ImageLoader } from "./ImageLoader";
import { Texture } from "../textures/Texture";
import { Loader } from "./Loader";
/**
 * Class for loading textures. Images are internally
 * loaded via {@link ImageLoader}.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { TextureLoader } from 'ek3d/loaders/TextureLoader';
 * import { MeshBasicMaterial } from 'ek3d/materials/MeshBasicMaterial';
 *
 * const loader = new TextureLoader();
 * const texture = await loader.loadAsync( 'textures/land_ocean_ice_cloud_2048.jpg' );
 *
 * const material = new MeshBasicMaterial( { map:texture } );
 * ```
 * Please note that `TextureLoader` has dropped support for progress
 * events in `r84`. For a `TextureLoader` that supports progress events, see
 * [this thread](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/issues/10439#issuecomment-293260145).
 *
 */
export class TextureLoader extends Loader<Texture, string> {
  /**
   * Constructs a new texture loader.
   *
   * @param [manager] - The loading manager.
   */
  constructor(manager?: LoadingManager) {
    super(manager);
  }
  /**
   * Starts loading from the given URL and pass the fully loaded texture
   * to the `onLoad()` callback. The method also returns a new texture object which can
   * directly be used for material creation. If you do it this way, the texture
   * may pop up in your scene once the respective loading process is finished.
   *
   * @param url - The path/URL of the file to be loaded. This can also be a data URI.
   * @param [onLoad] - Executed when the loading process has been finished.
   * @param [onProgress] - Unsupported in this loader.
   * @param [onError] - Executed when errors occur.
   * @return The texture.
   */
  load(
    url: string,
    onLoad?: (value: Texture) => void,
    onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void,
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void,
  ): Texture {
    const texture = new Texture();
    const loader = new ImageLoader(this.manager);
    loader.setPriority(this.priority);
    loader.setCache(this.cache);
    loader.setCrossOrigin(this.crossOrigin);
    loader.setPath(this.path);
    loader.load(
      url,
      function (image?: any) {
        texture.image = image;
        texture.needsUpdate = true;
        if (onLoad !== undefined) {
          onLoad(texture);
        }
      },
      onProgress,
      onError,
    );
    return texture;
  }
}
````

## ek3d/materials/LineBasicMaterial

````typescript
import type { Texture } from "../textures/Texture";
import { Material } from "./Material";
import { Color } from "../math/Color";

export type LineBasicMaterialParameters = Omit<Partial<LineBasicMaterial>, "color"> & {
  color?: Color | number | string;
};
/**
 * A material for rendering line primitives.
 *
 * Materials define the appearance of renderable 3D objects.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { LineBasicMaterial } from 'ek3d/materials/LineBasicMaterial';
 *
 * const material = new LineBasicMaterial( { color: 0xffffff } );
 * ```
 *
 */
export class LineBasicMaterial extends Material {
  isLineBasicMaterial: boolean;

  color: Color;
  map: Texture | null;
  linewidth: number;
  linecap: string;
  linejoin: string;
  fog: boolean;

  /**
   * Constructs a new line basic material.
   *
   * @param [parameters] - An object with one or more properties
   * defining the material's appearance. Any property of the material
   * (including any property from inherited materials) can be passed
   * in here. Color values can be passed any type of value accepted
   * by {@link Color#set}.
   */
  constructor(parameters?: LineBasicMaterialParameters) {
    super();
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isLineBasicMaterial = true;
    this.type = "LineBasicMaterial";
    /**
     * Color of the material.
     *
     * @default (1,1,1)
     */
    this.color = new Color(0xffffff);
    /**
     * Sets the color of the lines using data from a texture. The texture map
     * color is modulated by the diffuse `color`.
     *
     * `map` represents color data, and the texture must be assigned a
     * {@link Texture#colorSpace}. Most `map` textures set
     * `texture.colorSpace = ColorSpace.SRGB`.
     *
     * @default null
     */
    this.map = null;
    /**
     * Controls line thickness or lines.
     *
     * Can only be used with {@link SVGRenderer}. WebGL ignores this setting and always render line primitives with a
     * width of one pixel.
     *
     * @default 1
     */
    this.linewidth = 1;
    /**
     * Defines appearance of line ends.
     *
     * Can only be used with {@link SVGRenderer}.
     *
     * @default 'round'
     */
    this.linecap = "round";
    /**
     * Defines appearance of line joints.
     *
     * Can only be used with {@link SVGRenderer}.
     *
     * @default 'round'
     */
    this.linejoin = "round";
    /**
     * Whether the material is affected by fog or not.
     *
     * @default true
     */
    this.fog = true;
    this.setValues(parameters);
  }
  copy(source: LineBasicMaterial): this {
    super.copy(source);
    this.color.copy(source.color);
    this.map = source.map;
    this.linewidth = source.linewidth;
    this.linecap = source.linecap;
    this.linejoin = source.linejoin;
    this.fog = source.fog;
    return this;
  }
}

## ek3d/materials/Material

```typescript

/**
 * Abstract base class for materials.
 *
 * Materials define the appearance of renderable 3D objects.
 *
 * @abstract
 */
export class Material extends EventDispatcher {
  isMaterial: boolean;
  uuid: string;
  name: string;
  type: string;
  blending: Blending;
  side: Side;
  vertexColors: boolean;
  opacity: number;
  transparent: boolean;
  alphaHash: boolean;
  blendSrc: Factor;
  blendDst: Factor;
  blendEquation: Equation;
  blendSrcAlpha: Factor | null;
  blendDstAlpha: Factor | null;
  blendEquationAlpha: Equation | null;

     * @readonly

     */
    this.isMaterial = true;

     * The ID of the material.
     *
     * @name Material#id
     * @readonly
     */

      value: (this.id = _materialId++),
      writable: false,
      enumerable: false,
      configurable: false,
    });
    /**
     * The UUID of the material.
     *
     * @readonly
     */
    this.uuid = generateUUID();
    /**
     * The name of the material.
     *
     */
    this.name = "";
    /**
     * The type property is used for detecting the object type
     * in context of serialization/deserialization.
     *
     * @readonly
     */
    this.type = "Material";
    /**
     * Defines the blending type of the material.
     *
     * It must be set to `Blending.Custom` if custom blending properties like
     * {@link Material#blendSrc}, {@link Material#blendDst} or {@link Material#blendEquation}
     * should have any effect.
     *
     * @default Blending.Normal
     */
    this.blending = Blending.Normal;
    /**
     * Defines which side of faces will be rendered - front, back or both.
     *
     * @default Side.Front
     */
    this.side = Side.Front;
    /**
     * If set to `true`, vertex colors should be used.
     *
     * The engine supports RGB and RGBA vertex colors depending on whether a three (RGB) or
     * four (RGBA) component color buffer attribute is used.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.vertexColors = false;
    /**
     * Defines how transparent the material is.
     * A value of `0.0` indicates fully transparent, `1.0` is fully opaque.
     *
     * If the {@link Material#transparent} is not set to `true`,
     * the material will remain fully opaque and this value will only affect its color.
     *
     * @default 1
     */
    this.opacity = 1;
    /**
     * Defines whether this material is transparent. This has an effect on
     * rendering as transparent objects need special treatment and are rendered
     * after non-transparent objects.
     *
     * When set to true, the extent to which the material is transparent is
     * controlled by {@link Material#opacity}.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.transparent = false;
    /**
     * Enables alpha hashed transparency, an alternative to {@link Material#transparent} or
     * {@link Material#alphaTest}. The material will not be rendered if opacity is lower than
     * a random threshold. Randomization introduces some grain or noise, but approximates alpha
     * blending without the associated problems of sorting. Using TAA can reduce the resulting noise.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.alphaHash = false;
    /**
     * Defines the blending source factor.
     *
     * @default Factor.SrcAlpha
     */
    this.blendSrc = Factor.SrcAlpha;
    /**
     * Defines the blending destination factor.
     *
     * @default Factor.OneMinusSrcAlpha
     */
    this.blendDst = Factor.OneMinusSrcAlpha;
    /**
     * Defines the blending equation.
     *
     * @default Equation.Add
     */
    this.blendEquation = Equation.Add;
    /**
     * Defines the blending source alpha factor.
     *
     * @default null

    this.blendSrcAlpha = null;
    /**
     * Defines the blending destination alpha factor.
     *
     * @default null

    this.blendDstAlpha = null;
    /**

     *

    this.blendEquationAlpha = null;
