// Flattening for arrays of vectors and matrices
function flatten(array?: any, nBlocks?: any, blockSize?: any) {
  const firstElem = array[0];
  if (firstElem <= 0 || firstElem > 0) return array;
  // unoptimized: ! isNaN( firstElem )
  // see http://jacksondunstan.com/articles/983
  const n = nBlocks * blockSize;
  let r = arrayCacheF32[n];
  if (r === undefined) {
    r = new Float32Array(n);
    arrayCacheF32[n] = r;
  }
  if (nBlocks !== 0) {
    firstElem.toArray(r, 0);
    for (let i = 1, offset = 0; i !== nBlocks; ++i) {
      offset += blockSize;
      array[i].toArray(r, offset);
    }
  }
  return r;
}
function arraysEqual(a?: any, b?: any) {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
  for (let i = 0, l = a.length; i < l; i++) {
    if (a[i] !== b[i]) return false;
  }
  return true;
}
function copyArray(a?: any, b?: any) {
  for (let i = 0, l = b.length; i < l; i++) {
    a[i] = b[i];
  }
}
// Texture unit allocation
function allocTexUnits(textures?: any, n?: any) {
  let r = arrayCacheI32[n];
  if (r === undefined) {
    r = new Int32Array(n);
    arrayCacheI32[n] = r;
  }
  for (let i = 0; i !== n; ++i) {
    r[i] = textures.allocateTextureUnit();
  }
  return r;
}
// --- Setters ---
// Note: Defining these methods externally, because they come in a bunch
// and this way their names minify.
// Single scalar
function setValueV1f(this: any, gl?: any, v?: any) {
  const cache = this.cache;
  if (cache[0] === v) return;
  gl.uniform1f(this.addr, v);
  cache[0] = v;
}
// Single float vector (from flat array or THREE.VectorN)
function setValueV2f(this: any, gl?: any, v?: any) {
  const cache = this.cache;
  if (v.x !== undefined) {
    if (cache[0] !== v.x || cache[1] !== v.y) {
      gl.uniform2f(this.addr, v.x, v.y);
      cache[0] = v.x;
      cache[1] = v.y;
    }
  } else {
    if (arraysEqual(cache, v)) return;
    gl.uniform2fv(this.addr, v);
    copyArray(cache, v);
  }
}
function setValueV3f(this: any, gl?: any, v?: any) {
  const cache = this.cache;
  if (v.x !== undefined) {
    if (cache[0] !== v.x || cache[1] !== v.y || cache[2] !== v.z) {
      gl.uniform3f(this.addr, v.x, v.y, v.z);
      cache[0] = v.x;
      cache[1] = v.y;
      cache[2] = v.z;
    }
  } else if (v.r !== undefined) {
    if (cache[0] !== v.r || cache[1] !== v.g || cache[2] !== v.b) {
      gl.uniform3f(this.addr, v.r, v.g, v.b);
      cache[0] = v.r;
      cache[1] = v.g;
      cache[2] = v.b;
    }
  } else {
    if (arraysEqual(cache, v)) return;
    gl.uniform3fv(this.addr, v);
    copyArray(cache, v);
  }
}

}
// Single matrix (from flat array or THREE.MatrixN)
function setValueM2(this: any, gl?: any, v?: any) {
  const cache = this.cache;
  const elements = v.elements;
  if (elements === undefined) {
    if (arraysEqual(cache, v)) return;
    gl.uniformMatrix2fv(this.addr, false, v);
    copyArray(cache, v);
  } else {
    if (arraysEqual(cache, elements)) return;
    mat2array.set(elements);
    gl.uniformMatrix2fv(this.addr, false, mat2array);
    copyArray(cache, elements);
  }
}

function initShadowTexture(texture?: any) {
  if (texture.version === 0) {
    texture.compareFunction = Compare.Always;
    texture.needsUpdate = true;

// Single texture (2D / Cube)
function setValueT1(this: any, gl?: any, v?: any, textures?: any) {

  const unit = textures.allocateTextureUnit();
  if (cache[0] !== unit) {
    gl.uniform1i(this.addr, unit);
    cache[0] = unit;
  }
  let emptyTexture2D: any;
  if (this.type === GL.SAMPLER_2D_SHADOW) {
    emptyTexture2D = initShadowTexture(emptyShadowTexture);
  } else {
    emptyTexture2D = emptyTexture;
  }
  textures.setTexture2D(v || emptyTexture2D, unit);
}

// Helper to pick the right setter for the singular case
function getSingularSetter(type?: any) {
  switch (type) {
    case 0x1406:
      return setValueV1f; // FLOAT
    case 0x8b50:
      return setValueV2f; // _VEC2
    case 0x8b51:
      return setValueV3f; // _VEC3
    case 0x8b52:
      return setValueV4f; // _VEC4
    case 0x8b5a:
      return setValueM2; // _MAT2
    case 0x8b5b:
      return setValueM3; // _MAT3
    case 0x8b5c:
      return setValueM4; // _MAT4
    case 0x1404:
    case 0x8b56:
      return setValueV1i; // INT, BOOL
    case 0x8b53:
    case 0x8b57:
      return setValueV2i; // _VEC2
    case 0x8b54:
    case 0x8b58:
      return setValueV3i; // _VEC3
    case 0x8b55:
    case 0x8b59:
      return setValueV4i; // _VEC4
    case 0x1405:
      return setValueV1ui; // UINT
    case 0x8dc6:
      return setValueV2ui; // _VEC2
    case 0x8dc7:
      return setValueV3ui; // _VEC3
    case 0x8dc8:
      return setValueV4ui; // _VEC4
    case 0x8b5e: // SAMPLER_2D
    case 0x8d66: // SAMPLER_EXTERNAL_OES
    case 0x8dca: // INT_SAMPLER_2D
    case 0x8dd2: // UNSIGNED_INT_SAMPLER_2D
    case 0x8b62: // SAMPLER_2D_SHADOW
      return setValueT1;
    case 0x8b5f: // SAMPLER_3D

    case 0x8b60: // SAMPLER_CUBE
    case 0x8dcc: // INT_SAMPLER_CUBE
    case 0x8dd4: // UNSIGNED_INT_SAMPLER_CUBE
    case 0x8dc5: // SAMPLER_CUBE_SHADOW

    case 0x8dd7: // UNSIGNED_INT_SAMPLER_2D_ARRAY
    case 0x8dc4: // SAMPLER_2D_ARRAY_SHADOW
      return setValueT2DArray1;
  }

// --- Uniform Classes ---
class SingleUniform {
  id: any;
  addr: any;
  cache: any[];
  type: any;
  setValue: ((...args: any[]) => void) | undefined;

  constructor(id: any, activeInfo: any, addr?: any) {
    this.id = id;
    this.addr = addr;
    this.cache = [];
    this.type = activeInfo.type;
    this.setValue = getSingularSetter(activeInfo.type);
    // this.path = activeInfo.name; // DEBUG
  }
}
class PureArrayUniform {
  id: any;
  addr: any;
  cache: any[];
  type: any;
  size: any;
  setValue: ((...args: any[]) => void) | undefined;

  constructor(id: any, activeInfo: any, addr?: any) {
    this.id = id;
    this.addr = addr;
    this.cache = [];
    this.type = activeInfo.type;
    this.size = activeInfo.size;
    this.setValue = getPureArraySetter(activeInfo.type);
    // this.path = activeInfo.name; // DEBUG
  }
}
class StructuredUniform {
  id: any;
  seq: any[];
  map: any;

  constructor(id?: any) {
    this.id = id;
    this.seq = [];
    this.map = {};
  }
  setValue(gl: any, value: any, textures?: any) {
    const seq = this.seq;
    for (let i = 0, n = seq.length; i !== n; ++i) {
      const u = seq[i];
      u.setValue(gl, value[u.id], textures);
    }
  }
}
// --- Top-level ---
// Parser - builds up the property tree from the path strings
const RePathPart = /(\w+)(\])?(\[|\.)?/g;
// extracts
// 	- the identifier (member name or array index)
//  - followed by an optional right bracket (found when array index)
//  - followed by an optional left bracket or dot (type of subscript)
//
// Note: These portions can be read in a non-overlapping fashion and
// allow straightforward parsing of the hierarchy that WebGL encodes
// in the uniform names.
function addUniform(container?: any, uniformObject?: any) {
  container.seq.push(uniformObject);
  container.map[uniformObject.id] = uniformObject;
}
function parseUniform(activeInfo?: any, addr?: any, container?: any) {
  const path = activeInfo.name,
    pathLength = path.length;
  // reset RegExp object, because of the early exit of a previous run
  RePathPart.lastIndex = 0;
  while (true) {
    const match = RePathPart.exec(path)!,
      matchEnd = RePathPart.lastIndex;
    let id: any = (match as any)[1];
    const idIsIndex = (match as any)[2] === "]",
      subscript = (match as any)[3];
    if (idIsIndex) id = id | 0; // convert to integer
    if (subscript === undefined || (subscript === "[" && matchEnd + 2 === pathLength)) {
      // bare name or "pure" bottom-level array "[0]" suffix
      addUniform(
        container,
        subscript === undefined ? new SingleUniform(id, activeInfo, addr) : new PureArrayUniform(id, activeInfo, addr),
      );
      break;
    } else {
      // step into inner node / create it in case it doesn't exist
      const map = container.map;
      let next = map[id];
      if (next === undefined) {
        next = new StructuredUniform(id);
        addUniform(container, next);
      }
      container = next;
    }
  }
}
// Root Container
export class WebGLUniforms {
  seq: any[];
  map: any;

  constructor(gl: any, program?: any) {
    this.seq = [];
    this.map = {};
    const n = gl.getProgramParameter(program, GL.ACTIVE_UNIFORMS);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
      const info = gl.getActiveUniform(program, i),
        addr = gl.getUniformLocation(program, info.name);
      parseUniform(info, addr, this);
    }
    // Sort uniforms to prioritize shadow samplers first (for optimal texture unit allocation)
    const shadowSamplers: any[] = [];
    const otherUniforms: any[] = [];
    for (const u of this.seq) {
      if (
        u.type === GL.SAMPLER_2D_SHADOW ||
        u.type === GL.SAMPLER_CUBE_SHADOW ||
        u.type === GL.SAMPLER_2D_ARRAY_SHADOW
      ) {
        shadowSamplers.push(u);
      } else {
        otherUniforms.push(u);
      }
    }
    if (shadowSamplers.length > 0) {
      this.seq = shadowSamplers.concat(otherUniforms);
    }
  }
  setValue(gl: any, name: any, value: any, textures?: any) {
    const u = (this.map as any)[name];
    if (u !== undefined) u.setValue(gl, value, textures);
  }
  setOptional(gl: any, object: any, name?: any) {
    const v = object[name];
    if (v !== undefined) this.setValue(gl, name, v);
  }
  static upload(gl: any, seq: any, values: any, textures?: any) {
    for (let i = 0, n = seq.length; i !== n; ++i) {
      const u = seq[i],
        v = values[u.id];
      if (v.needsUpdate !== false) {
        // note: always updating when .needsUpdate is undefined
        u.setValue(gl, v.value, textures);
      }
    }
  }
  static seqWithValue(seq: any, values?: any) {
    const r: any[] = [];
    for (let i = 0, n = seq.length; i !== n; ++i) {
      const u = seq[i];
      if (u.id in values) r.push(u);
    }
    return r;
  }
}

## ek3d/renderers/webgl/WebGLUniformsGroups

```typescript
import { GL } from "../../GL";
import { warn } from "../../utils";
export function WebGLUniformsGroups(gl?: any, info?: any, capabilities?: any, state?: any) {
  let buffers: any = {};
  let groups: any = {};
  let updateList: any = {};
  function bind(uniformsGroup?: any, program?: any) {
    const webglProgram = program.program;
    state.uniformBlockBinding(uniformsGroup, webglProgram, (buffers as any)[uniformsGroup.id]);
  }
  function update(uniformsGroup?: any, program?: any) {
    let buffer = (buffers as any)[uniformsGroup.id];
    if (buffer === undefined) {
      prepareUniformsGroup(uniformsGroup);
      buffer = createBuffer(uniformsGroup);
      (buffers as any)[uniformsGroup.id] = buffer;
      uniformsGroup.addEventListener("dispose", onUniformsGroupsDispose);
      (groups as any)[uniformsGroup.id] = uniformsGroup;
    }
    // ensure to update the binding points/block indices mapping for this program
    const webglProgram = program.program;
    state.updateUBOMapping(uniformsGroup, webglProgram);
    // update UBO once per frame
    const frame = info.render.frame;
    if ((updateList as any)[uniformsGroup.id] !== frame) {
      updateBufferData(uniformsGroup);
      (updateList as any)[uniformsGroup.id] = frame;
    }
  }
  function createBuffer(uniformsGroup?: any) {
    const buffer = gl.createBuffer();
    const size = uniformsGroup.__size;
    const usage = uniformsGroup.usage;
    gl.bindBuffer(GL.UNIFORM_BUFFER, buffer);
    gl.bufferData(GL.UNIFORM_BUFFER, size, usage);
    gl.bindBuffer(GL.UNIFORM_BUFFER, null);
    return buffer;
  }
  function updateBufferData(uniformsGroup?: any) {
    const buffer = (buffers as any)[uniformsGroup.id];
    const uniforms = uniformsGroup.uniforms;
    const cache = uniformsGroup.__cache;
    gl.bindBuffer(GL.UNIFORM_BUFFER, buffer);
    for (let i = 0, il = uniforms.length; i < il; i++) {
      const uniformItem = uniforms[i];
      if (Array.isArray(uniformItem)) {
        for (let j = 0, jl = uniformItem.length; j < jl; j++) {
          updateUniform(uniformItem[j], i, j, cache);
        }
      } else {
        updateUniform(uniformItem, i, 0, cache);
      }
    }
    gl.bindBuffer(GL.UNIFORM_BUFFER, null);
  }
  function updateUniform(uniform?: any, index?: any, indexArray?: any, cache?: any) {
    if (hasUniformChanged(uniform, index, indexArray, cache) === true) {
      const offset = uniform.__offset;
      const value = uniform.value;
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        let arrayOffset = 0;
        for (let k = 0; k < value.length; k++) {
          const val = value[k];
          const info = getUniformSize(val, true);
          writeUniformValue(val, uniform.__data, arrayOffset);
          arrayOffset += info.storage / Float32Array.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT;
        }
      } else {
        writeUniformValue(value, uniform.__data, 0);
      }
      gl.bufferSubData(GL.UNIFORM_BUFFER, offset, uniform.__data);
    }
  }
  function writeUniformValue(value?: any, data?: any, offset?: any) {
    // TODO add integer vector and struct support
    if (typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "boolean") {
      data[offset] = value;
    } else if (value.isMatrix3) {
      // manually converting 3x3 to 3x4
      data[offset] = value.elements[0];
      data[offset + 1] = value.elements[1];
      data[offset + 2] = value.elements[2];
      data[offset + 3] = 0;
      data[offset + 4] = value.elements[3];
      data[offset + 5] = value.elements[4];
      data[offset + 6] = value.elements[5];
      data[offset + 7] = 0;
      data[offset + 8] = value.elements[6];
      data[offset + 9] = value.elements[7];
      data[offset + 10] = value.elements[8];
      data[offset + 11] = 0;
    } else if (ArrayBuffer.isView(value)) {
      // copy the buffer data using "set"
      data.set((value as any).subarray(0, data.length - offset), offset);
    } else {
      value.toArray(data, offset);
    }
  }
  function hasUniformChanged(uniform?: any, index?: any, indexArray?: any, cache?: any) {
    const value = uniform.value;
    const indexString = index + "_" + indexArray;
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      // arrays are cached per element
      if (cache[indexString] === undefined) cache[indexString] = [];
      const cachedArray = cache[indexString];
      let changed = false;
      for (let k = 0; k < value.length; k++) {
        if (hasValueChanged(value[k], cachedArray, k) === true) changed = true;
      }
      return changed;
    }
    return hasValueChanged(value, cache, indexString);
  }
  function hasValueChanged(value?: any, cache?: any, key?: any) {
    if (cache[key] === undefined) {
      // cache entry does not exist so far
      if (typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "boolean") {
        cache[key] = value;
      } else if (ArrayBuffer.isView(value)) {
        cache[key] = (value as any).slice();
      } else {
        cache[key] = value.clone();
      }
      return true;
    } else {
      const cachedObject = cache[key];
      // compare current value with cached entry
      if (typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "boolean") {
        if (cachedObject !== value) {
          cache[key] = value;
          return true;
        }
      } else if (ArrayBuffer.isView(value)) {
        // always update the array buffers
        return true;
      } else {
        if (cachedObject.equals(value) === false) {
          cachedObject.copy(value);
          return true;
        }
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
  function prepareUniformsGroup(this: any, uniformsGroup?: any) {
    // determine total buffer size according to the STD140 layout
    // Hint: STD140 is the only supported layout in WebGL 2
    const uniforms = uniformsGroup.uniforms;
    let offset = 0; // global buffer offset in bytes
    const chunkSize = 16; // size of a chunk in bytes
    for (let i = 0, l = uniforms.length; i < l; i++) {
      const uniformArray = Array.isArray(uniforms[i]) ? uniforms[i] : [uniforms[i]];
      for (let j = 0, jl = uniformArray.length; j < jl; j++) {
        const uniform = uniformArray[j];
        const values = Array.isArray(uniform.value) ? uniform.value : [uniform.value];
        // arrays of uniforms and uniforms with array values both represent GLSL arrays
        const isArray = Array.isArray(uniforms[i]) || Array.isArray(uniform.value);
        let start = offset;
        for (let k = 0, kl = values.length; k < kl; k++) {
          const value = values[k];
          const info = getUniformSize(value, isArray);
          const chunkOffset = offset % chunkSize; // offset in the current chunk
          const chunkPadding = chunkOffset % info.boundary; // required padding to match boundary
          const chunkStart = chunkOffset + chunkPadding; // the start position in the current chunk for the data
          offset += chunkPadding;
          // Check for chunk overflow
          if (chunkStart !== 0 && chunkSize - chunkStart < info.storage) {
            // Add padding and adjust offset
            offset += chunkSize - chunkStart;
          }
          if (k === 0) start = offset;
          // Update the global offset
          offset += info.storage;
        }
        // the following two properties will be used for partial buffer updates
        const ArrayType = uniform.type === "int" ? Int32Array : uniform.type === "uint" ? Uint32Array : Float32Array;
        uniform.__data = new ArrayType((offset - start) / Float32Array.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT);
        uniform.__offset = start;
      }
    }
    // ensure correct final padding
    const chunkOffset = offset % chunkSize;
    if (chunkOffset > 0) offset += chunkSize - chunkOffset;
    //
    uniformsGroup.__size = offset;
    uniformsGroup.__cache = {};
    return this;
  }
  function getUniformSize(value?: any, isArrayElement?: any) {
    const info: any = {
      boundary: 0, // bytes
      storage: 0, // bytes
    };
    // determine sizes according to STD140
    if (typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "boolean") {
      // float/int/bool
      info.boundary = 4;
      info.storage = 4;
    } else if (value.isVector2) {
      // vec2
      info.boundary = 8;
      info.storage = 8;
    } else if (value.isVector3 || value.isColor) {
      // vec3
      info.boundary = 16;
      info.storage = 12; // evil: vec3 must start on a 16-byte boundary but it only consumes 12 bytes
    } else if (value.isVector4) {
      // vec4
      info.boundary = 16;
      info.storage = 16;
    } else if (value.isMatrix3) {
      // mat3 (in STD140 a 3x3 matrix is represented as 3x4)
      info.boundary = 16;
      info.storage = 48;
    } else if (value.isMatrix4) {
      // mat4
      info.boundary = 16;
      info.storage = 64;
    } else if (value.isTexture) {
      warn("WebGLRenderer: Texture samplers can not be part of an uniforms group.");
    } else if (ArrayBuffer.isView(value)) {
      info.boundary = 16;
      info.storage = value.byteLength;
    } else {
      warn("WebGLRenderer: Unsupported uniform value type.", value);
    }
    if (isArrayElement === true) {
      // the alignment and stride of array elements are rounded up to the size of a vec4
      info.boundary = 16;
      info.storage = Math.ceil(info.storage / 16) * 16;
    }
    return info;
  }
  function onUniformsGroupsDispose(event?: any) {
    const uniformsGroup = event.target;
    uniformsGroup.removeEventListener("dispose", onUniformsGroupsDispose);
    delete (groups as any)[uniformsGroup.id];
    gl.deleteBuffer((buffers as any)[uniformsGroup.id]);
    delete (buffers as any)[uniformsGroup.id];
    delete (updateList as any)[uniformsGroup.id];
  }
  function dispose() {
    for (const id in buffers) {
      (groups as any)[id].removeEventListener("dispose", onUniformsGroupsDispose);
      gl.deleteBuffer((buffers as any)[id]);
    }
    buffers = {};
    groups = {};
    updateList = {};
  }
  return {
    bind: bind,
    update: update,
    dispose: dispose,
  };
}
```

## ek3d/renderers/webgl/WebGLUtils

```typescript
import { GL } from "../../GL";
import { PixelFormat, TextureType, ColorSpace, Transfer } from "../../constants";
import { ColorManagement } from "../../math/ColorManagement";
export function WebGLUtils(gl?: any, extensions?: any) {
  function convert(p?: any, colorSpace: string = ColorSpace.No) {
    let extension: any;
    const transfer = ColorManagement.getTransfer(colorSpace);
    if (p === TextureType.UnsignedByte) return GL.UNSIGNED_BYTE;
    if (p === TextureType.UnsignedShort4444) return GL.UNSIGNED_SHORT_4_4_4_4;
    if (p === TextureType.UnsignedShort5551) return GL.UNSIGNED_SHORT_5_5_5_1;
    if (p === TextureType.UnsignedInt5999) return GL.UNSIGNED_INT_5_9_9_9_REV;
    if (p === TextureType.UnsignedInt101111) return GL.UNSIGNED_INT_10F_11F_11F_REV;
    if (p === TextureType.Byte) return GL.BYTE;
    if (p === TextureType.Short) return GL.SHORT;
    if (p === TextureType.UnsignedShort) return GL.UNSIGNED_SHORT;
    if (p === TextureType.Int) return GL.INT;
    if (p === TextureType.UnsignedInt) return GL.UNSIGNED_INT;
    if (p === TextureType.Float) return GL.FLOAT;
    if (p === TextureType.HalfFloat) return GL.HALF_FLOAT;
    if (p === PixelFormat.Alpha) return GL.ALPHA;
    if (p === PixelFormat.RGB) return GL.RGB;
    if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA) return GL.RGBA;
    if (p === PixelFormat.Depth) return GL.DEPTH_COMPONENT;
    if (p === PixelFormat.DepthStencil) return GL.DEPTH_STENCIL;
    // WebGL2 formats.
    if (p === PixelFormat.Red) return GL.RED;
    if (p === PixelFormat.RedInteger) return GL.RED_INTEGER;
    if (p === PixelFormat.RG) return GL.RG;
    if (p === PixelFormat.RGInteger) return GL.RG_INTEGER;
    if (p === PixelFormat.RGBAInteger) return GL.RGBA_INTEGER;
    // S3TC
    if (
      p === PixelFormat.RGB_S3TC_DXT1 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_S3TC_DXT1 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_S3TC_DXT3 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_S3TC_DXT5
    ) {
      if (transfer === Transfer.SRGB) {
        extension = extensions.get("WEBGL_compressed_texture_s3tc_srgb");
        if (extension !== null) {
          if (p === PixelFormat.RGB_S3TC_DXT1) return extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB_S3TC_DXT1_EXT;
          if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_S3TC_DXT1) return extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB_ALPHA_S3TC_DXT1_EXT;
          if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_S3TC_DXT3) return extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB_ALPHA_S3TC_DXT3_EXT;
          if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_S3TC_DXT5) return extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB_ALPHA_S3TC_DXT5_EXT;
        } else {
          return null;
        }
      } else {
        extension = extensions.get("WEBGL_compressed_texture_s3tc");
        if (extension !== null) {
          if (p === PixelFormat.RGB_S3TC_DXT1) return extension.COMPRESSED_RGB_S3TC_DXT1_EXT;
          if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_S3TC_DXT1) return extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_S3TC_DXT1_EXT;
          if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_S3TC_DXT3) return extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_S3TC_DXT3_EXT;
          if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_S3TC_DXT5) return extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_S3TC_DXT5_EXT;
        } else {
          return null;
        }
      }
    }
    // PVRTC
    if (
      p === PixelFormat.RGB_PVRTC_4BPPV1 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGB_PVRTC_2BPPV1 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_PVRTC_4BPPV1 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_PVRTC_2BPPV1
    ) {
      extension = extensions.get("WEBGL_compressed_texture_pvrtc");
      if (extension !== null) {
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGB_PVRTC_4BPPV1) return extension.COMPRESSED_RGB_PVRTC_4BPPV1_IMG;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGB_PVRTC_2BPPV1) return extension.COMPRESSED_RGB_PVRTC_2BPPV1_IMG;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_PVRTC_4BPPV1) return extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_PVRTC_4BPPV1_IMG;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_PVRTC_2BPPV1) return extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_PVRTC_2BPPV1_IMG;
      } else {
        return null;
      }
    }
    // ETC
    if (
      p === PixelFormat.RGB_ETC1 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGB_ETC2 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ETC2_EAC ||
      p === PixelFormat.R11_EAC ||
      p === PixelFormat.SIGNED_R11_EAC ||
      p === PixelFormat.RG11_EAC ||
      p === PixelFormat.SIGNED_RG11_EAC
    ) {
      extension = extensions.get("WEBGL_compressed_texture_etc");
      if (extension !== null) {
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGB_ETC1 || p === PixelFormat.RGB_ETC2)
          return transfer === Transfer.SRGB ? extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB8_ETC2 : extension.COMPRESSED_RGB8_ETC2;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ETC2_EAC)
          return transfer === Transfer.SRGB
            ? extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB8_ALPHA8_ETC2_EAC
            : extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA8_ETC2_EAC;
        if (p === PixelFormat.R11_EAC) return extension.COMPRESSED_R11_EAC;
        if (p === PixelFormat.SIGNED_R11_EAC) return extension.COMPRESSED_SIGNED_R11_EAC;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RG11_EAC) return extension.COMPRESSED_RG11_EAC;
        if (p === PixelFormat.SIGNED_RG11_EAC) return extension.COMPRESSED_SIGNED_RG11_EAC;
      } else {
        return null;
      }
    }
    // ASTC
    if (
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_4x4 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_5x4 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_5x5 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_6x5 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_6x6 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_8x5 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_8x6 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_8x8 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_10x5 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_10x6 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_10x8 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_10x10 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_12x10 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_12x12
    ) {
      extension = extensions.get("WEBGL_compressed_texture_astc");
      if (extension !== null) {
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_4x4)
          return transfer === Transfer.SRGB
            ? extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB8_ALPHA8_ASTC_4x4_KHR
            : extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_ASTC_4x4_KHR;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_5x4)
          return transfer === Transfer.SRGB
            ? extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB8_ALPHA8_ASTC_5x4_KHR
            : extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_ASTC_5x4_KHR;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_5x5)
          return transfer === Transfer.SRGB
            ? extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB8_ALPHA8_ASTC_5x5_KHR
            : extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_ASTC_5x5_KHR;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_6x5)
          return transfer === Transfer.SRGB
            ? extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB8_ALPHA8_ASTC_6x5_KHR
            : extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_ASTC_6x5_KHR;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_6x6)
          return transfer === Transfer.SRGB
            ? extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB8_ALPHA8_ASTC_6x6_KHR
            : extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_ASTC_6x6_KHR;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_8x5)
          return transfer === Transfer.SRGB
            ? extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB8_ALPHA8_ASTC_8x5_KHR
            : extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_ASTC_8x5_KHR;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_8x6)
          return transfer === Transfer.SRGB
            ? extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB8_ALPHA8_ASTC_8x6_KHR
            : extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_ASTC_8x6_KHR;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_8x8)
          return transfer === Transfer.SRGB
            ? extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB8_ALPHA8_ASTC_8x8_KHR
            : extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_ASTC_8x8_KHR;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_10x5)
          return transfer === Transfer.SRGB
            ? extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB8_ALPHA8_ASTC_10x5_KHR
            : extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_ASTC_10x5_KHR;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_10x6)
          return transfer === Transfer.SRGB
            ? extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB8_ALPHA8_ASTC_10x6_KHR
            : extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_ASTC_10x6_KHR;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_10x8)
          return transfer === Transfer.SRGB
            ? extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB8_ALPHA8_ASTC_10x8_KHR
            : extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_ASTC_10x8_KHR;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_10x10)
          return transfer === Transfer.SRGB
            ? extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB8_ALPHA8_ASTC_10x10_KHR
            : extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_ASTC_10x10_KHR;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_12x10)
          return transfer === Transfer.SRGB
            ? extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB8_ALPHA8_ASTC_12x10_KHR
            : extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_ASTC_12x10_KHR;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_ASTC_12x12)
          return transfer === Transfer.SRGB
            ? extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB8_ALPHA8_ASTC_12x12_KHR
            : extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_ASTC_12x12_KHR;
      } else {
        return null;
      }
    }
    // BPTC
    if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_BPTC || p === PixelFormat.RGB_BPTC_SIGNED || p === PixelFormat.RGB_BPTC_UNSIGNED) {
      extension = extensions.get("EXT_texture_compression_bptc");
      if (extension !== null) {
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGBA_BPTC)
          return transfer === Transfer.SRGB
            ? extension.COMPRESSED_SRGB_ALPHA_BPTC_UNORM_EXT
            : extension.COMPRESSED_RGBA_BPTC_UNORM_EXT;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGB_BPTC_SIGNED) return extension.COMPRESSED_RGB_BPTC_SIGNED_FLOAT_EXT;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RGB_BPTC_UNSIGNED) return extension.COMPRESSED_RGB_BPTC_UNSIGNED_FLOAT_EXT;
      } else {
        return null;
      }
    }
    // RGTC
    if (
      p === PixelFormat.RED_RGTC1 ||
      p === PixelFormat.SIGNED_RED_RGTC1 ||
      p === PixelFormat.RED_GREEN_RGTC2 ||
      p === PixelFormat.SIGNED_RED_GREEN_RGTC2
    ) {
      extension = extensions.get("EXT_texture_compression_rgtc");
      if (extension !== null) {
        if (p === PixelFormat.RED_RGTC1) return extension.COMPRESSED_RED_RGTC1_EXT;
        if (p === PixelFormat.SIGNED_RED_RGTC1) return extension.COMPRESSED_SIGNED_RED_RGTC1_EXT;
        if (p === PixelFormat.RED_GREEN_RGTC2) return extension.COMPRESSED_RED_GREEN_RGTC2_EXT;
        if (p === PixelFormat.SIGNED_RED_GREEN_RGTC2) return extension.COMPRESSED_SIGNED_RED_GREEN_RGTC2_EXT;
      } else {
        return null;
      }
    }
    //
    if (p === TextureType.UnsignedInt248) return GL.UNSIGNED_INT_24_8;
    // if "p" can't be resolved, assume the user defines a WebGL constant as a string (fallback/workaround for packed RGB formats)
    return gl[p] !== undefined ? gl[p] : null;
  }
  return { convert: convert };
}

## ek3d/scenes/Fog

````typescript
import { Color } from "../math/Color";
/**
 * This class can be used to define a linear fog that grows linearly denser
 * with the distance.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { Fog } from 'ek3d/scenes/Fog';
 * import { Scene } from 'ek3d/scenes/Scene';
 *
 * const scene = new Scene();
 * scene.fog = new Fog( 0xcccccc, 10, 15 );
 * ```
 */
export class Fog {
  isFog: boolean;
  name: string;
  color: Color;
  near: number;
  far: number;

  /**
   * Constructs a new fog.
   *
   * @param color - The fog's color.
   * @param [near=1] - The minimum distance to start applying fog.
   * @param [far=1000] - The maximum distance at which fog stops being calculated and applied.
   */
  constructor(color: Color | number | string, near: number = 1, far: number = 1000) {
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isFog = true;
    /**
     * The name of the fog.
     *
     */
    this.name = "";
    /**
     * The fog's color.
     *
     */
    this.color = new Color(color);
    /**
     * The minimum distance to start applying fog. Objects that are less than
     * `near` units from the active camera won't be affected by fog.
     *
     * @default 1
     */
    this.near = near;
    /**
     * The maximum distance at which fog stops being calculated and applied.
     * Objects that are more than `far` units away from the active camera won't
     * be affected by fog.
     *
     * @default 1000
     */
    this.far = far;
  }
  /**
   * Returns a new fog with copied values from this instance.
   *
   * @return A clone of this instance.
   */
  clone(): Fog {
    return new Fog(this.color, this.near, this.far);
  }
  /**
   * Serializes the fog into JSON.
   *
   * @param meta - An optional value holding meta information about the serialization.
   * @return A JSON object representing the serialized fog
   */
  toJSON(/* meta */) {
    return {
      type: "Fog",
      name: this.name,
      color: this.color.getHex(),
      near: this.near,
      far: this.far,
    };
  }
}
````

     * This flag can be used for type testing.

     * The name of the fog.

     */

     * The fog's color.

     *  Defines how fast the fog will grow dense.

## ek3d/scenes/Scene

```typescript
import type { Color } from "../math/Color";
import type { Fog } from "./Fog";
import type { FogExp2 } from "./FogExp2";
import type { Material } from "../materials/Material";
import type { Texture } from "../textures/Texture";
import { Object3D } from "../core/Object3D";
import { Euler } from "../math/Euler";
/**
 * Scenes allow you to set up what is to be rendered and where by three.js.
 * This is where you place 3D objects like meshes, lines or lights.
 *
 */
export class Scene extends Object3D {
  isScene: boolean;

  background: Color | Texture | null;
  environment: Texture | null;
  fog: Fog | FogExp2 | null;
  backgroundBlurriness: number;
  backgroundIntensity: number;
  backgroundRotation: Euler;
  environmentIntensity: number;
  environmentRotation: Euler;
  overrideMaterial: Material | null;

  /**
   * Constructs a new scene.
   */
  constructor() {
    super();
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isScene = true;
    this.type = "Scene";
    /**
     * Defines the background of the scene. Valid inputs are:
     *
     * - A color for defining a uniform colored background.
     * - A texture for defining a (flat) textured background.
     * - Cube textures or equirectangular textures for defining a skybox.
     *
     * @default null
     */
    this.background = null;
    /**
     * Sets the environment map for all physical materials in the scene. However,
     * it's not possible to overwrite an existing texture assigned to the `envMap`
     * material property.
     *
     * @default null
     */
    this.environment = null;
    /**
     * A fog instance defining the type of fog that affects everything
     * rendered in the scene.
     *
     * @default null
     */
    this.fog = null;
    /**
     * Sets the blurriness of the background. Only influences environment maps
     * assigned to {@link Scene#background}. Valid input is a float between `0`
     * and `1`.
     *
     * @default 0
     */
    this.backgroundBlurriness = 0;
    /**
     * Attenuates the color of the background. Only applies to background textures.
     *
     * @default 1
     */
    this.backgroundIntensity = 1;
    /**
     * The rotation of the background in radians. Only influences environment maps
     * assigned to {@link Scene#background}.
     *
     * @default (0,0,0)
     */
    this.backgroundRotation = new Euler();
    /**
     * Attenuates the color of the environment. Only influences environment maps
     * assigned to {@link Scene#environment}.
     *
     * @default 1
     */
    this.environmentIntensity = 1;
    /**
     * The rotation of the environment map in radians. Only influences physical materials
     * in the scene when {@link Scene#environment} is used.
     *
     * @default (0,0,0)
     */
    this.environmentRotation = new Euler();
    /**
     * Forces everything in the scene to be rendered with the defined material. It is possible
     * to exclude materials from override by setting {@link Material#allowOverride} to `false`.
     *
     * @default null
     */
    this.overrideMaterial = null;
  }
  copy(source: any, recursive?: any): this {
    super.copy(source, recursive);
    this.background = source.background !== null ? source.background.clone() : null;
    this.environment = source.environment !== null ? source.environment.clone() : null;
    this.fog = source.fog !== null ? source.fog.clone() : null;
    this.backgroundBlurriness = source.backgroundBlurriness;
    this.backgroundIntensity = source.backgroundIntensity;
    this.backgroundRotation.copy(source.backgroundRotation);
    this.environmentIntensity = source.environmentIntensity;
    this.environmentRotation.copy(source.environmentRotation);
    this.overrideMaterial = source.overrideMaterial !== null ? source.overrideMaterial.clone() : null;
    this.matrixAutoUpdate = source.matrixAutoUpdate;
    return this;
  }
  toJSON(meta?: any) {
    const data = super.toJSON(meta);
    if (this.fog !== null) data.object.fog = this.fog.toJSON();
    data.object.backgroundBlurriness = this.backgroundBlurriness;
    data.object.backgroundIntensity = this.backgroundIntensity;
    data.object.backgroundRotation = this.backgroundRotation.toArray();
    data.object.environmentIntensity = this.environmentIntensity;
    data.object.environmentRotation = this.environmentRotation.toArray();
    return data;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/textures/CanvasTexture

```typescript
import { Mapping, Wrapping, TextureFilter, PixelFormat, TextureType } from "../constants";
import { Texture } from "./Texture";
/**
 * Creates a texture from a canvas element.
 *
 * This is almost the same as the base texture class, except that it sets {@link Texture#needsUpdate}
 * to `true` immediately since a canvas can directly be used for rendering.
 *
 */
export class CanvasTexture extends Texture {
  isCanvasTexture: boolean;

  /**
   * Constructs a new texture.
   *
   * @param [canvas] - The HTML canvas element.
   * @param [mapping=Texture.DEFAULT_MAPPING] - The texture mapping.
   * @param [wrapS=Wrapping.ClampToEdge] - The wrapS value.
   * @param [wrapT=Wrapping.ClampToEdge] - The wrapT value.
   * @param [magFilter=TextureFilter.Linear] - The mag filter value.
   * @param [minFilter=TextureFilter.LinearMipmapLinear] - The min filter value.
   * @param [format=PixelFormat.RGBA] - The texture format.
   * @param [type=TextureType.UnsignedByte] - The texture type.
   * @param [anisotropy=Texture.DEFAULT_ANISOTROPY] - The anisotropy value.
   */
  constructor(
    canvas?: HTMLCanvasElement | OffscreenCanvas,
    mapping?: Mapping,
    wrapS?: Wrapping,
    wrapT?: Wrapping,
    magFilter?: TextureFilter,
    minFilter?: TextureFilter,
    format?: PixelFormat,
    type?: TextureType,
    anisotropy?: number,
  ) {
    super(canvas, mapping, wrapS, wrapT, magFilter, minFilter, format, type, anisotropy);
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isCanvasTexture = true;
    this.needsUpdate = true;
  }

  get image(): HTMLCanvasElement | OffscreenCanvas | null {
    return this.source.data;
  }

  set image(value: CanvasTexture["image"]) {
    this.source.data = value;
  }
}

## ek3d/textures/CompressedArrayTexture

```typescript
import type { CompressedTextureMipmap } from "./CompressedTexture";

import { Wrapping, PixelFormat, TextureType } from "../constants";
import { CompressedTexture } from "./CompressedTexture";
/**
 * Creates a texture 2D array based on data in compressed form.
 *
 * These texture are usually loaded with {@link CompressedTextureLoader}.
 *
 */
export class CompressedArrayTexture extends CompressedTexture {
  isCompressedArrayTexture: boolean;
  wrapR: Wrapping;
  layerUpdates: Set<number>;

  /**
   * Constructs a new compressed array texture.
   *
   * @param mipmaps - This array holds for all mipmaps (including the bases mip)
   * the data and dimensions.
   * @param width - The width of the texture.
   * @param height - The height of the texture.
   * @param depth - The depth of the texture.
   * @param [format=PixelFormat.RGBA] - The min filter value.
   * @param [type=TextureType.UnsignedByte] - The min filter value.
   */
  constructor(
    mipmaps: CompressedTextureMipmap[],
    width: number,
    height: number,
    depth: number,
    format?: PixelFormat,
    type?: TextureType,
  ) {
    super(mipmaps, width, height, format, type);
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isCompressedArrayTexture = true;
    /**
     * The image property of a compressed texture just defines its dimensions.
     *
     * @name CompressedArrayTexture#image
     */
    this.image.depth = depth;
    /**
     * This defines how the texture is wrapped in the depth and corresponds to
     * *W* in UVW mapping.
     *
     * @default Wrapping.ClampToEdge
     */
    this.wrapR = Wrapping.ClampToEdge;
    /**
     * A set of all layers which need to be updated in the texture.
     *
     */
    this.layerUpdates = new Set();
  }
  /**
   * Copies the values of the given texture to this instance.
   *
   * @param source - The texture to copy.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  copy(source: CompressedArrayTexture & Pick<this, "image" | "mipmaps">): this {
    super.copy(source);
    this.wrapR = source.wrapR;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Describes that a specific layer of the texture needs to be updated.
   * Normally when {@link Texture#needsUpdate} is set to `true`, the
   * entire compressed texture array is sent to the GPU. Marking specific
   * layers will only transmit subsets of all mipmaps associated with a
   * specific depth in the array which is often much more performant.
   *
   * @param layerIndex - The layer index that should be updated.
   */
  addLayerUpdate(layerIndex: number) {
    this.layerUpdates.add(layerIndex);
  }
  /**
   * Resets the layer updates registry.
   */
  clearLayerUpdates() {
    this.layerUpdates.clear();
  }

  get image(): { width: number; height: number; depth: number } {
    return this.source.data;
  }

  set image(value: CompressedArrayTexture["image"]) {
    this.source.data = value;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/textures/CompressedTexture

```typescript
import { Mapping, Wrapping, TextureFilter, PixelFormat, TextureType } from "../constants";
import { Texture } from "./Texture";
export interface CompressedTextureMipmap {
  data:
    | Int8Array
    | Uint8Array
    | Uint8ClampedArray
    | Int16Array
    | Uint16Array
    | Int32Array
    | Uint32Array
    | Float32Array
    | Float64Array;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}
export interface CompressedTextureFace {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  mipmaps: CompressedTextureMipmap[];
}
/**
 * Creates a texture based on data in compressed form.
 *
 * These texture are usually loaded with {@link CompressedTextureLoader}.
 *
 */
export class CompressedTexture extends Texture<CompressedTextureMipmap> {
  isCompressedTexture: boolean;

  /**
   * Constructs a new compressed texture.
   *
   * @param [mipmaps=[]] - This array holds for all mipmaps (including the bases mip)
   * the data and dimensions.
   * @param width - The width of the texture.
   * @param height - The height of the texture.
   * @param [format=PixelFormat.RGBA] - The texture format.
   * @param [type=TextureType.UnsignedByte] - The texture type.
   * @param [mapping=Texture.DEFAULT_MAPPING] - The texture mapping.
   * @param [wrapS=Wrapping.ClampToEdge] - The wrapS value.
   * @param [wrapT=Wrapping.ClampToEdge] - The wrapT value.
   * @param [magFilter=TextureFilter.Linear] - The mag filter value.
   * @param [minFilter=TextureFilter.LinearMipmapLinear] - The min filter value.
   * @param [anisotropy=Texture.DEFAULT_ANISOTROPY] - The anisotropy value.
   * @param [colorSpace=ColorSpace.No] - The color space.
   */
  constructor(
    mipmaps: CompressedTextureMipmap[] = [],
    width?: number,
    height?: number,
    format?: PixelFormat,
    type?: TextureType,
    mapping?: Mapping,
    wrapS?: Wrapping,
    wrapT?: Wrapping,
    magFilter?: TextureFilter,
    minFilter?: TextureFilter,
    anisotropy?: number,
    colorSpace?: string,
  ) {
    super(null, mapping, wrapS, wrapT, magFilter, minFilter, format, type, anisotropy, colorSpace);
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isCompressedTexture = true;
    /**
     * The image property of a compressed texture just defines its dimensions.
     *
     */
    this.image = { width: width, height: height };
    /**
     * This array holds for all mipmaps (including the bases mip) the data and dimensions.
     *
     */
    this.mipmaps = mipmaps;
    /**
     * If set to `true`, the texture is flipped along the vertical axis when
     * uploaded to the GPU.
     *
     * Overwritten and set to `false` by default since it is not possible to
     * flip compressed textures.
     *
     * @default false
     * @readonly
     */
    this.flipY = false;
    /**
     * Whether to generate mipmaps (if possible) for a texture.
     *
     * Overwritten and set to `false` by default since it is not
     * possible to generate mipmaps for compressed data. Mipmaps
     * must be embedded in the compressed texture file.
     *
     * @default false
     * @readonly
     */
    this.generateMipmaps = false;
  }

  get image(): { width: number | undefined; height: number | undefined } | CompressedTextureFace[] {
    return this.source.data;
  }

  set image(value: CompressedTexture["image"]) {
    this.source.data = value;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/textures/CubeDepthTexture

```typescript
import { DepthTexture } from "./DepthTexture";
import { Mapping, TextureFilter, TextureType, PixelFormat, Wrapping } from "../constants";
/**
 * This class can be used to automatically save the depth information of a
 * cube rendering into a cube texture with depth format. Used for PointLight shadows.
 *
 */
export class CubeDepthTexture extends DepthTexture {
  isCubeDepthTexture: boolean;
  isCubeTexture: boolean;

  /**
   * Constructs a new cube depth texture.
   *
   * @param size - The size (width and height) of each cube face.
   * @param [type=TextureType.UnsignedInt] - The texture type.
   * @param [mapping=Mapping.CubeReflection] - The texture mapping.
   * @param [wrapS=Wrapping.ClampToEdge] - The wrapS value.
   * @param [wrapT=Wrapping.ClampToEdge] - The wrapT value.
   * @param [magFilter=TextureFilter.Nearest] - The mag filter value.
   * @param [minFilter=TextureFilter.Nearest] - The min filter value.
   * @param [anisotropy=Texture.DEFAULT_ANISOTROPY] - The anisotropy value.
   * @param [format=PixelFormat.Depth] - The texture format.
   */
  constructor(
    size: number,
    type: TextureType = TextureType.UnsignedInt,
    mapping: Mapping = Mapping.CubeReflection,
    wrapS?: Wrapping,
    wrapT?: Wrapping,
    magFilter: TextureFilter = TextureFilter.Nearest,
    minFilter: TextureFilter = TextureFilter.Nearest,
    anisotropy?: number,
    format: PixelFormat = PixelFormat.Depth,
  ) {
    // Create 6 identical image descriptors for the cube faces
    const image: any = { width: size, height: size, depth: 1 };
    const images = [image, image, image, image, image, image];
    // Call DepthTexture constructor with width, height
    super(size, size, type, mapping, wrapS, wrapT, magFilter, minFilter, anisotropy, format);
    // Replace the single image with the array of 6 images
    this.image = images;
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isCubeDepthTexture = true;
    /**
     * Set to true for cube texture handling in WebGLTextures.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isCubeTexture = true;
  }
  /**
   * Alias for {@link CubeDepthTexture#image}.
   *
   */
  get images(): CubeDepthTexture["image"] {
    return this.image;
  }
  set images(value: CubeDepthTexture["image"]) {
    this.image = value;
  }

  get image(): { width: number; height: number; depth: number }[] {
    return this.source.data;
  }

  set image(value: CubeDepthTexture["image"]) {
    this.source.data = value;
  }
}

## ek3d/textures/Data3DTexture

```typescript
import { Texture } from "./Texture";
import { Wrapping, TextureFilter } from "../constants";
/**
 * Creates a three-dimensional texture from raw data, with parameters to
 * divide it into width, height, and depth.
 *
 */
export class Data3DTexture extends Texture {
  isData3DTexture: boolean;
  wrapR: Wrapping;

  /**
   * Constructs a new data array texture.
   *
   * @param [data=null] - The buffer data.
   * @param [width=1] - The width of the texture.
   * @param [height=1] - The height of the texture.
   * @param [depth=1] - The depth of the texture.
   */
  constructor(
    data:
      | (
          | Int8Array
          | Uint8Array
          | Uint8ClampedArray
          | Int16Array
          | Uint16Array
          | Int32Array
          | Uint32Array
          | Float32Array
          | Float64Array
        )
      | null = null,
    width: number = 1,
    height: number = 1,
    depth: number = 1,
  ) {
    // We're going to add .setXXX() methods for setting properties later.
    // Users can still set in Data3DTexture directly.
    //
    //	const texture = new THREE.Data3DTexture( data, width, height, depth );
    // 	texture.anisotropy = 16;
    //
    // See #14839
    super(null);
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isData3DTexture = true;
    /**
     * The image definition of a data texture.
     *
     */
    this.image = { data, width, height, depth };
    /**
     * How the texture is sampled when a texel covers more than one pixel.
     *
     * Overwritten and set to `TextureFilter.Nearest` by default.
     *
     * @default TextureFilter.Nearest
     */
    this.magFilter = TextureFilter.Nearest;
    /**
     * How the texture is sampled when a texel covers less than one pixel.
     *
     * Overwritten and set to `TextureFilter.Nearest` by default.
     *
     * @default TextureFilter.Nearest
     */
    this.minFilter = TextureFilter.Nearest;
    /**
     * This defines how the texture is wrapped in the depth and corresponds to
     * *W* in UVW mapping.
     *
     * @default Wrapping.ClampToEdge
     */
    this.wrapR = Wrapping.ClampToEdge;
    /**
     * Whether to generate mipmaps (if possible) for a texture.
     *
     * Overwritten and set to `false` by default.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.generateMipmaps = false;
    /**
     * If set to `true`, the texture is flipped along the vertical axis when
     * uploaded to the GPU.
     *
     * Overwritten and set to `false` by default.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.flipY = false;
    /**
     * Specifies the alignment requirements for the start of each pixel row in memory.
     *
     * Overwritten and set to `1` by default.
     *
     * @default 1
     */
    this.unpackAlignment = 1;
  }
  /**
   * Copies the values of the given texture to this instance.
   *
   * @param source - The texture to copy.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  copy(source: Data3DTexture & Pick<this, "image" | "mipmaps">): this {
    super.copy(source);
    this.wrapR = source.wrapR;
    return this;
  }

  get image(): {
    data:
      | (
          | Int8Array
          | Uint8Array
          | Uint8ClampedArray
          | Int16Array
          | Uint16Array
          | Int32Array
          | Uint32Array
          | Float32Array
          | Float64Array
        )
      | null;
    width: number;
    height: number;
    depth: number;
  } {
    return this.source.data;
  }

  set image(value: Data3DTexture["image"]) {
    this.source.data = value;
  }
}

     * @default false
     */
    this.generateMipmaps = false;
    /**
     * If set to `true`, the texture is flipped along the vertical axis when
     * uploaded to the GPU.
     *
     * Overwritten and set to `false` by default.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.flipY = false;
    /**
     * Specifies the alignment requirements for the start of each pixel row in memory.
     *
     * Overwritten and set to `1` by default.
     *
     * @default 1
     */
    this.unpackAlignment = 1;
    /**
     * A set of all layers which need to be updated in the texture.
     *
     */
    this.layerUpdates = new Set();
  }
  /**
   * Copies the values of the given texture to this instance.
   *
   * @param source - The texture to copy.
   * @return A reference to this instance.
   */
  copy(source: DataArrayTexture & Pick<this, "image" | "mipmaps">): this {
    super.copy(source);
    this.wrapR = source.wrapR;
    return this;
  }
  /**
   * Describes that a specific layer of the texture needs to be updated.
   * Normally when {@link Texture#needsUpdate} is set to `true`, the
   * entire data texture array is sent to the GPU. Marking specific
   * layers will only transmit subsets of all mipmaps associated with a
   * specific depth in the array which is often much more performant.
   *
   * @param layerIndex - The layer index that should be updated.
   */
  addLayerUpdate(layerIndex: number) {
    this.layerUpdates.add(layerIndex);
  }
  /**
   * Resets the layer updates registry.
   */
  clearLayerUpdates() {
    this.layerUpdates.clear();
  }

  get image(): {
    data:
      | (
          | Int8Array
          | Uint8Array
          | Uint8ClampedArray
          | Int16Array
          | Uint16Array
          | Int32Array
          | Uint32Array
          | Float32Array
          | Float64Array
        )
      | null;
    width: number;
    height: number;
    depth: number;
  } {
    return this.source.data;
  }

  set image(value: DataArrayTexture["image"]) {
    this.source.data = value;
  }
}
```

## ek3d/textures/DataTexture

```typescript
import { Texture } from "./Texture";
import { TextureFilter, Mapping, Wrapping, PixelFormat, TextureType } from "../constants";

export type DataTextureImageData =
  | Int8Array
  | Uint8Array
  | Uint8ClampedArray
  | Int16Array
  | Uint16Array
  | Int32Array
  | Uint32Array
  | Float32Array
  | Float64Array
  | null;

export interface DataTextureImage {
  data: DataTextureImageData;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

/**
 * Creates a texture directly from raw buffer data.
 *
 * The interpretation of the data depends on type and format: If the type is
 * `TextureType.UnsignedByte`, a `Uint8Array` will be useful for addressing the
 * texel data. If the format is `PixelFormat.RGBA`, data needs four values for
 * one texel; Red, Green, Blue and Alpha (typically the opacity).
 *
 */
export class DataTexture extends Texture {
  isDataTexture: boolean;

  /**
   * Constructs a new data texture.
   *
   * @param [data=null] - The buffer data.
   * @param [width=1] - The width of the texture.
   * @param [height=1] - The height of the texture.
   * @param [format=PixelFormat.RGBA] - The texture format.
   * @param [type=TextureType.UnsignedByte] - The texture type.
   * @param [mapping=Texture.DEFAULT_MAPPING] - The texture mapping.
   * @param [wrapS=Wrapping.ClampToEdge] - The wrapS value.
   * @param [wrapT=Wrapping.ClampToEdge] - The wrapT value.
   * @param [magFilter=TextureFilter.Nearest] - The mag filter value.
   * @param [minFilter=TextureFilter.Nearest] - The min filter value.
   * @param [anisotropy=Texture.DEFAULT_ANISOTROPY] - The anisotropy value.
   * @param [colorSpace=ColorSpace.No] - The color space.
   */
  constructor(
    data: DataTextureImageData = null,
    width: number = 1,
    height: number = 1,
    format?: PixelFormat,
    type?: TextureType,
    mapping?: Mapping,
    wrapS?: Wrapping,
    wrapT?: Wrapping,
    magFilter: TextureFilter = TextureFilter.Nearest,
    minFilter: TextureFilter = TextureFilter.Nearest,
    anisotropy?: number,
    colorSpace?: string,
  ) {
    super(null, mapping, wrapS, wrapT, magFilter, minFilter, format, type, anisotropy, colorSpace);
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isDataTexture = true;
    /**
     * The image definition of a data texture.
     *
     */
    this.image = { data: data, width: width, height: height };
    /**
     * Whether to generate mipmaps (if possible) for a texture.
     *
     * Overwritten and set to `false` by default.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.generateMipmaps = false;
    /**
     * If set to `true`, the texture is flipped along the vertical axis when
     * uploaded to the GPU.
     *
     * Overwritten and set to `false` by default.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.flipY = false;
    /**
     * Specifies the alignment requirements for the start of each pixel row in memory.
     *
     * Overwritten and set to `1` by default.
     *
     * @default 1
     */
    this.unpackAlignment = 1;
  }

  get image(): DataTextureImage {
    return this.source.data;
  }

  set image(value: DataTextureImage) {
    this.source.data = value;
  }
}

## ek3d/textures/DepthTexture

```typescript
import { TextureSource } from "./TextureSource";
import { Texture } from "./Texture";
import { TextureFilter, TextureType, PixelFormat, Mapping, Wrapping } from "../constants";
/**
 * This class can be used to automatically save the depth information of a
 * rendering into a texture.
 *
 */
export class DepthTexture extends Texture {
  isDepthTexture: boolean;
  compareFunction: number | null;

  /**
   * Constructs a new depth texture.
   *
   * @param width - The width of the texture.
   * @param height - The height of the texture.
   * @param [type=TextureType.UnsignedInt] - The texture type.
   * @param [mapping=Texture.DEFAULT_MAPPING] - The texture mapping.
   * @param [wrapS=Wrapping.ClampToEdge] - The wrapS value.
   * @param [wrapT=Wrapping.ClampToEdge] - The wrapT value.
   * @param [magFilter=TextureFilter.Nearest] - The mag filter value.
   * @param [minFilter=TextureFilter.Nearest] - The min filter value.
   * @param [anisotropy=Texture.DEFAULT_ANISOTROPY] - The anisotropy value.
   * @param [format=PixelFormat.Depth] - The texture format.
   * @param [depth=1] - The depth of the texture.
   */
  constructor(
    width: number,
    height: number,
    type: TextureType = TextureType.UnsignedInt,
    mapping?: Mapping,
    wrapS?: Wrapping,
    wrapT?: Wrapping,
    magFilter: TextureFilter = TextureFilter.Nearest,
    minFilter: TextureFilter = TextureFilter.Nearest,
    anisotropy?: number,
    format: PixelFormat = PixelFormat.Depth,
    depth: number = 1,
  ) {
    if (format !== PixelFormat.Depth && format !== PixelFormat.DepthStencil) {
      throw new Error("THREE.DepthTexture: format must be either THREE.DepthFormat or THREE.DepthStencilFormat");
    }
    const image: any = { width: width, height: height, depth: depth };
    super(image, mapping, wrapS, wrapT, magFilter, minFilter, format, type, anisotropy);
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isDepthTexture = true;
    /**
     * If set to `true`, the texture is flipped along the vertical axis when
     * uploaded to the GPU.
     *
     * Overwritten and set to `false` by default.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.flipY = false;
    /**
     * Whether to generate mipmaps (if possible) for a texture.
     *
     * Overwritten and set to `false` by default.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.generateMipmaps = false;
    /**
     * Code corresponding to the depth compare function.
     *
     * @default null
     */
    this.compareFunction = null;
  }
  copy(source: DepthTexture & Pick<this, "image" | "mipmaps">): this {
    super.copy(source);
    this.source = new TextureSource(Object.assign({}, source.image)); // see #30540
    this.compareFunction = source.compareFunction;
    return this;
  }
  toJSON(meta?: any) {
    const data = super.toJSON(meta);
    data.compareFunction = this.compareFunction;
    return data;
  }

  get image(): { width: number; height: number; depth: number } | { width: number; height: number; depth: number }[] {
    return this.source.data;
  }

  set image(value: DepthTexture["image"]) {
    this.source.data = value;
  }
}

## ek3d/textures/FramebufferTexture

````typescript
import { Texture } from "./Texture";
import { TextureSource } from "./TextureSource";
import { TextureFilter } from "../constants";
/**
 * This class can only be used in combination with `copyFramebufferToTexture()` methods
 * of renderers. It extracts the contents of the current bound framebuffer and provides it
 * as a texture for further usage.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import type { Camera } from 'ek3d/cameras/Camera';
 * import { Vector2 } from 'ek3d/math/Vector2';
 * import type { WebGLRenderer } from 'ek3d/renderers/WebGLRenderer';
 * import type { Scene } from 'ek3d/scenes/Scene';
 * import { FramebufferTexture } from 'ek3d/textures/FramebufferTexture';
 *
 * function copyFrame( renderer: WebGLRenderer, scene: Scene, camera: Camera ) {
 * 	const pixelRatio = renderer.getPixelRatio();
 * 	const textureSize = 128 * pixelRatio;
 * 	const frameTexture = new FramebufferTexture( textureSize, textureSize );
 *
 * 	// Calculate the start position for copying part of the frame data.
 * 	const size = renderer.getDrawingBufferSize( new Vector2() );
 * 	const vector = size.subScalar( textureSize ).multiplyScalar( 0.5 );
 *
 * 	renderer.render( scene, camera );
 *
 * 	// Copy part of the rendered frame into the framebuffer texture.
 * 	renderer.copyFramebufferToTexture( frameTexture, vector );
 * 	return frameTexture;
 * }
 * ```
 *
 */
export class FramebufferTexture extends Texture {
  isFramebufferTexture: boolean;

  /**
   * Constructs a new framebuffer texture.
   *
   * @param [width] - The width of the texture.
   * @param [height] - The height of the texture.
   */
  constructor(width?: number, height?: number) {
    super({ width, height });
    /**
     * This flag can be used for type testing.
     *
     * @readonly
     * @default true
     */
    this.isFramebufferTexture = true;
    /**
     * How the texture is sampled when a texel covers more than one pixel.
     *
     * Overwritten and set to `TextureFilter.Nearest` by default to disable filtering.
     *
     * @default TextureFilter.Nearest
     */
    this.magFilter = TextureFilter.Nearest;
    /**
     * How the texture is sampled when a texel covers less than one pixel.
     *
     * Overwritten and set to `TextureFilter.Nearest` by default to disable filtering.
     *
     * @default TextureFilter.Nearest
     */
    this.minFilter = TextureFilter.Nearest;
    /**
     * Whether to generate mipmaps (if possible) for a texture.
     *
     * Overwritten and set to `false` by default.
     *
     * @default false
     */
    this.generateMipmaps = false;
    this.needsUpdate = true;
  }
  copy(source: FramebufferTexture & Pick<this, "image" | "mipmaps">): this {
    super.copy(source);
    this.source = new TextureSource(Object.assign({}, source.image));
    return this;
  }

  get image(): { width: number; height: number } {
    return this.source.data;
  }

  set image(value: FramebufferTexture["image"]) {
    this.source.data = value;
  }
}
